Na mo yɛ ɔman kronkron ma AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn; mo na AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn ayi mo sɛ mommɛyɛ ɔman a wafa ayɛ ne dea wɔ aman a ɛwɔ asase so nyinaa mu.
Ɛnyɛ mo dodoɔ a ɛsene aman nyinaa nti na AWURADE de ne ho abɔ mo ho na wayi mo, ɛfiri sɛ mo na mosua aman nyinaa mu.
Na ɛsiane sɛ AWURADE dɔ mo na ɔdi ne ntam a ɔkaa mo nananom no soɔ nti na ɔde nsa a ɛyɛ den yii mo, na ɔgyee mo firii nkoafie firii Misraimhene Farao nsam.
Enti hunu sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn no, ɔno ne Onyankopɔn, — Onyankopɔn nokwafoɔ a ɔkora apam ne adɔeɛ ma wɔn a wɔdɔ no na wɔdi ne mmara nsɛm so kɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ apem soɔ, na ɔtua wɔn a wɔtane no ka wɔ wɔn anim na ɔsɛe wɔn; ɔnyɛ nyaa mma deɛ ɔtane no, ɔbɛtua no ka wɔ n’anim.
Enti di mmara nsɛm ne atemmudeɛ a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi so, na yɛ.
Setie mu Nhyira Na sɛ motie atemmudeɛ yi na modi so yɛ a, AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nso bɛdi apam ne adɔeɛ a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wo nananom no so ama wo, na wadɔ wo ahyira wo ama woadɔre, na wahyira wo yafunu mu aba ne w’asase so aba, w’aburoo ne wo nsa ne wo ngo ne w’anantwie mma ne wo nnwan mma, asase a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wo nananom sɛ ɔde bɛma woɔ no so.
Wɔbɛhyira wo asene aman nyinaa; ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa, anaa w’afieboa renyɛ obonini wɔ wo mu.
Na AWURADE bɛyi yadeɛ nyinaa afiri wo so, na ɔremfa Misraim yadeɛ bɔne a wonim no biara nto wo so, na ɔde bɛto wɔn a wɔtane woɔ nyinaa so.
Na sɛe aman a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wɔn bɛma woɔ no nyinaa; mma w’ani nnhu wɔn mmɔbɔ, na nsom wɔn anyame, ɛfiri sɛ ɛno bɛyɛ fidie ama wo.
Sɛ wose no w’akoma mu sɛ: Amanaman yi dɔɔso sene me, mɛyɛ dɛn na matumi matu wɔn?
Nsuro wɔn, na kae deɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn yɛɛ Farao ne Misraim nyinaa, sɔhwɛ akɛseɛ a w’ani hunuiɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ ne nsa a ɛyɛ den ne basa a watene mu a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de yii woɔ no; saa na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛyɛ aman a wosuro wɔn no nyinaa.
Nkotokurodu nso na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛsoma ama wɔakɔ wɔn mu akɔsi sɛ wɔn a wɔaka na wɔahunta no bɛsɛe w’anim.
Mma wɔn anim nnyɛ wo hu, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn wɔ wo mu, Onyankopɔn kɛseɛ a ne ho yɛ hu ne no.
Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛpamo amanaman yi afiri w’anim nkakrankakra; nsɛe wɔn prɛko, na ewiram mmoa annɔɔso wo so.
Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wɔn bɛhyɛ wo nsa, na ɔbɛma ahodwirie kɛseɛ aba wɔn mu akɔsi sɛ wɔbɛsɛeɛ.
Na ɔde wɔn ahemfo bɛhyɛ wo nsa, na woasɛe wɔn din afiri wiase; obiara rentumi nnyina w’anim de bɛkɔ akɔsi sɛ wobɛsɛe wɔn.
Wɔn anyame ahoni no, momfa ogya nhye; mma w’ani mmmere ɛho dwetɛ ne sika, na mfa bi, na ansum wo fidie, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn akyiwadeɛ.
Na mfa akyiwadeɛ nkɔ wo fie, na woanyɛ abusudeɛ sɛ ɛno; ma no nyɛ wo tane, na kyi, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ abusudeɛ.
Asetena mu ahwɛyie Mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi nyinaa monhwɛ nyɛ, na moanya nkwa, na moadɔre, na moakɔ akɔfa asase a AWURADE kaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ mo nananom no adi so.
Na kae kwan a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn maa wonantee so mfirinhyia aduanan yi ɛserɛ soɔ no nyinaa, sɛ ɔrebrɛ wo ase asɔ wo ahwɛ, na wahunu deɛ ɛwɔ w’akoma mu, sɛ wobɛdi ne mmara nsɛm so anaasɛ worenni so.
Na ɔbrɛɛ wo ase maa ɛkɔm dee wo, na ɔde mana a wonnim na wo nananom nso nnim maa wo diiɛ, na wama woahunu sɛ, ɛnyɛ aduane nko so na onipa nam bɛtena aseɛ, na adeɛ biara a ɛfiri AWURADE anomu so na onipa nam tena aseɛ.
Wo ntoma ansu wo ho, na wo nan anhonhon mfirinhyia aduanan yi mu.
Na hunu no w’akoma mu sɛ, sɛdeɛ onipa tea ne ba no, saa ara na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn tea woɔ.
Enti di AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm so, sɛ wobɛnante n’akwan soɔ na woasuro no.
Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wo rekɔ asase pa so, asase a ɛso wɔ nsubɔntene, nsuo aniwa ne atareɛ a ɛfifiri mmonhwa ne mmepɔ mu sene, asase a ayuo ne atokoɔ ne bobe ne borɔdɔma ne atoaa wɔ soɔ, asase a ɛso wɔ ngodua ne ɛwoɔ, asase a worenni so aduane na, na biribiara renhia wo wɔ soɔ, asase a n’aboɔ yɛ dadeɛ, na wɔbɛtu kɔbere afiri ne mmepɔ mu.
Na sɛ wodidi mee a, hyira AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, asase pa a ɔde ama woɔ no nti.
Hwɛ yie na wo werɛ amfiri AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn sɛ worenni ne mmara nsɛm ne n’atemmudeɛ ne n’ahyɛdeɛ a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi soɔ; na sɛ wodidi mee na wosisi adan pa tena mu, na w’anantwie ne wo nnwan dɔre, na wo dwetɛ ne wo sika dɔɔso ma wo, na adeɛ a wowɔ nyinaa dɔɔso a, hwɛ yie na w’akoma amma ne ho so, na wo werɛ amfiri AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn a ɔyii wo Misraim asase so firii nkoa fie no; ɔno na ɔdii w’anim de wo faa ɛserɛ kɛseɛ a awɔ a wɔn ano wɔ borɔ ne anyanyankyerɛ wɔ, ne nkyɛkyerɛ a nsuo nni hɔ so; ɔyii nsuo firii ɔbohemmaa botan mu maa wo; ɔde mana a wo nananom nnim maa wodii wɔ ɛserɛ so, sɛ ɔrebrɛ wo aseɛ na wasɔ wo ahwɛ, na awieeɛ no, wayɛ wo yie, na woanka no w’akoma mu sɛ: M’ahoɔden ne me nsa den na ama manya ahonyadeɛ yi, na mmom kae AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na ɔno na ɔma wo ahoɔden a wode nya wo ho, na wama n’apam a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wo nananom no atim sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ yi.
Na sɛ wo werɛ firi AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na wokɔdi anyame foforɔ akyi som wɔn na wosɔre wɔn a, medi wo adanseɛ nnɛ, sɛ sɛeɛ na mobɛsɛeɛ.
Sɛ amanaman a AWURADE sɛe wɔn firi mo anim no, saa ara na mobɛsɛeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ moantie AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn nne.
Israelfoɔ ahantan Israel, tie!
Worebɛtwa Yordan nnɛ akɔ akɔtu amanaman a wɔsoso na wɔn ho yɛ den sene woɔ, afa nkuro akɛseɛ a wɔatoto ho afasuo akɔ soro, ɔman kɛseɛ a wɔwowareɛ, Anakfoɔ mma a woni wɔn na woate wɔn ho asɛm sɛ: Hwan na ɔbɛgyina Anak mma anim?
Na hunu nnɛ sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ne deɛ ɔdi w’anim retwa, sɛ ogya a ɛhyeɛ; ɔno na ɔbɛsɛe wɔn, na wabrɛ wɔn ase, w’anim, na watu wɔn asɛe wɔn ntɛm, sɛdeɛ AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ woɔ no.
Sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn tu wɔn firi w’anim gu a, nka no w’akoma mu sɛ: Me tenenee nti na AWURADE de me baa sɛ memmɛfa asase yi; na amanaman yi abɔnefosɛm nti na AWURADE retu wɔn afiri w’anim.
Ɛnyɛ wo tenenee ne w’akoma a ɛtene nti na worekɔ akɔfa wɔn asase, na mmom amanaman yi abɔnefosɛm nti na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn retu wɔn afiri w’anim, na wama asɛm a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wo nananom, Abraham, Isak ne Yakob no atim.
Enti hunu sɛ ɛnyɛ wo tenenee nti na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de asase pa yi rema wo sɛ di soɔ, na ɔman a wɔn kɔn asene ne wo.
Kae na mma wo werɛ mmfi, sɛdeɛ wohyɛɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn abufuo ɛserɛ soɔ no; ɛfiri da a wofirii Misraim asase soɔ de bɛsii sɛ mobaa ha yi, mote ne so atua.
Na Horeb nso mohyɛɛ AWURADE abufuo, na ɛmaa ne bo fuu mo sɛ anka ɔbɛsɛe mo; ɛberɛ a meforoo bepɔ no sɛ merekɔgye aboɔpono, apam a AWURADE ne mo pameeɛ no apono no, medii bepɔ no so adaduanan awia ne anadwo, mannidi na mannom; na AWURADE maa me aboɔpono mmienu a wɔde Nyankopɔn nsateaa twerɛeɛ a nsɛm a AWURADE firii ogya mu wɔ bepɔ no so ne mo kaa no dwabɔ da no nyinaa wɔ soɔ.
Na adaduanan awia ne anadwo no wiee duro no, AWURADE de aboɔpono mmienu, apam apono no, maa me, na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Sɔre siane firi ha ntɛm, na ɔman a wokɔyii wɔn firii Misraim no adi asɛmmɔne.
Wɔadane ntɛm afiri ɔkwan a mehyɛɛ wɔn no so; wɔayɛ ohoni a wɔaguo afa.
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Mahunu ɔman yi, na hwɛ, wɔyɛ ɔman a wɔn kɔn asene; gyaa me ma mensɛe wɔn, na mempepa wɔn din mfiri asase so, na mede wo bɛyɛ ɔman a ɛyɛ den na ɛso sene wɔn.
Ɛnna medanee me ho mefirii bepɔ no so mesianeeɛ, na bepɔ no redɛre ogya, na apam apono mmienu no kurakura me nsam; na mehunui, na hwɛ, na moayɛ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn bɔne ayɛ nantwie ba a wɔaguo afa: Moamane ntɛm afiri ɔkwan a AWURADE hyɛɛ mo no so.
Ɛnna mefaa apono mmienu no meto firii me nsam guiɛ, na mebobɔɔ no wɔ mo anim.
Na mehwee AWURADE anim ase sɛ kane no, adaduanan awia ne anadwo, mannidi na mannom, mo bɔne a moyɛeɛ nyinaa, sɛ moyɛɛ deɛ ɛnyɛ wɔ AWURADE ani so de hyɛɛ no abufuo no nti.
Na mesuroo abufuhyeɛ a AWURADE anya no mo ho na ɔde rebɛsɛe mo no.
Na AWURADE tiee me saa berɛ no nso.
Na AWURADE faa Aaron ho abufuo kɛse sɛ ɔrebɛsɛe no, na mepaa kyɛw memaa Aaron nso saa berɛ no.
Na mefaa mo bɔne a moyɛeɛ a ɛne nantwie ba no, na mede ogya mehyee, na mesi meyam no muhumuhu kɔsii sɛ ɛfee sɛ mfuturo, na metoo ne mfuturo no guu asuo a ɛfiri bepɔ no so sene no mu.
Na Tabera ne Masa ne Kibrot-hataawa nso mohyɛɛ AWURADE abufuo.
Na AWURADE somaa mo firi Kades-barnea kaa sɛ: Momforo nkɔfa asase a mede mama mo no, motee AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anomu asɛm so atua, na moannye no anni, na moantie ne nne.
AWURADE anim atuatefoɔ ne mo firi da a mehunuu mo.
Na mehwee ase AWURADE anim adaduanan, awia ne anadwo.
Mehwee ase, ɛfiri sɛ na AWURADE aka sɛ ɔrebɛsɛe mo.
Ɛno nti mepaa AWURADE kyɛw sɛ: AWURADE Nyankopɔn, nsɛe wo man ne w’agyapadeɛ a wode wo kɛseyɛ agye wɔn na wode nsa a ɛyɛ den ayi wɔn afiri Misraim no.
Kae wo nkoa Abraham, Isak ne Yakob; nnane w’ani nhwɛ ɔman yi asoɔden ne wɔn amumuyɛ ne wɔn bɔne, na asase a woyii yɛn firii soɔ no sofoɔ anka sɛ: AWURADE antumi amfa wɔn ankɔ asase a ɔkaa wɔn ɛho asɛm no so, na tane a ɔtane wɔn nti na ɔde wɔn firi kɔɔ sɛ ɔrekɔkunkum wɔn ɛserɛ soɔ.
Na wɔyɛ wo man ne w’agyapadeɛ a wode wo tumi kɛseɛ ne wo nsa a woatene ayi wɔn.
Aboɔ apono no ho asɛm Saa berɛ no na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Sene aboɔpono mmienu sɛ kane deɛ no na fa foro bra me nkyɛn bepɔ no so, na yɛ dua adaka; na mɛtwerɛ nsɛm a ɛwɔ kane apono a wobobɔeɛ no soɔ no mahyɛ apono no so, na fa sie adaka no mu.
Na meyɛɛ okuo adaka, na mesenee aboɔpono mmienu sɛ kane deɛ no, na meforoo bepɔ no a apono mmienu no kura me nsam.
Na AWURADE twerɛɛ apono no so sɛ kane ntwerɛeɛ no, nsɛm du no a ɔfiri ogya no mu ka kyerɛɛ mo wɔ bepɔ no so dwabɔ da no, na ɔde maa me.
Na medanee me ho siane firii bepɔ no so, mede apono no mebɛsiee adaka a meyɛeɛ no mu, na ɛwɔ hɔ sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ me no.
Na me deɛ, megyinaa bepɔ no so sɛ kane no, adaduanan awia ne anadwo, na AWURADE tiee me saa berɛ no nso, na wampɛ sɛ ɔsɛe woɔ.
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Sɔre kɔdi ɔman no anim ma wɔntu nkɔfa asase a mekaa wɔn nananom ntam sɛ mede bɛma wɔn no.
AWURADE apɛdeɛ Na afei, Israel, ɛdeɛn na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn repɛ no wo nkyɛn?
Ɛne sɛ wobɛsuro AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na wonante n’akwan nyinaa soɔ, na woadɔ no, na wode w’akoma nyinaa ne wo kra nyinaa asom AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na woadi ne mmara nsɛm ne n’ahyɛdeɛ a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi soɔ, na asi wo yie.
Hwɛ, ɔsoro ne ɔsoro mu soro yɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn dea, asase ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa.
Nanso wo nananom nko na AWURADE bata wɔn ho sɛ ɔbɛdɔ wɔn, na wayi wɔn asefoɔ a wɔdi wɔn akyire a ɛne mo, afiri aman nyinaa mu, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ yi.
Enti montwitwa mo akoma twetia, na monnsene mo kɔn bio.
Na AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn yɛ anyame mu Nyankopɔn, ne Awurade mu Awurade, Onyankopɔn kɛseɛ no, Otumfoɔ a ne ho yɛ hu a ɔnhwɛ nnipa anim na ɔnnye adanmudeɛ; ɔbu atɛn ma awisiaa ne okunafoɔ, na ɔdɔ ɔhɔhoɔ ma no aduane ne nkataho.
Enti monnɔ ahɔhoɔ, ɛfiri sɛ moyɛɛ ahɔhoɔ Misraim asase so.
AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn na suro no, ɔno na som no, na ne ho na bata, na ne din ho ntam na ka.
Ɔno ne w’ayeyie, na ɔne wo Nyankopɔn a wayɛ nnoɔma akɛseɛ a ɛyɛ hu a w’ani ahunu yi ama woɔ.
Akra aduɔson na wo nananom de siane kɔɔ Misraim, afei AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ayɛ wo dodoɔ sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma.
Ɔsetie ho kɔkɔbɔ Enti dɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na hwɛ n’ahwɛdeɛ, n’ahyɛdeɛ ne n’atemmudeɛ ne ne mmara nsɛm nna nyinaa.
Na monhunu nnɛ, (na ɛnyɛ mene mo mma a wɔnnim na wɔnhunuiɛ no) monhunu AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn ntea, ne kɛseyɛ, ne nsa a ɛyɛ den ne ne basa a watene mu ne ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne ne nneyɛeɛ a ɔyɛɛ no Misraim a ɔde yɛɛ Misraimhene Farao ne n’asase nyinaa, ne deɛ ɔyɛɛ Misraim dɔm ne n’apɔnkɔ ne ne nteaseɛnam a wɔde reti mo a ɔmaa Mmɛwa Po mu nsuo bu faa wɔn soɔ, na AWURADE sɛee wɔn, de abɛduru nnɛ da yi, ne deɛ ɔyɛɛ mo ɛserɛ so bɛsii sɛ moduruu ha yi, ne deɛ ɔyɛɛ Ruben ba Eliab mma Datan ne Abiram a asase buee n’anomu menee wɔn ne wɔn afie ne wɔn ntomadan ne wɔn a wɔdii wɔn akyire nyinaa firii Israel nyinaa mfimfini no; na mo ani ahunu AWURADE nneyɛeɛ akɛseɛ a ɔyɛeɛ no nyinaa.
Enti monni mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi nyinaa so, na mo ho ayɛ den, na moakɔ akɔfa asase a moretwam akɔ so akɔfa no, na mo nna aware asase a AWURADE kaa mo nananom ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma wɔn ne wɔn asefoɔ no so, asase a ɛsene nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ no.
Na asase a worekɔ akɔfa no nte sɛ Misraim asase a mofiri so baeɛ a woguu w’aba na wode wo nan guguu so nsuo sɛ ɛfan turo mu no; na asase a moretwam akɔ so akɔfa no yɛ mmepɔ ne mmonhwa asase a ɛnom ɔsoro nsuo, asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn hwɛ so daa, a n’ani wɔ so firi afe mfitiaseɛ kɔsi afe awieeɛ.
Na sɛ motie me mmara nsɛm a mede merema mo nnɛ yi, sɛ mode mo akoma nyinaa bɛdɔ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn na moasom no a, ɛnneɛ mɛma mo asase so osuo atɔ ne berɛ mu, asusɔ ne bereamporɔ, na woaboaboa w’aburoo ne wo nsa ne wo ngo ano, na mɛma wo serɛ so aba wira ama w’afieboa, na woadidi amee.
Monhwɛ mo ho yie na wɔannaadaa mo akoma, na moammane ankɔsom anyame foforɔ ansɔre wɔn, na AWURADE abufuo annɛre antia mo, na wanto ɔsoro mu sɛ osuo nntɔ na asase mmma ne nnɔbaeɛ, na moansɛe ntɛm so amfiri asase pa a AWURADE de rema mo no so.
Enti momfa me nsɛm yi nsie mo akoma ne mo kra mu, na fa yɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ kyekyere wo nsa, na ɛnyɛ w’aniwa ntam nkaeɛ abotire; na momfa nkyerɛkyerɛ mo mma, na kasa ho w’afitena mu ne wo kwan so nanteɛ mu ne wo nna mu ne wo sɔreɛ mu; na twerɛ gu wo fie aponnwa ho ne w’aponkɛseɛ so; na wo nna ne wo mma nna adɔɔso asase a AWURADE kaa wo nananom ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma wɔn no so, sɛdeɛ ɔsoro a ɛkata asase soɔ yi nna teɛ.
Na sɛ mobɛdi mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ mo yi so ayɛ, na moadɔ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anante n’akwan nyinaa so na moabata ne ho a, ɛnneɛ AWURADE bɛtutu amanaman yi nyinaa afiri mo anim, na moafa amanaman akɛseɛ a wɔyɛ den sene mo.
Baabiara a mo nan bɛtia no bɛyɛ mo deɛ, ɛfiri ɛserɛ so ne Lebanon, ɛfiri Asubɔntene Eufrate ho, kɔsi akyiri po no ano bɛyɛ mo asase.
Obiara rentumi nnyina mo anim; AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn de mo ho hu ne mo ho suro bɛgu asase a mobɛfa soɔ nyinaa so, sɛdeɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ mo no.
Nhyira ne nnome Hwɛ, mede nhyira ne nnome meregu mo anim nnɛ: Sɛ motie AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi a, mobɛnya nhyira, na sɛ moantie AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm na momane firi ɔkwan a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi so kɔdi anyame foforɔ a monni wɔn akyiri a, mobɛnya nnome.
Na sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wo duru asase a worekɔ akɔfa no so a, ka nhyira no Gerisim bepɔ so ne nnome no nso Ebal bepɔ so.
Ɛnni Yordan agya, owiatɔeɛ kwan no akyi, Kanaanfoɔ a wɔte Araba asase so, Gilgal ntentensoɔ, More pɔ ho?
Na morebɛtwa Yordan akɔ akɔfa asase a AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn de rema mo no, na mobɛfa atena so.
Enti monhwɛ yie na monyɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ a mede meresi mo anim nnɛ yi nyinaa.
Wɔnsɛe ahoni Yeinom ne ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ a monhwɛ nyɛ no asase a AWURADE wo nananom Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ fa no soɔ, nna a mode te asase soɔ nyinaa.
Sɛeɛ na monsɛe ɔsombea a amanaman a morekɔtu wɔn no som wɔn anyame, mmepɔ atentene so ne nkokoɔ so ne dua mono biara ase no nyinaa; na monnwiri wɔn afɔrebukyia, na mommubu wɔn aboɔ adum, na momfa ogya nhye wɔn abosompɔ, na mommobɔ wɔn anyame ahoni, na monsɛe wɔn din mfiri hɔ.
Faako a wɔnsom Onyankopɔn Monnyɛ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn saa, na mmom faako a ɔbɛyi mo mmusuakuo nyinaa mu sɛ ɔde ne din bɛtoɔ na watena no na monhwɛ, na ɛhɔ na monkorɔ; na ɛhɔ na momfa mo hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne mo kum afɔdeɛ ne mo ntotosoɔ du du ne mo nsam mmasoɔ adeɛ ne mo bɔhyɛ adeɛ ne mo ayamyi afɔdeɛ ne mo anantwie ne mo nnwan mmakan nkorɔ; na ɛhɔ na monnidi AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anim, na mo ne mo afie ani nnye ade a mode mo nsa ka a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de ahyira woɔ no mu nyinaa.
Monnyɛ sɛdeɛ yɛreyɛ no ɛha nnɛ yi biara a obiara yɛ deɛ ɛtene n’ani soɔ nyinaa no; na ɛde bɛsi sɛsɛɛ yi monnya nnuruu home ne agyapadeɛ a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no mu.
Na sɛ monya twa Yordan kɔtena asase a AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn de rema mo sɛ monni soɔ no so, na ɔma mo home firi mo atamfoɔ a wɔatwa mo ho ahyia no nyinaa ho na motena ase dwoodwoo a, ɛnneɛ faako a AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn bɛyi ama ne din atena no, ɛhɔ na momfa deɛ merehyɛ mo no nyinaa nkorɔ: Mo hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne mo kum afɔdeɛ ne mo ntotosoɔ du du ne mo nsam mmasoɔ adeɛ ne mo bɔhyɛ adeɛ a moyie a mode hyɛ AWURADE bɔ no nyinaa.
Na momma mo ani nnye AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anim, mo ne mo mmammarima ne mo mmammaa ne mo nkoa ne mo mfenaa ne Lewini a ɔwɔ mo kuro apono mu, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno deɛ, ɔnni mo mu kyɛfa anaa agyapadeɛ.
Hwɛ wo ho yie na woammɔ wo hyeɛ afɔdeɛ baabiara a wohunu, gye faako a AWURADE bɛyi wɔ wo mmusuakuo baako mu no, ɛhɔ na bɔ wo hyeɛ afɔdeɛ, na yɛ deɛ merehyɛ woɔ nyinaa.
Nanso ɛnam biara a wo kra kɔn dɔ no, kum di, sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ahyira wo wɔ wo nkuro nyinaa mu; obi a ne ho nteɛ ne deɛ ne ho teɛ nni bi, sɛ ɔwansane ne ɔforoteɛ; mogya no nko na monnnie, monhwie ngu fam sɛ nsuo.
Deɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ wodie wɔ wo nkuro mu ne: W’aburoo ne wo nsa ne wo ngo ntotosoɔ du du ne w’anantwie ne wo nnwan mmakan ne wo bɔhyɛ adeɛ biara a woahyɛ ho bɔ ne w’ayamyi afɔdeɛ ne wo nsam mmasoɔ adeɛ; gye sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim, faako a ɔbɛyie no na die, wo ne wo babarima ne wo babaa ne w’akoa ne w’afenaa ne Lewini a ɔwɔ wo kuro apono mu, na ma w’ani nnye AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim, deɛ wode wo nsa ka nyinaa ho.
Hwɛ yie na wo werɛ amfiri Lewini, nna a wode te w’asase soɔ nyinaa.
Na sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn trɛ wo hyeɛ mu sɛdeɛ waka akyerɛ woɔ no, na wose mɛdi nam, ɛfiri sɛ wo kra kɔn dɔ sɛ ɔbɛdi nam a, di nam sɛdeɛ wo kra kɔn dɔ.
Sɛ faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛyi de ne din ato hɔ no ne wo ntam ware a, ɛnneɛ kum w’anantwie ne wo nnwan a AWURADE de ama woɔ no bi, sɛdeɛ mehyɛɛ woɔ no, na di no wo kuro mu, sɛdeɛ wo kra kɔn dɔ; sɛdeɛ wɔdi ɔwansane ne ɔforoteɛ no, saa ara nso na die; obi a ne ho nteɛ ne deɛ ne ho teɛ nyinaa nni.
Hwɛ yie mmom na hwɛ na woanni mogya, ɛfiri sɛ mogya ne ɔkra, na nni ɔkra nka nam no ho; nni, hwie gu fam sɛ nsuo; nni, na ɛnsi wo ne wo mma a wɔdi w’akyire yie, sɛ woreyɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani soɔ.
Fa akronkronneɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ wode ma, ne wo bɔhyɛ adeɛ na ma so kɔ faako a AWURADE bɛkyerɛ hɔ.
Na fa nam ne mogya no bɔ wo hyeɛ afɔdeɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn afɔrebukyia so, na wɔnhwie w’afɔdeɛ no mogya ngu n’afɔrebukyia no so, na nam no deɛ, di.
Hwɛ na tie nsɛm a merehyɛ woɔ nyinaa na ɛnsi wo ne wo mma a wɔdi w’akyire yie daa, sɛ woreyɛ deɛ ɛyɛ na ɛtene AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ani so.
Wɔnnni ahoni akyi Sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn twitwa amanaman a worekɔ hɔ akɔtu wɔn no firi w’anim, na wotu wɔn tena wɔn asase so a, hwɛ wo ho yie na sɛeɛ a wɔasɛe wɔn afiri w’anim no akyiri no wɔn akyiridie anyɛ wo fidie, na woammisa wɔn anyame akyiri kwan sɛ: Amanaman yi som wɔn anyame sɛn?
Na me nso menyɛ saa.
Nyɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn saa, na n’akyiwadeɛ a ɔtane nyinaa na wɔayɛ ama wɔn anyame, na wɔn mmammarima ne wɔn mmammaa mpo, wɔde ogya hye wɔn ma wɔn anyame.
Asɛm a merehyɛ mo nyinaa, monhwɛ nni so; mfa bi nka ho na nyi bi nso mfiri mu.
Ahonisom ho kɔkɔbɔ Sɛ odiyifoɔ anaa ɔdaeɛsofoɔ bi sɔre wo mu, na ɔma wo nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ anaa anwanwadeɛ bi, na nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ anaa anwanwadeɛ a ɔka kyerɛɛ woɔ no ba mu na ɔka sɛ: Ma yɛnkɔ nkɔdi anyame foforɔ a wonni wɔn akyi nkɔsom wɔn a, ntie odiyifoɔ anaa ɔdaeɛsofoɔ no nsɛm no.
Ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn resɔ mo ahwɛ na wahunu sɛ mode mo akoma nyinaa ne mo kra nyinaa bɛdɔ no anaa.
AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn akyi na monnie, na ɔno na monsuro no, na ne mmara nsɛm so na monnie, na ne nne na montie, na monsom no, na mommata ne ho.
Na odiyifoɔ anaa ɔdaeɛsofoɔ no, monku no, ɛfiri sɛ wakasa sɛ mommane mfiri AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn a ɔyii mo firii Misraim asase soɔ na ɔgyee mo firii nkoafie no ho de retwetwe wo afiri ɔkwan a wahyɛ wo sɛ nante mu no so; na tu bɔne no firi wo mu.
Sɛ wo nuabarima, wo na ba anaa wo babarima anaa wo babaa anaa wo yere a ɔda wo kokom anaa w’adamfo a ɔte sɛ wo ara wo kra redaadaa wo kokoam sɛ: Ma yɛnkɔ nkɔsom anyame foforɔ a wo ne wo nananom nnim wɔn, amanaman a wɔatwa wo ho ahyia a wɔbɛn woɔ anaasɛ wɔmmɛn woɔ firi asase ano kɔsi asase ano nohoa anyame bi, a, mpene no na ntie no, na mma w’ani nnhu no mmɔbɔ, nanso mma no nnyɛ wo mmɔbɔ na mfa no nhunta.
Na kum na ku no, wo nsa na ɛnni kan ntɔ ne so sɛ woreku no, na ɛno akyiri no ɔman no nyinaa nsa; na si no aboɔ ma no nwu, ɛfiri sɛ ɔrehwehwɛ atwetwe wo afiri AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn a ɔyii wo Misraim asase soɔ firii nkoafie no ho; na Israel nyinaa ntie na wɔnsuro, na wɔankɔ so anni wo mu asɛmmɔne a ɛte seyie.
Sɛ wote wo nkuro a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woatena mu no bi nka sɛ: Mmarima mmabusufoɔ bi asɔre wo mu adaadaa wɔn nkurɔfoɔ sɛ: Momma yɛnkɔ nkɔsom anyame foforɔ a monnim wɔn a, ɛnneɛ hwehwɛ mu na bisabisa mu yie; na hwɛ sɛ asɛm no wom ampa sɛ wɔayɛ saa akyiwadeɛ yi wɔ wo mu a, kum na fa nkrantɛ kum kuro no mufoɔ.
Fa nkrantɛ sɛe ɛno ne deɛ ɛwom nyinaa ne emu afieboa pasapasa; na boaboa emu asadeɛ nyinaa ano gu abɔntene so, na fa ogya hye kuro no ne emu asadeɛ no nyinaa sɛ afɔdeɛ mu ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na ɛnyɛ daa amamfo a wɔnnkyekyere bio.
Na mma abusudeɛ no bi nnka wo nsam; na AWURADE nnane mfiri n’abufuhyeɛ no ho, na ɔnhu wo mmɔbɔ, na ne yam nhyehye no mma wo, na ɔmma wonnɔɔso sɛdeɛ ɔkaa wo nananom ntam no.
Sɛ wobɛtie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne adi ne mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi nyinaa so ayɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ani so a.
Mmoa a monni ne deɛ monnni AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn mma ne mo, mommmotabota mo ho na monnyɛ ahyɛnsodeɛ wɔ mo moma so mmma owufoɔ biara; na ɔman kronkron ne wo ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na wo na AWURADE ayi wo sɛ yɛ no ahodeɛ man, asase so aman nyinaa mu.
Nni akyiwadeɛ biara.
Yeinom ne mmoa a monnie: Nantwie, odwanten ne abirekyie; ɔforoteɛ, adowa, ɔwansane, eyuo, ɔtwe, ɛkoɔ ne abedeɛ.
Na atɔteboa biara a ɔwɔ tɔte a emu apaeɛ, na ne tɔte mu apae nta mmienu, na ɔpu wesa, mmoa mu no, ɔno na monnie.
Nanso yeinom deɛ, monnni, wɔn a wɔpu wesa ne wɔn a wɔn tɔte mu apae koraa no mu: Yoma, adanko ne atwaboa, ɛfiri sɛ wɔpu wesa deɛ, nanso wɔn tɔte mu mpae, wɔn ho nte mma mo; ne prako nso, ɛfiri sɛ ne tɔte mu apae deɛ, nanso ɔmpu nwesa, ne ho nte mma mo.
Monnni wɔn nam, na monnka wɔn afunu.
Yei ne deɛ monnie, deɛ ɛwɔ nsuom nyinaa mu, deɛ ɛwɔ tɛtɛ ne abon nyinaa, monni.
Na biribiara a ɛnni tɛtɛ ne abon no, monnni: Ɛho nte mma mo.
Anomaa biara a ne ho teɛ no, monni.
Na yeinom ne wɔn a monnnie: Ɔkɔdeɛ, ɔkorɔbia, asuo so kɔdeɛ, ɔkompɛtɛ, asansa, ɔkom, n’ahodoɔ, anene ahodoɔ nyinaa, sohori, anadwoakorɔma ne ɛpo so asomfenakatakyi, akorɔma, n’ahodoɔ, patubiaa, patukɛseɛ, bakanoma nantwinoma, ɔpɛtɛ, ɛpo so anene, sukɔnkɔn, sukɔnkɔn ahodoɔ, asɔkwaa ne apan.
Na ntuboa a wɔwea nyinaa ho nte mma mo; monnni.
Ntuboa a wɔn ho teɛ nyinaa, monni.
Monnni aboa funu; fa ma ɔhɔhoɔ a ɔwɔ wo kuro apono mu ma no nni anaasɛ tɔn ma ɔnanani, ɛfiri sɛ woyɛ ɔman kronkron ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn.
Nnoa odwan ba wɔ ne na nufosuo mu.
Ntotosoɔ du du ho mmara W’adeɛ a woduaeɛ nnɔbaeɛ a w’afuo ma daa afirinhyia no, yi so ntotosoɔ du du.
Na di no wɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim wɔ faako a ɔbɛyi sɛ ne din ntena no, w’aburoo, wo nsa ne wo ngo so ntotosoɔ du du, w’anantwie ne wo nnwan mmakan, na woasua AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn suro nna nyinaa.
Na sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn hyira wo na sɛ ɔkwan no ware a wontumi nsoa, ɛfiri sɛ faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ayi sɛ ɔde ne din bɛto hɔ no ne wo ntam ware a, ɛnneɛ dane no sika, na kyekyere sika no kura, na sim kɔ faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ayie no.
Na fa sika no tɔ adeɛ biara a wo kra kɔn dɔ, nantwie ne odwan ne bobesa ne nsa biara a ɛyɛ den ne adeɛ biara a wo kra pɛ, na di no hɔ, AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim, na ma wo ne wo fie ani nnye.
Na Lewini a ɔwɔ wo kuro apono mu no, mma wo werɛ mmfiri no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnni kyɛfa ne agyapadeɛ biara sɛdeɛ wo deɛ wowɔ.
Mfeɛ mmiɛnsa awieeɛ no, yi w’afe no mu nnɔbaeɛ so ntotosoɔ du du gugu wo kuro apono mu, na Lewini, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnni kyɛfa ne agyapadeɛ biara sɛdeɛ wo deɛ wowɔ no, ne ɔhɔhoɔ ne awisiaa ne okunafoɔ a wɔwɔ wo kuro apono mu mmra mmɛdi mmee, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ahyira wo, wo nsa ano adwuma a woyɛ nyinaa mu.
Afe a ɛtɔ so nson no ho mmara Mfirinhyia nson biara awieeɛ no, gya biribi mu kyɛ.
Na sɛdeɛ wɔnnyaa mu nkyɛ nie: Ɔdefɛmni biara a ɔde biribi afɛm ne yɔnko mfa nkyɛ no; ɔnnhyɛ ne yɔnko ne ne nua sɛ ɔntua, ɛfiri sɛ wɔapae no adekyɛ afe ama AWURADE.
Ɔnanani deɛ, hyɛ no ma no ntua, nanso wo biribi a ɛwɔ wo nua nkyɛn deɛ, fa kyɛ.
Anka ɛnsɛ sɛ ohiani wɔ wo mu, ɛfiri sɛ hyira na AWURADE bɛhyira wo, asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ agyapadeɛ a kɔfa no so.
Tie nko na tie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne sɛ wobɛhwɛ adi mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi nyinaa so.
Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛhyira wo sɛdeɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ woɔ no, na wode afɛm amanaman pii, na wo deɛ, worenkɔfɛm, na wobɛdi amanaman pii so, na wo deɛ, wɔrenni wo so.
Sɛ wo nuanom mu biara dane ohiani wɔ kuro biara apono mu, w’asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so a, mpirim w’akoma, na mmua wo nsa so ntia wo nua hiani.
Na bue wo nsam ma no, na fɛm no deɛ ɛbɛso ne hia a ɛhia no no.
Hwɛ yie na w’akomam amma ahuhusɛm bi sɛ: Afe a ɛtɔ so nson, gyae-mukyɛ afe no abɛn, na woannya wo nua hiani no ho adwemmɔne sɛ woremma no hwee, na wanteam amfrɛ AWURADE antia wo, na annane wo bɔne.
Yi wo yam ma no, na mma no nnyɛ w’akoma ahi sɛ wobɛma no; na saa adeɛ yi nti AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛhyira wo, wo nnwuma nyinaa ne deɛ wode wo nsa bɛka nyinaa mu.
Na ohiani rempa w’asase so, enti na merehyɛ wo sɛ, bue wo nsam ma wo nua, wo mmɔborɔni ne wo hiani a ɔwɔ w’asase soɔ.
Sɛ wɔtɔn wo nua Hebrini, ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa ma wo, na ɔsom wo mfirinhyia nsia a, afe a ɛtɔ so nson no gya no kwan ma no mfiri wo nkyɛn mfa ne ho nkɔdi.
Na sɛ woregya no kwan ama no afa ne ho afiri wo nkyɛn akɔdi a, mma no nnkɔ nsapan: Fa wo nnwan ne w’ayuporebea ne wo nsakyi-amena no bi kyɛ no; adeɛ a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de ahyira woɔ no bi na fa ma no.
Na kae sɛ woyɛɛ akoa Misraim asase so, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn gyee wo; enti na nnɛ merehyɛ wo mmara yi.
Na sɛ ɛba sɛ ɔka kyerɛ wo sɛ: Meremfiri wo nkyɛn, na medɔ wo ne wo fie, ɛfiri sɛ ɔdi yie wɔ wo nkyɛn a, ɛnneɛ fa fitiiɛ fiti n’aso mu aponnwa ho na ɔnyɛ w’akoa daa; na w’afenaa nso yɛ no saa ara.
Mma no nnyɛ wo den sɛ wobɛgya no kwan na wafa ne ho afiri wo nkyɛn akɔdie, na wasom wo mfirinhyia nsia ayɛ ɔpaani akatua mmienu ho adeɛ; na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ahyira wo deɛ woyɛ nyinaa mu.
W’anantwie ne wo nnwan mmakan anini a wɔbɛwoɔ no, yɛ wɔn kronkron ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn.
Mfa wo nantwie abakan nyɛ adwuma, na ntwitwa wo nnwan abakan ho.
AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim na di no daa afirinhyia, faako a AWURADE bɛyie no, wo ne wo fie.
Na sɛ ɛdɛm bi wɔ ne ho, ɔtɔ apakye anaasɛ n’ani afira, anaasɛ ɛdɛmmɔne biara wɔ ne ho a, mfa no mmɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn afɔdeɛ; wo kuro apono mu na die, deɛ ne ho nteɛ ne deɛ ne ho teɛ nyinaa, sɛdeɛ wɔdi ɔwansane ne ɔforoteɛ no; ne mogya nko na nnie, hwie gu fam sɛ nsuo.
Afahyɛ ahodoɔ no ho mmara Hwɛ bosome Abib na di Twam ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, ɛfiri sɛ bosome Abib mu na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn yii wo firii Misraim anadwo.
Enti kum Twam afɔdeɛ no ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, nnwan ne anantwie, faako a AWURADE ayi sɛ ne din ntena no.
Nni mmɔreka paanoo nka ho; nnanson na di apiti, amanehunu paanoo, ɛfiri sɛ ɛherɛ so na wofirii Misraim asase soɔ, na woakae wo Misraim asase so fire da no, wo nkwa nna nyinaa.
Na mma wɔnnhunu mmɔreka wɔ wo nkyɛn, w’asase nyinaa so nnanson; nso mma nam a wɔku no da a ɛdi kan anwummerɛ no bi nnka nnkɔsi anɔpa.
Nkum Twam no wɔ wo nkuro a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no biara mu, gye faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛyi sɛ ne din ntena no, ɛhɔ na kum Twam no anwummerɛ a owia rekɔtɔ no, wo Misraim fire berɛ no mu; na ma no mmen na di no faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛkyerɛ hɔ, na adeɛ kye a, woasane akɔ wo ntomadan mu.
Nnansia na di apiti, na da a ɛtɔ so nson no nyɛ afahyɛ nhyiam mma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn; nyɛ adwuma biara.
Adapɛn nson na kan fa; da a wɔrefiri aseɛ de kantankrankyi ahyɛ ayuo mu no na firi kan adapɛn nson; na di adapɛn dapɔnna ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɔ wo nsam ayamyi afɔdeɛ sɛdeɛ wahyira woɔ no.
Na ma w’ani nnye AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim, wo ne wo babarima ne wo babaa ne w’akoa ne w’afenaa ne Lewini a ɔwɔ wo kuro apono mu ne ɔhɔhoɔ ne awisiaa ne okunafoɔ a wɔwɔ mo mu, faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛyi sɛ ne din ntena no; na kae sɛ woyɛɛ akoa Misraim, na hwɛ na yɛ ahyɛdeɛ yi.
Di asese nnapɔnna nnanson, berɛ a woaboaboa w’ayuporebea ne wo nsa-kyi-amena mu adeɛ ano no; na ma w’ani nnye wo nnapɔnna no mu, wo ne wo babarima, wo babaa, w’akoa, w’afenaa, Lewini, ɔhɔhoɔ, awisiaa ne okunafoɔ a wɔwɔ wo kuro apono mu.
Nnanson na di dapɔnna no ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn faako a wayie hɔ: Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛhyira wo, wo nnɔbaeɛ mu ne wo nsa ano adwuma nyinaa mu; enti ma w’ani nnye ara.
Afirinhyia baako mu mprɛnsa na wo mmarima nyinaa mmɛyi wɔn ho adi AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim faako a ɔbɛkyerɛ hɔ.
Apiti nnapɔnna, adapɛn dapɔnna ne asese nnapɔnna mu; na wɔmmfa nsapan mmmɛyi wɔn ho adi AWURADE anim.
Obiara mma deɛ ne nsa bɛso soɔ, sɛdeɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nhyira a ɔde ahyira woɔ no teɛ.
Atemmufoɔ ne atemmuo ho asɛm Sisi wo so atemmufoɔ ne mpanimfoɔ, wo nkuro a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛdeɛ wo mmusuakuo teɛ no nyinaa mu, na wɔmfa atɛntenenee mmu ɔman no.
Nnane atemmuo ani, nhwɛ nnipa anim na nnye adanmudeɛ; na adanmudeɛ fira anyansafoɔ ani, na ɛdane teneneefoɔ nsɛm ani butu.
Asɛntenenee nko ara akyi na die, na woanya nkwa, na woakɔfa asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no.
Ntɛ nnua biara mfa nyɛ abosompɔ wɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn afɔrebukyia a worebɛsie no ho; na mfa ɔboɔ dum nsi hɔ mfa; na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn akyiwadeɛ ne no.
Afɔrebɔdeɛ Mfa nantwie anaa odwan a ne ho wɔ dɛm anaa adebɔne biara mmɔ afɔdeɛ mma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ n’akyiwadeɛ.
Sɛ wɔhunu wo mu, wo nkuro a ɔde rema woɔ no biara mu ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa bi a ɔyɛ deɛ ɛnyɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ani soɔ bu apam so, na ɔkɔ kɔsom anyame foforɔ bi te sɛ owia anaa ɔsrane anaa ɔsoro asafo a mabara no mu biara, na wɔka kyerɛ wo na wote a, ɛnneɛ hwehwɛ mu yie; na sɛ wohunu sɛ ɛyɛ nokorɛ, na asɛm no wom sɛ wɔayɛ saa akyiwadeɛ yi wɔ Israel a, ɛnneɛ fa ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa a wadi saa asɛmmɔne yi firi adi wo kuro apono ho, na si no aboɔ ma ɔnwu.
Adansefoɔ baanu anaa baasa anomu asɛm so na wɔmfa nkum deɛ ɔsɛ wuo; wɔmmfa ɔdanseni baako anomu asɛm so nnku no.
Adansefoɔ no nsa na ɛngu ne so kane nku no, na ɛno akyiri no ɔman no nyinaa nsa; na yi bɔne no firi wo mu.
Sɛ asɛm bi a ɛho atemmuo yɛ wo den te sɛ awudie, manso, ɔpira ne ɔbɔ ne ɔbɔ ntam si, na ɛyɛ wo nkuro mu akasakasa nsɛm bi a, ɛnneɛ sɔre kɔ faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛkyerɛ, na kɔ asɔfoɔ Lewifoɔ ne ɔtemmufoɔ a ɔwɔ so saa berɛ no nkyɛn kɔbisa, na wɔnkyerɛ wo atɛn a buo.
Na di asɛm a wɔbɛkyerɛ wo faako a AWURADE bɛkyerɛ no so, na hwɛ na yɛ sɛdeɛ wɔbɛkyerɛ woɔ nyinaa.
Mmara a wɔbɛkyerɛ woɔ ne atemmuo a wɔbɛka akyerɛ woɔ no so na die, mmane mfiri asɛm a wɔbɛkyerɛ woɔ no ho nkɔ nifa anaa benkum.
Na onipa a ɔbɛdi ahantansɛm na ɔrentie ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔgyina hɔ som AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anaa ɔtemmufoɔ no, saa onipa no nwu; na yi bɔne no firi Israel, na ɔman no nyinaa nte na wɔnsuro, na wɔanni ahantansɛm bio.
Ɔhene yie ne n’asɛdeɛ Sɛ woduru asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so na wofa tena so, na woka sɛ: Mɛsi me so hene sɛ amanaman a wɔatwa me ho ahyia no nyinaa a, fa deɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛyi no no si wo so hene; wo nuanom mu bi na fa no si wo so hene; mfa ɔnanani bi a ɔnyɛ wo nua nsi wo so hene.
Nanso ɔhene no mma n’apɔnkɔ nnnɔɔso, na ɔmmma ɔman no nnsane nnkɔ Misraim nkɔpɛ apɔnkɔ dodoɔ; na AWURADE aka akyerɛ mo sɛ monnsane mmfa ɔkwan yi so bio.
Nanso ɔmmma ne yerenom nnnɔɔso, na n’akoma ammane; saa ara na ɔmmma ne dwetɛ ne sika nnnɔɔso pii.
Na sɛ ɔte n’ahennie adwa so a, ɔnhwɛ mmara yi nwoma a ɛda asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ anim no so ntwerɛ bi mfa; na ɛntena ne nkyɛn, na ɔnkenkan mu, ne nkwa nna nyinaa, na wasua AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn suro, ne mmara yi mu nsɛm nyinaa ne ahyɛdeɛ yi so hwɛ ne ɛsodie, na n’akoma amma ne ho so ansene ne nuanom, na wammane amfiri mmara nsɛm no ho ankɔ nifa anaa benkum, na ama ne nna aware n’ahennie mu, ɔno ne ne mma, Israel mu.
Asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ agyapadeɛ ne AWURADE Wɔmmma Lewifoɔ asɔfoɔ, Lewi abusuakuo nyinaa nnnya kyɛfa ne agyapadeɛ biara Israel mu: AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ so adeɛ ne n’agyapadeɛ a wɔnnie; na ɔrennya agyapadeɛ ne nuanom mu; AWURADE ne n’agyapadeɛ, sɛdeɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ no no.
Na yei nyɛ asɔfoɔ no kyɛfa a ɛfiri ɔman no nsam mfiri wɔn a wɔbɔ afɔdeɛ no nkyɛn, nantwie oo, odwan oo: Wɔmfa basa ne abɔgyeɛ ne efuro mma ɔsɔfoɔ no; w’aburoo, wo nsa ne wo ngo adikan ne wo nnwan ho nwi a wotwa kane no, fa ma no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ayi no afiri wo mmusuakuo nyinaa mu, sɛ ɔnnyina nsom AWURADE din mu, ɔno ne ne mma, nna nyinaa.
Lewifoɔ kyɛfa Na sɛ Lewini bi firi wo nkuro no biara mu, firi Israel mu baabiara a wakɔsoɛ, na ɔde ne pɛ nyinaa ba bɛtena faako a AWURADE bɛkyerɛ a, ɛnneɛ ɔnsom AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn din mu sɛ ne nuanom Lewifoɔ a wɔgyina AWURADE anim hɔ nyinaa yɛ no.
Wɔnnya kyɛfa korɔ nni nka deɛ ɛfiri n’agyanom adeɛ a wɔatɔn mu no ho.
Amanaman nneyɛɛ a ɛyɛ akyiwadeɛ Sɛ wonya duru asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so a, nsua amanaman no nneyɛɛ a ɛyɛ akyiwadeɛ no yɛ.
Mma wɔnnhunu wo mu obi a ɔma ne babarima anaa ne babaa fa ogya mu, ɔkɔmfoɔ a ɔhyɛ abosonkɔm, ɔbayifoɔ, ɔdebisafoɔ, ntafowayifoɔ, nkaberɛkyerefoɔ, samanfrɛfoɔ, adutofoɔ ne deɛ ɔbisa afunu, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE akyiwadeɛ ne wɔn a wɔyɛ yeinom nyinaa, na akyiwadeɛ yi nti na ɔretu wɔn afiri w’anim yi.
Wo ne AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ntena no amudie mu.
Na amanaman yi a worekɔtu wɔn yi tie abayifoɔ ne nkɔmhyɛfoɔ, na wo deɛ, AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn mmaa wo kwan sɛ yɛ no saa.
Wɔntie Onyankopɔn diyifoɔ no Odiyifoɔ a ɔfiri wo mu a ɔfiri wo nuanom mu te sɛ me na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛma no so ama woɔ, ɔno na montie no.
Sɛdeɛ wobisaa AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn wɔ Horeb adwabɔ da no sɛ: Mma mennte AWURADE me Nyankopɔn nne bio, na mma mennhunu ogya kɛseɛ yi bio, na manwu!
Ɛno na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Deɛ wɔaka no wɔaka no yie: Mɛma odiyifoɔ so mama wɔn wɔn nuanom mu sɛ wo; na mede me nsɛm bɛhyɛ n’anomu, na waka deɛ mɛhyɛ no nyinaa akyerɛ wɔn.
Na ɛbɛba sɛ obiara a ɔrentie me nsɛm a ɔbɛka no me din mu no, me na mɛbisa no ne hɔ.
Na odiyifoɔ a ɔbɛma ne ho so aka asɛm bi, me din mu, a menhyɛɛ no sɛ ɔnka, ne deɛ ɔbɛkasa anyame foforɔ din mu no, odiyifoɔ ko no bɛwu.
Ebia wobɛka no w’akoma mu sɛ: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na yɛbɛhunu asɛm a AWURADE nkaeɛ no?
Sɛ odiyifoɔ bi kasa wɔ AWURADE din mu, na asɛm korɔ no amma mu anaa ɛnyɛ nokorɛ a, na asɛm no mfiri AWURADE; ahantan mu na odiyifoɔ no kasaeɛ, nsuro no.
Dwanekɔbea nkuro Sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn twitwa amanaman a ɔde wɔn asase rema woɔ no, na wotu wɔn tena wɔn nkuro ne wɔn adan mu a, yiyi w’asase a ɔde rema wo sɛ fa no so nkuro mmiɛnsa fa.
Siesie ɛhɔ kwan no fa, na kyɛ w’asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ di soɔ no mu mmiɛnsa, na onipakumfoɔ biara adwane akɔ hɔ.
Na onipakumfoɔ a ɔnnwane nkɔ hɔ na ɔnnya nkwa no ho asɛm nie: Deɛ ɔnnim na ɔde adeɛ bɔ ne yɔnko, nanso berɛ a atwam no ɔntane no, sɛ ebia obi ne ne yɔnko kɔ kwaeɛ mu kɔto nnua, na ne nsa ma abonnua so de retwa dua, na dadeɛ no hɔn firi ne dua mu bɔ ne yɔnko ma no wu a, ɛnneɛ ɔnnwane nkɔ nkuro yi baako mu na ɔnnya nkwa; na mogya ho weretɔfoɔ amfa abufuhyeɛ anti onipakumfoɔ no na ɔkwan no wareɛ nti, wankɔto no anku no; nso na ɛnsɛ sɛ onipa kumfoɔ no wuo, ɛfiri sɛ berɛ a atwam no na ɔntane ne yɔnko no.
Enti na merehyɛ wo sɛ yiyi nkuro mmiɛnsa fa.
Na sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn trɛ wo hyeɛ mu, sɛdeɛ ɔkaa wo nananom ntam no, na ɔde asase a ɔkaa sɛ ɔde bɛma wo nananom no nyinaa ma wo, na sɛ wodi mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi nyinaa so yɛ, na wodɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn na wonante n’akwan so nna nyinaa a, ɛnneɛ yiyi nkuro mmiɛnsa bio ka mmiɛnsa yi ho fa, na wɔanhwie mogya a bɔne nni mu angu w’asase a ɔde rema wo sɛ di soɔ no so, na woanni mogya ho so.
Na sɛ obi tane ne yɔnko na ɔtɛ no sɔre to hyɛ ne so, na ɔde adeɛ bɔ no ma no wu, na ɔdwane kɔ nkuro yi baako mu a, ɛnneɛ ne kurom mpanimfoɔ nsoma mma wɔnkɔfa no mfiri hɔ, na wɔmfa no nhyɛ mogya ho weretɔfoɔ no nsa, na ɔnwu.
Mma w’ani nhu no mmɔbɔ, na yi mogya a ɛdi bem ho afobuo firi Israel, na ɛnsi wo yie.
Ntwe wo yɔnko hyeɛ a tetefoɔ atwa no w’agyapadeɛ a woanya mu wɔ asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ fa no so.
Adansefoɔ ho asɛm Ɔdanseni baako nnsɔre nntia obi, amumuyɛ biara anaa bɔne biara ho, bɔne biara a wɔyɛ mu; adansefoɔ baanu anaa baasa anomu nsɛm so na asɛm biara nnyina.
Sɛ ɔdansekurumfoɔ bi sɔre tia obi di no mfomsoɔ ho adanseɛ a, ɛnneɛ nnipa baanu a ɛham da wɔn ntam no mmɛgyina AWURADE anim, asɔfoɔ ne atemmufoɔ a wɔwɔ hɔ nna no mu anim.
Na atemmufoɔ no mpeepee mu yie, na sɛ ɔdanseni no yɛ ɔdansekurumfoɔ na wadi ne nua ho adansekurumu a, ɛnneɛ monyɛ no sɛdeɛ ɔsusuu sɛ anka ɔbɛyɛ ne nua no; na yi bɔne no firi wo mu, na wɔn a aka no nte na wɔnsuro, na wɔankɔ so anni asɛmmɔne a ɛte seyie wɔ wo mu bio.
Na mma w’ani nnhunu mmɔbɔ: Ɔkra nsi ɔkra ananmu, ani nsi ani ananmu, ɛse nsi ɛse ananmu, nsa nsi nsa ananmu, ɛnan nsi ɛnan ananmu.
Ɔsatuo ho mmara Sɛ woretu sa ne w’atamfo akɔko na wohunu apɔnkɔ ne nteaseɛnam ne ɔman a wɔdɔɔso sene woɔ a, nsuro wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn a ɔde wo firi Misraim asase so baeɛ no ka wo ho.
Na sɛ mobɛn dɔm no a, ɔsɔfoɔ no mpinkyɛ mmɛkasa nkyerɛ ɔman no, na ɔnka nkyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Israel, tie, morebɛn dɔm nnɛ ne mo atamfoɔ akɔko, mommma mo akoma nntu, monnsuro na mo ho mmpopo, na mommma wɔn ho nnyɛ mo hu, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ne mo na ɛnam ne mo atamfoɔ rekɔko ama mo na wagye mo.
Na ahwɛfoɔ no nkasa nkyerɛ ɔman no sɛ: Onii ko a wasi dan foforɔ na ɔmmuee ano no, ma no nsane nkɔ ne fie, na wantɔ ɔko mu na obi ankɔbue ɛdan no ano.
Na onii ko a watɛ bobeturo na ɔnnya nyii ano no, ma no nsane nkɔ ne fie, na wantɔ ɔko mu, na obi anyi ano.
Na onii ko a wagye ɔbaa bi awadeɛ na ɔnnya nhyiaa no no, ma no nsane nkɔ ne fie, na wantɔ ɔko mu na obi ammfa no sɛ ɔyerɛ.
Na ahwɛfoɔ no nkɔ so nkasa nkyerɛ ɔman no sɛ: Onii ko a ɔsuro na n’akoma tuo no, ma no nsane nkɔ ne fie, na wamma ne nuanom akoma annane sɛ ne deɛ.
Na sɛ ahwɛfoɔ no wie ɔman no kasakyerɛ a, wɔmfa asafohene nsisi ɔman no ti.
Sɛ wobɛn kuro bi ne no rekɔko a, ka asomdwoeɛsɛm kyerɛ no.
Na sɛ ɔbua wo asomdwoeɛ so na ɔhini wo a, ɔman a wobɛhu wɔn hɔ no nyi toɔ mma wo nsom wo.
Na sɛ wɔne wo anni asomdwoeɛsɛm na wɔne wo ko a, ɛnneɛ tua kuro no; na sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de hyɛ wo nsa a, fa nkrantɛ bobɔ emu mmarima nyinaa, nanso mmaa ne mmɔfra ne afieboa ne deɛ ɛwɔ kuro no mu nyinaa, emu asadeɛ nyinaa deɛ, fom fa, na di w’atamfo asadeɛ a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de ama woɔ no.
Saa na yɛ nkuro a ɛne wo ntam kwan ware pii a ɛnyɛ amanaman yi nkuro bie no.
Na amanaman yi nkuro a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ di soɔ no mu deɛ, mma biribiara a ɛhome nnnya nkwa, na sɛe wɔn pasapasa: Hetifoɔ, Amorifoɔ, Kanaanfoɔ, Perisifoɔ, Hewifoɔ ne Yebusifoɔ, sɛdeɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ woɔ no.
Na wɔankyerɛ mo wɔn akyiwadeɛ a wɔyɛ ma wɔn anyame no nyinaa bi yɛ, na moanyɛ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn bɔne.
Sɛ wotua kuro bi nna pii ne no reko afa a, mfa akuma nsɛe ho nnua, na ɛso aba bi na die, na mmu ngu.
Afuo mu dua yɛ onipa na woasɛe no?
Nanso nnua a wonim sɛ ɛnyɛ nnua a wɔdie no deɛ, sɛe no na twa fa yɛ kuro a ɛne wo redi ako no ntuaban kɔsi sɛ wobɛbrɛ no aseɛ.
Esum ase awudie Sɛ wohunu obi a wɔaku no da wiram asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ fa no so, na wonnim deɛ ɔkum no a, ɛnneɛ wo mpanimfoɔ ne w’atemmufoɔ mfiri adi nkɔsusu nkɔduru nkuro a ɛdeda deɛ wɔaku no no ho no so; na kuro a ɛbɛn deɛ wɔaku no no ho no, saa kuro no mu mpanimfoɔ mfa nantwiburuwa a wɔmfaa no nyɛɛ adwuma na ɔntwee kɔnnua pɛn, nsiane nkɔ subonhwa a nsuo sene wɔ mu a wɔnnɔeɛ na wɔnnuaa mu adeɛ da mu, na wɔmmu nantwiburuwa no kɔn mu wɔ subonhwa no mu.
Na Lewifoɔ mma asɔfoɔ no mmra ho, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ayi wɔn sɛ wɔnsom na wɔnhyira AWURADE din mu, na wɔn anomu asɛm so na wɔmfa nni akasakasa ne ɔborɔ ho asɛm biara; na kuro a ɛbɛn deɛ wɔaku no no mu mpanimfoɔ no nyinaa nhohoro wɔn nsa ngu nantwiburuwa a wɔabu ne kɔn mu subonhwa no mu no so, na wɔmma wɔn nne so nka sɛ: Ɛnyɛ yɛn nsa na ɛhwiee mogya yi guiɛ, na yɛn ani anhunu.
AWURADE fa kyɛ wo man Israel a woagye wɔn no, na mfa mogya a ɛdi bem ho afobuo ngu wo man Israel so; na fa mogya ho bɔne yi kyɛ wɔn.
Na wo deɛ, yi mogya a ɛdi bem ho afobuo firi wo mu, na yɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so.
Mmaa a wɔafa wɔn nnommum Sɛ wotu sa ne w’atamfo rekɔko, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wɔn hyɛ wo nsa, na wofa wɔn mu bi nnommum, na wohunu nnommum no mu baabereɛ bi, na wopɛ sɛ wofa no yɛ wo yere a, ɛnneɛ fa no bra wo fie, na ɔnyi ne ti, na ɔmmubu ne mmɔwerɛ, na ɔnyi ne dommum atadeɛ mfiri ne ho, na ɔntena wo fie nnyam n’agya ne ne na bosome mu, na ɛno akyiri no woakɔ ne ho aware no na wayɛ wo ɛyerɛ.
Na sɛ ɛba sɛ wompɛ no bio a, ma no mfa ne ho nkɔdi sɛdeɛ ɔpɛ, na tɔn deɛ, ntɔn no nnye sika, ɛne no nnni no sɛ afenaa, ɛfiri sɛ woahodwo no.
Mmakan dibea Sɛ ɔbarima bi wɔ yerenom baanu, na ɔdɔ ɔbaako, na ɔnnɔ ɔbaako, na wɔn baanu no no wowo mma ma no, na abakan no yɛ deɛ ɔnnɔ no no ba a, ɛnneɛ da a ɔrekyɛ n’adeɛ mu ama ne mma no, ɔmmfa deɛ ɔdɔ no no ba nnyɛ abakan nnni deɛ ɔnnɔ no no ba a ɔyɛ abakan no anim.
Na ɔmmu deɛ ɔnnɔ no no ba no abakan mma no deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa mu abupɛn mmienu; na ɔne n’ahoɔden asefire, abakan dibea yɛ ne dea.
Ɔba ɔtuatefoɔ Sɛ obi wɔ ɔba ɔsoɔdenfoɔ ne otuatefoɔ a ɔntie n’agya ne ne na asɛm, na wɔtea no na ɔntie wɔn a, ɛnneɛ n’agya ne ne na nkye no mfa no mfiri adi nkɔ ne kurom mpanimfoɔ nkyɛn wɔ kuro no pono ano, na wɔnka nkyerɛ ne kuro no mu mpanimfoɔ no sɛ: Yɛn ba yi yɛ ɔsoɔdenfoɔ ne otuatefoɔ, ɔntie yɛn asɛm, ɔyɛ ohohwini ne nsabofoɔ.
Na ne kuro no mu mmarima nyinaa nsi no aboɔ mma no nwu; na yi bɔne no firi wo mu na Israel nyinaa nte na wɔnsuro.
Mmara ahodoɔ bi Na sɛ obi yɛ bɔne a ɛsɛ kum na wɔku no de no sɛne dua bi so a, ne funu no nntena dua no so anadwo, sie no da no ara; na deɛ wɔasɛne no no yɛ Nyankopɔn nnome, na woangu w’asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ di soɔ no ho fi.
Nhwɛ wo nua nantwie anaa ne dwanten sɛ wɔrefom kwan, na ntwe wo ho mfiri wɔn ho; fa no sane brɛ wo nua no.
Na sɛ wo nua no mmɛn wo anaa wonni no a, ɛnneɛ fa no bra wo fie na ɔntena wo nkyɛn nkɔsi sɛ wo nua no bɛhwehwɛ no na woadane no ama no.
Na saa nso na yɛ n’afunumu, ne ntoma, ne wo nua adeɛ biara a ayera a wobɛhunu no; ntwe wo ho mfiri ho.
Nhwɛ wo nua afunumu anaa ne nantwie sɛ wɔahwe ase kwan mu, na ntwe wo ho mfiri wɔn ho; boa no ma no mma wɔn so.
Ɔbaa nnhyɛ ɔbarima adeɛ, na ɔbarima nso mmfira ɔbaa ntoma, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ yei nyinaa yɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn akyiwadeɛ.
Sɛ wokɔpue anomaa pirebuo ɔkwan mu, dua bi so anaa ɛfam, mma oo, nkosua oo, na ɛna no butu mma no anaa nkosua no so a, nkyere ɛna no nka mma no ho; na ma ɛna no nkɔ, na fa mma no, na asi wo yie na wɔama wo nna aware.
Sɛ wosi dan foforɔ a, gye wo dan atifi ban, na obi amfiri hɔ anhwe ase, na woamfa mogya ho asodie amma wo dan no so.
Mfa ade ahodoɔ mmienu nnua wo bobeturom, na anyɛ saa a wɔbɛhwere w’aduadeɛ a woduaeɛ no ne bobe turo no mu nnɔbaeɛ no nyinaa.
Mfa nantwie ne afunumu mmɔ mu mfuntum.
Mfira ntoma a wɔde kuntu ne asaawa afra anwono.
Yɛ wo ntoma a wode kata wo soɔ ahinanan so nnwo.
Sɛ obi ware yerɛ na ɔkɔ ne ho, na ɔmpɛ no bio, na ɔde animguasesɛm to ne so, na ɔbɔ no dimmɔne sɛ: Maware ɔbaa yi na mekɔɔ ne ho no, manto no ɔbaabunu a, ɛnneɛ ababaawa no agya ne ne na mfa ababaawa no baabunuyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ mfiri mmra kuro no mu mpanimfoɔ nkyɛn wɔ kuro no pono ano, na abaayewa no agya nka nkyerɛ mpanimfoɔ no sɛ: Mede me babaa mama ɔbarima yi aware, nso ɔmpɛ no bio.
Na hwɛ, ɔde animguasesɛm ato ne so sɛ: Manto wo babaa no ɔbaabunu; nso me ba baabunuyɛ adeɛ nie.
Na wɔntrɛ ntoma no mu kuro no mu mpanimfoɔ no anim.
Na kurom hɔ mpanimfoɔ no mfa ɔbarima no ntwe n’aso, na wɔnnye no dwetɛ nnwetɛbena ɔha mfa mma ababaa no agya, ɛfiri sɛ wabɔ Israel mu ɔbaabunu dimmɔne; na ɔnkɔso nware no, na ɔnnko no ne nna nyinaa mu.
Na sɛ asɛm yi yɛ nokwasɛm na wɔanhunu ababaawa no ɔbaabunu a, ɛnneɛ wɔnyi ababaa no mmra n’agya fie aboboano, na ne kurom mmarima nsi no aboɔ mma no nwu, ɛfiri sɛ wayɛ nkwaseadeɛ Israel mu sɛ wabɔ adwaman n’agya fie; na yi bɔne no firi wo mu.
Sɛ wohunu ɔbarima bi sɛ ɔne ɔbaa a ɔyɛ obi yere da a, ɛnneɛ wɔn baanu no nwu, ɔbarima a ɔne ɔbaa no daeɛ no ne ɔbaa no; na yi bɔne no firi Israel.
Sɛ wɔde ababaawa a ɔyɛ ɔbaabunu ma ɔbarima bi aware, na ɔbarima bi hu no kuro mu na ɔne no da a, ɛnneɛ momfa wɔn baanu no mfiri adi nkɔ kuro no pono n’akyi, na monsi wɔn aboɔ mma wɔnwuwu, ababaa no, ɛsiane sɛ ɔwɔ kuro mu na wanteam, ne ɔbarima no, sɛ wabrɛ ne yɔnko yere aseɛ nti; na yi bɔne no firi wo mu.
Na sɛ ɔbarima bi hunu ababaa ɔwarefoɔ wɔ wiram, na ɔbarima no kye no ne no da a, ɛnneɛ ɔbarima a ɔne no daeɛ no nko na ɔnwuo, na ababaa no deɛ, nyɛ no hwee, bɔne a ɛsɛ wuo nni ababaa no so, ɛfiri sɛ sɛdeɛ onipa sɔre tia ne yɔnko ku no no, saa na asɛm yi teɛ.
Ɛfiri sɛ wiram na ɔhunuu no, na ababaa a wɔagye no aware no teaa mu, na na obi a ɔbɛgye no nni hɔ.
Sɛ ɔbarima bi hunu ababaawa a ɔyɛ ɔbaabunu a wɔmfaa no mmaa aware na ɔkye no ne no da na wɔhu wɔn a, ɛnneɛ ɔbarima a ɔne no daeɛ no mma ababaa no agya dwetɛ nnwetɛbena aduonum, na ɔnyɛ ne yere sɛ ɔbrɛɛ no aseɛ nti; na ɔnnko no ne nna nyinaa.
Ɔbarima biara nnware n’agya yere, na ɔnnyi ɔbaa a ɔyɛ n’agya deɛ adagya so.
Deɛ ɔmfata sɛ ɔba AWURADE badwa mu Deɛ wɔapɛkyɛ ne hwewa ne deɛ ne barima atwa no mmma AWURADE badwa mu.
Adwaman ba biara mmma AWURADE badwa mu; n’awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛtɔ so du mpo mmma AWURADE badwa mu.
Amonni anaa Moabni mmma AWURADE badwa mu; wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛtɔ so du mpo mmma AWURADE badwa mu da, ɛfiri sɛ wɔamfa aduane ne nsuo ammɛhyia mo kwan mu, berɛ a mofiri Misraim reba no, ne sɛ wɔkɔbɔɔ Beor ba Bileam a ɔfiri Petor wɔ Mesopotamia paa sɛ ɔmmɛdome woɔ nti.
Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ampɛ sɛ ɔtie Bileam, na ɔdanee nnome no nhyira maa wo, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn dɔ wo.
Nhwehwɛ wɔn asomdwoeɛ ne wɔn papa da, wo nna nyinaa.
Nkyiri Edomni, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ wo nua.
Nkyiri Misraimni, ɛfiri sɛ wokɔyɛɛ n’asase so hɔhoɔ.
Mma a wɔbɛwo ama wɔn no awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mmra AWURADE badwa mu.
Ɛdɔm ahoteɛ Sɛ wofiri kɔkyere w’atamfo so nsraban a, hwɛ wo ho yie adebɔne nyinaa ho.
Sɛ ɔbarima bi wɔ wo mu a ne ho nteɛ wɔ ne ho a ɛsene anadwo no nti a, ɛnneɛ ɔmfiri nkɔ nsraban no akyi, ɔmmma nsraban no mu.
Na ɛrekɔ anwummerɛ no, ɔmfa nsuo nnware, na sɛ owia kɔtɔ a, ɔmmra nsraban no mu.
Na yɛ baabi, nsraban no akyi fa, na woafiri akɔgya wo nan wɔ hɔ.
Na fa sofi ka wo nnoɔma ho, na sɛ wokɔgya wo nan nsraban no akyiri hɔ awie no, fa sofi no tutu fam, na kata agyanan no so.
Ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nam wo nsraban mu sɛ ɔregye woɔ, na ɔde w’atamfo ama wɔ w’anim; enti ma wo nsraban mu nyɛ kronkron, na wanhunu wo mu aniwudeɛ biara, na wannane amfiri w’akyi.
Akoa dwanefoɔ Mfa akoa a wadwane afiri ne wura nkyɛn abɛdɔm woɔ nhyɛ ne wura nsa; ɔntena wo nkyɛn wɔ mo mu, wo nkuro mu baako a ɔbɛfa a ɛyɛ ma no mu; nhyɛ ne so.
Israel mmammaa mu biara nnnane odwamamfoɔ, na Israel babarima biara nnnane odwamamfoɔ.
Mfa ɔbaa odwamamfoɔ apɛdeɛ anaa ɔkraman (ɔbarima odwamamfoɔ) apaadeɛ mma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn fie wɔ wo bɔhyɛ biara mu, na ne mmienu no yɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn akyiwadeɛ.
Mfɛntomu, bɔhyɛ ne tɔsofa ho mmara Nnye wo nua mfɛntomu wɔ sika, aduane mfɛntomu, anaa wɔ biribiara ho.
Ɔnanani nkyɛn na gye mfɛntomu, na wo nua deɛ, nnye ne hɔ bi, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nhyira wo deɛ wode wo nsa bɛka nyinaa mu, asase a worekɔ akɔfa no so.
Sɛ wohyɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɔ a, nyɛ nyaa sɛ wobɛtua, ɛfiri sɛ ɔbɛhwehwɛ no wo hɔ, na adane wo bɔne.
Nanso woanhyɛ bɔ no koraa deɛ a, ɛnyɛ bɔne mma wo.
Deɛ afiri w’ano no, di so na yɛ, sɛdeɛ wofiri wo pɛ mu de w’ano ahyɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɔ no.
Sɛ woduru wo yɔnko bɔbeturom a, di aba no bi sɛdeɛ wopɛ mee, na mfa bi ngu w’adeɛ mu.
Sɛ woduru wo yɔnko ayuo a ɛgyina hɔ mu a, fa wo nsa pempane mmɛtem no bi, na mma kantankrankyi so wɔ wo yɔnko ayuo so.
Awareɛ ne awaregyaeɛ ho mmara Sɛ ɔbarima bi ware yerɛ, na ɛba sɛ n’ani nnye ɔbaa no ho a, ɛfiri sɛ wahunu ne ho aniwudeɛ bi a, ɛnneɛ ɔntwerɛ awaregyaeɛ nwoma mma no na ɔmfa nhyɛ ne nsa, na ɔnnya no kwan mfiri ne fie.
Na sɛ ɔfiri ne fie kɔ na ɔkɔware ɔbarima bi, na ekunu foforɔ no nso mpɛ no, na ɔtwerɛ awaregyaeɛ nwoma ma no de hyɛ ne nsa na ɔgya no kwan firi ne fie, anaasɛ ekunu a ɔwaree no akyire yi no wu a, ɛnneɛ ne kane kunu a ɔgyaa no kwan no nnsane mmmɛware no bio, ne ho figuo no akyi, ɛfiri sɛ ɛno yɛ AWURADE anim akyiwadeɛ, na mfa bɔne ngu asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ di soɔ no so.
Mmara ahodoɔ bi Sɛ ɔbarima bi ware yerɛ foforɔ a, ɔnnkɔ ɔsa, na wɔmmfa adwuma biara nnto ne so; na ɔnne ne ho wɔ ne fie afirinhyia, na ɔne ne yere a ɔwaree no no ani nnye.
Obi nnnye oyuyammoɔ ne ne ba sɛ awowa deɛ; sɛ ɛba saa a na onii no regye nkwa sɛ awowadeɛ.
Sɛ wɔhunu obi a ɔwia ne nuanom Israelfoɔ mu nipa bie na ɔdi no nya anaasɛ ɔtɔn no a, ɛnneɛ owifoɔ no nwu; na yi bɔne no firi wo mu.
Hwɛ yie kwata yadeɛ ho, na woahwɛ ayɛ sɛdeɛ asɔfoɔ Lewifoɔ no bɛkyerɛ mo no nyinaa pɛpɛɛpɛ; sɛdeɛ mehyɛɛ wɔn no, saa na monhwɛ nyɛ.
Kae deɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn yɛɛ Miriam wɔ kwan soɔ, berɛ a mofiri Misraim reba no.
Sɛ wode biribi fɛm wo yɔnko a, nhyɛne ne dan mu nkɔgye n’awowa; adihɔ na gyina, na onipa a wofɛm no adeɛ no mfa awowa no mmrɛ wo wɔ adihɔ.
Na sɛ ɔyɛ onipa a ɔdi hia a, mfa n’awowa no nna; owia kɔtɔ a, dane awowa no kɔma no, na ɔmfa ne ntoma nna, na ɔnhyira wo, na ɛnyɛ wo tenenee wɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim.
Nhyɛ ɔpaani, mmɔborɔni ne ohiani a ɔfiri wo nuanom anaa ahɔhoɔ a wɔwɔ w’asase soɔ, wo nkuro mu no so.
Da a ɔyɛ adwuma no ara na ma no n’apaadeɛ, na mma owia nnkɔtɔ so, ɛfiri sɛ ɔdi hia, na ɔde n’ani ato so; na wansu amfrɛ AWURADE antia wo, na annane wo bɔne.
Wɔnnkum nananom wɔ wɔn mma bɔne so nti, na wɔnnkum mma wɔ wɔn nananom bɔne so nti; na obiara bɔne nti na wɔnku no.
Nkyea ɔhɔhoɔ anaa awisiaa atɛn, na nnye okunafoɔ atadeɛ awowa.
Na kae sɛ woyɛɛ akoa Misraim, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn gyee wo firii hɔ, enti na merehyɛ wo sɛ di asɛm yi soɔ.
Sɛ wotwa w’aduane w’afuo mu na wo werɛ firi afi bi afuo mu hɔ a, nsane nkɔfa; ma no nyɛ ɔhɔhoɔ, awisiaa ne okunafoɔ deɛ, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ahyira wo wɔ wo nsa ano adwuma nyinaa mu.
Sɛ wopore wo ngo dua a, nsane nkɔtwee so; ma no nyɛ ɔhɔhoɔ, awisiaa ne okunafoɔ deɛ.
Sɛ wote wo bobeturom aba a, nsane nkɔdi so mpɛpɛ; ma no nyɛ ɔhɔhoɔ, awisiaa ne okunafoɔ deɛ.
Na kae sɛ woyɛɛ akoa Misraim asase so; enti na merehyɛ wo sɛ di asɛm yi soɔ.
Sɛ ɔham ba nnipa mmienu ntam a, wɔmmra asɛnniiɛ, na wɔmmu wɔn atɛn, na wɔmmu ɔteneneeni bem, na wɔmmu ɔbɔnefoɔ fɔ.
Na sɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ no di hweɛ a, ɔtemmufoɔ no mma no nna fam, na wɔnhwe no wɔ n’anim, dodoɔ a ɛsɛ ne bɔne no.
Mmaa aduanan na wɔnka no, ɛntra so, na wantra so anhwe no mmaa pii ansene yei, na wo nua annane w’ani so ɔhohorani.
Nkata nantwie a ɔpore ayuo ano.
Sɛ anuanom tena faako na wɔn mu baako wu na ɔnni ba a, owufoɔ no yere nnkɔ baabi nnkɔware ɔhɔhoɔ; ne kunu nua nkɔ ne ho nware no, na ɔnyɛ ekunu nua ayɛdeɛ mma no.
Na abakan a ɔbaa no bɛwo no no, wɔmfa ne nua a ɔwuiɛ no din nto no, na ne din ampepa amfiri Israel.
Na sɛ ɔbarima no mpɛ sɛ ɔware ne nua yere no a, ɛnneɛ ne nua yere no nkɔ kuro pono ano mpanimfoɔ nkyɛn nkɔka sɛ: Me kunu nua mpɛ sɛ ɔma ne nua din tena Israel, ɔmpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ me ekunu nua ayɛdeɛ.
Na ne kurom mpanimfoɔ no mfrɛ no nkasa nkyerɛ no, na sɛ ɔgyina hɔ ka sɛ: Mempɛ sɛ meware no a, ɛnneɛ ne nua yere no ntwe mpini no mpanimfoɔ no anim, na ɔnyi ɔbarima no nan ase mpaboa, na ɔnhinam n’ani so ntasuo nka sɛ: Saa na wɔnyɛ ɔbarima a ɔmpɛ sɛ ɔsiesie ne nua fie.
Na wɔmfrɛ ne fie wɔ Israel mu sɛ: Deɛ wɔayi ne nan ase mpaboa no fie.
Sɛ mmarima reko, obi ne ne nua, na ɔbaako yere twe pini sɛ ɔrebɛgye ne kunu afiri deɛ ɔrehwe no no nsam, na ɔbaa no tene ne nsa sɔ ne barima mu a, ɛnneɛ twa ɔbaa no nsa; mma w’ani nnhu no mmɔbɔ.
Nnya abrammoɔ ahodoɔ mmienu, kɛseɛ ne ketewa, wɔ wo fotoɔ mu.
Nnya efa ahodoɔ mmienu, kɛseɛ ne ketewa, wɔ wo fie.
Nya abrammokwanmu a ɛtene, nya efa a ɛduro na ɛtene, na wo nna aware asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so.
Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn akyiwadeɛ ne wɔn a wɔyɛ yeinom nyinaa, wɔn a wɔtwa nkontompo nyinaa.
Wɔmpepa Amalek nkaeɛ Kae deɛ Amalek yɛɛ wo kwan soɔ berɛ a mofiri Misraim reba no, sɛdeɛ ɔbɛtoaa wo ɛkwan soɔ, berɛ a woatɔ piti na woabrɛ, na ɔtwaa wɔn a aka w’akyire no nyinaa guiɛ wɔ w’akyire, na wansuro Onyankopɔn.
Enti sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ma wo ɔhome firi w’atamfo a wɔatwa wo ho ahyia nyinaa nsa, asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ fa tena soɔ no so a, pepa Amalek nkaeɛ firi asase so; mma wo werɛ mmfi.
Aduanekan afɔdeɛ Na sɛ wonya duru asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ di soɔ no so na wofa tena so a, fa so aduadeɛ a wobɛnya no w’asase a ɔde rema woɔ no soɔ no nyinaa so aduanekan no bi gu kɛntɛn mu, na fa kɔ faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛkyerɛ sɛ ne din ntena no, na kɔ ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔwɔ so saa berɛ no nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛ no sɛ: Mepae mu nnɛ mekyerɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn sɛ maduru asase a ɔkaa yɛn nananom ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma yɛn no so.
Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nnye kɛntɛn no mfiri wo nsam mfa nsi AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn afɔrebukyia no anim.
Na gye so ka no AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim sɛ: Na m’agya yɛ Aramni a anka ɔkyinkyini, na ɔde nnipa kakraa bi na ɛsiane kɔɔ Misraim kɔyɛɛ hɔ hɔhoɔ, na ɔyɛɛ ɔman kɛseɛ a wɔyɛ den na wɔdɔreeɛ wɔ hɔ; na Misraimfoɔ yɛɛ yɛn bɔne na wɔhyɛɛ yɛn so na wɔde ɔsom denden too yɛn so; na yɛsu frɛɛ AWURADE yɛn nananom Nyankopɔn, na ɔtiee yɛn nne, na ɔhunuu yɛn mmɔborɔ a yɛyɛ, yɛn haw ne yɛn ahodwan.
Na AWURADE de nsa a ɛyɛ den ne basa a watene mu ne ahodwirideɛ akɛseɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ yii yɛn firii Misraim bae.
Na ɔde yɛn aba ha yi de asase yi ama yɛn, asase a ɛsene nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ.
Na afei, hwɛ, mede asase a wo, AWURADE, de ama me no so aduanekan maba; na fa si AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim, na sɔre n’anim, na gye w’ani adepa a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de ama wo ne wo fie no nyinaa ho, wo ne Lewini ne ɔhɔhoɔ a ɔwɔ wo mu no.
Sɛ wowie wo nnɔbaeɛ mu ntotosoɔ du du nyinaa yiyi, afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa a ɛne ntotosoɔ du du ma afe no mu, na wode ama Lewini ne ɔhɔhoɔ ne awisiaa ne okunafoɔ ama wɔadi no wo kuro apono mu amee a, ɛnneɛ ka no wɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim sɛ: Mayi akronkronneɛ afiri me fie, na mede mama Lewini ne ɔhɔhoɔ ne awisiaa ne okunafoɔ nso, sɛdeɛ wo mmara a woahyɛ me no nyinaa teɛ, mamfom wo mmara nsɛm no na me werɛ amfi; mennii bi m’awerɛhoɔ mu, na menyii bi berɛ a me ho nteɛ, na memfaa bi memmaa owufoɔ biara.
Matie AWURADE me Nyankopɔn nne, na mayɛ sɛdeɛ woahyɛ me no nyinaa.
Firi wo tenabea kronkron ɔsoro brɛ w’ani ase hwɛ, na hyira wo man Israel ne asase a wode ama yɛn, sɛdeɛ wokaa yɛn nananom ntam no, asase a ɛsene nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ no.
Ɛnnɛ da yi AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn rehyɛ wo sɛ: Yɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ yi, na fa w’akoma ne wo kra nyinaa di so na yɛ.
Ɛnnɛ woaka no AWURADE ho sɛ ɔbɛyɛ wo Nyankopɔn, na woanante n’akwan so, na woadi n’ahyɛdeɛ ne ne mmara nsɛm ne n’atemmudeɛ so, na woatie ne nne.
Na AWURADE nso aka no wo ho nnɛ sɛ wobɛyɛ ɔno ara ne man, sɛdeɛ wahyɛ wo bɔ no, na woadi ne mmara nsɛm nyinaa so, na wama wo so akyɛne amanaman a ɔyɛɛ wɔn no nyinaa, de wo ayɛ ayeyie ne din ne animuonyam, na woayɛ ɔman kronkron ama AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn sɛdeɛ ɔkaeɛ no.
Wɔntwerɛ mmara no ngu aboɔpono so Na Mose ne Israel mpanimfoɔ no hyɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Monni mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi nyinaa so.
Na da a mobɛtwa Yordan akɔ asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no soɔ no, fa aboɔ akɛseɛ sisi hɔ, na fa akaadoo sra ho, na twerɛ mmara yi mu nsɛm nyinaa gu so, da a wobɛtwam akɔ asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no soɔ no, asase a ɛsene nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ no, sɛdeɛ AWURADE wo nananom Nyankopɔn ahyɛ wo bɔ no.
Na mo Yordan twa mu no, momfa aboɔ yi a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi nsisi hɔ wɔ Ebal bepɔ so, na fa akaadoo sra ho.
Na si hɔ afɔrebukyia ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, aboɔ afɔrebukyia, mma dadeɛ so wɔ so; aboɔ amuamu na fa si AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn afɔrebukyia, na bɔ so ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn; na bɔ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ di no hɔ, na gye w’ani AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim.
Na twerɛ mmara yi mu nsɛm nyinaa gu aboɔ no so, fa kurukyire mu yie.
Na Mose ne Lewifoɔ asɔfoɔ no kasa kyerɛɛ Israel nyinaa sɛ: Israel, monyɛ aso ntie; ɛnnɛ da yi woayɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ɔman; enti tie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne, na di ne mmara nsɛm ne n’ahyɛdeɛ a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi so.
Ebal bepɔ so nnome Na Mose hyɛɛ ɔman no da no ara sɛ: Motwa Yordan a, yeinom na ɛnnyina Gerisim bepɔ so nhyira ɔman no: Simeon, Lewi, Yuda, Isakar, Yosef ne Benyamin; na yeinom nnyina Ebal bepɔ so nnome: Ruben, Gad, Aser, Sebulon, Dan ne Naftali.
Na Lewifoɔ mfiri aseɛ mfa nne kɛseɛ nka nkyerɛ Israelfoɔ nyinaa sɛ: Nnome nka onipa a ɔbɛyɛ ohoni a wɔasene anaa agudeɛ, AWURADE akyiwadeɛ, adwumfoɔ nsa ano adwuma, na ɔde bɛsi kokoam.
Na ɔman no nyinaa nnye so sɛ: Amen!
Nnome nka deɛ ɔyeyɛ n’agya ne ne na!
Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
Nnome nka deɛ ɔtwe ne yɔnko hyeɛ.
Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
Nnome nka deɛ ɔma onifirani fom kwan.
Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
Nnome nka deɛ ɔkyea ɔhɔhoɔ, awisiaa ne okunafoɔ atemmuo.
Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
Nnome nka deɛ ɔne n’agya yere da, ɛfiri sɛ wayi n’agya nkataho.
Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
Nnome nka deɛ ɔne aboa biara da.
Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
Nnome nka deɛ ɔne ne nuabaa, n’agya ba anaa ne na ba da.
Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
Nnome nka deɛ ɔne n’ase da.
Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
Nnome nka deɛ ɔhunta de adeɛ bɔ ne yɔnko.
Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
Nnome nka deɛ ɔgye apaadeɛ sɛ ɔbɛkum onipa a ɔdi bem.
Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
Nnome nka deɛ ɔmfa mmara yi mu nsɛm nsi hɔ sɛ ɔbɛyɛ.
Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
Ɔsetie ho nhyira Na sɛ wotie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne sɛ wobɛhwɛ na woadi ne mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi nyinaa so a, AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛma wo so akɔ soro asi asase so amanaman nyinaa so; na nhyira yi nyinaa bɛba wo so na abɛto wo, ɛfiri sɛ wotie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne.
Nhyira bɛka wo wɔ kuro mu, na nhyira aka wo wɔ afuo mu.
Nhyira bɛka wo yafunu mu aba ne w’asase so aba ne w’afieboa mma, w’anantwie mma ne wo nnwan mma.
Nhyira bɛka wo kɛntɛn ne wo mmɔre kodoɔ.
Nhyira bɛka wo wo fieba mu, na nhyira bɛka wo w’adifire mu.
AWURADE bɛma w’atamfo a wɔsɔre tia woɔ adi nkoguo w’anim; wɔnam ɔkwan koro so bɛfiri abɛhyia wo, na wɔnam akwan nson so adwane w’anim.
AWURADE bɛhyɛ nhyira ama no aba wo so wɔ w’asan so ne adeɛ a wode wo nsa bɛka nyinaa mu, na ɔbɛhyira wo, asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so.
Sɛ wodi AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm so na wonante n’akwan so a, AWURADE de wo bɛgyina hɔ ayɛ ɔman kronkron afa, sɛdeɛ waka wo ntam no.
Na asase so aman nyinaa bɛhunu sɛ wɔde AWURADE din na afrɛ woɔ, na wɔbɛsuro wo.
Na AWURADE bɛma nnepa abu wo so wɔ wo yafunu mu aba mu ne w’afieboa aba mu ne w’asase so aba mu, asase a AWURADE kaa wo nananom ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma woɔ no so.
AWURADE bɛbue n’adepa korabea a ɛyɛ ɔsoro no ama wo, na atɔ w’asase so osuo ne berɛ mu, na wahyira wo nsa ano adwuma nyinaa; na wode bɛfɛm amanaman pii, na wo deɛ, woremfɛm obi hɔ biribi.
Sɛ wotie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi sɛ wobɛhwɛ ayɛ a, ɛnneɛ AWURADE bɛma woakɔ kan na worenka akyire, na wobɛkɔ soro ara, na woremmrɛ ase da; Ne saa nti, mmane mfiri nsɛm a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi mu biara ho nkɔ nifa anaa benkum nkɔdi anyame foforɔ akyi nkɔsom wɔn.
Asoɔden ho nnome Nanso ɛbɛba sɛ, sɛ woantie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne sɛ wobɛhwɛ ne mmara nsɛm ne n’ahyɛdeɛ a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi ayɛ a, nnome yi nyinaa bɛba wo so abɛmene wo.
Nnome bɛka wo, kuro mu, na nnome aka wo, wiram.
Nnome bɛka wo kɛntɛn ne wo mmɔre kodoɔ.
Nnome bɛka wo yafunu mu aba ne w’asase so aba, w’anantwie mma ne wo nnwan mma.
Nnome bɛka wo, wo fieba mu, na nnome bɛka wo w’adifire mu.
AWURADE bɛma nnome, benabɔ ne adapaabɔ aba wo so deɛ wode wo nsa bɛka ayɛ nyinaa mu de akɔsi sɛ wo bra bɔne nti wɔbɛdwɛre woɔ, na woasɛe ntɛm, ɛfiri sɛ woagya me.
AWURADE bɛma ɔyaredɔm afam wo ho de akɔsi sɛ ɔbɛwie wo hyeɛ afiri asase a worekɔ so akɔfa no soɔ.
AWURADE de ɛfɔn, ɔfoɛ ne ahuhuro ne ahohyehyeɛ kɛseɛ ne nkrantɛ ne ɔhoɔ ne ɔpoɔ bɛbɔ wo, na ɛbɛti wo de akɔsi sɛ wobɛsɛeɛ.
Na ɔsoro bɛyɛ sɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ama wo, na asase ayɛ sɛ dadeɛ ama wo.
Na AWURADE bɛma mfuturo ne nso atɔ sɛ osuo ama no agu w’asase so de akɔsi sɛ wɔbɛsɛe woɔ.
AWURADE bɛma woadi nkoguo wɔ w’atamfo anim: Wonam ɔkwan koro so bɛfiri akɔhyia wɔn, na wonam akwan nson so adwane wɔn anim, na wɔbɛto wo apete asase so ahennie nyinaa mu.
Na wo funu bɛyɛ ewiem nnomaa nyinaa ne asase so mmoa aduane, na obiara renka wɔn.
AWURADE de Misraim mpɔmpɔ ne nsisiiwa ne ntutuiɛ ne ntwom a wɔrentumi nsa bɛbobɔ wo.
AWURADE de adammɔ ne anifira ne akoma mu ahodwirie bɛbɔ wo.
Na wobɛkeka awia ketee sɛdeɛ onifirani keka sum mu, na w’akwan renwie wo yie, na hyɛ nko na wɔbɛhyɛ wo afom wo afa daa nyinaa, na obiara rennye wo.
Wobɛgye ɔbaa aware, na obi ne no ada; wobɛsi dan, na worentena mu; wobɛtɛ bobeturo, na worente ɛso aba.
Wɔbɛkum wo nantwie w’anim, na worenni bi; wɔbɛfa w’afunumu w’anim, na wɔrennane mma wo; wɔde wo nnwan bɛma w’atamfo, na worennya ɔgyefoɔ.
Wɔde wo mmammarima ne wo mmammaa bɛma ɔman bi, na w’ani bɛhwɛ, na wɔn hwɛ ama w’ani atɔ sia daa nyinaa, ɛfiri sɛ tumi biara nni wo nsam.
W’asase so aba ne w’adwumadeɛ nyinaa, ɔman a wonni wɔn na wɔbɛdie, na hyɛ nko na wɔbɛhyɛ woɔ na wɔapɛkyɛ wo, nna nyinaa; na w’ani so adeɛ a wobɛhunu no bɛbɔ wo dam.
AWURADE de akuro bɔne bɛbɔ wo wɔ nankoroma ne srɛ so a wɔrentumi nsa mma woɔ firi wo nan ase kɔsi w’atifi.
AWURADE de wo ne wo hene a wobɛsi no wo soɔ no bɛkɔ ɔman a wo ne wo nananom nnim soɔ, na ɛhɔ na wobɛsom anyame foforɔ, nnua ne aboɔ.
Na wobɛdane ahodwirideɛ ne kasabebuo ne ɛfene, aman a AWURADE de wo bɛkɔ soɔ no nyinaa mu.
Wode aba pii bɛfiri akɔ afuom, na ketewaa bi na wobɛboa ano aba mu, ɛfiri sɛ ntutummɛ bɛdi.
Wobɛtɛ bobe nturo na woadɔ mu, na nsa deɛ, worennom, na woremmoa aba no ano, ɛfiri sɛ mmoa bɛdi.
Wobɛnya ngodua w’asase nyinaa so, na ngo deɛ, worensra bi, ɛfiri sɛ wo ngodua no bɛpore agu.
Wobɛwo mmammarima ne mmammaa, na wɔrenyɛ wo deɛ, ɛfiri sɛ wɔbɛkɔ nnommumfa mu.
Wo nnua nyinaa ne w’asase so aba, mmɛbɛ bɛfa.
Ɔhɔhoɔ a ɔwɔ wo mu bɛkɔ soro akyɛne wo ara, na wo deɛ, wobɛsiane aba famfamfam; ɔno deɛ, ɔbɛfɛm wo adeɛ, na wo deɛ, worennya bi mfɛm no; ɔno bɛkɔ kan, na wo deɛ, woaka akyire.
Na nnome yi nyinaa bɛba wo so abɛmene wo akɔsi sɛ wobɛsɛeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ woantie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne sɛ wobɛdi ne mmara nsɛm ne n’ahyɛdeɛ a ɔhyɛɛ woɔ no soɔ.
Na ɛbɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ, wo ne w’asefoɔ ho daa.
Ɛsiane sɛ woamfa anigyeɛ ne akoma pa ansom AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn w’ahonya mu nti, wobɛsom w’atamfo a AWURADE bɛsoma aba wo soɔ no, ɛkɔm ne sukɔm ne adagya ne nnoɔma nyinaa mu hia mu; na ɔde dadeɛ kɔnnua bɛto wo kɔn mu akɔsi sɛ ɔbɛsɛe woɔ.
AWURADE de ɔman bi bɛfiri akyirikyiri afiri asase ano aba wo so, ɔherɛ so, sɛdeɛ ɔkɔdeɛ tuo; ɔman a wonte wɔn kasa, ɔman a wɔn ani yɛ den a wɔnhwɛ akɔkoraa anim na aberanteɛ nyɛ wɔn mmɔbɔ.
Na wɔbɛdi wo mmoa mma ne w’asase so aba akɔsi sɛ wɔbɛsɛe woɔ, na wɔrennya w’aburoo, nsa anaa ngo, w’anantwie mma anaa wo nnwan mma, kɔsi sɛ wɔbɛsɛe woɔ.
Na wɔbɛka wo ahyɛ mu wo nkuro apono nyinaa mu akɔsi sɛ w’afasuo atentene a ɛyɛ den a wode wo ho too soɔ no bɛdwiri aguo, w’asase nyinaa so, na wɔbɛka wo ahyɛ mu wo nkuro apono nyinaa mu, w’asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de ama woɔ no nyinaa so.
Na wobɛdi wo yafunu mu aba, wo mmammarima ne wo mma mmaa a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ama woɔ no nam, ahohiahia ne ahokyere a w’atamfo bɛma wo ho akyere woɔ no mu.
Ɔbarima a ɔdwoɔ na ɔwɔ tema wɔ wo mu bɛnya ne nua ne ne kokom yerɛ ne ne mma nkaeɛ a wama no aka no ho anibɔne, sɛ ɔremma wɔn mu biara ne mma nam a ɔredie no bie, ɛfiri sɛ hwee nkae wɔ ne ho bio, — ahohiahia ne ahokyere a w’atamfo bɛma wo ho akyere woɔ, wo nkuro apono nyinaa mu no mu.
Wo mu ɔbaa nso a ɔdwoɔ na ahodɔ ne mmerɛyɛ nti ɔnsɔ nhwɛɛ pɛn sɛ ɔde ne nan bɛsi fam no bɛnya ne kokom kunu ne ne babarima ne ne babaa ho anibɔne, na ɔbɛdi ne mma a wawo wɔn ne akyiriadeɛ wɔ kokoam, ɛsiane ahohiahia ne ahokyere a wo tamfo bɛma aba wo soɔ, wo nkuro apono nyinaa mu no nti.
Sɛ worenhwɛ nyɛ mmara yi mu nsɛm a wɔatwerɛ no nwoma yi mu nyinaa na worensuro din a ɛwɔ animuonyam na ɛho yɛ hu yi a ɛne AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn no a, ɛnneɛ AWURADE bɛma wo haw ne w’asefoɔ haw ayɛ nwanwa, ɔhaw akɛseɛ a ɛkyɛreɛ ne nyarewa bɔne a ɛkyɛreɛ; na ɔde Misraim nyarewa a wosuro no nyinaa no bɛba wo so, na abɛfemfam wo ho; nso yadeɛ biara ne ɔhaw biara a wɔntwerɛɛ no mmara yi nwoma mu no, AWURADE de bɛba wo so akɔsi sɛ wɔbɛsɛe woɔ.
Na mobɛka nnipa kakraa bi, nanso kane no na mo dodoɔ te sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma, ɛfiri sɛ woantie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne.
Na sɛdeɛ AWURADE ani gyee mo ho sɛ ɔbɛyɛ mo yie na wama moadɔre no, saa ara nso na AWURADE ani bɛgye mo ho sɛ ɔbɛsɛe mo na wadwerɛ mo; na wɔbɛtutu mo afiri asase a morekɔ hɔ akɔdi soɔ no so.
Na AWURADE bɛbɔ wo ahwete aman nyinaa mu afiri asase ano akɔsi asase ano, na ɛhɔ na wobɛsom anyame foforɔ a wo ne wo nananom nni wɔn a ɛyɛ nnua ne aboɔ; na amanaman no mu nso worennya ahodwoɔ, na w’anammɔn rennya home; ɛhɔ na AWURADE bɛma wo akoma a ɛtuo ne ani a ɛyɛ samoo ne ɔkra a ɛkusa; na wo nkwa bɛsɛne w’anim ahinhim, na wobɛsuro anadwo ne awia, na worennye wo nkwa nni.
Na w’akoma mu suro a wobɛsuro ne w’ani so adeɛ a wobɛhunu nti, anɔpa wobɛka sɛ: Sɛ ɛyɛ anwummerɛ ɛ, na anwummerɛ nso wobɛka sɛ: Sɛ ɛyɛ anɔpa ɛ!
Na AWURADE de wo bɛsane afa ahyɛn mu akɔ Misraim wɔ ɔkwan a mekaa wo ɛho asɛm sɛ worenhunu bio no so; na ɛhɔ na mobɛtontɔn mo ho ama mo atamfoɔ sɛ nkoa ne mfenaa, na obiara rentɔ mo mpo.
AWURADE apam Yei ne apam a AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose sɛ ɔne Israelfoɔ mpam Moab asase so nka apam a ɔne wɔn pamm Horeb ho no mu nsɛm no ho.
Na Mose frɛɛ Israel nyinaa ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Mo ara moahunu deɛ AWURADE yɛɛ Farao ne ne nkoa nyinaa ne n’asase nyinaa mo ani so wɔ Misraim asase soɔ no nyinaa, nsɔhwɛ akɛseɛ a w’ani hunuiɛ, nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ akɛseɛ no.
Nanso ɛde bɛsi nnɛ AWURADE mmaa mo saa akoma a ɛnim adeɛ, ani a ɛhunu adeɛ ne aso a ɛte asɛm.
Na mama moanante ɛserɛ so mfirinhyia aduanan; mo ntoma nsuu mo ho, na wo mpaboa ntetee wo nan ase; moanni paanoo na moannom bobesa ne nsa biara, na moahunu sɛ mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.
Na moduruu ha yi no, Hesbon hene Sihon ne Basan hene Og firi ne yɛn bɛkoe, na yɛkumm wɔn; na yɛfaa wɔn asase de maa Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manasefoɔ abusuakuo fa sɛ wɔnni so.
Enti monhwɛ apam yi mu nsɛm nni so, na deɛ moyɛ nyinaa awie mo yie.
Ɛnnɛ mo nyinaa mogyina AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anim; mo atitire, mo mmusuakuo, mo mpanimfoɔ ne mo ahwɛfoɔ, Israel mmarima nyinaa; mo mma, mo yerenom ne wo hɔhoɔ a ɔwɔ wo nsraban mu, ɛfiri duabuni so kɔsi wo nsusafoɔ soɔ, sɛ wobɛhyɛne AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn apam ne ne nseɛ a ɔne wo repam na ɔredi nnɛ yi mu, sɛ nnɛ ɔde wo resi hɔ ayɛ ne man, na ɔno nso ayɛ wo Nyankopɔn, sɛdeɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ woɔ ne sɛdeɛ ɔkaa wo nananom Abraham, Isak ne Yakob ntam no.
Na ɛnyɛ mo nko na me ne mo repam yi na meredi nseɛ yi, na mmom me ne wɔn a wɔne yɛn gyina AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn anim ha nnɛ yi ne wɔn a wɔne yɛn nni ha nnɛ yi.
Na mo ara monim sɛdeɛ yɛtenaa Misraim asase soɔ, ne sɛdeɛ yɛtwaa amanaman a mofaa wɔn mu baeɛ no mu; na mohunuu wɔn akyiwadeɛ ne wɔn nnua ne aboɔ ne dwetɛ ne sika ahoni a ɛwɔ wɔn mu no; na monhwɛ yie, na ɔbarima bi anaa ɔbaa bi anaa abusua bi anaa abusuakuo bi antena mo mu a wɔn akoma redane nnɛ afiri AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn ho, sɛ worekɔ akɔsom amanaman no anyame no, na nhini bi antena mo mu a ɛso ɛborɔ ne ɔnwono; na sɛ ɔte nseɛ yi mu nsɛm no a, wanhyira ne ho n’akoma mu anka sɛ: Menam m’akoma denyɛ mu deɛ, nanso mɛnya asomdwoeɛ; na wɔansesa deɛ wanom ne deɛ sukɔm de no ammom.
AWURADE rempene mfa nkyɛ no, na ɛno de AWURADE abufuo ne ne ninkuntwe bɛpunu onipa ko no, na nseɛ a wɔatwerɛ no nwoma yi mu no nyinaa bɛduru no, na AWURADE bɛpepa ne din afiri asase so.
Na AWURADE bɛyi no afiri Israel mmusuakuo nyinaa mu ama bɔne, sɛdeɛ apam a wɔatwerɛ no mmara nwoma yi mu no mu nseɛ no nyinaa teɛ.
Na sɛ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛbɛba, mo mma a wɔbɛsɔre adi mo akyire, ne ɔnanani a ɔfiri akyirikyiri asase so bɛba no hunu asase yi haw ahodoɔ ne nyarewa a AWURADE de aba soɔ, sɔfe ne nkyene, hyeɛ a asase no nyinaa ahyeɛ a wɔnnua so adeɛ na ɛnsoɔ, na wira biara mfifiri soɔ, sɛ Sodom ne Gomora, Adma ne Seboim butuo a AWURADE de n’abufuo ne n’abufuhyeɛ butuiɛ no a, wɔbɛka ho asɛm, na amanaman nyinaa bɛka sɛ: Adɛn nti na AWURADE ayɛ asase yi seyie?
Abufuo kɛseɛ hyehyeɛ yi yɛ deɛn?
Na wɔbɛka sɛ: Ɛfiri sɛ wɔagya AWURADE wɔn nananom Nyankopɔn apam a ɔyii wɔn Misraim asase soɔ no, ɔne wɔn pameeɛ no, na wɔakɔ akɔsom anyame foforɔ na wɔasɔre wɔn, anyame a wɔnni wɔn na ɛnyɛ ɔno na ɔde wɔn maa wɔn.
Na AWURADE abufuo dɛre tiaa asase yi maa no de nnome a wɔatwerɛ no nwoma yi mu nyinaa baa so; enti na watutu wɔn afiri wɔn asase soɔ abufuo ne aboɔhyeɛ ne abohuro kɛseɛ mu na wato wɔn agu asase bi soɔ sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ yi.
Nnoɔma a ahunta yɛ AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn dea, na deɛ wɔayi no adie no yɛ yɛn ne yɛn mma dea kɔsi daa, sɛ yɛnni mmara yi mu nsɛm nyinaa so.
Na sɛ nsɛm yi nyinaa, nhyira ne nnome a mede masi w’anim yi ba wo so, na wokae wɔ amanaman a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn apamo wo akɔ hɔ no nyinaa mu, na wosane ba AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, na wo ne wo mma tie ne nne sɛdeɛ merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi nyinaa, mo akoma nyinaa ne mo kra nyinaa mu a, ɛnneɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛdane wo dommum no, na ne yam ahyehye no ama wo, na wasane aboa wo ano afiri aman a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn apansam wo akɔ hɔ no nyinaa mu.
Sɛ wo nnipa a wapamo wɔn no wɔ ɔsoro ano mpo a, ɛfiri hɔ na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛboa wo ano, na ɛfiri hɔ na ɔbɛfa woɔ.
Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de wo bɛba asase a wo nananom dii soɔ no so, na woadi so, na wayɛ wo yie, na wama woadɔre akyɛne wo nananom.
Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛma wo ne w’asefoɔ akoma a ɛdwoɔ, na wode w’akoma nyinaa ne wo kra nyinaa adɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn na woanya nkwa.
Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de nnome yi nyinaa bɛgu w’atamfo ne wɔn a wɔkyiri woɔ a wɔtaa woɔ no so.
Na wo deɛ, wobɛsane abɛtie AWURADE nne, na woadi ne mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi nyinaa so.
Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛma woadi yie ama biribiara abu wo so, wo nsa ano adwuma nyinaa mu, wo yafunu mu aba mu ne wo mmoa mma mu ne w’asase so aba mu, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE ani bɛgye wo ho bio, ama woadi yie sɛdeɛ n’ani gyee wo nananom ho no; sɛ wotie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne, na wodi ne mmara nsɛm ne n’ahyɛdeɛ a wɔatwerɛ no mmara nwoma yi mu no so, na wode w’akoma nyinaa ne wo kra nyinaa sane ba AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn a!
Na mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi nnyɛ den mma wo, nanso ɛnni akyirikyiri; ɛnni ɔsoro na woaka sɛ: Hwan na ɔbɛkɔ ɔsoro ama yɛn akɔfa abrɛ yɛn ama yɛate ayɛ?
Na ɛnni po agya nso na woaka sɛ: Hwan na ɔbɛtwa po ama yɛn akɔfa abrɛ yɛn ama yɛate ayɛ?
Na asɛm no bɛn wo papaapa, ɛwɔ w’anomu ne w’akoma mu sɛ di so.
Hwɛ, ɛnnɛ mede nkwa ne papa ɛne owuo ne bɔne masi w’anim, na merehyɛ wo nnɛ sɛ: Dɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, nante n’akwan so, na di ne mmara nsɛm ne n’ahyɛdeɛ ne n’atemmudeɛ so, na woanya nkwa, na woadɔre, na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ahyira wo, asase a worekɔ so akɔdi soɔ no so.
Na sɛ w’akoma dane na woantie, na woma wɔtwe wo kɔsɔre anyame foforɔ na wosom wɔn a, mepae mu mekyerɛ mo nnɛ sɛ sɛeɛ na mobɛsɛeɛ, wo nna renkyɛre asase a woretwa Yordan akɔ so akɔdi soɔ no so.
Ɛnnɛ mefrɛ ɔsoro ne asase medi mo adanseɛ, sɛ mede nkwa ne owuo, nhyira ne nnome masi mo anim; enti fa nkwa, na wo ne w’asefoɔ nnya nkwa, na dɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn na tie ne nne na bata ne ho, ɛfiri sɛ ɛne wo nkwa ne wo nna dodoɔ, na woatena asase a AWURADE kaa wo nananom Abraham, Isak ne Yakob ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma wɔn no so.
Yosua si Mose ananmu Na Mose kɔ kɔkaa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ Israel nyinaa.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ɛnnɛ madi mfeɛ ɔha aduonu, me a mentumi nkɔ na me nso a mentumi mma; afei nso AWURADE aka akyerɛ me sɛ: Worentwa Yordan yi.
AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, ɔno na ɔretwa adi w’anim, ɔno na ɔbɛsɛe amanaman yi afiri w’anim, na woadi wɔn so; Yosua na ɔretwa adi w’anim, sɛdeɛ AWURADE aka no.
Na AWURADE bɛyɛ wɔn sɛdeɛ ɔyɛɛ Amorifoɔ ahene Sihon ne Og a ɔsɛee wɔn no ne wɔn asase.
Na AWURADE de wɔn bɛhyɛ mo nsa na moayɛ wɔn sɛdeɛ mmara nsɛm a mahyɛ mo no nyinaa teɛ.
Monyɛ den na monyɛ nnam, monnsuro na mommma wɔn ho nnyɛ mo hu, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn no, ɔno na ɔne wo nam; ɔrempa wo na ɔrennya wo.
Na Mose frɛɛ Yosua, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no Israel nyinaa anim sɛ: Yɛ den na yɛ nnam, na wo na wode ɔman yi bɛkɔ asase a AWURADE kaa wɔn nananom ntam sɛ ɔde bɛma wɔn no soɔ, na wo na wobɛkyɛ ama wɔn.
Na AWURADE, ɔno na ɔredi w’anim, ɔno na ɔbɛdi w’akyire, ɔrempa wo na ɔrennya wo; nsuro na mma w’akoma nntu.
Wɔnkenkan mmara no mfeɛ nson biara Na Mose twerɛɛ mmara yi, na ɔde maa asɔfoɔ no, Lewi mma a wɔsoa AWURADE apam adaka no, ne Israel mpanimfoɔ nyinaa.
Na Mose hyɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Daa mfirinhyia nson awieeɛ, Adekyɛ afe afahyɛ no mu, asese nnapɔnna no mu a Israel nyinaa aba rebɛpue AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim faako a ɔbɛkyerɛ no, kenkan mmara yi, Israel nyinaa anim gu wɔn aso mu.
Na ɔman no mmarima ne mmaa, mmɔfra ne wo hɔhoɔ a ɔwɔ wo nkuro apono mu mmɔ dwa na wɔntie, na wɔnsua, nsuro AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na wɔnhwɛ mmara yi mu nsɛm nyinaa nni so: Na wɔn mma a wɔnnim no ntie, na wɔnsua, nsuro AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn, nna a mode te asase a moretwa Yordan akɔ so akɔdi soɔ no so no nyinaa.
AWURADE ka Israel asoɔden ho asɛm Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Hwɛ, wo nna a worebɛwuo no abɛn; frɛ Yosua bra, na mommɛgyina ntomadan no mu, na menhyɛ no mmara.
Na Mose ne Yosua ba bɛgyinaa ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu.
Na AWURADE de mununkum dum bɛyii ne ho adi ntomadan no mu, na mununkum dum no bɛgyinaa ntomadan no ano.
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Hwɛ, worebɛti wo nananom wɔ asamando na ɔman yi bɛsɔre akɔdi asase a wɔrekɔ soɔ no anyame akyi adwamammɔ mu, na wɔagya me, na wɔato m’apam a me ne wɔn pameeɛ no.
Na me bo bɛfu wɔn da no, na magya wɔn, na mayi m’ani ahunta wɔn, na wɔamene wɔn, na bɔne pii ne ahohiahia ahodoɔ bɛto wɔn ama wɔaka no da no sɛ: Ɛnyɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn a ɔnni yɛn mu nti na bɔne yi abɛto yɛn yi anaa?
Na me deɛ, bɔne a wɔayɛ no nyinaa sɛ wɔamane akɔ anyame foforɔ nkyɛn nti, da no hunta na mede m’anim bɛhunta.
Na afei montwerɛ dwom yi mfa, na fa kyerɛkyerɛ Israelfoɔ; fa hyɛ wɔn anomu, na dwom yi nni me adanseɛ, Israelfoɔ mu.
Na mede wɔn duru asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene wɔ soɔ a mekaa ho ntam mekyerɛɛ wɔn nananom no so a, wɔbɛdidi amee na wɔayɛ akɛseɛ, na wɔamane akɔ anyame foforɔ nkyɛn akɔsom wɔn, na wɔapo me na wɔato m’apam.
Na sɛ bɔne pii ne ahohiahia ahodoɔ bɛto wɔn a, dwom yi bɛyɛ danseni adi adanseɛ wɔ wɔn anim, ɛfiri sɛ ɛrempa wɔn asefoɔ anomu.
Na menim wɔn adwene a wɔredwene nnɛ mpo, ansa na mede wɔn maduru asase a mekaa ho ntam no so.
Na Mose twerɛɛ dwom yi da no ara, na ɔde kyerɛkyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ no.
Na AWURADE hyɛɛ Nun ba Yosua sɛ: Yɛ den na yɛ nnam; na wo na wode Israelfoɔ bɛkɔ asase a mekaa wɔn ɛho ntam no soɔ: Na mɛdi w’akyi.
Mose de mmara no hyɛ Lewifoɔ nsa Na Mose twerɛɛ mmara yi mu nsɛm de hyɛɛ nwoma mu wiee koraa no, ɔhyɛɛ Lewifoɔ a wɔso AWURADE apam adaka no sɛ: Momfa mmara nwoma yi nto AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn apam adaka no ho, na ɛntena hɔ nni wo adanseɛ.
Na me deɛ, menim w’atuateɛ ne wo kɔn a asene; hwɛ, meda so ne mo te ase nnɛ yi mpo moyɛ AWURADE anim atuatefoɔ, na me wuo akyiri ɛ!
Momma mo mmusuakuo mu mpanimfoɔ nyinaa ne mo ahwɛfoɔ mmɛbɔ me nkyɛn dwa, na menka nsɛm yi nyinaa ngu wɔn aso mu, na memfrɛ ɔsoro ne asase nni wɔn adanseɛ.
Na menim sɛ me wuo akyiri no, sɛeɛ na mobɛsɛeɛ, na moamane afiri ɔkwan a mahyɛ mo no so, na bɔne abɛto mo daakye, ɛfiri sɛ mobɛyɛ AWURADE anim bɔne, na mode mo nsa ano adwuma bɛhyɛ no abufuo.
Na Mose kaa dwom yi mu nsɛm guu Israel badwa no nyinaa aso mu de kɔsii sɛ ɔwieeɛ.
Mose dwom no Ɔsoro, monyɛ aso, na merebɛkasa, na asase ntie m’anomu nsɛm!
Me nkyerɛkyerɛ nsosɔ sɛ nsuo, na me kasa ngu sɛ obosuo, sɛ wira so mfetema ne nhahan so hasuo.
Na AWURADE din na mɛbɔ.
Momfa anidie mma yɛn Nyankopɔn.
Ɔbotan no, n’adeyɛ yɛ pɛ, na n’akwan nyinaa yɛ tenenee; ɔyɛ nokorɛ Nyankopɔn na nkontompo nni ne mu; ɔteneneeni ne teefoɔ ne no.
Wɔadi no asɛmmɔne, wɔn nkekaeɛ nti wɔnna so nyɛ ne mma, awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ kontonkye a wɔakyea.
AWURADE na motua no ka seyie yi?
Ɔman nkwaseafoɔ a wonni tire!
Ɛnyɛ ɔno ne w’agya a ɔnyaa woɔ?
Ɔno na ɔyɛɛ woɔ na ɔde wo tim hɔ.
Kae tete nteredee nna, hwɛ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ dodoɔ no mfeɛ; bisa w’agya na ɔnkyerɛ wo, wo mpanimfoɔ, na wɔnka nkyerɛ wo.
Ɔsorosoroni no kyekyɛɛ asase maa amanaman, ɔpaepaee Adam mma mu no, ɔde aman no ahyeɛ totoo hɔ sɛ Israelfoɔ ano sie.
Na AWURADE kyɛfa ne ne man, Yakob ne n’agyapadeɛ a wɔasusu ama no.
Ɔhunuu no anwea pradada asase so ne nkyɛkyerɛ so, ɛserɛ so mmoa werɛmfoɔ su mu; ɔtwaa ne ho hyiae, ɔhwɛɛ ne so yie, ɔkoraa no sɛ n’aniwa kurutuawisi.
Sɛdeɛ ɔkɔdeɛ hwanyan ne buo na ɔtu bɔ ne mma ho mpɛmpɛ no, ɔtrɛɛ ne ntaban mu faa no, ɔsoaa no ne ntakra so.
AWURADE nko ara na ɔkyerɛɛ no kwan, na anyame foforɔ biara anka ne ho.
Ɔmaa no faa asase sorɔnsorɔn so kɔe, na ɔdii asase so nnɔbaeɛ; na ɔmaa no fefee ɛwoɔ firii ɔbotan mu, ne ngo firii abohemmaa mu, anantwie nufosuo ani sradeɛ, ne nnwan nufosuo, nnwammuruwa sradeɛ, ne Basan adwennini mpapo deɛ, ne ayuo sawa mu sradeɛ, na wonom bobe aba mu mogya gyenegyene.
Na Yesurum dɔree sradeɛ, na ɔtotoo anankotie; woadɔre sradeɛ ayɛ kɛse, wo mu ayɛ duru; na wagyaa Onyankopɔn a ɔyɛɛ no no, na ɔbuu ne nkwagyeɛ botan no akumaa.
Wɔde ananafoɔ anyame maa no twee ninkunu, wɔde akyiwadeɛ huruu ne bo.
Wɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ maa abosom a wɔnyɛ Onyankopɔn, anyame a wɔnni wɔn, afoforɔ a ɛbaa akyire yi na wɔn nananom amfɛre wɔn.
Ɔbotan a ɔwoo woɔ no, woannwene ne ho, na wo werɛ afiri Onyankopɔn a ɔkyem woo woɔ no.
Na ne mmabanin ne ne mmammaa ho ahi nti AWURADE hunuiɛ no, ɔpoo wɔn, na ɔkaa sɛ: Mɛyi m’ani mahunta wɔn, mɛhwɛ deɛ wɔn akyiri bɛwie, na awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ kontonkyi ne wɔn, mma a nokorɛ nni wɔn mu.
Wɔn deɛ, wɔde deɛ ɛnyɛ Onyankopɔn maa metwee ninkunu, wɔde wɔn adehuhuo yii me abufuo.
Na me nso mede deɛ ɛnyɛ ɔman bɛma wɔatwe ninkunu, mede ɔman nkwaseafoɔ bi na ɛbɛyi wɔn abufuo.
Na ogya asɔ m’abufuo mu, na ɛredɛre akɔduru Asamando aseɛ, na ɛrehye asase ne ne nnɔbaeɛ, na ɛde ogya ato mmepɔ nnyinasoɔ mu.
Mɛboaboa mmusuo ano agu wɔn so, mɛhwere m’agyan wɔ wɔn so.
Ɛkɔm bɛfɔn wɔn, na ahoɔhyeɛ yadeɛ yaya bɛmene wɔn; na mɛsoma mmoa se aba wɔn mu, ne mfuturo mu awɔ borɔ.
Nkrantɛ bɛfa wɔn mma abɔntene so, na ehu aku wɔn mpia mu, aberanteɛ ne ababaa, akɔkoaa ne deɛ wafu ɛdwono nyinaa.
Anka mese: Mɛhu wɔn agu, mɛma wɔn nkaeɛ to atwa afiri nnipa mu, sɛ ɛnyɛ ɔtamfoɔ ahiyie na mesuro a, na wɔn ahohiahiafoɔ annane me nsusuiɛ yi ani, na wɔanka sɛ: Yɛn nsa na adi nkonim na ɛnyɛ AWURADE na ɔyɛɛ yei nyinaa.
Na wɔyɛ ɔman a afotuo abɔ wɔn, na nhunumu bi nni wɔn mu.
Sɛ wɔyɛ anyansafoɔ a, anka wɔbɛte yei ase, na wɔahunu wɔn awiekyire.
Sɛ ɛnyɛ wɔn botan na watɔn wɔn na AWURADE ayi wɔn ama a, anka ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na ɔbaakofoɔ bɛtaa apem, na baanu ama mpemdu adwane?
Ɛfiri sɛ wɔn botan nte sɛ yɛn botan, na yɛn atamfoɔ mpo bu atɛn saa.
Na Sodom bobe mu na wɔn bobe fire, ɛne Gomora mfofowa so; wɔn aba yɛ ɛborɔ aba, wɔso esia esia a ɛyɛ nwono; wɔn nsa yɛ atweaseɛ borɔ ne nhuritia borɔ a ano yɛ den.
Wɔnkoraa yeinom wɔ me nkyɛn, na wɔnsɔɔ ano wɔ m’adekorabea?
Me na aweretɔ ne akatua wɔ me, ɛberɛ a wɔn nan bɛwatiri no.
Na wɔn dwɛreɛ da abɛn, na deɛ wɔahyɛ ama wɔn bɛba ntɛmntɛm.
Na AWURADE bɛbu ne man atɛn, na ne nkoa bɛyɛ no mmɔbɔ, berɛ a ɔbɛhunu sɛ wɔahodwo koraa, na akoa anaa ɔdehyeɛ nni hɔ bio.
Na ɔbɛka sɛ: Ɛhe na wɔn anyame no wɔ, ɔbotan a wɔde wɔn ho too soɔ no?
Wɔn a wɔdii wɔn afɔdeɛ sradeɛ, na wɔnom wɔn ahwiesa no?
Ma wɔnsɔre mmɛboa mo, ma wɔnyɛ mo so nkatasoɔ.
Afei monhunu sɛ me ara mene no, na onyame biara nka me ho.
Me na mekum, na mema nkwa, mepira, na mesa, na deɛ ɔbɛtumi agye afiri me nsam nni hɔ.
Na mema me nsa so mekɔ soro, na mese: Sɛ mete ase daa yi!
Sɛ mese me nkrantɛ nyinamnyinam no na me nsa sɔ atemmuo mu a, mɛtɔ wɔn a wɔne me di asie were, na matua m’atamfoɔ ka.
Mɛma m’agyan aboro mogya, na me nkrantɛ adi nam, atɔfoɔ ne nnommumfoɔ mogya, ɔtamfoɔ tiri a apɛsɛ no.
Amanaman, mo ne ne man mmɔ anigyese, ɛfiri sɛ ɔbɛtɔ ne nkoa mogya so were, na ɔde aweretɔ bɛtua n’atamfo ka, na wapata ama n’asase, ne man.
Na Mose ba bɛkaa dwom yi mu nsɛm nyinaa guu ɔman no aso mu, ɔno ne Nun ba Yosua.
Na Mose wiee Israel nyinaa nsɛm yi nyinaa ka no, ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Momfa mo akoma nto nsɛm a meredi mo ho adanseɛ nnɛ yi so, na mode ahyɛ mo mma, sɛ wɔnhwɛ mmara yi mu nsɛm nyinaa nni so.
Na ɛnyɛ mo asɛnhunu, na mmom ɛne mo nkwa, na asɛm yi so na monam bɛma mo nna aware asase a moretwa Yordan akɔdi soɔ no so.
Onyankopɔn soma Mose Nebo bepɔ so Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose da no ara sɛ: Kɔforo Abarim bepɔ yi, Nebo bepɔ a ɛwɔ Moab asase soɔ, Yeriko ntentensoɔ no, na kɔhwɛ Kanaan asase a mede merema Israelfoɔ sɛ wɔmfa no.
