Na Tamar faa ɔfam a ɔyɛeɛ no de kɔmaa ne nua Amnon pia no mu.
Nanso ɔde rema no sɛ ɔnnie no, ɔsɔɔ ne mu na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Bra, bɛda me nkyɛn, me nuabaa!
Na Tamar buaa no sɛ: Dabi, me nuabarima, mmrɛ me ase, na wɔnyɛ saa Israel mu; nni saa agyegyentwisɛm yi!
Na me deɛ, ɛhe mpo na mede m’ahohora bɛkorɔ?
Na wo deɛ, wobɛyɛ sɛ Israel mu nnyegyentwie no bi.
Na afei ɛne ɔhene nkɔkasa, na ɔremfa me nkame wo.
Nanso wampɛ sɛ ɔtie no, na ɛnam sɛ ne ho yɛ den sene no nti, ɔbrɛɛ no ase ne no dae.
Ɛnna Amnon de ɛtane kɛseɛ tanee no pii senee ɔdɔ a ɔdɔɔ no no.
Na Amnon ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɔre kɔ!
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Dabi me nua, ɛfiri sɛ pamo a worepamo me yi bɔne sene deɛ woyɛɛ me no; nanso wampɛ sɛ ɔtie no.
Ɔfrɛɛ n’abɔfra a ɔsom no no sɛ: Pamo ɔbaa yi firi me so firi adi, na to ɛpono akyi korɔkorɔ mu wɔ n’akyi.
Nso na atadeɛ nworonnworan yuu bi hyɛ no, na saa ntadeɛ na na ɔhene mmammaa a wɔyɛ mmabunu no hyɛ.
Na ne somfoɔ no de no firii adi, na ɔtoo ɛpono akyi korɔkorɔ mu wɔ n’akyi.
Ɛnna Tamar sesaa nso guu n’atifi, na ɔsunsuanee n’atadeɛ nworonnworan a ɛhyɛ no no mu, na ɔde ne nsa guu ne ti de benabɔ ara kɔe.
Na ne nua Absalom bisaa no sɛ: Wo nua Amnon ne wo ada anaa?
Na afei, me nua, mua w’ano, ɔyɛ wo nua.
Mfa w’akoma nto asɛm yi so.
Na Tamar de awerɛhoɔ tenaa ne nua Absalom fie komm.
Absalom tɔ were Amnon so Na Ɔhene Dawid tee nsɛm yi nyinaa no, ne bo fuu yie.
Na Absalom ne Amnon ankasa bɔne anaa papa.
Na Absalom tanee Amnon, sɛ wabrɛ ne nua Tamar aseɛ nti.
Na mfeɛ mmienu akyiri no, Absalom maa wɔkɔtwitwaa ne nnwan ho wɔ Baal-hasor a ɛbɛne Efraim no, na Absalom hyiaa ɔhene mma nyinaa kɔɔ hɔ.
Na Absalom baa ɔhene nkyɛn bɛkaa sɛ: Hwɛ, w’akoa rema wɔakɔtwitwa ne nnwan ho nwi; enti mesrɛ ma ɔhene ne ne nkoa ne w’akoa nkɔ.
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Absalom sɛ: Dabi, me ba, mma yɛn nyinaa nnkɔ, na yɛankɔyɛ wo so adesoa.
Na ɔsrɛɛ no ara, nanso wampɛ sɛ ɔkorɔ, na ɔhyiraa no.
Ɛnna Absalom kaa sɛ: Sɛ ɛnte saa a, mesrɛ wo ma me nua Amnon ne yɛn nkɔ.
Na ɔhene bisaa no sɛ: Adɛn nti na ɔne wo nkorɔ?
Na Absalom hyɛɛ no ara, na ɔmaa Amnon ne ɔhene mma no nyinaa ne no kɔe.
Nso na Absalom ahyɛ ne mmeranteɛ sɛ: Monhwɛ, na sɛ Amnon boro nsa tam na mese mo sɛ: Mommɔ Amnon a, monku no.
Monnsuro, ɛnyɛ me na mahyɛ mo?
Monyɛ den, na monyɛ mo ho mmarima.
Na Absalom mmeranteɛ no yɛɛ Amnon sɛdeɛ Absalom hyɛɛ wɔn no.
Ɛnna ɔhene mma no nyinaa sɔresɔre tenatenaa wɔn mfunumu so dwanedwaneeɛ.
Na wɔnam kwan soɔ no, asɛm no duruu Dawid nkyɛn sɛ: Absalom akum ɔhene mmammarima no nyinaa, na wɔn mu baako mpo anka.
Ɛnna ɔhene sɔre sunsuanee ne ntadeɛ mu, na ɔdaa fam, na ne nkoa nyinaa wɔgyinagyina hɔ asunsuane wɔn ntadeɛ mu.
Na Dawid nua Simea ba Yonadab kaa sɛ: Mma me wura nnnwene sɛ wɔakum ɔhene mma mmeranteɛ no nyinaa, na Amnon nko na wawuo, na na Absalom ahyɛ firi da no a ɔbrɛɛ ne nua Tamar aseɛ no.
Na afei mma me wura ɔhene mmfa asɛm no nnhyɛ n’akoma mu, sɛ ɔhene mma nyinaa awuwu, na Amnon nko na wawuo.
Absalom dwane Na Absalom dwaneeɛ.
Na aberanteɛ a ɔwɛn no no maa n’ani so hwɛe, na hwɛ, na nnipa bebree nam kwan a ɛwɔ n’akyire no so bepɔ ho nkyɛn mu reba.
Na Yonadab ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Hwɛ, ɔhene mma no reba; sɛ w’akoa kaeɛ no, sɛ ɛteɛ ne no.
Na ɔwiee kasa no ara pɛ na hwɛ, ɔhene mma no baeɛ, na wɔmemaa wɔn nne so sui, na ɔhene nso ne ne nkoa nyinaa nso suu kɛseɛ pa ara.
Na Absalom dwaneeɛ, na ɔkɔɔ Gesurhene Amihud ba Talmai nkyɛn.
Na Dawid gyam ne ba no nna nyinaa.
Na Absalom dwane kɔɔ Gesur no, ɔtenaa hɔ mfeɛ mmiɛnsa.
Na Ɔhene Dawid ani gyinaa Absalom, ɛfiri sɛ na ne werɛ akyekye, Amnon wuo no ho.
Yoab di ma Absalom Na Seruia ba Yoab hunuu sɛ ɔhene akoma wɔ Absalom ho.
Na Yoab soma maa wɔkɔɔ Tekoa kɔfaa ɔbaa nyansafoɔ bi firi hɔ bae, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Dane wo ho oyiyɛni, na hyɛ ayiyɛ ntadeɛ, nso nsra ngo, na yɛ sɛ ɔbaa a ɔfiri gyam owufoɔ akyɛreɛ.
Afei kɔ ɔhene nkyɛn na kɔka saa asɛm yi kyerɛ no.
Na Yoab de nsɛm no hyɛɛ n’ano.
Na ɛberɛ a Tekoani baa no baa ɔhene nkyɛn no, ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase wɔ ɔhene anim kaa sɛ: Ɔhene boa me!
Na ɔhene bisaa no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na ayɛ woɔ?
Na ɔse: Ampa, meyɛ okunafoɔ, me kunu awu.
Na w’afenaa wɔ mmammarima baanu, na wɔn baanu no kɔkoo wiram a ɔpatafoɔ biara nni hɔ, na ɔbaako bɔɔ ɔbaako maa no wui.
Na hwɛ, abusua no nyinaa asɔre atia w’afenaa sɛ: Yi deɛ ɔbɔɔ ne nua no ma, na ne nua a wadi no awuo no kra nti yɛnku no.
Wɔnam yei so bɛsɛe ɔdedifoɔ no nso, na wɔde rebɛhye m’ase, na wɔannya din anaa okyikafoɔ biara amma me kunu asase so.
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ ɔbaa no sɛ: Kɔ wo fie, na mɛhyɛ wo ho mmara bi.
Na Tekoani baa no ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Me wura ɔhene, me ne m’agya fie so na ɛso yi nna, na ɔhene ne n’adwa nni bem.
Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: Obi ka wo asɛm bi a, fa no bra me nkyɛn, na ɔrensane nka wo bio.
Na ɔbaa no kaa sɛ: Ma ɔhene nkae AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na mogya ho weretɔfoɔ no ansane ankum bio, na wɔankum me ba.
Na ɔse: Sɛ AWURADE te aseɛ yi, wo ba nwi baako mpo rentɔ fam!
Ɛnna ɔbaa no kaa sɛ: Mesrɛ wo, ma w’afenaa nka me wura ɔhene asɛm bi.
Na ɔse: Ka ɛ!
Na ɔbaa no se: Ɛnneɛ adɛn nti na woasusu saa adeɛ yi Nyankopɔn man ho, na sɛ ɔhene reka saa asɛm yi a, ɔte sɛ deɛ ɔdi fɔ, sɛ ɔhene nkɔfa ne nipa a wɔapam no no nsane mmra fie bio.
Ɛtwa sɛ yɛn nyinaa wuo, na yɛte sɛ nsuo a wɔahwie agu fam a wɔntumi mmoa ano bio; na Onyankopɔn rekum obi a ɔdwene akwan a ɛremma onipa a wɔapam no nsane mma fie bio.
Na afei deɛ enti a mebaeɛ na me ne me wura ɔhene abɛka asɛm yi ne sɛ, ɔman no maa mesuroe; na w’afenaa kaa sɛ: Me ne ɔhene bɛkɔ akɔkasa; ebia ɔhene bɛyɛ deɛ n’afenaa abisadeɛ ama no: Sɛ ɔhene bɛtie na wayi n’abaawa afiri onipa a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔsɛe me ne me ba firi Nyankopɔn agyapadeɛ mu no nsam.
Na w’afenaa susuu sɛ: Me wura ɔhene asɛm bɛma me asomdwoeɛ, na sɛ Nyankopɔn bɔfoɔ teɛ no, sɛ me wura ɔhene nso teɛ ne no, sɛ ɔhunu papa ne bɔne mu.
Enti AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nni w’akyi.
Ɛnna ɔhene bua see ɔbaa no sɛ: Nsi me asɛm biara a merebisa woɔ yi so.
Na ɔbaa no se: Ma me wura ɔhene nkasa ɛ!
Na ɔhene bisaa no sɛ: Yoab nka wo ho yei nyinaa mu anaa?
Na ɔbaa no buaa sɛ: Sɛ wo kra te aseɛ yi, me wura ɔhene, ɛnyɛ sɛ obi bɛmane nifa anaa benkum afiri deɛ me wura ɔhene aka no nyinaa ho; na w’akoa Yoab na ɔhyɛɛ me, na ɔno ara na ɔde nsɛm yi nyinaa hyɛɛ w’afenaa anomu; na sɛ ɔbɛdane asɛm no ani aka nti na w’akoa Yoab ayɛ saa adeɛ yi, nanso me wura ɔhene yɛ onyansafoɔ sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn bɔfoɔ nyansa teɛ, sɛ ɔbɛhunu deɛ ɛwɔ asase soɔ nyinaa.
Ɛnna ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ: Hwɛ, mema wo kwan, kɔ na kɔfa aberanteɛ Absalom sane bra.
Na Yoab bɔɔ ne mu ase wɔ n’anim na ɔhyiraa ɔhene.
Na Yoab kaa sɛ: Ɛnnɛ na w’akoa ahunu sɛ manya me wura ɔhene anim adom, sɛ ɔhene ayɛ deɛ n’akoa aka akyerɛ no.
Ɛno nti Yoab sii mu kɔɔ Gesur kɔfaa Absalom baa Yerusalem.
Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: Ma no mmane nkɔ ne fie, mempɛ sɛ mehunu n’anim.
Ɛnna Absalom mane kɔɔ ne fie, na wanhunu ɔhene anim.
Nso Israel nyinaa mu na obiara ho nyɛ fɛ sɛ Absalom, na ɛma wɔkamfo no sɛ; ɛfiri ne nan ase kɔsi n’apampam ɛdɛm biara nni ne ho.
Na sɛ ɔyi ne ti a, (nso daa afe duru a ɔyi, ɛfiri sɛ, ɛyɛ a ne tiri afu dodo,) na wɔkari ne tirinwi no a, ɛyɛ nnwetɛbena ahanu ɔhene abrammoɔ so.
Na wɔwoo mmammarima baasa maa Absalom ne ɔbaa baako a wɔfrɛ no Tamar; ɔyɛ ɔbaa a ne ho yɛ fɛ.
Saa nti Absalom dii Yerusalem mfeɛ mmienu, nso wanhunu ɔhene anim da.
Na Absalom soma maa wɔkɔfrɛɛ Yoab sɛ ɔrebɛsoma no ɔhene nkyɛn, nso Yoab amma.
Na ɔsomaa ne mprenu so, nso wamma.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’asomfoɔ sɛ: Monhwɛ, Yoab afuo wɔ me deɛ ho na ɔwɔ atokoɔ wɔ hɔ, monkɔ nkɔto mu gya.
Na Absalom nkoa no kɔtoo afuo no mu gya.
Ɛnna Yoab sɔre baa Absalom nkyɛn efie bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Adɛn nti na wo nkoa de ogya akɔto m’afuo a mewɔ no mu?
Na Absalom ka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ: Hwɛ, masoma ama wɔaba wo nkyɛn sɛ: Bra ha na mensoma wo ɔhene nkyɛn sɛ: Ɛdeɛn nti na mefiri Gesur mebaeɛ?
Ɛyɛ ma me sɛ anka meda so mewɔ hɔ.
Na afei mɛhunu ɔhene anim; na sɛ ɛso bi da me so a, ɔnku me.
Ɛnna Yoab kɔɔ ɔhene nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no, na ɔfrɛɛ Absalom, na ɔbaa ɔhene nkyɛn, na ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase wɔ ɔhene anim, na ɔhene yɛɛ Absalom atuu.
Absalom mansotwe Na yei akyiri no, Absalom siesiee teaseɛnam ne apɔnkɔ fae, ne mmarima aduonum a wɔbɛwɛn no.
Na Absalom sɔre anɔpahema kɔgyina kuro no pono ano kwan ho.
Na obiara a ɔwɔ asɛm bi na ɔreba ɔhene nkyɛn abɛdie no, Absalom frɛ no bisa no sɛ: Kuro bɛn so na wofire?
Na sɛ ɔbua sɛ: Israel mmusuakuo bi mu na w’akoa fire, a, ɛnna Absalom bɛka akyerɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, wo nsɛm yɛ na ɛtene, nanso obi nni hɔ a ɔhene ayi no a ɔbɛtie ama woɔ.
Absalom toa so ka sɛ: Na anka meyɛ asase yi so temmufoɔ, me nkyɛn na anka obiara a ɔwɔ asɛm bi anaa atemmudeɛ bi bɛba na mabu no atɛntenenee.
Na sɛ obi twe pini no bɛbɔ ne mu ase a, ɔtene ne nsa sɔ ne mu yɛ no atuu.
Na saa na na Absalom yɛ Israelfoɔ a wɔba ɔhene nkyɛn asennie nyinaa, na Absalom de nyaa Israel mmarima baa n’afa.
Na mfirinhyia nnan twaa mu no, Absalom ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Mesrɛ wo, ma menkɔ menkɔma m’aboadeɛ a mede mehyɛɛ AWURADE bɔ wɔ Hebron.
Ɛfiri sɛ metenaa Gesur wɔ Aram no, w’akoa hyɛɛ bɔ sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE de me sane ba Yerusalem a, ɛnneɛ mɛsom AWURADE.
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Fa asomdwoeɛ kɔ.
Na ɔsii mu kɔɔ Hebron.
Na Absalom somasomaa akwansrafoɔ maa wɔkɔɔ Israel mmusuakuo nyinaa mu kodɛɛ sɛ: Mote totorobɛnto nka ara pɛ a, monka sɛ: Absalom adi hene wɔ Hebron.
Na mmarima ahanu a wɔfrɛɛ wɔn firi Yerusalem kaa Absalom ho kɔe; na wɔn deɛ, wɔkɔɔ ɔkɔ hunu, na wɔnnim ho hwee.
Na Absalom soma maa wɔkɔhyiaa Giloni Ahitofel, Dawid fotufoɔ, firii ne kuro Gilo mu, berɛ a ɔrebɔ afɔdeɛ no; na atirisopam no mu yɛɛ den, na nnipa a wɔwɔ Absalom nkyɛn no kɔɔ so dɔɔso ara.
Dawid dwane Na ɔbɔfoɔ bi baa Dawid nkyɛn bɛkaa sɛ: Israel mmarima akoma di Absalom akyi.
Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa a wɔne no wɔ Yerusalem nyinaa sɛ: Monsɔre mma yɛnnwane, na Absalom ammɛku yɛn.
Monyɛ ntɛm ma yɛnkɔ, na wammɛto yɛn anyɛ yɛn bɔne bi, na wamfa nkrantɛ ano ammɛbɔ kuro yi.
Na ɔhene nkoa no ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Sɛdeɛ me wura ɔhene pɛ nyinaa no, hwɛ, wo nkoa bɛyɛ.
Ɛnna ɔhene firii adie na ne fiefoɔ nyinaa dii n’akyi; na ɔhene gyaa ne mpenafoɔ du sɛ wɔnhwɛ fie no.
Na ɔhene firii adi, na ɔman no nyinaa dii n’akyi, na wɔkɔgyinaa ɛdan bi a ɛtwa toɔ ho.
Na ne nkoa nyinaa sene faa ne nkyɛn; na Keretifoɔ nyinaa, Peletifoɔ nyinaa ne Gatfoɔ nyinaa, mmarima ahansia a wɔdii n’akyi firi Gat baeɛ no bɛtwaa mu ɔhene anim.
Ɛnna ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Gatni Itai sɛ: Adɛn nti na wo nso wone yɛn rekorɔ?
Sane kɔ, na kɔtena ɔhene nkyɛn, na woyɛ ɔnanani ne wo kuro mu ɔtukɔni nso.
Nnora nko ara na wobaeɛ, na ɛnnɛ memma wo ne yɛn nkɔkyini?
Na me deɛ, merekɔ deɛ mennim; sane, na fa wo nuanom nso ka wo ho sane kɔ AWURADE adɔeɛ ne ne nokorɛ mu.
Na Itai buaa ɔhene sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE te aseɛ na me wura ɔhene nso te aseɛ yi, faako a me wura ɔhene bɛtena no, ewuo mu oo, nkwa mu oo, ɛhɔ ara na w’akoa nso bɛtena!
Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Itai sɛ: Bra bɛsene!
Na Gatni Itai ne ne mmarima nyinaa ne mmɔfra a wɔka ne ho no nyinaa bɛtwaa mu.
Na asase no sofoɔ nyinaa de nne kɛseɛ sui, na ɔman no nyinaa twaa mu kɔe, na ɔhene twaa asuo Kidron, na ɔman no nyinaa twae a wɔn ani kyerɛ ɛserɛ no so.
Na hwɛ, Abiatar baeɛ na Sadok nso nie, a Lewifoɔ nyinaa ka ne ho.
Wɔso Nyankopɔn apam adaka no, na wɔsoɛɛ Nyankopɔn adaka no sii hɔ, na wɔamfa bio kɔsii sɛ ɔman no nyinaa firii kuro no mu twaa mu wieeɛ ansa.
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Sadok sɛ: Fa Nyankopɔn adaka no sane kɔ kuro no mu.
Sɛ menya AWURADE anim adom a, ɔde me bɛsane aba, na wama mabɛhu no ne ne tenabea bio.
Na sɛ ɔka sɛ: Mempɛ wo a, hwɛ, menie, ma no nyɛ me sɛdeɛ ɛyɛ wɔ n’ani soɔ.
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Ɔsɔfoɔ Sadok sɛ: Sɛ woahunu, sane kɔ kuro no mu dwoodwoo, na wo ba Ahimaas ne Abiatar ba Yonatan, mo mma baanu no ne mo ntena.
Monhwɛ, mɛtwentwɛn me nan ase ɛserɛ so mpaperɛ mu akɔsi sɛ asɛm a mobɛka akyerɛ me bɛfiri mo nkyɛn aba.
Ɛnna Sadok ne Abiatar de Nyankopɔn adaka no sane baa Yerusalem, na wɔbɛtenaa hɔ.
Na Dawid foroo Ngo-bepɔ no, na ɔreforɔ no na ɔresu, na wakata ne ti, na ɔnhyɛ mpaboa, na ɔman a wɔne no nam no nyinaa akatakata wɔn ti, na wɔreforɔ no, na wɔresu.
Na obi ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: Ahitofel fra wɔn a wɔne Absalom apam no mu.
Na Dawid bɔɔ mpaeɛ sɛ: AWURADE, mesrɛ wo, ma Ahitofel agyinatuo nnane nkwaseasɛm.
Na Dawid duruu bepɔ no atifi deɛ wɔsɔre Onyankopɔn no, hwɛ, Arkini Husai bɛhyiaa no a, wasunsuane n’atadeɛ mu na dɔteɛ gu n’atifi.
Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ wo ne me sene kɔ a, wobɛyɛ adesoa ama me.
Na sɛ wosane kɔ kuro no mu kɔka kyerɛ Absalom sɛ: Ɔhene, mɛyɛ w’akoa sɛdeɛ akane no meyɛɛ w’agya akoa no, na afei deɛ, mɛyɛ w’akoa, a, wobɛma Ahitofel agyinatuo no ayɛ ɔkwa ama me.
Na Asɔfoɔ Sadok ne Abiatar nni wo nkyɛn hɔ anaa?
Enti asɛm biara a wobɛte no ahemfie no, ka kyerɛ asɔfoɔ Sadok ne Abiatar.
Hwɛ, wɔn mma baanu no, Sadok ba Ahimaas, ne Abiatar ba Yonatan wɔ wo nkyɛn hɔ, na wɔn so na momma asɛm biara a mobɛteɛ mfa nnuru me nkyɛn.
Na Dawid adamfo Husai baa kuro no mu, ɛberɛ korɔ a na Absalom rehyɛne Yerusalem mu no.
Dawid ne Siba Na ɛberɛ a Dawid twaa mu firii bepɔ no atifi hɔ kakra no, hwɛ, Mefiboset somfoɔ Siba bɛhyiaa no; ɔde mfunumu mmienu a wɔahyehyɛ wɔn a wɔsoso paanoo mmua ahanu ne bobe aba a wɔabɔ no ntoantoa ɔha ne borɔdɔma ntoantoa ɔha ne nsa nwoma kotokuo ma.
Na ɔhene bisaa Siba sɛ: Wode yeinom rebɛyɛ dɛn?
Na Siba se: Mfunumu yi, wɔmfa mma ɔhene fiefoɔ na wɔntena so, na paanoo ne nnuaba yi, mmeranteɛ no nni, na nsa yi nso, wɔmfa mma wɔn a wɔabrɛ ɛserɛ soɔ na wɔnnom.
Na ɔhene bisaa sɛ: Na ɛhe na wo wura ba no wɔ?
Na Siba buaa ɔhene sɛ: Ɔte Yerusalem, na deɛ ɔreka ne sɛ: Ɛnnɛ Israel fie bɛdane m’agya ahennie ama me.
Ɛnna ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Siba sɛ: Hwɛ, deɛ ɛyɛ Mefiboset deɛ nyinaa yɛ wo dea.
Na Siba kaa sɛ: Mebɔ me mu ase ma wo, na ma mennya me wura ɔhene anim adom.
Dawid ne Simei Na Ɔhene Dawid duruu Bahurim no, ɔbarima bi a ɔfiri Saulo abusua mu a wɔfrɛ no Simei a ɔyɛ Gera ba firii adi baa hɔ; na ɔreba no, na ɔredome.
Na ɔpaa Dawid ne n’asomfoɔ nyinaa aboɔ; nso na ɔman no nyinaa ne mmarima akofoɔ no nyinaa wowɔ ne nifa ne ne benkum.
Na Simei redome no, sɛ ɔkaeɛ nie: Firi adi, firi adi, mogyapɛfoɔ, onipa huhuni!
AWURADE atua wo Saulo a wobɛdii n’adeɛ no fie mogya nyinaa so ka, na AWURADE de ahennie no ahyɛ wo ba Absalom nsa, na hwɛ, w’asotwe mu na woda yi, ɛfiri sɛ woahwie mogya agu!
Ɛnna Seruia ba Abisai ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Adɛn nti na ɔkraman funu yi dome me wura ɔhene yi?
Ma menkɔ menkɔtwa ne tiri ɛ!
Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na me ne mo Seruia mma wɔ yɛ?
Ma no nnome ara, na sɛ AWURADE ase no sɛ: Dome Dawid!
a, hwan na ɔbɛka akyerɛ no sɛ: Adɛn nti na woreyɛ sei?
Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Abisai ne ne nkoa sɛ: Hwɛ, me ba a ɔfiri me yam na ɔrehwehwɛ me aku me yi, na kampɛsɛ Benyaminni yi.
Monnyaa no mma no nnome, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE na wahyɛ no.
Ebia AWURADE bɛhwɛ m’amanehunu, na AWURADE de papa ahyɛ me nnome a ɔredome me nnɛ yi ananmu.
Na Dawid ne ne nnipa no nam kwan no so rekorɔ no, na Simei nso nam bepɔ no ho ntentensoɔ rekɔ; na ɔrekorɔ no, na ɔredome ara paa no aboɔ, na ɔtoo mfuturo peteeɛ.
Na ɔhene ne nnipa a wɔka ne ho no nyinaa durui Yordan ho no; na wɔabrɛ, na wɔhomee wɔ hɔ.
Ahitofel afotu bɔne no Na Absalom ne Israel mmarima nyinaa baa Yerusalem, na Ahitofel ka ne ho.
Na Arkini Husai a ɔyɛ Dawid adamfo baa Absalom nkyɛn no, Husai kyeaa Absalom sɛ: Ɔhene tiri nkwa, ɔhene tiri nkwa!
Na Absalom bisaa Husai sɛ: W’adɔeɛ a wode yɛ w’adamfo nie?
Adɛn nti na wo ne w’adamfo no ankorɔ?
Na Husai ka kyerɛɛ Absalom sɛ: Dabi, na deɛ AWURADE ne ɔman yi ne Israel mmarima nyinaa afa no no, ɔno na mɛyɛ ne deɛ na me ne no atena.
Bio nso, hwan na mɛsom no?
Ɛnyɛ ne ba?
Sɛdeɛ mesom w’agya no, saa ara na mɛyɛ no w’anim.
Ɛnna Absalom ka kyerɛɛ Ahitofel sɛ: Tu yɛn fo wɔ deɛ yɛnyɛ ho ɛ. Na Ahitofel ka kyerɛɛ Absalom sɛ: Kɔ ne w’agya mpenafoɔ a ɔgyaa wɔn sɛ wɔnhwɛ fie no nna, na Israel nyinaa nte sɛ woama wo ho abɔn w’agya, na wɔn a wɔwɔ wo nkyɛn nyinaa nsa bɛyɛ den.
Ɛnna wɔsii Absalom ntomadan, aban no atifi, na Absalom ne n’agya mpenafoɔ no daeɛ, Israel nyinaa anim.
Na Ahitofel ɛfo a ɔtuu no nna no mu yɛɛ wɔn sɛ obi kɔbisa Nyankopɔn hɔ adeɛ, na saa na na Ahitofel afotuo nyinaa teɛ ma Dawid ne Absalom.
Ahitofel afotuo yɛ ɔkwa Bio, Ahitofel ka kyerɛɛ Absalom sɛ: Ma menkɔyi mmarima mpem dummienu, na mensɔre menkɔti Dawid anadwo yi, mɛkɔ no so wɔ berɛ a wabrɛ na ne nsam agoɔ, na makɔ yi no ehu, ɛbɛma wɔn a wɔka ne ho nyinaa adwane, na makum ɔhene no nko.
Na afei mede nnipa no nyinaa masane mabrɛ wo, sɛdeɛ wɔde ayeforɔ ba ne kunu nkyɛn; na onipa baako pɛ na worehwehwɛ no aku no, na ɔman no nyinaa bɛyɛ komm.
Na asɛm no tɔɔ Absalom ne Israel mpanimfoɔ nyinaa aso mu.
Na Absalom kaa sɛ: Kɔfrɛ Arkini Husai nso bra, na yɛntie deɛ ɛwɔ ɔno nso anomu.
Na Husai baa Absalom nkyɛn no, Absalom ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ Ahitofel aka nie.
Yɛnni n’asɛm no so anaa?
Sɛ ɛnte saa a, wo nso ka bi.
Husai ka kyerɛɛ Absalom sɛ: Ɛfo a Ahitofel tuu seesei yi deɛ, ɛnyɛ.
Na Husai kaa sɛ: Wo ara wonim w’agya ne ne mmarima sɛ wɔyɛ ahoɔdenfoɔ, na wɔn bo ahuri sɛ sisire a wɔafa ne mma wiram, na w’agya nso yɛ dɔmmarima, na ɔne nkurɔfoɔ no renna anadwo yi.
Hwɛ, sɛsɛɛ wakɔhunta amena bi mu anaa baabi.
Na sɛ mfitiaseɛ no wɔn mu bi totɔ a, obiara a ɔbɛteɛ no bɛka sɛ: Nnipa a wɔdi Absalom akyire no adi nkoguo.
Na deɛ ɔyɛ ɔbarima na n’akoma te sɛ gyata akoma mpo, ehu nti, ɔbɛhodwo.
Na Israel nyinaa nim sɛ w’agya yɛ dɔmmarima na wɔn a wɔka ne ho nso yɛ akofoɔ.
Enti meretu wo fo sɛ: Boaboa Israel nyinaa ano firi Dan kɔsi Beer-seba wɔ wo nkyɛn sɛ mpoano anwea dodoɔ, na wo ara kɔ sa no.
Ɛno na sɛ yɛkɔto no baabiara a yɛbɛhu no a, yɛato ahyɛ ne so sɛdeɛ bosuo gu fam, na ɔno ne mmarima a wɔka ne ho no mu baako mpo anka.
Nanso sɛ ɔtwe ne ho kɔ kuro bi mu a, Israel nyinaa de ntampehoma bɛto kuro no ho, na yɛatwe akɔ bɔnhwa mu akɔsi sɛ wɔrenhunu ɔboɔ ketewa baako mpo wɔ hɔ.
Ɛnna Absalom ne Israel mmarima nyinaa kaa sɛ: Arkini Husai afotuo no yɛ sene Ahitofel deɛ no.
Na AWURADE na ahyɛ sɛ wɔmma Ahitofel afotu pa no nyɛ ɔkwa, na AWURADE de bɔne aba Absalom so.
Ɛnna Husai ka kyerɛɛ Asɔfoɔ Sadok ne Abiatar sɛ: Ɛfo a Ahitofel atu Absalom ne Israel mpanimfoɔ nie, na ɛfo a me nso matuo nie.
Na afei monsoma ntɛm na wɔnkɔka nkyerɛ Dawid sɛ: Ntena ɛserɛ so mpaperɛ mu anadwo yi, na twa mmom na twa korɔ, na wɔammɛtɔre ɔhene ne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔka ne ho nyinaa ase.
Nso na Yonatan ne Ahimaas tete En-rogel, na abaawa bi kɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn deɛ wɔnkɔka nkyerɛ Ɔhene Dawid, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔntumi nkɔ kuro no mu mma wɔnhu wɔn.
Nso aberanteɛ bi kɔhunuu wɔn, na ɔkɔka kyerɛɛ Absalom.
Na wɔn baanu no firii hɔ ntɛm kɔduruu Bahurim barima bi fie, na ɔwɔ abura n’adihɔ, na wɔsiane kɔtɛɛ mu.
Na ɔbaa no faa nkatasoɔ bi de kataa abura no ano, na ɔde atokoɔ a wɔasie trɛtrɛɛ so na obiara anhunu hwee.
Na Absalom asomfoɔ no duruu ɔbaa no nkyɛn efie hɔ no, wɔbisaa sɛ: Ɛhe na Ahimaas ne Yonatan wɔ?
Na ɔbaa no kaa sɛ: Wɔatwa asuwa no kɔ.
Na wɔhwehwɛɛ wɔn; na wɔanhu wɔn no, wɔsane baa Yerusalem.
Na wɔn korɔ akyiri no, mmarima no firi abura no mu firii adi, na wɔkɔ kɔka kyerɛɛ Ɔhene Dawid sɛ: Monsɔre nkɔtwa asuo no ntɛm, na ɛfo a Ahitofel atu wɔ mo ho nie.
Ɛnna Dawid ne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔka ne ho no nyinaa sɔre kɔtwaa Yordan no; adeɛ kyee anɔpa no, na wɔn mu baako mpo nkae a ɔnnya ntwaa Yordan.
Na Ahitofel hunuu sɛ wɔanni n’afotuo soɔ no, ɔhyehyɛɛ n’afunumu, na ɔsɔre kɔɔ ne fie, wɔ ne kurom.
Na ɔtotoo ne fie wieeɛ no, ɔkɔsɛnee ne mene wuiɛ, na wɔsiee no n’agya da mu.
Na Dawid duruu Mahanaim.
Na Absalom ne Israel mmarima no nyinaa kɔtwaa Yordan.
Na Absalom de Amasa sii Yoab ananmu hyɛɛ asraafoɔ dɔm no so.
Amasa yɛ ɔbarima a wɔfrɛ no Yitra, Israelni a ɔkɔɔ Nahas babaa Abigail a ɔyɛ Yoab ne na Seruia nua ho no, ba.
Na Absalom ne Israel kɔkyeree nsraban wɔ Gilead asase so.
Na Dawid duruu Mahanaim no, Nahas ba Sobi a ɔfiri Amonfoɔ Raba, ne Amiel ba Makir a ɔfiri Lo-debar, ne Gileadni Barsilai a ɔfiri Rogelim no de mpa, nyowa, nkukuo, atokoɔ, esiam, nkyeweɛ, asɛ, asedua, ɛwoɔ, nufosuo ani sradeɛ ne anantwie nufosuo a akyenkyen mua brɛɛ Dawid ne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔka ne ho no sɛ wɔnni, na wɔse: Ɛkɔm de nkurɔfoɔ no, na wɔabrɛ, na sukɔm ade wɔn ɛserɛ so.
Absalom nkoguo ne ne wuo Afei Dawid kanee ɛdɔm a wɔka ne ho no, na ɔde mpem mpem so asafohene ne ɔha ha so asafohene sisii wɔn so.
Na Dawid gyaa ɛdɔm no kwan de abupɛn mmiɛnsa mu baako hyɛɛ Yoab nsa, na ɔde baako hyɛɛ Seruia ba Abisai, Yoab nua, nsa, na ɔde baako hyɛɛ Gatni Itai nsa.
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ ɛdɔm no sɛ: Fire na me nso mene mo bɛfiri akorɔ.
Na ɛdɔm no kaa sɛ: Ɛnne yɛn nnkɔ, na sɛ dwane na yɛdwane a, wɔrennwene yɛn ho; na sɛ yɛn mu fa totɔ nso a, wɔrennwene yɛn ho, na wote sɛ yɛn mu mpem du; na enti ɛyɛ sɛ wo firi kuro no mu di boa yɛn.
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ mo ani soɔ no, mɛyɛ.
Na ɔhene gyinaa kuro pono no nkyɛn, na ɛdɔm no nyinaa firii adi, ɔha ha ne mpem mpem so.
Na ɔhene hyɛɛ Yoab ne Abisai ne Itai sɛ: Mo ne aberanteɛ Absalom no nni no brɛɛ mma me!
Na ɔhene rehyɛ asafohene nyinaa Absalom ho no, ɔman no nyinaa teeɛ.
Na ɛdɔm no firii adi kɔɔ wiram kɔhyiaa Israel; na wɔkoo wɔ Efraim kwaeɛ mu.
Na wɔkaa Israel dɔm no gui, Dawid nkoa no anim, na ekum kɛseɛ baa hɔ da no, nnipa mpem aduonu.
Na ɔko no trɛɛ wɔ asase no nyinaa ani, na ɛdɔm no mu wɔn a wɔwuu kwaeɛ no mu dɔɔso sene wɔn a wɔwuu nkrantɛ ano da no.
Na Absalom hyiaa Dawid mmarima no; nso na Absalom te afunumupɔnkɔ so, na afunumupɔnkɔ no de no faa odum kɛseɛ bi mman kusuu ase, na ne tirinwi kɔsɔɔ odum no dubaa so maa no sensɛnee ɔsoro ne fam ntam, na afunumupɔnkɔ a ɔwɔ n’aseɛ no gyaa ne hɔ kɔe.
Na ɔbarima bi kɔhunui, na ɔkɔka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ: Hwɛ makɔhunu Absalom sɛ ɔsɛne odum bi soɔ.
Na Yoab ka kyerɛɛ ɔbarima a ɔka kyerɛɛ no no sɛ: Saa!
Wohunuu no no, adɛn nti na woammɔ no anhwe fam hɔ?
Na anka mɛma wo dwetɛ du ne abɔsoɔ.
Nanso ɔbarima no ka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ: Sɛ wokari dwetɛ apem gu me nsam mpo a, merentene me nsa menka ɔhene ba no; na yɛn aso mu na ɔhene hyɛɛ wo, Abisai ne Itai sɛ: Monhwɛ yie, obiara biara, aberanteɛ Absalom no ho.
Anaasɛ, sɛ anka metwa ne kra ho nkontompo a, (nso asɛm biara nhunta ɔhene), wo deɛ, anka wobɛpa m’akyi agyina akyiri.
Na Yoab kaa sɛ: Merentwentwɛn me nan ase w’anim saa.
Na ɔfaa mpɛmɛ mmiɛnsa kurae, na ɔde kɔwowɔɔ Absalom akoma mu berɛ a ɔda so yɛ anikan odum no so.
Na mmeranteɛ du a wɔkura Yoab akodeɛ twaa Absalom ho hyiae, na wɔbobɔɔ no kumm no.
Ɛnna Yoab hyɛnee totorobɛnto, na ɛdɔm no nyinaa sane firii Israel akyi die; na Yoab siankaa ɛdɔm no.
Na wɔyii Absalom de no too kwaeɛ mu hɔ amena kɛseɛ bi mu, na wɔboaboaa aboɔkuo kɛseɛ pa ano guu ne so.
Na Israel nyinaa dwanedwane kokɔɔ wɔn ntomadan mu.
Nso Absalom te aseɛ no, ɔsii nkaeɛ dum bi a ɛwɔ ɔhene bonhwa mu fae, a ɔkaa sɛ: Menni ɔbabarima a wɔde no bɛkae me din.
Na ɔde ne din too odum no, na wɔfrɛ no Absalom nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ de bɛsi nnɛ.
Ɛnna Sadok ba Ahimaas kaa sɛ: Ma mentu mmirika menkɔbɔ ɔhene kaseɛ pa yi, sɛ AWURADE agye no afiri n’atamfo nsam.
Na Yoab ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛnyɛ wo na wobɛyɛ kaseɛbɔni nnɛ.
Da foforɔ na wobɛyɛ kaseɛbɔni, na ɛnnɛ deɛ, nkɔbɔ kaseɛ biara, ɛfiri sɛ ɔhene ba atɔ.
Na Yoab ka kyerɛɛ Kusni no sɛ: Kɔ na kɔka deɛ woahunu kyerɛ ɔhene.
Na Kusni no bɔɔ ne mu ase maa Yoab, na ɔtuu mmirika kɔeɛ.
Ɛnna Sadok ba Ahimaas kɔɔ so ka kyerɛɛ Yoab bio sɛ: Ɛyɛ dɛn ara a, ma me nso mentu mmirika menni Kusni no akyi.
Na Yoab kaa sɛ: Me ba, adɛn nti na worebɛtu mmirika yi?
Ɛnyɛ kaseɛ a ɛbɛma biribi afiri mu aba ama woɔ.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Ɛyɛ dɛn ara a, mɛtu mmirika.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Tu ɛ!
Ɛnna Ahimaas tuu mmirika faa nsunoa kwan so kɔsianee Kusni no ho.
Na Dawid te kuro no apono mmienu no ntam.
Na ɔwɛmfoɔ no kɔɔ kuro pono no atifi, ɔfasuo no so, na ɔmaa n’ani so hwɛe, na ɔhunuu ɔbarima bi a ne nko ara de mmirika reba.
Na ɔwɛmfoɔ no teaa mu ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene.
Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: Sɛ ɛyɛ ɔno nko a, na kaseɛ bi wɔ n’anomu.
Na ɔde reba ara, na ɔpinkyɛe.
Na ɔwɛmfoɔ no hunuu ɔbarima foforɔ sɛ ɔde mmirika reba; na ɔwɛmfoɔ no teaa mu kyerɛɛ ɔpono ano hwɛfoɔ no sɛ: Hwɛ ɔbarima foforɔ sɛ ɔde mmirika reba.
Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: Ɔno nso yɛ kaseɛbɔni.
Na ɔwɛmfoɔ no kaa sɛ: Me deɛ, mehunu odikanfoɔ no mmirikatuo sɛ ɛte sɛ Sadok ba Ahimaas mmirikatuo.
Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: Onipa pa nie, na ɔde kaseɛ pa reba.
Na Ahimaas teaa mu ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Asomdwoeɛ!
Na ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase ɔhene anim, na ɔkaa sɛ: Nhyira nka AWURADE, wo Nyankopɔn a wayi nnipa a wɔmaa wɔn nsa so tiaa me wura ɔhene no ahyɛ wo nsa.
Na ɔhene bisaa sɛ: Aberanteɛ Absalom ho yɛ anaa?
Na Ahimaas buaa sɛ: Yoab resoma ɔhene somfoɔ bi ne w’akoa no, mehunuu kitikiti kɛseɛ bi, na mennim adekodeɛ.
Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: Sene gyina ha!
Na ɔsene kɔgyinaa hɔ.
Na hwɛ, Kusni no bae; na Kusni no kaa sɛ: Me wura ɔhene ntie kaseɛ, sɛ AWURADE abu atɛn ama wo nnɛ, wɔn a wɔsɔre tiaa woɔ no nyinaa ho.
Na ɔhene bisaa Kusni no sɛ: Aberanteɛ Absalom ho yɛ anaa?
Na Kusni no se: Ma me wura ɔhene atamfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔsɔre tia woɔ pɛ wo bɔne no nyinaa nyɛ sɛ aberanteɛ no!
Na ɔhene ho popoe, na ɔforo kɔɔ kuro pono so pia mu, na ɔsui.
Na ɔrekorɔ no, sɛ ɔkaeɛ nie: Ao, me ba Absalom, me ba, me ba Absalom!
Ɛkaa me nko a, anka mesii w’ananmu wui!
Ao, Absalom, me ba, me ba!
Dawid agyaadwotwa Wɔka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ: Hwɛ, ɔhene resu, na ɔretwa Absalom ho adwo.
Na nkonimdie no danee nnipa no nyinaa abooboodie ɛda no; na nkurɔfoɔ no tee da no sɛ ɔhene redi awerɛhoɔ ma ne ba.
Na nnipa no wiawiaa wɔn ho baa kuro no mu da no, sɛdeɛ ɛdɔm a wɔredwane ɔko mu wɔ ahohora mu wiawia wɔn ho no.
Na ɔhene deɛ, na wakata n’anim, na ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaa mu sɛ: Ao, me ba Absalom, ao, Absalom me ba, me ba!
Na Yoab baa ɔhene nkyɛn efie, na ɔkaa sɛ: Woahyɛ wo nkoa a ɛnnɛ wɔagye wo kra, wo mmammarima, wo mmammaa kra, wo yerenom kra ne wo mpenafoɔ kra no nyinaa aniwuo nnɛ, sɛ wodɔ w’atamfoɔ na wotane w’adɔfoɔ.
Na woakyerɛ nnɛ sɛ asafohene ne nkoa nyɛ hwee mma wo; na mahunu sɛ, sɛ Absalom nyaa nkwa na yɛn nyinaa wuwuiɛ a, anka wopɛ.
Na afei sɔre firi adi, na kɔka abotɔyam asɛm kyerɛ wo nkoa.
Na medɔ Nyame sɛ, sɛ woamfiri adi a, obiara rentena wo nkyɛn anadwo yi, na ɛno mmom bɛyɛ bɔne ama wo asene bɔne biara a aba wo soɔ firi wo mmeranteberɛ mu de abɛduru sɛsɛɛ.
Ɛnna ɔhene sɔre bɛtenaa ase wɔ kuro pono no mu.
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinaa sɛ: Hwɛ, ɔhene te kuro pono no mu.
Ɛnna ɔman no nyinaa baa ɔhene anim.
Dawid saneba Na Israel deɛ, na wɔadwanedwane kɔ wɔn afie mu.
Na ɔman no nyinaa kasakasaa Israel mmusuakuo nyinaa mu sɛ: Ɔhene gyee yɛn firii yɛn atamfoɔ nsam, na ɔyii yɛn Filistifoɔ nsam; na afei Absalom nti wadwane afiri asase yi so.
Na Absalom a yɛsraa no ngo dii yɛn soɔ no nso atɔ dɔm ano; na afei adɛn nti na motwentwɛn sɛ mobɛkɔ akɔfa ɔhene asane aba yi?
Na Ɔhene Dawid tee deɛ Israel nyinaa aka no, ɔsoma maa wɔkɔɔ Asɔfoɔ Sadok ne Abiatar nkyɛn sɛ: Monkɔbisa nkyerɛ Yuda mpanimfoɔ sɛ: Adɛn nti na motwentwɛn mo nan ase sɛ mobɛba abɛfa ɔhene asane akɔ ne fie?
Me nuanom ne mo, me nnompe ne me nam ne mo, na adɛn nti na motwentwɛn mo nan ase sɛ mobɛba abɛfa ɔhene asane akorɔ?
Na Amasa nso, monka nkyerɛ no sɛ: Ɛnyɛ me nnompe ne me nam ne wo?
Sɛ woanyɛ dɔm so safohene m’anim nna nyinaa ansi Yoab ananmu a, Onyankopɔn nyɛ me sɛɛ na ɔnkɔ so nyɛ me sɛɛ!
Ɔtwee Yuda mmarima nyinaa bae sɛ onipa baako, na wɔsoma maa wɔbaa ɔhene nkyɛn sɛ: Wo ne wo nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa, monsane mmra.
Na ɔhene sane baa Yordan ano.
Na Yuda baa Gilgal sɛ wɔreba abɛhyia Ɔhene, na wɔde no atwa Yordan.
Na Benyaminni Gera ba Simei a ɔfiri Bahurim no yɛɛ ntɛm ne Yuda mmarima no siane ba bɛhyiaa Ɔhene Dawid, na Benyamin mmarima apem ka ne ho, na Saulo fie abɔfra Siba ne ne mma dunum ne n’asomfoɔ aduonu no ne no bɛtwaa Yordan baa ɔhene anim.
Na kodoɔ no twa kɔɔ sɛ wɔde rekɔfa ɔhene fiefoɔ, na wɔayɛ deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ n’ani soɔ.
Na ɔhene rebɛtwa Yordan no, Gera ba Simei bɔɔ ne mu ase n’anim, na ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Mma me wura mmmu amumuyɛ nnto me so, na nkae deɛ w’akoa fom yɛɛ no da a me wura ɔhene firii Yerusalem no, na ɔhene mmfa nnhyɛ n’akomam.
Na w’akoa nim sɛ mayɛ bɔne; saa nti, hwɛ, me na madi Yosef fie nyinaa kan maba nnɛ sɛ meresiane mabɛhyia me wura ɔhene.
Na Seruia ba Abisai bisaa sɛ: Ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔkum Simei, sɛ wadome deɛ AWURADE asra no no anaa?
Na Dawid buaa sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na me ne mo Seruia mma wɔ yɛ, sɛ moyɛ sɛ atamfoɔ a wɔne me di asie nnɛ yi?
Ɛnnɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkum obi Israel anaa?
Mennim sɛ ɛnnɛ mene Israel so hene anaa?
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Simei sɛ: Wɔrenku wo.
Na ɔhene kaa no ne ntam.
Na Saulo ba Mefiboset siane ba bɛhyiaa ɔhene; na ɔnsiesiee ne nan ase, na ɔnyii ne bɔdwesɛ, na ne ntadeɛ nso ɔnsii, firi da a ɔhene kɔeɛ no de bɛsi da a ɔbaa fie asomdwoeɛ mu no.
Na ɔfirii Yerusalem bɛhyiaa ɔhene no, ɔhene bisaa no sɛ: Mefiboset, adɛn nti na wo ne me ankorɔ?
Na ɔbuaa sɛ: Ao, me wura ɔhene, me somfoɔ no na ɔdaadaa me; na wo somfoɔ ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hyehyɛ afunumu na mentena no so nkɔ ne ɔhene nkɔ, ɛfiri sɛ wo somfoɔ yɛ apakye.
Na ɔbɛsɛee me kyerɛɛ me wura ɔhene.
Na me wura ɔhene te sɛ Nyankopɔn bɔfoɔ, enti yɛ deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ w’ani soɔ.
Na m’agya fie nyinaa nsɛ hwee sɛ owuo mma ma me wura ɔhene, nanso wode wo somfoɔ sii wɔn a wɔdidi wo pono soɔ mu, enti kwan bɛn na mewɔ bio, nso ɛdeɛn na mede bɛsu afrɛ ɔhene bio?
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Adɛn nti na woda so ka w’asɛm yi bio?
Mese: Wone Siba nkɔkyɛ asase no mu.
Na Mefiboset ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Sɛ me wura ɔhene de asomdwoeɛ anya aba ne fie yi, ma Siba mfa asase nyinaa mpo.
Na Gileadni Barsilai siane firii Rogelim bae, na ɔne ɔhene twaa Yordan, sɛ ɔrekɔgya no Yordan agya.
Nso na Barsilai abɔ akora sɛ, wadi mfirinhyia aduɔwɔtwe.
Na ɔhene tenaa Mahanaim no, ɔno na ɔhwɛɛ no, na ɔyɛ ɔdefoɔ kɛseɛ.
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Barsilai sɛ: Wo deɛ, wo ne me ntwa nkɔ, na menhwɛ wo me nkyɛn wɔ Yerusalem.
Na Barsilai bisaa ɔhene sɛ: Me nkwa nna aka ahe na me ne ɔhene mforo nkɔ Yerusalem yi?
Madi mfirinhyia aduɔwɔtwe nnɛ, mɛhunu papa ne bɔne mu, anaasɛ w’akoa bɛte deɛ mɛdie ne deɛ mɛnom dɛ, anaasɛ mɛte nnwontofoɔ mmarima ne mmaa nne bio anaa?
Na adɛn nti na wo somfoɔ nkɔ so nyɛ adesoa mma me wura ɔhene?
Enti wo somfoɔ bɛgya ɔhene kwan Yordan agya ara.
Na adɛn nti na ɔhene de akatua yi bɛtua me?
Wo kyɛw nie, ma w’akoa nsane nkɔwu ne kurom, n’agya ne ne na damena ho.
Na hwɛ, ma wo somfoɔ Kimham ne me wura ɔhene ntwa nkɔ, na yɛ no deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ w’ani soɔ.
Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: Kimham ne me ntwa nkɔ, na mɛyɛ no deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ w’ani soɔ; na biribiara a wobɛhwehwɛ no me hɔ no, mɛyɛ ama wo.
Na ɔman no nyinaa twaa Yordan, na ɔhene nso twae; na ɔhene yɛɛ no atuu, na ɔhyiraa no maa ɔsane kɔɔ fie.
Na ɔhene sene kɔɔ Gilgal; na Kimham ne no kɔe.
Na Yuda man nyinaa ne Israel man fa nso de ɔhene sene kɔe.
Na hwɛ, Israel mmarima nyinaa baa ɔhene nkyɛn bɛbisaa ɔhene sɛ: Adɛn nti na yɛn nuanom Yuda mmarima awia wo korɔ, na wɔde ɔhene ne ne fiefoɔ ne Dawid mmarima a wɔka ne ho nyinaa akɔtwa Yordan aba?
Ɛnna Yuda mmarima nyinaa buaa Israel mmarima sɛ: Ɛfiri sɛ ɔhene bɛn yɛn.
Na adɛn nti na asɛm yi nti mo bo huru mo yi?
Yɛadi ɔhene biribi anaasɛ wakyɛ yɛn biribi anaa?
Na Israel mmarima no buaa Yuda mmarima sɛ: Yɛwɔ kyɛfa du ɔhene mu, na Dawid mu nso deɛ yɛwɔ sene mo.
Adɛn nti na moabu yɛn ketewa, na ɛnyɛ yɛn na yɛdii kan kaa sɛ yɛde ɔhene bɛsane aba?
Na Yuda mmarima nsɛm ano yɛɛ den sene Israel mmarima nsɛm no.
Seba mansotwe ne Amasa wuo Na ɔbarima huhuni bi wɔ hɔ a ne din de Seba a ɔyɛ Benyaminni Bikri ba.
Na ɔhyɛnee totorobɛnto sɛ: Yɛnni kyɛfa biara wɔ Dawid mu, na yɛnni agyapadeɛ Yisai ba no nkyɛn.
Israel, monkɔ mo adan mu.
Ɛnna Israel mmarima nyinaa firii Dawid akyi kɔ kɔdii Bikri ba Seba akyire.
Na Yuda mmarima deɛ, wɔbataa wɔn hene ho firi Yordan ho ara de baa Yerusalem.
Na Dawid baa ne fie wɔ Yerusalem.
Na Dawid faa mmaa du, ne mpenafoɔ a ɔgyaa wɔn sɛ wɔnhwɛ fie no de wɔn kɔguu mmaa mu, na ɔbɔɔ wɔn akɔnhoma, na wɔn ho deɛ, wankɔ.
Na wɔtoo wɔn mu kɔsii wɔn wu da maa wɔdii wɔn nkwa berɛ te sɛ deɛ wɔyɛ kuna.
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Amasa sɛ: Kɔfrɛfrɛ Yuda mmarima ma wɔnhyia me nnansa yi mu ara, na wo nso bra bi.
Na Amasa kɔɔ sɛ ɔrekɔfrɛfrɛ Yudafoɔ; na ɔkyɛre sene berɛ a wɔhyɛɛ no no.
Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Abisai sɛ: Afei deɛ, Bikri ba Seba bɛyɛ yɛn bɔne asene Absalom deɛ no mpo: Wo deɛ, fa wo wura mmarima no na ti no, na wannya afasuo nkuro no bi amfa, na wammɛha yɛn.
Ɛnna Yoab mmarima ne Keretifoɔ ne Peletifoɔ ne nnɔmmarima no nyinaa tu dii n’akyire; na wɔfirii Yerusalem sɛ wɔreti Bikri ba Seba.
Na wɔduruu Gibeon boɔ kɛseɛ no ho no, Amasa bɛfirii wɔn anim.
Na Yoab deɛ, na wabɔ n’akotadeɛ a ɔhyɛ no so, ɛso na na ne nkrantɛ abɔsoɔ wɔ, ɛsɛne n’asene mu, bɔha mu; na ɔrefiri adie no, ɛworɔ tɔɔ fam.
Na Yoab bisaa Amasa sɛ: Me nua, wo ho yɛ anaa?
Na Yoab de ne nsa nifa kɔsɔɔ Amasa bɔdwesɛ mu sɛ ɔrefe n’ano.
Na Amasa anhwɛ nkrantɛ a ɛkura Yoab nsam no, na ɔde wɔɔ ne yafunu mu tuee ne nsono guu fam, na wamfoa no so, na ɔwui.
Na Yoab ne ne nua Abisai tii Bikri ba Seba.
Na Yoab mmeranteɛ no mu bi gyinaa ne nkyɛn na ɔkaa sɛ: Deɛ ɔpɛ Yoab asɛm ne deɛ ɔyɛ Dawid deɛ no, ma no nni Yoab akyi!
Na Amasa yantamyantam mogya mu tempɔn no so.
Na obiara a ɔbɛduru hɔ sɛ n’ani bɔ no so a, na wagyina.
Saa nti, ɔbarima no hunuu sɛ ɛdɔm no nyinaa gyinagyina hɔ no, ɔtwee Amasa firii tempɔn no so kɔtoo wiram na ɔde ntoma kataa ne so.
Na wɔyii no firii tempɔn no soɔ no, wɔn nyinaa sene kɔdii Yoab akyi tii Bikri ba Seba.
Na Seba faa Israel mmusuakuo nyinaa mu twaa mu kɔduruu Abel ne Bet-maaka ne Bikrifoɔ nyinaa so, na wɔhyia boaa ano ba bɛdii n’akyi.
Na ɛdɔm a wɔka Yoab ho no nyinaa kɔkaa no hyɛɛ Abel a ɛwɔ Bet-maaka, na wɔtotoo kuro no ho epie wɔ afasuo no akyi, na wɔpempemee afasuo no sɛ wɔredwiri agu.
Ɛnna ɔbaa nyansafoɔ bi firi kuro no mu teaa mu sɛ: Montie, montie!
Monka nkyerɛ Yoab sɛ ɔntwe mpini ha, na me ne no nkasa.
Na ɔtwe pinii no no, ɔbaa no bisaa no sɛ: Ɔne Yoab anaa?
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Mene no.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Tie w’abaawa nsɛm yi.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Meretie.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Akane no na wɔka sɛ: Wɔnkɔ abisa wɔ Abel, na wɔawie no saa.
Meyɛ wɔn a wɔpɛ asomdwoeɛ ne nokorɛ no mu baako, wo deɛ, worehwehwɛ akum Israel mu kuro a ɛyɛ ɛna; adɛn nti na worebɛmene AWURADE agyapadeɛ?
Na Yoab buaa sɛ: Ɛmpare me, ɛmpare me sɛ mɛmene anaasɛ mɛsɛeɛ.
Asɛm no nte saa, na ɔbarima bi a ɔfiri Efraim bepɔ soɔ a ne din de Bikri ba Seba na wama ne nsa so atia Ɔhene Dawid.
Monyi ɔno nko mma, na mɛfiri kuro no ho akɔ.
Na ɔbaa no ka kyerɛɛ Yoab sɛ: Hwɛ, wɔbɛto ne tiri afa ɔfasuo no so ama wo.
Ɛnna ɔbaa no faa nyansa kwan so kɔɔ ɔman no nyinaa nkyɛn.
Na wɔtwaa Bikri ba Seba ti to twenee Yoab.
Na Yoab hyɛnee totorobɛnto, na wɔfirii kuro no ho hwete kokɔɔ wɔn ntomadan mu.
Na Yoab sane baa Yerusalem ɔhene nkyɛn.
Dawid asomfoɔ Nso Yoab na na ɔdi Israel asraa dɔm nyinaa soɔ, na Yoiada ba Benaia di Keretifoɔ ne Peletifoɔ soɔ.
Na Adoram di ɛtoɔ soɔ, na Ahilud ba Yosafat ne ɔsɛnkaefoɔ.
Na Sefa ne ɔtwerɛfoɔ, na Sadok ne Abiatar ne asɔfoɔ.
Na Yairini Ira nso yɛ Dawid sɔfoɔ.
Gibeonfoɔ tɔ Saulo so were Na ɛkɔm bi baa Dawid berɛ so mfeɛ mmiɛnsa, afe toa afe so.
Na Dawid kɔbɔɔ AWURADE anim mpaeɛ.
Na AWURADE buaa sɛ: Mogya ho afobuo aba Saulo ne ne fiefoɔ so sɛ ɔkumm Gibeonfoɔ no.
Ɛno nti ɔhene frɛɛ Gibeonfoɔ no.
Nso na Gibeonfoɔ no mfiri Israelfoɔ mu, na mmom wɔyɛ Amorifoɔ nkaeɛ no bi, — na Israelfoɔ aka ntam akyerɛ wɔn sɛ wɔrenkum wɔn, nanso Saulo hwehwɛɛ sɛ ɔku wɔn wɔ mmɔden a wɔbɔ maa Israel ne Yudafoɔ no mu.
Ɛnna Dawid bisaa Gibeonfoɔ no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na menyɛ mma mo?
Na ɛdeɛn na memfa mpata mo na moahyira AWURADE agyapadeɛ?
Na Gibeonfoɔ ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛnyɛ dwetɛ anaa sika asɛm na yɛne Saulo ne ne fiefoɔ wɔka, ɛnna ɛnyɛ Israel mu obi na yɛrepɛ no aku no.
Na ɔse: Ɛdeɛn na mose menyɛ mma mo?
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Ɔbarima a ɔdwerɛɛ yɛn a ɔtuu yɛn tiri so agyina sɛ wɔnsɛe yɛn na yɛannya Israel asase biara so antena no, ma wɔmfa ne mma mu mmarima nson mma yɛn, na yɛnsensɛne wɔn mma AWURADE wɔ Saulo a AWURADE faa no no kuro Gibeon mu.
Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: Mɛma.
Na AWURADE ntam a ɛda wɔn ntamu, na ɛda Dawid ne Saulo ba Yonatan ntamu no nti, ɔhene hunuu Saulo ba Yonatan ba Mefiboset mmɔbɔ.
Na ɔhene faa Aia babaa Rispa mmammarima mmienu a ɔwo maa Saulo, Armoni ne Mefiboset ne Saulo babaa Mikal mmammarima nnum a ɔwo maa Meholatni Barsilai ba Adriel no, na ɔde wɔn hyɛɛ Gibeonfoɔ no nsa, na wɔsensɛnee wɔn bepɔ no so AWURADE anim, na wɔn nnipa nson no totɔɔ prɛko.
Na wɔkumm wɔn twaberɛ nna a ɛdi kan mu, atokoɔtwa mfitiaseɛ mu.
Na Aia babaa Rispa faa ayitoma de sɛɛ ɔbotan no so deɛ amu no wɔ no fae firii twaberɛ mfitiaseɛ no kɔsii sɛ osuo firi soro guguu wɔn soɔ, na wamma ewiem nnomaa ammɛsisi wɔn so awia, na wiram mmoadoma nso amma wɔn so anadwo.
Na wɔbɛkaa deɛ Aia ba Rispa, Saulo mpena no yɛeɛ no kyerɛɛ Dawid.
Na Dawid kɔ kɔgyee Saulo nnompe ne ne ba Yonatan nnompe firii Yabes-gileadfoɔ nsam, na wɔn na wɔkɔwiaa no Bet-san abɔntene soɔ, deɛ Filistifoɔ de wɔn sensɛnee da a Filistifoɔ kumm Saulo wɔ Gilboa no, na ɔde Saulo nnompe ne ne ba Yonatan nnompe firii hɔ bae, na wɔboaboaa ano kaa wɔn a wɔsensɛnee wɔn no nnompe ho.
Na wɔsiee Saulo ne ne ba Yonatan nnompe Benyamin asase so wɔ Sela, n’agya Kis da mu; na wɔyɛɛ deɛ ɔhene hyɛɛ wɔn no nyinaa; na ɛno akyiri no Onyankopɔn dom asase no.
Filistifoɔ so nkonimdie Na Filistifoɔ ne Israel dii ako bio.
Na Dawid ne ne nkurɔfoɔ siane kɔnee Filistifoɔ no koe; na Dawid brɛe.
Na Yisbi-benob a ɔyɛ abrane mma mu bi a ne pea duro kari kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nnwetɛbena ahasa na ɔde nkrantɛ foforɔ abɔ n’asene no kaa sɛ ɔrebɛkum Dawid.
Na Seruia ba Abisai boaa no, na Dawid bɔɔ Filistini no kumm no.
Ɛno na Dawid mmarima no kaa ntam sɛ: Wo ne yɛn remfiri nnkɔ ɔsa bio, na wɔannum Israel kanea.
Yei akyiri no, wɔne Filistifoɔ nyaa ɔko bio wɔ Gob.
Ɛno mu na Husani Sibekai kumm Saf a ɔyɛ abrane mma mu bie no.
Na wɔne Filistifoɔ nyaa ɔko bio wɔ Gob.
Na Betlehemni Yaare-oregim ba Elhanan kumm Gitini Goliat a ne pea dua te sɛ ntomanwomfoɔ nsadua.
Na ɔko baa bio wɔ Gat.
Na ɔbarima tentene bi wɔ hɔ a ɔwɔ nsateaa ne nansoaa nsia nsia ma ano si aduonu nnan, na ɔno nso yɛ abrane no bi ba.
Na ɔretwitwa Israel mpoa no, Dawid nua Simei ba Yonatan kumm no.
Nnipa baanan yi yɛ Gat abrane no bi mma a wɔtotɔɔ Dawid ne ne nkoa nsam.
Dawid aseda ne nkonimdie dwom Na da a AWURADE yii Dawid firii n’atamfo nyinaa ne Saulo nsam no, ɔkaa dwom yi mu nsɛm kyerɛɛ AWURADE, na ɔse: AWURADE, ne me botan, m’abankɛseɛ ne me gyefoɔ, me botantim Nyankopɔn a medwane mekɔtoa no.
Me kyɛm ne me nkwagyeɛ abɛn, m’abantenten ne me dwanekɔbea, m’agyenkwa a wogyee me firii akakabensɛm mu.
AWURADE a ɔfata sɛ wɔyi no ayɛ no na mesu mefrɛ no, na ɔgye me m’atamfoɔ nsam.
Na owuo asorɔkyeɛ twaa me ho hyiae, na sɛeɛ asuasu woro yii me hu.
Asamando nhoma kyekyeree me, owuo fidie bɛhyiaa me rebɛyi me.
M’ahohiahia mu mesu mefrɛɛ AWURADE, me Nyankopɔn na meteaa mu mefrɛɛ no.
Na ɔtee me nne n’asɔrefie, na me nteamu duruu n’aso mu.
Ɛnna asase hinhimiiɛ, na ɛwosoe, ɔsoro nnyinasoɔ nso popoe, na ɛhinhimii, ɛfiri sɛ na ne bo afu.
Wisie tu firii ne hwenem, na ogya firii n’anomu hyee adeɛ, na nnyansramma a wɔasɔ ne mu.
Ɔkuntunuu ɔsoro na ɔdurui fam, na esum kabii wɔ ne nan ase.
Na ɔtenaa Kerub so tui, na wɔhunuu no mframa ntaban so.
Na ɔde esum yɛɛ ne ho asese, nsuo mmoaano, danee mununkum kusuu.
Ne ho haran mu na nnyansramma dɛreeɛ.
AWURADE bɔɔ mu firii soro, na ɔsorosoroni no maa wɔtee ne nne.
Na ɔtotoo agyan de bɔɔ wɔn petee, aprannaa na ɔde tuu wɔn ase.
Na ɛpo mu aka yiyii adi, wiase nnyinasoɔ ho daa hɔ.
Ɛnam AWURADE animuka nti, ɛfiri ne hwene mu home tehyeetehyee mu.
Ɔtenee ne nsa firii soro bɛfaa me, ɔtwee me firii nsuo pii mu.
Ɔgyee me firii me tamfo aniɛdenfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔkyiri me no nsam, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn ho yɛ den sene me.
Wɔbɛtoaa me m’amanehunu da mu, na AWURADE bɛyɛɛ me okyigyinafoɔ, na ɔyii me kɔgyinaa deɛ ɛhɔ trɛ, ɔgyee me, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔpɛ m’asɛm.
AWURADE tuaa me ka sɛdeɛ me tenenee teɛ, sɛdeɛ me bemdie teɛ na ɔtuaa me ka.
Na mehwɛɛ AWURADE akwan, na menyɛɛ bɔne mfirii me Nyankopɔn ho.
Na n’atemmudeɛ nyinaa wɔ m’ani so, na n’ahyɛdeɛ nso, memfirii ho.
Na manni fɔ wɔ n’anim, na mahwɛ me ho so afiri m’amumuyɛ ho.
Na AWURADE atua me ka sɛdeɛ me tenenee teɛ, sɛdeɛ m’ahoteɛ a ɛda n’anim no teɛ.
Ɔnokwafoɔ na wo ne no bɛdi no nokorɛ mu, ɔbarima a ɔdi mu na wo ne no bɛdi no amudie soɔ.
Deɛ ne ho teɛ na wobɛte wo ho akyerɛ no, na ɔkontonkyini deɛ, wobɛkyinkyim wo ho akyerɛ no.
Na ɔman a wɔbrɛ wɔn ho aseɛ no, wogye wɔn, na w’ani sa ahantanfoɔ na woabrɛ wɔn ase.
Na wo, AWURADE, wone me kanea, na AWURADE haran me sum mu ma me.
Na wo na mede wo tu dɔm, na mede me Nyankopɔn mehuri metra ɔfasuo.
Onyankopɔn deɛ, ne kwan yɛ pɛ, AWURADE bɔhyɛ yɛ nokorɛ, ɔyɛ ɛkyɛm ma wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to ne soɔ nyinaa.
Na hwan ne onyame?
Gye sɛ AWURADE nko.
Na hwan na ɔyɛ ɔbotan?
Gye sɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn.
Saa Onyankopɔn yi ne m’aban a ɛyɛ den, na ɔma me kwan yɛ dwoodwoo.
Ɔyɛɛ me nan sɛ aforotebereɛ deɛ, na ɔmaa megyinaa me mmepɔ so pintinn.
Ɔkyerɛ me nsa akodie, na m’abasa akuntunu kɔbere mfrafraeɛ tadua mu.
Na wode wo nkwagye kyɛm maa me, na wo mmoa ma meyɛɛ kɛseɛ.
Wotrɛ m’anammɔn tutuo mu wɔ m’ase na me nan anwatiri.
Metii m’atamfoɔ na mesɛee wɔn, na mansane de kɔsii sɛ mehyee wɔn, na memenee wɔn, na mebobɔɔ wɔn na wɔansɔre, na wɔtotɔe wɔ me nan ase.
Na wode ahoɔden bɔɔ me abɔsoɔ maa akodie, wobrɛɛ wɔn a wɔsɔre tiaa me no ase hyɛɛ m’ase.
Na womaa m’atamfoɔ danee wɔn akyi kyerɛɛ me, wɔn a na wɔkyiri me no, na mesɛee wɔn.
Wɔhwɛe, na ɔgyefoɔ biara nni hɔ, wɔsu frɛɛ AWURADE, na wammua wɔn.
Na mepɛkyɛɛ wɔn pasaa sɛ fam mfuturo, metiatiaa wɔn so mewɔɔ wɔn sɛ mmɔntene so dɔteɛ.
Woyii me firii m’amanko mu, woahwɛ me sɛ menyɛ amanaman ti.
Ɔman a menni wɔn no som me.
Ananafoɔ bɛbrɛ wɔn ho ase ama me, wɔtee me nka pɛ, wɔtiee me.
Ananafoɔ bo tui, na wɔde ahopopoɔ firi wɔn aban mu bae.
AWURADE te ase, na nhyira nka me botantim no.
Na me nkwagyeɛ botan Nyankopɔn no, wɔmma no so.
Onyankopɔn a ɔtɔɔ were maa me, na ɔbrɛɛ aman ase hyɛɛ m’ase, deɛ ɔyii me firi m’atamfoɔ nsam, aane, wo na woma me so boro wɔn a wɔsɔre tia me no soɔ, wogyee me firi aniɛdenfoɔ nsam, Enti, AWURADE, mɛkamfo wo amanaman mu, na mabɔ wo din mato ayeyie nnwom, sɛ wone deɛ ɔma ne hene nkwagyeɛ so, na ɔyɛ deɛ wasra no no adɔeɛ, Dawid ne n’asefoɔ daa.
Dawid nsɛm a ɛdi akyire Na yeinom ne Dawid nsɛm a ɛdi akyire.
Yisai ba Dawid adiyisɛm a wanya sɛ ɔreka, ɔbarima a wɔmaa no soɔ no adiyisɛm, deɛ Yakob Nyankopɔn asra no ne Israel dwom dɛdɛ tofoɔ asɛm a ɔreka nie: AWURADE honhom nam me so kasa, na n’asɛm wɔ me tɛkyerɛma so.
Israel Nyankopɔn akasa, me na Israel botan no kasa kyerɛɛ me.
Deɛ ɔdi nnipa soɔ a ɔtene, deɛ ɔdi so Nyankopɔn suro mu.
Na ɔbɛyɛ sɛ anɔpa hann, berɛ a owia repue, sɛ anɔpa a mununkum nni hɔ, sɛ owia gyegyeɛ ne osutɔ nti wira fifiri fam.
Aane, ɛnyɛ saa na me fie teɛ wɔ Nyankopɔn nkyɛn?
Na ɔne me apam daa apam, wasiesie nnoɔma nyinaa mu na wɔhwɛ so.
Na me mmoa nyinaa ne deɛ mepɛ nyinaa, ɔremma no mfefɛ anaa?
Nanso ahuhufoɔ deɛ, wɔn nyinaa te sɛ nkasɛɛ a wɔato aguo, na wɔmfa nsa nsɔ mu.
Na onipa a ɔrebɛka no no, wɔde dadeɛ ne pea dua ma no ma no de mia, na ɛhyeɛ ara na wɔde ogya bɛhyeɛ ama no asa koraa.
Dawid nnɔmmarima ne wɔn nneyɛɛ Yeinom ne nnɔmmarima a Dawid wɔ no din: Takemoni Yoseb-basebet a ɔdi akunini mmiɛnsa no mu titire.
Ɔno na ɔmaa ne pea so nnipa ahanwɔtwe a ɔkunkum wɔn prɛko soɔ.
Na deɛ ɔdi n’akyire ne Ahohi ba Dodo ba Eleasa a ɔfra nnɔmmarima baasa a wɔka Dawid ho berɛ a wɔresopa Filistifoɔ a na wɔaboaboa wɔn ano rebɛko na Israel mmarima foro kɔeɛ no mu.
Ɔno na ɔsɔre kunkumm Filistifoɔ no kɔsii sɛ ne nsam goeɛ na ne nsa fam ne nkrantɛ ho.
Na AWURADE yɛɛ nkonim ade kɛseɛ da no, na ɛdɔm no dane kɔdii n’akyiri sɛ wɔbɛfom adeɛ nko.
Na deɛ ɔdi n’akyire ne Hararini Agee ba Sama.
Na Filistifoɔ no boaboaa wɔn ano yɛɛ asafo, na asasewa bi wɔ hɔ a asedua wɔ soɔ, na ɔman no dwane Filistifoɔ no anim.
Na ɔno deɛ, ɔgyinaa asase no mfimfini na ɔperee, na ɔkum Filistifoɔ no, na AWURADE yɛɛ nkonim ade kɛseɛ.
Na atitire aduasa no mu baasa siane baa Dawid nkyɛn twaberɛ wɔ Adulam bodan mu.
Na Filistifoɔ asafo bi akyere nsraban Refaim bonhwa mu.
Nso ɛberɛ no mu no, na Dawid wɔ bepɔ so atenaeɛ no mu, na Filistifoɔ bansifoɔ wɔ Betlehem.
Na sukɔm dee Dawid, na ɔkaa sɛ: Hwan na ɔbɛma me Betlehem asubura a ɛwɔ kuro pono ho no mu nsuo anom?
Na nnɔmmarima baasa no te faa Filistifoɔ nsraban no mu kɔsaa Betlehem asubura a ɛwɔ kuro pono ho no mu nsuo de brɛɛ Dawid.
Nanso wampɛ sɛ ɔnom, na ɔhwie gu maa AWURADE, na ɔse: Ɛmpare me, AWURADE, sɛ mɛyɛ yei.
Mennom mmarima a wɔde wɔn kra too wɔn nsam kɔeɛ no mogya?
Na wampɛ sɛ ɔnom.
Yei na nnɔmmarima baasa no yɛeɛ.
Na Yoab nua Seruia ba Abisai nso di baasa no mu titire.
Ɔno na ɔtwee ne pea kumm nnipa ahasa, na ɔgyee din sɛ baasa no.
Ɔno na na ɔwɔ animuonyam kɛseɛ wɔ nnipa aduasa no mu, na ɔdi wɔn so safohene, nanso wanto akane nnipa baasa no.
Na Yehoiada ɔbarima a ɔfiri Kabseel a ɔyɛ mmaninneɛ a ɛso no ba Benaia kumm Moab gyatasɛefoɔ baanu; na ɔno nso siane kɔkum gyata wɔ abura mu, sukyerɛmma da bi; na ɔno ara nso kɔkum Misraimni bi a ɔyɛ ɔbarima a ɔso, na Misraimni no kura pea ne nsam, na ɔde poma siane kɔɔ ne nkyɛn, na ɔhwam Misraimni no nsam pea no de ɔno ara ne pea no kumm no.
Yei na Yehoiada ba Benaia yɛeɛ, na ɔnyaa din nnɔmmarima baasa no mu.
Akunini aduasa no mu na ɔwɔ animuonyam, na akane baasa no deɛ, wanto wɔn.
Na Dawid de no sii n’ankɔbeafoɔ so.
Yoab nua Asahel fra aduasa no mu; Dodo ba Elhanan a ɔfiri Betlehem, Harodini Sama, Harodini Elika, Paltini Heles, Ikes ba Ira a ɔyɛ Tekoani, Anatotni Abieser, Husatni Mebunai, Ahohini Salmon, Netofani Maharai, Netofani Baana ba Heleb, Ribai ba Itai a ɔfiri Benyamin mma Gibea.
Piratonni Benaia, Hidai a ɔfiri Nahale-gaas, Arabani Abi-albon, Barhumini Asmawet, Saalbonni Eliahba, Yasenfoɔ no mu: Yonatan.
Hararini Sama, Hararini Sarar ba Ahiam, Maakati ba Ahasbai ba Elifelet, Giloni Ahitofel ba Eliam, Karmelni Hesro, Arbini Paarai, Natan ba Yigal a ɔfiri Soba, Gadni Bani, Amonni Selek, Beerotni Naharai, Seruia ba Yoab akodeɛkurani, Yitrini Ira, Yitrini Gareb, Hetini Uria.
Wɔn nyinaa yɛ aduasa nson.
Ɔman no kan ne ɛho asotwe Na AWURADE bo huru tiaa Israel bio, na ɔpiapiaa Dawid hyɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Kɔ na kɔkan Israel ne Yuda.
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ ɔsahene Yoab a ɔka ne ho no sɛ: Kɔkyini Israel mmusuakuo nyinaa mu firi Dan kɔsi Beer-seba, na monkan ɔman no, na menhunu ɔman no dodoɔ.
Na Yoab ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nka ɔman no sɛdeɛ wɔteɛ yi ho mprɛha, na me wura ɔhene ani nhunu, na adɛn nti na me wura ɔhene pɛ sɛ wɔdi saa asɛm yi?
Nanso ɔhene asɛm no yɛɛ Yoab ne ɛdɔm no mu asafohene no so den.
Na Yoab ne ɛdɔm no mu asafohene no firi ɔhene anim firii adi, sɛ wɔrekɔkan Israel man no.
Na wɔkɔtwaa Yordan, na wɔkɔsoɛɛ Aroer, kuro bi a ɛda Gad subonhwa no mu a ɛkyerɛ Yaser no nifa, na wɔkɔɔ Gilead ne anafoɔ Hodsi asase so, na wɔkɔɔ Dan-yaan ne Sidon.
Na wɔduruu Tiro kuro a ɛyɛ den no ne Hewifoɔ ne Kanaanfoɔ nkuro nyinaa mu.
Na wɔfiri hɔ baa Yuda anafoɔ fam wɔ Beer-seba.
Na wɔkyinii asase no nyinaa so, na abosome nkron ne adaduonu akyiri no, wɔbaa Yerusalem, na Yoab de ɔman no anobuo no dodoɔ brɛɛ ɔhene, na Israel dɔm mu mmarima a wɔtwe nkrantɛ ano si mpem ha ahodoɔ nwɔtwe, na Yuda mmarima yɛ mpem ha ahodoɔ nnum.
Na Dawid kan ɔman no saa no, n’akoma bɔɔ no paripari, na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: Deɛ mayɛ yi, mayɛ bɔne pa ara, na afei AWURADE, mesrɛ wo, ma w’akoa amumuyɛ nsene nkɔ, na madi nkwaseasɛm sɛ!
Na Dawid sɔree anɔpa no, AWURADE asɛm baa Odiyifoɔ Gad, Dawid dehununi no nkyɛn sɛ: Kɔ na kɔka kyerɛ Dawid sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Adeɛ mmiɛnsa na mede mereto w’anim, fa emu baako na memfa menyɛ wo.
Na Gad baa Dawid nkyɛn bɛka kyerɛɛ no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛkɔm mmra w’asase so mfeɛ nson, anaasɛ wobɛdwane w’atamfoɔ a wɔpamo woɔ anim abosome mmiɛnsa, anaasɛ ɔyaredɔm mmra w’asase so nnansa?
Afei hwɛ, na hunu mmuaeɛ ko a memfa mensane menkɔma deɛ ɔsomaa me no.
Ɛnna Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Gad sɛ: Me ho hiahia me sɛ!
Ma yɛnhwe AWURADE nsa mu ɛ, na ne mmɔborɔhunu dɔɔso; na nnipa nsam na wɔmmma mennhweɛ.
Ɛnna AWURADE maa owuyadeɛ baa Israel soɔ firi anɔpa kɔsii berɛ a ɔhyɛeɛ no, na ɔman a ɛfiri Dan kɔsi Beer-seba no mu nnipa mpem aduɔson wuwui.
Arauna ayuporebea afɔrebɔ Na ɔbɔfoɔ no tenee ne nsa Yerusalem so sɛ ɔresɛe no no, AWURADE nuu ne ho mmusuo no ho, na ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔsɛe ɔman no sɛ: Ayɛ yie, pono wo nsa.
Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ no aduru Yebusini Arauna ayuporebea ho.
Na Dawid hunuu ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔsɛe ɔman no no, ɔka kyerɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: Hwɛ, me na mayɛ bɔne, na me na mafom, na nnwan yi deɛ, ɛdeɛn na wɔayɛ?
Ma wo nsa mmra me ne m’agya fie so.
Na Gad baa Dawid nkyɛn da no bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Foro kɔ na kɔsi afɔrebukyia ma AWURADE Yebusini Arauna ayuporebea hɔ.
Na Dawid nam Gad asɛm no so foro kɔe, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛeɛ no.
Na Arauna hwɛeɛ no, ɔhunuu ɔhene ne ne nkoa sɛ wɔresene aba ne nkyɛn.
Na Arauna firii adi kɔbɔɔ ne mu ase ɔhene anim.
Ɛnna Arauna bisaa sɛ: Adɛn nti na me wura ɔhene reba n’akoa nkyɛn yi?
Na Dawid buaa sɛ: Merebɛtɔ wo hɔ ayuporebea no, na masi afɔrebukyia mama AWURADE, na wɔasi ɔhaw no kwan afiri ɔman no so.
Na Arauna ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: Ma me wura ɔhene mfa, na ɔmmɔ afɔdeɛ sɛdeɛ ɛyɛ wɔ n’ani soɔ.
Hwɛ, ɔhyeɛ afɔrebɔ nantwie ne poreɛ nteaseɛnam ne anantwie no adwumayɛ nnua a wɔde bɛyɛ nnyina nie.
Ɔhene, Arauna de ne nyinaa ma ɔhene.
Na Arauna ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ani nsɔ wo.
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Arauna sɛ: Dabi, na tɔ na mɛtɔ no wo hɔ, sɛdeɛ ne boɔ teɛ, na meremfa adeɛ biara a ɛnsom me boɔ memmɔ AWURADE me Nyankopɔn ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ.
Na Dawid tɔɔ ayuporebea no ne anantwie no maa dwetɛ nnwetɛbena aduonum.
Na Dawid sii afɔrebukyia maa AWURADE wɔ hɔ, na ɔbɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ.
Na AWURADE gyee mpata no maa asase no, na wɔsii ɔhaw no kwan firii Israel so.
NHYƐNMU Ahemfo nwoma a ɛdi kan no yɛ Israel ahennie ho abakɔsɛm a ɛyɛ Samuel nwoma no ntoasoɔ.
Wɔakyekyɛ mu mmiɛnsa; Salomo di a ɔdii Yuda so hene ne n’agya Dawid wuo.
Salomo ahennie ne deɛ ɔyɛe.
Deɛ ɛda adi yie wɔ ne berɛ so ne Yerusalem Asɔredan a ɔsiiɛ no.
Kyɛ a wɔkyɛɛ ɔman no mu mmienu; atifi ne anafoɔ ahemman, ne nsɛm a ɛfa ahemfo a wɔdii adeɛ firii mfitiaseɛ kɔsii afe ahankron a ɛdi Yesu awoɔ anim no mfimfini.
Ahemfo nwoma mmienu no mu na wɔbuu ɔhene biara atɛn sɛdeɛ ne nokorɛ a ɔdii Onyankopɔn no teɛ, na wɔhunu ɔman no nkɔsoɔ sɛ ɛgyina saa nokorɛdie yi so.
Ɔkwan bi so no, abosonsom ne asoɔden na ɛde saa amanehunu yi baeɛ.
Atifi ahennie mu ahemfo no nyinaa dii ntwo wɔ sɔhwɛ no mu, na deɛ wɔatwerɛ ato hɔ kyerɛ sɛ Yuda ahemfo no deɛ yɛ afrafra.
Nnipa a wɔda adie titire wɔ Ahemfo nwoma a ɛdi kan no mu no ne AWURADE adiyifoɔ no, wɔn a wɔyɛ nnipa akokoɔdurufoɔ a wɔkasa maa Onyankopɔn na wɔbɔɔ ɔman no kɔkɔ sɛ wɔnnsom abosom na wɔnnyɛ asoɔden ntia Onyankopɔn.
Deɛ ɔyɛ titire wɔ wɔn mu ne Elia a ɔne Baal akɔmfoɔ no dii apereapereɛ no .

Yudahene Yehosafat ne Israelhene Ahasia .-
Dawid mmerɛyɛ ne Adoniya ho asɛm Afei Ɔhene Dawid abɔ akora, na ɛwom sɛ na ne nkoa de bomo kata ne ho deɛ, nanso ne ho anyɛ no hye.
Enti ne nkoa ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ma yɛnhwehwɛ ababaa bi mmrɛ me wura ɔhene, na ɔmmɛgyina ɔhene anim nyɛ ne hwɛfoɔ, na ɔnna wo kokom na me wura ɔhene ho nyɛ no hye.
Ɛnna wɔkɔhwehwɛɛ ababaa hoɔfɛfoɔ bi Israel ahyeɛ nyinaa mu, na wɔkɔhunuu Sunamni Abisag, na wɔde no brɛɛ ɔhene.
Na ababaa no ho yɛ fɛ pa ara, na ɔyɛɛ ɔhene hwɛfoɔ na ɔsomm no.
Nanso ɔhene ne no anna.
Na Hagit ba Adoniya maa ne ho so kaa sɛ: Me na mɛdi hene.
Na ɔsiesiee nteaseɛnam ne apɔnkɔsotefoɔ ne mmarima aduonum a wɔbɛbɔ ne ho ban.
Nanso n’agya anka asɛm a ɛyɛ ya biara ankyerɛ no da sɛ: Adɛn na woayɛ saa yi?
Na ɔno nso yɛ onipa a ne ho yɛ fɛ, na ɔno na wɔwoo no dii Absalom akyire.
Na ɔne Seruia ba Yoab ne Ɔsɔfoɔ Abiatar dii atirimusɛm, na wɔdii Adoniya akyi boaa no.
Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Sadok, Yoiada ba Benaia, Odiyifoɔ Natan, Simei, Rei ne Dawid nnɔmmarima no deɛ, na wɔnni Adoniya afa.
Na Adoniya kumm nnwan, anantwie ne anantwie a wɔadɔre sradeɛ wɔ Sohelet Boɔ a ɛwɔ En-rogel ho no so, na ɔhyiahyiaa ne nuanom ahene mma no nyinaa ne Yuda mmarima a wɔyɛ ɔhene nkoa no nyinaa.
Na Odiyifoɔ Natan ne Benaia ne nnɔmmarima no ne ne nua Salomo deɛ, wanhyia wɔn.
Ɛnna Natan ka kyerɛɛ Batseba, Salomo na sɛ: Dabrɛ wontee sɛ Hagit ba Adoniya redi hene, na yɛn wura Dawid nnim?
Afei, bra na memma wo adwene, na gye wo ne wo ba Salomo nkwa.
Kɔ Ɔhene Dawid nkyɛn, na ka kyerɛ no sɛ: Ɛnyɛ wo, me wura ɔhene na wokaa w’afenaa ntam sɛ: Wo ba Salomo na ɔbɛdi m’adeɛ, na ɔno na ɔbɛtena m’adwa soɔ?
Na adɛn nti na Adoniya di hene yi?
Hwɛ, wo ne ɔhene da so rekasa wɔ hɔ no, me nso mɛdi w’akyiri aba, na mabɛfoa wo so.
Na Batseba kɔɔ ɔhene nkyɛn pia mu; na ɔhene abɔ akora pa ara, na Sunamni Abisag som ɔhene.
Ɛnna Batseba bɔɔ ne mu ase maa ɔhene.
Na ɔhene bisaa no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na worehwehwɛ?
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Me wura, wo na wokaa AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ntam kyerɛɛ w’abaawa sɛ: Wo ba Salomo na ɔbɛdi w’adeɛ, na ɔno na ɔbɛtena w’adwa soɔ.
Na afei, hwɛ, Adoniya na ɔredi hene yi; nanso, me wura ɔhene, wonnim.
Na wakum anantwie ne nyɛmmoa ne nnwan bebree, na wahyiahyia ahene mma nyinaa ne Ɔsɔfoɔ Abiatar ne Ɔsahene Yoab, na w’akoa Salomo deɛ, wanto ne nsa amfrɛ no.
Na wo, me wura ɔhene, na Israel nyinaa ani da wo soɔ sɛ wobɛkyerɛ wɔn deɛ ɔbɛdi me wura ɔhene akyiri atena adwa no soɔ.
Anyɛ saa a, me wura ɔhene wuo akyiri no wɔbɛbu me ne me ba Salomo mmaratofoɔ.
Na hwɛ, ɔda so ne ɔhene rekasa no, Odiyifoɔ Natan nso baa hɔ.
Na wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Hwɛ, Odiyifoɔ Natan nie.
Na ɔduruu ɔhene anim no, ɔkotoo ɔhene de n’anim butuu fam.
Na Natan kaa sɛ: Me wura ɔhene, wo na wose: Adoniya nni m’adeɛ, na ɔno na ɔntena m’adwa so anaa?
Na ɛnnɛ wasiane kɔ, na wakɔkum anantwie ne anantwie a wɔadɔre sradeɛ ne nnwan bebree, na wahyia ɔhene mma nyinaa ne asafohene ne Ɔsɔfoɔ Abiatar, na hwɛ, wɔredidi na wɔrenom n’anim, na wɔka sɛ: Ɔhene Adoniya nkwa so!
Na me, w’akoa ne Ɔsɔfoɔ Sadok ne Yoiada ba Benaia ne w’akoa Salomo deɛ, wanto ne nsa amfrɛ yɛn.
Me wura ɔhene nkyɛn na asɛm yi fire, na woamma w’akoa anhunu deɛ ɔbɛtena me wura ɔhene adwa no soɔ n’akyiri?
Ɛnna Ɔhene Dawid buaa sɛ: Momfrɛ Batseba mma me.
Na ɔba bɛgyinaa ɔhene anim.
Na ɔhene kaa ntam sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE a ɔgyee me kra firii ahohiahia nyinaa mu te aseɛ yi, sɛdeɛ mekaa AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn ntam mekyerɛɛ wo sɛ: Wo ba Salomo na ɔbɛdi m’adeɛ, na ɔno na ɔbɛtena m’adwa soɔ asi m’ananmu no, saa ara na mɛyɛ nnɛ da yi.
Ɛnna Batseba bɔɔ ne mu ase de n’anim butuu fam kotoo ɔhene kaa sɛ: Me wura ɔhene nnya nkwa daa!
Wɔsra Salomo si no hene Na Ɔhene Dawid kaa sɛ: Momfrɛ Ɔsɔfoɔ Sadok ne Odiyifoɔ Natan ne Yoiada ba Benaia mma me.
Na wɔbaa ɔhene anim.
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Momfa mo wura nkoa nka mo ho, na momfa me ba Salomo ntena m’afunumupɔnkɔ so, na momfa no nsiane nkɔ Gihon.
Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Sadok ne Odiyifoɔ Natan nsra no ngo mfa no nsi Israel so hene wɔ hɔ, na monhyɛne totorobɛnto sɛ: Ɔhene Salomo nkwa so oo!
Na momforo nni n’akyi, na ɔmmra mmɛtena m’adwa so, na ɔnsi m’ananmu nni hene, na ɔno na mahyɛ no sɛ ɔnyɛ Israel ne Yuda so hene.
Ɛnna Yoiada ba Benaia buaa ɔhene sɛ: Amen!
Saa ara nso na AWURADE me wura Ɔhene Nyankopɔn nka.
Sɛdeɛ AWURADE ne me wura ɔhene tenaeɛ no, saa ara nso na ɔne Salomo ntena, na ɔmma n’adwa nso nsene me wura Ɔhene Dawid adwa no.
Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Sadok ne Odiyifoɔ Natan ne Yoiada ba Benaia, Keretifoɔ ne Peletifoɔ siane kɔe, na wɔde Salomo tenaa ɔhene afunumupɔnkɔ so, na wɔde no kɔɔ Gihon.
Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Sadok faa ngo abɛn firii ntomadan no mu de bɛsraa Salomo.
Na wɔhyɛnee totorobɛnto, na ɔman no nyinaa kaa sɛ: Ɔhene Salomo nkwa so!
Na ɔman no nyinaa foro dii n’akyiri bae, na ɔman no hyenhyɛnee ntɛntɛbɛn, na wɔn ani gyee kɛse, na wɔn gyegyeegye no reyɛ ama asase mu apae.
Na Adoniya ne wɔn a wahyia wɔn a wɔne no wɔ hɔ no nyinaa teeɛ.
Na wɔawie adidi; na Yoab tee totorobɛnto no nka no, ɔkaa sɛ: Kuro no mu hooyɛ a yɛteɛ yi ase ne sɛn?
Na ɔda so rekasa no, hwɛ, Ɔsɔfoɔ Abiatar ba Yonatan bae; na Adoniya kaa sɛ: Bra, na woyɛ ɔbarima a wofata, na wokura kaseɛ pa. Na Yonatan bua see Adoniya sɛ: Dabi, na yɛn wura Ɔhene Dawid de Salomo asi hene.
Na ɔhene asoma Ɔsɔfoɔ Sadok ne Odiyifoɔ Natan ne Yoiada ba Benaia, Keretifoɔ ne Peletifoɔ aka ne ho, na ɔde no atena ɔhene afunumupɔnkɔ so, na Ɔsɔfoɔ Sadok ne Odiyifoɔ Natan asra no de no asi hene Gihon, na wɔde anigyeɛ de no aforo afiri hɔ aba, na kuro no mu ayɛ hoo: Ɛno ne gyegyeegye a moteeɛ no.
Nso Salomo te ahennwa no so.
Yeinom nyinaa akyiri no, ɔhene nkoa aba abɛma yɛn wura Ɔhene Dawid amo sɛ: Onyankopɔn mma Salomo din nyɛ kɛse nsene wo din, na ɔmma n’adwa nso nsene w’adwa.
Na ɔhene bɔɔ ne mu ase ne mpa so; na ɔhene kaa sɛ: Nhyira ne AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn a wama me ba atena m’adwa so nnɛ yi, na m’ani ahunu.
Ɛnna nnipa a wɔahyia wɔn a wɔyɛ Adoniya deɛ no nyinaa ho popoe, na wɔsɔresɔree sisii wɔn akwan so kɔe.
Na Adoniya suroo Salomo anim, na ɔsɔre kɔe kɔsosɔɔ afɔrebukyia abɛn mu.
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ Salomo sɛ: Hwɛ, Adoniya suro Ɔhene Salomo, na hwɛ, wakɔsosɔ afɔrebukyia abɛn mu sɛ: Ɔhene Salomo nka me ntam nnɛ, sɛ ɔremfa nkrantɛ nkum n’akoa.
Na Salomo kaa sɛ: Sɛ ɔdane onipa a ɔfata a, ne nwi baako mpo rentɔ fam; na sɛ wɔhunu bɔne wɔ ne mu a, ɔbɛwu.
Na Ɔhene Salomo soma maa wɔkɔfaa no firii afɔrebukyia no ho siane bae.
Na ɔba bɛkotoo Ɔhene Salomo, na Salomo ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kɔ wo fie.
Dawid samanseɛ ne ne wuo Afei Dawid nna bɛnee sɛ ɔbɛwuo no, ɔhyɛɛ ne ba Salomo sɛ: Me deɛ, mereti nananom wɔ asamando: Enti yɛ den na yɛ ɔbarima; na hwɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ahyɛdeɛ sɛ wobɛnante n’akwan so, sɛ wobɛdi n’ahyɛdeɛ, ne mmara nsɛm ne n’atemmudeɛ ne n’adansesɛm soɔ, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ no Mose mmara mu no, na woadi yie deɛ woyɛ nyinaa mu, baabiara a wobɛkorɔ.
Na AWURADE ama n’asɛm a ɔkaa no me ho no atim, sɛ ɔse: Sɛ wo mma hwɛ wɔn akwan so yie sɛ wɔbɛnante m’anim nokorɛ mu, wɔn akoma nyinaa ne wɔn kra nyinaa mu a, ɛnneɛ Israel adwa so barima remmɔ wo.
Bio, wo ara wonim deɛ Seruia ba Yoab yɛɛ me, deɛ ɔyɛɛ Israel asahene baanu Ner ba Abner ne Yeter ba Amasa, sɛ ɔdii wɔn awuo na ɔkaa ɔsa mu mogya guu asomdwoeɛ berɛ mu, na ɔde ɔsa mu mogya kekaa n’abɔsoɔ a ɛbɔ n’asene ne ne mpaboa a ɛhyɛ ne nan ho no.
Enti di no nyansa so, na mma ne dwono mmfa asomdwoeɛ mu nnsiane nnkɔ Asamando.
Na Gileadni Barsilai mma deɛ, yɛ wɔn adɔeɛ na ma wɔntena wɔn a wɔdidi wo pono soɔ mu; Na saa na wɔtwe baa me nkyɛn berɛ a medwanee wo nua Absalom anim no.
Na hwɛ, Benyaminni Gera ba Simei a ɔfiri Bahurim a ɔwɔ wo nkyɛn yi, ɔno na ɔdomee me nnome denden da a mekɔɔ Mahanaim no.
Nanso ɔsiane bɛhyiaa me Yordan ho, na mede AWURADE kaa no ntam sɛ meremfa nkrantɛ menku no.
Na afei deɛ, mma ne ho nnyɛ tɔtorɔtɔɔ, na woyɛ ɔba nyansafoɔ, na wobɛhunu adeɛ a wobɛyɛ no, na woama ne dwono nam mogya mu asiane akɔ Asamando.
Ɛnna Dawid tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no Dawid kuro mu.
Na nna a Dawid de dii Israel so hene yɛ mfirinhyia aduanan.
Ɔdii hene mfeɛ nson wɔ Hebron, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ aduasa mmiɛnsa Yerusalem.
Na Salomo tenaa n’agya adwa so, na n’ahennie tim pintinn pa. Salomo nneyɛɛ bi Na Hagit ba Adoniya baa Salomo na Batseba nkyɛn.
Na ɔbisaa no sɛ: Asomdwoeɛ mu na woreba yi?
Na ɔse: Asomdwoeɛ mu.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Mewɔ asɛm bi meka kyerɛ wo.
Na ɔse: Ka ɛ!
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Wo ara wonim sɛ anka ahennie no yɛ me dea, na me so na Israel nyinaa de wɔn ani toeɛ sɛ mɛdi hene, nanso ahennie no danee, na akɔyɛ me nua deɛ; na AWURADE na ɔde maa no.
Na afei adeɛ baako pɛ na merebisa no wo hɔ, na nkame me.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kasa ɛ!
Na ɔse: Mesrɛ wo, ka kyerɛ Ɔhene Salomo, na ɔrenkame wo, na ɔmfa Sunamni Abisag mma me aware.
Na Batseba kaa sɛ: Yoo, mɛka makyerɛ ɔhene mama wo.
Ɛnna Batseba baa Ɔhene Salomo nkyɛn sɛ ɔde Adoniya dwantoa rebrɛ no.
Na ɔhene sɔre kɔhyiaa no, na ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase maa no, na ɔtenaa n’adwa so; na wɔde adwa sii hɔ maa ɔhene na, na ɔtenaa ne nifa so.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Ade ketewa bi na merebɛbisa no wo hɔ, na nkame me.
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Awo, bisa, na merenkame wo.
Na ɔse: Ma wɔmfa Sunamni Abisag mma wo nua Adoniya awareɛ.
Na Ɔhene Salomo bua see ne na sɛ: Na adɛn nti na wobisa Sunamni Abisag awareɛ ama Adoniya?
Bisa ahennie no nso ma no, na ɔno ne me nua panin, na Ɔsɔfoɔ Abiatar ne Seruia ba Yoab nso wɔ n’afa.
Ɛnna Ɔhene Salomo kaa AWURADE ntam sɛ: Onyankopɔn nyɛ me sei na ɔnkɔ so saa, sɛ Adoniya asɛm a waka yi nti wɔakum no a. Na afei, sɛ AWURADE a wama matim, na ɔde me atena m’agya Dawid adwa soɔ, na wakyekyere fie ama me sɛdeɛ ɔkaeɛ no te aseɛ yi, ɛnnɛ ara wɔbɛkum Adoniya.
Na Ɔhene Salomo somaa Yoiada ba Benaia maa no kɔkumm no.
Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Abiatar nso, ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kɔ Anatot, wo ara w’asase so, na woyɛ owuo ba.
Na ɛnnɛ yi deɛ, merenku wo, ɛfiri sɛ woasoa AWURADE Nyankopɔn adaka no m’agya Dawid anim, na wohunuu amane nso wɔ deɛ m’agya hunuu mu amaneɛ nyinaa mu.
Saa na Salomo tuu Abiatar sɛ ɔnnni AWURADE sɔfoɔ bio, na ɔnam yei so maa AWURADE asɛm a ɔkaa Eli fie ho wɔ Silo no baa mu.
Na asɛm no duruu Yoab nkyɛn; na Yoab adane akɔdi Adoniya akyi, na Absalom akyiri deɛ, wannane ankɔdi; na Yoab dwane kɔɔ AWURADE ntomadan mu kɔsɔɔ afɔrebukyia mmɛn no mu.
Na wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ Ɔhene Salomo sɛ: Yoab adwane kɔ AWURADE ntomadan mu, na hwɛ, wakɔsɔ afɔrebukyia no ho mmɛn no mu.
Na Salomo somaa Yoiada ba Benaia sɛ: Kɔku no.
Na Benaia kɔɔ AWURADE ntomadan no mu kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ ɔhene seɛ nie: Firi adi!
Na ɔse: Dabi, na ɛha na mɛwuo.
Na Benaia sane bɛka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Sɛdeɛ Yoab aka nie, na sɛdeɛ wabua me nie.
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Yɛ sɛdeɛ ɔkaeɛ no, na kɔku no, na sie no, na yi mogya a Yoab ahwie agu kwa no ho afodie firi me ne m’agya fie so.
Na AWURADE mma ne mogya mmua n’atifi, sɛ ɔkumm mmarima baanu a wɔtene a wɔyɛ sene no, na ɔde nkrantɛ dii wɔn awuo: Ner ba Abner, Israel sahene ne Yeter ba Amasa, Yuda sahene no berɛ a m’agya Dawid nnim ho bie.
Na wɔn mogya nsane mmɛbua Yoab atifi ne n’asefoɔ, atifi nkɔsi daa, na Dawid ne n’asefoɔ ne ne fie ne n’adwa nnya AWURADE nkyɛn asomdwoeɛ daa.
Na Yoiada ba Benaia foro kɔkumm no; na wɔsiee no ne fie wɔ ɛserɛ so.
Na ɔhene de Yoiada ba Benaia sii n’ananmu dii ɛdɔm no so, na Ɔsɔfoɔ Sadok nso, ɔhene de no sii Abiatar ananmu.
Na ɔhene soma maa wɔkɔhyiaa Simei bae, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Si dan wɔ Yerusalem fa, na tena hɔ, na mfiri hɔ nkɔ baabiara, na da a wobɛfiri adie akɔtwa Kidron subonhwa no, hunu sɛ, wuo na wobɛwuo, na wo mogya bɛbua w’atifi.
Na Simei ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Ɛyɛ; sɛdeɛ me wura ɔhene aka no, saa ara na w’akoa bɛyɛ.
Na Simei tenaa Yerusalem nna pii.
Na mfeɛ mmiɛnsa akyiri no, Simei nkoa baanu dwane kɔɔ Gathene Maaka ba Akis nkyɛn.
Na wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ Simei sɛ: Hwɛ, wo nkoa no wɔ Gat.
Na Simei sɔre hyehyɛɛ n’afunumupɔnkɔ, na ɔsii mu kɔɔ Gat, Akis nkyɛn sɛ ɔrekɔhwehwɛ ne nkoa no; na Simei kɔ kɔfaa ne nkoa no firii Gat bae.
Na wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ Salomo sɛ: Simei afiri Yerusalem akɔ Gat, na wasane aba.
Na ɔhene soma maa wɔkɔfaa Simei bae sɛ: Manka wo AWURADE ntam manni wo adanseɛ sɛ da a wobɛfiri adi akɔ baabiara no, hunu sɛ wuo na wobɛwuo?
Na woka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Ɛyɛ, mate.
Adɛn nti na woanni AWURADE ntam ne mmara a mehyɛɛ woɔ no soɔ?
Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Simei sɛ: Wo ara wonim, w’akomam, bɔne a wode yɛɛ m’agya Dawid no nyinaa, na AWURADE adane wo bɔne no agu w’atifi.
Na nhyira bɛka Ɔhene Salomo, na Dawid adwa bɛtim AWURADE anim akɔsi daa.
Na ɔhene hyɛɛ Yoiada ba Benaia, na ɔfirii adi kɔkumm no.
Na ahennie no tim Salomo nsam.
Salomo bisa Awurade hɔ nyansa Na Salomo ne Misraimhene Farao yɛɛ awareɛ apam.
Na ɔfaa Farao babaa waree, ɔde no baa Dawid kuro mu kɔsii sɛ ɔwiee ne dan ne AWURADE dan ne Yerusalem ho fasuo no toɔ.
Na ɔman no da so bɔ afɔdeɛ sorɔnsorɔmmea ara, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔnsii dan biara mmaa AWURADE din.
Na Salomo nam n’agya Dawid ahyɛdeɛ no mu dɔ AWURADE, nanso ɔbɔ afɔdeɛ na ɔhye aduhwam sorɔnsorɔmmea no so.
Na ɔhene kɔɔ Gibeon sɛ ɔrekɔbɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ na ɛno ne sorɔnsorɔnbea kɛseɛ.
Ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ apem na Salomo bɔɔ no afɔrebukyia no soɔ.
Na AWURADE yii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ Salomo anadwo daeɛ mu wɔ Gibeon, na Onyankopɔn kaa sɛ: Srɛ deɛ menyɛ mma woɔ.
Na Salomo se: Wo na woyɛɛ w’akoa m’agya Dawid adɔeɛ kɛseɛ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnantee w’anim nokorɛ ne tenenee mu, ne wo ho akoma mu teeyɛ mu, na wode adɔeɛ kɛseɛ yi asie ama no, na woama no ɔba a ɔte n’adwa soɔ, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ yi.
Na afei, ao AWURADE me Nyankopɔn, wo na woasi w’akoa ɔhene asi m’agya Dawid ananmu, na me deɛ, meyɛ abɔfra ketewa, mennim adifire ne emuba.
Na w’akoa wɔ wo man a woayi wɔn, ɔman kɛseɛ a wɔn dodoɔ nti wɔntumi nkan wɔn mmu wɔn ano no mu.
Enti ma w’akoa nteaseɛ adwene na memfa memmu wo man atɛn, na menhunu papa ne bɔne mu, na hwan na ɔbɛtumi abu wo man kɛseɛ yi atɛn?
Na ɛsɔɔ AWURADE ani, sɛ Salomo abisa asɛm yi.
Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛsiane sɛ wobisaa asɛm yi, na woammisa nna dodoɔ amfa, na woammisa ahonyadeɛ amfa, nso woammisa w’atamfo nkwa, na mmom wobisa nhunumu, a wode bɛtie atemmuo yi, hwɛ, mayɛ sɛdeɛ w’asɛm no seɛ.
Hwɛ, mama wo nyansa ne nhunumu adwene a obiara a ɔdii w’anim nte sɛ woɔ, na w’akyiri nso, obiara rensɔre a ɔsɛ woɔ.
Afei deɛ wommisaeɛ no mama wo, ahonya ne animuonyam a ahemfo mu biara rento woɔ wo nna nyinaa mu.
Na sɛ wonante m’akwan mu na wodi m’ahyɛdeɛ ne me mmara nsɛm so sɛdeɛ w’agya Dawid nanteeɛ a, mɛma wo nna aware.
Na Salomo nyanee, na hwɛ, ɛyɛ daeɛ.
Na ɔbaa Yerusalem, na ɔbɛgyinaa AWURADE apam adaka no anim, na ɔbɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ, na ɔtoo ne nkoa nyinaa pono.
Salomo atemmuo bi Ɛberɛ no mu no, mmaa nnwamamfoɔ mmienu bi baa ɔhene nkyɛn bɛgyinaa n’anim.
Na ɔbaa baako kaa sɛ: Me wura, mepa wo kyɛw, me ne ɔbaa yi te fie koro mu, na mewoo ba wɔ ne nkyɛn efie hɔ.
Na ɛbaa sɛ mewoeɛ akyiri nnansa no, ɔbaa yi nso woe, na yɛwɔ faako ara, ɔhɔhoɔ bi nka yɛn ho efie hɔ gye yɛn mmienu pɛ na yɛwɔ efie no mu.
Na ɔbaa yi ba no wuu anadwo, ɛfiri sɛ ɔdaa ne so.
Na ɔsɔree ɔdasuo mu bɛfaa me ba no wɔ me nkyɛn, nso na w’afenaa ada, na ɔde no too ne kokom, na ɔde ne ba a wawuo no bɛtoo me kokom.
Na mesɔree anɔpa sɛ merema me ba nufoɔ no, na hwɛ, wawu.
Na mehwehwɛɛ ne ho anɔpa no, na hwɛ, ɛnyɛ me ba a mewoo no a. Na ɔbaa baako no se: Dabi, na me ba ne ɔteasefoɔ no, na wo ba ne owufoɔ no.
Na oyi se: Dabi, na wo ba ne owufoɔ no, na me ba ne ɔteasefoɔ no.
Na wɔkasakasaa ɔhene anim hɔ.
Ɛnna ɔhene kaa sɛ: Oyi se: Me ba ne ɔteasefoɔ no, na wo ba ne owufoɔ no; na oyi se: Dabi, na wo ba ne owufoɔ no, na me ba ne ɔteasefoɔ no.
Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: Mommrɛ me nkrantɛ.
Na wɔde nkrantɛ baa ɔhene anim.
Na ɔhene kaa sɛ: Monkyɛ abɔfra a ɔte aseɛ no mu mmienu, na momfa ɔfa mma ɔbaako, na momfa ɔfa mma ɔbaako.
Ɛnna ɔbaa a ne ba ne ɔteasefoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Me wura, mepa wo kyɛw, momfa akwadaa teasefoɔ no mma no, na kum deɛ, monnku no!
Ɔkaa saa, ɛfiri sɛ na ne yam hyehye no ne ba no ho.
Ɔbaako no nso kaa sɛ: Mma no nnyɛ me deɛ, nso ɔnnyɛ wo deɛ, monkyɛ mu!
Ɛnna ɔhene buaa sɛ: Momfa akwadaa teasefoɔ no mma ɔbaa a ɔdi kan no, na kum deɛ wɔnnku no, ɔne ne na.
Na Israel nyinaa tee atɛn a ɔhene buiɛ no, wɔsuroo ɔhene anim, ɛfiri sɛ wɔhunuu sɛ, Nyankopɔn nyansa wɔ ne mu a ɔde bu atɛn.
Salomo mpanimfoɔ Na Ɔhene Salomo di Israel nyinaa so hene.
Na yeinom ne ne mmapɔmma: Sadok ba Ɔsɔfoɔ Asaria; Sisa mma Elihoref na Ahia ne atwerɛfoɔ; Ahilud ba Yosafat ne ɔsɛnkaefoɔ; Yoiada ba Benaia di asraadɔm no so, na Sadok ne Abiatar di asɔfoɔ; Natan ba Asaria di toɔ sohwɛfoɔ so, na Natan ba Sabud yɛ ɔsɔfoɔ ne ɔhene adamfo; na Ahisar di ahemfie so, na Abda ba Adoniram di wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wɔyɛ adwuma so.
Na Salomo wɔ toɔ sohwɛfoɔ dummienu Israel nyinaa so a wɔhwɛ ɔhene ne ne fie aduane soɔ; afirinhyia mu bosome baako wɔn mu biara ma aduane.
Wɔn din nie: Hur ba wɔ Efraim bepɔ so; Deker ba wɔ Makas ne Saalbim ne Bat-semes ne Elon-bet-anan; Hesed ba wɔ Arubot, (ne deɛ ne Soko ne Hefer asase nyinaa); Abinadab ba wɔ Nafat-dor nyinaa.
(Ɔwaree Salomo babaa Tafat).
Ahilud ba Baana wɔ Taanak ne Megido ne Bet-sean a ɛwɔ Saretan nkyɛn mu nyinaa Yesreel ase, de firi Bet-sean kɔduru Abel-mehola, de kɔ Yokmeam akyi; Geber ba wɔ Ramot-gilead, (ne deɛ ne Manase ba Yair atenaeɛ a ɛwɔ Gilead no, ne deɛ nso ne Argob asase a ɛwɔ Basan, nkuro akɛseɛ aduosia a ɛho wɔ afasuo ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ adaban); Ido ba Abinadab wɔ Mahanaim; Ahimaas wɔ Naftali; (ɔno nso faa Salomo ba Basmat wareɛ); Husai ba Baana wɔ Aser ne Alot; Parua ba Yehosafat wɔ Isakar; Ela ba Simei wɔ Benyamin; Uri ba Geber wɔ Gilead asase so, Amorifoɔ hene Sihon ne Basanhene Og asase so, na toɔ sohwɛfoɔ baako na ɔwɔ Yuda asase no soɔ.
Yuda ne Israel dɔɔso sɛ mpoano anwea dodoɔ, wɔdidi na wɔnom, na wɔn ani gye.
Salomo tumi Na Salomo dii aman yi so firi Asubɔntene Eufrate ano kɔsi Filistifoɔ asase so ne Misraim hyeɛ so.
Wɔde apeatoɔ ba na wɔsomm Salomo ne nkwa nna nyinaa.
Na Salomo da koro aduane yɛ esiam pa susukoraa aduasa ne ayuosiam susukoraa aduosia; anantwie a wɔadorɔ du ne adidibea anantwie aduonu ne nnwan ɔha, ɛsono aforoteɛ, nnowa, awansane ne nnomaa a wɔadorɔ.
Na ɔdi asubɔnten no atɔeɛ ahemfo a wɔwɔ asubɔnten no fa ha nyinaa so tumi firi Tifsa bɛduru Gasa, na ɔnyaa asomdwoeɛ n’ahyeɛ nyinaa so hyiae.
Na Yuda ne Israel tenaa ase dwoodwoo wɔn bobe ne wɔn borɔdɔma ase mmaako mmaako firi Dan kɔsi Beer-seba, Salomo nna nyinaa.
Na Salomo wɔ apɔnkɔdan mpem aduanan ma ne nteaseɛnam, ne apɔnkɔsotefoɔ mpem dummienu.
Na ɛtoɔ sohwɛfoɔ no hwɛɛ aduane so maa Ɔhene Salomo ne wɔn a wɔbaa Ɔhene Salomo pono ho nyinaa, obiara wɔ ne bosome mu; wɔmma hwee nka.
Na atokoɔ ne ɛserɛ a wɔde ma apɔnkɔ ne apɔnkɔ ahoɔharefoɔ nso, wɔde baa faako a wɔwɔ hɔ, wɔn nyinaa sɛdeɛ wɔahyehyɛ ama wɔn no.
Salomo nyansa Na Onyankopɔn maa Salomo nyansa ne nhunumu bebree pa ne adwene a emu trɛ sɛ mpoano anwea.
Na Salomo nyansa dɔɔso sene apueeɛ mma nyinaa nyansa ne Misraim nyansa nyinaa.
Na ɔnim nyansa sene nnipa nyinaa, ɔsene Esrahini Etan ne Heman ne Kalkol ne Darda a wɔyɛ Mahel mma no, na ne din hyetae wɔ amanaman nyinaa mu.
Na ɔbubuu mmɛ mpensa, na ne nnwom yɛ apem ne nnum.
Na ɔkasaa nnua ho firi tweneduro a ɛwɔ Lebanon so kɔsii adwera a ɛfifiri ɔfasuo mu so, na ɔkaa mmoa ne nnomaa ne wɔn a wɔwea ne mpataa ho asɛm.
Na amanaman nyinaa mu bi baa sɛ wɔrebɛtie Salomo nyansa, wɔfirii asase so ahemfo a wɔtee ne nyansa no nyinaa nkyɛn bae.
Asɔrefie sie ho ahoboaboa Na Tirohene Hiram somaa ne nkoa maa wɔbaa Salomo nkyɛn, ɛberɛ a ɔtee sɛ wɔasra no ngo asi no hene n’agya ananmu; ɛfiri sɛ Hiram dɔɔ Dawid daa.
Na Salomo soma maa wɔkɔɔ Hiram nkyɛn sɛ: Wo ara wonim m’agya Dawid sɛ ɛdɔm a ɛtwaa ne ho hyiaeɛ nti, wantumi ansi ɛdan amma AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn din de kɔsii sɛ AWURADE de wɔn hyɛɛ ne nan aseɛ.
Na afei AWURADE me Nyankopɔn ama me ɔhome afa nyinaa; ɔtamfoɔ biara nni hɔ, na asiane biara nni hɔ.
Na hwɛ, mese merebɛsi ɛdan mama AWURADE me Nyankopɔn din, sɛdeɛ AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ m’agya Dawid no sɛ: Wo ba a mede no bɛsi w’ananmu atena w’adwa soɔ no, ɔno na ɔbɛsi ɛdan ama me din.
Na afei hyɛ na wɔmmu ntweneduro mfiri Lebanon mma me, na me nkoa bɛba abɛka wo nkoa ho, na mede wo nkoa apaadeɛ bɛma wo, sɛdeɛ wobɛka nyinaa; na wo ara wonim sɛ obi nni yɛn mu a ɔnim nnuabuo sɛ Sidonfoɔ.
Na Hiram tee Salomo nsɛm no, n’ani gyee sɛ, na ɔkaa sɛ: Nhyira nka AWURADE nnɛ, sɛ wama Dawid ɔba nyansafoɔ de no asi ɔman kɛseɛ yi soɔ.
Na Hiram soma maa wɔbaa Salomo nkyɛn sɛ: Mate deɛ enti wosoma maa wɔbaa me nkyɛn no; me deɛ, mɛyɛ deɛ wopɛ nyinaa ntweneduro nnua ne papea nnua fam.
Me nkoa de bɛfiri Lebanon asiane aba mpoano, na makyekyere no ntɛneani ɛpo so mabɛduru deɛ wobɛma wɔaka akyerɛ me no, na masanesane no hɔ, na wo nso woama wɔabɛfa akɔ.
Na wo nso yɛ deɛ mepɛ ma me, sɛ wobɛma me fie aduane.
Ɛnna Hiram maa Salomo ntweneduro ne papea nnua sɛdeɛ ɔpɛ nyinaa.
Na Salomo maa Hiram ayuo susukoraa mpem du, sɛ ne fie aduane, ne ngo kronkron susukoraa ɔpeduonu; saa na Salomo maa Hiram afe biara.
Na AWURADE maa Salomo nyansa sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ no bɔ no; na asomdwoeɛ daa Hiram ne Salomo ntam, na wɔn baanu pamee.
Na Ɔhene Salomo gyee Israel nyinaa hɔ adwumatoɔ, na ɛtoɔ no yɛ nnipa mpem aduasa.
Na ɔsomaa wɔn Lebanon, nnipa mpem du bosome biara maa wɔdii no nnyegyeɛ, wɔdi bosome Lebanon, na wɔdi abosome mmienu efie; na Adoniram na na ɔdi toɔ adwuma no soɔ.
Na Salomo wɔ nnesoasoafoɔ mpem aduɔson ne nnuatwafoɔ mpem aduɔwɔtwe bepɔ no so, ɛsono Salomo ahwɛfoɔ mpemsa ahasa a wɔdi adwumafoɔ no soɔ.
Na ɔhene hyɛ maa wɔpaee aboɔ akɛseɛ, aboɔ a ne boɔ yɛ den aboɔ a wɔasensene sɛ wɔde bɛto ɛdan no fapem.
Na Salomo abantofoɔ ne Hiram abantofoɔ ne Gebalfoɔ no sensenee, na wɔsiesiee nua ne aboɔ sɛ wɔde bɛsi ɛdan no.
Asɔrefie no sie Na Israelfoɔ firi Misraim asase so baeɛ no akyi, afe a ɛtɔ so ahanan aduɔwɔtwe so, Salomo dii Israel so hene afe a ɛtɔ so nnan mu bosome Siw a ɛne bosome a ɛtɔ so mmienu (a ɛte sɛ Kɔtɔnimma) no soɔ no, ɔfitii aseɛ sii AWURADE dan no.
Na ɛdan a Ɔhene Salomo si maa AWURADE no, basafa aduasa ne ne ntwemu, na basafa du ne ne tɛtrɛtɛ, na basafa dunum ne ne korɔn.
Na ntwonoo a ɛwɔ asɔrefie dan no anim no, basafa du ne ne ntwemu, sɛdeɛ ɛdan no trɛ no teɛ no, basafa nnum ne ne trɛ ɛdan no anim.
Na ɔyɛɛ ɛdan no ho mpomma a emu aniahunuankansa tintim mu.
Na ɔtotoo ɛdan no fasuo ho ban de twaa ho hyiae, na asɔredan no ara ne mpiakyire no ho, na ɔyɛɛ no mpia mpia hyiae: Aseɛ pa ara pia yɛ basafa mmienu ne fa ne ne tɛtrɛtɛ; na mfimfini deɛ yɛ basafa mmiɛnsa, na deɛ ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no yɛ basafa mmiɛnsa ne fa; na ɔyɛɛ ɛdan no akyi mmamma hyiae, na mpuna no anhyɛne ɛdan no afasuo mu.
Na wɔresi ɛdan no, wɔde aboɔ amuamu a wɔasiesie firi abotubea na ɛsiiɛ.
Na wɔresie no, wɔante asaeɛ anaa pɛeɛ anaa dwinnadeɛ biara nka ɛdan no ho.
Aseɛ pia no pono wɔ ɛdan no anafoɔ fam, na wɔforo ntwedeɛ nkyinkyimiiɛ kɔ mfimfini deɛ no mu, na wɔfiri mfimfini deɛ no mu kɔ deɛ ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no mu.
Na ɔsii ɛdan no wieeɛ no, ɔde tweneduro mpuna ne ntaaboɔ kataa ɛdan no so.
Na ɔsisii nsamsoɔ twaa ɛdan no ho nyinaa hyiae, basafa mmienu ne fa ne ne korɔn, na wɔde tweneduro mpuna guu ɛdan no so.
Na AWURADE asɛm baa Salomo nkyɛn sɛ: Ɛdan yi a woresie yi, sɛ wonante m’ahyɛdeɛ mu na woyɛ m’atemmudeɛ na wodi me mmara nsɛm nyinaa so sɛ wobɛnante mu a, ɛnneɛ mɛma m’asɛm a meka mekyerɛɛ w’agya Dawid no agyina ama wo.
Na mɛtena Israelfoɔ mu, na merennya me man Israel.
Na Salomo sii ɛdan no wiee.
Ɛdan no mu Nsiesie Na ɔde tweneduro ntaaboɔ penam ɛdan no afasuo ho wɔ mu, ɔde nnua kataa mu firi ɛdan no fam kɔsi nsamsoɔ ani, na ɔde papea ntaaboɔ sam ɛdan no fam.
Na ɔde tweneduro ntaaboɔ sii ɛdan no akyiri fam basafa du, firi fam kɔpem nsamsoɔ mpuna, na ɔsii de emu yɛɛ mpiakyire, ɛne kronkronkronbea no.
Na kronkronbea a ɛwɔ kronkron mu kronkron no anim no yɛ basafa aduonu.
Na ɛdan no mu tweneduro ntaaboɔ no anim no, wɔdii so ntoa ne nhwiren a ahanehane adwini; ne nyinaa yɛ tweneduro, wɔanhunu ɔboɔ biara.
Na ɔsiesiee mpiakyire no ɛdan no mu, sɛ wɔmfa AWURADE apam adaka no nsi hɔ.
Na mpiakyire no mu kwan deɛ, basafa du ne ne ntwemu, na basafa du yɛ ne tɛtrɛtɛ, na basafa du ne ne korɔn; na ɔde sika amapa duraa mu, na ɔde tweneduro kataa afɔdeɛ pono no ho hyiae.
Na Salomo de sika amapa duraa ɛdan no mu, na ɔde sika nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn twaa mpiakyire no anim, na ɔduraa ho sika.
Na ɛdan no nyinaa, ɔde sika duraa mu kɔsii sɛ ɛhyiaa ɛdan no nyinaa mu; na afɔdeɛ pono a ɛwɔ mpiakyire no, ɔde sika duraa ho nyinaa.
Na mpiakyire no mu hɔ no, ɔde ngodua yɛɛ kerubim mmienu, a basafa nnum ne ebiara tentene.
Na kerub no ntaban baako yɛ basafa mmienu ne fa, na kerub no ntaban baako no nso yɛ basafa mmienu ne fa, ɛfiri ne ntaban baako ano kɔsi ne ntaban baako ano yɛ basafa nnum.
Na kerub a ɔtɔ so mmienu no nso yɛ basafa nnum; kerubim mmienu no nyinaa tentene pɛ, na wɔn su nso yɛ pɛ.
Kerub baako tentene yɛ basafa nnum, na kerub baako no nso saa ara.
Na ɔde kerubim no sisii akyire dan no mu, na kerubim no trɛtrɛɛ wɔn ntaban mu.
Ɔbaako ntaban ka ɔfasuo, na ɔbaako ntaban ka ɔfasuo baako no nso, na wɔn ntaban no hyia ɛdan no mfimfini, ntaban pem ntaban anim.
Na ɔde sika duraa kerubim no ho.
Na ɔdii ɛdan no afasuo no nyinaa ho adwini hyiae, kerubim ne mmɛ ne nhwiren a ahanehane na wɔhunu wɔ pia no mu ne asa no so.
Na ɛdan no fam nso, ɔde sika duraa hɔ, pia no mu ne asa no so.
Na mpiakyire no ano no, ɔde ngodua yɛɛ aponta too hɔ; ɛfiri aponnwa no atifi kɔsi ne nkyɛn mu yɛ ɔfasuo no mu abupɛn nnum mu baako; na ngodua apono mmienu no, ɔdii so adwini, kerubim ne mmɛ ne nhwiren a ahanehane, na ɔde sika duraa ho, na ɔde sika kataa kerubim ne mmɛ no ho.
Saa ara nso na ɔde ngodua yɛɛ asɔredan no ano aponnwa no, ahinanan soɔ.
Na ɔde papea nnua yɛɛ apono mmienu, ɛpono baako wɔ afa mmienu a ɛtumi danedane, na ɛpono baako nso wɔ afa mmienu a ɛtumi danedane; na ɔdii so adwini, kerubim ne mmɛ ne nhwiren a ahanehane; na ɔde sika duraa ho, na ɔkeka tintim nkurukyireeɛ no mu.
Na ɔyɛɛ emu fam abannwa no, aboɔ a wɔasensene kyerɛpɛn mmiɛnsa ne tweneduro mpuna kyerɛpɛn baako.
Afe a ɛtɔ so nnan bosome Siw (a ɛte se Kɔtɔnimma) mu na wɔtoo AWURADE dan no fapem.
Na afe a ɛtɔ so dubaako bosome Bul a ɛne bosome a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe (a ɛte sɛ Obubuo) no mu na wɔwiee efie no, ɛho nnoɔma ne ne yɛbea nyinaa fam.
Mfeɛ nson na wɔde siiɛ.
Ahemfie no sie Na Salomo no ara ne fie deɛ, mfeɛ dummiɛnsa ansa na ɔrewie efie no nyinaa sie.
Ɔsii Lebanon Kwaeɛ Dan no, basafa aduonum ne ne ntwemu, na basafa aduonu nnum ne ne trɛ, na basafa dunum ne ne korɔn; ɛwɔ ntweneduro adum kyerɛpɛn nnan so, na ntweneduro adum kyerɛpɛn nnan so, na ntweneduro mpuna gu so; na wɔde tweneduro samm soro, nkyɛn mu mpia a ɛwowɔ adum no soɔ no so, ɛyɛ aduanan nnum a dunum yɛ kyerɛpɛn baako.
Na nsamsoɔ mpuna yɛ kyerɛpɛn mmiɛnsa, na mpomma kyerɛkyerɛ mpomma anim ahodoɔ mmiɛnsa.
Na apono no ne aponnwa no nyinaa yɛ mpuna ahinanan, na mpomma hwehwɛ mpomma anim ahodoɔ mmiɛnsa.
Na ɔyɛɛ Adum Abrannaa a ne tentene yɛ basafa aduonu nnum ne ne ntwemu yɛ basafa dunum ne ne trɛ; na abrannaa bi wɔ anim, na adum ne ntwedeɛ wɔ anim.
Na ɔyɛɛ Ahennwa Abrannaa a ɛhɔ na ɔbu atɛn, atemmuo abrannaa no; na ɔde tweneduro kataa fam nyinaa.
Na ne dan a ɔte mu no, ɛne abannwa a ɛwɔ abrannaa no mu no yɛbea te, yɛ pɛ ara.
Na ɔsii ɛdan nso maa Farao babaa a ɔwaree no no.
Yeinom nyinaa yɛ aboɔ a ne boɔ yɛ den, wɔasusu no sɛ aboɔ a wɔasene no ahinanan, wɔde ɛwan na ɛtwaeɛ, ɛwowɔ emu fam ne akyire fam, firi fapem so kɔpem atifi, na ɛfiri akyire fam kɔsi abannwa kɛseɛ no so.
Na fapem no yɛ aboɔ a ne boɔ yɛ den, aboɔ akɛseɛ, basafa nnum nnum aboɔ ne basafa nnan nnan aboɔ.
Na ɛso a wɔtoeɛ no yɛ aboɔ a ne boɔ yɛ den, wɔasusu no sɛ aboɔ a wɔasene no ahinanan, ɛne ntweneduro.
Na abannwa kɛseɛ a ɛtwa hyia no yɛ aboɔ a wɔasene kyerɛpɛn mmiɛnsa ne ntweneduro mpuna kyerɛpɛn baako; na AWURADE fie no mu fam abannwa no ne ɛdan no abrannaa no te saa ara.
Hiram adwinneɛ Na Ɔhene Salomo soma maa wɔkɔfaa Hiram firii Tiro baeɛ; ɔyɛ Naftali abusuakuo mu ɔbaa kunafoɔ bi ba, na n’agya yɛ Tironi a ɔyɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ dwumfoɔ; na nyansa ne nhunumu ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ adwinnie ho nimdeɛ nyinaa ahyɛ no ma; na ɔbaa Ɔhene Salomo nkyɛn bɛdii n’adwini nyinaa maa no.
Kɔbere adum mmienu no Na ɔyɛɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ adum mmienu, baako tentene yɛ basafa nkron, na homa a ne tentene yɛ basafa nsia twa baako ho hyia, tokuro da mu, na emu pipiripie yɛ nsateaa nan.
Dum a ɛtɔ so mmienu no te sɛ ɛno ara.
Na ɔyɛɛ ntaasotire mmienu sɛ wɔmfa nsisi adum no atifi; ɔde kɔbere mfrafraeɛ na ɛguiɛ.
Oduntire baako korɔn yɛ basafa mmienu ne fa, na baako no nso korɔn yɛ basafa mmienu ne fa.
Atena a wɔanwono a ɛyɛ ntweaban a wɔakyinkyim, ntaasotire a ɛwɔ adum no atifi no ho, nson wɔ oduntire baako ho, na nson nso wɔ baako no ho; na ɔyɛɛ atoaa aba nsɛsoɔ kyerɛpɛn mmienu twaa atena no ho hyiae de kataa aduntire no so; saa na ɔyɛɛ oduntire baako no nso; na ntaasotire a ɛwɔ adum no atifi no, wɔyɛɛ no sɛ sukooko nhwiren, ntwonoo no ho, basafa mmienu; na adum mmienu no so ntaasotire no wɔ soro nso, n’afuru a ɛwɔ atena no ho; na atoaa aba nsɛsoɔ ahanu, kyerɛpɛn kyerɛpɛn, twitwa oduntire baako no ho hyia.
Na ɔmemaa adum no so sisii asɔredan no ntwonoo no ano, na odum a ɔde sii anafoɔ no, ɔtoo no din Yakin, na odum a ɔde sii atifi no, ɔtoo no din Boas.
Na sukooko adwini wowɔ adum no atifi.
Saa na ɔde wiee adum no ho adwuma no.
Na ɔyɛɛ dwaresɛn no, wɔgui, ɛfiri ano kɔpem ano yɛ basafa nnum, ɛyɛ kurukuruwa, na basafa mmienu ne fa ne ne korɔn, na basafa dunum homa twa ho hyia.
Na nkukuduuduu wɔ ano no aseɛ twa ho hyia, basafa nnum nnum twa ho hyia, ɛbɔ ɛpo no ho kɔntɔnkrɔn, kukuduuduu kyerɛpɛn mmienu, na wɔguu no ne guo ara mu.
Ɛtaa anantwie dummienu so: Mmiɛnsa hwɛ atifi fam, na mmiɛnsa hwɛ atɔeɛ, na mmiɛnsa hwɛ anafoɔ fam, na mmiɛnsa hwɛ apueeɛ; na ɛpo no taa wɔn so, na wɔn akyiri nyinaa wɔ emu fam.
Na ne pipiripie yɛ nsayam trɛ; na wɔyɛɛ ano sɛ kuruwa ano, te sɛ sukooko nhwiren a ahane.
Ɛdi galɔn ɔpedu.
Na ɔyɛɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nsugyeɛ nnaka du, adaka no baako ntwemu yɛ basafa mmienu, na ne tɛtrɛtɛ yɛ basafa mmienu, na ne korɔn yɛ basafa baako ne fa.
Na nnaka no yɛbea nie: Ɛwowɔ nhyehyɛmu ntrawantrawa na nhyehyɛmu no hyehyɛ n’adwa ntam; na agyata, anantwie ne kerubim wowɔ adwa no ntam nhyehyɛmu no so, na nnyinasoɔ bi wɔ adwa no so soro.
Na agyata ne anantwie no ase no wɔyɛɛ nhahamma nkyekyereeɛ a ɛsensɛne hɔ.
Na nnaka no wowɔ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ntwahonan nnan nnan ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nhyɛmu dua, na ne nsisoɔ nan nnan no so wowɔ nsosɔmu nsa bi, wɔgui, dwaresɛn no ase, na nhahamma nkyekyereɛ wowɔ nkyɛn nkyɛn.
