Na dwaresɛn no ano wɔ adakatire hankra no mu fam a ɛho so kakra anammɔn baako ne fa, na hankra no ano yɛ kurukuruwa, wɔyɛɛ no sɛ nnyinasoɔ anammɔn mmienu ne fa, na wɔdii adwini ano ano; na ne nhyehyɛmu ntrawantrawa no yɛ ahinanan, ɛnyɛ kurukuruwa.
Na ntwahonan nnan no wowɔ nhyehyɛmu ntrawantrawa no ase; na ntwahonan no nsa kurakura nnaka no mu, na ntwahonan no baako korɔn yɛ anammɔn mmienu ne fa; na ntwahonan no yɛbea te sɛ teaseɛnam deɛ, ɛho nsa ne ne hankra ne ne mpadeɛ ne ne berɛmo nyinaa nso, wɔgui.
Na nsosɔmu nsa nnan wowɔ nnaka no ahinanan no ho, nnaka no mu ara na nsa no fifire.
Na nnaka no tiri no, wɔyeyɛɛ no nkurukuruwa nkurukuruwa hyiae, ne korɔn yɛ anammɔn baako, na nnakatire no so na ne nsa ne ne nhyehyɛmu ntrawantrawa a ɛfiri mu no wɔ.
Na ɔdii ne nsa no trɛ ne ne nhyehyɛmu ntrawantrawa no so adwini: Kerubim ne agyata ne mmɛ, sɛdeɛ ntam nnedahɔ teteɛ no, na nhahamma nkyekyereɛ twa ho hyia.
Saa na ɔyɛɛ nnaka du no, ne nyinaa yɛ gubea, nsusuiɛ ne suban korɔ.
Ɛnna ɔyɛɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ dwaresɛn du, dwaresɛn baako di galɔn ahanan.
Na dwaresɛn baako biara yɛ basafa mmienu; nnaka du no nyinaa, dwaresɛn no sisi so mmaako mmaako.
Na ɔde nnaka no nnum sisii ɛdan no anafoɔ fam, na ɔde nnum sisii atifi fam; na ɛpo no deɛ, ɔde sii ɛdan no anafoɔ fam, apueeɛ a ɛkyerɛ anafoɔ fam no.
Asɔredan no mu nsiesie nnoɔma Na Hiram yɛɛ nnwaresɛn no, sesa adeɛ ne nkoraa.
Na Hiram wiee adwuma a ɔyɛ maa Ɔhene Salomo, AWURADE fie ho no nyinaa yɛ, adum mmienu no ne adum no atifi ntaasotire no apɔ mmienu no, ne atena mmienu a wɔde kataa adum no, atifi ntaasotire apɔ mmienu no ho no, na atena mmienu no ho atoaa aba nsɛsoɔ ahanan no, atoaa aba nsɛsoɔ kyerɛpɛn mmienu yɛ atena baako deɛ, sɛ ɛnkata ntaasotire apɔ mmienu a ɛwowɔ adum no soɔ no ho, ne nsugyeɛ nnaka du no so nnwaresɛn du no, ne ɛpo baako, ne ɛpo no ase anantwie dummienu no; ne nsenaa ne sesa adeɛ ne nkoraa no.
Na nnoɔma a Hiram yɛ maa Ɔhene Salomo de maa AWURADE fie no nyinaa yɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ a wɔapɔ ho.
Na ɔhene de kɔɔ Yordan ho asase so dɔteɛ mu wɔ Sukot ne Saretan ntam.
Na Salomo gyaee nnoɔma no nyinaa karie, ne dɔ a ɛdɔɔso nti; wɔanhunu kɔbere mfrafraeɛ no mu duro.
Na Salomo yɛɛ AWURADE fie nnoɔma no nyinaa, sika afɔrebukyia ne ɛpono a kyerɛ paanoo sisi soɔ no sika, ne nkaneadua no, nnum wɔ nifa na nnum wɔ benkum, mpiakyire no anim no yɛ sika amapa, na ɛho nhwiren ne nkanea ne adaban no yɛ sika; ne nyowa ne adumgya ne nkoraa ne nyowaa ne nsramma kukuwa no yɛ sika ara nko; na ɛdan no mu fam kronkronkronbea hɔ apono ne asɔredan apono no mpɛɛwa nso yɛ sika.
Na wɔwiee adwuma a Ɔhene Salomo yɛɛ no AWURADE fie ho no nyinaa.
Na Salomo de n’agya Dawid akronkronneɛ, dwetɛ ne sika ne nnoɔma nnoɔma no, baa mu de bɛsiee AWURADE fie akoradeɛ mu.
Asɔrefie no dwira Ɛno na Salomo hyiahyiaa Israel mpanimfoɔ ne mmusuakuo mu atitire, Israel mma agyanom mmapɔmma nyinaa baa Ɔhene Salomo nkyɛn wɔ Yerusalem, sɛ wɔrekɔ akɔfa AWURADE apam adaka no afiri Dawid kuro Sion mu aba.
Na Israel mmarima nyinaa bɛhyiaa Ɔhene Salomo nkyɛn bosome Etanim a ɛyɛ bosome a ɛtɔ so nson (a ɛte sɛ Ahinime) no mu nnapɔnna no mu.
Na Israel mpanimfoɔ nyinaa bae, na asɔfoɔ no bɛsoaa adaka no.
Na wɔde AWURADE adaka no ne ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ne kronkronbea nnoɔma a ɛwɔ ntomadan no mu no nyinaa bae, asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ no na wɔde foro baeɛ.
Na Ɔhene Salomo ne Israel asafo a wɔabɛhyia ne nkyɛn no nyinaa ne no dii adaka no anim kunkumm nnwan ne anantwie a wɔn dodoɔ nti wɔntumi nkan mmu ano bɔɔ afɔdeɛ.
Na asɔfoɔ no de AWURADE apam adaka no bɛsii n’afa, ɛdan no mpiakyire a ɛne kronkronkronbea no mu, kerubim no ntaban ase.
Na kerubim no atrɛtrɛ wɔn ntaban mu, adaka no afa no so, na kerubim no kataa adaka no ne ɛho nnua no so.
Na nnua no woware maa wɔhunuu nnua no ti kronkronbea hɔ wɔ mpiakyire no anim; na wɔnhu no adihɔ, na ɛwɔ hɔ de bɛsi nnɛ.
Biribiara nni adaka no mu, gye aboɔ apono mmienu a Mose de guu mu Horeb, berɛ a wɔfiri Misraim asase so reba a AWURADE ne Israelfoɔ pameeɛ no.
Na asɔfoɔ no firii kronkronbea hɔ firii adie no, mununkum bɛhyɛɛ AWURADE dan no ma.
Na mununkum no nti amma asɔfoɔ no antumi annyina ansom, ɛfiri sɛ na AWURADE animuonyam ahyɛ AWURADE dan no ma.
Ɛno na Salomo kaa sɛ: AWURADE de owia asi soro, nanso ɔbɛtena esum kabii mu.
Sie na masi ɛdan mayɛ no tenabea mama woɔ, baabi a wobɛtena hɔ daa.
Salomo kasa kyerɛ Ɔman no Na ɔhene danee n’ani, na ɔhyiraa Israel asafo no nyinaa, na Israel asafo no nyinaa gyinagyina hɔ.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Nhyira nka AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn a ɔde n’ano kasa kyerɛɛ m’agya Dawid, na ɔde ne nsa ama no aba mu sɛ: Ɛfiri da a mekɔyii me man Israel firii Misraim baeɛ no, manyi Israel mmusuakuo nyinaa mu kuro bi sɛ wɔnsi ɛdan, na me din ntena hɔ; na mafa Dawid sɛ ɔnni me man Israel so.
Na ɛwɔ m’agya Dawid akoma mu sɛ anka ɔbɛsi ɛdan ama AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn din.
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ m’agya Dawid sɛ: Sɛ ɛwɔ w’akoma mu sɛ anka wobɛsi ɛdan ama me din yi, woayɛ no yie deɛ, nanso ɛnyɛ wo na wobɛsi ɛdan no, na mmom wo ba a ɔfiri w’asene mu, ɔno na ɔbɛsi ɛdan ama me din.
Na AWURADE ama n’asɛm a ɔkaeɛ no atim, na masɔre masi m’agya Dawid ananmu, atena Israel ahennwa so, sɛdeɛ AWURADE kaeɛ no, na masi ɛdan no mama AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn din, na mayɛ hɔ afa bi mama adaka a apam a AWURADE de yɛn agyanom firi Misraim asase so reba no, ɔne wɔn pameeɛ no wɔ mu no.
Salomo Mpaebɔ Na Salomo gyinaa AWURADE afɔrebukyia anim, Israel asafo nyinaa anim, na ɔtrɛɛ ne nsam kɔɔ soro kaa sɛ: AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn, Onyankopɔn bi nni ɔsoro a ɛwɔ atifi ne asase so ɛfam, sɛ wo a wokora apam ne adɔeɛ ma wo nkoa a wɔde wɔn akoma nyinaa nante w’anim no.
Wo na woakora deɛ woka kyerɛɛ w’akoa m’agya Dawid no ama no; wode w’ano na ɛkaeɛ, na wode wo nsa ama no aba mu, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ yi.
Na afei, AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn, kora deɛ woaka akyerɛ w’akoa m’agya Dawid so no ma no, sɛdeɛ wokaa sɛ: Wɔremma onipa a ɔbɛtena Israel ahennwa soɔ mmmɔ no wo m’anim, hwɛ nko na wo mma nhwɛ wɔn kwan, sɛ wɔbɛnante m’anim sɛdeɛ wonantee m’anim no.
Na afei, Israel Nyankopɔn, ma wo nsɛm a woka kyerɛɛ w’akoa m’agya Dawid no ntim ɛ!
Na ampa sɛ Onyankopɔn bɛtena asase so anaa?
Hwɛ, ɔsoro ne ɔsoro mu soro ntumi nkora wo, na nkantom ɛdan yi a masie yi!
Nanso dane w’ani kyerɛ w’akoa mpaebɔ ne ne nkotosrɛ, AWURADE me Nyankopɔn, na tie nteamu ne mpaeɛ a w’akoa rebɔ no w’anim nnɛ yi, sɛ wobɛbue w’ani akyerɛ ɛdan yi anadwo ne awia, sɛdeɛ wokaa sɛ: Me din bɛtena hɔ no, na woatie mpaeɛ a w’akoa rebɔ kyerɛ ha yi.
Na tie w’akoa ne wo man Israel nkotosrɛ a wɔde rebɔ mpaeɛ ha yi, na wo deɛ, tie no wo tenabea ɔsoro, na wote a, fa kyɛ!
Sɛ obi yɛ ne yɔnko bɔne na wɔde ntam gye no sɛ ɔnka, na ntam no ba w’afɔrebukyia anim efie yi mu a, ɛnneɛ wo ara tie wɔ ɔsoro, na yɛ, na bu wo nkoa atɛn, sɛ wobɛbu ɔbɔnefoɔ fɔ ama ne kwan abua n’atifi, na woabu ɔteneneeni bem ama no sɛdeɛ ne tenenee teɛ.
Sɛ wɔka wo man Israel gu wɔn atamfoɔ anim, sɛ wɔayɛ wo bɔne nti, na wɔsane ba wo nkyɛn bɛbɔ wo din, na wɔbɔ wo mpaeɛ na wɔkoto srɛ wo efie yi mu a, ɛnneɛ wo ara tie wɔ ɔsoro, na fa wo man Israel bɔne kyɛ, na sane wɔn bra asase a wode maa wɔn agyanom no so.
Sɛ wɔto ɔsoro mu na osuo ntɔ, sɛ wɔayɛ wo bɔne nti, na wɔbɛbɔ mpaeɛ kyerɛ wɔ ha yi na wɔbɔ wo din, na wɔsane firi wɔn bɔne no ho, sɛ wɔabrɛ wɔn ase nti a, ɛnneɛ wo ara tie wɔ ɔsoro, na fa wo nkoa ne wo man Israel bɔne kyɛ, na kyerɛ wɔn ɔkwan pa a wɔmfa soɔ, na ma osuo ntɔ ngu w’asase a wode maa wo man sɛ agyapadeɛ no so.
Sɛ ɛkɔm ba asase yi so oo, ɔyaredɔm ba oo, ɛhoɔ, ɛpoɔ, ntutummɛ, mmɛbɛ ba oo, sɛ wɔn atamfoɔ bɛhiahia wɔn ho wɔn kuro apono asase so oo, ɔhaw biara oo, yadeɛ biara oo, mpaebɔ biara, nkotosrɛ biara a onipa biara anaa wo man Israel nyinaa wɔ no, sɛ obiara bɛhunu n’akoma mu yea, na ɔbɛtrɛ ne nsa mu kyerɛ efie yi a, wo ara tie wɔ ɔsoro, wo tenabea hɔ na fa kyɛ, na yɛ ma onipa no sɛdeɛ n’akwan nyinaa teɛ, sɛdeɛ wohunu n’akomam no; na wo ara wo nko na wonim nnipa mma nyinaa akoma mu, deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na wɔasuro woɔ, nna a wɔde bɛtena asase a wode maa yɛn agyanom no soɔ no nyinaa.
Afei nso, ɔhɔhoɔ a ɔmfiri wo man Israel mu na wo din nti ɔfiri akyirikyiri asase bi so aba, (ɛfiri sɛ wɔbɛte wo din kɛseɛ ne wo nsa denden ne wo basa a woama so no nka), sɛ ɔba bɛbɔ mpaeɛ kyerɛ ɛdan yi a, wo ara tie wɔ ɔsoro, wo tenabea hɔ, na yɛ sɛdeɛ ɔhɔhoɔ no su frɛ woɔ no nyinaa, deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na asase so aman nyinaa ahunu wo din na wɔasuro woɔ, sɛ wo man Israel, na wɔahunu sɛ, wo din na wɔde frɛ ɛdan a masie yi.
Sɛ wo man firi adi ne wɔn atamfoɔ kɔdi ako, ɔkwan a wobɛsoma wɔn so, na wɔbɔ AWURADE mpaeɛ kyerɛ kuro a woayie ne ɛdan a masi mama wo din yi a, ɛnneɛ tie wɔn mpaebɔ ne wɔn nkotosrɛ wɔ ɔsoro, na di wɔn asɛm ma wɔn.
Sɛ wɔyɛ wo bɔne — ɛfiri sɛ onipa biara nni hɔ a ɔnyɛ bɔne, — na wofa wɔn abufuo, na woyi wɔn ma wɔn atamfoɔ, na ɛdɔm soa wɔn nnommum kɔ atamfoɔ asase so akyirikyiri oo, mmɛnkyɛneeɛ oo, na wɔma no ka wɔn akoma, asase a wɔafa wɔn nnommum kɔ hɔ no so, na wɔdane wɔn ho, na wɔkoto srɛ wo wɔn nnommumfafoɔ asase no so ka sɛ: Yɛayɛ bɔne na yɛafom, yɛadi abɔnefosɛm, na wɔde wɔn akoma nyinaa ne wɔn kra nyinaa sane ba wo nkyɛn, wɔn atamfoɔ a wɔfaa wɔn nnommum kɔeɛ no asase so, na wɔbɔ wo mpaeɛ kyerɛ wɔn asase a wode maa wɔn agyanom no, kuro a woayie ne ɛdan a masi mama wo din yi a, ɛnneɛ tie wɔn mpaebɔ ne wɔn nkotosrɛ wɔ ɔsoro, wo tenabea hɔ, na di wɔn asɛm ma wɔn, na fa wo man bɔne a wɔayɛ woɔ ne wɔn mmarato a wɔato afom woɔ no nyinaa kyɛ wɔn, na ma wɔnnya wɔn nnommumfafoɔ no anim mmɔborɔhunu, na wɔnhu wɔn mmɔbɔ.
Ɛfiri sɛ wɔyɛ wo man ne w’agyapadeɛ a woyii wɔn Misraim firii dadeɛ fononoo mu de wɔn baeɛ no, na bue w’ani ma w’akoa nkotosrɛ ne wo man Israel nkotosrɛ, na tie wɔn deɛ wɔsu frɛ woɔ no nyinaa mu.
Na wo AWURADE Nyankopɔn, wo ara na woyii wɔn yɛɛ agyapadeɛ firii asase so aman nyinaa mu, sɛdeɛ wonam w’akoa Mose so kaeɛ ɛberɛ a woyii yɛn agyanom firii Misraim baeɛ no.
Na Salomo wiee mpaeɛ a ɔbɔɔ AWURADE ne nkotosrɛ yi nyinaa no, ɔsɔre firii afɔrebukyia no anim, na ɔgyaee ne nankoroma anim kotoɔ ne ne nsam trɛ a ɔtrɛ kyerɛɛ ɔsoro no.
Na ɔgyinaa hɔ de nne kɛseɛ hyiraa Israel asafo no nyinaa sɛ: Nhyira ne AWURADE a wama ne man Israel ahome.
N’asɛmpa a ɔnam n’akoa Mose so kaeɛ no nyinaa mu asɛm baako mpo antɔ fam.
AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn nni yɛn akyi, sɛdeɛ ɔdii yɛn agyanom akyire no, ɔnnnya yɛn, na ɔmmpa yɛn nso.
Na ɔnkom yɛn akoma mmra ne so, na yɛanante n’akwan nyinaa mu, na yɛadi ne mmara nsɛm ne n’ahyɛdeɛ ne n’atemmudeɛ a ɔhyɛɛ yɛn agyanom no so.
Na ma me nsɛm a mede mekoto mesrɛ AWURADE anim yi mmɛn AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn awia ne anadwo, na ɔnni n’akoa asɛm ne ne man Israel asɛm mma wɔn, sɛdeɛ ɛhia da biara, na asase so aman nyinaa nhunu sɛ: AWURADE ne Onyankopɔn, na obiara nni hɔ bio.
Na momma mo akoma nni mu AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn anim, sɛ mobɛnante n’ahyɛdeɛ soɔ, na moadi ne mmara nsɛm soɔ sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ yi.
Wɔtu Asɔredan no hyɛ AWURADE nsa Ɛnna ɔhene ne Israel nyinaa bɔɔ mu bɔɔ afɔdeɛ AWURADE anim.
Na Salomo de anantwie mpem aduonu mmienu ne nnwan mpem ha aduonu bɔɔ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ maa AWURADE.
Na saa na ɔhene ne Israelfoɔ nyinaa dwiraa AWURADE fie.
Da no ara ɔhene yɛɛ AWURADE dan no anim abannwa no kronkron, na ɛhɔ na ɔhyee ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne aduane afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ ho sradeɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ afɔrebukyia a ɛsi AWURADE anim no sua dodo sɛ wɔbɛhye ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne aduane afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ ho sradeɛ no wɔ so.
Na Salomo dii nnapɔnna no ɛberɛ no mu, na Israel nyinaa ka ne ho, asafo kɛseɛ, wɔfiri deɛ wɔrekɔ Hamat de bɛsi Misraim subonhwa ano, wɔdii AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn anim nnapa nnanson.
Da a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no, ɔgyaa ɔman no kwan maa wɔkɔe; na wɔhyirahyiraa ɔhene, na wɔde papa a AWURADE ayɛ ama n’akoa Dawid ne ne man Israel nyinaa no ho anigyeɛ ne akoma pa sii mu kɔɔ wɔn afie mu.
Onyankopɔn yi ne ho adi kyerɛ Salomo bio Na Salomo wiee AWURADE fie ne ahemfie no sie, ne deɛ ɔpɛɛ sɛ ɔsie nyinaa yɛ no, AWURADE yii ne ho kyerɛɛ no ne mprenu so, sɛdeɛ ɔyii ne ho kyerɛɛ no wɔ Gibeon no.
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Mate wo mpaebɔ ne wo nkotosrɛ a wɔbɛsrɛɛ no m’anim no, na mayɛ efie a woasi yi kronkron, sɛ mede me din bɛto so akɔsi daa, na m’ani ne m’akoma atena hɔ nna nyinaa.
Na wo deɛ, sɛ wonante m’anim sɛdeɛ w’agya Dawid nanteeɛ no, akoma mu pɛyɛ ne tee mu, sɛ wobɛyɛ sɛdeɛ mahyɛ woɔ nyinaa, na woadi m’ahyɛdeɛ ne m’atemmudeɛ so a, ɛnneɛ mɛma wo hene a wodi Israel soɔ no adwa atim akɔsi daa, sɛdeɛ mekaa no w’agya Dawid ho sɛ: Onipa remmɔ wo, Israel ahennwa soɔ no.
Na sɛ mo ne mo mma sane firi m’akyire, na moanni me mmara nsɛm, m’ahyɛdeɛ a mede magu mo anim yi so, na mokɔ kɔsom anyame foforɔ na mosɔre wɔn a, ɛnneɛ mɛtwa Israel afiri asase a mede mama wɔn no ani, na efie a mayɛ no kronkron ama me din no, mɛto afiri m’anim atwene, na Israel bɛdane ɛbɛ ne nkasadwaa aman nyinaa mu.
Na ɛdan yi, bɛyɛ dammoto na obiara a ɔtwam wɔ ho no ho bɛdwiri no, na wabɔ kyɛkyɛ, na waka sɛ: Ɛnam ɛdeɛn so nti na AWURADE ayɛ asase yi ne efie yi sɛɛ?
Ɛno na wɔbɛbua sɛ: Ɛfiri sɛ wɔagya AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn a ɔyii wɔn agyanom firii Misraim asase so baeɛ no, na wɔakɔsosɔ anyame foforɔ mu asɔre wɔn asom wɔn, enti na AWURADE de bɔne yi nyinaa aba wɔn soɔ yi.
Nkuro ne ahyɛn Na mfeɛ aduonu a Salomo de sisii afie mmienu, AWURADE fie ne ahemfie no, akyire yi no, nso Tirohene Hiram de ntweneduro nnua ne papea nnua ne sika, sɛdeɛ ɔpɛ, maa Salomo.
Ɔhene Salomo maa Hiram nkuro aduonu wɔ Galilea asase so.
Na Hiram firii Tiro bɛhwɛɛ nkuro a Salomo de maa no no, nanso ansɔ n’ani.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Nkuro bɛn na wode ama me yi, me nua?
Sei nti na wɔfrɛ hɔ Kabul Asase, de bɛsi nnɛ.
Na Hiram soma maa wɔde sika dwetikɛseɛ ɔha aduonu brɛɛ ɔhene.
Na adwuma toɔ a Ɔhene Salomo gyee sɛ ɔde rebɛsi AWURADE fie, ne ɔno ara ne fie, ne Milo, ne Yerusalem fasuo ne Hasor, Megido ne Geser no ho asɛm nie: ne Bet-horon a ɛwɔ anafoɔ ne Baalat ne Tamar a ɛwɔ ɛserɛ so asase no soɔ, ne aduanekora nkuro a Salomo wɔ nyinaa, ne nteaseɛnam nkuro, ne apɔnkɔsotefoɔ nkuro ne Salomo adeɛ a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔsi no Yerusalem ne Lebanon ne asase a ɔdi soɔ nyinaa no so.
Nkurɔfoɔ a wɔaka wɔ Amorifoɔ, Hetifoɔ, Perisifoɔ, Hewifoɔ ne Yebusifoɔ mu a wɔmfiri Israelfoɔ mu no, wɔn a Israel mma antumi ansɛe wɔn no mma a wɔkaa wɔn akyi, asase no soɔ no, Salomo yɛɛ wɔn ɔhyɛ adwumayɛfoɔ de bɛduru nnɛ yi.
Na Israelfoɔ no mu deɛ, Salomo amfa obi anyɛ akoa, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn na wɔyɛ akofoɔ ne ne gyaasefoɔ ne ne mmapɔmma ne ne mmarima akunini ne ne nteaseɛnam so ahwɛfoɔ ne n’apɔnkɔsotefoɔ.
Yeinom ne Salomo adwuma so ahwɛfoɔ mu mpanin: Ahanum aduonum a wɔdi nkurɔfoɔ a wɔkura adwuma no mu no soɔ.
Nso Farao babaa no firii Dawid kuro no mu baa ne dan a Salomo si maa no no mu.
Afei ɔsii Milo.
Na Salomo bobɔɔ afɔdeɛ afe mu mprɛnsa, ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ, wɔ afɔrebukyia a ɔsi maa AWURADE no so, na ɔhyee aduhwam wɔ deɛ ɛsi AWURADE anim no so.
Na ɔwiee efie no koraa.
Na Ɔhene Salomo yɛɛ ahyɛn wɔ Esion-geber a ɛwɔ Elot ho, Mmɛwa Po ano, Edom asase so.
Na Hiram somaa ne nkoa a wɔyɛ hyɛn mufoɔ a wɔnim ɛpo so adwuma maa wɔkaa Salomo nkoa ho ahyɛn no mu.
Na wɔkɔɔ Ofir kɔgyee sika hɔ, dwetikɛseɛ ahanan aduonu, na wɔde brɛɛ Ɔhene Salomo.
Seba hemmaa nsrahwɛ Na Seba hemmaa tee Salomo nka a ɛfa AWURADE din ho, na ɔbaa sɛ ɔde nsɛm a emu yɛ den rebɛsɔ no ahwɛ, na ɔne ɛdɔm kɛseɛ de yoma a wɔsoso nnuhwam ne sika bebree pa ne aboɔden aboɔ baa Yerusalem.
Na ɔduruu Salomo nkyɛn no, ɔne no bɔɔ deɛ ɛwɔ n’akomam nyinaa ho nkɔmmɔ.
Na Salomo buaa no ne nsɛm nyinaa; asɛm biara anhunta ɔhene a wantumi ammua no.
Na Seba hemmaa no hunuu Salomo nyansa nyinaa, ne efie a wasie no, ne ne pono so nnuane, ne ne nkoa atenaeɛ, ne n’asomfoɔ gyinabea ne wɔn ntadeɛ ne ne nsahyɛfoɔ ne n’aforeɛ a ɔbɔɔ no AWURADE fie, na ne ho dwirii no.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔhene no sɛ: Wo nneyɛɛ ne wo nyansa ho nsɛm a metee no m’asase soɔ no yɛ nokorɛ; na mannye nsɛm no anni de bɛsii sɛ mebaeɛ, na mede m’ani abɛhunu yi; na hwɛ, wɔanka me emu fa mpo; wo nyansa ne w’ahonyadeɛ sene deɛ meteeɛ no.
Nhyira ne wo yerenom, nhyira ne w’asomfoɔ yi a wɔgyinagyina w’anim daa yi tie wo nyansa no.
Nhyira nka AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn a ɔpɛ w’asɛm na ɔde wo atena Israel ahennwa soɔ.
Sɛ AWURADE dɔ Israel de rekɔsi daa nti, na wasi wo hene sɛ yɛ atemmudeɛ ne teneneedeɛ.
Na ɔmaa ɔhene sikakɔkɔɔ dwetikɛseɛ ɔha aduonu ne nnuhwam bebree pa ara ne aboɔden aboɔ; nnuhwam bebree saa bi amma bio, sɛdeɛ Seba hemmaa de maa Ɔhene Salomo no.
Na Hiram ahyɛnkuo a ɛde sika firi Ofir baeɛ no de samfona nnua bebree pa ara ne aboɔden aboɔ bae.
Na ɔhene de samfona nnua no yɛɛ AWURADE fie ne ɔhene fie aforoeɛ ne nsankuo ne mmɛnta maa nnwontofoɔ no.
Saa samfona nnua bi amma bio, na wɔanhunu saa bio de bɛsi nnɛ.
Na Ɔhene Salomo maa Seba hemmaa no deɛ ɔbisaeɛ nyinaa; ɛsono deɛ ɛfiri Ɔhene Salomo ankasa akoma mu a ɔde maa no.
Na ɔsane sii mu kɔɔ n’asase so, ɔno ne n’asomfoɔ.
Salomo ahonyadeɛ ne n’animuonyam Sika a na ɛba Salomo nsam afe baako mu duro yɛ sika dwetikɛseɛ ahansia aduosia nsia, ɛsono deɛ ɛfiri adwadifoɔ hɔ ne akwantemfoɔ batadie mu, ne deɛ ɛfiri Arabia ahemfo nyinaa ne asase no so amradofoɔ no nsam.
Na Salomo de sika a wɔaborɔ yɛɛ akyɛm ahanu; sika nnwetɛbena ahansia na ɔde duraa akyɛm no mu baako biara ho; na ɔde sika a wɔaborɔ yɛɛ akyɛm nkumaa ahasa; sika mmɛnaa mmiɛnsa na ɔde duraa akyɛm no mu biara ho.
Na ɔhene de kɔsii Lebanon Kwaeɛ Dan no mu.
Na ɔhene yɛɛ asonse ahennwa kokuroo, na ɔde sika amapa duraa ho.
Adwa no wɔ ntwedeɛ nsia, na akyire na nantwie tiri wɔ; na adwa no tiri a ɛwɔ akyire yɛ kurukuruwa, na nsa wowɔ ha ne ha wɔ atenaeɛ no ho, na agyata mmienu gyinagyina nsa no ho.
Na agyata dummienu gyinagyina ntwedeɛ nsia no so ha ne ha; ɛso bi nni ahennie biara mu.
Na Ɔhene Salomo nkuruwa a ɔnom mu nyinaa yɛ sika, na Lebanon Kwaeɛ Dan mu nnoɔma nyinaa yɛ sika amapa.
Na dwetɛ, nni mu, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔmmu no ade titire bi wɔ Salomo berɛ so.
Na ɔhene ahyɛn wɔ Tarsis ɛpo no so a ɛka Hiram hyɛn ho; mfensa mu Tarsis ahyɛn no ba prɛko de sika ne dwetɛ, asonse ne nkontromfi ne nkokɔnini-abankwaa ba.
Na Ɔhene Salomo yɛɛ kɛse sene asase so ahemfo nyinaa, ahodeɛ ne nyansa fam.
Na asase nyinaa hwehwɛɛ Salomo anim ahunu, sɛ wɔbɛtie ne nyansa a Onyankopɔn de ahyɛ ne tiri mu no.
Na wɔde wɔn ayɛyɛdeɛ ba mmaako mmaako, dwetɛ nnoɔma ne sika nnoɔma ne ntadeɛ ne nkuu hwanhwam ne nnuhwam, apɔnkɔ ne mfunumupɔnkɔ, afe biara ne ne deɛ.
Na Salomo boaboaa nteaseɛnam ne apɔnkɔsotefoɔ ano, na ɔnyaa nteaseɛnam apem ne ahanan ne apɔnkɔsotefoɔ mpemdumienu, na ɔde wɔn duaduaa nteaseɛnam nkuro mu ne ɔhene nkyɛn Yerusalem.
Na ɔhene maa dwetɛ buu so sɛ aboɔ wɔ Yerusalem, na ntweneduro nso yɛɛ pii sɛ akyee nnua a ɛwɔ asaseta soɔ no.
Na Salomo kra n’apɔnkɔ firi Misraim ne Kue, deɛ ɔhene adwadifoɔ asafo kɔtotɔ apɔnkɔ kuo, sɛdeɛ wɔn boɔ teɛ, de ba.
Na wɔde teaseɛnam firi Misraim ba, bɛgye dwetɛ nnwetɛbena ahansia, ne ɔpɔnkɔ nso, ɔha aduonum; na saa ara na adwadifoɔ de bi brɛ Hetifoɔ ahemfo nyinaa ne Siria ahemfo.
Salomo yerenom ne n’abosonsom Na Ɔhene Salomo dɔɔ aman foforɔ so mmaa bebree kaa Farao babaa no ho, wɔne Moabfoɔ, Amonfoɔ, Edomfoɔ, Sidonfoɔ ne Hetifoɔ mmaa a wɔfiri amanaman a AWURADE kaa wɔn ho asɛm kyerɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ: Monnkɔ wɔn mu awareɛ na wɔn nso mmma mo mu, na wɔankom mo akoma anni wɔn anyame no akyi; wɔn na Salomo bataa wɔn ho ɔdɔ mu.
Na ɔwɔ yerenom, ahenemma ahanson ne mpenafoɔ nso ahasa; na ne yerenom no maa ɔdanee n’akoma firii Onyankopɔn ho.
Na ɛbaa sɛ, Salomo nkɔkoraa berɛ mu no, ne yerenom danee n’akoma kɔdii anyame foforɔ akyi, na n’akoma anni mu AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn ho sɛ n’agya Dawid akoma.
Na Salomo kɔdii Sidonfoɔ nyamewa Astoret ne Amonfoɔ Milkom a ɛyɛ akyiwadeɛ no akyi.
Na Salomo yɛɛ deɛ ɛyɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, na wantumi anni AWURADE akyiri sɛ n’agya Dawid.
Ɛno mu na Salomo sii sorɔnsorɔmmea maa Moabfoɔ Kemos a ɛyɛ akyiwadeɛ, bepɔ a ɛwɔ Yerusalem apueeɛ so, ne Amon mma Molek a ɛyɛ akyiwadeɛ.
Na saa na ɔyɛ maa ne yerenom ananafoɔ ma wɔhyee aduhwam na wɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ maa wɔn anyame no nyinaa.
Na AWURADE bo fuu Salomo, ɛfiri sɛ n’akoma adane afiri AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn a wayi ne ho akyerɛ no mprenu na wahyɛ no asɛm yi ho mmara sɛ ɔnnkɔdi anyame foforɔ akyi; nanso wanni deɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ no no so.
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Salomo sɛ: Ɛsiane sɛ yei wɔ w’adwene mu, na woanni m’apam ne m’ahyɛdeɛ a mehyɛɛ woɔ no soɔ nti, teɛ na mɛte ahennie no mafiri wo nsam, na mede mama w’akoa.
Nanso wo berɛ so deɛ, merenyɛ, ɛsiane w’agya Dawid nti, na wo ba nsam na mɛte afire; nanso m’akoa Dawid ne Yerusalem a mafa no nti, merente ahennie no nyinaa, na mede abusuakuo baako bɛma wo ba.
Salomo atamfoɔ ne ne wuo Na AWURADE maa ɔperedifoɔ bi, Edomni Hadad, sɔre tiaa Salomo; ɔfiri ɔhene asefoɔ mu wɔ Edom.
Ɛberɛ a na Dawid wɔ Edom na ɔsahene Yoab kɔɔ sɛ ɔrekɔsie wɔn a wɔatotɔ no, ɔkumm Edom mmarima nyinaa, (na Yoab ne Israel nyinaa tenaa hɔ abosome nsia kɔsii sɛ ɔkumm Edom mmarima nyinaa).
Na Hadad ne Edom mmarima bi a wɔfiri n’agya nkoa mu dwane kɔɔ Misraim; saa berɛ no na Hadad yɛ abɔfra kumaa.
Na wɔsɔre firii Midian, na wɔkɔduruu Paran; na wɔfaa mmarima bi wɔ Paran kaa wɔn ho, na wɔkɔɔ Misraim, Misraimhene Farao nkyɛn; na ɔmaa no efie na ɔhyɛɛ aduane a wɔmma no, na wɔmaa no asase nso.
Na Hadad nyaa Farao anim animuonyam pii, na ɔde ne yere Tapenes nua, maa no awareɛ.
Na Tapenes nua woo ne babarima Genubat maa no, na Tapenes twaa no nufoɔ Farao fie, na Genubat wɔ Farao fie, Farao mma mu.
Na Hadad tee no Misraim sɛ Dawid ne n’agyanom akɔda na ɔsahene Yoab nso awuo no, Hadad ka kyerɛɛ Farao sɛ: Gya me kwan ma menkɔ m’asase so.
Ɛnna Farao bisaa no sɛ: Na ɛdeɛn na ɛhia wo me nkyɛn ha na worehwehwɛ w’asase so akorɔ yi?
Na ɔbuaa sɛ: Ɛnyɛ biribiara, nanso gya me kwan ma menkɔ.
Na Onyankopɔn maa ɔtamfoɔ bi, Eliada ba Reson a ɔdwane firii ne wura Hadad-eser, Sobahene, nkyɛn no sɔre tiaa no.
Ɔno na ɔboaa mmarima ano, na ɔyɛɛ asafo no so safohene, berɛ a Dawid kumm Sobafoɔ no; na wɔkɔɔ Damasko kɔtenaa hɔ, na ɔdii hene Damasko.
Na ɔyɛɛ Israel tamfoɔ Salomo nna nyinaa, kaa bɔne a Hadad yɛeɛ no ho; na ɔkyirii Israel, na ɔdii Siria so hene.
Na Nebat ba Yeroboam, Efratini a ɔfiri Sereda a ɔyɛ Salomo akoa, na ne na din de Serua, ɔbaa kunafoɔ bi, nso tee ɔhene so atua.
Na deɛ ɛmaa no tee ɔhene so atua ne sɛ: Salomo kyekyeree Milo na ɔtuatuaa n’agya Dawid kuro ho fasuo mu.
Na ɔbarima Yeroboam no yɛ ɔbarima a ɔyɛ nnam, na Salomo hunuu aberanteɛ no sɛ ɔyɛ ɔdeyɛfoɔ no, ɔmaa no yɛɛ Yosef fie adwumayɛfoɔ no nyinaa so hwɛfoɔ.
Na berɛ no mu, Yeroboam firi Yerusalem rekorɔ no, Odiyifoɔ Ahia, Siloni, bɛhunuu no ɔkwan no so; nso na ɔfira ntoma foforɔ, na wɔn mmienu pɛ na na ɛwɔ wiram hɔ.
Na Ahia sɔɔ ntoma foforɔ a ɛfira no no mu, na ɔsunsuanee mu asinasini dummienu, na ɔka kyerɛɛ Yeroboam sɛ: Yi asinasini du fa, na sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Hwɛ, merebɛte ahennie no mafiri Salomo nsam, na mede mmusuakuo du mama wo.
Na m’akoa Dawid ne kuro Yerusalem a mafa afiri Israel mmusuakuo nyinaa mu no nti, abusuakuo baako na ɛbɛyɛ ne deɛ; ɛsiane sɛ wɔagya me na wɔakɔsɔre Sidonfoɔ nyamewa Astoret ne Moabfoɔ nyame Kemos ne Amon mma nyame Milkom, na wɔannante m’akwan mu sɛ ɔbɛyɛ deɛ ɛtene m’ani soɔ ne m’ahyɛdeɛ ne m’atemmudeɛ sɛ n’agya Dawid.
Nanso merennye ne nsam ahennie no nyinaa, na m’akoa Dawid a mafa no a ɔdii me mmara nsɛm ne m’ahyɛdeɛ soɔ no nti, mɛsi no ɔman so panin ne nkwa nna nyinaa.
Na mɛgye ahennie no ne ba nsam, na mede mmusuakuo du mama wo.
Na ne ba no, mede abusuakuo baako bɛma no, deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na kanea atena hɔ ama m’akoa Dawid nna nyinaa wɔ m’anim Yerusalem kuro a mayi mafa sɛ mede me din bɛto hɔ no mu.
Na wo na mɛfa wo mama woadi hene sɛdeɛ wo kra pɛ nyinaa, na woayɛ Israel so hene.
Na sɛ wotie deɛ mɛhyɛ woɔ nyinaa na wonante m’akwan so na woyɛ deɛ ɛtene m’ani soɔ, sɛ wobɛdi m’ahyɛdeɛ ne me mmara nsɛm soɔ sɛdeɛ m’akoa Dawid yɛeɛ no a, ɛnneɛ mɛdi w’akyi na masi efie a ɛtim hɔ mama wo; sɛdeɛ mesi memaa Dawid no, na mede Israel mama wo.
Na yei nti mɛbrɛ Dawid asefoɔ ase, nanso ɛnyɛ nna nyinaa.
Na Salomo hwehwɛɛ sɛ ɔkum Yeroboam; na Yeroboam sɔre dwane kɔɔ Misraim, Misraimhene Sisak nkyɛn; na ɔtenaa Misraim kɔsii sɛ Salomo wuiɛ.
Na Salomo ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa ne ne nyansa no, wɔatwerɛ no Salomo ho nsɛm nwoma no mu.
Na nna a Salomo de dii hene Yerusalem Israel nyinaa soɔ yɛ mfirinhyia aduanan.
Na Salomo tii ne nananom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no n’agya Dawid kuro mu; na ne ba Rehoboam bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Ahennie no mu paepae Na Rehoboam sii mu kɔɔ Sekem; na Sekem na Israel nyinaa aba sɛ wɔrebɛsi no hene.
Na Nebat ba Yeroboam teeɛ no, ɔno deɛ, (na ɔda so wɔ Misraim a ɔdwane firii Ɔhene Salomo anim kɔɔ hɔ no), na ɔte Misraim, na wɔsoma maa wɔkɔhyiaa no bae, na Yeroboam ne Israel asafo nyinaa baeɛ no, wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ Rehoboam sɛ: W’agya maa yɛn kɔnnua yɛɛ duru, na wo deɛ, afei yi w’agya ɔsom denden ne ne kɔnnua duruduro a ɔde too yɛn soɔ no so ma no nyɛ hare, na yɛnsom wo.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monkɔ, na nnansa monsane mmra me nkyɛn.
Na ɔman no kɔe.
Na Ɔhene Rehoboam ne mpanimfoɔ a n’agya Salomo da so te aseɛ no, na wɔyɛ n’afotufoɔ no tuu agyina sɛ: Ɛfoɔ bɛn na moretu me na mede mabua ɔman yi?
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ ɛnnɛ woyɛ akoa ma ɔman yi na wosom wɔn na wobua wɔn na woka wɔn asɛmpa a, ɛnneɛ wɔbɛyɛ wo nkoa nna nyinaa.
Na ɔgyaa mpanimfoɔ fo a wɔtuu no no, na ɔne mmeranteɛ a wɔne no nyiniiɛ a wɔyɛ n’afotufoɔ no kɔtuu agyina, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ɛfoɔ bɛn na mo nso motuo, na yɛde abua ɔman yi a wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Yi kɔnnua a w’agya de too yɛn kɔn soɔ no so ma no nyɛ hare, no?
Na mmeranteɛ a wɔne no nyiniiɛ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sei na ka kyerɛ ɔman yi a wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ wo sɛ: W’agya maa yɛn kɔnnua yɛɛ duru, na wo deɛ, yɛ no hare ma yɛn no, sei na ka kyerɛ wɔn: Me kɔkorɔmmɔto so sene m’agya asene, na afei, m’agya de kɔnnua duruduro soaa mo, na me deɛ, mɛto mo kɔnnua no so; m’agya de mpire na ɛhwee mo, na me deɛ, mede anyanyankyerɛ na ɛbɛhwe mo.
Na Yeroboam ne ɔman no nyinaa san baa Rehoboam nkyɛn da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, sɛdeɛ ɔhene kaeɛ sɛ: Da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, monsane mmra me nkyɛn, no.
Na ɔhene de asɛmdenden buaa ɔman no, na ɔgyaa mpanimfoɔ no fo a wɔtuu no no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛdeɛ mmeranteɛ no tuu no foɔ no, sɛ: M’agya maa mo kɔnnua yɛɛ duru, na me deɛ, mɛto mo kɔnnua no so.
M’agya de mpire na ɛhwee mo, na me deɛ, mede anyanyankyerɛ na ɛbɛhwe mo.
Na ɔhene antie ɔman no, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE na ɔdanee no saa, sɛ ɔbɛma n’asɛm a AWURADE nam Siloni Ahia so ka kyerɛɛ Nebat ba Yeroboam no aba mu.
Na Israel nyinaa hunuu sɛ ɔhene antie wɔn no, ɔman no buaa ɔhene sɛ: Kyɛfa bɛn na yɛwɔ no Dawid mu?
Yɛnni agyapadeɛ bi Yisai ba no mu, monkɔ mo afie mu, Israel, afei Dawid, hwɛ wo ara wo fie so.
Ɛnna Israel sii mu kɔɔ wɔn afie.
Na Israelfoɔ a wɔtete Yuda nkuro mu no deɛ, Rehoboam dii wɔn so hene.
Na Ɔhene Rehoboam somaa Adoram a ɔdi ɔhyɛ adwumayɛ toɔ soɔ no; na Israel nyinaa sii no aboɔ maa no wuiɛ.
Ɛnna Ɔhene Rehoboam yɛɛ ntɛm faa teaseɛnam sɛ ɔredwane aba Yerusalem.
Ɛno nti Israel wae firii Dawid fie ho de bɛsi nnɛ.
Na Israel nyinaa tee sɛ Yeroboam asane aba no, wɔsoma maa wɔkɔhyiaa no baa asafo no mu, na wɔsii no Israel nyinaa so hene; obiara nni hɔ a ɔdii Dawid fie akyire sɛ Yuda abusuakuo nko.
Na Rehoboam duruu Yerusalem no, ɔboaboaa Yuda fie nyinaa ne Benyamin abusuakuo ano, nnipa a wɔayi wɔn a wɔtu sa mpemha aduɔwɔtwe sɛ ɔne Israel fie rekɔko, na wɔadane ahennie no ama Salomo ba Rehoboam.
Na Nyankopɔn asɛm baa Nyankopɔn nipa Semaia nkyɛn sɛ: Ka kyerɛ Salomo ba Rehoboam, Yuda hene, ne Yuda ne Benyamin fie nyinaa ne ɔman no nkaeɛ sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Mommforo nnkɔ na mo ne mo nuanom Israel nnkɔko, monsane nkɔ mo afie; na me na asɛm yi firi me.
Na wɔtiee AWURADE asɛm no, na wɔsane kɔe, sɛdeɛ AWURADE asɛm no seɛ no.
Yeroboam abosonsom Na Yeroboam kyekyeree Sekem, Efraim bepɔ so tenaa mu; na ɔfirii hɔ kɔkyekyeree Penuel.
Na Yeroboam see n’akoma mu sɛ: Afei na ahennie no bɛsane akɔ Dawid fie, sɛ ɔman yi foro kɔbɔ afɔdeɛ AWURADE fie Yerusalem a, ɛnneɛ ɔman yi akoma bɛdane akɔ wɔn wura Rehoboam, Yuda hene nkyɛn, na wɔaku me, na wɔasane akɔ Yudahene Rehoboam nkyɛn.
Na ɔhene no tuu agyina, na ɔyɛɛ sika nantwie mma mmienu, na ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Moaforo akɔ Yerusalem bi ara!
Israel, hwɛ wo anyame a ɔde wo firi Misraim baeɛ nie.
Na ɔde baako kɔsii Betel na ɔde baako nso kɔsii Dan.
Na asɛm yi danee bɔne, na ɔman no fa kɔɔ baako yi anim wɔ Dan, na baako no nso kɔɔ Betel.
Na ɔyɛɛ sorɔnsorɔmmea fie, na ɔde ɔman no nyinaa mu nnipa a wɔmfiri Lewi mma mu sisii asɔfoɔ.
Na Yeroboam hyɛɛ dapɔnna bosome a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe mu, bosome no da a ɛtɔ so dunum so, sɛ dapɔnna a wɔdi no Yuda no, na ɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ afɔrebukyia no so.
Saa na ɔyɛɛ no Betel, ɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ maa nantwie mma a ɔyɛeɛ no, na ɔde sorɔnsorɔmmea a ɔyɛeɛ no asɔfoɔ duaa Betel.
Na ɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ afɔrebukyia a ɔyɛɛ no Betel no so, bosome a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe da a ɛtɔ so dunum no so, bosome a ɔno nko ara bɔɔ ne tirim hyɛeɛ no mu, na ɔhyɛɛ dapɔnna maa Israelfoɔ, na ɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ afɔrebukyia no so, na ɔhyee aduhwam.
Odiyifoɔ bi a ɔkasa tiaa Betel Na hwɛ, Nyankopɔn nipa bi firi Yuda nam AWURADE asɛm so baa Betel, na Yeroboam gyina afɔrebukyia no ho rebɛhye aduhwam.
Na ɔnam AWURADE asɛm so teaa mu tiaa afɔrebukyia no sɛ: Afɔrebukyia, afɔrebukyia, sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Hwɛ, wɔbɛwo ɔba ama Dawid fie a ne din de Yosia, na wo so na ɔde sorɔnsorɔmmea asɔfoɔ a wɔhye wo so aduhwam bɛbɔ afɔdeɛ, na wahye nnipa nnompe wɔ wo so.
Na ɔmaa nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ da no ara sɛ: Yei ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ sɛ AWURADE na aka, hwɛ, afɔrebukyia no bɛbubu, na nso a ɛwɔ soɔ no ahwie agu.
Na ɔhene tee Nyankopɔn nipa no asɛm a ɔteaa mu tiaa afɔrebukyia a ɛwɔ Betel no, Yeroboam tenee ne nsa firii afɔrebukyia no so kaa sɛ: Monkye no.
Na ne nsa a ɔtenee no ne soɔ no senee kyerebann, na wantumi antwe amma ne ho.
Na afɔrebukyia no bubui, na nso no firii afɔrebukyia no so gui, sɛdeɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a Nyankopɔn nipa no de AWURADE asɛm kaeɛ no teɛ no.
Ɛnna ɔhene srɛɛ Nyankopɔn nipa no sɛ: Afei pa AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn kyɛw na srɛ ma me, na me nsa nsane mmra me ho.
Na Nyankopɔn nipa no paa AWURADE kyɛw, na ɔhene nsa no sane baa ne ho, na ɛyɛɛ sɛ kane no.
Ɛnna ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ Nyankopɔn nipa no sɛ: Wo ne me nkɔ fie, na kɔdwodwo wo ho, na mɛkyɛ wo adeɛ.
Na Nyankopɔn nipa no ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene no sɛ: Sɛ wode wo fie fa bɛma me mpo a, me ne wo renkɔ, na merenni aduane, nso merennom nsuo ɛha yi, ɛfiri sɛ wɔde AWURADE asɛm hyɛɛ me sɛ: Nni aduane na nnom nsuo wɔ hɔ, na nsane mfa ɔkwan a wonam so kɔeɛ no so.
Na ɔfaa ɔkwan foforɔ so, a wansane amfa ɔkwan a ɔnam so kɔɔ Betel no so.
Nso na odiyifoɔ akɔkoraa bi te Betel; na ne mma kɔkaa no nneyɛɛ a Nyankopɔn nipa no bɛyɛɛ no Betel da no; nsɛm a ɔkaa ɔhene no nso, wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn agya.
Na wɔn agya no bisaa wɔn sɛ: Ɔkwan bɛn so na ɔfaeɛ?
Na ne mma no hunuu ɔkwan a Nyankopɔn nipa a ɔfiri Yuda baeɛ no faa soɔ.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne mma sɛ: Monhyehyɛ afunumu no mma me.
Na wɔhyehyɛɛ afunumu no maa no, na ɔtenaa so, na ɔsii mu tii Nyankopɔn nipa no, na ɔkɔtoo no sɛ ɔte odum kɛseɛ no aseɛ.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wone Nyankopɔn nipa a wofiri Yuda baeɛ no?
Na ɔse: Mene no.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wone me nkɔ fie na kɔdidi.
Na ɔse: Mentumi ne wo nsane na me ne wo nkɔ, nso merennidi na me ne wo rennom nsuo ɛha yi, na wɔnam AWURADE asɛm so see me sɛ: Nni aduane na nnom nsuo hɔ, nsane mfa ɔkwan a wonam so kɔeɛ no so.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Me nso meyɛ odiyifoɔ sɛ wo, na ɔbɔfoɔ bi nam AWURADE asɛm so aka akyerɛ me sɛ: Kɔsane no na ɔne wo mmra wo fie, na ɔmmɛdi aduane na ɔnnom nsuo.
Nanso atorɔ na ɔdi kyerɛɛ no.
Ɛnna ɔne no saneeɛ, na ɔkɔdidii ne fie, na ɔnom nsuo.
Na wɔte pono ho no, AWURADE asɛm baa odiyifoɔ a ɔkɔsanee no baeɛ no nkyɛn, na ɔteaa mu kyerɛɛ Nyankopɔn nipa a ɔfiri Yuda baeɛ no sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Ɛnam sɛ woate AWURADE anomu asɛm ho atua na woanni mmara asɛm a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ woɔ no soɔ, na woasane abɛdidi na woanom nsuo faako a wɔka kyerɛɛ wo sɛ: Nnidi na nnom nsuo, no nti, wo funu renkɔ w’agyanom da mu.
Na ɔdidiiɛ na ɔnomm nsuo wieeɛ no, ɔhyehyɛɛ afunumu no maa odiyifoɔ a ɔkɔsanee no baeɛ no, na ɔkɔeɛ; na gyata hunuu no ɔkwan no mu, na ɔkumm no, na ne funu no da ɔkwan no mu, na afunumu no gyina nkyɛn, na gyata no nso gyina efunu no ho.
Na hwɛ, sɛ nnipa retwam, na wɔhunu efunu a ɛda ɔkwan no mu, ne gyata a ɔgyina efunu no ho no a, wɔkɔ kɔka no kuro a odiyifoɔ akɔkoraa no te mu no mu.
Na odiyifoɔ a ɔkɔsanee no firii ɔkwan no soɔ no teeɛ no, ɔkaa sɛ: Nyankopɔn nipa a ɔtee AWURADE anomu asɛm ho atua no ne no, na AWURADE de no ama gyata no ama no atete ne mu aku no, sɛ AWURADE asɛm a ɔka kyerɛɛ no no teɛ no.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne mma sɛ: Monhyehyɛ afunumu no mma me.
Na wɔhyehyɛɛ no.
Na ɔkɔ kɔhunuu efunu no sɛ ɛda ɔkwan no mu, na afunumu no ne gyata no gyinagyina efunu no ho.
Gyata no nwee funu no, na ɔmpiraa afunumu no nso.
Na odiyifoɔ no maa Nyankopɔn nipa no funu no so de no saneeɛ, na odiyifoɔ akɔkoraa no de no kɔɔ ne kuro mu, sɛ ɔrekɔgyam no na wasie no.
Na ɔde ne funu no too ne da mu, na wɔgyamm no sɛ: Due, me nua!
Na ɔwiee no sie no, ɔka kyerɛɛ ne mma sɛ: Sɛ mewu a, monsie me ɛda a wɔasie Nyankopɔn nipa no mu no mu, momfa me nnompe nto ne nnompe ho.
Na asɛm a ɔnam AWURADE asɛm so teaa mu tiaa afɔrebukyia a ɛwɔ Betel no ne sorɔnsorɔmmea afie a ɛwɔ Samaria nkuro mu no nyinaa, ɛbɛba mu ampa.
Asɛm yi akyiri no, Yeroboam ansane amfiri ne kwammɔne so, na ɔsane faa ɔman no mu baabiara nnipa sisii sorɔnsorɔmmea asɔfoɔ; obiara a ɔpɛ no, ɔde asɔfodeɛ hyɛ ne nsa ma ɔyɛ sorɔnsorɔmmea asɔfoɔ no bi.
Na asɛm yi danee Yeroboam fie bɔne a enti wɔdwerɛɛ wɔn na wɔsɛee wɔn firii asase ani.
Yeroboam ho nkɔmhyɛ Ɛberɛ no mu no, Yeroboam ba Abia yaree.
Na Yeroboam ka kyerɛɛ ne yere sɛ: Sɔre, sakyera wo ho, na wɔanhunu sɛ wone Yeroboam yere, na kɔ Silo; hwɛ, ɛhɔ na Odiyifoɔ Ahia wɔ; ɔno na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ mɛdi ɔman yi so hene.
Na fa paanoo du ne taterɛ ne ɛwoɔ toa kura wo nsam, na kɔ ne nkyɛn; ɔno na ɔbɛka wo deɛ ɛbɛyɛ abɔfra yi.
Na Yeroboam yere no yɛɛ saa, na ɔsii mu kɔɔ Silo, na ɔduruu Ahia fie.
Nso na Ahia nhunu adeɛ, na akorabɔ nti n’ani so ayɛ kusuu.
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Ahia sɛ: Hwɛ, Yeroboam yere reba abɛbisa wo hɔ asɛm ne ba ho, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyare.
Sɛɛ ne sɛɛ na ka kyerɛ no.
Ɔbaeɛ no, ɔyɛɛ ne ho sɛ ɔbaa foforɔ bi.
Na Ahia tee ne nan ase sɛ ɔreba ɛpono ano no, ɔkaa sɛ: Yeroboam yere, bra!
Adɛn nti na woasakyera wo ho ayɛ sɛ obi yi?
Na me deɛ, wɔde asɛm denden asoma me wo nkyɛn.
Kɔka kyerɛ Yeroboam sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Ɛsiane sɛ memaa wo so wo man no mu, na mesii wo me man Israel so panin, na metee ahennie no mefirii Dawid fie de maa woɔ, nanso woanyɛ sɛ m’akoa Dawid a ɔdii me mmara nsɛm soɔ, na ɔde n’akoma nyinaa dii m’akyire sɛ ɔbɛyɛ deɛ ɛtene m’ani soɔ no nko, na woayɛ bɔne asene wɔn a wɔdii w’anim nyinaa, na woakɔ akɔyɛ anyame foforɔ ne ahoni a wɔaguo sɛ wode rehuru me bo, na woato me atwene w’akyire nti, hwɛ, mede bɔne bɛba Yeroboam fie so, na matwa Yeroboam fie barima biara ne Israel mu akoa ne ɔdehyeɛ atwene, na mapra Yeroboam fie sɛdeɛ obi pra fi kɔsi sɛ ɛsa.
Yeroboam nipa biara a ɔbɛwu kuro mu no, akraman na ɛbɛdi ne nam, na deɛ ɔbɛwu wiram no, ewiem nnomaa na ɛbɛdi ne nam.
AWURADE na waka.
Na wo deɛ, sɔre kɔ wo fie; na wo nan si kuro no mu ara pɛ a, abɔfra no bɛwu.
Na Israel nyinaa bɛgyam no na wɔasie no, na ɔno nko ne Yeroboam deɛ a ɔbɛkɔ ɛda mu, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno mu na wɔahunu adepa bi a ɛsɔ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn ani, Yeroboam fie.
Na AWURADE bɛma ɔhene bi so, Israel so a ɔbɛtwa Yeroboam fie atwene nnɛ.
Na ɛfiri nnɛ, AWURADE bɛbɔ Israel sɛdeɛ demmire woso nsuo mu, na watutu Israel afiri asase pa a ɔde maa wɔn agyanom yi so, na wabɔ wɔn apete akɔ asuogya, ɛsiane sɛ wɔayɛ wɔn Asera nnua de ahuru AWURADE bo.
Na Yeroboam bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ na ɔde maa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no nti, ɔbɛgyae Israel mu ama.
Na Yeroboam yere no sɔre sii mu kɔɔ Tirsa.
Na ɔduruu ɛdan no aponnwa ano no, abɔfra no wui.
Na wɔsiee no, na Israel nyinaa gyamm no, sɛdeɛ AWURADE asɛm a ɔnam n’akoa Odiyifoɔ Ahia so kaeɛ no teɛ no.
Na Yeroboam ho nsɛm nkaeɛ, sɛdeɛ ɔdii ako ne sɛdeɛ ɔdii ne hene faeɛ no, hwɛ, wɔatwerɛ no Israel ahemfo berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu.
Na nna a Yeroboam de dii hene yɛ mfeɛ aduonu mmienu; na ɔtoaa n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na ne ba Nadab bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Rehoboam di Yuda so hene Na Salomo ba Rehoboam dii hene Yuda.
Na Rehoboam adi mfirinhyia aduanan baako na ɔbɛdii hene, na ɔdii hene mfirinhyia dunson wɔ Yerusalem, kuro a AWURADE fa firii Israel mmusuakuo nyinaa mu sɛ ɔde ne din bɛto hɔ no mu.
Na ne na din de Naama a ɔyɛ Amonni.
Na Yuda yɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, na wɔmaa no twee wɔn ho ninkunu sene wɔn agyanom bɔne a wɔyɛ tiaa no no ho deɛ nyinaa.
Na wɔn nso yeyɛɛ sorɔnsorɔmmea ne adum ne abosompɔ nkokoɔ sorɔnsorɔn nyinaa so ne nnua frɔmfrɔm nyinaa ase fae.
Na mmarima nnwamamfoɔ nso wɔ asase no so; wɔyɛɛ sɛdeɛ amanaman a AWURADE tuu wɔn firii Israelfoɔ anim no akyiwadeɛ nyinaa teɛ.
Na Ɔhene Rehoboam afe a ɛtɔ so nnum soɔ no Misraimhene Sisak foro baa Yerusalem so.
Na ɔfaa AWURADE fie akoradeɛ ne ahemfie akoradeɛ, ɔfaa ne nyinaa kɔe.
Na ɔfaa sika akyɛm a Salomo yɛeɛ no nso nyinaa.
Na Ɔhene Rehoboam yɛɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ akyɛm sisii ananmu, na ɔde hyɛɛ awɛmfoɔ a wɔhwɛ ahemfie pono ano no so asafohene nsa.
Na da biara a ɔhene bɛkɔ AWURADE fie no, awɛmfoɔ no soa kɔ, na wɔde sane bɛsie awɛmfoɔ dan mu.
Na Rehoboam ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ no nyinaa, wɔantwerɛ no Yuda ahemfo berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu?
Na akodie daa Rehoboam ne Yeroboam ntam daa.
Na Rehoboam toaa n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no n’agyanom nkyɛn, Dawid kuro mu.
Na ne na din de Naama a ɔyɛ Amonni.
Na ne ba Abiam bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Abiam di Yuda so hene Na Nebat ba Ɔhene Yeroboam afe a ɛtɔ so dunwɔtwe mu na Abiam bɛdii Yuda so hene.
Mfeɛ mmiɛnsa na ɔdii hene wɔ Yerusalem.
Na ne na din ne Maaka a ɔyɛ Abisalom babaa.
Na ɔnantee n’agya bɔne a ɔyɛ dii n’anim nyinaa mu, na n’akoma anni mu AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn anim sɛ n’agya Dawid akoma.
Nanso Dawid nti, AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn maa no kanea wɔ Yerusalem, sɛ ɔbɛma ne ba so asi n’akyire, na wama Yerusalem agyina, ɛfiri sɛ Dawid yɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so, na wammane amfiri biribiara a ɔhyɛɛ no ho, ne nkwa nna nyinaa, gye Hetini Uria asɛm no nko ara mu.
Na akodie daa Rehoboam ne Yeroboam ntam ne nkwa nna nyinaa.
Na Abiam ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa, wɔantwerɛ no Yuda ahemfo berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu?
Na akodie daa Abiam ne Yeroboam ntam.
Na Abiam toaa n’agyanom wɔ asamando; na wɔsiee no Dawid kuro mu; na ne ba Asa bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Asa di Yuda so hene Na Israelhene Yeroboam afe a ɛtɔ so aduonu soɔ na Asa bɛdii Yuda so hene.
Na ɔdii hene mfirinhyia aduanan baako Yerusalem.
Na ne na din ne Maaka a ɔyɛ Abisalom babaa.
Na Asa yɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so sɛ n’agya Dawid.
Na ɔtutuu mmarima nnwamamfoɔ no firii asase no so, na ɔyiyii ahoni a n’agyanom yɛeɛ no nyinaa.
Na ne na Maaka nso, ɔtuu no firii ahemmaadie so, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛɛ ohoni bi maa Asera; na Asa twaa ne honi no kɔhyee no Kidron subonhwa mu.
Na sorɔnsorɔmmea no deɛ, wanyi, nanso Asa akoma dii mu AWURADE anim ne nna nyinaa.
Na ɔde n’agya akronkronneɛ ne ɔno ara n’akronkronneɛ baa AWURADE fie: Dwetɛ ne sika ne nnwinneɛ.
Na akodie bɛdaa Asa ne Israelhene Baasa ntam wɔn nna nyinaa.
Na Israelhene Baasa foro baa Yuda so, na ɔbɛkyekyeree Rama, sɛ ɔremma obi nni Yudahene Asa nkyɛn ahyɛmfire.
Ɛnna Asa faa dwetɛ ne sika a ɛkaa AWURADE fie akoradeɛ ne ɔhene fie akoradeɛ mu de hyɛɛ ne nkoa nsa, na Ɔhene Asa de somaa wɔn maa wɔkɔɔ Hesion ba Tabrimon ba Siriahene Ben-hadad a ɔte Damasko nkyɛn sɛ: Ma apam nna me ne wo ntam, te sɛ m’agya ne w’agya ntam: Hwɛ, merebrɛ wo dwetɛ ne sika ayɛyɛdeɛ, na kɔ kɔbubu wo ne Israelhene Baasa apam no mu, na ɔmfiri me so nkɔ.
Na Ben-hadad tiee Ɔhene Asa, na ɔsomaa asafohene a ɔwɔ no maa wɔkɔko tiaa Israel nkuro, na ɔbɔɔ Iyon ne Dan ne Abel-bet-maaka ne Kinerot nyinaa ne Naftali asase nyinaa.
Na Baasa teeɛ no, ɔgyaee Rama kyekyerɛ, na ɔkɔtenaa Tirsa.
Ɛnna Ɔhene Asa maa wɔpaee no Yuda nyinaa, wɔanyi obiara amfiri mu, na wɔkɔsoaa Rama aboɔ ne nnua a Baasa de kyekyereeɛ no, na Ɔhene Asa de kyekyeree Geba-benyamin ne Mispa.
Na Asa ho nsɛm nyinaa nkaeɛ, ne ne mmaninneɛ nyinaa ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa ne nkuro a ɔkyekyereeɛ, wɔantwerɛ no Yuda ahemfo berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu?
Nanso ne nkɔkoraaberɛ mu no, ɔyaree ne nan.
Na Asa toaa n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no n’agyanom nkyɛn, n’agya Dawid kuro mu.
Na ne ba Yehosafat bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Nadab di Israel so hene Na Yeroboam ba Nadab bɛdii Israel so hene, Yudahene Asa afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu mu.
Na ɔdii Israel so hene mfeɛ mmienu.
Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, na ɔnantee n’agya kwan ne ne bɔne a ɔde maa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no mu.
Na Ahia ba Baasa a ɔfiri Isakar fie no pam ne tiri so; na Baasa bɔɔ no wɔ Gibeton a ɛyɛ Filistifoɔ dea hɔ; nso na Nadab ne Israel nyinaa retua Gibeton.
Na Baasa kumm no, Yudahene Asa afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu, na ɔdii n’adeɛ.
Na ɔbɛdii hene no pɛ, ɔbɔɔ Yeroboam fie nyinaa, wannya obiara a ɔhome amma Yeroboam de kɔsii sɛ ɔsɛee no, sɛ AWURADE asɛm a ɔnam n’akoa Siloni Ahia so kaeɛ wɔ Yeroboam bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ na ɔde maa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no ne abohuro a ɔde huruu AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn bo no nti.
Na Nadab ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa, wɔantwerɛ no Israel ahemfo berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu?
Na akodie bɛdaa Asa ne Israelhene Baasa ntam wɔn nna nyinaa.
Baasa di Israel so hene Yudahene Asa afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu na Ahia ba Baasa bɛdii Israel nyinaa so hene Tirsa.
Na ɔdii adeɛ mfeɛ aduonu nnan.
Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, na ɔnantee Yeroboam kwan ne ne bɔne a ɔde maa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no mu.
Na AWURADE asɛm baa Hanani ba Yehu nkyɛn tiaa Baasa sɛ: Ɛsiane sɛ mama wo so afiri mfuturo mu, na masi wo me man Israel so panin, na woafa Yeroboam kwan soɔ, na woama me man Israel ayɛ bɔne ama wɔde wɔn bɔne ahuru me bo yi nti, hwɛ, merepra Baasa ne ne fie akɔ, na mɛyɛ wo fie sɛ Nebat ba Yeroboam fie.
Baasa busuani biara a ɔbɛwu kuro mu no, akraman na ɛbɛwe ne nam, na ne ho nipa biara a ɔbɛwu wiram no, ewiem nnomaa na ɛbɛdi ne nam.
Na Baasa ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ ne ne mmaninneɛ, wɔantwerɛ no Israel ahemfo berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu?
Na Baasa toaa n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no Tirsa.
Na ne ba Ela bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Nanso AWURADE asɛm nam Hanani ba Odiyifoɔ Yehu so ba tiaa Baasa ne ne fie, bɔne a ɔyɛɛ no AWURADE ani soɔ nyinaa, sɛ ɔde ne nsa ano adwuma yɛɛ sɛ Yeroboam fie no huruu ne boɔ ne kum a ɔkumm no ho.
Ela di Israel so hene Yudahene Asa afe a ɛtɔ so aduonu nsia mu na Baasa ba Ela bɛdii hene Tirsa mfeɛ mmienu.
Na n’akoa Simri, ne nteaseɛnam fa so safohene no, pamm ne tiri so.
Na ɔwɔ Tirsa anom nsa abo wɔ Arsa a ɔdi ahemfie a ɛwɔ Tirsa no soɔ no fie.
Na Simri kɔɔ mu kɔbɔɔ no kumm no, Yudahene Asa afe a ɛtɔ so aduonu nson mu, na ɔdii n’adeɛ.
Na ɔbɛdii hene na ɔtenaa ahennwa soɔ ara pɛ no, ɔkumm Baasa fiefoɔ nyinaa, obusuani oo, adamfo oo, wannya ɔbarima biara amma no.
Na Simri sɛee Baasa fie nyinaa sɛ AWURADE asɛm a ɔnam Odiyifoɔ Yehu so ka tiaa Baasa, wɔ Baasa bɔne nyinaa ne ne ba Ela bɔne a wɔyeyɛeɛ na wɔde maa Israel yɛɛ bɔne sɛ wɔde wɔn ahuhudeɛ huruu AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn, boɔ no ho.
Na Ela ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa, wɔantwerɛ no Israel ahemfo berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu?
Simri di Israel so hene Yudahene Asa afe a ɛtɔ so aduonu nson mu na Simri bɛdii hene nnanson wɔ Tirsa.
Na ɔman no akyere Gibeton a ɛyɛ Filistifoɔ deɛ no ho nsraban.
Na ɔman a wɔwɔ nsra mu no tee sɛ Simri akɔ apam na wakum ɔhene no, Israel nyinaa de ɔsahene Omri sii Israel so hene da no ara nsraban no mu.
Na Omri firi Gibeton foro bae, na Israel nyinaa ka ne ho, na wɔbɛtuaa Tirsa.
Na Simri hunuu sɛ wɔagye kuro no no, ɔkɔɔ ahemfie aban mu, na ɔde ogya hyee ahemfie no ne ne ho, na ɔwui ne bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ, sɛ ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, sɛ ɔnantee Yeroboam kwan soɔ, ne ne bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ de maa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no mu nti.
Na Simri ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne n’apam a ɔkɔeɛ no, wɔantwerɛ no Israel ahemfo berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu?
Ɛno na Israel man mu paepaee afaafa mmienu.
Ɔman no fa dii Ginat ba Tibni akyiri sɛ wɔbɛsi no hene, na ɔfa nso dii Omri akyi.
Na ɔman no fa a wɔdii Omri akyire no yɛ den sene ɔman no fa a wɔdii Ginat ba Tibni akyire; na wɔkumm Tibni, na Omri dii hene.
Omri di Israel so hene Yudahene Asa afe a ɛtɔ so aduasa baako mu na Omri bɛdii Israel so hene mfeɛ dummienu.
Ɔdii hene Tirsa mfeɛ nsia.
Na ɔkɔtɔɔ Samaria bepɔ wɔ Semer hɔ, maa dwetɛ dwetikɛseɛ mmienu, na ɔkyekyeree bepɔ no so kuro, na ɔde bepɔ no wura Semer din too kuro a ɔkyekyereeɛ no.
Ɛnne Samaria.
Na Omri yɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, na ɔyɛɛ bɔne sene wɔn a wɔdii n’anim nyinaa.
Na ɔfaa Nebat ba Yeroboam kwan nyinaa ne ne bɔne a ɔde maa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no so, sɛ wɔde wɔn ahuhudeɛ bɛhuru AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn, no boɔ.
Na Omri ho nsɛm nkaeɛ, deɛ ɔyɛeɛ ne ne mmaninneɛ a ɔyɛeɛ no, wɔatwerɛ no Israel ahemfo berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu.
Na Omri toaa n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no Samaria.
Na ne ba Ahab bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Ahab di Israel so hene Na Omri ba Ahab bɛdii Israel so hene, Yudahene Asa afe a ɛtɔ so aduasa nwɔtwe mu.
Na Omri ba Ahab dii Israel so hene Samaria mfirinhyia aduonu mmienu.
Na Omri ba Ahab yɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne sene wɔn a wɔdii n’anim nyinaa.
Na ɛyɛɛ hare maa no sɛ ɔbɛnante Nebat ba Yeroboam bɔne mu, na ɔkɔfaa Sidonfoɔ hene Etbaal babaa Isebel waree, na ɔkɔ kɔsomm Baal na ɔsɔree no.
Na ɔsii afɔrebukyia maa Baal wɔ Baal fie a ɔsii no Samaria.
Na Ahab yɛɛ Asera nnua, na Ahab yɛɛ pii sɛ ɔde bɛhuru AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn bo asene Israel ahemfo a wɔdii n’anim nyinaa.
Ne berɛ so na Betelni Hiel kyekyeree Yeriko.
N’abakan Abiram wui berɛ a ɔtoo fapem, na ne ba kumaa Segub nso wui berɛ a ɔsisii ano apono, sɛdeɛ AWURADE asɛm a ɔnam Nun ba Yosua so kaeɛ no teɛ.
Elia hyɛ ɔhaw ho nkɔm Na Tisbini Elia a ɔfiri Gilead atubrafoɔ mu ka kyerɛɛ Ahab sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn a megyina n’anim te aseɛ yi, obosuo anaa osuo rentɔ mfeɛ yi mu gye sɛ ɛnam m’asɛm so!
Na AWURADE asɛm baa ne nkyɛn sɛ: Firi ha kɔ, na dane wo ho kɔ apueeɛ, na kɔhunta asuo Kerit a ɛwɔ Yordan anim no ho.
Na wobɛnom asuo no mu nsuo, na mahyɛ anene sɛ wɔnhwɛ wo wɔ hɔ.
Na ɔsii mu kɔyɛɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE asɛm no teɛ, na ɔkɔ kɔtenaa asuo Kerit a ɛwɔ Yordan apueeɛ no ho.
Na anene brɛɛ no paanoo ne nam anɔpa, ne anwummerɛ, na ɔnomm asuo no mu nsuo bi.
Na ɛbaa sɛ nna bi akyiri no, asuo no wee, ɛfiri sɛ osuo antɔ asase no so.
Elia wɔ Sarefat ɔbaa kunafoɔ bi nkyɛn Na AWURADE asɛm baa ne nkyɛn sɛ: Sɔre kɔ Sarefat a ɛyɛ Sidonfoɔ deɛ no, na kɔtena hɔ; na hwɛ, mahyɛ ɔbaa kunafoɔ bi wɔ hɔ sɛ ɔnhwɛ wo.
Na ɔsɔre kɔɔ Sarefat.
Na ɔduruu kuro no pono ano no, na hwɛ, ɔbaa kunafoɔ no wɔ hɔ repɛ mmaboa.
Na ɔfrɛɛ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kɔsa nsuo kakra gu kuruwa mu brɛ me na mennom.
Na ɔrekɔ akɔsa no, ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Fa paanoo afono ma kura wo nsam brɛ me.
Na ɔse: Sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn te aseɛ yi, atodeɛ biara nni me nsam, gye esiam nsa ma a ɛwɔ kuruwa mu, ne ngo kakra a ɛwɔ toa mu, na hwɛ, merepɛ mmaboa mmienu bi makɔ makɔto, na me ne me ba adi na yɛawu.
Na Elia ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Nsuro, kɔyɛ sɛdeɛ woaka no, na kɔfa bi yɛ ɔfam ketewaa bi nso ma me kane, na fa brɛ me, na ɛno akyiri no yɛ wo ne wo ba deɛ.
Na sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Esiam kuruwa no so renhwan, na ngo toa no so rente de bɛkɔ akɔsi da a AWURADE bɛma osuo atɔ agu asase no soɔ.
Na ɔkɔ kɔyɛɛ sɛdeɛ Elia ka kyerɛɛ no no, na ɔdii, ɔno ne ɔbaa no ne ne fiefoɔ, nna pii; na esiam kuruwa no so anhwan, na ngo toa no so ante, sɛdeɛ AWURADE asɛm a ɔnam Elia so kaeɛ no teɛ no.
Na nsɛm yi akyiri no, ɔbaa fiewura no babarima yaree, na ne yadeɛ no mu yɛɛ den pii kɔsii sɛ ɔwuiɛ.
Na ɔbaa no ka kyerɛɛ Elia sɛ: Wo Nyankopɔn nipa, ɛdeɛn na me ne wo wɔ yɛ?
Wobaa me nkyɛn sɛ worebɛma wɔakae me bɔne na wɔakum me ba!
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Fa wo ba no brɛ me!
Na ɔgyee no firii ne kokom de no kɔɔ abansoro pia a ɔte mu no mu, na ɔde no kɔtoo ne mpa so.
Na ɔteaa mu frɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: AWURADE me Nyankopɔn, ɔbaa kunafoɔ yi nso a mabɛsoɛ ne nkyɛn yi, wode mmusuo reba ne so sɛ worekum ne ba yi?
Na ɔtenee ne mu butuu abɔfra no so mprɛnsa, na ɔteaa mu frɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: AWURADE me Nyankopɔn, ma abɔfra yi kra nsane mmra ne mu.
Na AWURADE tiee Elia nne, na abɔfra no kra sane baa ne mu, na ɔnyaa nkwa.
Na Elia faa abɔfra no de no siane firii abansoro pia mu baa ɛdan no mu, na ɔde no brɛɛ ne na, na Elia se: Hwɛ, wo ba anya nkwa.
Na ɔbaa no ka kyerɛɛ Elia sɛ: Afei na mahunu sɛ Nyankopɔn nipa ne wo, na AWURADE asɛm a ɛwɔ w’anomu yɛ nokorɛ.
Elia ne Obadia Na nna pii akyiri no, afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu no, AWURADE asɛm baa Elia nkyɛn sɛ: Fa wo ho kɔkyerɛ Ahab, na mɛma osuo atɔ asase so.
Na Elia sii mu kɔɔ sɛ ɔde ne ho rekɔkyerɛ Ahab.
Nso na ɛkɔm a emu yɛ den aba Samaria.
Na Ahab frɛɛ Obadia a ɔdi ne fie soɔ; Na Ahab ka kyerɛɛ Obadia sɛ: Kɔkyini asase no so, nsuo aniwa nyinaa ne nsubɔnhwa nyinaa ho; ebia yɛbɛnya wira de agye apɔnkɔ ne mfunumupɔnkɔ no bi nkwa, na yɛanhwere mmoa no.
Na wɔkyɛɛ asase no mu fae sɛ wɔrekyini so, Ahab nko faa ɔkwan baako so, na Obadia nko nso faa ɔkwan baako soɔ.
Na Obadia wɔ ɔkwan no soɔ no, hwɛ, Elia ne no bɛhyiae, na ɔhunuu no, na ɔde n’anim butuu fam kaa sɛ: Me wura Elia nie?
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Menie.
Kɔka kyerɛ wo wura sɛ: Mahunu Elia.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Bɔne bɛn na mayɛ, na wo deɛ, woreyi w’akoa ahyɛ Ahab nsa na waku me yi?
Sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn te aseɛ yi, ɔman ne ahennie biara nni hɔ a me wura nsoma mmaa wɔnkɔɔ hɔ nkɔhwehwɛɛ woɔ.
Na sɛ wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɔnni hɔ, a, ɔma ahennie no ne ɔman no ka ntam sɛ wɔnhunuu woɔ.
Na afei, wo ara wose: Kɔka kyerɛ wo wura sɛ: Elia wɔ ha.
Na sɛ me deɛ, mefiri wo nkyɛn mekɔ a, AWURADE honhom bɛma wo so akɔ baabi a mennim, na sɛ meka mekyerɛ Ahab na wanhu wo a, ɔbɛkum me.
Na me, w’akoa deɛ, mefiri me mmɔfraase mesuro AWURADE.
Wɔnkaa deɛ Isebel kumm AWURADE adiyifoɔ no, meyɛeɛ no nkyerɛɛ me wura, sɛ mefaa AWURADE adiyifoɔ mu mmarima ɔha, na mede wɔn aduonum aduonum mesiee ɔbodan mu, na me de aduane ne nsuo mehwɛɛ wɔn no?
Na afei, wo deɛ, wose: Kɔka kyerɛ wo wura sɛ: Elia wɔ ha, na ɔnku me.
Na Elia kaa sɛ: Sɛ asafo AWURADE a megyina n’anim te aseɛ yi, ɛyɛ dɛn ara a nnɛ mede me ho bɛkyerɛ no.
Ɛnna Obadia kɔ kɔhyiaa Ahab, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no; na Ahab kɔ kɔhyiaa Elia.
Na Ahab hunuu Elia no, Ahab bisaa no sɛ: Wo a woha Israel no, wo nie?
Na ɔse: Menhaa Israel, na mmom wo ne w’agya fie, sɛ moagya AWURADE mmara nsɛm, na moakɔdi Baalim akyire.
Na afei soma ma wɔnkɔboaboa Israel nyinaa ano mmrɛ me Karmel bepɔ so ne Baal adiyifoɔ ahanan aduonum no ne Asera adiyifoɔ ahanan a wɔdidi Isebel pono soɔ no.
Na Ahab soma maa wɔkɔɔ Israelfoɔ nyinaa mu kɔboaboaa adiyifoɔ no ano kɔɔ Karmel bepɔ so.
Elia ne Baal asɔfoɔ Ɛnna Elia twe pinii ɔman no nyinaa nkyɛn bɛkaa sɛ: Ɛnkɔsi da bɛn na mo adwene bɛyɛ mo ntanta?
Sɛ AWURADE ne Onyankopɔn a, monni n’akyi: Sɛ Baal nso a, monni n’akyi!
Na ɔman no ammua no asɛm biara.
Na Elia ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Me deɛ, me nko ara mene AWURADE diyifoɔ a waka, na Baal adiyifoɔ deɛ, wɔyɛ mmarima ahanan aduonum.
Na momma wɔmma yɛn anantwinini mmienu, na ma wɔnyi nantwinini no baako mfa, na wɔntwitwa no asinasini, na wɔmfa ngu nnyina so, na ogya deɛ, wɔmmfa nngu aseɛ.
Na me nso, mɛsiesie nantwinini baako no, na mede magu nnyina so, na meremfa ogya mengu aseɛ.
Na mommɔ mo nyame din, na me nso memmɔ AWURADE din, na onyame a ɔde ogya bɛgye soɔ no, ɔno ne Onyankopɔn.
Na ɔman no nyinaa gyee so sɛ: Ɔsɛmpa!
Ɛnna Elia ka kyerɛɛ Baal adiyifoɔ no sɛ: Monyi nantwinini baako mfa, na monsiesie no kane; na mo deɛ, modɔɔso; na mommɔ mo nyame din, na ogya na mommfa nngu aseɛ.
Na wɔfaa nantwinini a wɔde maa wɔn no, na wɔsiesiee; na wɔbɔɔ Baal din firii anɔpa kɔsii awigyina sɛ: Baal, gye yɛn so!
Nso wɔante nne biara, na obiara nso annye so.
Na wɔhurihuri twaa afɔrebukyia a wɔyɛeɛ no ho hyiae.
Na ɛduruu awigyina no, Elia sii wɔn atwetweɛ goroo wɔn ho, na ɔkaa sɛ: Momfa nne kɛseɛ mfrɛ na onyame ne no!
Sɛsɛɛ ɔredwene, anaasɛ wafiri adi rekɔgya ne nan, anaasɛ ɔnam kwan so; ebia wada, na wanyane.
Na wɔde nne kɛseɛ teateaa mu, na wɔde nkrantɛ ne mpea bobɔɔ wɔn ho akam, sɛdeɛ wɔn amanneɛ teɛ no, kɔsii sɛ mogya guu wɔn soɔ.
Na awigyina twaa mu no, wɔkɔmee kɔsii sɛ ɛrekɔ aduane afɔrebɔ berɛ soɔ; nso wɔante nne biara, na obiara nso annye so, na obiara nso antie wɔn.
Ɛnna Elia ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinaa sɛ: Montwe mpini me!
Na ɔman no nyinaa twe pinii no.
Na ɔsiesiee AWURADE afɔrebukyia a abubuo no.
Na Elia tasee aboɔ dummienu sɛ Yakob a AWURADE asɛm baa ne nkyɛn sɛ: Israel ne wo din no, mma mmusuakuo no ano sie.
Na ɔde aboɔ no sii afɔrebukyia, AWURADE din mu, na ɔtwaa ɛka a ɛbɛdi aba a wɔguo susuo adeɛ mmienu afɔrebukyia no ho hyiae.
Na ɔhyehyɛɛ nnyina no, na ɔtwitwaa nantwinini no asinasini de guu nnyina no so kaa sɛ: Momfa nsuo nhyehyɛ nhina nnan amaama, na mommɛhwie ngu ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne nnyina no so!
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Monyɛ bio!
Na wɔyɛɛ bio.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Momma no nyɛ mprɛnsa!
Na wɔmaa no yɛɛ mprɛnsa.
Na nsuo no fefaa afɔrebukyia no ho hyiae, na ɛka no nso, ɔhyɛɛ no nsuo ma.
Na afɔrebɔberɛ mu no, Odiyifoɔ Elia twe pinii, na ɔkaa sɛ: AWURADE, Abraham ne Isak ne Israel Nyankopɔn, nnɛ ma wɔnhunu sɛ wo na wone Onyankopɔn Israel mu, na mene w’akoa, na w’asɛm so na mayɛ adeɛ yi nyinaa.
Gye me so, AWURADE, gye me so, na ɔman yi nhunu sɛ wo AWURADE ne Onyankopɔn, na wo nso woama wɔn akoma asane akyire aba.
Ɛnna AWURADE gya duru bɛhyee ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no ne nnyina no ne aboɔ ne dɔteɛ no, na ɛwee nsuo a ɛwɔ ɛka no mu no.
Na ɔman no nyinaa hunuiɛ no, wɔde wɔn anim butubutuu fam kaa sɛ: AWURADE, ɔno ne Onyankopɔn!
AWURADE, ɔno ne Onyankopɔn!
Na Elia kaa sɛ: Monkyere Baal adiyifoɔ no, mommma wɔn mu biara mmfiri mu mfi!
Na wɔkyeree wɔn na Elia de wɔn siane kɔɔ Kison asuo ho, na ɔkumm wɔn wɔ hɔ.
Na Elia ka kyerɛɛ Ahab sɛ: Foro kɔ kɔdidi na nom.
Na mete osu kɛseɛ nka.
Na Ahab foro kɔɔ sɛ ɔrekɔdidi na wanom.
Na Elia deɛ, ɔforo kɔɔ Karmel atifi na ɔkotoo fam, na ɔde n’anim hyɛɛ ne nkotodwe ntam.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’abɔfra sɛ: Foro kɔ kɔhwɛ po fam.
Na ɔforo kɔhwɛe, na ɔbɛkaa sɛ: Hwee nni hɔ.
Na ɔse: Sane kɔ mprɛnson.
Na ɛbaa sɛ, deɛ ɛtɔ so nson no, ɔkaa sɛ: Hwɛ, mununkum ketewa bi te sɛ onipa nsa resɔre firi po mu.
Na ɔse: Foro kɔka kyerɛ Ahab sɛ: Siesie wo nteaseɛnam na siane kɔ na osuo ansi wo kwan.
Na ɛbaa sɛ ɛyɛɛ kakra na mununkum ne mframa abiri soro tumm, na osu kɛseɛ bi tɔe.
Na Ahab nam teaseɛnam mu kɔɔ Yesreel.
Na AWURADE nsa baa Elia so, na ɔbɔɔ n’abɔsoɔ tuu mmirika dii Ahab anim de kɔduruu sɛ wɔrehyɛne Yesreel.
Elia aba pa Na Ahab bɛka kyerɛɛ Isebel deɛ Elia yɛeɛ no nyinaa ne sɛdeɛ ɔkumm adiyifoɔ no nyinaa, nkrantɛ ano no.
Na Isebel somaa ɔbɔfoɔ maa no kɔɔ Elia nkyɛn sɛ: Sei na anyame no nyɛ me, na sei nso na wɔmfa nka ho, sɛ ɔkyena sɛsɛɛ na mama wo kra ayɛ sɛ wɔn mu baako deɛ.
Na ɔhunuu saa no, ne nkwa nti ɔsuroe na ɔsɔre kɔe, na ɔkɔduruu Beer-seba a ɛyɛ Yuda deɛ no, na ɔgyaa n’abɔfra no wɔ hɔ.
Na ɔno deɛ, ɔnantee ɛserɛ so da koro kwan na ɔkɔtenaa sesea bi ase, na ɔsrɛ maa ne ho sɛ anka ɔnwu.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Ayɛ yie, afei, AWURADE, fa me kra, na menyɛ nsene m’agyanom.
Na ɔde ne ho too hɔ sesea bi ase.
Na hwɛ, ɔbɔfoɔ bɛkaa no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɔre didi!
Na ɔhwɛe, na hwɛ, na ɔfam a wɔato no nnyansramma soɔ ne nsuo kuruwa si n’atifi; na ɔdidii na ɔnomee, na ɔtɔɔ hɔ dae.
Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ sane bɛkaa no ne mprenu soɔ sɛ: Sɔre didi, na ɔkwan no ware papa ma wo.
Na ɔsɔre didii na ɔnomee, na ɔnantee aduane no ahoɔden mu adaduanan, awia ne anadwo de kɔduruu Nyankopɔn bepɔ Horeb ho.
Onyankopɔn yi ne ho adi Horeb Na ɔduruu ɔbodan no ho hɔ, na ɔsoɛɛ hɔ.
Na hwɛ, AWURADE asɛm baa ne nkyɛn sɛ: Elia, ɛdeɛn na wowɔ yɛ wɔ ha?
Na ɔse: Ninkunu na matwe mama AWURADE, asafo Nyankopɔn, sɛ Israelfoɔ agya w’apam; w’afɔrebukyia no, wɔadwiridwiri, na w’adiyifoɔ nso, wɔde nkrantɛ akum wɔn; na me nko na maka, na wɔrehwehwɛ me aku me.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Firi adi kɔgyina bepɔ no so AWURADE anim.
Na hwɛ, AWURADE twaa mu, na mframa kɛseɛ a ɛyɛ den paepaee mmepɔ na ɛbubuu abotan dii AWURADE anim; nanso na ɛnyɛ mframa no mu na AWURADE wɔ; na mframa no akyiri no asasewosoɔ, na ɛnyɛ asasewosoɔ no mu na AWURADE wɔ; na asasewosoɔ no akyiri no, ogya, na ɛnyɛ ogya no mu na AWURADE wɔ; na ogya no akyi no ɛnne bɔkɔɔ bi a. Na ɛbaa sɛ Elia teeɛ no, ɔde ne ngusoɔ kataa n’anim, na ɔfiri kɔgyinaa ɔbodan no ano.
Na hwɛ, ɛnne bi baa ne nkyɛn sɛ: Elia, ɛdeɛn na wowɔ yɛ wɔ ha?
Na ɔse: Ninkunu na matwe mama AWURADE, asafo Nyankopɔn, sɛ Israelfoɔ agya w’apam: W’afɔrebukyia no, wɔadwiridwiri, na w’adiyifoɔ nso, wɔde nkrantɛ akum wɔn; na me nko na maka, na wɔrehwehwɛ me aku me.
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kɔ, sane si wo kwan so kɔ Damasko serɛ so; na sɛ woduru a, sra Hasael ngo si no Siria so hene; na Nimsi ba Yehu nso, sra no ngo si Israel so hene; na Safat ba Elisa a ɔfiri Abel-mehola no deɛ, sra no si w’ananmu sɛ odiyifoɔ.
Na deɛ ɔbɛfiri Hasael nkrantɛ ano no, Yehu bɛku no, na deɛ ɔbɛfiri Yehu nkrantɛ ano no, Elisa bɛku no.
Nanso mɛgya Israel mu nnipa mpemnson, nkotodwe a ɛnnya nkutoo Baal, ne ano a ɛnnya mfee n’ano.
Elisa frɛ Ɛnna ɔfirii hɔ kɔeɛ.
Na ɔkɔhunuu Safat ba Elisa sɛ ɔrefuntum; anantwie mpamho dummienu na ɛdi n’anim, na ɔno ne deɛ ɛtɔ so dummienu no na ɛrefuntum, na Elia sene baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔtoo ne ngusoɔ guu ne so.
Na ɔgyaa anantwie no hɔ, na ɔtuu mmirika dii Elia akyi kaa sɛ: Ma menkɔ kra m’agya ne me na, na memmɛdi w’akyi.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kɔ na bra, na ɛdeɛn na mayɛ woɔ yi?
Na ɔsane firii n’akyi kɔfaa anantwie mpamho no kumm wɔn, na ɔde anantwie no adwumayɛ nnua no noaa nam no, na ɔde maa nkurɔfoɔ no, na wɔdii; na ɔsɔre kɔdii Elia akyi, na ɔsom no.
Ahab di Siriafoɔ so nkonim mprenu Na Siriahene Ben-hadad boaboaa ne dɔm nyinaa ano, na ahemfo aduasa mmienu kaa ne ho, ne apɔnkɔ ne nteaseɛnam, na ɔforo ba bɛtuaa Samaria ne no koeɛ.
Na ɔsomaa abɔfoɔ maa wɔbaa Israelhene Ahab nkyɛn kuro no mu bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ Ben-hadad seɛ nie: Wo dwetɛ ne wo sika yɛ me dea, na wo yerenom ne wo mma a wɔn ho yɛ fɛ no nso, wɔyɛ me dea.
Na Israel hene buaa sɛ: W’asɛm no wom, me wura ɔhene, wo na me ne deɛ mewɔ nyinaa wɔ woɔ.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ no sane baa bio bɛkaa sɛ: Sɛ Ben-hadad seɛ nie: Sɛ mesoma maa wɔbaa wo nkyɛn sɛ: Wo dwetɛ ne wo sika ne wo yerenom ne wo mma, fa ma me no, sɛ ɔkyena sɛsɛberɛ nso mesoma me nkoa ma wɔaba wo nkyɛn abɛkyini wo fie ne wo nkoa afie mu, na adeɛ biara a ɛyɛ wɔn ani so fɛ no, wɔbɛfa akura wɔn nsam de akɔ.
Ɛnna Israel hene frɛɛ asase no so mpanimfoɔ nyinaa sɛ: Monhwɛ nhunu sɛ bɔne na oyi rehwehwɛ; na wasoma ama wɔaba me nkyɛn, me yerenom ne me mma ne me dwetɛ ne me sika ho, na mankame no.
Na mpanimfoɔ no nyinaa ne ɔman no nyinaa ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ntie, na mpene nso.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ Ben-hadad abɔfoɔ no sɛ: Monkɔka nkyerɛ me wura ɔhene sɛ: Deɛ wobisaa w’akoa kane no nyinaa deɛ, mɛyɛ, na asɛm yi deɛ, merentumi menyɛ.
Na abɔfoɔ no kɔ kɔka kyerɛɛ no.
Na Ben-hadad soma kɔsee no sɛ: Mede mmarima bebree bɛba abɛsɛe wo kuro no, na wɔasoa hɔ mfuturo wɔn nsamu akɔ.
Anyame no nkum me sɛ manyɛ a. Na Israel hene buaa sɛ: Monkɔka sɛ: Mma deɛ ɔhyɛ akodeɛ nnhoahoa ne ho sɛ deɛ ɔyie.
Na ɛbaa sɛ ɔtee asɛm yi no, na ɔne ahemfo no renom nsa asese mu, ɔka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa sɛ: Montoa kuro no!
Na wɔto hyɛɛ kuro no so.
Na hwɛ, odiyifoɔ bi twe pinii Israelhene Ahab sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Wohunu asafokuo kɛseɛ yi nyinaa?
Hwɛ, mede wɔn merehyɛ wo nsa nnɛ, na woahunu sɛ mene AWURADE.
Na Ahab kaa sɛ: Ɛnam hwan so?
Na ɔse: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Ɛnam amansini no mmapɔmma mmeranteɛ no so.
Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: Hwan na ɔmfa nkɔbɔ ani?
Na ɔse: Wo!
Ɛnna ɔkan amansini mmapɔmma no mmeranteɛ no, na wɔyɛ ahanu aduasa mmienu, na wɔn akyiri no, ɔkan ɔman no nyinaa, Israel mma nyinaa, mpemnson.
Na wɔfirii adi awigyina.
Na Ben-hadad anom nsa abo wɔ asese no mu, ɔno ne ahemfo aduasa mmienu a wɔboa no no.
Na amansini mmapɔmma no mmeranteɛ no firii adi kane.
Na Ben-hadad somaa adɔntenfoɔ, na wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Mmarima afiri adi afiri Samaria reba.
Na ɔse: Sɛ ɔmannwoeɛ so na wɔfirii adie a, monkye wɔn animono, na sɛ ɔko so nso na wɔfirii adie a, monkye wɔn animono.
Na wɔn deɛ, wɔfiri kuro no mu firii adi, amansini mmapɔmma no mmeranteɛ no ne dɔm a wɔdii wɔn akyire no.
Na wɔkumm wɔn mmaako mmaako, na Siriafoɔ dwanedwanee, na Israel tii wɔn, na Siriahene Ben-hadad tenaa ɔpɔnkɔ so ne apɔnkɔsotefoɔ firi dwanee.
Na Israel hene firii adi kɔ kyekyeree apɔnkɔ ne nteaseɛnam, na ɔde okunkɛseɛ kumm Siriafoɔ.
Na odiyifoɔ no twe pinii Israel hene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kɔ na kɔhyɛ wo ho den, na hwɛ na hunu deɛ wobɛyɛ; na afeda sɛsɛɛ no Siriafoɔ bɛforo aba wo so.
Na Siriahene nkoa ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wɔn nyame yɛ mmepɔ nyame, enti na wɔn ho yɛɛ den sene yɛn no; na sɛ yɛne wɔn koo asaseta so deɛ a, anka yɛn ho renyɛ den nsene wɔn anaa?
Na yei na yɛ: Tutu ahemfo no firi wɔn dibea, na fa amradofoɔ sisi wɔn ananmu.
Na wo deɛ, boaboa ɛdɔm bi ano sɛ ɛdɔm a woahwereɛ no, apɔnkɔ sɛ apɔnkɔ no, ne nteaseɛnam sɛ nteaseɛnam no, na yɛne wɔn nkɔko asaseta so, sɛ yɛn ho renyɛ den nsene wɔn anaa?
Na ɔtiee wɔn, na ɔyɛɛ saa.
Na afeda ɔpɛ berɛ mfitiaseɛ no mu, Ben-hadad boaboaa Siriafoɔ dɔm ano na ɔforo baa Afek sɛ ɔne Israel rebɛko.
Na wɔboaboaa Israelfoɔ nso ano, na wɔsiesiee wɔn ho, na wɔkɔ kɔhyiaa wɔn.
Na Israelfoɔ kyeree nsraban wɔn ntentensoɔ sɛ mmirekyie akuo nketewa mmienu.
Na Siriafoɔ deɛ, wɔyɛɛ asase no ma.
Na Nyankopɔn nipa no twe pinii bɛka kyerɛɛ Israel hene sɛ: Sɛdeɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Ɛsiane sɛ Siriafoɔ aka sɛ: Mmepɔ nyame ne AWURADE, na ɔnyɛ mmonhwa mu nyame nti, mede wɔn asafokuo kɛseɛ yi nyinaa bɛhyɛ wo nsa, na moahunu sɛ mene AWURADE.
Na wɔkyeree nsraban, yeinom wɔ yeinom ntentensoɔ, nnanson.
Na da a ɛtɔ so nson no, wɔde dɔm koo no kɔbɔɔ anim na Israelfoɔ no kumm Siriafoɔ anammɔnmufoɔ mpemha da koro.
Na nkaeɛ no dwanedwane kɔɔ Afek kuro no mu, na ɔfasuo no bu guu nnipa a wɔkaeɛ no mu mpem aduonu nson so.
Na Ben-hadad deɛ, ɔdwane kɔɔ kuro no mu firi pia mu kɔɔ pia mu.
Na ne nkoa ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, yɛate sɛ Israel fie ahemfo yɛ ahemfo a wɔyɛ adɔeɛ.
Ma yɛmfa ayitoma nkyekyere yɛn asene, na yɛmfa ntampehoma mmobɔ yɛn ti, na yɛmfiri nkɔ Israel hene nkyɛn; ebia ɔbɛgye wo kra nkwa.
Na wɔde ayitoma kyekyeree wɔn asene, na wɔde ntampehoma bobɔɔ wɔn ti, na wɔbaa Israel hene nkyɛn sɛ: W’akoa Ben-hadad se: Ma me kra nnya nkwa ɛ!
Na ɔbisaa sɛ: Ɔda so te ase?
Ɔyɛ me nua.
Afei na mmarima no rehwɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ anim kwan, na wɔyɛɛ ntɛm gyee asɛm no, na wɔkaa sɛ: Wo nua ne Ben-hadad.
Na ɔse: Monkɔfa no mmra!
Na Ben-hadad firi baa ne nkyɛn; na ɔmaa no foro baa teaseɛnam no mu.
Na Ben-hadad ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Nkuro a m’agya gyee no w’agya nsam no, mɛdane mama, na te mmorɔno nso Damasko fa, sɛdeɛ m’agya tee no Samaria no.
Na Ahab kaa sɛ: Me nso, mede apam bɛgya wo kwan.
Ɛnna ɔne no pameeɛ, na ɔgyaa no kwan.
Ɛnna ɔbarima bi a ɔfiri adiyifoɔ mma mu de AWURADE asɛm ka kyerɛɛ ne yɔnko sɛ: Bɔ me ɛ!
Na ɔbarima no ampene sɛ ɔbɔ no.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛsiane sɛ woantie AWURADE nti, hwɛ, wofiri me nkyɛn ha rekɔ ara pɛ a, gyata bɛku wo.
Na ɔfiri ne kyɛn kɔeɛ no, gyata hunuu no, na ɔkum no.
Na ɔhunuu ɔbarima foforɔ, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Bɔ me ɛ!
Na ɔbarima no bɔɔ no, ɔbɔɔ no piraa no.
Ɛnna odiyifoɔ no kɔ kɔgyinaa ɔkwan no ho twɛn ɔhene, na ɔde abotire akyekyere n’ani akyiri asakyera ne ho.
Na ɔhene retwam no, ɔbɔnee ɔhene no sɛ: W’akoa firi kɔɔ ɛko no mu, na hwɛ, ɔbarima bi manee de ɔbarima bi brɛɛ me sɛ: Hwɛ ɔbarima yi so, na sɛ ɔyera a, ɛnneɛ wode wo kra bɛsi ne kra ananmu, anaasɛ wobɛtua dwetɛ talente baako.
Na w’akoa reyɛ adeɛ foforɔ no, hwɛ, ɔdwanneeɛ hɔ.
Ɛnna Israel hene kaa sɛ: Sɛ w’atemmuo teɛ ne no, wo ara woabu.
Ɛnna ɔyɛɛ ntɛm yii abotire no firii n’ani akyire, na Israel hene no hunuu no sɛ ɔfiri adiyifoɔ no mu.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Ɛsiane sɛ woama onipa a mahyira no soɔ afiri wo nsa korɔ nti, wo kra bɛsi ne kra ananmu, na wo man asi ne man ananmu.
Ɛnna Israel hene no sii mu kɔɔ ne fie, a wakum n’anim na ne bo afuo, na ɔbaa Samaria.
Wɔdi Nabot awu Na Yesreelni Nabot wɔ bobe turo bi Yesreel wɔ Samariahene Ahab ahemfie ho.
Na Ahab ka kyerɛɛ Nabot sɛ: Fa wo bobe turo no ma me, na memfa menyɛ fan turo, ɛfiri sɛ ɛbɛn me fie ho, na mɛma wo bobe turo a ɛyɛ sene no ahyɛ ananmu, anaasɛ wopɛ a, mɛma wo ɛho sika.
Na Nabot ka kyerɛɛ Ahab sɛ: AWURADE mma yei mpare me, sɛ mede m’agyanom awunnyadeɛ bɛma woɔ.
Ɛnna Ahab kɔɔ ne fie a wakum n’anim na waboto, Yesreelni Nabot asɛm a ɔka kyerɛɛ no no nti; sɛ waka akyerɛ no sɛ: Meremfa m’agyanom awunnyadeɛ memma wo.
Na ɔdaa ne mpa so danee n’ani, na wannidi.
Na ne yere Isebel baa ne nkyɛn bɛbisaa no sɛ: Adɛn na wo honhom aboto sɛɛ na wonnidie yi?
Na ɔbuaa no sɛ: Ɛfiri sɛ me ne Yesreelni Nabot kasae, na mesee no sɛ: Fa wo bobeturo no ma me gye sika, anaasɛ nso sɛ wopɛ a, mɛma wo bobeturo ahyɛ ananmu.
Na ɔse: Meremfa me bobeturo no memma wo.
Ɛnna ne yere Isebel ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛnyɛ wo na wodi Israel soɔ?
Sɔre didi, na ma wo bo ntɔ wo yam, na mede Yesreelni Nabot bobeturo no bɛma wo.
Ɛnna ɔde Ahab din twerɛtwerɛɛ nwoma, na ɔde ne nsɔanodeɛ sosɔɔ ano, na ɔsomasoma maa wɔde nwoma no kɔmaa mpanimfoɔ ne adehyeɛ a wɔwɔ ne kurom a wɔne Nabot te mu no.
Na ɔtwerɛɛ nwoma no mu sɛ: Mompae mma wɔnni mmuada, na momfa Nabot ntena nkurɔfoɔ no ti.
Na momfa mmarima baanu a wɔyɛ mmahuhufoɔ nnyina n’anim, na wɔnni adanseɛ ntia no sɛ: Woadome Onyankopɔn ne ɔhene!
Na momfa no mfiri nkɔsi no aboɔ mma no nwu.
Ɛnna ne kuro no mufoɔ mpanimfoɔ ne adehyeɛ a wɔte ne kurom no yɛɛ sɛdeɛ Isebel kraa wɔn no, sɛdeɛ ɔtwerɛɛ nwoma a wɔde kɔmaa wɔn no mu no: Wɔpaee sɛ wɔnni mmuada, na wɔde Nabot tenaa nkurɔfoɔ no ti.
Na mmarima mmahuhufoɔ baanu ba bɛtenaa n’anim, na mmarima ahuhufoɔ no dii adanseɛ tiaa Nabot ɔman no anim sɛ: Nabot adome Onyankopɔn ne ɔhene.
Na wɔyii no firi kɔɔ kuro no akyi kɔsii no aboɔ maa no wui.
Ɛnna wɔsoma maa wɔkɔɔ Isebel nkyɛn sɛ: Wɔasi Nabot aboɔ, na wawu.
Na Isebel tee sɛ wɔasi Nabot aboɔ na wawuo no, Isebel ka kyerɛɛ Ahab sɛ: Sɔre kɔfa Yesreelni Nabot bobeturo a ɔmpɛ sɛ ɔde ma wo gye sika no di so, ɛfiri sɛ Nabot nte ase bio, na wawu.
Na ɛbaa sɛ Ahab tee sɛ Nabot awuo no, Ahab sɔree sɛ ɔresiane akɔ Yesreelni Nabot bobeturo no mu akɔfa adi so.
Elia hyɛ asotwe ho nkɔm Ɛnna AWURADE asɛm baa Tisbini Elia nkyɛn sɛ: Sɔre siane kɔhyia Israelhene Ahab a ɔwɔ Samaria no.
Hwɛ, ɔwɔ Nabot bobeturo a wasiane kɔ hɔ sɛ ɔrekɔfa adi soɔ no mu; na ka kyerɛ no sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Woadi awu, na woafa obi adeɛ adi so?
Na ka kyerɛ no sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Faako a akraman taferee Nabot mogya no, ɛhɔ na akraman bɛtafere wo nso wo mogya.
Na Ahab ka kyerɛɛ Elia sɛ: Woahu me, me tamfo?
Na ɔse: Mahu wo, ɛfiri sɛ woatɔn wo ho ayɛ deɛ ɛyɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne.
Hwɛ, mede bɔne bɛba wo so; mɛpra wo akɔ na matwa Ahab babarima biara wɔ Israel mu, akoa anaa ɔdehyeɛ atwene.
Na mɛyɛ wo fie sɛ Nebat ba Yeroboam fie ne Ahia ba Baasa fie, huru a woahuru me bo na woama Israel ayɛ bɔne nti.
Na Isebel nso, AWURADE kaa ne ho asɛm sɛ: Akraman bɛwe Isebel nam, Yesreel fasuo ho.
Ahab fie mu nipa a ɔbɛwu kuro mu no, akraman na ɛbɛwe ne nam, na deɛ ɔbɛwu wiram no, ewiem nnomaa na ɛbɛdi ne nam.
Na Ahab tee nsɛm yi no, ɔsunsuanee ne ntadeɛ mu, na ɔde ayitoma firaeɛ, na ɔdii abuada, na ɔdaa ayitoma no mu, na n’anim yɛɛ samoo.
Na AWURADE asɛm baa Tisbini Elia nkyɛn sɛ: Woahunu sɛ Ahab abrɛ ne ho ase m’anim?
Ɛsiane sɛ wabrɛ ne ho ase m’anim nti, meremfa bɔne no memma ne berɛ so.
Ne ba berɛ so, na mede bɔne no bɛba ne fie soɔ.
Ahab ne Yehosafat ko tia Siriafoɔ Na Siria ne Israel tenaa hɔ mfeɛ mmiɛnsa a ɔko bi nni wɔn ntam.
Na afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu no Yudahene Yehosafat siane baa Israel hene nkyɛn.
Na Israel hene ka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa sɛ: Monnim sɛ Ramot-gilead wɔ yɛn, na yɛn deɛ yɛte hɔ komm na yɛnnye mfiri Siriahene nsam?
Na ɔbisaa Yehosafat sɛ: Wo ne me bɛkɔ Ramot-gilead sa anaa?
Na Yehosafat buaa Israel hene no sɛ: Mete sɛ wo, me man te sɛ wo man, m’apɔnkɔ te sɛ w’apɔnkɔ.
Na Yehosafat ka kyerɛɛ Israel hene sɛ: Bisa AWURADE asɛm nnɛ ɛ!
Ɛnna Israel hene boaboaa adiyifoɔ no ano, wɔbɛyɛ mmarima ahanan, na ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: Menkɔ Ramot-gilead menkɔko anaasɛ mennyae?
Na wɔkaa sɛ: Foro kɔ, na AWURADE de bɛhyɛ ɔhene nsa.
Ɛnna Yehosafat bisaa sɛ: AWURADE diyifoɔ biara nni ha bio a yɛbɛbisa ne hɔ adeɛ anaa?
Na Israel hene ka kyerɛɛ Yehosafat sɛ: Ɔbarima baako bi da so wɔ hɔ a anka yɛbɛtumi abisa AWURADE afiri ne nkyɛn, nanso metane no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔnhyɛ me ho nkɔm pa, sɛ bɔne nko, ɛyɛ Imla ba Mikaia.
Na Yehosafat se: Mma ɔhene nnka saa.
Ɛnna Israel hene frɛɛ gyaaseni bi, na ɔkaa sɛ: Ma Imla ba Mikaia nnuru ha ntɛm!
Na Israel hene ne Yudahene Yehosafat tete wɔn nhennwa so hyehyɛ wɔn ntadeɛ, Samaria pono ano mpraeɛ so, na adiyifoɔ no nyinaa hyehyɛɛ nkɔm wɔn anim.
Na Kenaana ba Sedekia ayɛ dadeɛ mmɛn na ɔkaa sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Yeinom na wode bɛsum Siriafoɔ de kɔsi sɛ wɔbɛwie wɔn sɛeɛ.
Na adiyifoɔ no nyinaa hyehyɛɛ nkɔm saa sɛ: Kɔ Ramot-gilead na kɔdi siadeɛ, na AWURADE de ahyɛ ɔhene nsa.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔkɔfrɛɛ Mikaia no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, adiyifoɔ no nyinaa de ano korɔ ka asɛmpa kyerɛ ɔhene, ma wo nsɛm nyɛ sɛ wɔn mu baako deɛ, na ka deɛ ɛyɛ!
Na Mikaia kaa sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE te aseɛ yi, deɛ AWURADE bɛka akyerɛ me no, ɛno na mɛka.
Mikaia hyɛ nkoguo ho nkɔm Ɛnna ɔbaa ɔhene nkyɛn.
Na ɔhene no bisaa no sɛ: Mikaia, yɛnkɔ Ramot-gilead nkɔko anaasɛ yɛnnyae?
Na ɔbuaa no sɛ: Kɔ na kɔdi nim, na AWURADE de ahyɛ ɔhene nsa.
Na ɔhene no bisaa no sɛ: Mprɛ ahe ara na menka wo ntam sɛ, nka me asɛm bi sɛ nokorɛ nko AWURADE din mu?
Na ɔse: Mahunu Israel nyinaa sɛ wɔahwete mmepɔ soɔ sɛ nnwan a wɔnni hwɛfoɔ, na AWURADE se: Yeinom nni wura, ma wɔnsane nkɔ wɔn afie asomdwoeɛ mu.
Na Israel hene ka kyerɛɛ Yehosafat sɛ: Manka mankyerɛ wo sɛ ɔrenhyɛ me ho nkɔm pa biara, na mmom bɔne?
Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: Enti tie AWURADE asɛm: Mahunu AWURADE sɛ ɔte n’adwa soɔ, na ɔsoro asafo nyinaa gyinagyina ne ho, ne nifa ne ne benkum.
Na AWURADE kaa sɛ: Hwan na ɔbɛdaadaa Ahab na waforo akɔtɔ wɔ Ramot-gilead?
Na oyi kaa sɛɛ, na oyi kaa sɛɛ.
Na honhom bi firi bɛgyinaa AWURADE anim kaa sɛ: Me na mɛdaadaa no.
Na AWURADE bisaa no sɛ: Wode deɛn?
Na ɔse: Mɛfiri makɔyɛ atorɔ honhom n’adiyifoɔ nyinaa anomu.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Wobɛdaadaa no na wobɛtumi nso; firi kɔ na kɔyɛ saa.
Na afei, hwɛ, AWURADE de honhom torofoɔ ahyɛ w’adiyifoɔ yi nyinaa anomu, na AWURADE aka wo ho bɔne.
Ɛnna Kenaana ba Sedekia twe pini bɛbɔɔ Mikaia sotorɔ kaa sɛ: Ɛhe na AWURADE honhom nam firii me nkyɛn kɔ kasa kyerɛɛ woɔ yi?
Na Mikaia se: Hwɛ, da a wobɛfiri pia mu akɔ pia mu akɔhunta no na wobɛhunu.
Ɛnna Israel hene kaa sɛ: Kyere Mikaia, na fa no kɔ kuro no so hwɛfoɔ Amon ne ɔhene ba Yoas nkyɛn, na kɔka sɛ: Sɛ ɔhene seɛ nie: Momfa oyi nto nneduadan mu, na momma no ahohiahia aduane nni ne ahohiahia nsuo nnom kɔsi sɛ mɛba no dwoodwoo.
Na Mikaia kaa sɛ: Sɛ wosane ba dwoodwoo a, ɛnneɛ na ɛnyɛ AWURADE na ɔnam me so kasaeɛ.
Na ɔse: Mo aman nyinaa, montie!
Ahab wuo Na Israel hene ne Yudahene Yehosafat foro kɔɔ Ramot-gilead.
Na Israel hene ka kyerɛɛ Yehosafat sɛ: Mɛsakyera me ho na makɔ ɔko no ano, na wo deɛ, hyɛ wo ntadeɛ.
Na Israel hene no sakyeraa ne ho, na ɔkɔɔ ko no ano.
Nso na Siriahene no ahyɛ ne nteaseɛnam a ɔwɔ no so asafohene aduasa mmienu no sɛ: Ma monne akumaa anaa ɔkɛseɛ nnko, gye Israel hene no nko.
Na nteaseɛnam so asafohene no hunuu Yehosafat no, wɔkaa sɛ: Ampa, Israel hene no nie!
Na wɔmane ne no kɔkoe.
Na Yehosafat teaa mu.
Na nteaseɛnam so asafohene no hunuu sɛ ɛnyɛ Israel hene ne no no, wɔsane firii n’akyi.
Na ɔbarima bi twee ne tadua mu anibiannasoɔ so, na ɔde saa Israel hene no mmɔtoam ne nkataboɔ no ntam.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne teaseɛnamkafoɔ no sɛ: Dane wo ho fa me firi ɛdɔm yi mu, na mapira.
Na ɔko no mu yɛɛ den da no.
Na wɔkura ɔhene no mu maa no gyinaa teaseɛnam no mu Siriafoɔ no anim ara, na ɔwuu anwummerɛ.
Na apirakuro no mu mogya sene guu teaseɛnam no mu.
Na wɔpae faa nsraban no mu owiatɔ berɛ sɛ: Obiara nkɔ ne kurom ne n’asase so.
Na ɔhene no wui, na wɔde no baa Samaria; na wɔsiee ɔhene no Samaria.
Na wɔkɔhohoroo teaseɛnam no mu wɔ Samaria tareɛ mu, na akraman bɛtaferee ne mogya, na mmaa nnwamamfoɔ nso dwaree mu, sɛ AWURADE asɛm a ɔkaeɛ no teɛ no.
Na Ahab ho nsɛm nkaeɛ, ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa ne asonse dan a ɔsiiɛ, ne nkuro a ɔkyekyereeɛ nyinaa, wɔantwerɛ no Israel ahemfo berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu anaa?
Na Ahab toaa n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na ne ba Ahasia bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Yehosafat di Yuda so hene Na Israelhene Ahab afe a ɛtɔ so nnan mu na Asa ba Yehosafat bɛdii Yuda so hene.
Yehosafat bɛdii hene no, na wadi mfirinhyia aduasa nnum, na ɔdii hene mfirinhyia aduonu nnum wɔ Yerusalem.
Na ne na din de Asuba a ɔyɛ Silhi ba.
Na ɔfaa n’agya Asa kwan nyinaa so, wammane amfiri ho, na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so; gye sorɔnsorɔmmea no na wɔanyiyie, ɔman no kɔɔ so bɔɔ afɔdeɛ na wɔhyee aduhwam sorɔnsorɔmmea hɔ.
Na asomdwoeɛ bɛdaa Yehosafat ne Israel hene ntam.
Na Yehosafat ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne ne mmaninneɛ a ɔyɛeɛ ne sɛdeɛ ɔdii ako no, wɔantwerɛ no Yuda ahemfo berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu anaa?
Na mmarima nnwamamfoɔ nkaeɛ a wɔgyaa wɔn n’agya Asa nna mu no, ɔhyee wɔn ase firii asase no so.
Na ɔhene bi nni Edom; na ɔhene abadiakyire na na ɔhwɛ akyire sɛ ɔhene; Yehosafat yɛɛ Tarsis ahyɛn sɛ ɛnkɔ Ofir na ɛnkɔpɛ sika kɔkɔɔ, nanso ankɔ, ɛfiri sɛ ahyɛn no bobɔe wɔ Esion-geber.
Ɛno mu na Ahab ba Ahasia ka kyerɛɛ Yehosafat sɛ: Ma me nkoa ne wo nkoa nkɔ ahyɛn no mu.
Na Yehosafat ampene.
Na Yehosafat toaa n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no kaa n’agyanom ho, n’agya Dawid kuro mu; na ne ba Yehoram bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Ahasia di Israel so hene Ahab ba Ahasia bɛdii Israel so hene Samaria, Yudahene Yehosafat afe a ɛtɔ so dunson mu, na ɔdii Israel so mfeɛ mmienu.
Na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛyɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, na ɔfaa n’agya kwan so, ne ne na kwan so, ne Nebat ba Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no kwan so; na ɔsomm Baal na ɔsɔree no, na ɔhuruu AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn bo, sɛdeɛ n’agya yɛeɛ no ara.
NHYƐNMU Ahemfo Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mmienu no toa Israelfoɔ ahemman mmienu no ho abakɔsɛm a ɛfirii aseɛ wɔ Ahemfo Nwoma a ɛdi kan mu no so.
Wɔkyɛ nwoma no mu mmienu: Ɔfa a ɛdi kan no ka ahemman mmienu no ho abakɔsɛm a ɛfiri mfeɛ ahankron a ɛdi Kristo awoɔ anim no mfimfini de kɔsi Samaria asehweɛ no mu ne atifi ahemman no awieeɛ wɔ mfeɛ ahanson aduonu baako a ɛdi Kristo awoɔ anim no mu no ho asɛm.
Ɔfa a ɛtɔ so mmienu no ka Yuda ahemman no ho abakɔsɛm.
Ɛfiri aseɛ wɔ Israel asehweɛ no de kɔsi berɛ a Babelhene Nebukadnessar kɔtuaa Yerusalem sɛee no wɔ mfeɛ ahanum aduɔwɔtwe nsia a ɛdi Kristo awoɔ anim no mu.
Wɔde Gedalia a na ɔyɛ amrado wɔ berɛ a na Yerusalem hyɛ Babelfoɔ aseɛ no ne asɛm a ɛfa Ɔhene Yehoiakyin a ɔfiri Yuda no gyae a wɔgyae no firii afiase wɔ Babel no na ewie.
Nokorɛ a Israel ne Yuda ahemfo ne wɔn manfoɔ annie nti na atoyerɛnkyɛm ahodoɔ yi totoo wɔn.
Yerusalem sɛeɛ ne Yudafoɔ bebree a wɔfaa wɔn kɔɔ nnommum mu no yɛ asɛm kɛseɛ wɔ Israel abakɔsɛm mu.
Odiyifoɔ a ɔdi akotene wɔ Ahemfo Nwoma a ɛtɔ so mmienu no mu ne Odiyifoɔ Elisa a ɔbɛdii Odiyifoɔ Elia adeɛ no.
EMU NSƐM Ahemman no mu kyɛɛ mmienu .—.
.
Odiyifoɔ Elisa .—.
.
Yuda ne Israel ahemfo .—.
.
Samaria asehweɛ .- Yuda ahemman .—.
.
Ɛfiri Hesekia berɛ so de kɔsi Yosia berɛ so .—.
.
Yosia ahennie .—.
.
Yuda ahemfo a wɔtwa toɔ .—.
.
Yerusalem ase hweɛ .-
Ɔhene Ahasia adebisa Na Ahab wuo akyiri no Moab tee Israel so atua.
Na Ahasia firii n’abansoro dan a ɛwɔ Samaria no mpomma mu te hwee fam, na ɔyaree; na ɔsomaa abɔfoɔ, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monkɔ nkɔbisa Ekron nyame Baalsebub, sɛ mɛnya yadeɛ yi mu nkwa anaa?
Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ ka kyerɛɛ Tisbini Elia sɛ: Sɔre foro kɔhyia Samariahene abɔfoɔ no, na bisa wɔn sɛ: Onyankopɔn bi nni Israel nti na morekɔ akɔbisa Ekron nyame Baalsebub hɔ adeɛ yi anaa?
Enti AWURADE se: Mpa a woaforɔ no, woremfiri so nsiane, na wuo na wobɛwuo!
Na Elia kɔeɛ.
Ɛnna abɔfoɔ no sane baa ne nkyɛn, na ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: Adɛn na moasane aba yi?
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɔbarima bi foro bɛhyiaa yɛn, na ɔka kyerɛɛ yɛn sɛ: Monsane nkɔ ɔhene a ɔsomaa mo no nkyɛn nkɔka nkyerɛ no sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Aso onyame bi nni Israel nti na woasoma rekɔ Ekron nyame Baalsebub hɔ adebisa yi?
Yei nti, mpa a woaforɔ no, woremfiri so nsiane, na wuo na wobɛwuo.
Na ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: Ɔbarima a ɔforo ba bɛhyiaa mo na ɔkaa mo nsɛm yi no te sɛn?
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Atadeɛ a ɔhyɛ no yɛ aboa nwi, na nwoma abɔsoɔ bɔ n’asene.
Na ɔse: Ɛyɛ Tisbini Elia.
Elia ne asafohene baasa no Na ɔsomaa aduonum so safohene ne n’aduonum no kɔɔ ne nkyɛn.
Na ɔforo kɔɔ Elia nkyɛn, na hwɛ, na ɔte bepɔ no atifi.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Nyankopɔn nipa, ɔhene se: Siane bra.
Na Elia bua see aduonum so safohene no sɛ: Sɛ Nyankopɔn nipa ne me a, ogya mfiri soro nsiane mmɛhye wo ne w’aduonum no!
Na ogya firi soro ba bɛhyee ɔno ne n’aduonum no.
Na ɔsane somaa aduonum so safohene foforɔ ne n’aduonum no kɔɔ ne nkyɛn.
Na ɔsee no sɛ, Nyankopɔn nipa, ɔhene ahyɛ sɛ: Yɛ ntɛm siane bra.
Na Elia bua see wɔn sɛ: Sɛ Nyankopɔn nipa ne me a, ogya mfiri soro nsiane mmɛhye wo ne w’aduonum!
Na Nyankopɔn gya firi soro ba bɛhyee ɔno ne n’aduonum no.
Na ɔhene somaa aduonum so safohene a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa ne n’aduonum.
Na aduonum so safohene a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa no foro kɔe, na ɔkɔkotoo ne nankoroma anim Elia anim, na ɔpaa no kyɛw sɛ: Nyankopɔn nipa, ma me kra ne wo nkoa aduonum yi kra boɔ nyɛ den w’ani so.
Hwɛ, ogya afiri ɔsoro aduru abɛhye akane aduonum so asafohene baanu no ne wɔn aduonum aduonum no, na afei ma me kra boɔ nyɛ den w’ani so.
Ɛnna AWURADE bɔfoɔ ka kyerɛɛ Elia sɛ: Ɛne no nsiane nkɔ, nsuro n’anim.
Na ɔsɔree ne no siane kɔɔ ɔhene no nkyɛn.
Ahasia wuo Na Elia ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene no sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Ɛsiane sɛ woasoma abɔfoɔ sɛ wɔnkɔbisa Ekron nyame Baalsebub hɔ adeɛ, sɛdeɛ onyame bi nni Israel a wɔkɔbisa no asɛm nti, mpa a woaforɔ no, woremfiri so nsiane, na wuo na wobɛwuo.
Na ɔwui, sɛ AWURADE asɛm a Elia kaeɛ no teɛ.
Na Yehoram sii n’ananmu dii hene, Yudahene Yehosafat ba Yehoram afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu so, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔnni ɔbabarima.
Na Ahasia ho nsɛm nkaeɛ, deɛ ɔyɛeɛ no, wɔntwerɛɛ no Israel Ahemfo Berɛsosɛm Nwoma no mu anaa?
Elia sorokorɔ Na ɛbaa sɛ, AWURADE rebɛfa Elia ahum mu akɔ ɔsoro no, na Elia ne Elisa firi Gilgal rekɔ.
Na Elia ka kyerɛɛ Elisa sɛ: Mesrɛ wo tena ha ɛ, na AWURADE asoma me Betel.
Na Elisa kaa sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE te aseɛ na wo kra te aseɛ yi, merennya wo hɔ.
Na wɔsii mu kɔɔ Betel.
Na adiyifoɔ mma a wɔwɔ Betel no firii adi baa Elisa nkyɛn bɛbisaa no sɛ: Wonim sɛ ɛnnɛ AWURADE rebɛfa wo wura afiri wo nkyɛn akɔ?
Na ɔse: Aane, me nso menim; monyɛ komm!
Na Elia ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Elisa, tena ha ɛ, na AWURADE asoma me Yeriko.
Na ɔse: Sɛ AWURADE te aseɛ na wo kra te aseɛ yi, merennya wo hɔ.
Na wɔkɔɔ Yeriko.
Na adiyifoɔ mma a wɔwɔ Yeriko no twe baa Elisa nkyɛn bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wonim sɛ ɛnnɛ AWURADE bɛfa wo wura afiri wo nkyɛn?
Na ɔse: Aane, me nso menim; monyɛ komm!
Na Elia ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Tena ha ɛ, AWURADE asoma me Yordan ano.
Na ɔse: Sɛ AWURADE te aseɛ na wo kra te aseɛ yi, merennya wo hɔ.
Na wɔn baanu no kɔe.
Na adiyifoɔ mma no mu aduonum kɔ kɔgyinagyinaa wɔn ntentensoɔ akyirikyiri, na wɔn baanu no gyinaa Yordan ano.
Na Elia faa ne ngusoɔ bobɔ de bɔɔ nsuo no mu, na ɛpae kɔɔ ha ne ha, na wɔn baanu no nam asase pɛsɛɛ so twae.
Na ɛbaa sɛ wɔtwaeɛ no, Elia ka kyerɛɛ Elisa sɛ: Bisa deɛ menyɛ mma woɔ ansa na wɔafa me afiri wo nkyɛn akɔ.
Na Elisa kaa sɛ: Ma wo honhom abupɛn mmienu mmra me so.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Woabisa adeɛ a ɛyɛ den; sɛ wohu me sɛ wɔrefa me afiri wo nkyɛn a, ɛbɛyɛ saa ama wo; na sɛ anyɛ saa a, ɛrenyɛ.
Na ɛbaa sɛ, wɔnam rekorɔ na wɔrekasa no, hwɛ, ogya teaseɛnam ne ogya apɔnkɔ ba bɛpaee wɔn baanu no ntam, na Elia faa ahum mu foro kɔɔ ɔsoro.
Na Elisa hwɛe na ɔteaa mu sɛ: M’agya, m’agya!
Israel teaseɛnam ne n’apɔnkɔsotefoɔ na ɔrekorɔ no!
Na wanhu no bio.
Na ɔsɔɔ n’atadeɛ mu suanee mu mmienu.
Na ɔmaa Elia ngusoɔ a ɛfiri ne ho guiɛ no so, na ɔsane bɛgyinaa Yordan ano.
Na ɔde Elia ngusoɔ a ɛfiri ne ho guiɛ no bɔɔ nsuo no mu kaa sɛ: Ɛhe na AWURADE, Elia Nyankopɔn no ara wɔ?
Na ɔbɔɔ nsuo no mu, na ɛpae kɔɔ ha ne ha, na Elisa twae.
Na adiyifoɔ mma a wɔwɔ Yeriko a wɔwɔ ntentensoɔ no hunuu no, na wɔkaa sɛ: Elia honhom abɛsi Elisa so.
Na wɔba bɛhyiaa no, na wɔkotoo no butuu fam.
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, mmarima aduonum a wɔn ho yɛ den wɔ wo nkoa mu, ma wɔnkɔ nkɔhwehwɛ wo wura; na ebia sɛsɛɛ AWURADE honhom ama ne so kɔ de no akɔto mmepɔ no bi so, anaa mmonhwa no bi mu.
Na ɔse: Monnsoma!
Na wɔhyɛɛ no ara maa no yɛɛ no ahometeɛ no, ɔkaa sɛ: Monsoma!
Na wɔsomaa mmarima aduonum, na wɔkɔhwehwɛ no nnansa, nanso wɔanhu no.
Na wɔsane baa ne nkyɛn berɛ a ɔretwɛn wɔ Yeriko.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Manka mankyerɛ mo sɛ monnkɔ anaa?
Elisa yɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ Na kuro no mufoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ Elisa sɛ: Hwɛ, kuro yi dabea yɛ fɛ, sɛdeɛ me wura hunu yi; nanso nsuo no nyɛ, na asase no nso awu.
Na ɔse: Mommrɛ me ayowa foforɔ, na momfa nkyene ngu mu.
Na wɔde brɛɛ no.
Na ɔfirii adi kɔɔ nsuo aniwa no ho, na ɔkɔhwiee nkyene no guu mu hɔ, na ɔkaa sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Masa nsuo yi yadeɛ, owuo anaa apɔn biara remfiri mu hɔ mma bio.
Na nsuo no yɛɛ yie de bɛsi nnɛ da yi, sɛdeɛ Elisa kaeɛ no.
Na ɔfirii hɔ foro kɔɔ Betel; na ɔreforo akɔ ɔkwan no soɔ no, mmɔfra nketewa bi firii kuro no mu ba bɛgoroo ne ho ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Atipa, foro bra ɛ, atipa, foro bra ɛ!
Ɛnna ɔdanee ne ho, na ɔhunuu wɔn no, ɔde AWURADE din domee wɔn.
