Na asisirebereɛ mmienu firi kwaeɛ no mu ba bɛtetee wɔn mu mmɔfra aduanan mmienu.
Na ɔfiri hɔ kɔɔ Bepɔ Karmel ho, na ɔfirii hɔ nso sane baa Samaria.
Yehoram ne Yehosafat ko tia Moab Na Ahab ba Yehoram bɛdii Israel so hene Samaria, Yudahene Yehosafat afe a ɛtɔ so dunwɔtwe so; na ɔdii hene mfeɛ dummienu.
Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne deɛ, nanso na ɛnte sɛ n’agya ne ne na deɛ no; na ɔyii Baal honi a n’agya yɛeɛ no hɔ.
Nanso ɔbataa Nebat ba Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no bɔne ho, na wansane amfiri ho.
Na Moabhene Mesa yɛ nnwanyɛnfoɔ, na ɔmaa Israel hene nnwanten mma mpemha ne adwennini mpemha ho nwi.
Na Ahab wuiɛ no, Moabhene tee Israel hene anim atua.
Na Ɔhene Yehoram firii Samaria da no ara, na ɔkɔkanee Israel nyinaa.
Na ɔkɔe, na ɔsoma ma wɔkɔɔ Yudahene Yehosafat nkyɛn sɛ: Moabhene ate m’anim atua, na wo ne me bɛkɔ ne Moab akɔko anaa?
Na ɔse: Mɛkɔ, mete sɛ wo, me man te sɛ wo man, m’apɔnkɔ te sɛ w’apɔnkɔ.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Ɔkwan bɛn so na yɛbɛfa akorɔ?
Na ɔse: Edom serɛ so kwan no.
Ɛnna Israel hene, Yuda hene ne Edomhene sii mu kɔeɛ; na wɔtwaa nnanson kwan, na nsuo nni hɔ mma dɔm no ne mmoa a wɔdi wɔn akyire.
Na Israel hene kaa sɛ: Ao, AWURADE afrɛ ahemfo baasa yi ahyia sɛ wɔde wɔn rekɔhyɛ Moab nsa.
Na Yehosafat se: AWURADE diyifoɔ bi nni ha a yɛbɛkɔ ne nkyɛn akɔbisa AWURADE?
Na Israel hene nkoa mu baako buaa sɛ: Ɛha na Safat ba Elisa a ɔhwiee nsuo guu Elia nsa soɔ no wɔ.
Na Yehosafat kaa sɛ: Ampa, ɔyɛ AWURADE diyifoɔ kɛseɛ.
Ɛnna Israel hene ne Yehosafat ne Edomhene siane kɔɔ ne nkyɛn.
Na Elisa ka kyerɛɛ Israel hene no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na me ne wo wɔ yɛ?
Kɔ w’agya adiyifoɔ ne wo na adiyifoɔ no nkyɛn!
Na Israel hene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Dabi, na AWURADE afrɛ ahemfo baasa yi ahyia sɛ ɔde wɔn rekɔhyɛ Moab nsa.
Na Elisa kaa sɛ: Sɛ asafo AWURADE a megyina n’anim te aseɛ yi, sɛ ɛnyɛ Yudahene Yehosafat anim na mehwɛ a, anka merenhwɛ wo na mahu wo.
Na afei momfa sankubɔni mmrɛ me.
Na sankubɔni no rebɔ no, AWURADE nsa baa ne so, na ɔkaa sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Mɛma nsuo ahyɛ amena a emu aweɛ yi ma.
Na sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Morenhunu mframa na morenhunu osuo, nanso nsuo bɛyɛ bonhwa yi ma; na moanom, mo ne mo nantwikuo ne mo mmoa.
Na yei nso yɛ mmrɛ wɔ AWURADE ani so, na ɔbɛyi Moab nso ahyɛ mo nsa.
Na mobɛbubu wɔn nkuro akɛseɛ ho afasuo, na moafa nkuro a ɛyɛ fɛ nyinaa, na moabubu wɔn nkuro akɛseɛ nyinaa, na moasisi nsuo aniwa nyinaa, na mode aboɔ asɛe mfu pa nyinaa.
Na anɔpa a wɔrebɔ aduane afɔdeɛ no, hwɛ, nsuo firii Edom kwan so bae, na nsuo no yɛɛ asase no ma.
Na Moabfoɔ nyinaa tee sɛ ahemfo no reforo aba ne wɔn abɛko no, wɔfrɛfrɛɛ wɔn a wɔbɛtumi amia amiadeɛ nyinaa, ɛfiri mmɔfra so de kɔsi mpanimfoɔ so, na wɔbɛgyinaa ɛhyeɛ so.
Na wɔsɔree anɔpatutu a owia repue nsuo no soɔ no, Moabfoɔ hunuu nsuo no agya nohoa sɛ ɛbere sɛ mogya, na wɔkaa sɛ: Mogya nie!
Ahemfo no ne wɔn ho adi nnɔmmata akunkum wɔn ho, na afei, Moabfoɔ, monkɔfa asadeɛ!
Na wɔbaa Israel nsraban mu no, Israel sɔre kunkumm Moabfoɔ, na wɔdwanee wɔn anim, na wɔtaa wɔn kɔkunkumm Moabfoɔ.
Na nkuro no, wɔdwirii, na mfu pa nyinaa, wɔtotoo aboɔ guguu so mmaako mmaako kɔsii sɛ ɛso kataeɛ, na wɔsisii nsuo aniwa nyinaa, na wɔbubuu nnua pa nyinaa; gye Kir-haraset na wɔgyaa n’aboɔ, na ntɔmmoɔtofoɔ kɔtwaa ho hyiae bɔɔ no.
Na Moabhene hunuu sɛ ɛdɔm no ano ayɛ den papa ama no no, ɔfaa mmarima ahanson a wɔtwe nkrantɛ kaa ne ho, sɛ ɔrete mu akɔ Edomhene ho, nanso wɔantumi.
Ɛnna ɔfaa n’abakan a anka ɔbɛsi n’ananmu adi hene no, na ɔde no bɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ɔfasuo no so.
Na abufuo kɛseɛ baa Israel mu, na wɔfirii ne ho sane baa wɔn asase so.
Elisa ne ɔbaa kunafoɔ no Na adiyifoɔ mma no mu baako yere teaa mu ka kyerɛɛ Elisa sɛ: W’akoa, me kunu, awu, na wo ara wonim sɛ na w’akoa suro AWURADE; na ɔkafoɔ aba rebɛfa me mma baanu akɔyɛ ne nkoa.
Na Elisa bisaa no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na menyɛ memma woɔ?
Kyerɛ me ɛ, ɛdeɛn na wowɔ wɔ efie?
Na ɔbuaa sɛ: W’afenaa nni hwee fie, gye ngo ahina baako pɛ.
Na Elisa kaa sɛ: Firi adi kɔfemfɛm nhina wɔ wɔn a wɔtete bɛn woɔ nyinaa nkyɛn, nhina hunu, ma no nnɔɔso.
Na sɛ woba mu a, to wo ne wo mma no pono mu, na hwiehwie gu nhina no nyinaa mu, na fa deɛ ayɛ ma no sisi nkyɛn.
Na ɔfirii ne nkyɛn kɔe, na ɔkɔtoo ne ho ne ne mma pono mu.
Wɔn deɛ, wɔde nhina no brɛɛ no, na ɔno nso hwiehwie guguu mu.
Na ɛbaa sɛ nhina no yeyɛɛ amaama no, ɔka kyerɛɛ ne ba sɛ: Fa ahina bi brɛ me bio!
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ahina biara nni hɔ bio; na ngo no twae.
Ɛnna ɔba bɛka kyerɛɛ Nyankopɔn nipa no.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Kɔ na kɔtɔn ngo no, na fa tua wo ka, na wo ne wo mma nni deɛ aka no ntena ase.
Elisa ne Sunemni baa bi Na da bi Elisa sene kɔɔ Sunem.
Na ɔbaa ɔdefoɔ bi wɔ hɔ a ɔhyɛɛ no ma ɔdidiiɛ.
Na daa ɔretwam a, ɔmane hɔ kɔdidi.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne kunu sɛ: Hwɛ, mahunu sɛ Nyankopɔn nipa kronkron ne oyi a ɔbɛsene yɛn nkyɛn daa yi; ma yɛnyɛ abansoro fasuo mu pia ketewa bi, na yɛmfa mpadua, ɛpono, adwa ne kaneadua nsisi hɔ mma no, na sɛ ɔba yɛn nkyɛn a, wamane akɔ hɔ.
Na da bi ɔbaa hɔ, na ɔmane kɔɔ abansoro pia no mu kɔdaa hɔ.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’abɔfra Gehasi sɛ: Kɔfrɛ Sunemni no bra!
Na ɔkɔfrɛɛ no bae, na ɔbɛgyinaa n’anim.
Na Elisa ka kyerɛɛ Gehasi sɛ: Bisa no sɛ: Hwɛ, wode ɔhaw yi nyinaa aha wo ho ama yɛn: Ɛdeɛn na yɛnyɛ mma woɔ?
Wowɔ asɛm bi a wɔnkɔka nkyerɛ ɔhene anaa ɔsafohene?
Na ɔse: Me deɛ, mete me nkurɔfoɔ mu.
Na ɔbisaa sɛ: Gehasi, ɛdeɛn na wɔnyɛ mma no?
Na Gehasi kaa sɛ: Ampa, ɔnni ba, na ne kunu nso anyini.
Na Elisa kaa sɛ: Frɛ no!
Na ɔfrɛɛ no, na ɔbɛgyinaa ɛpono ano.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Afeda sɛsɛberɛ yi mu no, wobɛwo ɔba.
Na ɔse: Nyɛ saa, me wura, Nyankopɔn nipa, nni atorɔ nkyerɛ w’afenaa.
Nanso ɔbaa no nyinsɛnee, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima afeda no mu, berɛ a Elisa ka kyerɛɛ no no mu.
Na abɔfra no nyinii.
Na da bi ɔfirii adi kɔɔ n’agya nkyɛn wɔ ayutwafoɔ nkyɛn.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’agya sɛ: Me ti, me ti!
Na agya no ka kyerɛɛ aberanteɛ bi sɛ: Ma no so kɔma ne na.
Na ɔmaa no so de no brɛɛ ne na; na ɔde no tenaa ne srɛ so kɔsii awigyina, na ɔwui.
Na ɔforo de no kɔtoo Nyankopɔn nipa no mpa no so, na ɔtoo ɛpono no mu na ɔfirii adi.
Na ɔkɔfrɛɛ ne kunu sɛ: Mesrɛ wo, soma mmeranteɛ no mu baako ne mfunumu abereɛ no mu baako brɛ me, na mentutu mmirika menkɔ Nyankopɔn nipa no nkyɛn na memmra.
Na ɔbisaa no sɛ: Adɛn nti na wopɛ sɛ wokɔ ne nkyɛn nnɛ yi?
Ɛnyɛ ɔsrane foforɔ, na ɛnyɛ homeda.
Na ɔbaa no kaa sɛ: Ɛnyɛ hwee.
Na ɔhyehyɛɛ afunumubereɛ no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’abɔfra no sɛ: Ka no kɔ ara, ngo ammirikatuo no mu, gye sɛ meka mekyerɛ wo ansa.
Na ɔsii mu, na ɔbɛduruu Nyankopɔn nipa no nkyɛn Karmel bepɔ so.
Na ɛbaa sɛ, Nyankopɔn nipa no hunuu no akyirikyiri no, ɔka kyerɛɛ n’abɔfra Gehasi sɛ: Hwɛ, Sunemni no nie.
Afei tu mmirika kɔhyia no, na bisa no sɛ: Wo ho yɛ anaa?
Wo kunu ho yɛ anaa?
Abɔfra no nso ho yɛ anaa?
Na ɔbuaa sɛ: Ɛyɛ.
Na ɔduruu Nyankopɔn nipa no nkyɛn bepɔ no soɔ no, ɔbɛsosɔɔ ne nan.
Na Gehasi twe pinii sɛ ɔrebɛsum no.
Na Nyankopɔn nipa no kaa sɛ: Gyaa no, na ne kra werɛ aho wɔ ne mu, nanso AWURADE de ahunta me, na wanka ankyerɛ me.
Na ɔbaa no kaa sɛ: Mebɛsrɛɛ me wura hɔ ɔba?
Manka sɛ: Nnaadaa me anaa!
Ɛnna ɔka kyerɛɛ Gehasi sɛ: Bɔ abɔsoɔ, na fa me poma kura na kɔ; woto obi a, nkyea no, nso obiara kyea wo a, nnye no so; na fa me poma yi kɔto abɔfra no anim.
Na abɔfra no na kaa sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE te aseɛ na wo kra te aseɛ yi, merennya wo hɔ.
Ɛnna ɔsɔre dii n’akyi.
Na Gehasi dii wɔn anim kɔe, na ɔde poma no kɔtoo abɔfra no anim; nanso wante nne biara, na wanhunu nkwa ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ biara.
Na ɔsane kɔhyiaa no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Abɔfra no nnyaneeɛ.
Na Elisa duruu fie hɔ no, ɔhunuu sɛ, abɔfra no awu da ne mpa so.
Ɛnna ɔkɔɔ mu, na ɔtoo wɔn baanu pono mu, na ɔbɔɔ AWURADE mpaeɛ.
Na ɔforo kɔbutuu abɔfra no so, na ɔde n’ano butuu n’ano, na ɔde n’ani butuu n’ani so, na ɔde ne nsam totoo ne nsam, na ɔponoo ne mu, abɔfra no so, na abɔfra no honam yɛɛ hye.
Ɛnna ɔsane ba bɛnantee ɛdan no mu dii hɔ akɔneaba.
Na ɔforo kɔɔ bio kɔponoo ne mu wɔ ne so: Ɛnna abɔfra no nwansii mprɛnson, na abɔfra no buee n’ani.
Na ɔfrɛɛ Gehasi sɛ: Frɛ Sunemni no!
Na ɔfrɛɛ no, na ɔbaa ne nkyɛn.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Fa wo ba no!
Ɛnna ɔba bɛhwee ne nan ase kotoo no butuu fam, na ɔfaa ne ba no firii adi.
Owuo a ɛwɔ ɛsɛn no mu.
Aduane ma Na Elisa sane baa Gilgal.
Na ɛkɔm aba asase no so, na adiyifoɔ mma no tete n’anim.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’abɔfra sɛ: Fa ɛsɛnkɛseɛ si so noa aduane ma adiyifoɔ mma no.
Na ɔbaako firi kɔɔ wiram sɛ ɔrekɔtete fan, na ɔkɔhunuu wiram homa bi, na ɔtetee so wiram ɛferɛ ne ntoma ma, na ɔba bɛtwitwaa mu guu ɛsɛn a aduane wɔ mu no mu; nso na ɔnnim n’adeban.
Ɛnna wɔhwie maa nnipa no sɛ wɔnni.
Na wɔredi aduane no bie no, wɔteaa mu sɛ: Awuduro wɔ ɛsɛne no mu, Onyame nipa!
Na wɔantumi anni.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Ɛnneɛ momfa esiam mmra.
Na ɔde guu ɛsɛn no mu, na ɔkaa sɛ: Hwie ma nkurɔfoɔ no na wɔnni.
Na biribi bɔne bi nni ɛsɛn no mu bio.
Na ɔbarima bi nso firi Baal-salisa bae, na ɔbrɛɛ Nyankopɔn nipa no aba a ɛdi kan paanoo, atokoɔ paanoo aduonu ne ayuo foforɔ a wɔnhwaneeɛ.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Fa ma nkurɔfoɔ no na wɔnni.
Na ne somfoɔ no bisaa sɛ: Ɛdeɛn?
Memfa yei mensi nnipa ɔha anim anaa?
Na ɔkaa bio sɛ: Fa ma nkurɔfoɔ no na wɔnni.
Na sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Wɔbɛdi na wɔagya bi.
Ɛnna ɔde sii wɔn anim; na wɔdii, na wɔgyaa bi, sɛdeɛ AWURADE asɛm no teɛ no.
Naaman ayaresa Na Siriahene sahene Naaman yɛ onipa titire wɔ ne wura anim, na ɔwɔ animuonyam, ɛfiri sɛ ɔno so na AWURADE nam gyee Siria; na onipa no yɛ dɔmmarima a ɔtumi ne ho, nso na ɔyare kwata.
Na Siria asafo no mu bi akɔto ahyɛ Israelfoɔ so afa abaayewa kumaa bi dommum aba; na ɔsom Naaman yere.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’awuraa sɛ: Aa, sɛ anka me wura wɔ odiyifoɔ a ɔwɔ Samaria no anim a, ɛnneɛ anka ɔbɛsa ne kwata yi ama no.
Ɛnna ɔkɔ kɔka kyerɛɛ ne wura sɛ: Sɛɛ ne sɛɛ na abaayewa a ɔfiri Israel asase soɔ no ka.
Na Siriahene no kaa sɛ: Kɔ na bra, na mɛtwerɛ Israel hene no nwoma.
Na ɔsii mu kɔe, na ɔfaa dwetɛ dwetikɛseɛ du ne sika nnwetɛbena mpemnsia ne ntadeɛ nsakyeraho du kurae.
Na ɔde nwoma no brɛɛ Israel hene sɛ: Sɛ nwoma yi ka wo nsa a, hwɛ, masoma m’akoa Naaman aba wo nkyɛn sɛ sa ne kwata no ma no.
Na ɛbaa sɛ, Israel hene kenkan nwoma no, ɔsunsuanee ne ntadeɛ mu kaa sɛ: Onyankopɔn ne me na makum na mama nkwa, sɛ oyi resoma ama wɔaba me nkyɛn sɛ mensa obi kwata yi?
Ampa, monhwɛ nhunu sɛ, asɛm na ɔrepɛ me.
Na Nyankopɔn nipa Elisa tee sɛ Israel hene asunsuane ne ntadeɛ mu no, ɔsoma maa wɔkɔɔ ɔhene no nkyɛn sɛ: Adɛn nti na woasunsuane wo ntadeɛ mu?
Ma no mmra me nkyɛn ɛ, na ɔnhunu sɛ odiyifoɔ bi wɔ Israel.
Ɛnna Naaman ne n’apɔnkɔ ne ne nteaseɛnam ba bɛgyinaa Elisa fie pono akyi.
Na Elisa somaa ɔbɔfoɔ maa no kɔɔ ne nkyɛn sɛ: Kɔ na kɔdware mprɛnson Yordan mu, na wo honam bɛsane aba wo ho, na wo ho afi.
Ɛnna Naaman bo fuiɛ, na ɔsii mu kɔe, kaa sɛ: Hwɛ, mesusuu sɛ: Fire na ɔbɛfiri aba abɛgyina hɔ abɔ AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn din, na ɔde ne nsa asra hɔ, na wasa kwata no.
Damasko nsubɔntene Abana ne Parpar nyɛ nsene Israel nsuo nyinaa?
Anka merennware mu na me ho mfi anaa?
Na ɔdanee ne ho de abufuo sii mu.
Na ne nkoa twe pinii bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: M’agya, sɛ ade kɛseɛ bi na odiyifoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ wo a, anka worenyɛ anaa?
Na nkantom sɛ waka akyerɛ wo sɛ: Kɔdware na wo ho mfi!
Ɛnna ɔsiane de ne ho kɔbɔɔ Yordan mu mprɛnson, sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn nipa asɛm no teɛ no; na ne honam sane baa mu sɛ abɔfra ketewa honam, na ne ho firiiɛ.
Na ɔsane baa Nyankopɔn nipa no nkyɛn, ɔno ne n’asafo nyinaa, na ɔba bɛgyinaa n’anim kaa sɛ: Hwɛ, mahunu sɛ Onyankopɔn bi nni asase biara so sɛ Israel nko, na afei gye akyɛdeɛ yi w’akoa nsam.
Na ɔse: Sɛ AWURADE a megyina n’anim te aseɛ yi, merennye hwee.
Na ɔhyɛɛ no sɛ ɔnnye, nanso wampene.
Na Naaman kaa sɛ: Sɛ ɛnte saa a, ma wɔmfa dɔteɛ a mfunumupɔnkɔ mmienu bɛtumi asoa mma w’akoa, na w’akoa remmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ anaa afɔdeɛ biara mma onyame biara bio sɛ AWURADE nko.
Asɛm yi mu nko na AWURADE mfa nkyɛ w’akoa, sɛ me wura rekɔ Rimon fie akɔsɔre hɔ, na ɔtwere me nsa soɔ, na mekoto Rimon fie.
Sɛ mekoto Rimon fie a, AWURADE mfa nkyɛ w’akoa, asɛm yi mu.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kɔ asomdwoeɛ mu.
Gehasi sikapɛ ne ɛho asotwe Na Naaman firii ne nkyɛn kɔɔ kwantiaa bi.
Na Nyankopɔn nipa Elisa abɔfra Gehasi kaa sɛ: Hwɛ, me wura agyaa Siriani Naaman yi, sɛ wannye deɛ ɔde baeɛ no ne nsam; sɛ AWURADE te aseɛ yi, mɛtu mmirika mati no makɔgye ne hɔ biribi.
Na Gehasi tii Naaman.
Na Naaman hunuu sɛ obi de mmirika di n’akyire no, ɔfiri teaseɛnam no mu sii fam bɛhyiaa no kaa sɛ: Asomdwoeɛ mu anaa?
Na ɔse: Asomdwoeɛ mu.
Me wura asoma me sɛ: Hwɛ, seesei mmeranteɛ baanu a wɔfiri adiyifoɔ mma no mu firi Efraim bepɔ so aba me nkyɛn, mesrɛ wo, ma wɔn dwetɛ talente baako ne ntadeɛ nsakyeraho mmienu.
Na Naaman kaa sɛ: Pene na gye talente mmienu.
Na ɔhyɛɛ no, na ɔkyekyeree dwetɛ talente mmienu no mmoa mmienu ne ntadeɛ nsakyeraho mmienu no, na ɔde soaa ne mmeranteɛ mu baanu, na wɔsoa dii n’anim.
Na ɔduruu kokoɔ no ho no, ɔgyee wɔn nsam, na ɔde kɔguu fie, na ɔgyaa mmarima no kwan maa wɔkɔe.
Na ɔno deɛ, ɔba bɛgyinaa ne wura anim.
Na Elisa bisaa no sɛ: Gehasi, ɛhe na wofire?
Na ɔse: W’akoa nkɔɔ baabiara!
Na ɔbisaa no sɛ: M’akoma ne wo ankɔ berɛ a ɔbarima no danee ne ho firii ne teaseɛnam mu bɛhyiaa woɔ no anaa?
Berɛ a wɔgye dwetɛ na wɔgye ntadeɛ ne ngo nnua ne bobe nturo ne nnwan ne anantwie ne nkoa ne mfenaa nie?
Na Naaman kwata no bɛfam wo ne w’asefoɔ ho daa.
Na ɔfirii n’anim firii adie, na kwata ayɛ no fitaa sɛ sukyerɛmma.
Elisa ma dadeɛ bi tɛ nsuo ani Na adiyifoɔ mma no ka kyerɛɛ Elisa sɛ: Hwɛ, w’anim ha a yɛteɛ yi yɛ hiahiaa papa ma yɛn.
Ma yɛnkɔ Yordan ano na yɛnkɔfa mpuna mmaako mmaako mfiri hɔ, na yɛnsiesie baabi wɔ hɔ ntena hɔ.
Na ɔse: Monkɔ ɛ!
Na ɔbaako kaa sɛ: Pene na ɛne wo nkoa nkɔ.
Na ɔbuaa sɛ: Me nso mɛkɔ.
Na ɔne wɔn sii mu kɔe.
Na wɔduruu Yordan ano no, wɔbubuu nnua no.
Na ɔbaako rebu dua no, n’akuma no ti firi tɔɔ nsuo mu.
Na ɔteaa mu sɛ: Ao, me wura!
Wɔkɔfɛmee oo.
Na Nyankopɔn nipa no bisaa sɛ: Ɛhe na ɛtɔeɛ?
Na ɔkyerɛɛ no hɔ.
Na ɔtwaa dua bi too hɔ, na dadeɛ no bɛtɛɛ ani.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Ma so fa!
Na ɔtenee ne nsa fae.
Wɔde anifira bɔ Siriafoɔ Na Siriahene ne Israel bɛdii ako; na ɔne ne nkoa tuu agyina sɛ: Ɛha ne ha na mɛbɔ me nsraban.
Na Nyankopɔn nipa no soma maa wɔkɔɔ Israel hene nkyɛn sɛ: Hwɛ yie, na wɔamfa saa bea yi so, ɛfiri sɛ ɛhɔ na Siriafoɔ nam reba.
Na Israel hene soma maa wɔkɔɔ faako a Nyankopɔn nipa no ka kyerɛɛ no na ɔtuu no ɛho foɔ no hɔ, na ɔsraa hɔ, ɛnyɛ prɛko na ɛnyɛ mprenu nso.
Ɛnna Siriahene akoma peree no asɛm yi ho; na ɔfrɛɛ ne nkoa ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Morenkyerɛ me yɛn mu deɛ ɔwɔ Israel hene afa?
Na ne nkoa no mu baako kaa sɛ: Me wura Ɔhene, ɛnte saa, na mmom Odiyifoɔ Elisa a ɔwɔ Israel no na ɔka nsɛm a woka no wo dabekyire no kyerɛ Israel hene.
Na ɔse: Monkɔ nkɔsra baabi a ɔwɔ, na mensoma mma wɔnkɔfa no mmra.
Na wɔkyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, ɔwɔ Dotan.
Ɛnna ɔsomaa apɔnkɔ ne nteaseɛnam ne dɔm kɛseɛ kɔɔ hɔ, na wɔduruu anadwo, na wɔbɛtwaa kuro no ho hyiae.
Na Nyankopɔn nipa no somfoɔ tuaa nhema sɛ ɔresɔre afiri adie no, na hwɛ, ɛdɔm ne apɔnkɔ ne nteaseɛnam atwa kuro no ho ahyia.
Na n’abɔfra no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ao, me wura, yɛbɛyɛ dɛn?
Na ɔse: Nsuro, na wɔn a wɔka yɛn ho dɔɔso sene wɔn a wɔka wɔn ho no.
Na Elisa bɔɔ mpaeɛ sɛ: AWURADE, bue n’ani na ɔnhunu!
Na AWURADE buee aberanteɛ no ani, no ɔhunui, na hwɛ, ogya apɔnkɔ ne nteaseɛnam ayɛ bepɔ no so ma atwa Elisa ho ahyia.
Ɛnna Siriafoɔ siane baa ne so, na Elisa bɔɔ AWURADE mpaeɛ sɛ: Mesrɛ wo, fa anifira bɔ dɔm yi; na ɔde anifira bɔɔ wɔn, sɛdeɛ Elisa asɛm no teɛ no.
Na Elisa ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ɛnyɛ ɔkwan nie, na ɛnyɛ kuro no nie, monni m’akyi, na memfa mo nkɔ ɔbarima a morehwehwɛ no no nkyɛn.
Na ɔde wɔn kɔɔ Samaria.
Na ɛbaa sɛ wɔduruu Samaria no, Elisa bɔɔ mpaeɛ sɛ: AWURADE, bue wɔn ani, na wɔnhunu; na AWURADE buee wɔn ani, na wɔhunui, na hwɛ, na wɔwɔ Samaria mfimfini.
Na Israel hene hunuu wɔn no, ɔbisaa Elisa sɛ: M’agya, memmobɔ wɔn anaa?
Na ɔbuaa sɛ: Dabi, mmobɔ wɔn.
Deɛ wode wo nkrantɛ ne wo tadua afa no dommum no na wobɔ no.
Fa aduane ne nsuo sisi wɔn anim na wɔnni na wɔnnom, na wɔnkɔ wɔn wura nkyɛn.
Na ɔtoo ɛpono kɛseɛ maa wɔn; na wɔdidiiɛ na wɔnomeeɛ no, ɔgyaa wɔn kwan, na wɔsii mu kɔɔ wɔn wura nkyɛn.
Na Siria fomfafoɔ asafo no antoa so amma Israel asase so bio.
Ɛkɔm ba Samaria Na ɛno akyiri no Siriahene Ben-hadad boaa ne dɔm nyinaa ano hyiae, na ɔforo ba bɛtuaa Samaria.
Na ɛkɔm kɛseɛ baa Samaria, na hwɛ, wɔkaa wɔn hyɛɛ mu ara de kɔsii sɛ wɔtɔn afunumu ti gyee nnwetɛbena aduɔwɔtwe, na mmuruburo bini kab abupɛn nnan mu baako gyee nnwetɛbena nnum Na Israel hene retwam fasuo soɔ no, ɔbaa bi bɔn no sɛ: Owura Ɔhene, boa me!
Na ɔse: Sɛ AWURADE ammoa wo a, mɛfiri he na maboa woɔ?
Ɛmfiri ayuporebea anaa nsa-kyi-amena mu?
Na Ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na ayɛ woɔ?
Na ɔse: Ɔbaa yi ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Fa wo ba ma yɛnni ne nam nnɛ, na yɛadi me ba nam ɔkyena.
Na yɛnoaa me ba no weeɛ; na adeɛ kyeeɛ no, mesee no sɛ: Fa wo ba bra ma yɛnwe; na ɔde ne ba no ahunta.
Na ɔhene tee ɔbaa no nsɛm no, ɔsunsuanee ne ntadeɛ mu.
Na ɔretwam ɔfasuo no soɔ no, nkurɔfoɔ no hwɛe, na ɔfira ayitoma wɔ aseɛ de akata ne honam ani.
Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: Sɛ wɔankum Safat ba Elisa nnɛ da yi a, Onyankopɔn nyɛ me sei na ɔnto so sei.
Nanso na Elisa te ne fie, na mpanimfoɔ no tete ne nkyɛn.
Na ɔhene somaa onipa dii n’anim.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ no nnya nnuruu ne nkyɛn no, ɔno ara ka kyerɛɛ mpanimfoɔ no sɛ: Sɛ moahunu sɛ owudini ba yi asoma sɛ wɔmmɛtwa me tire?
Monhwɛ, sɛ ɔbɔfoɔ no ba a, monto pono mu, na mompia no nkɔ pono ano.
Ɛnyɛ ne wura nan ase pim pim na ɛdi n’akyire yi?
Na ɔda so ne wɔn rekasa no, hwɛ, na ɔbɔfoɔ no resiane aba ne nkyɛn.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Hwɛ, bɔne yi firi AWURADE nkyɛn, ɛdeɛn na mentwɛn AWURADE mennye bio?
Berɛ pa wɔ Samaria Ɛnna Elisa kaa sɛ: Montie AWURADE asɛm: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Ɔkyena sɛsɛɛ ayuosiam susuo adeɛ baako bɛdi dwetɛbena, na atokoɔ susuo adeɛ mmienu bɛdi dwetɛbena Samaria kuro pono ano.
Ɛnna okunini a ɔhene twere ne nsa soɔ no buaa Nyankopɔn nipa no sɛ: Hwɛ, sɛ AWURADE reyɛ mpomma ɔsoro mpo a, saa asɛm yi bɛbam anaa?
Na ɔse: Wo ara wode w’ani bɛhunu, na worenni bi.
Na mmarima akwatafoɔ baanan wɔ kuro no pono ano, na wɔsesee wɔn ho wɔn ho sɛ: Adɛn na yɛtete ha kɔsi sɛ yɛbɛwuwuo?
Sɛ yɛse: Yɛbɛhyɛne kuro no mu a, ɛnneɛ ɛkɔm wɔ kuro no mu na yɛbɛwuwu hɔ; na sɛ yɛtete ha yi nso a, yɛbɛwuwu; na afei mommra mma yɛnkɔhwɛ Siriafoɔ nsraban no mu, sɛ wɔgye yɛn nkwa a, yɛbɛtena ase, sɛ wɔku yɛn nso a, yɛawu.
Na wɔsɔree anwummerɛ fɔmm sɛ wɔrekɔ Siriafoɔ nsraban mu: Na wɔduruu Siriafoɔ nsraban no ano, na hwɛ, onipa biara nni hɔ.
Na AWURADE ama Siriafoɔ dɔm ate nteaseɛnam ne apɔnkɔ ne dɔm kɛseɛ nka, na wɔsesee wɔn ho wɔn ho sɛ: Hwɛ, Israel hene akɔgye Hetifoɔ ahemfo ne Misraim ahemfo adɔm atia yɛn sɛ wɔmmra yɛn so.
Enti anwummerɛ no wɔasɔre adwane, na wɔagyigya wɔn ntomadan ne wɔn apɔnkɔ ne wɔn mfunumu ne nsraban no sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ no, na wɔn nkwa nti wɔadwane.
Na akwatafoɔ no duruu nsraban no ano no, wɔkɔɔ ntomadan baako mu kɔdidii nomee, na wɔfaa dwetɛ ne sika ne ntoma firii hɔ kɔe de kɔhuntae, na wɔsane ba bɛhyɛnee ntomadan foforɔ mu, na wɔfaa hɔ adeɛ nso, na wɔde kɔ kɔhuntae.
Ɛnna wɔsesee wɔn ho wɔn ho sɛ: Deɛ yɛreyɛ yi nyɛ, ɛnnɛ da yi yɛ asɛmpa da, na yɛn deɛ, yɛayɛ komm yi; na sɛ yɛtwɛn kɔsi adekyeeɛ a, asotwe bi bɛda yɛn so; na afei momma yɛnkɔ ahemfie nkɔka!
Na wɔba bɛfrɛɛ kuro no apono ano ahwɛfoɔ, na wɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Yɛkɔɔ Siriafoɔ nsram, na hwɛ, onipa biara ne onipa nne biara nni hɔ gye apɔnkɔ a wɔasesa wɔn ne mfunumu a wɔasesa wɔn ne ntomadan no, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ.
Na ɛpono ano ahwɛfoɔ no frɛe maa wɔkɔkaa no ahemfie.
Ɛnna ɔhene sɔree anadwo no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa sɛ: Mɛkyerɛ mo deɛ Siriafoɔ ayɛ yɛn yi: Wɔnim sɛ ɛkɔm de yɛn, enti na wɔafiri nsram hɔ korɔ sɛ wɔrekɔhunta wiram, na sɛ wɔfiri kuro no mu ba a, yɛakye wɔn animono, na yɛakɔhyɛne kuro no mu.
Na ne nkoa no mu baako buaa sɛ: Ɛnneɛ ma wɔmfa apɔnkɔ nkaeɛ a wɔaka kurom ha no mu nnum, hwɛ, wɔte sɛ Israel dodoɔ a wɔaka mu no, hwɛ wɔte sɛ Israel dodoɔ a wɔahyeɛ no, na ma yɛnsoma wɔn na yɛnhwɛ.
Na wɔfaa apɔnkɔ nteaseɛnam mmienu na ɔhene somaa wɔn maa wɔdii Siriafoɔ dɔm no akyiri sɛ: Monkɔ nkɔhwɛ!
Na wɔdii wɔn akyi de kɔduruu Yordan ano, na hwɛ, ntadeɛ ne nnoɔma nnoɔma a Siriafoɔ atoto agu wɔn ntɛmpɛ no mu ayɛ ɔkwan no nyinaa so ma.
Na abɔfoɔ no sane ba bɛka kyerɛɛ Ɔhene.
Ɛnna nkurɔfoɔ no firii adie kɔfom Siriafoɔ nsraban no.
Na esiam susuo adeɛ baako tiriboɔ bɛyɛɛ dwetɛbena, na ɛmo susuo adeɛ mmienu nso yɛɛ dwetɛbena, sɛdeɛ AWURADE asɛm no teɛ no.
Na ɔhene yii okunini a ɔtwere ne nsa soɔ no sɛ ɔnhwɛ ɛpono ano; na nkurɔfoɔ no tiatiaa ne so ɛpono no mu, na ɔwui, sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn nipa no kasa a ɔhene siane baa ne nkyɛn no, ɔkaeɛ no.
Na ɛbaa mu sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn nipa no ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene no sɛ: Atokoɔ susuo adeɛ bɛyɛ dwetɛbena, na ayuosiam susuo adeɛ baako nso ayɛ dwetɛbena ɔkyena sɛsɛɛ Samaria kuro pono ano.
Na ɔsafohene no buaa Nyankopɔn nipa no sɛ: Na hwɛ, sɛ AWURADE reyɛ mpomma ɔsoro mpo a, ɛbɛyɛ sɛ saa asɛm yi anaa?
Na ɔse: Hwɛ, wo deɛ, wode w’ani bɛhunu, na worenni bi.
Na ɛyɛɛ no saa ara, na nkurɔfoɔ no tiatiaa no kuro pono no mu, na ɔwui.
Elisa ne Sunemni baa no Na Elisa aka akyerɛ ɔbaa a ɔnyanee ne ba no sɛ: Sɔre kɔ, wo ne wo fie, na kɔyɛ ɔhɔhoɔ baabiara a wobɛtumi, na AWURADE rema ɛkɔm aba, na ɛbɛba asase yi so mfeɛ nson.
Na ɔbaa no sɔree yɛɛ sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn nipa no asɛm no teɛ no, na ɔne ne fiefoɔ sii mu kɔ kɔyɛɛ ahɔhoɔ Filistifoɔ asase so mfeɛ nson.
Na ɛbaa sɛ mfeɛ nson no awieeɛ no, ɔbaa no sane firii Filistifoɔ asase so bae, na ɔfiri adi kɔsrɛɛ ɔhene sɛ ɔregye ne fie ne n’asase.
Nso na ɔhene ne Nyankopɔn nipa no abɔfra Gehasi rekasa sɛ: Ka me nnoɔma akɛseɛ a Elisa ayɛ no ɛ!
Na ɔgu so reka kyerɛ ɔhene sɛdeɛ Elisa nyanee owufoɔ no, hwɛ, ɔbaa a ɔnyanee ne ba maa no no bɛsrɛɛ ɔhene sɛ ɔregye ne fie ne n’asase.
Na Gehasi kaa sɛ: Me wura Ɔhene, ɔbaa no nie, na ne ba a Elisa maa no nyaa nkwa no nie.
Na ɔhene bisaa ɔbaa no no, ɔka kyerɛɛ no.
Ɛnna ɔhene yii opiani bi maa no sɛ: Hwehwɛ deɛ ɛyɛ ne deɛ nyinaa, ne n’afuo no aba nyinaa, ɛfiri da a ɔgyaa asase yi hɔ de bɛsi nnɛ ma no.
Hasael di Siria so hene Na Elisa kɔɔ Damasko; nso na Siriahene Ben-hadad yare; na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Nyankopɔn nipa no aba ha.
Na ɔhene no ka kyerɛɛ Hasael sɛ: Fa ayɛyɛdeɛ kura wo nsam, na kɔ kɔhyia Nyankopɔn nipa no, na kɔbisa AWURADE adeɛ ne hɔ sɛ: Mɛnya yadeɛ yi mu nkwa anaa?
Na Hasael ba bɛhyiaa no, na ɔfaa ayɛyɛdeɛ kurae, ɛyɛ Damasko nnoɔma pa nyinaa mu bi, yoma aduanan na ɛsoso wɔn.
Na ɔba bɛgyinaa n’anim sɛ: Wo ba Ben-hadad, Siriahene na ɔsomaa me wo nkyɛn sɛ: Mɛnya yadeɛ yi mu nkwa anaa?
Na Elisa ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kɔ kɔka kyerɛ no sɛ: Nkwa deɛ, wobɛnya, na AWURADE akyerɛ me sɛ wobɛwu ara.
Na ɔgyenee n’ani hwɛɛ no dinn kɔsii sɛ n’ani wuiɛ, na Nyankopɔn nipa no sui.
Na Hasael bisaa sɛ: Adɛn nti na me wura resu?
Na ɔse: Ɛfiri sɛ menim bɔne a wobɛyɛ Israelfoɔ.
Wɔn nkuro a ɛyɛ den no, wobɛtoto mu gya, na wode nkrantɛ bɛkunkum wɔn mmeranteɛ, na woatete wɔn nkɔkoaa ahwehwe fam, na woapaepae wɔn anyinsɛnfoɔ mu.
Na Hasael kaa sɛ: Na w’akoa ne deɛn, ɔkraman yi a, sɛ ɔbɛyɛ adeɛ kɛseɛ yi?
Na Elisa se: AWURADE ama mahu wo sɛ Siriahene.
Na ɔfirii Elisa nkyɛn kɔ kɔduruu ne wura nkyɛn.
Na ɔbisaa no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na Elisa ka kyerɛɛ woɔ?
Na ɔse: Ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Nkwa deɛ, wobɛnya.
Na adeɛ kyeeɛ no, ɔfaa mmuatoma no bɔɔ nsuo mu de kataa n’anim, na ɔwui.
Na Hasael sii n’ananmu dii hene.
Yoram di Yuda so hene Na Israelhene Ahab ba Yoram afe a ɛtɔ so nnum mu berɛ a Yehosafat dii Yuda hene no, na Yudahene Yehosafat ba Yehoram bɛdii hene.
Ɔbɛdii hene no na wadi mfirinhyia aduasa mmienu, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ nwɔtwe wɔ Yerusalem.
Na ɔfaa Israel ahemfo kwan so sɛdeɛ Ahab fie yɛeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ na ne yere yɛ Ahab ba.
Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne.
Nanso n’akoa Dawid nti AWURADE ampɛ sɛ ɔsɛe Yuda, sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ bɔ sɛ ɔbɛma no ne ne mma nna nyinaa.
Ne berɛ so na Edom tee atua firii Yuda nsa aseɛ, na wɔkɔsii wɔn so hene.
Na Yoram twaa mu kɔɔ Sair, ne nteaseɛnam nyinaa ka ne ho; na ɔsɔree anadwo, kɔkunkumm Edomfoɔ a wɔatwa ne ho ahyia ne nteaseɛnam so asafohene no; na nkurɔfoɔ no dwane kɔɔ wɔn ntomadan mu.
Na Edom tee atua firii Yuda nsa ase de bɛsi nnɛ.
Ɛnna Libna nso tee atua berɛ no ara mu.
Na Yoram ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa, wɔantwerɛ no Yuda ahemfo berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu?
Na Yoram tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no kaa n’agyanom ho Dawid kuro mu; na ne ba Ahasia sii n’ananmu dii hene.
Ahasia di Yuda so hene Na Israelhene Ahab ba Yoram afe a ɛtɔ so dummienu mu na Yudahene Yehoram ba Ahasia bɛdii hene.
Ahasia dii mfeɛ aduonu mmienu na ɔbɛdii hene no, na ɔdii hene afe baako Yerusalem.
Na ne na din de Atalia a ɔyɛ Israelhene Omri ba.
Na ɔfaa Ahab fiefoɔ kwan so, na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne sɛ Ahab fie, ɛfiri sɛ na Ahab ase ne no.
Na ɔne Ahab ba Yoram ne Siriahene Hasael kɔkoeɛ wɔ Ramot-gilead.
Na Siriafoɔ piraa Yoram.
Na Ɔhene Yoram sane baa sɛ ɔrebɛsa pira a Siriafoɔ piraa no Rama, berɛ a ɔne Siriahene Hasael reko no wɔ Yesreel.
Na Yudahene Yehoram ba Ahasia siane kɔɔ sɛ ɔrekɔhwɛ Ahab ba Yoram wɔ Yesreel, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔyare.
Wɔsra Yehu ngo si no Israel so hene Na Odiyifoɔ Elisa frɛɛ adiyifoɔ mma no mu baako ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Bɔ abɔsoɔ, na fa ngo toa yi kura wo nsam, na kɔ Ramot-gilead.
Na sɛ woduru hɔ a, hwehwɛ Nimsi ba Yehosafat ba Yehu hɔ, na kɔ mu, na ma no nsɔre mfiri ne nuanom mu, na fa no kɔ mpiakyire pia mu, na fa ngo toa no hwie gu n’atifi, na ka sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Masra wo ngo asi Israel so hene; na hini ɛpono no na dwane, na nnyina.
Ɛnna aberanteɛ a ɔyɛ odiyifoɔ aberanteɛ no sii mu kɔɔ Ramot-gilead.
Na ɔduruiɛ no, na hwɛ, ɛdɔm so asafohene tete hɔ; na ɔkaa sɛ: Mewɔ asɛm bi mese wo, ɔsafohene.
Na Yehu bisaa sɛ: Wone yɛn nyinaa mu hwan?
Na ɔse: Mene wo, ɔsafohene.
Ɛnna ɔsɔre kɔɔ ɛdan no mu, na ɔhwiee ngo no guu n’atifi, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Masra wo masi wo AWURADE man Israel so hene.
Na wobɛbɔ wo wura Ahab fie, na matɔ me nkoa adiyifoɔ no mogya ne AWURADE nkoa nyinaa mogya so were Isebel nsam; na Ahab fie nyinaa asɛe, na matwa Ahabni barima biara atwene, akoa oo, ɔdehyeɛ oo, Israel mu.
Na mɛyɛ Ahab fie sɛ Nebat ba Yeroboam fie ne Ahia ba Baasa fie.
Na akraman bɛwe Isebel nam, Yesreel asase so, na obiara nni hɔ a ɔbɛsie no.
Na ɔhinii ɛpono no dwanee.
Na Yehu firii adi baa ne wura nkoa nkyɛn.
Na obi bisaa no sɛ: Ɛyɛ anaa?
Adɛn nti na ɔbɔdamfoɔ yi baa wo nkyɛn yi?
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Mo ara monim ɔbarima no ne ne nsɛnkeka.
Na wɔse: Atorɔ!
Ka kyerɛ yɛn ɛ!
Na ɔse: Sɛɛ ne sɛɛ na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Masra wo ngo masi wo Israel so hene.
Ɛnna wɔyɛɛ ntɛm yiyii wɔn ntadeɛ de hyehyɛɛ n’ase wɔn nan ase wɔ ntwedeɛ no ara soɔ, na wɔhyɛnee totorobɛnto sɛ: Yehu adi hene!
Yehu di Yehoram ne Ahasia awu Na Nimsi ba Yehosafat ba Yehu pam Yoram tiri so; nso na Yoram ne Israel nyinaa rewɛn wɔ Ramot-gilead, Siriahene Hasael nti; na Ɔhene Yehoram deɛ, na wasane aba Yesreel sɛ ɔrebɛsa pira a ɔne Siriahene Hasael reko no, Siriafoɔ piraa no no.
Na Yehu kaa sɛ: Sɛ sei ne w’adwene a, ɛnneɛ mommma obiara mmfiri adi nnnwane mmfiri kuro yi mu nnkɔka no wɔ Yesreel.
Na Yehu tenaa teaseɛnam mu kɔɔ Yesreel.
Na ɛhɔ na na Yoram da, na Yudahene Ahasia asiane aba sɛ ɔrebɛhwɛ Yoram.
Na ɔwɛmfoɔ gyina Yesreel abantenten so; na ɔhunuu Yehu asafokuo no sɛ wɔreba, na ɔkaa sɛ: Mehunu asafokuo bi.
Na Yehoram se: Fa ɔpɔnkɔsoteni soma no ma no nkɔhyia wɔn, na ɔmmisa sɛ: Asomdwoeɛ anaa?
Na ɔpɔnkɔsoteni bi kɔ kɔhyiaa no, na ɔkaa sɛ: Sɛ ɔhene seɛ nie: Asomdwoeɛ anaa?
Na Yehu se: Wo ne asomdwoeɛ wɔ deɛn na ɛyɛ?
Bra bɛdi m’akyi!
Na ɔwɛmfoɔ no de nkra kɔmaa ɔhene sɛ: Ɔbɔfoɔ no aduru wɔn nkyɛn, nso ɔnsane mma.
Ɛnna ɔsomaa ɔpɔnkɔsoteni a ɔtɔ so mmienu; na ɔkɔduruu wɔn nkyɛn no, ɔkaa sɛ: Sɛ ɔhene seɛ nie: Ɛyɛ asomdwoeɛ anaa?
Na Yehu se: Asomdwoeɛ fa wo ho bɛn?
Bra bɛdi m’akyi!
Na ɔwɛmfoɔ no kaa sɛ: Waduru wɔn nkyɛn, nso ɔnsane mma.
Na ɔka pɔnkɔ no sɛdeɛ Nimsi ba Yehu ka no, na ɔka no denden pa ara.
Ɛnna Yehoram kaa sɛ: Monsiesie!
Na wɔsiesiee ne teaseɛnam no.
Na Israelhene Yehoram ne Yudahene Ahasia firii adi, wɔn nteaseɛnam mu, na wɔfiri kɔhyiaa Yehu, na wɔkɔtoo no Yesreelni Nabot asase no so.
Na Yehoram hunuu Yehu no, ɔbisaa sɛ: Yehu, asomdwoeɛ anaa?
Na ɔse: Asomdwoeɛ bɛyɛ dɛn aba, berɛ a wo na Isebel adwamammɔ ne n’abayigorɔ bebree no rekɔ soɔ yi?
Ɛnna Yehoram danee ne ho dwaneeɛ, na ɔka kyerɛɛ Ahasia sɛ: Atirisopamsɛm nie, Ahasia!
Na Yehu de ne nsa sɔɔ agyan mu to bɔɔ Yehoram abasa ntam, na agyan no hwiree n’akoma mu, na ɔhwee ne teaseɛnam mu.
Ɛnna ɔka kyerɛɛ ne kunini Bidkar sɛ: Ma no so to no twene Yesreelni Nabot asase no so!
Na kae sɛ me ne wo te apɔnkɔ so bɔɔ anan dii n’agya Ahab akyiri no, AWURADE de atemmusɛm yi too ne so sɛ: Ampa ara, mehunuu Nabot mogya ne ne mma mogya nnora!
AWURADE na ɔseɛ: Na mɛtua wo ɛso ka, asase yi so!
AWURADE na ɔseɛ.
Na afei ma no so to no twene asase yi so, sɛdeɛ AWURADE asɛm no teɛ no.
Na Yudahene Ahasia hunuiɛ no, ɔfaa turom dan kwan so dwanee.
Na Yehu tii no, na ɔkaa sɛ: Mommɔ ɔno nso teaseɛnam no mu.
Wɔyɛɛ saa Gur aforoeɛ a ɛwɔ Yibleam ho no; na ɔdwane kɔɔ Megido, na ɔkɔwuu wɔ hɔ.
Na ne nkoa de no nam teaseɛnam mu kɔɔ Yerusalem; na wɔsiee no n’asieeɛ kaa n’agyanom ho, Dawid kuro mu.
Na Ahab ba Yoram afe a ɛtɔ so dubaako mu na Ahasia bɛdii Yuda so hene.
Isebel awieeɛ a ɛyɛ hu Ɛnna Yehu baa Yesreel.
Na Isebel teeɛ no, ɔkekaa n’ani ho adubire, na ɔhyehyɛɛ ne ti, na ɔhwɛɛ mpomma mu.
Na Yehu duruu ɛpono no ano no, ɔbisaa sɛ: Ɛyɛ asomdwoeɛ anaa, wo Simri a, wokumm wo wura?
Na ɔmaa n’ani so hwɛɛ mpomma no, na ɔbisaa sɛ: Hwan na ɔwɔ m’afa, hwan?
Ɛnna pia mufoɔ baanu anaa baasa firi bɔɔ wɔn ani kyerɛɛ no.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Monto no nhwe fam!
Ɛnna wɔtoo no hwee fam, na ne mogya bi petee ɔfasuo ho ne apɔnkɔ no ho, na ɔde teaseɛnam faa ne so.
Na ɔhyɛnee mu; na ɔdidiiɛ na ɔnomeeɛ no, ɔkaa sɛ: Monkɔ nkɔhwɛ ɔbaa a wɔadome no no, na monsie no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ ɔhene babaa.
Na wɔkɔɔ sɛ wɔrekɔsie no, na wɔanhunu ne ho biribiara gye ne tikwankoraa ne ne nan ne ne nsayam.
Na wɔsane bɛka kyerɛɛ no; na ɔkaa sɛ: AWURADE asɛm a ɔnam n’akoa Elia Tisbini no so kaeɛ no nie sɛ: Yesreel asase so na akraman bɛwe Isebel nam, na Isebel funu bɛhwete ayɛ sɛ sɛbeɛ wɔ wiram, Yesreel asase no so, na obiara anhunu anka sɛ: Isebel nie!
Yehu sɛe Ahab fie Na Ahab wɔ mmammarima aduɔson wɔ Samaria.
Na Yehu twerɛtwerɛɛ nwoma na ɔsoma maa wɔde kɔɔ Samaria kɔmaa Yesreel asafohene, mpanimfoɔ ne Ahab mmagyegyefoɔ no sɛ: Sɛ nwoma yi ka mo nsa a, sɛ mo wura mma wɔ mo nkyɛn na nteaseɛnam ne apɔnkɔ ne nkuro a wɔato ho afasuo ne akodeɛ nso wɔ mo nkyɛn yi; monhwehwɛ mo wura mma no mu deɛ ɔyɛ, ne deɛ ɔtene, na momfa no ntena n’agya adwa so, na monko mma mo wura fie.
Na wɔsuroo pa ara kaa sɛ: Hwɛ, ahemfo baanu no annyina n’anim, na yɛn deɛ, yɛbɛgyina sɛn?
Na deɛ ɔhwɛ ahemfie no soɔ, ne deɛ ɔdi kuro no soɔ no, mpanimfoɔ ne mmagyegyefoɔ no soma maa wɔkɔɔ Yehu nkyɛn sɛ: Wo nkoa ne yɛn, na deɛ wobɛka akyerɛ yɛn nyinaa, yɛbɛyɛ; yɛrensi ɔhene biara; yɛ deɛ wopɛ.
Ɛnna ɔtwerɛɛ wɔn nwoma a ɛtɔ so mmienu sɛ: Sɛ mowɔ m’afa na mobɛtie me a, momfa nnipa no, mo wura mma no tiri mmra me nkyɛn ɔkyena sɛsɛɛ wɔ Yesreel.
Nso na ɔhene mma no yɛ mmarima aduɔson; kuro no mu nnipa akɛseɛ no nkyɛn na wɔyɛnee wɔn.
Na ɛbaa sɛ nwoma no kaa wɔn nsa no, wɔfaa ɔhene mma no kunkumm nnipa aduɔson no, na wɔde wɔn tiri guu nkɛntɛn mu, na wɔsoma maa wɔde kɔmaa no wɔ Yesreel.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ no ba bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wɔde ɔhene mma no tiri no aba.
Na ɔse: Monhɔre no akuo mmienu ɛpono no ano nkɔsi anɔpa.
Na anɔpa no, ɔfirii adi kɔgyinaa hɔ, na ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinaa sɛ: Modi bem, hwɛ, me na mepamm me wura tiri soɔ na mekumm no; na hwan na ɔkunkumm yeinom nyinaa?
Monhunu afei, sɛ AWURADE asɛm a ɔkaa no Ahab fie ho no mu biara bɛba mu, na AWURADE ayɛ deɛ ɔnam n’akoa Elia so kaeɛ no.
Na Yehu kumm Ahab fie nnipa a wɔkaa wɔ Yesreel no nyinaa ne ne nnipa akɛseɛ ne n’amannifoɔ ne n’asɔfoɔ nyinaa kɔsii sɛ wannya no obiara amma wamfiri mu amfire.
Na ɔsɔre sii mu kɔɔ Samaria; na ɔduruu Bet-eked nnwanhwɛfoɔ nsraban mu, ɔkwan mu no, Yehu hyiaa Yudahene Ahasia nuanom, na ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: Hwannom ne mo?
Na wɔse: Ahasia nuanom ne yɛn, na yɛresiane akɔ akɔhwɛ ɔhene mma ne ɔhemmaa mma no sɛ wɔte sɛn.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Monkye wɔn anikan so!
Na wɔkyeree wɔn anikan, na wɔkunkumm wɔn wɔ Bet-eked amena ho, nnipa aduanan mmienu, na wɔannyae wɔn mu biara.
Na ɔfiri hɔ rekorɔ no, ɔhunuu Rekab ba Yehonadab sɛ ɔreba abɛhyia no; na ɔkyeaa no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wodɔ me sɛdeɛ medɔ woɔ no?
Na Yehonadab se: Medɔ wo!
Na sɛ ɛte saa a, sɔ me nsa mu ɛ!
Na ɔsɔɔ mu; na ɔmaa no foro kɔɔ ne nkyɛn teaseɛnam no mu.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Ɛne me nkɔ, na kɔhwɛ me ninkunu a metwe mema AWURADE.
Na ɔmaa no tenaa ne teaseɛnam no mu.
Na ɔduruu Samaria no, ɔkumm nnipa a wɔka maa Ahab, Samaria no nyinaa kɔsii sɛ ɔtɔree wɔn ase, sɛdeɛ AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Elia no.
Yehu sɛe Baal Na Yehu boaboaa ɔman no nyinaa ano hyiae, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ahab somm Baal kakraa bi, na Yehu deɛ, ɔbɛsom no bebree.
Na afei, Baal adiyifoɔ nyinaa, ne n’asomfoɔ nyinaa ne n’asɔfoɔ nyinaa, momfrɛ wɔn mmra me nkyɛn, mommma obiara nnka, na mewɔ afɔdeɛ kɛseɛ bi bɔ mema Baal; obiara a ɔremma no rennya nkwa.
Na Yehu yɛɛ no aniteɛ mu, sɛ ɔrebɛsɛe Baal asomfoɔ.
Na Yehu kaa sɛ: Mompae nhyia kronkron mma Baal.
Na wɔpaee.
Na Yehu soma maa wɔkɔkyinii Israel nyinaa, na Baal nkoa nyinaa bae, wɔannya obiara a wamma.
Na wɔbaa Baal fie, na Baal fie yɛɛ ma firi ano kɔpem ano.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ deɛ ɔhwɛ ntadeɛ dan soɔ no sɛ: Yiyi ntadeɛ brɛ Baal nkoa nyinaa.
Na ɔkɔyii ntadeɛ no de brɛɛ wɔn.
Ɛnna Yehu ne Rekab ba Yehonadab kɔɔ Baal fie, na ɔka kyerɛɛ Baal nkoa no sɛ: Mompeepee mu nhunu na AWURADE nkoa mu bi ammɛka mo ho ha sɛ Baal nkoa nko.
Na ɔkɔɔ mu sɛ ɔrekɔbɔ afɔdeɛ ne ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ.
Na Yehu de mmarima aduɔwɔtwe agyina adihɔ sɛ: Sɛ mmarima a mede wɔn merehyɛ mo nsa yi mu biara firi mu kɔ a, deɛ ɔmaa no kɔeɛ no kra bɛsi ne kra ananmu.
Na ɔwiee ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no bɔ no, Yehu ka kyerɛɛ awɛmfoɔ ne akunini no sɛ: Monkɔ nkɔkunkum wɔn, mommma obiara mmfi.
Na awɛmfoɔ ne akunini no de nkrantɛ ano kunkumm wɔn totoo wɔn gui.
Na wɔkɔɔ Baal fie ban no mu, na wɔyii Baal fie adum no, na wɔhyeeɛ; na wɔbubuu Baal dum no, na wɔdwirii Baal fie no gui, na wɔde yɛɛ tiafi de bɛsi nnɛ.
Saa na Yehu sɛee Baal firii Israel.
Nanso Nebat ba Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no bɔne akyiri deɛ, Yehu amfi, ɛne sika nantwie mma a ɛwɔ Betel ne Dan no.
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yehu sɛ: Ɛsiane sɛ woayɛ yei, sɛ woayɛ deɛ ɛtene m’ani soɔ, na woayɛ Ahab fie sɛdeɛ ɛwɔ m’akoma mu nyinaa nti, wo mma a wɔbɛtɔ so nnan no bɛtena Israel adwa so.
Nanso Yehu anhwɛ amfa n’akoma nyinaa anni AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn mmara so; wamfiri Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no bɔne ho.
Nna no mu na AWURADE firii aseɛ twitwaa Israel soɔ, na Hasael dii wɔn so Israel ahyeɛ nyinaa so, ɛfiri Yordan owiapueeɛ, Gilead asase nyinaa, Gadfoɔ ne Rubenfoɔ ne Manasefoɔ deɛ, firi Aroer a ɛwɔ Arnon subonhwa ano ne Gilead ne Basan.
Na Yehu ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa ne ne mmaninneɛ nyinaa, wɔantwerɛ no Israel Ahemfo Berɛsosɛm Nwoma no mu anaa?
Na Yehu tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no Samaria; na ne ba Yehoahas sii n’ananmu dii hene.
Na nna a Yehu de dii Israel so hene Samaria no yɛ mfirinhyia aduonu nwɔtwe.
Atalia ahennie ne ne wuo Na Ahasia ne na Atalia hunuu sɛ ne ba awuo no, ɔsɔree na ɔsɛee adehyeɛ abusua no nyinaa.
Na Ɔhene Yoram babaa Yehoseba, Ahasia nuabaa, faa Ahasia ba Yoas, na ɔwiaa no firii ɔhene mma a wɔreku wɔn no mu de no ne ne ɔbagyegyefoɔ kɔɔ pia mu, na ɔde no hunta firii Atalia anim na wɔanku no.
Na ɔne no huntaa AWURADE fie mfeɛ nsia.
Na Atalia dii asase no so hemmaa.
Na afe a ɛtɔ so nson mu no, Yehoiada soma maa wɔkɔfaa Karifoɔ ne awɛmfoɔ no ɔha ha so asafohene baa ne nkyɛn AWURADE fie, na ɔne wɔn pamee, na ɔmaa wɔkekaa ntam AWURADE fie, na ɔde ɔhene ba no kyerɛɛ wɔn.
Na ɔhyɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Adeɛ a monyɛ nie: Mo mu nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako mmra adwuma homeda, na mommɛwɛn ɔhene fie, (na nkyɛmu baako ntena Sur pono ano, na nkyɛmu baako nso ntena awɛmfoɔ akyiri pono no ano); na monwɛn efie no mmɔ ho ban.
Na mo mu asafokuo mmienu, wɔn a homeda wɔwɛn AWURADE fie no nkɔwɛn ɔhene no.
Na montwa ɔhene no ho nhyia, monkurakura mo akodeɛ mo nsam; na deɛ ɔbɛba mo kuo no mu no, monku no; na montena ɔhene ho, n’adifire ne ne muba mu.
Na asafohene no yɛɛ sɛdeɛ ɔsɔfoɔ Yehoiada hyɛeɛ no nyinaa, na wɔfaa wɔn nnipa a wɔba adwuma homeda ne wɔn a wɔmma homeda no, na wɔbaa Ɔsɔfoɔ Yehoiada nkyɛn.
Na ɔsɔfoɔ no de Ɔhene Dawid mpea ne akyɛm a ɛwɔ AWURADE fie no maa ɔha asafohene no.
Na awɛmfoɔ no gyinagyina ho kurakura wɔn akodeɛ wɔn nsam, ɛfiri ɛdan no anafoɔ fam ntwea so kɔsi ɛdan no atifi fam ntwea so, afɔrebukyia no ho ne ɛdan no ho, atwa ɔhene no ho ahyia.
Na ɔyii ɔhene ba no firii adi, na ɔde ahemmotire no bɔɔ ne ti, na ɔde adanseɛ nwoma no hyɛɛ ne nsa, na wɔsii no hene, na wɔsraa no ngo, na wɔbobɔɔ wɔn nsam sɛ: Ɔhene tiri nkwa!
Ɛnna Atalia tee awɛmfoɔ ne ɔman no gyegyeegye no, ɔbaa nkurɔfoɔ no nkyɛn AWURADE fie; na ɔbɛhunui, na hwɛ, na ɔhene no gyina simpie no so sɛdeɛ ne yɛbea teɛ no, na asafohene no ne ntotorobɛntohyɛnfoɔ wɔ ɔhene no nkyɛn, na asase no so nkurɔfoɔ no nyinaa ani agye, na wɔhyenhyɛnee ntotorobɛnto.
Ɛnna Atalia sunsuanee ne ntadeɛ mu, na ɔteaa mu sɛ: Atirisopam, atirisopam!
Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Yehoiada hyɛɛ ɔha ha so asafohene a wɔhwɛ dɔm no soɔ no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monyi no mfa mo mu mfi, na deɛ ɔbɛdi n’akyire no, momfa nkrantɛ nku no.
Na ɔsɔfoɔ no kaa sɛ: Wɔnnku no AWURADE fie.
Enti wɔsɔɔ ne mu de no kɔfaa kwan a apɔnkɔ nam so ba ahemfie no so; na wɔkumm no hɔ.
Yehoiada Nhyehyɛɛ foforɔ Na Yehoiada de apam too AWURADE ne ɔhene ne ɔman no ntam, sɛ wɔnyɛ AWURADE man; na ɔde too ɔhene ne ɔman no nso ntam.
Ɛnna asase no so nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa kɔɔ Baal fie kɔdwirii n’afɔrebukyia ne n’ahoni no, wɔbubuu no pasaa, na Baal sɔfoɔ Matan nso, wɔkum no afɔrebukyia no anim.
Na ɔsɔfoɔ no de awɛmfoɔ gyinagyinaa AWURADE fie no ho.
Na ɔfaa asafohene ne Karifoɔ ne awɛmfoɔ ne asase no so nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa, na wɔde ɔhene no firii AWURADE fie siane bɛfaa awɛmfoɔ pono ano kwan so baa ahemfie, na ɔtenaa ahennwa no so.
Na asase no so nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa ani gyee, na kuro no mu dwoe; na Atalia deɛ, wɔde nkrantɛ kumm no ɔhene fie hɔ.
Yehoas bɛdii hene no, na wadi mfirinhyia nson.
Yehoas di Yuda so hene Yehu afe a ɛtɔ so nson so na Yehoas bɛdii hene, na ɔdii hene mfirinhyia aduanan wɔ Yerusalem.
Na ne na din de Sibia a ɔfiri Beer-seba.
Na Yehoas yɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so, ɛfiri sɛ Ɔsɔfoɔ Yehoiada na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ no.
Nanso sorɔnsorɔmmea no deɛ, wanyi; na ɔman no kɔɔ so bɔɔ afɔdeɛ na wɔhyee aduhwam sorɔnsorɔmmea no so.
Na Yehoas ka kyerɛɛ asɔfoɔ no sɛ: Akronkronneɛ sika a wɔde ba AWURADE fie nyinaa ne obiara kra tiri sika sɛ wɔbɔ no boɔ no, ne sika biara nso a ɛba obi akoma mu sɛ ɔde bɛba AWURADE fie no, asɔfoɔ no nnyegye no wɔn amannifoɔ nkyɛn, na wɔmfa nsiesiee efie no baabi a ayɛ agoɔ no ne baabiara a wɔbɛhunu sɛ agoɔ bi wɔ hɔ.
Na Ɔhene Yehoas afe a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmiɛnsa soɔ no, na asɔfoɔ no nnya nsiesiee efie no mu adango no.
Ɛnna Ɔhene Yehoas frɛɛ Ɔsɔfoɔ Yehoiada ne asɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Adɛn nti na monsiesiee efie no mu adango no?
Afei monnnyegye sika amannifoɔ nkyɛn bio, na monyi mma na wɔmfa nyɛ efie no adango no.
Na asɔfoɔ no penee sɛ wɔrennye ɔman no hɔ sika, na wɔrenyɛ efie no mu adango no bio.
Ɛnna Ɔsɔfoɔ Yehoiada faa adaka bi, na ɔtuu ne mmuasoɔ mu tokuro, na ɔde sii afɔrebukyia ho, deɛ wɔfa ba AWURADE fie no nifa; na asɔfoɔ a wɔhwɛ ɛpono no ano no de sika a wɔde ba AWURADE fie no nyinaa guu mu.
Na sɛ wɔhunu sɛ sika pii wɔ adaka no mu a, ɔhene atwerɛfoɔ ne ɔsɔfoɔ panin no foro ba, na wɔbɛkyekyere, na wɔkan sika a wɔhu no AWURADE fie no.
Na wɔde sika a wɔakarie no hyɛɛ wɔn a wɔyɛɛ adwuma no a wɔde wɔn sisii AWURADE fie so ahwɛfoɔ no nsa, na wɔyi maa nnua adwumfoɔ ne adansifoɔ a wɔyɛ AWURADE fie no, ne abantofoɔ, ne abotwafoɔ, ne sɛ wɔde bɛtɔ nnua ne aboɔ a wɔatwa, sɛ wɔde bɛpempam AWURADE fie adango no, ne sɛ wɔde bɛtua efie no adango no bɛsiesie ho adeɛ a wɔhwereɛ nyinaa ka.
Nanso wɔamfa sika a wɔde ba AWURADE fie no mu bi anyɛ AWURADE fie dwetɛ nyowaa, adumgya, nkoraa, ntotorobɛnto anaa sika ne dwetɛ adeɛ biara.
Na wɔde maa wɔn a wɔyɛ adwuma no, na wɔde siesie AWURADE fie no.
Nanso wɔne nnipa a wɔde sika hyɛɛ wɔn nsa sɛ wɔmfa mma adwumayɛfoɔ no ammu nkonta, ɛfiri sɛ wɔyɛɛ no nokorɛ mu.
Asodie afɔdeɛ sika ne bɔne ho afɔdeɛ sika deɛ, wɔamfa amma AWURADE fie; ɛyɛ asɔfoɔ no dea.
Hasael tu Yerusalem so sa Ɛberɛ no mu na Siriahene Hasael foro bɛnee Gat koeɛ, na ɔfae; na Hasael de n’ani kyerɛɛ sɛ ɔreforo aba Yerusalem.
Ɛnna Yudahene Yehoas faa akronkronneɛ nyinaa a n’agyanom Yuda ahemfo Yehosafat, Yehoram ne Ahasia yɛɛ no kronkron no ne n’akronkronneɛ ne sika a wɔhunuu no AWURADE fie ne ahemfie akoradeɛ mu nyinaa, na ɔsoma maa wɔde kɔmaa Siriahene Hasael; ɛnna ɔfirii Yerusalem ho kɔeɛ.
Na Yehoas ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa, wɔatwerɛ no Yuda ahemfo berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu.
Na ne nkoa sɔre pam ne tiri so, na wɔkumm Yehoas wɔ Milo dan a ɛwɔ kwan a ɛde rekɔ Sila no mu.
Na ne nkoa Simeat ba Yosakar ne Somer ba Yehosabad bɔɔ no na ɔwui; na wɔsiee no kaa n’agyanom ho, Dawid kuro mu; na ne ba Amasia bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Yehoahas di Israel so hene Yudahene Ahasia ba Yoas afe a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmiɛnsa so na Yehu ba Yehoahas bɛdii Israel so hene Samaria mfeɛ dunson.
Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, na ɔdii Nebat ba Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no bɔne akyi; wamfiri ho.
Na AWURADE bo fu tiaa Israel, na ɔde wɔn hyɛɛ Siriahene Hasael nsa ne Hasael ba Ben-hadad nsa nna nyinaa.
Na Yehoahas koto srɛɛ AWURADE, na AWURADE tiee no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔhunuu ɔhaw a Siriahene de reha Israel no.
Na AWURADE maa Israel ɔgyefoɔ, na wɔfirii Siriafoɔ nsa ase, na Israel mma tenaa wɔn ntomadan mu sɛ akane no.
Nanso wɔamfiri Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no fie bɔne ho; emu na wɔnanteeɛ.
Na Asera nnua no nso sisii Samaria.
Na wɔannya dɔm biara amma Yehoahas gye apɔnkɔsotefoɔ aduonum ne nteaseɛnam du ne anammɔnmufoɔ mpem du, ɛfiri sɛ na Siriahene asɛe wɔn, na wayɛ wɔn sɛ mfuturo a wɔtiatia soɔ.
Na Yehoahas ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa ne ne mmaninneɛ, wɔantwerɛ no Israel ahemfo berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu?
Na Yehoahas tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no Samaria; na ne ba Yoas bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Yehoas di Israel so hene Yudahene Yoas afe a ɛtɔ so aduasa nson so na Yehoahas ba Yehoas bɛdii Israel so hene wɔ Samaria mfeɛ dunsia.
Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, wamfiri Nebat ba Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no bɔne nyinaa ho; emu na ɔnanteeɛ.
Na Yoas ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa ne ne mmaninneɛ, sɛ ɔne Yudahene Amasia dii ako no, wɔantwerɛ no Israel ahemfo berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu?
Na Yoas tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na Yeroboam bɛtenaa n’adwa so; na wɔsiee Yoas Samaria kaa Israel ahemfo ho.
Elisa nkɔmhyɛ ne ne wuo Nso na Elisa yare ne yadeɛ a ɔde wuiɛ no.
Na Israelhene Yoas siane baa ne nkyɛn bɛsuu n’anim, na ɔkaa sɛ: M’agya, m’agya!
Israel nteaseɛnam ne n’apɔnkɔsotefoɔ!
Ɛnna Elisa ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kɔfa tadua ne agyan!
Na ɔde tadua ne agyan brɛɛ no.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ Israel hene no sɛ: Fa wo nsa sɔ tadua no mu.
Na ɔde ne nsa sɔɔ mu; na Elisa de ne nsa guu ɔhene no nsa so.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Hini apueeɛ mpomma no!
Na ɔhiniiɛ.
Na Elisa se: To!
Na ɔtoe.
Na ɔse: AWURADE nkonimdie agyan, Siria so nkonimdie agyan!
Na wobɛbɔ Siria wɔ Afek akɔsi sɛ wobɛdwerɛ wɔn.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Fa agyan no!
Na ɔtasee.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ Israel hene no sɛ: To bɔ fam!
Na ɔto bɔɔ fam mprɛnsa, na ɔgyaeɛ.
Ɛnna Nyankopɔn nipa no bo fuu no kaa sɛ: Anka ɛsɛ sɛ woto no mprɛnnum anaa nsia; ɛno na anka wobɛbɔ Siria akɔsi sɛ wobɛdwerɛ wɔn; enti nso mprɛnsa pɛ na wobɛbɔ Siria.
Na Elisa wui, na wɔsiee no.
Na afe no baeɛ no, Moabfoɔ afomfafoɔ asafo baa asase no so.
Na wɔrekɔsie onipa bi, na hwɛ, wɔhunuu asafokuo no, wɔtoo onipa no twenee Elisa da mu; na onipa no kɔkaa Elisa nnompe pɛ, ɔnyaa nkwa, na ɔsɔre gyinaa ne nan so.
Yehoas di Ben-hadad so nkonim Na Siriahene Hasael haa Israel, Yehoahas nna nyinaa.
Nanso AWURADE dom wɔn, na ne yam hyehyee no maa wɔn, na ɔdanee ne ho kyerɛɛ wɔn n’apam a ɔne Abraham, Isak ne Yakob pameeɛ no nti, na wampɛ sɛ ɔsɛe wɔn, na wanto wɔn antwene amfiri n’anim de bɛsi seesei.
Na Siriahene Hasael wuiɛ; na ne ba Ben-hadad bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Na Yehoahas ba Yehoas sane kɔgyee Hasael ba Ben-hadad nsam nkuro a ɔde ɔko bɛgyee no n’agya Yehoahas nsam no; mprɛnsa na Yoas bɔɔ no, na ɔgyee Israel nkuro no.
Amasia di Yuda so hene Israelhene Yoahas ba Yoas afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu mu na Yudahene Yoas ba Amasia bɛdii hene.
Ɔbɛdii hene no, na wadi mfeɛ aduonu nnum, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ aduonu nkron wɔ Yerusalem.
Na ne na din de Yehoadin a ɔfiri Yerusalem.
Na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so, nanso na ɛnte sɛ n’agya Dawid; sɛdeɛ n’agya Yoas yɛeɛ no nyinaa na ɔno nso yɛeɛ, nanso sorɔnsorɔmmea no deɛ, wɔanyi.
Ɔman no kɔɔ so bɔɔ afɔdeɛ na wɔhyee aduhwam sorɔnsorɔmmea no so.
Na ahennie no timm ne nsam no, ɔkumm ne nkoa a wɔkumm n’agya ɔhene no.
Na awudifoɔ no mma no deɛ, wanku wɔn, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ no Mose mmara no mu sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ sɛ: Wɔnnkum agyanom mma nti a, nso wɔnkum mma agyanom nti, na mmom obiara bɔne so na wɔnkum no.
Ɔno na ɔkumm Edom mu nnipa mpemdu Nkyene-bonhwa mu, na ɔde ɔko faa Sela, na ɔtoo ne din Yokteel de bɛsi nnɛ.
Ɛberɛ no mu na Amasia somaa abɔfoɔ maa wɔkɔɔ Israelhene Yehu ba Yehoahas ba Yehoas nkyɛn sɛ: Bra, ma yɛnsɔ yɛn ho nhwɛ.
Na Israelhene Yehoas soma maa wɔbaa Yudahene Amasia nkyɛn sɛ: Nkasɛɛ dua a ɛwɔ Lebanon no soma maa wɔkɔɔ tweneduro a ɛwɔ Lebanon no nkyɛn sɛ: Fa wo babaa ma me ba nware.
Na wiram mmoa a wɔwɔ Lebanon no sene bɛtiatiaa nkasɛɛ dua no so.
Kum deɛ woakum Edom, na w’akoma ama wo so.
Ma w’animuonyam nnɔɔso mma wo na tena wo fie, na adɛn nti na wo ne mmusuo rebɛdi aperepereɛ na woahwe aseɛ, wo ne Yuda nyinaa?
Na Amasia antie.
Ɛnna Israelhene Yehoas foro baeɛ, na wɔbɛhyiaam koe, ɔno ne Yudahene Amasia wɔ Bet-semes a ɛyɛ Yuda dea hɔ.
Na Yuda dii nkoguo wɔ Israel anim, na wɔdwane kokɔɔ wɔn ntomadan mu.
Na Israelhene Yoas kyeree Ahasia ba Yehoas ba Yudahene Amasia wɔ Bet-semes; na ɔbaa Yerusalem bɛdwirii Yerusalem fasuo firi Efraim pono no ho de kɔsii ntwea pono no ho basafa ahanan.
Na ɔfaa sika ne dwetɛ nyinaa ne nnwinneɛ a ɔhunuu no AWURADE fie, ne ahemfie akoradeɛ mu, ne nnommum pii, na ɔsane kɔɔ Samaria.
Na Yoas ho nsɛm nkaeɛ, deɛ ɔyɛeɛ ne ne mmaninneɛ ne sɛdeɛ ɔne Yudahene Amasia koeɛ no, wɔantwerɛ no Israel Ahemfo Berɛsosɛm Nwoma no mu?
Na Yehoas tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no Samaria kaa Israel ahemfo ho, na ne ba Yeroboam bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Yuda hene Amasia wuo Yoas ba Yudahene Amasia tenaa ase Yehoahas ba Israelhene Yehoas wuo akyi mfirinhyia dunum.
Na Amasia ho nsɛm nkaeɛ no, wɔatwerɛ no Yuda Ahemfo Berɛsosɛm Nwoma no mu.
Na wɔpam ne tiri so Yerusalem, na ɔdwane kɔɔ Lakis; na wɔsoma maa wɔtii no kɔɔ Lakis, na wɔkɔkumm no wɔ hɔ.
Na wɔde no too apɔnkɔ so bae, na wɔsiee no Yerusalem kaa n’agyanom ho, Dawid kuro mu.
Ɛnna Yuda man no nyinaa faa Asaria a wadi mfeɛ dunsia no na wɔsii no hene sii n’agya Amasia ananmu.
Ɔno na ɔkyekyeree Elat na ɔdane maa Yuda, na akyire yi no ɔhene no tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando.
Yeroboam a ɔtɔ so mmienu di Israel so hene Yudahene Amasia, Yoas ba, afe a ɛtɔ so dunum so na Israelhene Yeroboam, Yoas ba, bɛdii hene, Samaria, na ɔdii adeɛ mfeɛ aduanan baako.
Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, wamfiri Nebat ba Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no bɔne nyinaa ho.
Ɔno na ɔkɔgyee Israel hyeɛ sane maa wɔn de firi Hamat de bɛsi Araba po ano, sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn asɛm a ɔnam n’akoa Amitai ba Yona, odiyifoɔ a ɔfiri Gat-hefer so kaeɛ no.
Na AWURADE hunuu Israel amanehunu, sɛ ɛyɛ nwono papa, na ɔdehyeɛ ne akoa nyinaa kɔ a Israel nni ɔboafoɔ biara.
Nso na AWURADE nkaa sɛ ɔbɛpepa Israel din afiri ɔsoro ase, na ɔnam Yoas ba Yeroboam so gyee wɔn.
Na Yeroboam ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa ne ne mmaninneɛ, sɛdeɛ ɔkoeɛ, ne sɛdeɛ ɔdanee Damasko ne Hamat a na ɛyɛ Yuda dea no maa Israel no, wɔantwerɛ no Israel Ahemfo Berɛsosɛm Nwoma no mu?
Na Yeroboam tii n’agyanom Israel ahemfo wɔ asamando, na ne ba Sakaria bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Asaria di Yuda so hene Israelhene Yeroboam afe a ɛtɔ so aduonu nson mu na Yudahene Amasia ba Asaria bɛdii hene.
Ɔbɛdii hene no, na wadi mfeɛ dunsia, na ɔdii hene mfirinhyia aduonum mmienu wɔ Yerusalem.
Na ne na din ne Yekolia a ɔfiri Yerusalem.
Na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so, sɛdeɛ n’agya Amasia yɛeɛ no nyinaa; gye sorɔnsorɔmmea no na wɔanyie; na ɔman no kɔɔ so bɔɔ afɔdeɛ na wɔhyee aduhwam wɔ sorɔnsorɔmmea no so.
Na AWURADE bɔɔ ɔhene no maa no yaree kwata de kɔsii ne wuda; na ɔkɔtenaa fie foforɔ a obiara nte mu, na ɔhene ba Yotam na ɔdii efie no soɔ na ɔbuu asase no sofoɔ atɛn.
Na Asaria ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa, wɔantwerɛ no Yuda Ahemfo Berɛsosɛm Nwoma no mu?
Na Asaria tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no kaa n’agyanom ho Dawid kuro mu; na ne ba Yotam bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Sakaria di Yuda so hene Yudahene Asaria afe a ɛtɔ so aduasa nwɔtwe mu na Yeroboam ba Sakaria bɛdii Israel so hene Samaria.
Ɔdii hene abosome nsia.
Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne sɛdeɛ n’agyanom yɛeɛ no; wamfiri Nebat ba Yeroboam bɔne a ɔmaa Israel yɛeɛ no ho.
Na Yabes ba Salum pam ne tiri so, na ɔbɔɔ no Ibleam kumm no, na ɔsii n’ananmu dii hene.
Na Sakaria ho nsɛm nkaeɛ no, hwɛ, wɔatwerɛ no Israel Ahemfo Berɛsosɛm Nwoma no mu.
(Ɛno ne AWURADE asɛm no a ɔka kyerɛɛ Yehu sɛ: W’awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛtɔ so nnan mu mma bɛtena Israel adwa so no baa mu.)
Salum di Israel so hene Yabes ba Salum bɛdii hene, Yudahene Usia afe a ɛtɔ so aduasa nkron mu; na ɔdii hene bosome wɔ Samaria.
Na Gadi ba Menahem firii Tirsa foro baa Samaria, na ɔbɛbɔɔ Yabes ba Salum wɔ Samaria kumm no, na ɔsii n’ananmu dii hene.
Na Salum ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne n’apam a ɔpameeɛ no, hwɛ, wɔatwerɛ no Israel Ahemfo Berɛsosɛm Nwoma no mu.
Ɛberɛ no mu no Menahem firii Tirsa kɔkum Tifsa ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa ne ɛho asase, ɛfiri sɛ wɔanhini no nti, ɔkumm wɔn, na ɔpaepaee emu anyinsɛnfoɔ nyinaa mu.
Menahem di Israel so hene Yudahene Asaria afe a ɛtɔ so aduasa nkron mu na Gadi ba Menahem bɛdii Israel so hene mfeɛ du wɔ Samaria.
Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, wamfiri Nebat ba Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no bɔne ho ne nna nyinaa.
Asiriahene Pul baa asase no so, na Menahem maa Pul dwetɛ dwetikɛseɛ apem, sɛ ɔmmoa no nhyɛ ne nsa mu den, n’ahennie no mu.
Na Menahem gyegyee Israel hɔ toɔ, mmarima a wɔbɛtumi nyinaa hɔ dwetɛ nnwetɛbena aduonum aduonum, sɛ ɔde rekɔma Asiriahene.
Ɛnna Asiriahene nsa kaeɛ no ɔsaneeɛ, na wannyina asase no so hɔ.
Na Menahem ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa, wɔantwerɛ no Israel Ahemfo Berɛsosɛm Nwoma no mu?
Na Menahem tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na ne ba Pekahia bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Pekahia di Israel so hene Yudahene Asaria afe a ɛtɔ so aduonum mu na Menahem ba Pekahia bɛdii Israel so hene Samaria mfeɛ mmienu.
Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne.
Wamfiri Nebat ba Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no bɔne ho.
Na ne kunini Peka a ɔyɛ Remalia ba pam ne tiri so, na ɔbɔɔ no Samaria ahemfie aban mu, ɔne Argob ne Arie, na Gileadfoɔ mma mu mmarima aduonum ka ne ho; na ɔkumm no, na ɔbɛdii n’adeɛ.
Na Pekahia ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa, hwɛ, wɔatwerɛ no Israel Ahemfo Berɛsosɛm Nwoma mu.
Yudahene Asaria afe a ɛtɔ so aduonum mmienu mu na Remalia ba Peka bɛdii Israel so hene Samaria mfeɛ aduonu.
Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne.
Wamfiri Nebat ba Yeroboam a ɔmaa Israel yɛɛ bɔne no bɔne ho.
Israelhene Peka berɛ so na Asiriahene Tiglat-pileser ba bɛfaa Iyon, Abel-bet-maaka, Yanoa, Kedes, Hasor, Gilead ne Galilea, Naftali asase nyinaa, na ɔtuu wɔn kɔɔ Asiria.
Na Ela ba Hosea pam Remalia ba Peka tiri so, na ɔbɔɔ no kumm no, na ɔbɛdii n’adeɛ Usia ba Yotam afe a ɛtɔ so aduonu mu.
Na Peka ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa, hwɛ, wɔatwerɛ no Israel ahemfo berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu.
Yotam di Yuda so hene Israelhene Remalia ba Peka afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu mu na Yudahene Usia ba Yotam bɛdii hene.
Ɔbɛdii hene no, na wadi mfeɛ aduonu nnum, na mfirinhyia dunsia na ɔdii hene Yerusalem.
Na ne na din de Yerusa a ɔyɛ Sadok babaa.
Na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so, sɛdeɛ n’agya Usia yɛeɛ nyinaa na ɔyɛeɛ; gye sorɔnsorɔmmea na wanyiyie, na ɔman no kɔɔ so bɔɔ afɔdeɛ, hyee nnuhwam wɔ so.
Ɔno na ɔsii AWURADE fie pono a ɛkorɔn no.
Na Yotam ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa, wɔantwerɛ no Yuda ahemfo berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu?
Nna no mu na AWURADE firii aseɛ somaa Siriahene Resin ne Remalia ba Peka baa Yuda soɔ.
Na Yotam tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no kaa n’agyanom ho, n’agya Dawid kuro mu, na ne ba Ahas bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Ahas di Yuda so hene Remalia ba Peka afe a ɛtɔ so dunson mu na Yudahene Yotam ba Ahas bɛdii hene.
Ahas bɛdii hene no, na wadi mfirinhyia aduonu, na ɔdii hene mfirinhyia dunsia Yerusalem.
Na wanyɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE, ne Nyankopɔn, ani so sɛ n’agya Dawid.
Na ɔfaa Israel ahemfo kwan so, na ne ba mpo ɔde no bɔɔ afɔdeɛ sɛ amanaman a AWURADE tuu wɔn firii Israel mma anim no akyiwadeɛ a na wɔyɛ.
Na ɔbobɔɔ afɔdeɛ na ɔhyee nnuhwam sorɔnsorɔmmea ne nkokoɔ so ne nnua frɔmfrɔm nyinaa ase.
Ɛberɛ no mu na Siriahene Resin ne Israelhene Remalia ba Peka foro baa Yerusalem bɛkoeɛ; na wɔkaa Ahas hyɛɛ mu, nanso wɔantumi anni ne so.
Ɛberɛ no mu ara na Siriahene Resin gyee Elat sane maa Siria, na ɔpamoo Yudafoɔ no firii Elat, na Edomfoɔ baa Elat bɛtenaa hɔ de bɛsi nnɛ.
Na Ahas somaa abɔfoɔ maa wɔkɔɔ Asiriahene Tiglat-pileser nkyɛn sɛ: W’akoa ne wo ba ne me; foro bra bɛgye me Siriahene ne Israel hene a wɔasɔre atia me yi nsam.
Na Ahas faa dwetɛ ne sika a wɔhunuu no AWURADE fie ne ahemfie akoradeɛ mu no soma maa wɔde kɔmaa Asiriahene sɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ.
Na Asiriahene tiee no, na Asiriahene foro baa Damasko, na ɔbɛfae, na ɔtuu wɔn kɔduaa Kir, na ɔkum Resin.
Na Ɔhene Ahas sii mu kɔhyiaa Asiriahene Tiglat-pileser wɔ Damasko; na ɔkɔhunuu afɔrebukyia a ɛwɔ Damasko no, na Ɔhene Ahas de afɔrebukyia no nsɛsoɔ ne nsususoɔ sɛdeɛ ne yɛbea nyinaa teɛ soma maa wɔde brɛɛ Ɔsɔfoɔ Uria.
Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Uria sii afɔrebukyia no sɛdeɛ Ɔhene Ahas soma firii Damasko de brɛɛ no no, saa na Ɔsɔfoɔ Uria yɛ twɛnee ba a Ɔhene Ahas firi Damasko baeɛ.
Na ɔhene firi Damasko baeɛ no, ɔhene bɛhunuu afɔrebukyia no, na ɔhene twe pinii afɔrebukyia no ho, na ɔbɔɔ so ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ.
Na ɔhyee ne hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne n’aduane afɔdeɛ, na ɔhwiee n’ahwiesa, na ɔde n’asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ mogya petee afɔrebukyia no so.
Na kɔbere mfrafraeɛ afɔrebukyia a ɛsi AWURADE anim no, ɔtwe firii asɔredan no anim, afɔrebukyia foforɔ no ne AWURADE dan no ntam de kɔsii afɔrebukyia no nkyɛn mu atifi fam.
Na Ɔhene Ahas hyɛɛ Ɔsɔfoɔ Uria sɛ: Afɔrebukyia kɛseɛ no so na hye anɔpa hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne anwummerɛ aduane afɔdeɛ ne ɔhene hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne n’aduane afɔdeɛ ne asase yi sofoɔ nyinaa hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne wɔn aduane afɔdeɛ ne wɔn ahwiesa, na fa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ mogya nyinaa ne okum afɔdeɛ nyinaa mogya pete so; na kɔbere mfrafraeɛ afɔrebukyia no nsi me hɔ na makɔ so abisa.
Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Uria yɛɛ sɛdeɛ Ɔhene Ahas hyɛɛ no no nyinaa.
Na Ɔhene Ahas twitwaa nnaka no nhyehyɛmu no, na ɔyiyii so nnwaresɛn no, na ɔyii dwaresɛn no firii kɔbere mfrafraeɛ anantwie a ɛwɔ aseɛ no so, na ɔde sii mmoseaa bi so.
Na ɔkwan a wɔakata soɔ a wɔfa so homeda a wɔyɛɛ no efie no mu, ne ɔhene mfikyikwan no, Asiriahene nti ɔyi kɔtoo AWURADE fie.
Na Ahas ho nsɛm nkaeɛ, deɛ ɔyɛeɛ no, wɔantwerɛ no Yuda Ahemfo Berɛsosɛm Nwoma no mu?
Na Ahas tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no kaa n’agyanom ho Dawid kuro mu; na ne ba Hesekia bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Hosea yɛ Israel hene a ɔdi akyire Yudahene Ahas afe a ɛtɔ so dummienu mu na Ela ba Hosea bɛdii Israel so hene wɔ Samaria mfeɛ nkron.
Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne, nanso na ɛnte sɛ Israel ahemfo a wɔdii n’anim no.
Ɔno so na Asiriahene Salmaneser baeɛ, na Hosea bɛyɛɛ n’akoa, na ɔtuaa apeatoɔ maa no.
Na Asiriahene hunuu sɛ Hosea apam ne tiri so, sɛ wasoma abɔfoɔ ama wɔakɔ Misraimhene So nkyɛn, na wamfa apeatoɔ ankɔma Asiriahene sɛ daa afe no.
Na Asiriahene bɛkyekyeree no kɔtoo nneduadan mu.
Na Asiriahene tu baa asase no nyinaa so, na ɔbaa Samaria bɛkaa no hyɛɛ mu mfeɛ mmiɛnsa.
Hosea afe a ɛtɔ so nkron mu na Asiriahene faa Samaria, na ɔtuu Israel kɔɔ Asiria, na ɔde wɔn kɔduaa Hala ne Habor, Gosan asubɔnten ho, ne Media nkuro mu.
Asiria tukorɔ Na ɛbaa saa, ɛfiri sɛ na Israelfoɔ ayɛ AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn a ɔyii wɔn Misraim asase soɔ Misraimhene Farao nsam baeɛ no bɔne, na wɔakɔsom anyame foforɔ, na wɔanante amanaman a AWURADE tuu wɔn firii Israel mma anim no amammerɛ ne Israel ahemfo deɛ a wɔhyehyɛeɛ no mu.
Na Israelfoɔ no nam aseɛ dii nsɛm a ɛmfata, na ɛne AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn dii asie, na wɔsisii sorɔnsorɔmmea, wɔn nkuro nyinaa mu, ɛfiri awɛmfoɔ abantenten so kɔsi afasuo nkuro so, na wɔyeyɛɛ adum ne Asera nnua, nkokoɔ a ɛkorɔn nyinaa so, ne nnua frɔmfrɔm nyinaa ase maa wɔn ho.
Na ɛhɔ na wɔhyee nnuhwam sorɔnsorɔmmea nyinaa, sɛ amanaman a AWURADE tutuu wɔn firii wɔn anim no, na wɔdii nsɛmmɔne de huruu AWURADE bo.
Na wɔsonsom ahonihuhuo a AWURADE aka wɔn ɛho asɛm sɛ: Monnni saa asɛm yi, no.
Na AWURADE nam n’adiyifoɔ nyinaa ne adehunufoɔ nyinaa so dii Israel ne Yuda adanseɛ sɛ: Monsane mfiri mo akwammɔne no so, na monni me mmara nsɛm ne m’ahyɛdeɛ so, sɛ mmara a mehyɛɛ mo agyanom a menam me nkoa adiyifoɔ no so memaa wɔde brɛɛ mo no nyinaa.
Nanso wɔantie, na wɔsensenee wɔn kɔn sɛ wɔn agyanom a wɔannye AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn annie no kɔn.
Na wɔpoo n’ahyɛdeɛ ne n’apam a ɔne wɔn agyanom pameeɛ ne n’adanseɛ a ɔdii wɔn no, na wɔkɔdii ahuhudeɛ akyi dii ahuhusɛm, na wɔkɔdii amanaman a wɔatwa wɔn ho ahyia a AWURADE hyɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnnyɛ sɛ wɔn no akyi.
Na wɔgyaa AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn mmara nyinaa, na wɔyɛɛ ahoni a wɔaguo, nantwie mma mmienu fae, na wɔyɛɛ Asera nnua, na wɔsɔree ɔsoro asafo nyinaa, na wɔsom Baal.
Na wɔmemaa wɔn mmammarima ne wɔn mmammaa fefaa ogya mu, na wɔhyehyɛɛ nkɔm bisabisaa adeɛ, na wɔtontɔn wɔn ho sɛ wɔbɛyɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne de ahuru ne bo.
Enti na AWURADE faa Israel abufuo sɛɛ, na ɔyii wɔn firii n’anim, wannya obiara sɛ Yuda abusuakuo nko.
Yuda nso anni AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm so, na wɔnantee Israel ahyɛdeɛ a wɔyɛeɛ no mu.
Enti na AWURADE poo Israel asefoɔ nyinaa, na ɔbrɛɛ wɔn ase, na ɔde wɔn hyɛɛ afomfafoɔ nsa kɔsii sɛ ɔtoo wɔn firii n’anim guiɛ.
Na Israel te firii Dawid fie ho, na wɔde Nebat ba Yeroboam sii hene, na Yeroboam twee Israel firii AWURADE akyiridie ho, maa wɔyɛɛ bɔne kɛse.
Na Israelfoɔ kɔnantee Yeroboam bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ no nyinaa mu; wɔamfiri ho de kɔsii sɛ AWURADE yii Israel firii n’anim, sɛdeɛ ɔnam ne nkoa adiyifoɔ no nyinaa so kaeɛ no.
Ɛno na wɔtuu Israel firii n’asase so kɔɔ Asiria de bɛsi nnɛ.
Samariafoɔ asefire Na Asiriahene kɔfaa nnipa firii Babel ne Kuta ne Awa ne Hamat ne Sefarwaim de wɔn bɛduaa Samaria nkuro mu sii Israelfoɔ no ananmu, na wɔdii Samaria so na wɔtenaa ne nkuro mu.
Na ɛbaa sɛ wɔn hɔ tena mfitiaseɛ mu no na wɔnsuro AWURADE, na AWURADE somaa agyata maa wɔbaa wɔn mu a wɔkunkumm wɔn mu binom.
Na wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ Asiriahene sɛ: Amanaman a woatutu wɔn de wɔn abɛdua Samaria nkuro mu yi, wɔnnim asase no so Nyankopɔn no atemmudeɛ, enti wasoma agyata ama wɔaba wɔn mu, na hwɛ, wɔrekunkum wɔn, ɛsiane sɛ wɔnnim asase no so Nyankopɔn atemmudeɛ.
Ɛnna Asiriahene no hyɛɛ sɛ: Momma asɔfoɔ a moatu wɔn hɔ no mu baako nkɔ hɔ, na ɔnkɔ nkɔtena hɔ, na ɔnkyerɛkyerɛ wɔn asase no so Nyankopɔn no atemmudeɛ.
Na asɔfoɔ a wɔtuu wɔn firii Samaria no mu baako ba bɛtenaa Betel, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ wɔn sɛdeɛ wɔnsuro AWURADE.
Nanso amanaman no yeyɛɛ wɔn anyame, na wɔde wɔn sisii sorɔnsorɔmmea adan a Samariafoɔ yeyɛeɛ no mu; ɔman biara, wɔn nkuro a wɔte mu no mu.
Na Babelfoɔ no yɛɛ Sukot Benot, na Kutfoɔ no yɛɛ Nergal, na Hamatfoɔ no yɛɛ Asima, na Awifoɔ no yɛɛ Nibhas ne Tartak.
Na Sefarwifoɔ de ogya hyehyee wɔn mma maa Adramelek ne Anamelek, Sefarwaim anyame no.
Na wɔsuroo AWURADE nso, na kuro biara yii nipa yɛɛ no sorɔnsorɔmmea sɔfoɔ, wɔn na wɔbobɔɔ afɔdeɛ maa wɔn sorɔnsorɔmmea afie no mu.
Wɔsuroo AWURADE deɛ, nanso wɔsonsom wɔn ara wɔn anyame, sɛ amanaman a wɔtuu wɔn firii hɔ baeɛ no amanneɛ teɛ.
Ɛde bɛsi nnɛ yi ara, wɔyɛ sɛ kane nneyɛɛ no.
Wɔnsuro AWURADE, nso wɔnyɛ sɛdeɛ wɔn ahyɛdeɛ, anaa wɔn atemmudeɛ, anaa mmara, anaa ɛmom a AWURADE hyɛɛ Yakob a ɔtoo no din Israel no mma no.
Wɔn na AWURADE ne wɔn pameeɛ, na ɔhyɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monnsuro anyame foforɔ, na monnsɔre wɔn na monnsom wɔn, na mommmɔ wɔn afɔdeɛ, na mmom AWURADE a ɔde ahoɔden kɛseɛ ne basa a watene mu kɔyii mo firii Misraim asase so baeɛ no, ɔno na monsuro no, na ɔno na monsɔre no, na ɔno na mommɔ no afɔdeɛ.
Na ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ ne mmara ne ɛmom a ɔtwerɛ maa mo no, monni so nyɛ no mo nna nyinaa, na monnsuro anyame foforɔ.
Na apam a me ne mo pameeɛ no, mommma mo werɛ mmfi, na monnsuro anyame foforɔ, na mmom AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn na monsuro no, na ɔno na ɔbɛyi mo afiri mo atamfoɔ nyinaa nsam.
Nanso wɔantie, na mmom sɛ wɔn kane yɛbea teɛ no ara na wɔyɛeɛ.
Sɛɛ na amanaman yi suro AWURADE, na wɔsonsom wɔn ahoni a wɔasensene no, wɔn mma ne wɔn mma mma nso, sɛdeɛ wɔn agyanom yɛeɛ no, saa ara na wɔn nso wɔyɛ de bɛsi nnɛ.
Hesekia di Yuda so hene Na Israelhene Ela ba Hosea afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu na Yudahene Ahas ba Hesekia bɛdii hene.
Ɔbɛdii hene no, na wadi mfirinhyia aduonu nnum, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ aduonu nkron wɔ Yerusalem.
Na ne na din de Abi a ɔyɛ Sakaria babaa.
Na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so, sɛdeɛ n’agya Dawid yɛeɛ nyinaa.
Ɔyiyii sorɔnsorɔmmea no, na ɔbubuu adum no, na ɔtwitwaa Asera nnua no guiɛ, na ɔbubuu kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ɔwɔ a Mose yɛeɛ no; ɛfiri sɛ saa berɛ no, na Israelfoɔ hye aduhwam ma no, na wɔfrɛ no Nehustan.
AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn so na ɔde ne ho toeɛ, na n’akyiri no, obiara amma sɛ ɔno Yuda ahemfo nyinaa mu, na obiara anni n’anim saa.
Na ɔbataa AWURADE ho, wansane amfiri n’akyi, na ɔdii mmara nsɛm a AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no so.
Na AWURADE dii n’akyi; baabiara a na ɔfiri korɔ no, ɔnya siadeɛ; na ɔtee Asiriahene so atua, na wansom no.
Ɔno na ɔkunkumm Filistifoɔ kɔduruu Gasa ne ɛho asase so, de firi awɛmfoɔ abantenten so kɔsii kuro a afasuo atwa ho ahyia no so.
Na ɛbaa sɛ, Ɔhene Hesekia afe a ɛtɔ so nnan a ɛyɛ Israelhene Ela ba Hosea afe a ɛtɔ so nson mu no, Asiriahene Salmaneser foro baa Samaria so bɛkaa no hyɛɛ mu, na mfeɛ mmiɛnsa awieeɛ no wɔfae.
Hesekia afe a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛne Israelhene Hosea afe a ɛtɔ so nkron no mu na wɔfaa Samaria.
Na Asiriahene tuu Israel kɔɔ Asiria, na ɔde wɔn kɔguu Hala ne Habor, Gosan asubɔnten ho, ne Media nkuro mu, ɛfiri sɛ wɔantie AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn, na wɔtoo n’apam ne deɛ AWURADE akoa Mose hyɛeɛ no nyinaa, na wɔantie na wɔanyɛ.
Asiriafoɔ bɔ Yerusalem nterɛnnee Na Ɔhene Hesekia afe a ɛtɔ so dunan mu na Asiriahene Sanaherib tu baa Yuda nkuro a ɛyɛ den nyinaa so bɛfaeɛ.
Na Yudahene Hesekia soma maa wɔkɔɔ Asiriahene nkyɛn wɔ Lakis sɛ: Mayɛ bɔne; sane firi me so, na deɛ wode bɛto me soɔ no, mɛsoa.
Na Asiriahene hyɛɛ sɛ Yudahene Hesekia ntua dwetɛ dwetikɛseɛ ahasa ne sika dwetikɛseɛ aduasa.
Na Hesekia de dwetɛ a wɔhunuu no AWURADE fie ne ahemfie akoradeɛ mu no nyinaa mae.
Ɛberɛ no mu na Hesekia twitwaa AWURADE aban apono ne adum ho sika a Yudahene Hesekia de duraduraa ho no, na ɔde maa Asiriahene.
Ɛnna Asiriahene somaa ne sahene anaa Tartan, ne piafoɔ panin anaa Rabsaris, ne nsahyɛfoɔ panin anaa Rabsake no firi Lakis ne dɔm a emu yɛ duro baa Ɔhene Hesekia so wɔ Yerusalem; na wɔforo baa Yerusalem.
Na wɔforo baeɛ no, wɔbɛgyinaa atifi tareɛ a ɛwɔ Ntomasifoɔ Asasewa no tempɔn ho no suka ho.
Na wɔbɛfrɛɛ ɔhene.
Ɛnna Hilkia ba Eliakim a ɔdi efie no soɔ ne Ɔtwerɛfoɔ Sebna ne ɔsɛnkaefoɔ Asaf ba Yoa firii adi kɔɔ wɔn nkyɛn.
Na Rabsake no ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monka nkyerɛ Hesekia sɛ: Sɛ ɔhenkɛseɛ no, Asiria hene no seɛ nie: Ɛdeɛn koraa na wode wo ho to soɔ yi?
Wosusu sɛ anosɛm nko yɛ akodie ho nyansa ne mmaninyɛ!
Na afei, hwan so na wode wo ho toɔ a enti wote me so atua yi?
Afei, hwɛ, wode wo ho to demmire a abuo yi so, ɛne Misraim a sɛ obi twere no a, ɛwɔ ne nsam hwire mu!
Saa na Misraimhene Farao teɛ ma wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to ne soɔ nyinaa.
Na sɛ moka kyerɛ me sɛ: AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn so na yɛde yɛn ho toɔ a, ɛnyɛ ɔno na Hesekia ayi ne sorɔnsorɔmmea ne n’afɔrebukyia, na wase Yuda ne Yerusalem sɛ: Afɔrebukyia a ɛwɔ Yerusalem yi anim na monsɔreɛ?
Na afei bra na ɛne me wura Asiriahene nto nkyea ɛ, na mɛma wo apɔnkɔ mpem mmienu, sɛ wobɛtumi anya nnipa atenatena wɔn so anaa.
Na nteaseɛnam ne apɔnkɔfoɔ nti, wode wo ho akɔto Misraim soɔ yi, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na woadane me wura nkoa nketewa mu safohene baako ani?
Afei, mekwatii AWURADE na mebaa ha yi sɛ merebɛsɛe ha anaa?
AWURADE na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Tu kɔ asase yi so kɔsɛe no.
Na Hilkia ba Eliakim ne Sebna ne Yoa ka kyerɛɛ Rabsake no sɛ: Ɛne wo nkoa nkasa Aramaik kasa, na yɛn deɛ, yɛte, na ɛne yɛn nnkasa Yuda kasa nkurɔfoɔ a wɔboa ɔfasuo soɔ no aso mu.
Na Rabsake no bisaa wɔn sɛ: Wo wura ne wo nkyɛn na me wura somaa me sɛ memmɛka nsɛm yi anaa?
Ɛnyɛ mmarima a wɔtete ɔfasuo soɔ yi nkyɛn sɛ wɔnni wɔn ara wɔn sɛbeɛ na wɔnnom wɔn dwonsɔ sɛ mo ara?
Ɛnna Rabsake no gyinaeɛ na ɔde ɛnne kɛseɛ teaa mu Yuda kasa mu kaa sɛ: Montie ɔhenkɛseɛ no, Asiriahene no asɛm: Sɛ ɔhene seɛ nie: Mommma Hesekia nnaadaa mo, na ɔrentumi nnye mo mfiri ne nsam, nso mommma Hesekia mmma mommfa mo ho nnto AWURADE so sɛ: Gyeɛ na AWURADE bɛgye yɛn, na wɔremfa kuro yi nhyɛ Asiriahene nsa.
Monntie Hesekia, na sɛ Asiriahene seɛ nie: Mo ne me nni asomdwoeɛsɛm, na momfiri mmra me nkyɛn, na monni mo bobe ne mo borɔdɔma no bi, na monnom mo mmura mu nsuo nkɔsi sɛ mɛba mabɛfa mo akɔ asase a ɛte sɛ mo asase yi soɔ, ayuo ne nsa asase, aduane ne bobe nturo asase, ngodua ne ɛwoɔ asase so, na moanya nkwa na moanwu.
Na sɛ Hesekia to mo tɛkyerɛmakyene sɛ: AWURADE bɛgye yɛn a, monntie.
Amanaman anyame no mu bi agye n’asase afiri Asiriahene nsam pɛn?
Ɛhe na Hamat ne Arpad anyame no wɔ?
Ɛhe na Sefarwaim, Hena ne Iwa anyame no wɔ?
Wɔagye Samaria me nsam?
Nsase no so anyame nyinaa mu hwannom na wɔagye wɔn nsase afiri me nsam, na AWURADE bɛgye Yerusalem afiri me nsam anaa?
Na ɔman no muaa wɔn ano, na wɔammua no asɛm biara, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ ɔhene asɛm a ɔhyɛɛ sɛ: Mommmua no!
Ɛnna Hilkia ba Eliakim a na ɔdi efie no soɔ no ne Ɔtwerɛfoɔ Sebna ne Asaf ba Ɔsɛnkaefoɔ Yoa de wɔn ntadeɛ a wɔasunsuane mu baa Hesekia nkyɛn bɛkaa Rabsake no nsɛm no kyerɛɛ no.
Hesekia bɔ mpaeɛ, na Yesaia hyɛ no aboɔduro Na Ɔhene Hesekia teeɛ no, ɔsunsuanee ne ntadeɛ mu na ɔfiraa ayitoma na ɔsii mu kɔɔ AWURADE fie.
Na ɔsomaa Eliakim a na ɔdi efie no soɔ ne Ɔtwerɛfoɔ Sebna ne asɔfoɔ mu mpanimfoɔ a wɔfirafira ayitoma kɔɔ Amos ba Odiyifoɔ Yesaia nkyɛn, na wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ Hesekia seɛ nie: Ahohiahia ne asotwe ne nsopa da ne nnɛ, na mma aduru awotwaa ano, na ahoɔden nni hɔ a wɔde bɛwo wɔn.
Ebia AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛte Rabsake no a ne wura Asiria hene asoma no sɛ ɔmmɛsopa Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ no nsɛm, na nsɛm a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ateɛ no nti, watwe n’aso.
Enti ma wo mpaebɔ so ma nnipa nkaeɛ a wɔwɔ hɔ no.
Na Ɔhene Hesekia nkoa no baa Yesaia nkyɛn.
Na Yesaia ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ monka nkyerɛ mo wura nie: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Nsuro nsɛm a woteeɛ a Asiriahene nkoa de abɛya me no anim.
Hwɛ, mede honhom bi bɛhyɛ ne mu, na wate nsɛm bi, na wasane akɔ n’asase so, na mama no atɔ nkrantɛ ano n’asase so.
Asiriafoɔ sane bɔ nterɛnnee bio Na Rabsake no sanee, na ɔkɔtoo Asiriahene sɛ ɔne Libna reko, ɛfiri sɛ na wate sɛ watu afiri Lakis.
Na ɔtee Etiopiahene Tirhaka nka sɛ: Hwɛ, watu ne wo rebɛko.
Na ɔsane somaa abɔfoɔ baa Hesekia nkyɛn bio sɛ: Sɛ monkɔka nkyerɛ Yudahene Hesekia nie: Mma wo Nyankopɔn a wode wo ho ato ne soɔ no nnaadaa wo sɛ: Wɔremfa Yerusalem nhyɛ Asiriahene nsa.
Hwɛ, wo ara woate deɛ Asiria ahemfo ayeyɛ nsase nyinaa, asɛe no pasapasa no, na wo na wɔbɛgye woɔ anaa?
Amanaman a m’agyanom asɛe wɔn, Gosan, Haran, Resef ne Edenfoɔ a wɔwɔ Telasar no anyame no gyee wɔn anaa?
Ɛhe na Hamathene, Arpadhene, Sefarwaim kuro, Hena ne Iwahene no wɔ?
Na Hesekia gyee nwoma no abɔfoɔ no nsam, na ɔkenkanee; na ɔforo kɔɔ AWURADE fie, na Hesekia trɛɛ mu too AWURADE anim.
Na Hesekia bɔɔ AWURADE anim mpaeɛ sɛ: AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn a wote Kerubim soɔ, wo nko wone Onyankopɔn asase so ahennie nyinaa mu; wo na woyɛɛ ɔsoro ne asase.
Brɛ w’aso ase, AWURADE, na tie!
Bue w’ani, AWURADE, na hwɛ!
Na tie Sanaherib nsɛm a wasoma sɛ wɔmfa mmɛsopa wo, Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ no.
Ɛwom, AWURADE, Asiria ahemfo asɛe amanaman ne wɔn nsase, na wɔatoto wɔn anyame agu ogya mu, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnyɛ anyame, na ɛyɛ onipa nsa ano adwuma, dua ne ɔboɔ nko ara, na wɔasɛe wɔn.
Enti afei, AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn, gye yɛn firi ne nsam, na asase so ahennie nyinaa nhunu sɛ wo, AWURADE, ne Onyankopɔn, wo nkutoo ara nko!
Yesaia asɛm a ɔde kɔma Ɔhene Ɛnna Amos ba Yesaia soma maa wɔkɔɔ Hesekia nkyɛn sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Deɛ wobɔɔ me ɛho mpaeɛ Asiriahene Sanaherib ho no, mate.
Yei ne asɛm a AWURADE aka agu ne soɔ no: Ɔbaabunu Sion babaa no bu wo animtia yi wo ahi, Yerusalem babaa rewoso ne ti wɔ w’akyiri.
Hwan na woasopa no na woaya no?
Na hwan so na woama wo nne soɔ na woama w’ani atra wo ntɔn?
Wode atia Israel Kronkronni no.
W’abɔfoɔ so na wonam asopa AWURADE, na woaka sɛ: Mede me nteaseɛnam dodoɔ no maforo kɔ mmepɔ atifi Lebanon mu nohoa tɔnn; na mɛtwitwa ne ntweneduro atentene ne pepeaa a ɛyɛ fɛ no agu na makɔduru, n’atenaeɛ a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri, ne kwaeɛbirentuo mu.
Me na matutu mmura manom amannɔne nsuo, na mede me nammuromu mawe Misraim nsubɔntene nyinaa.
Adɛn wontee, sɛ mefiri meyɛeɛ akyɛreɛ?
Na mefiri tete mmerɛ mu na mehyɛɛ no saa, na mama no aba mu, sɛ wɔnsɛe nkuro a afasuo atwa ho ahyia mma no nnanedane akurofo akuakuo, na emufoɔ no, wɔn nsa anso hwee yɛ, wɔn akoma tui na wɔn ani wui, wɔdanedanee mfofowa so ahahan ne wira mono, adan atifi wira ne ayuo a amma ne ho soɔ na ahoa.
Na menim w’asetena, ne w’adifire ne wo muba no, ɛne wo dam a wobɔ no me soɔ no.
Ɛsiane sɛ wobɔ me so dam, na w’ahantan aforo abɛduru m’aso mu nti, mede me kaa bɛhyɛ wo hwenem na mede me nnareka bɛto w’ano mu, na masane wo afa ɔkwan a wonam so baeɛ no so akɔ.
Na yei nyɛ wo nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ: Afe yi mu monni ntwakaeɛ a ɛfifiriiɛ, na afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu no mu, deɛ ɛbɛdi akyire aba.
Na afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu no, mongu na montwa, na montɛ bobe nturo, na monni mu aba.
Na Yuda fie mu wɔn a wɔagye wɔn afiri mu a wɔaka no, wɔn ase bɛgye nhini bio, na wɔaso aba wɔ soro.
Na Yerusalem na nnipa nkaeɛ bi bɛfire, na nnipa a wɔafiri mu anya nkwa nso afiri Sion bepɔ so, AWURADE ninkuntwe na ɛbɛyɛ yei.
Enti sɛ AWURADE se Asiriahene ho nie: Ɔremma kuro yi mu, na ɔrento agyan mma ha, na ɔremfa ɛkyɛm mmɛhyia no, na ɔrenhɔre pie ntia no.
Ɔkwan a ɔnam so baeɛ no so na ɔnam bɛsane akorɔ, na kuro yi deɛ, ɔremma mu, AWURADE na ɔseɛ.
Na mɛbɔ kuro yi ho ban na magye no, me ara ne m’akoa Dawid nti!
Asiriafoɔ di nkoguo Na anadwo no ara AWURADE bɔfoɔ firi kɔkumm Asiria nsra mu nnipa mpemha aduɔwɔtwe nnum; na wɔsɔree anɔpa no, na hwɛ, na wɔn nyinaa yɛ awufoɔ afunu.
Ɛnna Asiriahene Sanaherib sii mu saneeɛ, na ɔkɔtenaa Ninewe.
Na ɔresɔre ne nyame Nisrok fie no, ne mma Adramelek ne Sareser de nkrantɛ kumm no, na wɔfiri hɔ dwane kɔɔ Ararat asase so.
Na ne ba Esarhadon bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Hesekia yadeɛ ne n’ayaresa Nna no mu no Hesekia yaree owuyadeɛ.
Na Amos ba, Odiyifoɔ Yesaia baa ne nkyɛn bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Hyɛ wo fie nsamanseɛ, na worebɛwu na worennya nkwa.
Ɛnna Hesekia danee n’ani kyerɛɛ ɔfasuo, na ɔbɔɔ AWURADE mpaeɛ sɛ: Ao, AWURADE, kae sɛdeɛ manante w’anim nokorɛ ne akoma a ɛyɛ pɛ mu, na mayɛ deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ w’ani soɔ.
Na Hesekia suu esu kɛseɛ.
Na ɛbaa sɛ, Yesaia nnya mfirii mfimfini abannwa no mu no, AWURADE asɛm baa ne nkyɛn sɛ: Sane kɔka kyerɛ Hesekia, me man so hwɛfoɔ no sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE, w’agya Dawid Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Mate wo mpaebɔ, mahunu wo nisuo, hwɛ, me na mɛsa wo yadeɛ.
Da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no wobɛforo akɔ AWURADE fie.
Na mede mfirinhyia dunum bɛto wo nna so, na mɛgye wo ne kuro yi afiri Asiriahene nsam, na mabɔ kuro yi ho ban, me ara ne m’akoa Dawid nti.
Na Yesaia se: Momfa borɔdɔma a wɔabɔ no ɛtoa mmra.
Na momfa ntare mpɔmpɔ no so na ɔnya nkwa.
Na Hesekia bisaa Yesaia sɛ: Ɛdeɛn ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ sɛ AWURADE bɛsa me yadeɛ, na da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no mɛkɔ AWURADE fie?
Na Yesaia se: Yei nyɛ wo AWURADE nsam nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ sɛ AWURADE bɛyɛ adeɛ a waka no: Sunsum no nkɔ anim ntwedeɛ du anaasɛ ɛnsane n’akyi ntwedeɛ du?
Na Hesekia se: Ɛyɛ mmerɛ ma sunsum sɛ ɛsiane ntwedeɛ du, dabi, na ma sunsum no nsane n’akyi ntwedeɛ du.
Ɛnna Odiyifoɔ Yesaia frɛɛ AWURADE, na ɔmaa sunsum no sane n’akyi ntwedeɛ du, Ahas owia dɔn so ntwedeɛ a asiane dada no so.
Asomafoɔ a wɔfiri Babel ba Ɛberɛ no mu no, Babelhene Baladan ba Merodak-baladan soma maa wɔde nwoma ne ayɛyɛdeɛ brɛɛ Hesekia, ɛfiri sɛ ɔtee sɛ Hesekia yareeɛ.
Na Hesekia tiee wɔn, na ɔkyerɛɛ wɔn n’akoradeɛ dan nyinaa, dwetɛ ne sika ne nnuhwam ne ngo pa ne n’akodeɛ dan nyinaa ne deɛ wɔhunu n’akoradeɛ mu nyinaa.
Biribiara nni ne fie ne deɛ ɔdi soɔ nyinaa mu a Hesekia amfa ankyerɛ wɔn.
Ɛnna Odiyifoɔ Yesaia baa Ɔhene Hesekia nkyɛn bɛbisaa no sɛ: Nnipa yi se sɛn, na ɛhe na wɔfiri baa wo nkyɛn yi?
Na Hesekia se: Wɔfiri akyirikyiri asase bi so na ɛbaeɛ, wɔfiri Babel.
Na ɔbisaa sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na wɔahunu wɔ wo fie?
Na Hesekia buaa sɛ: Deɛ ɛwɔ me fie nyinaa, wɔahunu; biribiara nni m’akoradeɛ mu a mamfa mankyerɛ wɔn.
Na Yesaia ka kyerɛɛ Hesekia sɛ: Tie AWURADE asɛm: Hwɛ, nna bi reba a wɔbɛsoa deɛ ɛwɔ wo fie nyinaa ne deɛ w’agyanom akora de abɛsi nnɛ yi akɔ Babel; biribiara renka, AWURADE na ɔseɛ.
Na wo mma a wɔfiri wo mu a woawo wɔn no mu binom, wɔbɛfa wɔn na wɔakɔyɛ Babel hene aban mu apiafoɔ.
Ɛnna Hesekia ka kyerɛɛ Yesaia sɛ: AWURADE asɛm a woaka no, ɛyɛ.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Ɛnyɛ sɛ asomdwoeɛ ne nokorɛ na ɛbɛwɔ hɔ me nna mu?
Hesekia ahennie ba awieeɛ Na Hesekia ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne ne mmaninneɛ nyinaa ne sɛdeɛ ɔyɛɛ tareɛ ne suka na ɔde nsuo no baa kuro no mu no, wɔatwerɛ no Yuda Ahemfo Berɛsosɛm Nwoma no mu.
Na Hesekia tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na ne ba Manase bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Manase di Yuda so hene Manase bɛdii hene no, na wadi mfirinhyia dummienu, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ aduonum nnum wɔ Yerusalem.
Na ne na din de Hefsibah.
Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne sɛ amanaman a AWURADE tuu wɔn firii Israelfoɔ anim no akyiwadeɛ.
Na ɔsane sisii sorɔnsorɔmmea a n’agya Hesekia sɛesɛee no na ɔsisii afɔrebukyia maa Baal, na ɔyɛɛ Asera nnua sɛdeɛ Israelhene Ahab yɛeɛ no, na ɔsɔree ɔsoro asafo nyinaa na ɔsom wɔn.
Na ɔsisii afɔrebukyia AWURADE fie a AWURADE kaa ho asɛm sɛ: Yerusalem na mede me din bɛto hɔ, no mu.
Na ɔsisii afɔrebukyia maa ɔsoro asafo nyinaa AWURADE fie abannwa mmienu no so.
Na ɔmaa ne babarima faa ogya mu de bɔɔ afɔdeɛ, na ɔyɛɛ abayideɛ ne adebisadeɛ, na ɔhyehyɛɛ asamanfrɛfoɔ ne adunsinfoɔ, ɔmaa bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ no dɔɔso AWURADE ani so de huruu ne bo.
Na ɔde Asera ohoni a ɔyɛeɛ no sii efie no mu, efie a AWURADE kaa ho asɛm kyerɛɛ Dawid ne ne ba Salomo no sɛ: Efie yi ne Yerusalem na mayi Israel mmusuakuo nyinaa mu na mede me din bɛto daa.
Nanso meremma Israel nan ntu nkyini mfiri asase a mede mama wɔn agyanom no so bio.
Na deɛ wɔnyɛ nkutoo ne sɛ wɔhwɛ yɛ sɛdeɛ mahyɛ wɔn nyinaa ne sɛdeɛ mmara a m’akoa Mose hyɛɛ wɔn no nyinaa teɛ.
Nanso wɔantie, na Manase de wɔn yerae maa wɔyɛɛ bɔne sene amanaman a AWURADE sɛee wɔn firii Israel soɔ no.
Na AWURADE nam ne nkoa adiyifoɔ no so kaa sɛ: Ɛsiane sɛ Yudahene Manase ayɛ saa akyiwadeɛ yi, na wayɛ bɔne asene deɛ Amorifoɔ a wɔdii n’anim yɛeɛ nyinaa, na ɔde n’abosonhuhuo ama Yuda nso ayɛ bɔne nti, sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Hwɛ, mede bɔne mereba Yerusalem ne Yuda so a obiara a ɔbɛteɛ no, n’aso mmienu mu bɛyɛ no kyeoo.
Na mɛtwe Samaria susuhoma mu, ne Ahab fie so taahoma mu aba Yerusalem so, na mɛpepa Yerusalem mu sɛdeɛ wɔpepa ayowa mu, wɔpepa na wɔdane butuo; na mɛpo m’agyapadeɛ nkaeɛ no, na mede wɔn ahyɛ wɔn atamfoɔ nsa, na wɔayɛ fonam ne fomfa adeɛ ama wɔn atamfoɔ nyinaa, ɛfiri sɛ wɔayɛ m’ani so bɔne na wɔahuru me bo firi da a wɔn agyanom firii Misraim baeɛ de bɛsi nnɛ.
Afei nso, mogya a ɛdi bem nso Manase kaa pii pa gui kɔsii sɛ ɔde hyɛɛ Yerusalem ma firi ano kɔpem ano, ɛsono ne bɔne a ɔde maa Yuda yɛɛ bɔne, sɛ wɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛnyɛ AWURADE ani soɔ no.
Na Manase ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa ne ne bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ no, wɔatwerɛ no Yuda Ahemfo Berɛsosɛm Nwoma no mu.
Na Manase tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no ne fie turo a ɛne Usa turo no mu; na ne ba Amon bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Amon di Yuda so hene Amon bɛdii hene no, na wadi mfirinhyia aduonu mmienu, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ mmienu Yerusalem.
Na ne na din de Mesulemet a ɔyɛ Harus a ɔfiri Yotba ba.
Na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne sɛdeɛ n’agya Manase yɛeɛ no, na ɔnantee ɔkwan a n’agya nantee mu no nyinaa mu, na ɔsom abosonhuhuo a n’agya someeɛ no, na ɔsɔree wɔn; na ɔgyaa AWURADE n’agyanom Nyankopɔn, na wannante AWURADE kwan mu.
Na Amon nkoa pam ne tiri so, na wɔkumm ɔhene no wɔ ne fie.
Na asase no sofoɔ no kunkumm wɔn a wɔpamm Ɔhene Amon tiri soɔ no nyinaa, na asase no sofoɔ no de ne ba Yosia sii hene n’ananmu.
Na Amon ho nsɛm nkaeɛ, deɛ ɔyɛeɛ no, wɔantwerɛ no Yuda ahemfo berɛsosɛm nwoma no mu?
Na wɔsiee no ne da mu, Usa turom, na ne ba Yosia bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Yosia di Yuda so hene Yosia bɛdii hene no, na wadi mfirinhyia nwɔtwe, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ aduasa baako wɔ Yerusalem.
Na ne na din de Yedida a ɔyɛ Adaia a ɔfiri Boskat ba.
Na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so, na ɔnantee n’agya Dawid kwan nyinaa mu, na wammane ankɔ nifa anaa benkum.
Wɔhunu Mmara Nwoma no Na Ɔhene Yosia afe a ɛtɔ so dunwɔtwe no mu no, ɔhene somaa Mesulam ba Asalia ba Ɔtwerɛfoɔ Safan maa no kɔɔ AWURADE fie sɛ: Kɔ ɔsɔfo panin Hilkia nkyɛn, na ɔmmu sika a wɔde baa AWURADE fie a ɛpono ano ahwɛfoɔ aboa ano afiri ɔman no nsam no ho nkonta mma wo, na wɔmfa nhyɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ adwuma no a wɔde wɔn asisi AWURADE fie soɔ no nsam, na wɔmfa mma AWURADE fie mu adwumayɛfoɔ no sɛ wɔnsiesie efie no mu adango no, ne nnua adwumfoɔ ne adansifoɔ ne abantofoɔ no, na wɔmfa ntotɔ nnua ne aboɔ a wɔatwa, na wɔmfa nsiesie efie no; nanso wɔne wɔn mmmu sika a wɔde ahyɛ wɔn nsa no ho nkonta, ɛfiri sɛ wɔyɛ no nokorɛ mu.
Na Ɔsɔfo panin Hilkia ka kyerɛɛ Ɔtwerɛfoɔ Safan sɛ: Mahunu mmara nwoma no AWURADE fie.
Na Hilkia de nwoma no maa Safan, na ɔkenkanee.
Na Ɔtwerɛfoɔ Safan baa ɔhene nkyɛn, na ɔde mu asɛm brɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Wo nkoa ahwie sika a wɔhunuu no efie no mu no agu hɔ, na wɔde ahyɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ adwuma no a wɔde wɔn asisi AWURADE fie soɔ no nsa.
Na Ɔtwerɛfoɔ Safan bɔɔ din kyerɛɛ ɔhene sɛ: Ɔsɔfoɔ Hilkia de nwoma bi ama me.
Na Safan kenkanee no ɔhene anim.
Na ɛbaa sɛ ɔhene tee mmara nwoma no mu nsɛm no, ɔsunsuanee ne ntadeɛ mu.
Na ɔhene hyɛɛ Ɔsɔfoɔ Hilkia ne Safan ba Ahikam ne Mikaia ba Akbor ne Ɔtwerɛfoɔ Safan ne ɔhene akoa Asaia sɛ: Monkɔ nkɔbisa AWURADE mma me, ne ɔman yi ne Yuda nyinaa, nwoma a moahunu yi mu nsɛm no nti, na AWURADE abufuhyeɛ a adɛre atia yɛn no yɛ kɛseɛ, ɛfiri sɛ yɛn agyanom antie nwoma yi mu nsɛm no, sɛ wɔbɛyɛ sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ no yɛn ho no.
Odiyifoɔ baa Hulda Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Hilkia ne Ahikam ne Akbor ne Safan ne Asaia kɔɔ Odiyifoɔ baa Hulda a ɔyɛ Harhas ba Tikwa ba, ntadeɛ sohwɛfoɔ Salum yere nkyɛn, (nso na ɔte Yerusalem Fa a ɛtɔ so Mmienu mu), na wɔne no kasae.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Monkɔka nkyerɛ ɔbarima a ɔsomaa mo me nkyɛn no sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Hwɛ, mede bɔne bɛba ha ne ɛhafoɔ so, sɛdeɛ nwoma a Yuda hene akenkan no mu nsɛm nyinaa teɛ, ɛsiane sɛ wɔagya me, na wɔakɔhye aduhwam ama anyame foforɔ, sɛ wɔde wɔn nsa ano adwuma nyinaa rehuru me bo, enti m’abufuhyeɛ bɛdɛre atia ha yi, na ɛrennum.
Na Yuda hene a ɔsomaa mo sɛ mommɛbisa AWURADE no deɛ, sɛ monka nkyerɛ no nie: Sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Nsɛm a woateɛ no deɛ, ɛsiane sɛ w’akoma yɛ bɛtɛɛ na woabrɛ wo ho ase AWURADE anim, sɛ wotee deɛ maka no, ɛha yi ne ɛhafoɔ ho, sɛ wɔbɛdane amamfo ne nnome, na woasunsuane wo ntadeɛ mu na woasu m’anim nti, me nso mate, AWURADE na ɔseɛ.
Enti hwɛ, wobɛtoa w’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔasie wo damena mu asomdwoeɛ mu, na w’ani renhunu ɔhaw a mede reba ha yi soɔ no nyinaa.
Na wɔde asɛm no bɛsee ɔhene.
Yosia gu abosonsom Na ɔhene no soma maa wɔkɔboaboaa Yuda ne Yerusalem mpanimfoɔ nyinaa ano baa ne nkyɛn.
Na ɔhene kɔɔ AWURADE fie, na Yuda mmarima nyinaa ne Yerusalemfoɔ nyinaa ne asɔfoɔ ne adiyifoɔ ne ɔman mu no nyinaa, ɛfiri nketewa so kɔsi akɛseɛ soɔ ka ne ho.
Na ɔkenkanee apam nwoma a wɔhunuu no AWURADE fie no mu nsɛm no nyinaa guu wɔn nyinaa aso mu.
Na ɔhene gyinaa simpie no so, na ɔpamm AWURADE anim, sɛ ɔde n’akoma nyinaa ne ne kra nyinaa bɛdi AWURADE akyi, na wadi ne mmara nsɛm ne n’adansesɛm ne n’ahyɛdeɛ so, sɛ ɔbɛma apam yi mu nsɛm a wɔatwerɛ no nwoma yi mu no atim.
Na ɔman no nyinaa gyinaa apam no so hyɛɛ bɔ.
Yosia gu abosonsom Na ɔhene hyɛɛ Ɔsɔfo panin Hilkia ne asɔfoɔ a wɔdi soɔ no ne apono ano hwɛfoɔ no sɛ wɔnyi nnoɔma a wɔayɛ ama Baal ne Asera no nyinaa ne ɔsoro asafo nyinaa mfiri AWURADE fie no mu.
Na ɔde firii Yerusalem kɔhyee, Kidron ho mfofowa mu, na ɔde ɛho nso no kɔɔ Betel.
Na ɔtutuu asɔfoɔ hunu a Yuda ahemfo sisiiɛ a wɔhyee nnuhwam Yuda nkuro mu, ne Yerusalem ho sorɔnsorɔmmea soɔ, ne wɔn a wɔhyee nnuhwam maa Baal ne owia ne ɔsrane ne ɔsoro-nsoromma ne ɔsoro asafo no nyinaa.
Na ɔyii Asera no firii AWURADE fie de firii Yerusalem kɔɔ Kidron subonhwa ho, na ɔhyee no Kidron subonhwa mu, na ɔyam no sɛ mfuturo na ɔde ne mfuturo no guu nkurɔfoɔ mma adamena so.
Na ɔbubuu nnwaman adan a ɛwɔ AWURADE fie, a mmaa nwonoo ntwamutam maa Asera wɔ mu no.
