Nnomaa sɛdeɛ wɔn su teɛ, ne ntɔteboa, sɛdeɛ wɔn su teɛ, ne mmoa a wɔwea asase soɔ nyinaa, sɛdeɛ wɔn su teɛ, wɔn nyinaa mu mmienu mmienu mmra wo nkyɛn, na wɔanya nkwa.
Na wo deɛ, boaboa aduane nyinaa bi ano kɔ mu, na ayɛ wo ne wɔn aduane.
Na Noa yɛɛ sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ no no nyinaa pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nsuyire no Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Noa sɛ: Wo ne wo fiefoɔ nyinaa, monkɔ adaka no mu, ɛfiri sɛ wo na mahu wo sɛ ɔteneneeni m’anim, ɛberɛ yi mu.
Mmoa a wɔn ho teɛ nyinaa mu, fa nson nson, anini ne abedeɛ.
Na mmoa a wɔn ho nteɛ mu, fa mmienu mmienu, onini ne ɔbedeɛ; ewiem nnomaa mu nso fa nson nson, anini ne abedeɛ, na wɔn ase nnya nkwa asase nyinaa ani.
Ɛfiri sɛ aka nnanson na matɔ osuo agu asase so adaduanan awia ne anadwo, na mapepa adeɛ a nkwa wɔ mu a mayɛ nyinaa afiri asase ani.
Na Noa yɛɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ no no nyinaa.
Ɛberɛ a nsuyire no baa asase soɔ no na Noa adi mfirinhyia ahansia.
Nsuo a na ɛrebɛyire no nti, Noa ne ne mma, ne ne yere, ne ne mma yerenom kɔɔ adaka no mu.
Mmoa a wɔn ho teɛ ne mmoa a wɔn ho nteɛ ne nnomaa ne wɔn a wɔwea asase soɔ nyinaa mu mmienu mmienu baa Noa nkyɛn adaka no mu, onini ne ɔbedeɛ, sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ Noa no.
Na nnanson akyiri no, nsuyire baa asase so.
Noa dii mfirinhyia ahansia no, bosome a ɛtɔ so mmienu no dadu nnanson soɔ, da no ara, ebunu kɛseɛ no nsuo ani nyinaa paepaee, na ɔsoro mpomma buebuee.
Na osuo tɔɔ asase so pii adaduanan, awia ne anadwo.
Saa da yi ara (a nsuyire yi hyɛɛ aseɛ no) mu na Noa ne ne yere, ne ne mma, Sem, Ham ne Yafet, ne ne mma yerenom baasa akɔhyɛ adaka no mu.
Na mmoadoma nyinaa, ntɔteboa, mmoa a wɔwea asase soɔ, ntuboa nyinaa, sɛdeɛ wɔn su teɛ, ne wɔn na ɛkɔɔ mu.
Honam a nkwa home wɔ wɔn mu nyinaa mu mmienu mmienu na wɔbaa Noa nkyɛn wɔ adaka no mu.
Wɔn a ɛbaeɛ no, na wɔyɛ honam nyinaa mu anini ne abedeɛ, sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ no no; na AWURADE too no mu.
Na nsuyire no baa asase so adaduanan, na nsuo no yiriiɛ, na ɛmaa adaka no so firii asase so.
Na nsuo no yirii dodo wɔ asase so; maa adaka no tɛɛ nsuo no ani.
Na nsuo no boroo so ara wɔ asase so, na ɛkataa mmepɔ nyinaa so.
Nsuo no boroo so kɔɔ soro basafa nson ne fa na ɛkataa mmepɔ so.
Na abɔdeɛ a ɛte aseɛ nyinaa, nnomaa, ntɔteboa, wiram mmoa, mmoa a wɔwea asase soɔ, ne nnipa nyinaa; wɔn a nkwa home wɔ wɔn mu, na wɔte asase pɛsɛɛ soɔ nyinaa wuwui.
Na ɔpepaa biribiara a nkwa wom a ɛwɔ asase ani, ɛfiri nnipa so kɔsi ntɔteboa ne mmoa a wɔwea ne ewiem nnomaa so.
Na wɔpepaa wɔn firii asase so, na ɛkaa Noa nko ara ne wɔn a wɔne no wɔ adaka no mu no.
Na nsuo no yirii wɔ asase so nna ɔha aduonum.
Nsuo no twe Na Onyankopɔn kaee Noa ne mmoadoma nyinaa ne ntɔteboa nyinaa a wɔne no wɔ adaka no mu nyinaa.
Na Onyankopɔn maa mframa bɔ faa asase so, na nsuo no ano brɛɛ ase.
Na ebunu no nsuo aniwa sisii, na ɔsoro mpomma mu totoe, maa osuo a ɛfiri soro no gyaee tɔ; na nsuo no twe firii asase so ara.
Na ɛfiri nna ɔha aduonum akyiri no na na nsuo no so rehwan.
Na ɛda a ɛtɔ so dunson wɔ bosome nson mu no, adaka no kɔsii Ararat mmepɔ so.
Na nsuo no kɔɔ so twee ara kɔsii bosome a ɛtɔ so du no so; na saa bosome no ara, ne da a ɛdi kan no na mmepɔ atifi dedaa adie.
Na ɛno akyiri adaduanan no, Noa buee adaka no mpomma a ɔyɛeɛ no, na ɔsomaa anene.
Na ɔfirii adi, na ɔdii akɔneaba de kɔsii sɛ nsuo no wee asase soɔ.
Na ɔsomaa aburuburo sɛ ɔnkɔhwɛ sɛ nsuo no awe wɔ asase ani anaa.
Nanso aburuburo no annya ne nan sibea, na ɔsane baa ne nkyɛn adaka no mu, ɛfiri sɛ na nsuo no da so wɔ asase nyinaa ani.
Na ɔtenee ne nsa faa no baa ne nkyɛn wɔ adaka no mu.
Na ɔtwɛn nnanson bio, na ɔsomaa aburuburo firii adaka no mu bio.
Na aburuburo no baa ne nkyɛn anwummerɛ, na hwɛ, ngo dua ahahan frɔmfrɔm tua n’ano.
Noa hunuu sɛ nsuo no awe asase so.
Na ɔtwɛn nnanson bio no, ɔsomaa aburuburo no; na wansane amma ne nkyɛn bio.
Na Noa afe a ɛtɔ so ahansia ne baako, bosome a ɛdi kan no da a ɛdi kan no na na nsuo no awe asase soɔ.
Na Noa yii suhyɛ no firii adaka no so, na ɔhwɛe, na hwɛ, na asase ani awo.
Bosome a ɛtɔ so mmienu no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nson no na na asase so awo koraa.
Na Onyankopɔn kasa kyerɛɛ Noa sɛ: Firi adaka no mu, wo ne wo yere, wo mma ne wɔn yerenom a wɔka wo ho; mmoadoma a wɔka wo ho nyinaa a ɛfiri honam nyinaa mu, nnomaa ne ntɔteboa ne deɛ ɛwea asase soɔ nyinaa ne wo mfiri adi, na wɔnwo, na wɔnnɔɔso asase so.
Na Noa ne ne yere, ne ne mma ne wɔn yerenom firii adi; mmoadoma nyinaa, wɔn a wɔwea nyinaa ne nnomaa nyinaa, ne deɛ nkwa wɔ mu biara, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmoaban teɛ, firi adaka no mu firii adi.
Noa afɔrebɔ Na Noa sii afɔrebukyia maa AWURADE, na ɔfaa ntɔteboa a wɔn ho teɛ nyinaa mu bi ne nnomaa a wɔn ho teɛ nyinaa mu bi de wɔn bobɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ wɔ bukyia no so.
Na AWURADE tee afɔdeɛ no hwam no, ɔkaa no n’akoma mu sɛ: Onipa nti merennome asase bio, ɛfiri sɛ onipa akoma mu adwene yɛ bɔne firi ne mmɔfraase, na merensɛe deɛ ɛte aseɛ nyinaa bio, sɛdeɛ mayɛ yi.
Nna a asase wɔ hɔ yi nyinaa, oguo ne otwa, awɔ ne ahuhuro, asuso ne ɔpɛ, awia ne anadwo rennyae da.
Onyankopɔn ne Noa yɛ Apam Na Onyankopɔn hyiraa Noa ne ne mma, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monwo na monnɔɔso, na monhyɛ asase so ma.
Na mo ho hu ne mo ho suro mmra asase so mmoadoma nyinaa ne ewiem nnomaa nyinaa, deɛ ɛwea fam nyinaa ne ɛpo mu mpataa nyinaa so; mo nsa na wɔde wɔn ahyɛ.
Deɛ ɛkeka ne ho a ɛwɔ nkwa nyinaa, ɛnyɛ mo aduane; mede ne nyinaa mama mo, sɛdeɛ mede nhahan mono memaa mo no.
Nam a ne mogya da so wɔ ne mu nko na monnnie.
Na onipa biara a ɔka onipa mogya guo no, ne nsam mu na mɛbisa, na aboa mpo ka onipa mogya gu a mɛbisa afiri ne nsam.
Deɛ ɔhwie onipa mogya guo no, onipa so na wɔnam bɛhwie ne mogya aguo, ɛfiri sɛ Nyankopɔn suban so na ɔyɛɛ onipa.
Na mo deɛ, monwo na monnɔ, na monnɔɔso wɔ asase so.
Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Noa ne ne mma a wɔka ne ho no sɛ: Hwɛ, afei merema m’apam atim hɔ ama mo ne mo asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi mo akyi, ɛne akra a ɛtete aseɛ a ɛka mo ho nyinaa, nnomaa, ntɔteboa ne asase so mmoadoma a wɔne mo wɔ hɔ firi adaka no mu nyinaa.
Na mama me ne mo apam yi agyina hɔ, sɛ meremfa nsuyire mensɛe abɔdeɛ nyinaa bio, na nsuyire remma mmɛsɛe asase bio.
Na Onyankopɔn kaa sɛ: Apam a merema ada me ne mo ne akra ateasefoɔ a ɛka mo ho nyinaa ntam akɔ nnasanten awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ soɔ no ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ nie: Me nyankontɔn na mede masi mununkum mu, na ayɛ me ne asase ntam apam no ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ.
Na sɛ mede mununkum meba asase so a, wɔbɛhunu nyankontɔn no wɔ mununkum no mu; na makae m’apam a ɛwɔ me ne mo, ne abɔdeɛ nyinaa mu ateasefoɔ ntam no, na nsuo annane nsuyire ansɛe abɔdeɛ nyinaa bio.
Na nyankontɔn no bɛba mununkum mu, na mahwɛ, na mede makae daa apam a ɛwɔ Onyankopɔn ne nnipa ne abɔdeɛ mu ateasefoɔ a ɛwɔ asase soɔ nyinaa no ntam.
Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Noa sɛ: Yei ne apam a mama no agyina me ne honam a ɛwɔ asase nyinaa ntam no ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ.
Noa asefoɔ pete asase so Na Noa mma a wɔfirii adaka no mu firii adie ne Sem, Ham ne Yafet; na Ham ne Kanaan n’agya.
Yeinom ne Noa mma baasa no.
Wɔn mu na nnipa firi petee asase nyinaa soɔ.
Na Noa firii aseɛ yɛɛ kua, na ɔyɛɛ bobeturo.
Na ɔnom nsa no bi, na ɔboroe, na ɔda ne ntomadan mu a ne ho da hɔ.
Na Kanaan agya Ham kɔhunuu n’agya adagya mu, na ɔkɔka kyerɛɛ ne nuanom baanu no wɔ adihɔ.
Na Sem ne Yafet faa ntoma de guu wɔn mmatiri so nam nkyirinkyire de kɔkataa wɔn agya adagya so, na wɔdanee wɔn ani kyerɛɛ akyire, na wɔanhunu wɔn agya adagya mu.
Na Noa ani so tete firii ne nsaborɔ mu na ɔtee deɛ ne ba kumaa no ayɛ no no, ɔkaa sɛ: Wɔadome Kanaan, ɔbɛyɛ nkoa mu akoa ama ne nuanom.
Na ɔkaa nso sɛ: Nhyira ne Sem Nyankopɔn, AWURADE, na Kanaan nyɛ wɔn akoa.
Onyankopɔn mma Yafet ase ntrɛ, na ɔntena Sem ntomadan mu, na Kanaan nyɛ wɔn akoa.
Na nsuyire akyiri no, Noa tenaa ase mfirinhyia ahasa aduonum.
Na Noa nna a ɔdiiɛ nyinaa yɛ mfeɛ ahankron aduonum, na ɔwui.
Noa awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ Na yeinom ne Noa mma Sem, Ham ne Yafet awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ.
Na nsuyire no akyi, wɔwoo mma.
Yafet mma nie: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Yawan, Tubal, Mesek ne Tiras.
Na Gomer mma ne Askenas, Rifat ne Togarma.
Na Yawan mma ne Elisa, Tarsis, Kitim ne Dodanim.
Yeinom mu na nsuano amanaman no firi kɔpetee wɔn nsase soɔ, sɛdeɛ wɔn mu biara kasa ne wɔn mmusua teɛ, wɔn amanaman mu.
Na Ham mma ne Kus, Misraim, Put ne Kanaan.
Na Kus mma ne Seba, Hawila, Sabta, Raama ne Sabteka.
Na Raama mma ne Saba ne Dedan.
Na Kus woo Nimrod.
Ɔno na ɔdii kan yɛɛ ɔkatakyie wɔ asase soɔ.
Na ɔyɛ ɔbɔmmɔfoɔ wɔ AWURADE anim; enti na wɔka sɛ: Ɔbɔmmɔfoɔ kɛseɛ a ɔwɔ tumi AWURADE anim te sɛ Nimrod nie.
Na n’ahennie mfitiaseɛ ne Babel, Erek, Akad ne Kalne a ɛwɔ Sinear asase soɔ.
Asase no so na ɔfiri kɔɔ Asiria kɔkyekyeree Ninewe ne Rehobot-ir ne Kala, ne Resen kuro kɛseɛ a ɛda Ninewe ne Kala ntam no.
Na Misraim woo Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naftuhim, Patrusim, Kasluhim (a Filistifoɔ firii wɔn mu), ne Kaftorim.
Kanaan woo n’abakan Sidon, ne Het, Yebusifoɔ, Amorifoɔ, Girgasifoɔ, Hiwifoɔ, Arkifoɔ, Sinifoɔ, Arwadfoɔ, Semarifoɔ ne Hamatfoɔ.
Ɛno akyi na Kanaanfoɔ mmusua peteeɛ.
Na Kanaanfoɔ hyeɛ firi Sidon kɔduru Gerar de kɔsi Gasa kɔduru Sodom, Gomora, Adma ne Seboim de kɔsi Lasa.
Yeinom ne Ham mma, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua ne wɔn kasa, wɔn nsase ne wɔn amanaman teɛ.
Sem a ɔyɛ Yafet nua panin no mu na Eber mma nyinaa firie.
Sem mma ne Elam, Asur, Arfaksad, Lud ne Aram.
Na Aram mma ne Us, Hul, Geter ne Mas.
Na Arfaksad woo Sela, na Sela woo Eber.
Na Eber woo mma baanu.
Deɛ ɔdi kan no din de Peleg, ɛfiri sɛ ne nna mu na wɔkyekyɛɛ asase mu; na ne nua din de Yoktan.
Na Yoktan woo Almodad, Selef, Hasarmawet, Yera, Hadoram, Usal, Dikla, Obal, Abimael, Saba, Ofir, Hawila ne Yobab.
Yeinom nyinaa ne Yoktan mma.
Na wɔn tenabea firi Mesa kɔduru Sefar, apueeɛ bepɔ so.
Yeinom ne Sem mma, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua ne wɔn kasa, wɔn nsase ne wɔn amanaman teɛ.
Yeinom ne Noa mma mmusua, sɛdeɛ wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ teɛ wɔ wɔn amanaman mu.
Na ɛfiri yeinom mu na nsuyire no akyi amanaman petee asase soɔ.
Babel abantenten no Na asase nyinaa sofoɔ yɛ anokorɔ kasa kasa korɔ.
Na wɔtuu kwan faa apueeɛ no, wɔhunuu asasetam bi wɔ Sinear asase so, na wɔtenaa hɔ.
Na wɔsesee wɔn ho wɔn ho sɛ: Wiɛ, momma yɛnyɛ ntaayaa, na yɛnto!
Na ntaayaa no yɛɛ wɔn aboɔ, na ama yɛɛ wɔn dɔteɛ.
Ɛnna wɔkaa sɛ: Wiɛ, momma yɛnkyekyere kuro, na yɛnto abantenten a n’atifi bɛduru soro, na yɛmfa nnye din, na yɛanhwete asase nyinaa ani.
Na AWURADE siane bɛhwɛɛ kuro ne abantenten a nnipa mma retoɔ no.
Na AWURADE kaa sɛ: Hwɛ, wɔyɛ ɔman baako, na wɔn nyinaa ka kasa korɔ; na deɛ wɔafiri aseɛ reyɛ nie; na afei, biribiara rentumi nsi wɔn deɛ wɔsusu sɛ wɔbɛyɛ no biara ho kwan.
Wiɛ, momma yɛnsiane nkɔ hɔ na yɛnkɔyɛ wɔn kasa basabasa, na wɔn mu biara ante ne yɔnko kasa bio.
Na ɛfiri hɔnom na AWURADE bɔɔ wɔn hwetee asase nyinaa ani, na wɔgyaee kuro no kyekyerɛ.
Enti na wɔfrɛ hɔ Babel, ɛfiri sɛ ɛhɔ na AWURADE yɛɛ asase nyinaa kasa basabasa.
Ɛfiri hɔ na AWURADE bɔɔ wɔn hwetee asase nyinaa ani.
Sem awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ Yeinom ne Sem awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ: Sem dii mfirinhyia ɔha na ɔwoo Arfaksad, nsuyire no akyiri mfeɛ mmienu.
Na Sem woo Arfaksad no akyiri no, ɔdii mfeɛ ahanum na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmammaa.
Na Arfaksad dii mfirinhyia aduasa nnum na ɔwoo Sela.
Na ɔwoo Sela no akyi no, ɔdii mfeɛ ahanan ne mmiɛnsa, na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmammaa.
Na Sela dii mfirinhyia aduasa na ɔwoo Eber.
Na Sela woo Eber no akyiri no, ɔdii mfeɛ ahanan ne mmiɛnsa na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmammaa.
Na Eber dii mfirinhyia aduasa nnan na ɔwoo Peleg.
Na ɔwoo Peleg no akyi no, ɔdii mfeɛ ahanan aduasa na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmammaa.
Na Peleg dii mfirinhyia aduasa na ɔwoo Reu.
Peleg woo Reu no akyiri no, ɔdii mfeɛ ahanu ne nkron na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmammaa.
Na Reu dii mfirinhyia aduasa mmienu na ɔwoo Serug.
Na Reu woo Serug no akyiri no, ɔdii mfeɛ ahanu ne nson, na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmammaa.
Na Serug dii mfirinhyia aduasa na ɔwoo Nahor.
Na Serug woo Nahor no akyiri no, ɔdii mfeɛ ahanu na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmammaa.
Na Nahor dii mfirinhyia aduonu nkron na ɔwoo Tera.
Na Nahor woo Tera no akyiri no, ɔdii mfeɛ ɔha ne dunkron na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmammaa.
Na Tera dii mfirinhyia aduɔson na ɔwoo Abram, Nahor ne Haran.
Abram agya Tera awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ Na yeinom ne Tera awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ: Tera woo Abram, Nahor ne Haran, na Haran woo Lot.
Na Haran wuu n’agya Tera anim, asase a wɔwoo no soɔ no so, ɛne Ur a ɛwɔ Kaldea.
Na Abram ne Nahor waree yerenom, Abram yere din de Sarai, na Nahor yere din de Milka a ɔyɛ Haran babaa.
Na Haran yɛ Milka ne Iska agya.
Na Sarai yɛ obonini, na ɔnni ba.
Na Tera faa ne ba Abram ne ne nana Lot, a ɔyɛ Haran ba, ne n’ase Sarai, ne ba Abram yere, na ɔne wɔn firii Ur a ɛwɔ Kaldea sɛ wɔrekɔ Kanaan asase so.
Na wɔduruu Haran no, wɔtenaa hɔ.
Na Tera nna yɛ mfeɛ ahanu ne nnum, na Tera wuu wɔ Haran.
Onyankopɔn frɛ Abram Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Abram sɛ: Wo deɛ, firi w’asase so ne w’abusua mu ne w’agya fie kɔ asase a mɛkyerɛ woɔ no so.
Na mɛyɛ wo ɔman kɛseɛ, na mahyira wo, na mama wo din ayɛ kɛseɛ, na woayɛ nhyira.
Na mɛhyira wɔn a wɔhyira woɔ, na wɔn a wɔdome woɔ no, mɛdome wɔn; na wo mu na wɔbɛhyira asase so mmusua nyinaa.
Na Abram kɔe sɛdeɛ AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ no no, na Lot ne no kɔe.
Na Abram firii Haran no, na wadi mfeɛ aduɔson nnum.
Na Abram faa ne yere Sarai ne ne nua ba Lot ne wɔn ahodeɛ a wɔanya nyinaa ne nnipa a wɔnyaa wɔn wɔ Haran, na wɔfirii hɔ sɛ wɔrekɔ Kanaan asase so; na wɔkɔduruu Kanaan asase so.
Na Abram twaa mu asase no so kɔduruu baabi a wɔfrɛ hɔ Sekem wɔ More pɔ no ho.
Nso berɛ no mu na Kanaanfoɔ wɔ asase no so.
Na AWURADE yii ne ho kyerɛɛ Abram kaa sɛ: W’asefoɔ na mede asase yi bɛma wɔn.
Na ɔsii afɔrebukyia wɔ hɔ maa AWURADE a ɔyii ne ho kyerɛɛ no no.
Na ɔtu firii hɔ kɔɔ Betel apueeɛ bepɔ bi so.
Na ɔsii ne ntomadan a Betel da n’atɔeɛ, na Ai da apueeɛ; na ɔsii afɔrebukyia maa AWURADE wɔ hɔ, na ɔsɔree AWURADE.
Na Abram dii atutena ara kɔɔ Negeb.
Abram kɔ Misraim Na ɛkɔm baa asase no so, na Abram siane kɔtenaa Misraim kɔyɛɛ ɔhɔhoɔ wɔ hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ na ɛkɔm no mu yɛ den asase no so.
Na ɔreyɛ aduru Misraim asase soɔ no, ɔka kyerɛɛ ne yere Sarai sɛ: Hwɛ, menim sɛ woyɛ ɔbaa a wo ho yɛ fɛ, na sɛ Misraimfoɔ hu wo a, wɔbɛka sɛ: Ne yere nie, na wɔaku me, na wɔama woatena ase.
Enti ka sɛ, me nua ne wo, na wo nti wɔayɛ me yie, na matena ase.
Na Abram duruu Misraim no, Misraimfoɔ hunuu ne yere no sɛ ne ho yɛ fɛ sɛ.
Na Farao atitire hunuu no, na wɔkɔkamfoo no kyerɛɛ Farao, na wɔbɛfaa ɔbaa no kɔɔ Farao fie.
Na ne nti ɔyɛɛ Abram yie; na ɔnyaa nnwan, anantwie, mfunumu, nkoa, mfenaa, mfunumubereɛ ne yoma.
Na Abram yere Sarai ho asɛm no nti AWURADE de ɔhaw akɛseɛ haa Farao ne ne fie.
Na Farao frɛɛ Abram kaa sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na woayɛ me yi?
Adɛn nti na woanka ankyerɛ me sɛ ɔyɛ wo yerɛ?
Adɛn nti na wose: Ɔyɛ me nua?
Anka meremfa no nware no; na afei, hwɛ wo yere nie, fa no na kɔ wo kwan.
Na Farao tuu nnipa maa no sɛ wɔnkɔgya no ne ne yere ne deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa kwan.
Abram ne Lot di ntetemu Na Abram ne ne yere ne deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa, ne Lot nso, firii Misraim baa Negeb.
Na Abram anya ne ho sɛ, mmoa, dwetɛ ne sika mu.
Na ɔdii atutena firi Negeb kɔduruu Betel, deɛ akane na ne ntomadan sie no, wɔ Betel ne Ai ntam, deɛ afɔrebukyia a ɔsii kane no wɔ.
Na Abram sɔree AWURADE wɔ hɔ.
Na Lot nso a ɔne Abram nam no wɔ nnwan ne anantwie ne ntomadan.
Na asase no nso mma wɔn sɛ wɔbɛtena faako, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn ahodeɛ dɔɔso sɛ, enti wɔantumi antena faako.
Na akasakasa baa Abram mmoahwɛfoɔ ne Lot mmoahwɛfoɔ ntam.
Na berɛ no mu na Kanaanfoɔ ne Perisifoɔ tete asase no so.
Na Abram ka kyerɛɛ Lot sɛ: Mesrɛ wo, mma akasakasa mmma me ne wo ntam, ne me mmoahwɛfoɔ ne wo mmoahwɛfoɔ ntam, na yɛyɛ anuanom.
Ɛnyɛ asase no nyinaa na ɛda w’anim yi?
Mesrɛ wo, twe wo ho firi me ho, sɛ wofa benkum a, mɛfa nifa, na sɛ wofa nifa a, mɛfa benkum.
Na Lot maa n’ani so hwɛɛ Yordan kanko nyinaa de kɔsi Soar hunuu sɛ ne nyinaa so wɔ nsuo te sɛ AWURADE turo no, te sɛ Misraim, ansa na AWURADE resɛe Sodom ne Gomora no.
Na Lot yii Yordan kanko no nyinaa, na ɔtu faa apueeɛ fam; na anuanom no dii mpaapaemu.
Abram tenaa Kanaan asase so, na Lot deɛ, ɔtenaa Yordan kanko no nkuro mu, na ɔtutuu ne ntomadan ara de kɔduruu Sodom.
Nso na Sodomfoɔ yɛ atirimuɔdenfoɔ ne nnebɔneyɛfoɔ kɛse, AWURADE anim.
Abram kɔtena Hebron Na Lot tee ne ho firii Abram ho no, AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Abram sɛ: Ma w’ani so, na firi deɛ wowɔ hɔ hwɛ atifi fam ne anafoɔ fam, apueeɛ ne atɔeɛ.
Na asase a wohunu yi nyinaa, wo ne w’asefoɔ na mede bɛma mo daa.
Na mɛma w’asefoɔ adɔɔso sɛ asase so mfuturo.
Na sɛ obi tumi kan asase so mfuturo a, ɛnneɛ na ɔbɛtumi akan w’asefoɔ nso.
Sɔre, fa asase no tentene ne ne tɛtrɛtɛ mu, na wo na mede bɛma woɔ.
Na Abram tutuu ne ntomadan, na ɔbɛtenaa Mamre pɔ a ɛwɔ Hebron no ho, na ɔsii afɔrebukyia maa AWURADE wɔ hɔ.
Ahemfo kɔko gye Lot Na Sinear hene Amrafel, Elasar hene Ariok, Elam hene Kedorlaomer ne Goiim hene Tideal berɛ so no, wɔne Sodom hene Bera ne Gomora hene Birsa, Adma hene Sinab ne Seboim hene Semeber ne Bela (a ɛne Soar) hene dii ako.
Ahemfo yeinom nyinaa bɛhyiaa Sidim bonhwa mu, (ɛno ne Nkyene Po no).
Mfirinhyia dummienu na wɔsomm Kedorlaomer, na afe a ɛtɔ so dummiɛnsa no, wɔtee atua.
Na afe a ɛtɔ so dunan mu no, Kedorlaomer ne ahemfo a wɔkeka ne ho no bɛkum Refaim wɔ Asterot-karnaim, ne Susifoɔ wɔ Ham, ne Emifoɔ Kiriataim mpaperɛ so, ne Horifoɔ wɔ wɔn bepɔ Seir so de kɔsii El-paran a ɛwɔ ɛserɛ soɔ no.
Na wɔsane baa Enmispat, (ɛne Kades), na wɔkaa Amalekfoɔ asase nyinaa ne Amorifoɔ nso a wɔte Haseson-tamar no gui.
Na Sodom, Gomora, Adma, Seboim ne Bela (a ɛne Soar) ahemfo firi bae.
Na wɔne Elam hene Kedorlaomer, Goiim hene Tideal, Sinear hene Amrafel ne Elasar hene Ariok de bɛbɔɔ ani wɔ Sidim bonhwa mu, ahemfo baanan a wɔreko atia baanum.
Na Sidim bonhwa mu yɛ ama amena ara nko.
Na Sodom ne Gomora ahemfo dwanee.
Na ebinom totɔɔ amena no mu, na wɔn a aka no dwane kɔɔ bepɔ so.
Na wɔfaa Sodom ne Gomora nnoɔma ne wɔn nnuane nyinaa de sii mu kɔe.
Na wɔfaa Abram nua ba Lot a ɔte Sodom ne n’ahodeɛ kɔe.
Na odwanefoɔ bi bɛka kyerɛɛ Hebrini Abram a ɔte Amorini Mamre, Eskol ne Aner nua no pɔ mu; na wɔne Abram wɔ apam.
Abram gye Lot Na Abram tee sɛ wɔafa ne nua ba dommum no, ɔde ne mmarima a wɔawo wɔn wɔ ne fie ahasa ne dunwɔtwe tuu ɔsa tii wɔn kɔduruu Dan.
Na ɔne ne nkoa kyɛɛ wɔn ho mu baa wɔn so anadwo, na wɔbobɔɔ wɔn, na wɔtaa wɔn kɔduruu Hoba a ɛda Damasko benkum no.
Na ɔde nnoɔma no nyinaa ne ne nua ba Lot ne ne nnoɔma ne mmaa no nso ne nkurɔfoɔ no sane bae.
Melkisedek hyira Abram Na ɔsane firii Kedorlaomer ne ahemfo a ɛkeka ne ho so nkonimdie reba no, Sodom hene firi kɔhyiaa no wɔ Sawe bonhwa (a ɛne Ɔhene Bonhwa no) mu.
Na Salem hene Melkisedek de paanoo ne bobesa brɛɛ no; na ɔyɛ ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn sɔfoɔ.
Na ɔhyiraa no sɛ: Ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn a ɔyɛ ɔsoro ne asase wura no nhyira nka Abram.
Na nhyira ne ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn a ɔde w’atamfo ahyɛ wo nsa.
Na Abram maa no nnoɔma no nyinaa mu ntotosoɔ du du.
Na Sodom hene ka kyerɛɛ Abram sɛ: Fa nnipa no ma me, na fa ahodeɛ no.
Na Abram ka kyerɛɛ Sodom hene no sɛ: Mema me nsa so mekyerɛ AWURADE, ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn a ɔyɛ ɔsoro ne asase wura no, sɛ ɛfiri asaawa so de kɔsi mpaboa homa soɔ, meremfa biribiara a ɛyɛ wo deɛ, na woanka sɛ: Me na mama Abram anya ne ho; gye deɛ mmeranteɛ no adie no nko, ne mmarima a wɔne me kɔeɛ no, Aner, Eskol ne Mamre nya wɔn kyɛfa.
Onyankopɔn de ɔba hyɛ Abram bɔ Nsɛm yi akyiri no, AWURADE asɛm baa Abram nkyɛn anisoadehunu mu sɛ: Nsuro, Abram, mene wo kyɛm, na w’akatua bɛdɔɔso pii.
Na Abram bisaa sɛ: AWURADE Nyankopɔn, ɛdeɛn na wode bɛma me?
Menni ba na menam, na deɛ ɔbɛdi m’adeɛ ne Damaskoni Eliesa anaa?
Na Abram kaa sɛ: Ao, me deɛ, woamma me asefoɔ, na hwɛ, me fienipa na ɔbɛdi m’adeɛ.
Na AWURADE asɛm baa ne nkyɛn sɛ: Ɛnyɛ oyi na ɔbɛdi w’adeɛ, na deɛ ɔbɛfiri wo ara w’asene mu na ɔbɛdi w’adeɛ.
Na ɔde no firii adi kaa sɛ: Hwɛ ɔsoro ɛ, na kan nsoromma sɛ wobɛtumi akan anaa?
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ w’asefoɔ bɛyɛ ne no.
Na Abram gyee AWURADE diiɛ, na ɔbuu yei sɛ tenenee maa no.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Mene AWURADE a ɔde wo firii Ur a ɛwɔ Kaldea no, sɛ mede asase yi bɛma wo sɛ agyapadeɛ.
Na ɔbisaa sɛ: AWURADE Nyankopɔn, ɛdeɛn na mede bɛhunu sɛ mɛnya?
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Fa nantwie ba a wadi mfeɛ mmiɛnsa, abirekyie a wadi mfeɛ mmiɛnsa, odwennini a wadi mfeɛ mmiɛnsa, anyankuku ne aborɔnoma ba brɛ me.
Na ɔde yei nyinaa brɛɛ no, na ɔpaepaee wɔn mu mmienu mmienu, na ɔde afaafa no kyerɛkyerɛɛ anim totoo hɔ; na nnomaa no deɛ, wampaapae wɔn mu.
Na nnomaa a wɔdi nam bɛsisii mmoa afunu no so, na Abram pamm wɔn.
Na owia reyɛ akɔtɔ no, Abram daa nnahɔɔ, na hwɛ, ehu sum kabii duruu no.
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Abram sɛ: Hunu ampa ara sɛ w’asefoɔ bɛyɛ ahɔhoɔ asase a ɛnyɛ wɔn dea so, na wɔayɛ nkoa na wɔasom, na wɔbɛha wɔn mfirinhyia ahanan.
Na ɔman a wɔbɛsom wɔn no, mɛbu wɔn atɛn, na akyire yi no, wɔde ahodeɛ pii bɛfiri hɔ akɔ.
Na wo deɛ, wobɛkɔ wo nananom nkyɛn asomdwoeɛ mu, na wɔasie wo nkɔkoraaberɛ pa mu.
Na awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nnan mu na wɔbɛsane aba ha, ɛfiri sɛ Amorifoɔ amumuyɛ nnya nnurui.
Na owia tɔeɛ na esum kusuu duruiɛ no, hwɛ, biribi a ɛte sɛ gyaframa a ɛrefiri wisie ne tɛnee a ɛredɛre bɛfaa afaafa no ntam.
Da no ara na AWURADE ne Abram yɛɛ apam sɛ: W’asefoɔ na mede asase yi mama wɔn ɛfiri Misraim asubɔnten ho de kɔsi asubɔnten kɛseɛ, Eufrate asubɔnten ho: Kenifoɔ, Kenisifoɔ, Kadmonifoɔ, Hetifoɔ, Perisifoɔ, Refaimfoɔ, Amorifoɔ, Kanaanfoɔ, Girgasifoɔ ne Yebusifoɔ.
Hagar ne Ismael Na Abram yere Sarai nwo mma no.
Na ɔwɔ afenaa bi a ɔyɛ Misraimni a ne din de Hagar.
Na Sarai ka kyerɛɛ Abram sɛ: Hwɛ, AWURADE asi m’awoɔ ho kwan, enti kɔ m’afenaa nkyɛn, ebia mɛnya ne ho mma.
Na Abram tiee Sarai.
Na Abram tenaa Kanaan asase so mfirinhyia du no, ne yere Sarai faa n’afenaa Hagar a ɔyɛ Misraimni no de no maa ne kunu awareɛ.
Na ɔkɔɔ Hagar ho, na ɔnyinsɛnee.
Na ɔhunuu sɛ wanyinsɛn no, ɔbuu n’awuraa animtia.
Na Sarai ka kyerɛɛ Abram sɛ: Asɛmmɔne a wadi me da wo so.
Me na mede m’afenaa mato wo kokom, na ɔhunuu sɛ wanyinsɛn nti, ɔbu me animtia.
AWURADE mmu me ne wo ntam atɛn.
Ɛnna Abram ka kyerɛɛ Sarai sɛ: Hwɛ, w’afenaa wɔ wo nsam, yɛ no sɛdeɛ ɛyɛ w’ani soɔ.
Na Sarai tanee n’ani maa no dwane firii ne nkyɛn.
Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ hunuu no nsuo aniwa bi ho wɔ ɛserɛ so wɔ Sur kwan so nsuo aniwa no ho.
Na ɔbisaa sɛ: Hagar, Sarai afenaa, wofiri he na woreba, na worekɔ he ni?
Na ɔse: Mefiri m’awuraa Sarai anim na meredwane.
Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sane kɔ w’awuraa nkyɛn, na kɔbrɛ wo ho ase ma no.
Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Dɔ na mɛma w’asefoɔ adɔ, na wɔn dodoɔ nti wɔrentumi nkan wɔn.
Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, woanyinsɛn, na wobɛwo ɔba, na wobɛto ne din Ismael, sɛ AWURADE ate w’amanehunu.
Na ɔbɛyɛ onipa a ɔte sɛ ɛserɛ so afunumu.
Ne nsa bɛtia nnipa nyinaa, na nnipa nyinaa nsa atia no, na ɔbɛsɔre atia ne nuanom nyinaa.
Na ɔfrɛɛ AWURADE a ɔne no kasaeɛ no din sɛ: Wone El-roi, na ɔse: Mahunu deɛ ɔhu me no ampa anaa?
Enti wɔfrɛ asubura no sɛ: Beer-lahai-roi, na hwɛ, ɛwɔ Kades ne Bared ntam.
Na Hagar woo ɔba maa Abram.
Abram frɛɛ ne ba a Hagar woo no no Ismael.
Na Hagar woo Ismael maa Abram no, na Abram adi mfeɛ aduɔwɔtwe nsia.
Apam no ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ Na Abram dii mfirinhyia aduɔkron nkron no, AWURADE yii ne ho kyerɛɛ no kaa sɛ: Mene Onyankopɔn Tweaduampɔn, nante m’anim, na yɛ pɛ.
Na mɛma m’apam ada me ne wo ntam, na mama woadɔ kɛse ara.
Na Abram daa hɔ de n’anim butuu fam; na Onyankopɔn ne no kasaa sɛ: Me deɛ, hwɛ, m’apam da hɔ ma wo, na mɛyɛ wo aman pii agya.
Na wɔremfrɛ wo din Abram bio, na mmom wɔbɛfrɛ wo Abraham, ɛfiri sɛ mayɛ wo aman pii agya.
Na mɛma woadɔ pii pa ara, na mɛyɛ wo aman, na ahemfo afiri wo mu.
Na mɛma me ne wo ne w’asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi w’akyire no apam agyina wɔ wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mu, na ayɛ daa apam, na mayɛ wo ne w’asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi w’akyire no Nyankopɔn.
Na mede asase a woyɛ so hɔhoɔ yi, Kanaan asase nyinaa, bɛma wo ne w’asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi w’akyire, sɛ daa agyapadeɛ, na mayɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn.
Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Wo deɛ, di m’apam so, wo ne w’asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi w’akyi wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mu.
Yei ne me ne w’asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi w’akyire no ntam apam a monni soɔ: Wɔntwitwa mo mu mmarima nyinaa twetia.
Na montwitwa mo ho twetia, na ayɛ me ne mo ntam apam no ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ.
Na ɔbabarima biara a wadi nna nwɔtwe no, montwa no twetia mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mu, deɛ wɔawo no fie ne deɛ wɔde sika tɔɔ no wɔ ɔhɔhoɔ biara a ɔnyɛ w’aseni nkyɛn.
Twa deɛ wɔawo no wɔ wo fie ne deɛ wɔde wo sika tɔɔ no twetia, na m’apam atena mo honam mu sɛ daa apam.
Na ɔbarima momonoto biara a wɔntwaa no twetia no, saa onipa no wɔbɛtwa no afiri ne man mu, ɛfiri sɛ wato m’apam.
Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Wo yere Sarai deɛ, mfrɛ no Sarai bio, na mmom Sara.
Na mɛhyira no, na mama wo ne mu ɔba nso, ampa ara, mɛhyira no.
Ɔbɛyɛ aman, na aman ahemfo bɛfiri ne mu.
Na Abraham de n’anim butuu fam seree, na ɔkaa no n’akomam sɛ: Yee!
Wɔbɛwo ɔba ama deɛ wadi mfirinhyia ɔha, na Sara a wadi mfeɛ aduɔkron no bɛwo anaa?
Na Abraham ka kyerɛɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ: O, ɛnneɛ anka ma Ismael nya w’anim adom ɛ!
Na Onyankopɔn kaa sɛ: Ampaneampa, wo yere Sara bɛwo ɔba ama wo, na woato ne din Isak.
Na mɛma me ne no apam no agyina ayɛ daa apam ama n’asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi n’akyire no.
Na Ismael ho deɛ, matie wo.
Hwɛ, mɛhyira no, na mama no awo, na wadɔɔso pii pa ara.
Atitire dummienu na ɔbɛwoɔ, na mayɛ no ɔman kɛseɛ.
Na m’apam deɛ, me ne Isak a Sara bɛwo no ama wo afeda sɛsɛɛ no na ɛbɛpam ama no agyina.
Na ɔne no wiee kasa no, Onyankopɔn firii Abraham nkyɛn kɔɔ ɔsoro.
Na Abraham faa ne ba Ismael ne wɔn a wɔawo wɔn wɔ ne fie ne wɔn a ɔde ne sika tɔɔ wɔn nyinaa, Abraham fiefoɔ mu mmarima nyinaa, na ɔtwitwaa wɔn twetia da no ara, sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ no no.
Na Abraham adi mfirinhyia aduɔkron nkron na wɔtwaa no twetia.
Na ne ba Ismael adi mfeɛ dummiɛnsa na wɔtwaa no twetia.
Da no ara na wɔtwitwaa Abraham ne ne ba Ismael twetia.
Na ne fie mmarima nyinaa, wɔn a wɔwoo wɔn ne fie ne wɔn a wɔde sika totɔɔ wɔn wɔ ahɔhoɔ nkyɛn, wɔtwitwaa wɔn twetia kaa ne ho.
Isak awoɔ ho bɔhyɛ Na AWURADE yii ne ho kyerɛɛ Abraham wɔ Mamre pɔ mu, na ɔte ne ntomadan pono ano awia ketee.
Na ɔmaa n’ani so hwɛe, na hwɛ, mmarima baasa abɛgyina ne ntentensoɔ.
Na ɔhunuu wɔn no, ɔfirii ne ntomadan pono ano tuu mmirika kɔhyiaa wɔn, na ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase kaa sɛ: Me wura, sɛ manya w’anim adom a, mesrɛ wo, nsiane w’akoa ho nkɔ.
Ma wɔnkɔsa nsuo kakraa bi mmra, na monhohoro mo nan ase, na monhome dua yi ase.
Moanya abɛfa mo akoa nkyɛn yi, merekɔ makɔfa paanoo kakra maba, na mode adwodwo mo akoma, na ɛno akyiri no moakɔ.
Na wɔse: Yɛ sɛdeɛ woaka yi.
Na Abraham yɛɛ ntɛm kɔɔ Sara nkyɛn ntomadan mu kaa sɛ: Yɛ ntɛm, fa esiam pa susukoraa mmiɛnsa, fete to taterɛ.
Na Abraham tuu mmirika kɔɔ anantwie mu kɔkyeree nantwie ba a ɔyɛ na ɔde maa ɔsomfoɔ bi, na ɔyɛɛ ntɛm siesiee no.
Na Abraham faa nufosuo ani sradeɛ ne nufosuo ne nantwie ba nam a ɔsiesiee no no, na ɔde bɛsii wɔn anim; na ɔno deɛ, ɔgyinaa wɔn nkyɛn dua no ase, maa wɔdidii.
Na wɔbisaa Abraham sɛ: Wo yere Sara wɔ he?
Na ɔse: Hwɛ, ɔwɔ ntomadan mu.
Na wɔn mu baako kaa sɛ: Ampa ara, mɛsane maba wo nkyɛn afeda sɛsɛɛ no, na wo yere Sara anya ɔba.
Na Sara retie no ntomadan pono a ɛwɔ n’akyire no ano.
Na Abraham ne Sara nyinaa anyininyini a wɔadi mfirinhyia pii, na deɛ ɛyɛ mmaa no to atwa wɔ Sara ho.
Enti Sara seree ne mu kaa sɛ: Sɛ manya awie aberewa bɔ na me wura nso abɔ akɔkoraa yi, na mɛnya anigyeɛ?
Na AWURADE bisaa Abraham sɛ: Adɛn nti na Sara seree sɛ: Ampaneampa ara manyini yi mɛwo ɔba?
Biribi yɛ AWURADE yɛna anaa?
Berɛ a mahyɛ no, mɛsane aba wo nkyɛn afeda sɛsɛɛ no na Sara anya ɔba.
Na Sara sanee sɛ: Menseree, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔsuro.
Na ɔse: Dabi, woasere.
Abraham di ma Sodomfoɔ Na mmarima no sɔre firii hɔ danee wɔn ani kyerɛɛ Sodom, na Abraham kɔgyaa wɔn kwan.
Na AWURADE kaa sɛ: Memfa deɛ merebɛyɛ yi mensie Abraham anaa?
Ɛfiri sɛ ampa ara Abraham bɛyɛ ɔman a ɛso na wɔwɔ tumi, na ne mu na wɔbɛhyira wiase aman nyinaa.
Na mahu no mayi no sɛ ɔnhyɛ ne mma ne ne fiefoɔ a ɛbɛdi n’akyire sɛ wɔnni AWURADE kwan so nyɛ tenenee ne atɛntenenee adeɛ, na AWURADE ama deɛ waka no Abraham ho no aba ne so.
Na AWURADE kaa sɛ: Ɛsiane sɛ Sodom ne Gomora so nteamu so, na wɔn nnebɔne yɛ duru dodo nti, meresiane makɔhwɛ sɛ wɔayɛ sɛdeɛ nteamu a ɛduru me nkyɛn no teɛ no a; na sɛ ɛnte saa, mahunu.
Na mmarima no danee wɔn ani firii hɔ kɔɔ Sodom; na Abraham deɛ, na ɔda so gyina AWURADE anim ara.
Na Abraham twe bɛn bisaa sɛ: Wobɛpra ɔteneneeni ne ɔbɔnefoɔ abom agu anaa?
Sɛ ebia sɛsɛɛ ateneneefoɔ aduonum wɔ kuro no mu a, anka wobɛpra wɔn agu a ateneneefoɔ aduonum a ɛwɔ mu no nti woremfa kuro no ho nkyɛ wɔn anaa?
Yei mpare wo sɛ wobɛdi saa asɛm yi sɛ wobɛkum ɔteneneeni ne ɔdebɔneyɛni afra, na ɔteneneeni ayɛ sɛ ɔdebɔneyɛni; yei mpare wo.
Deɛ ɔbu asase nyinaa atɛn no remmu atɛntenenee anaa?
Na AWURADE kaa sɛ: Sɛ mehunu ateneneefoɔ aduonum Sodom kuro mu a, wɔn nti mede kuro no nyinaa ho bɛkyɛ wɔn.
Na Abraham buaa sɛ: Hwɛ, meyɛ mfuturo ne nso deɛ, nanso masi me bo sɛ me ne AWURADE bɛkasa: Sɛ ebia ateneneefoɔ aduonum no so te enum a; anka enum nti wobɛsɛe kuro no nyinaa anaa?
Na ɔse: Sɛ mehunu aduanan nnum wɔ hɔ a, merensɛe hɔ.
Na Abraham toaa so kasa kyerɛɛ AWURADE bio sɛ: Ebia wɔbɛhunu aduanan wɔ hɔ.
Na AWURADE buaa sɛ: Aduanan no nti merenyɛ.
Ɛnna ɔkaa sɛ: Mma AWURADE bo mmfu, na ma menkasa: Ebia wɔbɛhunu aduasa wɔ hɔ.
Na ɔse: Sɛ mehunu aduasa wɔ hɔ a, merenyɛ.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Hwɛ, masi me bo sɛ me ne AWURADE bɛkasa.
Ebia wɔbɛhunu aduonu wɔ hɔ.
Na ɔse: Aduonu no nti merensɛe hɔ.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Mma AWURADE bo mmfu, na menkasa baako pɛ yi: Ebia wɔbɛhunu edu wɔ hɔ.
Na ɔse: Edu no nti merensɛe hɔ.
Na AWURADE ne Abraham kasa wieeɛ no, ɔkɔe, na Abraham sane baa ne fie.
Sodom nneyɛɛ bɔne Na abɔfoɔ baanu no duruu Sodom anwummerɛ; na Lot te Sodom kuro pono ano.
Na Lot hunuu wɔn no, ɔsɔre kɔhyiaa wɔn, na ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase kaa sɛ: Me wuranom, mesrɛ mo, mommane mmra mo akoa fie mmɛsoɛ anadwo yi, na monhohoro mo nan ase, na anɔpatutu moasɔre akɔ mo kwan.
Na wɔse: Dabi, yɛbɛda abɔntene so.
Na ɔsrɛɛ wɔn dendeenden.
Na wɔmanee ne nkyɛn baa ne fie, na ɔtoo wɔn pono, na ɔtoo apiti maa wɔdii.
Na wɔnnya nkɔdaeɛ no, Sodom kurom hɔfoɔ bɛtwaa ɛdan no ho hyiae, ɛfiri mmɔfra so kɔsi mpanimfoɔ so, ɔman mu no nyinaa.
Na wɔfrɛɛ Lot ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Mmarima a wɔbaa wo nkyɛn anadwo yi no wɔ he?
Yi wɔn brɛ yɛn, na yɛne wɔn nna.
Na Lot firi kɔɔ wɔn nkyɛn ɛpono ano, na ɔtoo ɛpono no mu wɔ n’akyi.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Anuanom, mesrɛ mo, monnyɛ bɔne saa!
Hwɛ, mewɔ mmammaa baanu a wɔnhunuu ɔbarima, momma memfa wɔn mfiri mmrɛ mo, na monyɛ wɔn sɛdeɛ ɛyɛ mo ani soɔ na mmarima yi nko deɛ, monnyɛ wɔn hwee, na ɛno nti na wɔbaa me suhyɛ aseɛ yi.
Na wɔkaa sɛ: Twe wo ho firi hɔ!
Na wɔse: Saa onipa yi ba bɛyɛɛ ɔhɔhoɔ, ɛnna afei ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ ɔtemmufoɔ yi!
Afei yɛbɛyɛ wo bɔne akyɛne wɔn.
Na wɔhyɛɛ ɔbarima Lot so denden twe baa sɛ wɔbɛbubu ɛpono no.
Na mmarima no tenee wɔn nsa twee Lot baa wɔn nkyɛn wɔ ɛdan no mu, na wɔtoo ɛpono no mu.
Na nnipa a wɔgyina ɛpono ano no deɛ, wɔfirafiraa wɔn ani firi mmɔfra so kɔsi mpanin so, na wɔhwehwɛɛ ɛpono ano kwan brɛe.
Lot tu firi Sodom Na mmarima no ka kyerɛɛ Lot sɛ: Wowɔ obi wɔ ha ka wo ho?
Aseɛ anaa mmammarima anaa mmammaa anaa biribiara a wowɔ wɔ kuro yi mu, yi wɔn firi ha, na yɛrebɛsɛe ha, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn nnebɔne ayɛ kɛse AWURADE anim, na AWURADE asoma yɛn sɛ yɛmmɛsɛe ha.
Na Lot firii adi ne ne nsenom a wɔrebɛware ne mmammaa no kɔkasaa sɛ: Monsɔre mfiri ha, na AWURADE rebɛsɛe kuro yi.
Nanso ɔyɛɛ ne nsenom ani so sɛ obi a ɔredi fɛw.
Na adeɛ reyɛ akye no, abɔfoɔ no piapiaa Lot sɛ: Sɔre, fa wo yere ne wo mmammaa baanu a wɔwɔ ha no kɔ, anyɛ saa a, wɔbɛsɛe wo, ɔman yi asotwe mu.
Na ɔtwentwɛn ne nan ase no, mmarima no sosɔɔ ɔno ne ne yere ne ne mmammaa baanu no nsa, na wɔde no firii adi gyaa no kuro no akyi ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE huu no mmɔbɔ.
Na wɔde wɔn firii adie no, ɔkaa sɛ: Dwane gye wo kra nkwa, nhwɛ w’akyi, nso nnyina kanko yi mu baabiara; bepɔ so na dwane korɔ, anyɛ saa a, wɔbɛsɛe wo.
Na Lot ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: O, me wura, nnyɛ saa.
Hwɛ, w’akoa anya w’anim adom, na woama w’adɔeɛ a woayɛ me yi aso sɛ woregye me nkwa nanso merentumi nnwane nkɔ mmepɔ no so, na mmusuo no ammɛto me, na manwu.
Hwɛ, kuro yi na ɛbɛn sɛ wɔdwane kɔ hɔ, ɛhɔ sua.
Ma mennwane nkɔ hɔ ɛ!
Ɛnsua anaa?
Na me kra anya nkwa.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, matie wo wɔ saa asɛm yi ho nso, na meremmutu kuro a woaka ho asɛm yi.
Yɛ ntɛm dwane kɔ hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ merentumi nyɛ hwee gye sɛ woakɔduru hɔ ansa.
Enti na wɔfrɛ kuro no din sɛ: Soar.
Sodom ne Gomora sɛeɛ Na Lot duruu Soar no, na owia apue asase so.
Na AWURADE tɔɔ sɔfe ne ogya firi ɔsoro guu Sodom ne Gomora so.
Na ɔbutuu nkuro no ne kanko no nyinaa ne wɔn a wɔtete nkuro no mu nyinaa ne deɛ afifiri asase no soɔ.
Na Lot yere no deɛ, ɔhwɛɛ n’akyi, na ɔdanee nkyene sie.
Na Abraham tuaa ahema kɔɔ faako a na ɔgyina AWURADE anim hɔ no.
Na ɔdanee n’ani kyerɛɛ Sodom ne Gomora ne kanko no asase nyinaa, na ɔhwɛe, na hwɛ, asase no so wisie foroo sɛ fononoo mu wisie.
Enti berɛ a Onyankopɔn sɛee kanko no nkuro no no, ɔkaee Abraham, na ɔgyee Lot firii butuo a ɔbutuu nkuro a Lot te mu no mu.
Moabfoɔ ne Amonfoɔ ahyɛaseɛ Na Lot firii Soar kɔtenaa bepɔ no so, ɔne ne mmammaa baanu no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔsuroo Soar tena, na ɔne wɔn kɔtenaa ɔbodan bi mu.
Na abakan no ka kyerɛɛ akumaa no sɛ: Yɛn agya anyini, na ɔbarima biara nni asase yi so a ɔbɛba yɛn ho, sɛdeɛ asase sofoɔ nyinaa amanneɛ teɛ.
Bra, na yɛmma yɛn agya nsa nnom, na yɛne no nkɔda, na yɛanya yɛn agya ho mma.
Na wɔmaa wɔn agya nsa nomee anadwo no, na abakan no kɔɔ mu ne n’agya kɔdae; na wanhunu ne nna ne ne sɔreɛ mu.
Na adeɛ kyeeɛ no, abakan no ka kyerɛɛ akumaa no sɛ: Hwɛ, me ne m’agya akɔda anadwo yi, ma yɛmma no nsa nnom nnɛ anadwo yi nso, na kɔ mu, na wo ne no nkɔda, na yɛanya yɛn agya ho mma.
Na wɔmaa wɔn agya nsa nomee anadwo no nso, na akumaa no sɔre ne no kɔdae; na wanhunu ne nna ne ne sɔreɛ mu.
Na Lot mma maa baanu no nyinaa nyinsɛn wɔn agya ho.
Na abakan no woo ɔbabarima, na ɔtoo no din Moab; ɔne Moabfoɔ agya de bɛsi nnɛ.
Na akumaa no nso woo ɔbabarima, na ɔtoo no din Ben-ami; ɔne Amon mma agya de bɛsi nnɛ.
Abraham ne Abimelek Na Abraham tutu firii hɔ kɔɔ Negeb asase so, na ɔkɔtenaa Kades ne Sur ntam.
Na ɔkɔtenaa Gerar nso.
Ɛhɔ Abraham kaa ne yere Sara ho sɛ: Ɔyɛ me nuabaa.
Na Gerar hene Abimelek soma maa wɔbɛfaa Sara.
Na Onyankopɔn baa Abimelek nkyɛn anadwo daeɛ mu, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, ɔbaa a woakɔfa no no nti, woawu awie, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbarima bi yere.
Nso na Abimelek nnya mfaa ne ho nkaa no.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: AWURADE, wobɛkum ɔman tenenee nso?
Ɛnyɛ ɔno na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Me nua ne no?
Na ɔbaa no nso kaa sɛ: Me nua ne no.
M’akomam kann ne me tirim fitaa na mede meyɛɛ yei.
Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ no daeɛ mu sɛ: Me nso menim sɛ w’akomam kann na wode yɛɛ yei, na me nso mesɔɔ wo mu, na woanyɛ bɔne, ɛno nti na mamma woamfa wo ho anka no no.
Na afei dane ɔbarima no yere kɔma no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ odiyifoɔ, na wapa kyɛw ama wo, na woanya nkwa; na sɛ woannane no ankɔma no a, ɛnneɛ, hunu sɛ wuo na wobɛwuo, wo ne deɛ ɛwɔ woɔ nyinaa.
Na Abimelek sɔree anɔpatutu frɛɛ ne nkoa nyinaa, na ɔkaa nsɛm yi nyinaa guu wɔn aso mu, na nnipa no suroo pii.
Na Abimelek frɛɛ Abraham ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na woayɛ yɛn yi, na bɔne bɛn na mayɛ woɔ, na wode bɔne kɛseɛ yi aba me ne m’ahennie soɔ?
Adeɛ a wɔnyɛ na woayɛ me yi.
Na Abimelek ka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na wohunuiɛ na wodii saa asɛm yi?
Na Abraham kaa sɛ: Ɛfiri sɛ mesusuu sɛ, ampa Onyankopɔn ho suro nni ha yi, na me yere nti wɔbɛku me.
Nanso ɛwom ampa sɛ ɔyɛ me nua; m’agya ba ne no, na ɛnyɛ me na ba a; na wayɛ me yere.
Na Onyankopɔn maa mefirii m’agya fie mebɛkyiniiɛ no, mesee ɔbaa no sɛ: W’adɔeɛ a wobɛyɛ me ne sɛ, baabiara a yɛbɛduro no, ka no me ho sɛ: Ɔyɛ me nua.
Ɛnna Abimelek faa nnwan ne anantwie ne nkoa ne mfenaa de maa Abraham, na ɔdanee ne yere Sara maa no.
Na Abimelek kaa sɛ: Hwɛ, m’asase na ɛda w’anim yi, baabiara a ɛyɛ wɔ w’ani soɔ no, tena.
Na Sara deɛ, ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, mama wo nua nnwetɛbena apem, hwɛ, ɛno na wɔn a wɔka wo ho nyinaa de bɛhunu wo tirim, na wo ho afi nnipa nyinaa anim.
Na Abraham bɔɔ Onyankopɔn mpaeɛ, na Onyankopɔn saa Abimelek ne ne yere ne ne mfenaa yadeɛ maa wɔwowoe.
Ɛsiane Abraham yere Sara ho asɛm no nti, na AWURADE ato Abimelek fiefoɔ mmaa nyinaa yafunu mu.
Isak awoɔ Na AWURADE bɛhwɛɛ Sara sɛdeɛ ɔkaeɛ no, na ɔyɛɛ Sara sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ no bɔ no.
Na Sara nyinsɛnee, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima maa Abraham wɔ ne nkɔkoraaberɛ mu, berɛ a Onyankopɔn kaa ne ho asɛm no mu.
Abraham too ɔba a Sara wo maa no no din Isak.
Na Abraham ba Isak dii nnawɔtwe no, ɔtwaa no twetia sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ no no.
Na Abraham adi mfirinhyia ɔha berɛ a wɔwoo ne ba Isak maa no no.
Na Sara kaa sɛ: Onyankopɔn ama me sereɛ, obiara a ɔbɛteɛ no bɛsere ama me.
Na ɔse: Hwan na anka ɔbɛka akyerɛ Abraham sɛ Sara bɛma mma nufoɔ?
Nanso hwɛ, mawo ba ama no ne nkɔkoraaberɛ mu.
Na abɔfra no nyinii, na wɔtwaa no nufoɔ.
Na da a wɔtwaa Isak nufoɔ no, Abraham too pono kɛseɛ.
Wɔpamo Hagar ne Ismael Na Sara hunuu Misraimni Hagar ba a ɔwo maa Abraham no sɛ ɔredi fɛw.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Pamo afenaa yi ne ne ba no, na ɛnyɛ afenaa yi ba ne me ba Isak na ɛbɛdi adeɛ.
Na ne ba no nti, asɛm no yɛɛ Abraham ya yie.
Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Mma abɔfra no ne w’afenaa asɛm no nnyɛ wo ya, na deɛ Sara ka kyerɛɛ woɔ nyinaa, tie, na Isak mu na wɔbɛfrɛ w’asefoɔ.
Na afenaa ba no nso, mɛyɛ no ɔman kɛseɛ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ w’aseni.
Na Abraham sɔree anɔpatutu faa aduane ne nsuo kotokuo, na ɔde maa Hagar, ɔde sii ne kɔn ho, na ɔmaa no ne abɔfra no kɔe.
Na ɔkɔe kɔkyinkyinii Beer-seba serɛ so.
Na nsuo no saa wɔ kotokuo no mu no, ɔgyaa abɔfra no too dɔtɔ bi ase.
Ɛnna ɔkɔ kɔtenaa akyiri bɛyɛ sɛ deɛ wɔto bɛmma a ɛbɛtɔ, na ɔse: Mma mennhunu abɔfra yi wuo!
Na ɔtenaa ne ntentensoɔ, na ɔmaa ne nne so sui.
Na Onyankopɔn tee abarimaa no nne, na Nyankopɔn bɔfoɔ firi soro frɛɛ Hagar bisaa no sɛ: Hagar, ɛdeɛn na ɛreyɛ woɔ?
Nsuro, na Onyankopɔn ate abarimaa no nne wɔ deɛ ɔwɔ hɔ.
Sɔre ma abarimaa no so, na fa wo nsa sɔ ne mu; na mɛyɛ no ɔman kɛseɛ.
Na Onyankopɔn buee n’ani, na ɔhunuu subura bi, na ɔkɔ kɔsaa bi hyɛɛ nsuo kotokuo no ma, na ɔde bi maa abarimaa no nomee.
Na Onyankopɔn dii abarimaa no akyi, na ɔnyinii, na ɔtenaa ɛserɛ so hɔ yɛɛ agyantoni.
Na ɔtenaa Paran serɛ so; na ne na kɔwaree yerɛ firi Misraim asase so brɛɛ no.
Abimelek ne Abraham apam Na berɛ no mu no, Abimelek ne ne safohene Pikol bɛka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Onyankopɔn di w’akyi wɔ biribiara a woyɛ mu.
Enti afei ka Onyankopɔn ntam kyerɛ me sɛ worentwa me ne me mma ne me mmanana nkontompo, na sɛ adɔeɛ a meyɛɛ woɔ no teɛ no, wode bi bɛyɛ me ne m’asase a woabɛyɛ hɔhoɔ wɔ soɔ yi.
Na Abraham kaa sɛ: Mɛka ntam no.
Na asubura bi a Abimelek nkoa nam aniɛden so gyeeɛ no nti, Abraham kaa Abimelek anim.
Na Abimelek kaa sɛ: Mennim deɛ ɔyɛɛ saa adeɛ yi, na wo nso, woanka ankyerɛ me, nanso mentee da, gye nnɛ.
Na Abraham de nnwan ne anantwie maa Abimelek, na wɔn baanu pamee.
Na Abraham yii nnwanten mma abereɛ nson gyinaa fa.
Na Abimelek bisaa Abraham sɛ: Nnwanten mma abereɛ nson a woyii wɔn gyinaa fa yi aseɛ ne sɛn?
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Nnwanten mma abereɛ nson yi, gye wɔ me nsam, na ɛnyɛ me adanseɛ sɛ me na metuu abura yi.
Enti ɔfrɛɛ hɔ Beer-seba, ɛfiri sɛ ɛhɔ na wɔn baanu nyinaa kekaa ntam.
Na wɔpamee wɔ Beer-seba; na Abimelek ne ne safohene Pikol sɔree, na wɔsane kɔɔ Filistifoɔ asase so.
Na Abraham duaa ɛsɛnteɛ dua wɔ Beer-seba, na ɔsɔree AWURADE a ɔyɛ daa Nyankopɔn no wɔ hɔ.
Na Abraham yɛɛ ɔhɔhoɔ Filistifoɔ asase so nna pii.
Onyankopɔn hyɛ Abraham sɛ ɔmfa Isak mmɔ afɔreɛ Na nsɛm yi akyiri no, Onyankopɔn sɔɔ Abraham hwɛe, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Abraham!
Na ɔse: Menie.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Fa wo ba, wo ba korɔ a wodɔ no, Isak, kɔ Moria asase so, na fa no kɔbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ wɔ hɔ, wɔ mmepɔ no mu baako a mɛkyerɛ woɔ so.
Na Abraham sɔree anɔpatutu, na ɔhyehyɛɛ n’afunumu, na ɔfaa n’asomfoɔ mu baanu ne ne ba Isak kaa ne ho, na ɔtwaa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ nnyina, na ɔsii mu kɔɔ faako a Onyankopɔn kyerɛɛ no no.
Na da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, Abraham maa n’ani so, na ɔhunuu beaeɛ hɔ wɔ akyirikyiri.
Na Abraham ka kyerɛɛ ne somfoɔ no sɛ: Mo ne afunumu yi ntena ha; na me ne abarimaa yi bɛkɔ nohoa akɔsɔre, na yɛasane aba mo nkyɛn.
Na Abraham faa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ nnyina no de soaa ne ba Isak, na ɔfaa ogya ne sekan kurae, na wɔn baanu kɔe.
Na Isak ka kyerɛɛ n’agya Abraham sɛ: M’agya!
Na ɔse: Menie, me ba.
Na ɔse: Hwɛ, ogya ne nnyina nie, na adwammaa a wɔde rekɔbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no wɔ he?
Na Abraham se: Me ba, Onyankopɔn ankasa bɛkyerɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ adwammaa no.
Na wɔn baanu kɔe.
Na wɔkɔduruu deɛ Onyankopɔn kyerɛɛ no hɔ, na Abraham sii afɔrebukyia wɔ hɔ, na ɔsiesiee nnyina no, na ɔkyekyeree ne ba Isak, na ɔde no too afɔrebukyia no so wɔ nnyina no so.
Afei Abraham tenee ne nsa faa sekan no sɛ ɔde rebɛkum ne ba no.
Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ firi soro frɛɛ no sɛ: Abraham, Abraham!
Na ɔse: Menie.
Na ɔse: Mfa wo nsa nka abarimaa no, nso nyɛ no hwee.
Afei na mahunu sɛ wosuro Onyankopɔn, na woankame me wo ba korɔ no.
Na Abraham maa n’ani so, na ɔhunuu odwennini a dɔtɔ asɔ ne mmɛn mu wɔ n’akyi.
Na Abraham kɔfaa odwennini no de no sii ne ba no ananmu bɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ.
Na Abraham too bea hɔ din sɛ: Yahwe-yir’e.
Enti wɔka no nnɛ ara sɛ: AWURADE bepɔ so na wɔbɛhwɛ.
Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ firi soro frɛɛ Abraham bio sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Ɛsiane sɛ woayɛ saa asɛm yi, na woankame me wo ba korɔ no nti, maka me ho ntam sɛ: Hyira na mɛhyira woɔ, na dɔ na mɛma w’asefoɔ adɔre sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma ne mpoano anwea.
Na w’asefoɔ bɛfa wɔn atamfoɔ nkuro ano apono adi so.
Na w’asefoɔ mu na wɔbɛhyira asase so amanaman nyinaa, ɛfiri sɛ woatie me nne.
Ɛnna Abraham sane baa ne mmeranteɛ no nkyɛn, na wɔsɔre sii mu baa Beer-seba.
Na Abraham tenaa Beer-seba.
Nahor asefoɔ Na nsɛm yi akyiri no, wɔka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Hwɛ, Milka nso awo mma ama wo nua Nahor: N’abakan Us ne ne nua Bus ne Kemuel a ɔyɛ Aram agya, ne Kesed ne Haso ne Pildas ne Yidlaf ne Betuel.
Na Betuel woo Rebeka.
Nnipa baawɔtwe yi na Milka wo maa Abraham nua Nahor.
Na ne mpena baako bi a wɔfrɛ no Rehuma nso woo Teba, Gaham, Tahas ne Maaka.
Sara wuo ne ne sie Na Sara nkwa nna a ɔdiiɛ nyinaa yɛ mfirinhyia ɔha aduonu nson.
Na Sara wuu wɔ Kiriat-arba, (ɛne Hebron) a ɛwɔ Kanaan asase soɔ no.
Na Abraham ba bɛsuu Sara abia; ɔsuu no.
Na Abraham sɔre firii n’amu no anim, na ɔne Het mma kɔkasaa sɛ: Meyɛ mo nkyɛn hɔhoɔ ne mamfrani, momma me amusiebea wɔ mo nkyɛn, na mensie m’amu yi ma no mfiri m’ani so.
Na Het mma no buaa Abraham see no sɛ: Owura, tie yɛn!
Okunini bi ne wo wɔ yɛn mu.
Yɛn ada mu deɛ wopɛ no, sie w’amu no wɔ mu.
Yɛn mu biara renkame wo ne da, sɛ nsie w’amu wɔ mu.
Na Abraham sɔre gyinae, na ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase maa asase no so nkurɔfoɔ, Het mma no, na ɔne wɔn kasaa sɛ: Sɛ ɛyɛ mo pɛ sɛ mesie m’amu yi ma no firi m’ani so a, montie me, na monsrɛ Efron, Sohar ba, mma me, na ɔmfa Makpela bodan a ɛyɛ ne deɛ, na ɛwɔ n’afuo ano no mma me; ɔnnye me n’abotene na ɔmfa mma me, na mennya asieeɛ wɔ mo ha.
Na Efron te Het mma no mu.
Na Hetini Efron buaa Abraham maa Het mma no tee wɔ wɔn a wɔhyɛne ne kuro pono mu no nyinaa anim sɛ: Dabi, me wura, tie me: Mede afuo no mema wo, na ɔbodan a ɛwɔ mu no nso mede mema wo.
Me man mma anim na mede ma woɔ yi, sie w’amu.
Na Abraham bɔɔ ne mu ase wɔ asase no so nkurɔfoɔ no anim, na ɔkasa kyerɛɛ Efron maa asase no so nkurɔfoɔ no tee sɛ: Sɛ wotie me a, mede afuo no tiri dwetɛ bɛma wo; gye no me nsam, na mensie m’amu wɔ hɔ.
Na Efron buaa Abraham see no sɛ: Me wura, tie, nnwetɛbena ahanan asase yɛ deɛn wɔ me ne wo ntam?
W’amu ara na sie.
Na Abraham tiee Efron, na Abraham karii dwetɛ a Efron bɔɔ din maa Het mma teeɛ no maa no, nnwetɛbena ahanan a adwadifoɔ die no.
Na wɔde Efron afuo a ɛwɔ Makpela a ɛda Mamre ntentensoɔ no, afuo no ne ɔbodan a ɛwɔ mu no ne afuo no so nnua nyinaa, deɛ ɛwɔ n’ahyeɛ nyinaa soɔ, hyɛɛ Abraham nsa wɔ Het mma no anim, wɔn a wɔhyɛne ne kuro pono mu no nyinaa anim.
Na ɛno akyiri no, Abraham siee ne yere Sara wɔ Makpela afuo mu ɔbodan mu, wɔ Mamre ntentensoɔ, (a ɛne Hebron) a ɛwɔ Kanaan asase soɔ no.
Na Het mma de afuo no ne ɔbodan a ɛwɔ mu no hyɛɛ Abraham nsa sɛ amusiebea.
Wɔhwehwɛ yerɛ ma Isak Na Abraham abɔ akɔkoraa, na wadi nna pii, na AWURADE ahyira no ade nyinaa mu.
Na Abraham ka kyerɛɛ ne fie asomfoɔ mu panin a ɔhwɛ deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa soɔ sɛ: Fa wo nsa ka m’asene mu, na mɛma woaka AWURADE, ɔsoro Nyankopɔn ne asase Nyankopɔn, ntam sɛ worenware Kanaanfoɔ a mete wɔn mu yi mmammaa mu bi mma me ba.
Na kɔ me kuro ne m’abusua mu kɔware yerɛ ma me ba Isak.
Na ɔsomfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ebia ɔbaa no rempɛ sɛ ɔbɛdi m’akyiri aba asase yi soɔ; ɛnneɛ memfa wo ba no mensane menkɔ asase a wofiri so baeɛ no so anaa?
Na Abraham ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ yie, na woamfa me ba ansane ankɔ hɔ bio.
AWURADE, ɔsoro Nyankopɔn a ɔfaa me firii m’agya fie ne asase a wɔwoo me wɔ soɔ no so, na ɔne me kasaeɛ, na ɔkaa ntam kyerɛɛ me sɛ: W’asefoɔ na mede asase yi bɛma wɔn no, ɔbɛsoma ne bɔfoɔ adi w’anim, na woakɔware yerɛ afiri hɔ abrɛ me ba.
Na sɛ ɔbaa no mpɛ sɛ ɔdi w’akyiri a, ɛnneɛ wo ho afi me ntam yi mu, nanso mfa me ba nsane nkɔ hɔ bio.
Na ɔsomfoɔ no de ne nsa kaa ne wura Abraham asene mu, na ɔkaa no ntam wɔ asɛm no ho.
Na ɔsomfoɔ no faa ne wura yoma mu du, na ɔkɔe, na ɔkura ne wura nnepa ahodoɔ nyinaa bi.
Na ɔsɔre sii mu kɔɔ Mesopotamia, Nahor kuro mu.
Na ɔmaa ne yoma no butuu kuro no kurotia wɔ asubura bi ho anwummerɛ a mmaa bɛsa nsuo.
Na ɔbɔɔ mpaeɛ sɛ: AWURADE, me wura Abraham Nyankopɔn, mesrɛ wo, ma no nsi me yie nnɛ, na yɛ me wura Abraham adɔeɛ.
Hwɛ, meregyina asubura yi so ha; na kurom hɔfoɔ mmammaa bɛfiri abɛsa nsuo.
Na ma no mmra sɛ ababaa a mɛse no sɛ: Soɛ w’ahina ma mennom nsuo no bi, na ɔbɛka sɛ: Nom, na mɛma wo yoma no anom bie no, ma ɔno ara nyɛ deɛ woayi no ama w’akoa Isak, na ɛno mu na mɛhunu sɛ woayɛ me wura adɔeɛ.
Na ɔnnya nwiee kasa no, hwɛ, Rebeka baeɛ a n’ahina si ne batiri so.
Ɔyɛ Betuel a ɔyɛ Abraham ne nua Nahor yere Milka ba.
Na ababaa no ho yɛ fɛ sɛ, ɔyɛ ɔbaabunu ɛfiri sɛ na ɔbarima biara nhunuu no da.
Na ɔkɔɔ asubura no mu kɔhyɛɛ n’ahina ma, na ɔbae.
Na ɔsomfoɔ no tuu mmirika kɔhyiaa no sɛ: Mesrɛ wo, ma mennom w’ahina yi mu nsuo kakra.
Na ɔse: Me wura, nom bi!
Na ɔyɛɛ ntɛm soɛɛ n’ahina no sii ne nsam maa no nomee.
Na ɔmaa no nom wieeɛ no, ɔkaa sɛ: Mɛkɔ makɔsa bi mabrɛ wo yoma no nso akɔsi sɛ wɔbɛwie nom.
Na ɔyɛɛ ntɛm kɔhwiee n’ahina mu nsuo no guu anomeeɛ hɔ, na ɔtutuu mmirika kɔɔ abura no mu bio kɔsaa nsuo, na ɔsa maa ne yoma no nyinaa.
Na ɔbarima no hwɛɛ no ara, na ɔyɛɛ komm sɛ ɔbɛhunu sɛ AWURADE ama ne kwankorɔ no ayɛ dwoodwoo anaasɛ ɛnte saa.
Na yoma no wiee nsuo nom no, ɔbarima no yii sika hwenemkaa a ano si dwetɛbena fa ne nsa so nkapo mmienu a ano si sikabena du de hyɛɛ no.
Na ɔbisaa no sɛ: Hwan ba ne wo?
Mesrɛ wo, kyerɛ me!
Yɛbɛnya daberɛ wɔ w’agya fie anaa?
Na ɔbuaa no sɛ: M’agya ne Betuel a ɔyɛ Nahor ne Milka ba no.
Na ɔtoaa so sɛ: Yɛwɔ ɛserɛ ne mmoa aduane pii ne deɛ mobɛda.
Na ɔbarima no bɔɔ ne mu ase sɔree AWURADE.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Nhyira nka AWURADE, me wura Abraham Nyankopɔn a wamma n’adɔeɛ ne ne nokorɛ ammɔ me wura.
Na me nso, AWURADE akyerɛ me me wura nuanom fie kwan.
Na ababaa no tuu mmirika kɔkaa saa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ ne na fiefoɔ.
Na Rebeka wɔ nuabarima bi a ne din de Laban.
Na Laban de mmirika firii adi kɔɔ ɔbarima no nkyɛn wɔ asubura no ho.
Na ɔhunuu hwenemkaa ne ne nsa so nkapo no, na ɔtee ne nua Rebeka nsɛm no sɛ: Sɛdeɛ ɔbarima no kasa kyerɛɛ me nie no, ɔbaa ɔbarima no nkyɛn.
Na hwɛ, na ɔgyina yoma no nkyɛn, asubura no ho.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Wo a AWURADE ahyira woɔ, bra, adɛn nti na wogyina kurotia?
Na masiesie ɛdan mu, ne baabi nso mama yoma no.
Na ɔbarima no kɔɔ fie, na ɔyii yoma no so nnoɔma maa no ɛserɛ ne aduane, na ɔmaa ɔno ne nnipa a wɔka ne ho no nsuo sɛ wɔnhohoro wɔn nan ase.
Na wɔde aduane bɛsii n’anim sɛ ɔnni.
Nanso ɔkaa sɛ: Merennidi gye sɛ mabɔ m’amanneɛ ansa.
Na ɔse: Bɔ na yɛn ntie ɛ!
Na ɔse: Abraham somfoɔ ne me.
Na AWURADE ahyira me wura pii na wayɛ ɔkɛseɛ.
Na wama no nnwan ne anantwie, dwetɛ ne sika kɔkɔɔ, nkoa ne mfenaa, ne yoma ne mfunumu.
Na me wura yere Sara awo ba wɔ ne mmerewaberɛ mu ama me wura, na ɔde deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa ama no.
Na me wura ama maka ntam sɛ: Nware Kanaanfoɔ a mete wɔn asase soɔ yi mmammaa mu bi mma me ba.
Na mmom kɔ m’agya fie ne m’abusua mu kɔware yerɛ brɛ no.
Na mebisaa me wura sɛ: Na sɛ ɔbaa no anni m’akyi ɛ?
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: AWURADE a menam n’anim no bɛsoma ne bɔfoɔ aka wo ho, na wama wo kwan so ayɛ dwoodwoo, na woakɔware yerɛ wɔ m’abusua mu ne m’agya fie abrɛ me ba; Ɛno na sɛ wokɔ m’abusua mu, na wɔamma wo bi a, ɛnneɛ na wo ho afi me ntam no mu.
Na mebaa asubura no ho nnɛ kaa sɛ: AWURADE, me wura Abraham Nyankopɔn, sɛ wo ara worema me kwan a meretuo yi ayɛ dwoodwoo a, hwɛ, megyina asubura yi ho, na ma no mmra sɛ ababaa a ɔbɛfiri abɛsa nsuo no, na mɛse no sɛ: Mesrɛ wo, ma me w’ahina yi mu nsuo kakra mennom, na ɔbɛka akyerɛ me sɛ: Nom, na menkɔsa bi memmrɛ wo yoma no nso no, ma ɔno ara nyɛ ɔbaa a AWURADE ayi no ama me wura ba.
Na mennya menwiee m’akoma mu kasa no, hwɛ, Rebeka firii adi bae a ahina si ne mmatiri soɔ, na ɔkɔɔ abura no mu kɔsaa nsuo.
Na mesee no sɛ: Mesrɛ wo, ma me bi mennom.
Na ɔyɛɛ ntɛm soɛɛ n’ahina no kaa sɛ: Nom, na mɛma wo yoma no nso bi anom.
Na menomee, na ɔmaa yoma no nso bi nomee.
Na mebisaa no sɛ: Hwan ba ne wo?
Na ɔse: M’agya ne Betuel a ɔyɛ Nahor ne Milka ba no.
Na mede ɛhwenemkaa no mesɛnee ne hwenem, na mede nkapo no mehyehyɛɛ ne nsa, na mebɔɔ me mu ase mesɔree AWURADE, na mehyiraa AWURADE, me wura Abraham Nyankopɔn a ɔkyerɛɛ me nokorɛ kwan sɛ menkɔware me wura nua ba memma ne ba no.
Na afei sɛ mo ara moreyɛ me wura adɔeɛ adi no nokorɛ a, monka nkyerɛ me; na sɛ ɛnte saa a, monka nkyerɛ me, na mennane memfa nifa anaa benkum.
Ɛnna Laban ne Betuel buaa sɛ: AWURADE na asɛm yi firi no, yɛrentumi nka no papa anaa bɔne nkyerɛ wo.
Hwɛ, Rebeka na ɔgyina w’anim yi, fa no kɔ ma no nkɔyɛ wo wura ba yere, sɛdeɛ AWURADE aka no.
Na Abraham somfoɔ no tee wɔn nsɛm no, ɔkotoo fam sɔree AWURADE.
Na ɔsomfoɔ no yii dwetɛ nnwinneɛ ne sika kɔkɔɔ nnwinneɛ ne ntadeɛ de maa Rebeka; na ɔde nnoɔma a ɛsom boɔ maa ne nuabarima ne ne na.
Na ɔne nnipa a wɔka ne ho no didii na wɔnomeeɛ no, wɔdaa hɔ anadwo no.
Na wɔsɔree anɔpa no, ɔkaa sɛ: Monnya me kwan, na menkɔ me wura nkyɛn.
Na ne nua ne ne na kaa sɛ: Ma ababaa no ntena yɛn nkyɛn nna tiaa bi sɛ dadu ansa na woakɔ.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monnsi me kwan, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE ama m’akwantuo no asi me yie.
Monnya me kwan mma menkɔ me wura nkyɛn.
Na wɔse: Ma yɛmfrɛ ababaa no mmisa ɔno ara.
Na wɔfrɛɛ Rebeka ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wo ne ɔbarima yi bɛkɔ anaa?
Na ɔse: Mɛkɔ.
Na wɔgyaa wɔn nua Rebeka ne n’abaawa panin ne Abraham somfoɔ no ne ne nnipa no kwan.
Na wɔhyiraa Rebeka see no sɛ: Yɛn nuabaa, dane mpem du ahodoɔ mpem mpem, na w’asefoɔ mfa wɔn atamfoɔ apono nni.
Na Rebeka ne ne mmaawa sɔree, na wɔtenatenaa yoma so dii ɔbarima no akyi, na ɔsomfoɔ no de Rebeka sii mu kɔe.
Na Isak firi Lahai-roi abura ho bae, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔte Negeb asase no so.
Na Isak firii adi kɔɔ wiram anwummerɛ kɔdwennwenee ne nsɛm ho.
Na ɔmaa n’ani so hwɛe, na hwɛ, yoma reba.
Na Rebeka maa n’ani so, na ɔhunuu Isak no, ɔfirii yoma no so sii fam.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ɔsomfoɔ no sɛ: Ɔbarima bɛn na ɔnam wira mu rebɛhyia yɛn yi?
Na ɔsomfoɔ no se: Ɛyɛ me wura.
Na ɔfaa ne nkatanimu de kataa n’anim.
Na ɔsomfoɔ no kaa deɛ ɔyɛeɛ no nyinaa kyerɛɛ Isak.
Na Isak de no kɔɔ ne na Sara ntomadan mu, na ɔwaree Rebeka, na ɔyɛɛ no ɛyerɛ, na ɔdɔ no.
Na Isak werɛ kyekyeree, ne na wuo no akyi.
Abraham ne Ketura mma Na Abraham waree yerɛ bio a ne din de Ketura.
Na ɔwoo Simran, Yoksan, Medan, Midian, Isbak ne Sua maa no.
Na Yoksan woo Seba ne Dedan.
Na Dedan mma ne Asurfoɔ, Letusfoɔ ne Leumfoɔ.
Na Midian mma ne Hefa, Hefer, Hanok, Abida ne Eldaa.
Yeinom nyinaa ne Ketura mma.
Na Abraham de deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa maa Isak.
Na mmaa nkae mma a Abraham wɔ no deɛ, berɛ a Abraham te aseɛ no, ɔkyɛɛ wɔn adeɛ, na ɔgyaa wɔn kwan firii ne ba Isak ho maa wɔkɔɔ apueeɛ asase no so.
Abraham wuo ne ne sie Na Abraham nna a ɔdiiɛ yɛ mfeɛ ɔha aduɔson nnum.
Na Abraham gyaa ne honhom mu, na ɔwuu ɛdwono pa mu, wabɔ akɔkoraa, na ɔnyaa mfeɛ pii.
Na ɔtii n’agyanom wɔ asamando.
Na ne mma Isak ne Ismael siee no Makpela bodan mu, wɔ Hetini Efron, Sohar ba, afuo no mu wɔ Mamre ntentensoɔ, afuo a Abraham tɔɔ no Het mma nsam no.
Ɛhɔ na wɔsiee Abraham ne ne yere Sara.
Na Abraham wuo akyiri no, Onyankopɔn hyiraa ne ba Isak.
Na Isak tenaa Lahai-roi abura no ho.
Ismael awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ Na yei ne Abraham ba Ismael a Misraimni Hagar, Sara afenaa no, wo maa Abraham no awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ: Na yei ne Ismael mma din a wɔde frɛɛ wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ no: Ismael abakan Nebaiot.
Wɔn a wɔka ho ne Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam, Misma, Duma, Masa, Hadad, Tema, Yetur, Nafis ne Kedema.
Yeinom ne Ismael mma, na yeinom ne wɔn din, sɛdeɛ wɔn nkuraa ne wɔn nsraban teɛ, atitire dummienu ne wɔn aman.
(Na Ismael nkwa mu mfeɛ a ɔdiiɛ nie: Mfirinhyia ɔha aduasa nson.
Na ɔgyaa ne honhom mu, na ɔwui, na ɔtii n’agyanom wɔ asamando.)
Na wɔtena firi Hawila kɔsii Sur a ɛwɔ Misraim ntentensoɔ de rekɔ Asiria no.
Na ɔne ne nuanom antena no asomdwoeɛ mu.
Esau ne Yakob awoɔ Na yeinom ne Abraham ba Isak awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ: Abraham woo Isak.
Na Isak dii mfirinhyia aduanan no, ɔwaree Rebeka, Aramni Betuel ba a ɔfiri Mesopotamia no ne Aramni Laban nua.
Na Isak srɛɛ AWURADE maa ne yere, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔyɛ obonini.
Na AWURADE tiee n’adesrɛ no, na ne yere Rebeka nyinsɛnee.
Na nkɔkoaa no pempem wɔn ho wɔ ne yam.
Na ɔse: Sɛ ɛte saa a, na mete ase reyɛ deɛn?
Na ɔkɔbisaa AWURADE.
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Aman mmienu na ɛwɔ wo yam, na nkurɔfoɔ ahodoɔ mmienu na ɛbɛtete wɔn ho mu afiri wo yafunu mu.
Na ɔman no baako bɛdi baako so, na ɔpanin no bɛsom akumaa no.
Na ne nna duruu so sɛ ɔbɛwoɔ no, na hwɛ, nta wɔ ne yam.
Na deɛ ɔdi kan firi baeɛ no, na ne ho yɛ kɔɔ, ne ho nyinaa wɔ enwi kusuu.
Enti wɔtoo no din Esau.
Na ɛno akyiri no, ne nua no firi bae, na ne nsa kura Esau nantin, enti wɔtoo no din Yakob.
Na wɔwoo wɔn no, na Isak adi mfeɛ aduosia.
Esau tɔn ne panin Na mmɔfra no nyinii.
Na Esau nim ahayɔ yie, na ɔyɛ ɔhamuni, na Yakob deɛ na ɔyɛ onipa a ɔmpɛ kasa a daa ɔte ntomadan mu.
Na Isak dɔ Esau, ɛfiri sɛ na ne hanam yɛ no dɛ; na Rebeka deɛ, ɔdɔ Yakob.
Yakob noaa aduane bi, na Esau firi wiram baeɛ no, na wabrɛ.
Na Esau ka kyerɛɛ Yakob sɛ: Ma me adeɛ kɔkɔɔ yi bi menni ɛ, na mabrɛ.
(Enti wɔde too no din Edom) Na Yakob kaa sɛ: Tɔn wo panin ma me nnɛ.
Na Esau kaa sɛ: Hwɛ, wuo na merebɛwuo yi, na ɔpanin yi bɛyɛ me deɛn?
Na Yakob kaa sɛ: Ka ntam kyerɛ me nnɛ.
Na ɔkaa ntam kyerɛɛ no tɔn ne panin maa Yakob.
Ɛnna Yakob maa Esau paanoo ne asedua a wanoa; na ɔdii, na ɔdidi nomee, na ɔsɔre kɔe.
Na sɛdeɛ Esau ammu ne panin ne no.
Isak kɔ Gerar Na ɛkɔm baa asase no so, ɛsono ɛkɔm a ɛbaa Abraham berɛ soɔ no.
Na Isak kɔɔ Filistifoɔ hene Abimelek nkyɛn wɔ Gerar.
Na AWURADE yii ne ho kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Nsiane nkɔ Misraim, tena asase a mɛkyerɛ woɔ yi so.
Tena asase yi so sɛ ɔhɔhoɔ, na mɛdi w’akyi na mahyira wo, ɛfiri sɛ wo ne w’asefoɔ na mede nsase yi nyinaa bɛma mo, na mɛma ntam a mekaa w’agya Abraham no agyina.
Na mɛma w’asefoɔ adɔre sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma, na mede nsase yi nyinaa bɛma w’asefoɔ, na w’asefoɔ mu na wɔbɛhyira asase so amanaman nyinaa, ɛfiri sɛ Abraham tiee me nne, na ɔdii me nsiesieeɛ, me mmara nsɛm, m’ahyɛdeɛ ne me mmara so.
Na Isak tenaa Gerar.
Na ɛhɔfoɔ no bisaa no ne yere ho asɛm no, ɔkaa sɛ: Me nua ne no.
Na ɔsuro sɛ ɔbɛka sɛ: Me yere ne no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔse: Anyɛ saa a, Rebeka nti ɛhafoɔ bɛku me; ɛfiri sɛ ne ho yɛ fɛ.
Na ɔkyɛree hɔ no, Filistifoɔ hene Abimelek hwɛɛ mpomma mu hunui, na hwɛ, Isak ne ne yere Rebeka rewewe.
Na Abimelek frɛɛ Isak sɛ: Hwɛ, ampa ara ɔyɛ wo yere, na ɛyɛɛ dɛn na wose: Ɔyɛ me nua yi?
Na Isak ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛfiri sɛ medwenee sɛ: Anyɛ saa a, ne nti mɛwu.
Na Abimelek kaa sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na woayɛ yɛn yi?
Ɛkaa kumaa bi na anka ɔman yi muni bi ne wo yere dae, na anka wode mmusuo aba yɛn so.
Na Abimelek hyɛɛ ne nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa sɛ: Deɛ ɔbɛka ɔbarima yi anaa ne yere no, wuo na ɔbɛwuo.
Na Isak duaa mfudeɛ wɔ asase no so, na ɔnyaa nnɔbaeɛ mmɔho ɔha; afirinhyia no ara mu ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE hyiraa no.
Na Isak nyaa ne ho, na ɔkɔɔ so ara nyaa ne ho kɔsii sɛ ɔyɛɛ kɛseɛ pa ara.
Na ɔnyaa nnwankuo ne anantwikuo ne nkoa pii.
Na Filistifoɔ no ani beree no.
(Na nsubura a n’agya Abraham nkoa tutuu no n’agya berɛ soɔ no, Filistifoɔ sisii ne nyinaa de dɔteɛ hyehyɛɛ no mama.)
Na Abimelek ka kyerɛɛ Isak sɛ: Firi yɛn nkyɛn kɔ, na wowɔ tumi dodo sene yɛn.
Na Isak sii mu firi hɔ kɔsisii ne ntomadan wɔ Gerar bonhwa mu, na ɔtenaa hɔ.
Na Isak sane tetee nsubura a n’agya Abraham berɛ so wɔtutuiɛ a Abraham wuo akyi Filistifoɔ sisii no no mu.
Na ɔtotoo no din sɛdeɛ n’agya totoeɛ no ara.
Na Isak nkoa funuu bonhwa no mu, na wɔhunuu nsupa abura wɔ hɔ.
Na Gerar mmoahwɛfoɔ ne Isak mmoahwɛfoɔ dii so aperepereɛ kaa sɛ: Nsuo no yɛ yɛn dea!
Enti Isak too abura no din Esek, ɛfiri sɛ wɔne no hamee.
Na wɔtuu asubura foforɔ, na ɛno ho nso wɔpereperee, enti ɔfrɛɛ no Sitna.
Na wɔfirii hɔ kɔtuu abura foforɔ, na ɛno deɛ, wɔampere, enti ɔtoo no din Rehobot, na ɔkaa sɛ: Afei deɛ AWURADE ama yɛn mu atrɛ, na yɛadɔre wɔ asase yi so.
Na ɔfirii hɔ kɔɔ Beer-seba.
Na AWURADE yii ne ho kyerɛɛ no anadwo no ara kaa sɛ: Mene w’agya Abraham Nyankopɔn, nsuro, na medi w’akyi.
Mɛhyira wo, na m’akoa Abraham nti mɛma w’asefoɔ adɔre.
Na ɔsii afɔrebukyia wɔ hɔ, na ɔsɔree AWURADE, na ɔsii ne ntomadan wɔ hɔ.
Na Isak nkoa tuu asubura wɔ hɔ.
Abraham ne Abimelek yɛ apam Na Abimelek ne n’adamfo Ahusat ne ne safohene Pikol firi Gerar baa ne nkyɛn.
Na Isak ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ɛdeɛn nti na moaba me nkyɛn yi?
Sɛ motane me, na moapamo me afiri mo nkyɛn.
Na wɔse: Yɛahunu pefee sɛ AWURADE di w’akyi.
Na yɛse: Ma ntam nna yɛne wo ntam.
Na ma yɛne wo mpam, sɛ worenyɛ yɛn bɔne biara; sɛdeɛ yɛanka woɔ, na yɛayɛ wo papa nko ara, na yɛagya wo kwan asomdwoeɛ mu no.
Afei wone deɛ AWURADE ahyira no.
Na ɔtoo wɔn pono, na wɔdidi nomee.
Na wɔsɔree anɔpatutu kekaa ntam kyerɛkyerɛɛ wɔn ho, na Isak gyaa wɔn kwan, na wɔde asomdwoeɛ firi ne nkyɛn kɔe.
Na da no ara Isak nkoa ba bɛkaa no abura a wɔtuiɛ no ho asɛm sɛ: Yɛato nsuo.
Na ɔfrɛɛ no Siba.
Enti kuro no din de Beer-seba de bɛsi nnɛ yi ara.
Esau ananafoɔ yerenom Na Esau dii mfirinhyia aduanan no, ɔwaree Hetini Beeri babaa Yudit ne Hetini Elon babaa Basmat.
Na wɔhyɛɛ Isak ne Rebeka awerɛhoɔ.
Yakob gye Isak nhyira Na Isak bɔɔ akɔkoraa na n’ani so yɛɛ no kusukusu na ɔnhunu adeɛ yie no, ɔmaa wɔfrɛɛ ne ba panin Esau ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Me ba!
Na ɔgyee so sɛ: Agya, menie.
Na ɔse: Mabɔ akora, na mennim me wuda.
Afei fa w’ahayɔdeɛ, w’agyan kotokuo ne w’agyan kɔ wiram kɔpɛ hanam brɛ me, na noa akɔnnɔduane sɛdeɛ mepɛ brɛ me, na menni, na me nhyira wo ansa na mawu.
Ɛberɛ a Isak rekasa akyerɛ ne ba Esau no, Rebeka tee.
Na Esau kɔɔ wiram sɛ ɔrekɔkum nam aba.
Na Rebeka ka kyerɛɛ ne ba Yakob sɛ: Hwɛ, metee sɛ w’agya rekasa kyerɛ wo nua Esau sɛ: Kɔpɛ hanam brɛ me, na noa m’akɔnnɔduane, na menni, na menhyira wo AWURADE anim ansa na mawu.
Na afei, me ba, tie me nne, sɛdeɛ merehyɛ woɔ yi: Kɔ mmoakuo no mu kɔkyere mmirekyie mma pa mmienu brɛ me, na memfa menyɛ akɔnnɔduane memma w’agya sɛdeɛ ɔpɛ; na fa kɔma w’agya, na ɔnni, na ɔnhyira wo ansa na wawu.
Na Yakob ka kyerɛɛ ne na Rebeka sɛ: Hwɛ, me nua Esau ho wɔ nwi, na me deɛ, me ho yɛ toromtorom.
Ebia m’agya bɛka me ho ahwɛ, na mayɛ n’ani so sɛ ɔdaadaafoɔ, na mede nnome maba me so, na ɛnyɛ nhyira.
Ɛnna ne na ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wo nnome mmra me so, me ba, tie me nne ara, na kɔkyere wɔn brɛ me.
Na ɔkɔkyeree wɔn brɛɛ ne na, na ne na de yɛɛ akɔnnɔduane sɛdeɛ n’agya pɛ.
Na Rebeka faa ne ba panin Esau ntadeɛ fɛfɛ a ɛwɔ ne nkyɛn wɔ ɛdan mu de hyɛɛ ne ba kumaa Yakob.
Na ɔde mmirekyie mma no nwoma duraduraa ne nsa ne ne kɔn a ɛho yɛ toromtorom no ho.
Na ɔde akɔnnɔduane ne paanoo a wasiesie no hyɛɛ ne ba Yakob nsa.
Na ɔde kɔɔ n’agya nkyɛn, na ɔse: M’agya!
Na ɔgyee so sɛ: Menie, ɛyɛ wo hwan a, me ba?
Na Yakob ka kyerɛɛ n’agya sɛ: Ɛyɛ me, w’abakan Esau.
Mayɛ sɛdeɛ wokyerɛɛ me no.
Mesrɛ wo, sɔre, tena ase, na di me hanam, na wo kra nhyira me.
Na Isak bisaa ne ba no sɛ: Ɛyɛɛ dɛn na wonyaa no ntɛm sɛɛ yi, me ba?
Na ɔse: Ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn na ɔmaa me hyiaa yie.
Na Isak ka kyerɛɛ Yakob sɛ: Twe pini me, na menka wo menhwɛ, me ba, sɛ ampa ara sɛ me ba Esau ne wo anaasɛ ɛnyɛ ɔno a. Na Yakob twe pinii n’agya Isak, na ɔde ne nsa kaa ne ho hwɛe, na ɔkaa sɛ: Ɛnne no yɛ Yakob nne, na nsa no deɛ, ɛyɛ Esau nsa.
Na wanhu no, ɛfiri sɛ na ne nsa ho wɔ nwi te sɛ ne nua Esau deɛ.
Enti ɔhyiraa no.
Na ɔbisaa no sɛ: Ampa ara sɛ wone me ba Esau anaa?
Na ɔse: Mene no.
Na ɔse: Fa pini me nkyɛn, na menni me ba hanam, na me kra nhyira wo.
Na ɔde brɛɛ no, na ɔdii, na ɔde bobesa brɛɛ no, na ɔnomee.
Na n’agya Isak ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Twe pini bɛfe m’ano ɛ, me ba.
Na ɔtwe pinii kɔfee n’ano.
Na Isak huaa n’atadeɛ mu hwa hwɛe, na ɔhyiraa no sɛ: Hwɛ, me ba ho hwa te sɛ afuo a AWURADE ahyira soɔ mu hwa.
Onyankopɔn mma wo ɔsoro bosuo ne asase mu sradeɛ bi, ne aburoo ne nsa pii.
Aman nsom wo, na nkurɔfoɔ nkoto wo.
Yɛ wo nuanom so wura, na wo na mma nkoto wo.
Wɔadome wɔn a wɔdome woɔ, na wɔahyira wɔn a wɔhyira woɔ.
Esau srɛ Isak hɔ nhyira Na Isak wiee Yakob hyira na Yakob firii n’agya nkyɛn firii adi ara pɛ na ne nua Esau firi n’ahayɔ baeɛ.
Na ɔno nso bɛnoaa akɔnnɔduane de brɛɛ n’agya ka kyerɛɛ n’agya sɛ: M’agya sɔre ɛ, na di wo ba hanam, na wo kra nhyira me!
Na n’agya Isak see no sɛ: Ɛyɛ wo hwan a?
Na ɔse: Ɛyɛ me, wo ba, w’abakan Esau.
Na Isak de ahopopoɔ kɛseɛ pa ara kaa sɛ: Hwan mpo ne deɛ ɔkɔyɛɛ ha de brɛɛ me, na medii ne nyinaa na mehyiraa no ansa na woreba yi?
Nso ɔbɛyɛ deɛ wɔahyira no.
Esau tee n’agya nsɛm no, ɔde su kɛseɛ ne awerɛhoɔ pii teaa mu denden ka kyerɛɛ n’agya sɛ: M’agya, hyira me nso bi.
Na ɔse: Wo nua de nnaadaa aba abɛgye wo nhyira.
Na ɔse: Ne din nne Yakob anaa?
Mprenu ni na watwintwane m’anan mu.
Wafa me panin, na hwɛ, afei nso wagye me nhyira.
Na ɔse: Woamfa nhyira bi ansie me?
Na Isak bua see Esau sɛ: Hwɛ, mede no mayɛ wo so wura, na mede ne nuanom nyinaa mayɛ ne nkoa.
Na mede aburoo ne nsa mawowa no.
Na afei wo deɛ, ɛdeɛn na menyɛ woɔ, me ba?
Na Esau ka kyerɛɛ n’agya sɛ: M’agya, nhyira baako pɛ na wowɔ?
Hyira me nso, m’agya.
Na Esau maa ne nne so sui.
Na n’agya Isak bua see no sɛ: Hwɛ, asase a sradeɛ nni mu ne deɛ ɔsoro bosuo ngu soɔ so na wobɛtena.
Wo nkrantɛ so na wonam bɛtena aseɛ, na wobɛsom wo nua.
Nanso ɛbɛba sɛ wobɔ mmɔden kentene wo ho a, wobɛyi ne kɔnnua afiri wo kɔn so.
Esau repɛ Yakob aku no Na Esau tanee Yakob wɔ nhyira a n’agya de hyiraa no no nti.
Na Esau kaa no n’akoma mu sɛ: Nna a wɔde bɛsu m’agya no reyɛ abɛn, na merebɛkum me nua Yakob.
Na wɔkɔkaa ne ba panin Esau nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ Rebeka.
Na ɔsoma maa wɔkɔfrɛɛ ne ba kumaa Yakob, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, wo nua Esau rekyekyere ne werɛ sɛ ɔrebɛku wo.
Afei, me ba, tie me nne, na sɔre dwane kɔ me nua Laban nkyɛn wɔ Haran, na tena ne nkyɛn nna tiaa kɔsi sɛ wo nua anibereɛ no bɛfiri ne mu, kɔsi sɛ wo nua abufuo bɛdane afiri wo soɔ, na ne werɛ afiri deɛ woyɛɛ no no, ansa na masoma ama wɔabɛfa wo wɔ hɔ aba.
Na adɛn nti koraa na ɛsɛ sɛ mehwere mo baanu da koro?
Isak ma Yakob kɔ Laban nkyɛn Na Rebeka ka kyerɛɛ Isak sɛ: Het mmammaa nti m’asetena afono me.
Sɛ Yakob kɔware yerɛ Het mmammaa mu, sɛ yeinom a wɔwɔ ɛha yi a, na me mmerɛ ngui, na mete ase reyɛ deɛn bio?
Isak hyira Yakob, na ɔgya no kwan kɔ Mesopotamia Na Isak frɛɛ Yakob, na ɔhyiraa no hyɛɛ no sɛ: Nware ɛyerɛ wɔ Kanaan mmammaa mu.
Sɔre kɔ Mesopotamia kɔ wo na n’agya Betuel fie, na kɔware wɔ wo na nua Laban mmammaa mu bi.
Na Onyankopɔn Tweaduampɔn nhyira wo, na ɔmma wo nnɔ, na ɔmma wo nyɛ bebree, na woayɛ aman asafo; na ɔmfa Abraham nhyira nhyira wo, wo ne w’asefoɔ a wɔka wo ho, na woanya asase a woyɛ so hɔhoɔ a Onyankopɔn de ama Abraham yi.
Na Isak gyaa Yakob kwan, na ɔkɔɔ Mesopotamia wɔ Aramni Betuel ba Laban a ɔyɛ Yakob ne Esau wɔn na Rebeka nuabarima no nkyɛn.
Esau ware ɔbaa foforɔ Na Esau hunuu sɛ Isak ahyira Yakob, ama wagya no kwan sɛ ɔnkɔ Mesopotamia nkɔware yerɛ wɔ hɔ.
Afei ɔhunuu bio sɛ ɔhyiraa no hyɛɛ no sɛ: Nware Kanaan mmammaa mu yerɛ, na Yakob tiee n’agya ne ne na, na ɔkɔɔ Mesopotamia.
Na Esau hunuu sɛ Kanaan mmammaa nyɛ wɔ n’agya Isak ani soɔ no, ɔsii mu kɔɔ Ismael nkyɛn kɔwaree Abraham ba Ismael babaa, Nebaiot nuabaa Mahalat kaa ne yerenom no ho.
Yakob daeɛso wɔ Betel Na Yakob firi Beer-seba sii mu kɔɔ Haran.
Na ɔduruu baabi no ɔsoɛɛ hɔ anadwo no, ɛfiri sɛ na owia akɔtɔ.
Na ɔfaa hɔ aboɔ no mu baako de yɛɛ sumiiɛ, na ɔdaa hɔ.
Na ɔsoo daeɛ, na hwɛ, na atwedeɛ bi si fam a atifi pem soro, na hwɛ, Nyankopɔn abɔfoɔ redi so aforosiane.
Na hwɛ, AWURADE gyina atifi, na ɔse: Mene AWURADE, w’agya Abraham Nyankopɔn ne Isak Nyankopɔn; asase a woda soɔ yi mede bɛma wo ne w’asefoɔ.
Na w’asefoɔ bɛyɛ sɛ asase so mfuturo, na woatrɛ akɔ atɔeɛ ne apueeɛ, atifi fam ne anafoɔ fam.
Na wo ne w’asefoɔ mu na wɔbɛhyira wiase mmusuakuo nyinaa.
Na hwɛ, mɛdi w’akyi, na mahwɛ wo so baabiara a wobɛkorɔ, na mama woasane aba asase yi so.
Na merennya wo de bɛkɔ akɔsi sɛ mɛma deɛ maka makyerɛ woɔ yi aba mu.
Na Yakob nyane firii ne nna mu no, ɔkaa sɛ: Ampa ara, AWURADE wɔ ha yi, nanso me deɛ, manhunu.
Na ɔsuroe, na ɔse: Ɛha yi yɛ hu ampa.
Ɛha nyɛ baabiara sɛ Nyankopɔn fie, na ɛha ne ɔsoro aboboano.
Na Yakob sɔree anɔpatutu, na ɔfaa ɔboɔ a ɔde yɛɛ sumiiɛ no de yɛɛ odum sii hɔ, na ɔhwiee ngo guu so.
Na ɔfrɛɛ hɔ: Betel, nanso akane no na kuro no din de Lus.
Na Yakob hyɛɛ bɔ kaa sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn bɛdi m’akyi ahwɛ me so ɔkwan a merebɛtuo yi mu, na wama me aduane madi ne atadeɛ mahyɛ, na wasane me asomdwoeɛ mu de me aba m’agya fie a, ɛnneɛ AWURADE bɛyɛ me Nyankopɔn.
Na ɔboɔ yi a mede mayɛ odum asi hɔ yi bɛyɛ Nyankopɔn fie.
Na deɛ wobɛma me nyinaa, mɛma wo so ntotosoɔ du du.
Yakob kɔduru Laban fie Na Yakob sii mu kɔɔ nnipa a wɔte apueeɛ fam asase so.
Na ɔhunui asubura bi wɔ wiram, na hwɛ, nnwankuo mmiɛnsa boaboa ho wɔ hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ abura no mu nsuo na wɔsa ma nnwankuo no nom, na ɔboɔ kokuroo da abura no ano.
Ɛhɔ na wɔboa nnwankuo nyinaa ano, na wɔmuni ɔboɔ no firi abura no ano, na wɔma nnwan no nom, na wɔmuni ɔboɔ no to abura no so bio wɔ ne daberɛ hɔ.
Na Yakob bisaa wɔn sɛ: Me nuanom, mofiri he?
Na wɔse: Yɛfiri Haran.
Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Monim Nahor ba Laban anaa?
Na wɔse: Yɛni no.
Na ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: Ne ho yɛ?
Na wɔbuaa sɛ: Ne ho yɛ, na hwɛ, ne babaa Rahel ne nnwan na ɛreba yi.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Hwɛ, adeɛ nnya nsae koraa, na ɛberɛ a wɔboaboa mmoakuo ano nnya nnurui.
Momma nnwan no nsuo nnom, na monkɔ mma wɔnkɔdidi.
Na wɔse: Yɛntumi, gye sɛ wɔaboaboa nnwankuo no nyinaa ano, na wɔamuni ɔboɔ no afiri abura no ano, ansa na yɛama nnwan no anom.
Na Yakob ne wɔn da so rekasa no, Rahel ne n’agya nnwan no bae, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔyɛ odwanhwɛfoɔ.
Na Yakob hunuu ne na nua Laban ba Rahel ne ne na nua Laban nnwan no no, ɔtwe pinii kɔmunii ɔboɔ no firii asubura no ano, na ɔmaa ne na nua nnwan no nsuo nomee.
Na Yakob fee Rahel ano, na ɔmaa ne nne so sui.
Na Yakob ka kyerɛɛ Rahel sɛ ɔyɛ n’agya busuani, na ɔyɛ Rebeka ba.
Na Rahel tutuu mmirika kɔka kyerɛɛ n’agya.
Na Laban tee ne nua ba Yakob nka no, ɔtuu mmirika kɔhyiaa no, na ɔyɛɛ no atuu fee n’ano, na ɔde no baa ne fie.
Na ɔbɔɔ n’amanneɛ kyerɛɛ Laban.
Na Laban ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ampa, woyɛ me dompe ne me honam.
Na ɔtenaa ne nkyɛn bɛyɛ bosome.
Yakob som Laban de ware Lea ne Rahel Na Laban bisaa Yakob sɛ: Ɛnam sɛ woyɛ me busuani nti, wobɛsom me kwa anaa?
Kyerɛ me deɛ ɛnyɛ w’akatua.
Nso Laban wɔ mmammaa baanu, ɔpanin no din de Lea, na akumaa no din de Rahel.
Na Lea animma yɛ nketewa, na Rahel ho yɛ fɛ, na n’anim yɛ nyam.
Na Yakob dɔ Rahel, na ɔkaa sɛ: Wo ba kumaa Rahel nti mɛsom wo mfeɛ nson.
Na Laban se: Ɛyɛ sɛ mede no mema woɔ sene sɛ mede no bɛma onipa foforɔ bie; tena me nkyɛn.
Na Rahel nti Yakob som mfeɛ nson, na dɔ a ɔdɔ no nti ɛyɛɛ n’ani so sɛ nna mfuamfua bi.
Na Yakob ka kyerɛɛ Laban sɛ: Fa me yere ma me, na me nna no adu, na mene no nna.
Na Laban boaboaa kurom hɔfoɔ nyinaa ano, na ɔtoo pono.
Na anadwofa no ɔde ne ba Lea brɛɛ no, na ɔne no dae.
(Na Laban de n’abaawa Silpa maa ne ba Lea yɛɛ n’abaawa.)
Na adeɛ kyeeɛ no, Yakob hunuu sɛ ɛyɛ Lea mmom.
Na ɔbisaa Laban sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na woayɛ me yi?
Ɛnyɛ Rahel nti na mesom woɔ?
Na adɛn nti na woadaadaa me yi?
Ɛnna Laban se: Yɛn ha deɛ, wɔnyɛ no saa, wɔmma akumaa nware ansa na wɔde abakan ama.
Di ne nkyɛn nnawɔtwe yi, na yɛde oyi nso bɛma wo, som a wobɛsom me mfeɛ nson bio ho.
Na Yakob yɛɛ saa, na ɔdii ne nkyɛn nnawɔtwe no.
Na ɔde ne ba Rahel maa no awareɛ.
(Na Laban de n’abaawa Bilha maa ne ba Rahel yɛɛ n’abaawa.)
Na Yakob ne Rahel nso dae, na ɔdɔ Rahel sene Lea, na ɔsomm no mfeɛ nson bio.
Yakob mma Na AWURADE hunuu sɛ wɔtane Lea no, ɔbuee ne yafunu mu, na Rahel deɛ, ɔyɛɛ obonini.
Na Lea nyinsɛnee, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima, na ɔtoo no din Ruben, na ɔse: AWURADE ahwɛ m’amaneɛ, na afei deɛ, me kunu bɛdɔ me.
Na ɔnyinsɛnee bio, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima, na ɔkaa sɛ: AWURADE ate sɛ wɔtane me nti na ɔde oyi nso ama me.
Na ɔtoo no din Simeon.
Na ɔnyinsɛnee bio, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima, na ɔse: Afei ansa na me kunu de ne ho bɛfam me ho, ɛfiri sɛ me ne no awo mmammarima baasa.
Enti ɔtoo no din Lewi.
Na ɔnyinsɛnee bio, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima, na ɔse: Yei deɛ mɛyi AWURADE ayɛ.
Enti ɔtoo no din Yuda.
Na n’awoɔ mu twee.
Na Rahel hunuu sɛ ɔnwo mma Yakob no, ɔtwee ne nuabaa no ho kora, na ɔka kyerɛɛ Yakob sɛ: Ma me mma, na anyɛ saa a, mɛwu.
Na Yakob bo fuu Rahel kaa sɛ: Mesi Nyankopɔn a ɔkame wo wo yam mma no ananmu anaa?
Na Rahel kaa sɛ: Hwɛ, m’afenaa Bilha nie, wo ne no nna, na ɔnwo ngu me srɛ so, na me nso mennya ne ho mma.
Na ɔde n’abaawa Bilha maa no awareɛ, na Yakob ne no dae.
Na Bilha nyinsɛnee, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima maa Yakob.
Na Rahel kaa sɛ: Onyankopɔn adi m’asɛm, na watie me nne nso ama me ɔba.
Enti ɔtoo no din Dan.
Na Rahel abaawa Bilha nyinsɛnee bio, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima a ɔtɔ so mmienu maa Yakob.
Na Rahel kaa sɛ: Ako akɛseɛ na me ne me nuabaa adie, nso matumi no.
Na ɔtoo no din Naftali.
Na Lea hunuu sɛ n’awoɔ mu atwe no, ɔde n’abaawa Silpa maa Yakob awareɛ.
Na Lea abaawa Silpa woo ɔbabarima maa Yakob.
Na Lea kaa sɛ: Aba yie.
Na ɔtoo no din Gad.
Na Lea abaawa Silpa woo ɔbabarima a ɔtɔ so mmienu maa Yakob.
Na Lea kaa sɛ: M’ahotɔ nie!
Na mmaa bɛfrɛ me deɛ wɔahyira no.
Na ɔtoo no din Aser.
Na ayuo twaberɛ mu no, Ruben firii adi kɔhunuu dudaim wɔ wiram, na ɔde brɛɛ ne na Lea.
Na Rahel ka kyerɛɛ Lea sɛ: Ma me wo ba dudaim yi bi ɛ!
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛnnɔɔso sɛ woafa me kunu?
Na worebɛgye me ba dudaim nso anaa?
Na Rahel se: Wo ba dudaim no nti ma ɔne wo nkɔda anadwo yi.
Na anwummerɛ a Yakob firi wiram reba no, Lea firii adi kɔhyiaa no kaa sɛ: Bra me nkyɛn, ɛfiri sɛ ampa ara mede me ba dudaim matɔ wo.
Na ɔne no daa anadwo no.
Na Onyankopɔn tiee Lea, na ɔnyinsɛnee, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima a ɔtɔ so nnum maa Yakob.
Na Lea kaa sɛ: Onyankopɔn atua me ka, sɛ mede m’abaawa mama me kunu awareɛ.
Na ɔtoo no din Isakar.
Na Lea nyinsɛnee bio, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima a ɔtɔ so nsia maa Yakob.
Na Lea kaa sɛ: Onyankopɔn akyɛ me akyɛdeɛ pa, afei deɛ, me kunu ne me bɛtena yie, ɛfiri sɛ mawo mmammarima baasia mama no.
Na ɔtoo no din Sebulon.
Na ɛno akyiri no, ɔwoo ɔbabaa, na ɔtoo no din Dina.
Na Onyankopɔn kaee Rahel, na Onyankopɔn tiee no, na ɔbuee ne yam.
Na ɔnyinsɛnee, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima, na ɔse: Onyankopɔn ayi m’ahohora.
Na ɔtoo no din Yosef sɛ: AWURADE mma me ɔba foforɔ nka ne ho.
Laban ne Yakob nnaadaa Na Rahel woo Yosef no, Yakob ka kyerɛɛ Laban sɛ: Gya me kwan na menkɔ me kurom ne m’asase so.
Fa me yerenom ne me mma a wɔn nti mesomm woɔ no ma me.
Wo ara wonim me som a masom woɔ.
Na Laban ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ma mennya w’anim animuonyam, na mahunu sɛ wo nti AWURADE ahyira me.
Kyerɛ me w’akatua a woregye me, na mɛma.
Na Yakob see no sɛ: Wo ara wonim sɛdeɛ masom wo afa ne sɛdeɛ wo mmoakuo ayɛ wɔ m’aseɛ.
Mebaa wo nkyɛn no, na deɛ wowɔ no sua, na afei aseɛ atrɛ ayɛ pii, na AWURADE ahyira wo baabiara a mefa.
Na afei da bɛn na menhwɛ me fie nso?
Na ɔbisaa sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na memma woɔ?
Na Yakob se: Mma me biribiara; sɛ wobɛyɛ saa adeɛ yi ama me deɛ a, mɛsane mabɛyɛne wo nnwan na mahwɛ wɔn.
Ɛnnɛ mɛkɔ makɔfa wo nnwan nyinaa mu, na mayiyi emu nnwan a wɔn ho yɛ ntokontrama ne nworonnworan nyinaa ne nnwammire nyinaa wɔ nnwanten no mu ne mmirekyie no mu nworonnworan ne ntokontrama.
Wɔn a wɔtete sɛɛ na ɛnyɛ m’akatua.
Na daakye bi a wobɛka m’akatua ho asɛm no, me tenenee abua ama me wɔ w’anim.
Mmirekyie no mu biara a ne ho nyɛ ntokontrama ne nworonnworan, ne nnwanten no mu deɛ ɔnyɛ odwammire no, ma wɔmmu no awifodeɛ wɔ me nsam.
Na Laban se: Hwɛ, ma no nyɛ sɛdeɛ woaka yi ɛ!
Na da no ara ɔyiyii mpapo a wɔn ho yɛ nsensannsensan ne nworonnworan, ne mmirekyibereɛ a wɔn ho yɛ ntokontrama ne nworonnworan nyinaa, obiara a fufuo wɔ ne ho, ne nnwanten no mu nnwammire nyinaa.
Na ɔde wɔn hyɛɛ ne mmammarima nsa.
Na ɔde nnansa kwan too ɔne Yakob ntam, na Yakob yɛnee Laban nnwan a ɛkaeɛ no.
Na Yakob faa sɛsɛ dua, ɛdwono dua ne kyɛnkyɛn dua mman mono, na ɔyiyii ho nsema fitafitaa maa mmaa no ho fitaa no fifirii adi.
Na ɔde mmaa a ɔyiyii ho no guu anomeeɛ adaaseɛ a nnwan no rebɛnom mu nsuo no mu wɔ nnwan no anim, na wɔba nsunom a, wɔanyenyem so.
Na nnwan no nyenyem mmaa no so, na wɔwowoo nsensannsensan, ntokontrama ne nworonnworan.
Na Yakob yiyii nnwammaa no, na ɔde nnwan no ani kyerɛɛ Laban nnwan no mu nsensannsensan ne nnwammire nyinaa.
Na ɔyɛɛ ɔno ara nnwankuo nko wɔ fa baabi, na wamfa wɔn amfra Laban nnwan no mu.
Na sɛ daa nnwan a wɔn ho yɛ den no nyenyem a, na Yakob de mmaa no akɔgu adaaseɛ no mu wɔ nnwan no anim, na wɔanyenyem mmaa no so.
Na nnwan no yɛ nofonofo deɛ a, ɔmfa ngu mu.
Na wɔn a wɔyɛ mmerɛ no yɛɛ Laban dea, na wɔn a wɔn ho yɛ den no yɛɛ Yakob dea.
Na ɔbarima no yɛɛ kɛseɛ pa ara, na ɔnyaa nnwan pii ne mfenaa ne nkoa ne yoma ne mfunumu.
Yakob dwane firi Laban nkyɛn Na ɔtee Laban mmammarima nsɛm a wɔkaeɛ no sɛ: Yakob afa deɛ ɛyɛ yɛn agya deɛ nyinaa; na ɛno na ɔde anya saa agyapadeɛ yi nyinaa.
Na Yakob hunuu Laban anim, na hwɛ, ɛnte no sɛdeɛ na ɛteɛ kane no.
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yakob sɛ: Sane kɔ wo nananom asase so ne w’abusua mu, na mɛdi w’akyi.
Na Yakob soma maa wɔkɔfrɛɛ Rahel ne Lea baa wiram wɔ ne nnwan no nkyɛn, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Mehunu mo agya anim sɛ ɛnte me sɛdeɛ na ɛteɛ kane no; nanso m’agya Nyankopɔn adi m’akyi.
Na mo ara monim sɛ m’ahoɔden nyinaa na mede masom mo agya, na mo agya asisi me, adane m’akatua ani mprɛdu; nanso Onyankopɔn amma no kwan amma no anyɛ me bɔne biara.
Sɛ ɔka sɛ: Wɔn a wɔn ho yɛ ntokontrama no nyɛ w’akatua a, na nnwan no nyinaa awowo ntokontrama.
Na sɛ ɔka sɛ: Wɔn a wɔn ho yɛ nsensannsensan no nyɛ w’akatua a, na nnwan no nyinaa awowo nsensannsensan.
Na Onyankopɔn agye mo agya mmoakuo ama me.
Na berɛ a mmoa no refoforo wɔn ho na wɔanyinsɛn no, memaa m’ani so na mehunui wɔ daeɛ mu, na hwɛ, mpapo a na wɔforo mmirekyie no, wɔn ho yɛ nsensannsensan ne ntokontrama ne nworonnworan.
Na Nyankopɔn bɔfoɔ ka kyerɛɛ me daeɛ mu sɛ: Yakob!
Na mese: Menie.
Na ɔse: Ma w’ani so hwɛ, adwennini no a wɔreforo nnwan no nyinaa yɛ nsensannsensan ne ntokontrama ne nworonnworan: Ɛfiri sɛ mahunu deɛ Laban ayɛ woɔ nyinaa.
Mene Nyankopɔn a wohyiaa no Betel faako a wosraa ɛhɔ dum na wohyɛɛ bɔ maa me no; afei sɔre firi asase yi so, na sane kɔ w’abusua asase so.
Na Rahel ne Lea bua see no sɛ: Yɛda so wɔ kyɛfa anaasɛ agyapadeɛ bi wɔ yɛn agya fie anaa?
Ɔmmu yɛn ahɔhoɔ anaa?
Ɛsiane sɛ watɔn yɛn, na wadi yɛn tiri sika awie, na ahonyadeɛ a Onyankopɔn gyee yɛn agya nsam no yɛ yɛn ne yɛn mma dea.
Enti afei yɛ deɛ Onyankopɔn aka akyerɛ woɔ nyinaa.
Yakob dwane firi Laban anim Na Yakob sɔre faa ne mma ne ne yerenom tenatenaa yoma so, na ɔfaa ne mmoakuo nyinaa ne n’ahodeɛ a ɔnyaeɛ nyinaa ne mmoakuo a ɔnyaeɛ wɔ Mesopotamia no nyinaa sii mu sɛ ɔrekɔ n’agya Isak nkyɛn wɔ Kanaan asase so.
Na Laban kɔ rekɔtwitwa ne nnwan ho nwi.
Na Rahel wiaa n’agya abusua honi.
Na Yakob wiaa ne ho dwanee, ɛfiri sɛ wankra Aramni Laban.
Na ɔne deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa dwanee, na ɔsɔre twaa asubɔnten no, na ɔde n’ani kyerɛɛ Gilead bepɔ.
Laban ti Yakob Na da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ Laban sɛ Yakob adwane.
Na Laban faa ne nkurɔfoɔ kaa ne ho tii no nnanson kwan, na ɔbɛtoo no Gilead bepɔ so.
Na Onyankopɔn baa Aramni Laban nkyɛn anadwo daeɛ mu sɛ: Hwɛ yie, na woankasa papa anaa bɔne so ankyerɛ Yakob.
Na Laban kɔtoo Yakob.
Na Yakob asi ne ntomadan wɔ bepɔ no so, na Laban ne ne nkurɔfoɔ nso sii wɔn deɛ Gilead bepɔ so.
Na Laban bisaa Yakob sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na woayɛ yi, sɛ woawia wo ho adwane me, na woasoa me mmammaa kɔ sɛ wɔn a wɔde nkrantɛ afa wɔn nnommum yi?
Adɛn nti na woahunta adwane, na woawia wo ho afiri me nkyɛn?
Adɛn na woanka ankyerɛ me, na mamfa anigyeɛ ne nnwom, mpintin ne nsankuo mannya wo kwan?
Adɛn nti na woamma mamfe me mmammarima ne me mmammaa ano anya wɔn kwan?
Yei deɛ, woadi no nkwasea so.
Mewɔ tumi sɛ anka me ne mo di no bɔne; nanso nnora anadwo no, mo agya ne Nyankopɔn kasa kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Hwɛ yie, na woankasa papa anaa bɔne so ankyerɛ Yakob.
Na afei deɛ korɔ ara na wopɛ sɛ wokorɔ, ɛfiri sɛ gyina na w’ani agyina w’agya fie; na adɛn nti na woawia m’anyame?
Na Yakob bua see Laban sɛ: Na mesuro, ɛfiri sɛ mesusuu sɛ wobɛgye wo mmammaa afiri me nsam.
Na deɛ wobɛhunu w’anyame wɔ ne nsa mu no rentena ase.
Yɛn nkurɔfoɔ yi anim na hwehwɛ deɛ ɛyɛ wo dea wɔ me nkyɛn, na fa kɔ.
Na Yakob nnim sɛ Rahel na ɔwiaeɛ.
Na Laban kɔɔ Yakob ntomadan mu ne Lea ntomadan ne mfenaa baanu no ntomadan mu, nanso wanhunu.
Na ɔfiri Lea ntomadan mu kɔɔ Rahel ntomadan mu.
Na Rahel afa abusua honi no de ahyehyɛ yoma so adwa mu atena so.
Na Laban de ne nsa kekaa ntomadan mu hɔ nyinaa, nanso wanhunu.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’agya sɛ: Mma no nnyɛ me wura abufuo sɛ mentumi mensɔre wɔ w’anim, ɛfiri sɛ mabu me nsa.
Na ɔpɛe pɛe pɛe, nanso wanhunu ahoni no.
Na Yakob bo fui, na ɔne Laban hamee, na Yakob ka kyerɛɛ Laban sɛ: Me mfomsoɔ ne sɛn, na me bɔne ne sɛn na wosa me yerɛdɛdɛdɛdɛ yi?
Na wobɛhwehwɛɛ me nnoɔma mu nyinaa yi, wo fie mu adeɛ bɛn na woahunu wɔ mu?
Saa!
Fa bɛto me nkurɔfoɔ ne wo nkurɔfoɔ anim wɔ ha, na wɔmmu yɛn baanu ntam atɛn.
Mfirinhyia aduonu ni a metenaa wo nkyɛn, wo nnwammereɛ ne wo mmirekyie ampɔn, na wo nnwan mu adwennini nso, manni bi.
Wɔn a mmoa kumm wɔn no mamfa mammrɛ wo, me na metuaa so ka.
Deɛ wɔwiaa no awia ne deɛ wɔwiaa no anadwo, me nsa mu na wobisaeɛ.
Sɛ ɛyɛɛ me nie: Ahuhuro dee me awia, na awɔ dee me anadwo, na m’ani soroe.
Saa na medii wo fie mfirinhyia aduonu.
Wo mmammaa baanu ho mesom wo mfeɛ dunan, ne wo mmoakuo ho nso mfeɛ nsia, na wodanee m’akatua ani mprɛdu.
Sɛ m’agya Nyankopɔn, Abraham Nyankopɔn, ne Isak suro annyina m’akyiri a, anka afei wogyaa me kwan nsapan.
Me brɛ ne me nsa ano adwumayɛ na Onyankopɔn hunuiɛ, na ɔkaa w’anim nnora anadwo.
Na Laban bua see Yakob sɛ: Mma mmaa yi, me mma a, na mmammarima yi, me mma a, na nnwan yi, me nnwan a, na deɛ wohunu yi nyinaa, me dea.
Na me mmammaa yi, anaasɛ wɔn mma a wɔawo wɔn yi, ɛdeɛn na mɛtumi de ayɛ wɔn nnɛ?
Afei bra ma yɛmpam, me ne wo, na ɛnyɛ me ne wo ntam adanseɛ.
Na Yakob faa ɔboɔ de yɛɛ odum sii hɔ.
Na Yakob ka kyerɛɛ ne nkurɔfoɔ sɛ: Mommoaboa aboɔ ano!
Na wɔtasee aboɔ yɛɛ no kuo; na wɔdidii wɔ ekuo no so hɔ.
Na Laban frɛɛ hɔ Yegarsahaduta, na Yakob deɛ, ɔfrɛɛ hɔ Galeed.
Na Laban kaa sɛ: Ekuo yi ne me ne wo ntam adanseɛ nnɛ.
Enti wɔfrɛ hɔ Galeed, ne Mispa, ɛfiri sɛ ɔse: Sɛ yɛtete mu a, AWURADE nhwɛ me ne wo ntam.
Sɛ woteetee me mmammaa, na woware yerenom ka me mma ho a, obi nka yɛn ho deɛ, nanso Onyankopɔn ne me ne wo ntam danseni.
Na Laban ka kyerɛɛ Yakob sɛ: Hwɛ kuo yi, na hwɛ odum a mama so asi me ne wo ntam yi.
Aboɔkuo yi ne adanseɛ, na odum yi nso yɛ adanseɛ, sɛ me deɛ, merensiane ekuo yi ho memma wo nkyɛn, na wo nso, worensiane ekuo yi ne odum yi ho mma me nkyɛn mmɛyɛ bɔne.
Abraham Nyankopɔn ne Nahor Nyankopɔn, ne wɔn agya Nyankopɔn mmu yɛn ntam atɛn.
Na Yakob kaa n’agya suro ho ntam.
Na Yakob bɔɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ bepɔ no so, na ɔfrɛɛ ne nkurɔfoɔ sɛ wɔmmɛdidi; na wɔdidii na wɔtenaa bepɔ no so anadwo no.
Na Laban sɔree anɔpatutu, na ɔfee ne nananom ne ne mmammaa no ano hyiraa wɔn, na ɔsii mu sane kɔɔ ne kurom.
Yakob kɔhyia Esau Na Yakob sii ne kwan so sɛ ɔrekɔ; na Nyankopɔn abɔfoɔ bɛhyiaa no.
Na Yakob hunuu wɔn no, ɔkaa sɛ: Nyankopɔn asafo nie.
Na ɔtoo hɔ din: Maha-naim.
Na Yakob tuu abɔfoɔ dii n’anim kɔɔ ne nua Esau nkyɛn Seir asase so wɔ Edom wiram.
Na ɔhyɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛdeɛ monka nkyerɛ me wura Esau ne sɛ: W’akoa Yakob se: Mekɔtenaa Laban nkyɛn na ɛhɔ na mewɔ de abɛduru sɛsɛɛ.
Manya anantwie, mfunumu, nnwan, mmirekyie ne nkoa ne mfenaa; na masoma sɛ wɔmmɛka nkyerɛ me wura, sɛdeɛ mɛnya w’anim adom.
Na abɔfoɔ no sane baa Yakob nkyɛn bɛkaa sɛ: Yɛakɔ wo nua Esau nkyɛn, na ɔno nso ne mmarima ahanan reba abɛhyia wo.
Ɛnna Yakob suroo sɛ, na ne ho yeraa no.
Na ɔkyɛɛ nkurɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ ne nkyɛn ne nnwan, mmirekyie, anantwie ne yoma no mu akuo mmienu kaa sɛ: Sɛ Esau ba kuo baako so bɛku wɔn a, ekuo a ɛbɛka no bɛnya kwan adwane.
Na Yakob kaa sɛ: M’agya Abraham Nyankopɔn ne m’agya Isak Nyankopɔn, AWURADE a wosee me sɛ: Sane kɔ w’asase so ne w’abusua mu, na mɛyɛ wo yie no, w’adɔeɛ ne wo nokorɛ a wode akyerɛ w’akoa yi mu biara nsɛ me, ɛfiri sɛ mede me poma na metwaa Yordan yi, na afei mayɛ akuo mmienu.
