Mesrɛ wo, yi me firi me nua Esau nsam, ɛfiri sɛ mesuro no sɛ ɔbɛba abɛku me, ne ɛnanom ne wɔn mma nyinaa.
Wo na wokaa sɛ: Yie na mɛyɛ woɔ, na mɛma w’asefoɔ ayɛ sɛ mpoano anwea a ne dodoɔ nti wɔntumi nkan.
Na ɔtenaa hɔ anadwo no; na ɔyii deɛ ɛwɔ ne nsa mu bi sɛ ɔde rekɔkyɛ ne nua Esau, mmirekyibereɛ ahanu, mpapo aduonu, nnwammereɛ ahanu, adwennini aduonu, yoma a wɔma nufoɔ ne wɔn mma aduasa, anantwibereɛ aduanan, anantwinini du, mfunumubereɛ aduonu ne mfunumu anini du.
Na ɔde hyɛɛ ne nkoa nsa akuakuo, na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa no sɛ: Monsene nni m’anim, na momma kuo ne kuo ntam ntwe.
Na ɔhyɛɛ deɛ ɔdi kan no sɛ: Sɛ me nua Esau bɛhyia wo, na ɔbisa wo sɛ: Hwan nipa ne wo, na ɛhe na worekorɔ, na yeinom a ɛdi w’anim yi yɛ hwan dea?
Ka kyerɛ no sɛ: W’akoa Yakob dea; ɛyɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ a wasoma de rebrɛ me wura Esau; na hwɛ, ɔno nso wɔ yɛn akyi.
Na ɔhyɛɛ deɛ ɔtɔ so mmienu ne deɛ ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa ne wɔn a wɔdi mmoakuo no akyire nyinaa nso sɛ: Sɛ mokɔhunu Esau a, monka asɛm korɔ yi ara nkyerɛ no.
Na monka nsi so sɛ: Hwɛ, w’akoa Yakob wɔ yɛn akyi.
Afei ɔkaa sɛ: Mede ayɛyɛdeɛ a ɛdi m’anim yi merekɔpata no, ansa na mahunu n’anim; ebia ɔbɛhwɛ m’anim.
Na ayɛyɛdeɛ no sene dii n’anim; na ɔno deɛ, ɔtenaa nsraban no mu anadwo no.
Yakob ne ɔbɔfoɔ bi tentam Na anadwo no ɔsɔree, na ɔfaa ne yerenom baanu ne ne mmaawa baanu no ne ne mma dubaako no de wɔn kɔtwaa Yabok asutwareeɛ.
Na ɔde wɔn twaa asubɔnten no, na ɔmaa deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa twaee.
Na ɛkaa Yakob nko ara.
Na ɔbarima bi ne no bɛtentamee kɔduruu adekyeeɛ.
Na ɔbarima no hunuu sɛ ɔntumi no no, ɔkaa n’asene tokuro mu, na Yakob dwonku hwanee tentam a ɔne no tentameeɛ no mu.
Na ɔbarima no kaa sɛ: Ma menkɔ, na adeɛ rekye.
Na Yakob buaa sɛ: Meremma wonkɔ gye sɛ wohyira me.
Na ɔbarima no bisaa no sɛ: Wo din de sɛn?
Na ɔbuaa sɛ: Yakob.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Wɔremfrɛ wo din Yakob bio, na wɔbɛfrɛ no Israel, ɛfiri sɛ wo ne Onyankopɔn ne nnipa ako, na woatumi.
Na Yakob bisaa no sɛ: Mesrɛ wo, kyerɛ me wo din.
Na ɔse: Adɛn nti na worebisa me din?
Na ɔbarima no hyiraa no wɔ hɔ.
Na Yakob too ɛhɔ din Peni-el, ɛfiri sɛ ɔse: Me ne Onyankopɔn adi nhunuanimu, nso me kra anya nkwa.
Na ɔtwaa mu wɔ Peniel berɛ a na owia apue no, na ɔtɔ gu so ne dwonku a ahwan no nti.
Enti Israelfoɔ nni ntini a ɛwɔ asene mu akwaa tokuro mu no de bɛduru nnɛ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔkaa Yakob dwonkuo tokuro mu, n’asene mu ntini no so.
Yakob hyia Esau Na Yakob maa n’ani so hunui, na hwɛ, Esau reba, na mmarima ahanan ka ne ho.
Na ɔkyɛɛ ne mma mu maa Lea ne Rahel ne mmaawa baanu no.
Na ɔde mmaawa no ne wɔn mma dii anim, na Lea ne ne mma dii hɔ, na Rahel ne Yosef dii akyire.
Na ɔno ara deɛ ɔsene dii wɔn anim, na ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase kɔɔ fam mprɛnson de kɔsii sɛ ɔduruu ne nua nkyɛn.
Na Esau tuu mmirika bɛhyiaa no yɛɛ no atuu, na ɔde ne tiri too ne kɔn ho, na ɔfee n’ano, na wɔsui.
Na Esau maa n’ani so hunuu mmaa no ne wɔn mma no, ɔkaa sɛ: Hwannom ne yeinom a wɔka wo ho yi?
Na Yakob buaa sɛ: Ɛyɛ mma a Onyankopɔn de adom w’akoa.
Na mmaawa no twe pinii, wɔn ne wɔn mma, na wɔbobɔɔ wɔn mu ase.
Na Lea nso ne ne mma twe pinii bobɔɔ wɔn mu ase, na akyire yi no Yosef ne Rahel twe pinii bobɔɔ wɔn mu ase.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Na ɛdɔm a mehyiaa wɔn yi ase ne sɛn?
Na ɔse: Sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na mɛnya me wura anim adom.
Na Esau kaa sɛ: Deɛ mewɔ dɔɔso, me nua, ma w’adeɛ ntena hɔ mma wo.
Na Yakob kaa sɛ: Dabi da, mesrɛ wo, sɛ manya w’anim adom a, gye m’ayɛyɛdeɛ a ɛwɔ me nsam yi, na w’anim a mahunu yi te sɛdeɛ obi hunu Nyankopɔn anim, ɛfiri sɛ w’ani asɔ me.
Mesrɛ wo, gye nhyira a wɔde abrɛ woɔ yi, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn adom me, na mewɔ ade nyinaa.
Na ɔhyɛɛ no, na ɔgyee.
Na Esau kaa sɛ: Ma yɛnsim nkɔ, na menni w’anim.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Me wura nim sɛ mma a wɔyɛ mmerɛ ne nnwan ne anantwie a wɔma nufoɔ ka me ho, na sɛ wɔpia wɔn dodo da koro a, nnwankuo no nyinaa bɛwuwu.
Enti ma me wura nsene nni n’akoa anim, na me deɛ, mɛnante brɛoo, sɛdeɛ mmoa a wɔdi m’anim ne mma no bɛtumi de akɔsi sɛ mɛduru me wura nkyɛn wɔ Seir.
Na Esau kaa sɛ: Ma mennya wo nnipa a wɔka me ho yi bi.
Na ɔse: Na wɔnyɛ dɛn?
Ma mennya me wura anim adom.
Ɛnna Esau sanee da no ara sii kwan so kɔɔ Seir.
Na Yakob sii mu kɔɔ Sukot, na ɔsii dan maa ne ho, na ɔbobɔɔ asese maa ne mmoa.
Yei nti na wɔfrɛ hɔ Sukot.
Na Yakob firii Mesopotamia no, ɔnam bɛduruu Sekem kuro a ɛwɔ Kanaan asase soɔ no mu dwoodwoo, na ɔsisii ne ntomadan wɔ kuro no anim.
Na ɔtɔɔ asase a ɔsii ne ntomadan wɔ soɔ no wɔ Sekem agya Hamor mma nkyɛn nnwetɛbena ɔha.
Na ɔsii afɔrebukyia wɔ hɔ, na ɔtoo no: El-elohe-Israel.
Sekem to Dina mmɔnaa Na Lea ne Yakob babaa Dina firii adi sɛ ɔrekɔhwɛ asase no so mmaa.
Na asase no so otitire Hewini Hamor ba Sekem hunuu no, na ɔkyeree no too no mmɔnaa guu ne ho fi.
Na Yakob ba Dina sɔɔ Sekem ani, na ɔdɔɔ ababaa no, na ɔkorɔkorɔɔ no.
Na Sekem ka kyerɛɛ n’agya Hamor sɛ: Kɔgye ababaa yi awareɛ ma me.
Na Yakob tee sɛ wagu ne babaa Dina ho fi.
Nanso ɛnam sɛ na ne mmammarima no wɔ ne mmoa nkyɛn wɔ wiram no, enti ɔyɛɛ komm de kɔsii sɛ wɔbaa fie.
Na Sekem agya Hamor firii adi kɔɔ Yakob nkyɛn sɛ ɔne no rekɔkasa.
Na Yakob mmammarima teeɛ no, wɔfirii wiram bae.
Na ɛyɛɛ mmarima no ya, na wɔn bo fuu pa ara, sɛ Sekem adi Israel ho nkwaseasɛm sɛ ɔne Yakob babaa akɔda; adeɛ a ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ.
Na Hamor ne wɔn kasaa sɛ: Me ba Sekem akoma fam mo babaa no ho; mesrɛ mo, momfa no mma no aware.
Na mo ne yɛn nni ayewareɛ, na momfa mo mmammaa mma yɛn, na mo nso monware yɛn mmammaa.
Na mo ne yɛn ntena, na asase na ɛda mo anim yi, montena so nyɛ so adwuma nnya so adeɛ.
Na Sekem ka kyerɛɛ Dina n’agya ne ne nuanom sɛ: Momma mennya mo anim adom, na biribiara a mobɛse me no, mɛma.
Monnye me etire adeɛ dodoɔ ne akyɛdeɛ biara, na biribiara a mobɛse me no, mɛma; na momfa ababaa no mma me awareɛ.
Na Yakob mmammarima no kasa de nnaadaa buaa Sekem n’agya Hamor ɛfiri sɛ wagu wɔn nuabaa Dina ho fi.
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Yɛntumi saa adeɛ yi yɛ, sɛ yɛde yɛn nua bɛma ɔbarima a ɔyɛ momonoto, ɛfiri sɛ ɛno yɛ ahohora ma yɛn.
Na yei mu nko na yɛbɛpene mo sɛ mobɛdane ayɛ sɛ yɛn, na wɔatwitwa mo mu mmarima nyinaa twetia.
Ɛno na yɛde yɛn mmammaa bɛma mo, na yɛabɛfa mo mmammaa nso aware, na yɛne mo atena, na yɛayɛ ɔman korɔ.
Na sɛ moantie yɛn, na moantwitwa twetia a, ɛnneɛ yɛbɛfa yɛn babaa akɔ.
Na wɔn nsɛm no sɔɔ Hamor ne ne ba Sekem ani.
Enti Sekem antwetwe ne ho sɛ ɔbɛyɛ saa adeɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ na Yakob babaa no sɔ n’ani, na aberanteɛ no animuonyam sene n’agya fiefoɔ nyinaa.
Na Hamor ne ne ba Sekem kɔɔ wɔn kuro aboboano, na wɔne wɔn kurom mmarima kɔkasaa sɛ: Nnipa yi, wɔne yɛn te asomdwoeɛ mu, enti momma wɔntena asase yi so, na wɔnyɛ so adwuma.
Na asase yi, hwɛ, ɛda wɔn anim kakraa.
Momma yɛmfa wɔn mmammaa nware, na yɛmfa yɛn mmammaa nso mma wɔn.
Na yei nko mu na nnipa no bɛpene sɛ wɔne yɛn bɛtena, na yɛayɛ ɔman korɔ; sɛ yɛn mu mmarima nyinaa bɛtwitwa twetia, sɛdeɛ wɔatwitwa no.
Wɔn mmoa ne wɔn ahonyadeɛ ne wɔn afieboa nyinaa renyɛ yɛn dea anaa?
Momma yɛmpene so ma wɔn, na wɔne yɛn ntena.
Na wɔn a wɔnam Hamor kuro pono ano firi adie nyinaa tiee no ne ne ba Sekem, na mmarima nyinaa, wɔn a wɔnam ne kuro pono ano firi adie nyinaa twitwaa twetia.
Na da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa a ne yea kaa wɔn no, Yakob mmammarima baanu, Simeon ne Lewi a wɔyɛ Dina nuanom, fefaa wɔn nkrantɛ kɔɔ kuro no so mpofirim kɔkunkumm mmarima nyinaa.
Na wɔde nkrantɛ kumm Hamor ne ne ba Sekem; na wɔde Dina firii Sekem fie hɔ bae.
Yakob mmammarima no baa atɔfoɔ no so bɛfom kuro no mu nnoɔma fae, ɛfiri sɛ wɔagu wɔn nua no ho fi.
Wɔn nnwan, wɔn anantwie, wɔn mfunumu ne deɛ ɛwɔ kuro no mu ne deɛ ɛwɔ mfuo mu no, wɔfae.
Na wɔn ade nyinaa ne wɔn mma nyinaa ne wɔn yerenom, wɔfaa wɔn nnommum fom deɛ ɛwɔ fie nyinaa.
Na Yakob ka kyerɛɛ Simeon ne Lewi sɛ: Moaha me ama me ho abɔn wɔn a wɔte asase yi soɔ, Kanaanfoɔ ne Perisifoɔ.
Na me deɛ, meyɛ asafo a mesua yi, wɔbɛboaboa wɔn ano aba me so abɛku me, na wɔasɛe me ne me fie.
Na wɔse: Ɔnyɛ yɛn nuabaa sɛ odwamamfoɔ anaa?
Onyankopɔn hyira Yakob wɔ Betel Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Yakob sɛ: Sɔre kɔ Betel kɔtena hɔ, na si afɔrebukyia wɔ hɔ ma Onyankopɔn a ɔyii ne ho kyerɛɛ wo ɛda a woredwane afiri wo nua Esau anim no.
Ɛnna Yakob ka kyerɛɛ ne fiefoɔ ne wɔn a wɔka ne ho nyinaa sɛ: Montoto anyame ananafoɔ a ɛwɔ mo mu no ngu, na monnwira mo ho, na monsakyera mo ntadeɛ.
Na momma yɛnsɔre nkɔ Betel, na menkɔsi afɔrebukyia wɔ hɔ memma Onyankopɔn a m’ahohiahia da ɔtiee me na ɔdii m’akyi wɔ kwan a mekɔeɛ no mu no.
Ɛnna wɔde wɔn anyame ananafoɔ a ɛwɔ wɔn nsam nyinaa ne wɔn aso mu nkaa maa Yakob, na ɔde siee dupɔn bi a ɛwɔ Sekem ho no ase.
Na wɔsii mu sɛ wɔrekorɔ no, Nyankopɔn ho hu baa nkuro a atwa wɔn ho ahyia no so, na wɔanti Yakob mma no.
Na Yakob ne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔka ne ho nyinaa duruu Lus a ɛwɔ Kanaan asase soɔ (a ɛne Betel).
Na ɔsii hɔ afɔrebukyia, na ɔfrɛɛ hɔ: El-betel, ɛfiri sɛ da a ɔredwane afiri ne nua anim no, ɛhɔ na Onyankopɔn yii ne ho kyerɛɛ no.
Na Rebeka abaawa panin Debora wui, na wɔsiee no Betel aseɛ fam wɔ odum bi ase, na ɔtoo dua no din Alon-bakut.
Na Onyankopɔn yii ne ho kyerɛɛ Yakob bio, ne ba a ɔfirii Mesopotamia baeɛ no mu, na ɔhyiraa no.
Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wo din de Yakob, nanso wɔremfrɛ wo Yakob bio, na mmom Israel ne wo din; na ɔtoo no din Israel.
Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Mene Onyankopɔn Tweaduampɔn, dɔre na yɛ bebree; ɔman ne aman asafo bɛfiri wo mu aba, na ahemfo firi w’asene mu bɛba.
Na asase a mede mama Abraham ne Isak no, wo na mede bɛma woɔ; na w’asefoɔ a wɔbɛdi w’akyire no na mede asase no bɛma wɔn.
Na Onyankopɔn firii ne nkyɛn wɔ deɛ ɔne no kasaeɛ hɔ kɔɔ ɔsoro.
Na Yakob de odum sii deɛ ɔne no kasaeɛ hɔ, ɔboɔ dum, na ɔhwiee ɔnom afɔdeɛ guu so, na ɔde ngo guu so.
Na Yakob frɛɛ deɛ ɔne Onyankopɔn kasaeɛ hɔ Betel.
Rahel wuo Na wɔtutu firi Betel kɔe.
Na aka kwan tiaa bi na wɔaduru Efrat no, awoɔ kaa Rahel, na awoɔ no denee no.
Na n’awoɔ mu yɛɛ den no, awogyefoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Nsuro, na yei nso wobɛwo ɔbabarima.
Na ne kra refiri ne mu na ɔreyɛ awuo no, ɔtoo no din Ben-oni, na n’agya deɛ, ɔfrɛɛ no Benyamin.
Na Rahel wui, na wɔsiee no ɛkwan a ɛde Efrat (a ɛne Betlehem) no nkyɛn.
Na Yakob sii ne da so dum, ɛne Rahel da so dum de bɛsi nnɛ.
Na Israel tutu kɔsii ne ntomadan wɔ Eder abantenten akyiri nohoa.
Na ɛbaa sɛ Israel te asase no soɔ no, Ruben ne n’agya abaawayerɛ Bilha kɔdae, na Israel tee.
Yakob mmammarima Nso Yakob mmammarima yɛ dummienu: Lea mma ne Ruben (Yakob abakan), Simeon, Lewi, Yuda, Isakar ne Sebulon.
Rahel mma ne Yosef ne Benyamin.
Na Rahel abaawa Bilha mma ne Dan ne Naftali.
Na Lea abaawa Silpa mma ne Gad ne Aser.
Yeinom ne Yakob mmammarima a wɔwoo wɔn wɔ Mesopotamia.
Isak wuo Na Yakob baa n’agya Isak nkyɛn wɔ Mamre, wɔ Kiriat-arba (a ɛne Hebron), deɛ Abraham ne Isak tenaeɛ sɛ ahɔhoɔ no.
Na Isak nna nyinaa yɛ mfirinhyia ɔha aduɔwɔtwe.
Na Isak gyaa ne honhom mu, na ɔwui, na ɔtii ne nananom wɔ asamando, berɛ a na wabɔ akora, na nna amee no.
Na ne mma Esau ne Yakob siee no.
Esau asefoɔ Na yeinom ne Esau (a wɔfrɛ no Edom) awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ: Esau waree Kanaanfoɔ mmaa: Hetini Elon babaa Ada, ne Hewini Sibeon ba Ana babaa Oholibama, ne Ismael babaa Basmat, Nebaiot nuabaa.
Na Ada woo Elifas maa Esau, na Basmat woo Reuel.
Na Oholibama woo Yeus ne Yalam ne Kora.
Yeinom ne Esau mma a wɔwoo wɔn wɔ Kanaan asase soɔ.
Na Esau faa ne yerenom ne ne mmammarima ne ne mmammaa ne ne fiefoɔ nyinaa ne ne mmoa ne n’anantwie nyinaa ne n’ahonyadeɛ a ɔnyaeɛ wɔ Kanaan asase soɔ nyinaa, na ɔfirii ne nua Yakob ho kɔɔ asase bi so, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn ahonyadeɛ dɔɔso sene deɛ wɔde tena faako, na asase a wɔyɛ so ahɔhoɔ no, wɔn mmoa dodoɔ nti na wɔnsene so.
Esau, a ɔno ara ne Edom no kɔtenaa Seir bepɔ so.
Na yeinom ne Edomfoɔ agya Esau a ɔte Seir bepɔ soɔ no awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ: Esau mmammarima din nie: Esau yere Ada ba Elifas, ne Esau yere Basmat ba Reuel.
Na Elifas mma ne Teman, Omar, Sefo, Gatam ne Kenas.
(Na Timna yɛ Esau ba Elifas mpena, na ɔwoo Amalek maa Elifas.)
Yeinom ne Esau yere Ada mma.
Na yeinom ne Reuel mma: Nahat, Sera, Sama ne Misa; yeinom ne Esau yere Basmat mma.
Na yeinom ne Esau yere Oholibama, Sibeon ba Ana babaa no mma: Ɔwoo Yeus, Yalam ne Kora maa Esau.
Yeinom ne Esau mma mu atitire: Esau abakan Elifas mma: Otitire Teman, otitire Omar, otitire Sefo, otitire Kenas, otitire Kora, otitire Gatam, ne otitire Amalek.
Yeinom ne Elifas atitire wɔ Edom asase so; yeinom ne Ada mma.
Na yeinom ne Esau ba Reuel mma: Otitire Nahat, otitire Sera, otitire Sama, ne otitire Misa.
Yeinom ne Reuel atitire wɔ Edom asase so; yeinom ne Esau yere Basmat mma.
Na yeinom ne Esau yere Oholibama mma: Otitire Yeus, otitire Yalam, otitire Kora.
Yeinom ne Esau yere Oholibama, Ana ba, atitire no.
Yeinom ne Esau mma, na yeinom ne wɔn atitire no; (ɔne Edom.)
Seir Asefoɔ Yeinom ne Horini Seir mma asase no sofoɔ: Lotan, Sobal, Sibeon, Ana, Dison, Eser ne Disan.
Yeinom ne Horifoɔ a wɔyɛ Seir mma a na wɔte Edom asase soɔ no atitire.
Na Lotan mma ne Hori ne Hemam, na Lotan nuabaa ne Timna.
Na yeinom ne Sobal mma: Alwan, Manahat, Ebal, Sefo ne Onam.
Na yeinom ne Sibeon mma: Aya ne Ana.
Oyi ne Ana a na ɔhwɛ n’agya Sibeon mfunumu no, a ɔhunuu nsuohyeɛ aniwa wɔ ɛserɛ soɔ no.
Na yeinom ne Ana mma: Dison ne Oholibama, a ɔyɛ Ana babaa.
Na yeinom ne Dison mma: Hemdan, Esban, Itran ne Keran.
Yeinom ne Eser mma: Bilhan, Saawan ne Akan.
Yeinom ne Disan mma: Us ne Aran.
Yeinom ne Horifoɔ atitire: Otitire Lotan, otitire Sobal, otitire Sibeon, otitire Ana, otitire Dison, otitire Eser, otitire Disan.
Yeinom ne Horifoɔ atitire sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ wɔ Seir asase soɔ.
Edom Ahemfo Yeinom ne ahemfo a wɔdii Edom asase soɔ ansa na obi redi Israel mma so hene.
Na Bela, Beor ba, dii Edomhene, na ne kuro din de Dinhaba.
Na Bela wui, na Sera ba Yobab a ɔfiri Bosra bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Na Yobab wui, na Husam a ɔfiri Teman asase soɔ no bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Na Husam wui, na Bedad ba Hadad a ɔkumm Midian wɔ Moab petee mu no bɛdii n’adeɛ, na ne kuro din de Hawit.
Na Hadad wui, na Samla a ɔfiri Masreka bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Na Samla wui, na Saulo a ɔfiri Rehobot a ɛda asuo no ho no bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Na Saulo wui, na Akbor ba Baal-hanan bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Na Akbor ba Baal-hanan wui, na Hadar bɛdii n’adeɛ.
Na ne kuro din de Pau, na ne yere din de Mehetabel, Mesahab babaa Matred babaa.
Na yeinom ne Esau atitire no din, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusuakuo, wɔn tenabea ne wɔn din teɛ: Otitire Timna, otitire Alwa, otitire Yetet, otitire Oholibama, otitire Ela, otitire Pinon, otitire Kenas, otitire Teman, otitire Mibsar, otitire Magdiel, otitire Iram.
Yeinom ne Edom (a ɔne Esau, Edomfoɔ agya) no atitire, sɛdeɛ wɔn tenabea teɛ wɔ asase a wɔnyaeɛ no soɔ.
Yosef ne ne nuanom Na Yakob tenaa asase a n’agya yɛɛ so hɔhoɔ a ɛne Kanaan asase no so.
Na yei ne Yakob abusua ho abakɔsɛm: Yosef dii mfirinhyia dunson no, ɔne ne nuanom kɔhwɛɛ nnwan; na aberantewaa no ne n’agya yerenom Bilha ne Silpa mma na ɛwɔ hɔ.
Na Yosef bɛka wɔn ho asɛmmɔne kyerɛ n’agya.
Na ɛsiane sɛ Yosef yɛ ne nkɔkoraaberɛ mu ba nti, na Israel dɔ no sene ne mma nyinaa; enti ɔpam batakari fɛfɛ bi maa no.
Na ne nuanom hunuu sɛ wɔn agya dɔ no sene wɔn nyinaa no, wɔtanee no, na wɔmfa abodwoɔ ne no nkasa.
Na Yosef soo daeɛ, na berɛ a ɔka kyerɛɛ ne nuanom no, wɔtanee no senee akane no.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Montie daeɛ a maso yi: Na hwɛ, na yɛrekyekyere ayuo afiafi wɔ afuom.
Na m’afi no sɔre gyinaa kyirebenn, na hwɛ, mo afiafi no twaa m’afi ho hyiae, na ɛrekoto m’afi no.
Na ne nuanom ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kyerɛ sɛ worebɛdi yɛn so hene anaasɛ worebɛdi yɛn so tumi?
Na ne daeɛ ne ne nsɛm no nti wɔkɔɔ so tanee no bebree.
Na ɔsoo daeɛ foforɔ bio, na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne nuanom sɛ: Hwɛ, maso daeɛ bio, na hwɛ, owia ne ɔsrane ne nsoromma dubaako akoto me.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’agya ne ne nuanom no, n’agya kaa n’anim sɛ: Daeɛ bɛn na woaso yi?
Kyerɛ sɛ, me ne wo na ne wo nuanom bɛba abɛkoto fam wɔ w’anim?
Na ne nuanom ani beree no; na n’agya deɛ, ɔde nsɛm no siee.
Wɔtɔn Yosef ma wɔde no kɔ Misraim Na ne nuanom de wɔn agya nnwan kɔɔ adidie wɔ Sekem.
Na Israel ka kyerɛɛ Yosef sɛ: Sɛ wonim sɛ wo nuanom rewɛn mmoa wɔ Sekem.
Bra na mensoma wo wɔn nkyɛn.
Na ɔse: Menie.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kɔ na kɔhwɛ sɛ wo nuanom ne nnwan no ho yɛ anaa; na sane bɛka kyerɛ me.
Na ɔsomaa no firii Hebron bonhwa mu, na ɔkɔduruu Sekem.
Na ɔbarima bi hunuu no, na hwɛ, na ɔrewɔ wira no mu ntwɛtwɛdɛ.
Na ɔbarima no bisaa no sɛ: Worehwehwɛ deɛn?
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Me nuanom na merehwehwɛ wɔn; mesrɛ wo, kyerɛ me faako a wɔrehwɛ wɔn mmoa no.
Na ɔbarima no se: Wɔatu ha; na metee sɛ wɔreka sɛ: Momma yɛnkɔ Dotan.
Na Yosef tii ne nuanom, na ɔkɔhunuu wɔn wɔ Dotan.
Na ne nuanom hunuu no akyirikyiri na ɔnnya nnuruu wɔn nkyɛn no, wɔpamm ne tiri so sɛ wɔbɛku no.
Na wɔsesee wɔn ho wɔn ho sɛ: Hwɛ, ɔdaeɛsofoɔ no na ɔreba no.
Afei mommra mma yɛnku no mfa no nto mmura yi bi mu, na yɛnka sɛ: Aboa bɔne bi na awe no, na yɛahwɛ deɛ ne daeɛ no bɛyɛ.
Na Ruben teeɛ no, ɔgyee no firii wɔn nsam kaa sɛ: Mommma yɛnnku no.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Monnhwie mogya nngu, na momfa no nto ɛserɛ so ha abura yi mu; na mommfa mo nsa nnka no.
Ɔreyɛ na anka wayi no afiri wɔn nsam de no asane akɔma n’agya.
Na Yosef duruu ne nuanom nkyɛn no, wɔworɔɔ n’atadeɛ ne batakari fɛfɛ a ɔhyɛ no, na wɔde no kɔtoo abura no mu.
Nso na abura no da mpan a nsuo nni mu.
Na wɔtenaa ase didii.
Na wɔmaa wɔn ani so hwɛe, wɔhunuu Ismaelfoɔ akwantufoɔkuo bi a wɔfiri Gilead rekɔ Misraim ne wɔn yoma a wɔsoso hyehwam ne akyenkyennuro ne kurobo sɛ wɔreba.
Na Yuda ka kyerɛɛ ne nuanom sɛ: Sɛ yɛkum yɛn nua na yɛsi ne mogya so a, mfasoɔ bɛn na ɛwɔ mu?
Mommra mma yɛntɔn no mma Ismaelfoɔ.
Mommma yɛmmfa yɛn nsa nnka no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ yɛn nua ne yɛn mogya.
Na ne nuanom no tiee no.
Na Midianfoɔ adwadifoɔ bi rebɛsene.
Na wɔtwetwee Yosef yii no firii abura no mu, na wɔtɔn no maa Ismaelfoɔ no gyee nnwetɛbena aduonu.
Na wɔde Yosef kɔɔ Misraim.
Na Ruben sane baa abura no so, na hwɛ, na Yosef nni abura no mu.
Na ɔsunsuanee ne ntadeɛ mu, na ɔsane baa ne nuanom nkyɛn bɛkaa sɛ: Abɔfra no nni hɔ, na afei ɛdeɛn na menyɛ?
Na wɔfaa Yosef atadeɛ no, na wɔkumm ɔpapo bi, na wɔde atadeɛ no bɔɔ mogya no mu.
Na wɔsoma maa wɔde batakari fɛfɛ no brɛɛ wɔn agya bɛkaa sɛ: Yei na yɛahunu, hwɛ sɛ wo ba no atadeɛ ni anaa?
Na ɔhwɛeɛ no, ɔkaa sɛ: Ɛyɛ me ba no atadeɛ a!
Aboa bɔne bi na awe no, ampa ara wɔatete Yosef mu.
Ɛnna Yakob sunsuanee ne ntadeɛ mu, na ɔde ayitoma bɔɔ n’asene, na ɔsuu ne ba no kyɛree.
Na ne mmammarima nyinaa ne ne mmammaa nyinaa bae sɛ wɔbɛkyekyere ne werɛ, nanso wamma wɔankyekyere ne werɛ.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Mede awerɛhoɔ yi ara bɛkɔ me ba nkyɛn wɔ Asamando.
Na n’agya suu no.
Na Midianfoɔ no kɔtɔnee no wɔ Misraim maa Potifar a ɔyɛ Farao piani ne n’ankɔbeafoɔ so panin no.
Yuda ne Tamar Na ɛbaa sɛ berɛ no ara mu Yuda firii ne nuanom nkyɛn kɔe, na ɔkɔtenaa Adulamni bi a wɔfrɛ no Hira nkyɛn.
Na Yuda hunuu Kanaanni bi a wɔfrɛ no Sua babaa bi wɔ hɔ, ɔwaree no na ɔne no dae.
Na ɔnyinsɛnee, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima, na ɔtoo no din Er.
Na ɔnyinsɛnee bio woo ɔbabarima, na ɔtoo no din Onan.
Na ɔnyinsɛnee bio woo ɔbabarima, na ɔtoo no din Sela.
Na ɔwoo no no, na ɔwɔ Kesib.
Na Yuda waree yerɛ bi a wɔfrɛ no Tamar maa n’abakan Er.
Na Yuda abakan Er dii amumuyɛsɛm AWURADE anim, na AWURADE kumm no.
Na Yuda ka kyerɛɛ Onan sɛ: Kɔ wo nua yere no ho, na fa ne kunafoɔ, na wo mma ma wo nua no.
Na Onan nim sɛ mma no renyɛ ne dea, na ɛbaa sɛ, sɛ ɔkɔ ne nua yere no ho a, ɔma ne ho gu fam sɛe, na wanwo mma amma ne nua.
Na deɛ ɔyɛeɛ no yɛɛ bɔne wɔ AWURADE anim, enti ɔkumm ɔno nso.
Na afei Yuda ka kyerɛɛ n’ase Tamar sɛ: Kɔtena kuna mu wɔ w’agya fie kɔsi sɛ me ba Sela bɛnyini.
Ɛfiri sɛ ɔse, anyɛ saa a, ɔno nso bɛwu sɛ ne nuanom.
Na Tamar kɔ kɔtenaa n’agya fie.
Na ɛkyɛree kyɛreeɛ no, Sua babaa, Yuda yere no, wui.
Na Yuda werɛ kyekyereeɛ no, ɔne n’adamfo Hira Adulamni no kɔɔ ne nnwan ho twitwafoɔ nkyɛn wɔ Timnat.
Na wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ Tamar sɛ: Hwɛ, w’ase rekɔ Timnat akɔtwitwa ne nnwan ho.
Na ɔyii ne kuna ntadeɛ firii ne ho, na ɔde nkatanimu kataa n’anim, na ɔsakyeraa ne ho kɔtenaa Enaim kurotia wɔ Timnat kwan ho, ɛfiri sɛ wahunu sɛ Sela anyini, na wɔamfa no amma no awareɛ.
Na Yuda hunuu no no, ɛsiane sɛ wakata n’anim nti, ɔbuu no sɛ odwamamfoɔ.
Na ɔmane kɔɔ ne nkyɛn ɔkwan no ho kaa sɛ: Ma mene wo nkɔda ɛ, nso na ɔnnim sɛ n’ase a. Na ɔse: Ɛdeɛn na wobɛma me na wone me ada?
Na ɔse: Mɛma wɔde abirekyie ba afiri mmoa mu abrɛ wo.
Na ɔse: Ɛnneɛ ma me awowadeɛ kɔsi sɛ wode bɛba.
Na ɔkaa sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na memfa mensi wo awowa?
Na ɔse: Wo nsɔanokaa ne wo homa ne wo nsam poma.
Na ɔde maa no, na ɔkɔɔ ne ho, na ɔne no nyinsɛnee.
Na ɔsɔree, na ɔkɔe, na ɔyii ne nkatanimu firii ne ho, na ɔhyɛɛ ne kuna ntadeɛ no.
Na Yuda de abirekyie ba no maa n’adamfo Adulamni no sɛ ɔmfa nkɔgye n’awowadeɛ no wɔ ɔbaa no nsam mmrɛ no, nanso wanhu no.
Na ɔbisaa kurom hɔfoɔ sɛ: Odwamamfoɔ a ɔte Enaim kwan ho no wɔ he?
Na wɔse: Odwamamfoɔ biara nni ha.
Na ɔsane baa Yuda nkyɛn bɛkaa sɛ: Manhu no, nanso kurom hɔfoɔ se: Odwamamfoɔ biara nni hɔ.
Na Yuda se: Ma no mfa, na yɛn ani anwu.
Hwɛ, mama wode abirekyie ba yi akɔma no, na woanhu no.
Na ɛbɛyɛ abosome mmiɛnsa akyiri no, wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ Yuda sɛ: W’ase Tamar abɔ adwaman ama no anyinsɛn.
Na Yuda kaa sɛ: Monkɔfa no mmra na wɔnhye no.
Na wɔkɔfaa Tamar baeɛ no, ɔsoma maa wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ n’ase no sɛ: Ɔbarima a ne nnoɔma nie no, ne me na anyinsɛn.
Na ɔse: Hwehwɛ mu na hwɛ, deɛ nsɔanokaa, homa ne poma yi yɛ ne dea?
Na Yuda ani hunuiɛ no, ɔkaa sɛ: Ɔtene sene me, ɛfiri sɛ mamfa no mamma me ba Sela.
Nanso ɔne no anna bio.
Na ɛduruu n’awoɔ soɔ no, hwɛ, na nta na ɛwɔ ne yam.
Na ɔrewoɔ no, ɔbaako yii ne nsa, na awogyefoɔ no sɔɔ mu de asaawa kɔkɔɔ kyekyeree ne nsa no kaa sɛ: Oyi na ɔfirii adi kane.
Na ɔtwee ne nsa kɔɔ mu no, hwɛ, ne nua no firii adi, na ɔkaa sɛ: Hwɛ sɛdeɛ woatete mu?
Wo so na ntemu no wɔ.
Enti wɔtoo no din Peres.
Na akyire yi no, ne nua a asaawa kɔkɔɔ bɔ ne nsa soɔ no bae, na ɔtoo no din Sera.
Yosef ne Potifar yere Na wɔde Yosef kɔɔ Misraim.
Na Farao piani Potifar a ɔyɛ ankɔbeafoɔ so panin na ɔyɛ Misraimni no tɔɔ no Ismaelfoɔ a wɔde no kɔɔ hɔ no nsam.
Na AWURADE dii Yosef akyi, na ɔyɛɛ ɔbarima a ne ho wɔ siadeɛ, na ɔtenaa ne wura Misraimni no fie.
Na ne wura hunuu sɛ AWURADE di n’akyi na AWURADE ma deɛ ɔyɛ nyinaa yɛ yie n’abasa soɔ no, Yosef nyaa n’anim adom, na ɔsom no; na ɔde no sii ne fie so, na ɔde deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa hyɛɛ ne nsa.
Na ɛfiri berɛ a ɔde no sii ne fie ne deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa soɔ no, Yosef nti AWURADE hyiraa Misraimni no fie, na AWURADE nhyira baa deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa so, efie ne afuom.
Na ɔde deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa hyɛɛ Yosef nsa, na ɔwɔ hɔ nti, ɔnhwɛ biribiara gye aduane a ɔno ara die.
Nso na Yosef ho ne n’anim yɛ fɛ.
Na ɛbaa sɛ akyire yi no, Yosef wura yere tuu n’ani sii ne so, na ɔkaa sɛ: Wo ne me mmɛda.
Nanso wampene, na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne wura yere no sɛ: Hwɛ, sɛ me wura anya me nti ɔnhwɛ deɛ ɛwɔ ne fie, na ɔde deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa ahyɛ me nsa.
Obiara nyɛ kɛseɛ nsene me efie ha, na ɔnkame me biribiara gye wo, ɛnam sɛ ne yere ne woɔ ntira.
Na adɛn na menyɛ amumuyɛ kɛseɛ yi, na menyɛ bɔne mentia Onyankopɔn?
Na ɔka kyerɛ Yosef saa daa daa, nanso Yosef antie sɛ ɔne no bɛda na ama ne nsa aka no.
Na da koro bi a ɔkɔɔ ɛdan no mu sɛ ɔrekɔyɛ n’adwuma, na efie hɔfoɔ no mu biara nni hɔ no, ne wura yere no sɔɔ n’atadeɛ mu kaa sɛ: Wo ne me mmɛda!
Na Yosef gyaa n’atadeɛ no wɔ ne nsam dwane firii adi.
Na ɔbaa no hunuu sɛ wagya n’atadeɛ wɔ ne nsam adwane afiri adie no, ɔfrɛfrɛɛ ne fiefoɔ ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monhwɛ, wakɔfa Hebrini yi aba rebɛdi yɛn ho fɛw; waba me nkyɛn sɛ ɔne me rebɛda, na mede nne kɛseɛ meteaa mu; na ɔtee sɛ memaa me nne soɔ meteaa mu no, ɔgyaa n’atadeɛ wɔ me nsam, na ɔdwane firii adi.
Na ɔde n’atadeɛ no guu ne nkyɛn kɔsii sɛ ne wura baa fie.
Na ɔkaa saa nsɛm yi ara kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Akoa Hebrini a wokɔfaa no brɛɛ yɛn no baa me nkyɛn sɛ ɔrebɛdi me ho fɛw; na memaa me nne so meteaa mu no, ɔgyaa n’atadeɛ wɔ me nsam, na ɔdwane firii adie.
Na ne wura tee ne yere nsɛm a ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Saa adeɛ yi na w’akoa no ayɛ me no, ne bo fui.
Na Yosef wura no faa no de no kɔtoo afiase, deɛ ɔhene nneduafoɔ guo, na ɔdaa afiase hɔ.
Onyankopɔn di Yosef akyi Na AWURADE dii Yosef akyi, na ɔdom no, na ɔmaa n’anim baa nyam wɔ afiasehwɛni no anim.
Na afiasehwɛni no de nneduafoɔ a wɔwɔ afiase hɔ nyinaa hyɛɛ Yosef nsa, na biribiara a na wɔyɛ no wɔ hɔ no, ɔno na na ɔhwɛ soɔ.
Afiasehwɛni no anha ne ho anhwɛ biribiara a ɛwɔ Yosef nsam, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE dii n’akyi, na deɛ ɔyɛeɛ nyinaa, AWURADE maa no yɛɛ yie.
Yosef kyerɛ nneduafoɔ daeɛ ase Na ɛbaa sɛ akyire yi Misraimhene nsahyɛni ne ne paanootoni fom wɔn wura, Misraimhene no.
Na Farao bo fuu n’apiafoɔ baanu no, nsahyɛfoɔ panin ne paanootofoɔ panin no.
Na ɔde wɔn kɔguu afiase wɔ ankɔbeafoɔ panin no fie, faako a Yosef da hɔ.
Na ankɔbeafoɔ panin no maa Yosef hwɛɛ wɔn so som wɔn; na wɔkyɛree afiase hɔ kakra.
Na Misraimhene nsahyɛni ne ne paanootoni a na wɔgu afiase hɔ no baanu nyinaa sosoo daeɛ anadwo korɔ, ɛsono oyi daeɛ ne n’asekyerɛ, na ɛsono oyi nso daeɛ.
Na Yosef kɔɔ wɔn nkyɛn anɔpa kɔhwɛɛ wɔn, na hwɛ, na wɔayeyɛ mosomosoo.
Na ɔbisaa Farao apiafoɔ a wɔne no gu afiase wɔ ne wura fie no sɛ: Adɛn nti na nnɛ mo anim ayɛ bosabosaa sɛɛ?
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Yɛasoso daeɛ, nso obiara nni hɔ a ɔbɛkyerɛ aseɛ.
Na Yosef ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Nkyerɛaseɛ mfiri Onyankopɔn hɔ anaa?
Monka nkyerɛ me ɛ!
Ɛnna nsahyɛfoɔ panin no kaa ne daeɛ no kyerɛɛ Yosef sɛ: Me daeɛ mu no, na hwɛ, bobe bi si m’anim, na bobe no apae nkorabata mmiɛnsa, na ayɛ sɛdeɛ ɛrefefɛ, na anyini agu nhyerɛne, na abɔ esia ayɛ aba a abereɛ.
Na Farao kuruwa kura me, na metetee bobe aba no mekyi guu Farao kuruwa no mu, na mede kuruwa no hyɛɛ Farao nsa.
Na Yosef ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ne nkyerɛaseɛ nie: Nkorabata mmiɛnsa no yɛ nnansa.
Na aka nnansa na Farao ayi wo afiri ha de wo asane akɔdi wo dibea bio, na wode Farao kuruwa ahyɛ ne nsa sɛ kane a na woyɛ ne nsahyɛni no.
Nanso sɛ ɛyɛ a, kae me, na sɛ ɛsi wo yie a, yɛ me adɔeɛ, na bɔ me din kyerɛ Farao, na bɛyi me ɛdan yi mu, ɛfiri sɛ wia na wɔwiaa me Hebrifoɔ asase soɔ, na ɛha nso menyɛɛ hwee a anka ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde me bɛto amena yi mu.
Na paanootofoɔ panin no hunuu sɛ nkyerɛaseɛ no yɛ no, ɔka kyerɛɛ Yosef sɛ: Me nso, me daeɛ mu no, na hwɛ, paanoo nkɛntɛn mmiɛnsa a ɛsisi soɔ wɔ m’atifi.
Na kɛntɛn a ɛdi soro no mu na Farao anomu atɔduane nyinaa bi wɔ; na nnomaa redidi wɔ kɛntɛn no mu wɔ m’atifi.
Na Yosef buaa sɛ: Ne nkyerɛaseɛ nie: Nkyerɛnkyɛ mmiɛnsa no yɛ nnansa; na aka nnansa na Farao ayi wo afiri ha, na wakɔsɛne wo dua so ma nnomaa adi wo nam afiri wo ho.
Na da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa a ɛyɛ Farao awoda no, ɔtoo ne nkoa nyinaa pono, na ɔyii nsahyɛfoɔ panin ne paanootofoɔ mu panin no de wɔn baa ne nkoa anim; na ɔsane de nsahyɛfoɔ mu panin no sii ne nsahyɛ so bio a ɔde kuruwa hyɛ Farao nsa.
Na paanootofoɔ panin no deɛ, ɔsɛnee no, sɛdeɛ Yosef kyerɛɛ wɔn aseɛ no.
Nanso nsahyɛfoɔ panin no ankae Yosef, na ne werɛ firii no.
Yosef kyerɛ Farao daeɛ ase Na mfeɛ mmienu akyiri no, Farao soo daeɛ, na hwɛ, ɔgyina Nil asubɔnten no ho.
Na hwɛ, anantwibereɛ nson a wɔn ho yɛ fɛ na wɔn ho tua wɔn ho firi asubɔnten no mu ba bɛdidii ɛserɛ no mu.
Na hwɛ, anantwibereɛ nson foforɔ a wɔn ho yɛ tane na wɔafomfɔn nso firi asubɔnten no mu dii wɔn akyiri bae.
Na wɔbɛgyinaa anantwie nson no nkyɛn wɔ asubɔnten no nsunoa.
Na anantwie a wɔn ho yɛ tane na wɔafomfɔn no memenee nson a wɔn ho yɛ fɛ na wɔn ho tua wɔn ho no.
Na Farao nyanee.
Na ɔsane soo daeɛ bio, na hwɛ, ayuo mmɛtem nson a ɛtoatoa soɔ na abɔ ma refifiri wɔ nan korɔ so.
Na hwɛ, mmɛtem nson nkorowankorowa a apueeɛ mframa akusa no fifiri dii akyire bae.
Na mmɛtem nkorowankorowa no memenee mmɛtem nson a ɛtoatoa soɔ na ayuo wɔ mu no.
Na Farao nyanee, na hwɛ, ɛyɛ daeɛ.
Na anɔpa no ne ho dwanee no, na ɔsoma maa wɔkɔfrɛfrɛɛ Misraim atwerɛfoɔ nyinaa ne ɛhɔ anyansafoɔ nyinaa, na Farao kaa ne daeɛ no kyerɛɛ wɔn, nanso obiara antumi ankyerɛ no aseɛ.
Ɛnna nsahyɛfoɔ mu panin no ka kyerɛɛ Farao sɛ: Makae me mfomsoɔ nnɛ.
Berɛ a Farao bo fuu ne nkoa na ɔde me ne paanootofoɔ panin no kɔtoo afiase wɔ ankɔbeafoɔ panin fie no, yɛsosoo daeɛ anadwo korɔ no ara, me ne no na ɛsonsono yɛn daeɛ a yɛsosoeɛ ne ebiara nkyerɛaseɛ.
Na Hebrini aberanteɛ bi a ɔyɛ ankɔbeafoɔ panin no akoa ne yɛn na ɛwɔ hɔ, na yɛkekaa yɛn daeɛ kyerɛɛ no no, ɔkyerɛɛ yɛn yɛn daeɛ no ase, sɛdeɛ ebiara teɛ.
Na sɛdeɛ ɔkyerɛɛ yɛn aseɛ no, saa ara na ɛbaeɛ.
Wɔde me sane kɔdii me dibea, na ɔno deɛ, wɔsɛnee no.
Na Farao soma maa wɔkɔfrɛɛ Yosef, na wɔyɛɛ ntɛm yii no firii afiase hɔ; na ɔyii ne tirinwi, na ɔsakyeraa ne ntadeɛ, na ɔbaa Farao anim.
Na Farao ka kyerɛɛ Yosef sɛ: Maso daeɛ, nso obiara nni hɔ a ɔtumi kyerɛ aseɛ; na wo na mate wo nka sɛ, wote daeɛ a, wotumi kyerɛ aseɛ.
Na Yosef buaa Farao sɛ: Ɛnni me fam, na mmom Onyankopɔn na ɔmfa mmuaeɛ pa mma Farao.
Na Farao ka kyerɛɛ Yosef sɛ: Me daeɛ mu no, hwɛ, na megyina Asubɔntene Nil nsunoa.
Na hwɛ, anantwie nson a wɔn ho tua wɔn ho na wɔn ho yɛ fɛ firi nsuo no mu ba bɛdidii wɔ wiram hɔ.
Na hwɛ, anantwie nson foforɔ nso a wɔyɛ kanyaa na wɔn ho yɛ tane yie, na wɔafomfɔn a menhunuu wɔn ho tane no so bi wɔ Misraim asase nyinaa so da dii wɔn akyiri bae.
Na anantwie a wɔafomfɔn na wɔn ho yɛ tane no memenee kane anantwie nson a wɔadɔre no.
Na wɔduruu wɔn yafunu mu no, obi anhunu sɛ wɔaduru wɔn yafunu mu, na wɔn ho da so yɛ tane sɛ kane no ara.
Ɛnna menyaneeɛ.
Na mehunuu wɔ me daeɛ mu sɛ ayuo mmɛtem nson a ɛtoatoa soɔ na abɔ ma refifiri nan korɔ so.
Na hwɛ, mmɛtem nson a ahoa na ɛyɛ ntraantraa na apueeɛ mframa ama no akusa dii akyire fifirii.
Na mmɛtem ntraantraa no memenee mmɛtem nson a ɛyɛ no.
Na maka makyerɛ atwerɛfoɔ no, nso obiara antumi ankyerɛ me aseɛ.
Na Yosef ka kyerɛɛ Farao sɛ: Farao daeɛ no yɛ bafua; Onyankopɔn rekyerɛ Farao deɛ ɔrebɛyɛ.
Anantwie pa nson no yɛ mfeɛ nson, na mmɛtem nson pa no nso yɛ mfeɛ nson; ɛyɛ daeɛ korɔ.
Na anantwie nson a wɔafomfɔn a wɔn ho yɛ tane a wɔdii wɔn akyiri baeɛ no ne mmɛtem nson nkorowankorowa a apueeɛ mframa akusa no bɛyɛ mfirinhyia nson kɔm.
Asɛm no te sɛ deɛ maka makyerɛ Farao no ara.
Deɛ Onyankopɔn rebɛyɛ no na ɔde akyerɛ Farao yi: Hwɛ, mfirinhyia nson reba a aduane bebree bɛba Misraim asase nyinaa soɔ.
Na ɛno akyiri no, ɛkɔm bɛba mfirinhyia nson ama nnipa werɛ afiri aduane bebrebe no nyinaa wɔ Misraim asase so, na ɛkɔm no bɛhye asase no.
Na ɛkɔm a ɛbɛdi akyire no nti wɔrenhunu asase no so aduane bebrebe no bio, ɛfiri sɛ ɛkɔm no mu bɛyɛ dendeenden.
Na daeɛ no a ɛyɛɛ mmɔho mmienu maa Farao no ase ne sɛ, Onyankopɔn ahyɛ saa adeɛ no ampa, na Onyankopɔn rebɛyɛ no ntɛmntɛm.
Na afei ma Farao nhwehwɛ onipa a ɔyɛ ɔbadwemma ne onyansafoɔ mfa no nsi Misraim asase so.
Na Farao nyɛ yei, na ɔnsisi asase no so ahwɛfoɔ, na wɔnnyegye Misraim asase so aduane so ntotosoɔ nnum nnum mfeɛ nson a aduane bebree wɔ mu no mu.
Na ma wɔmmoaboa mfirinhyia pa a ɛrebɛba yi mu aduane nyinaa ano, na wɔmfa ayuo ngugu asan so sɛdeɛ Farao bɛhyɛ, na ɛnyɛ nkuro mu aduane, na wɔmfa nsie.
Na ayɛ aduane a wɔakora ama asase no de asie mfirinhyia nson kɔm a ɛbɛba Misraim asase soɔ no, na asase no ansɛe wɔ ɛkɔm no mu.
Yosef animuonyamhyɛ Na asɛm no sɔɔ Farao ne ne nkoa nyinaa ani.
Na Farao ka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa sɛ: Yɛbɛtumi anya onipa bi a ɔte sɛ oyi a Nyankopɔn honhom wɔ ne mu yi anaa?
Na Farao ka kyerɛɛ Yosef sɛ: Ɛnam sɛ Onyankopɔn de yei nyinaa akyerɛ woɔ yi, obiara nni hɔ a ɔyɛ ɔbadwemma ne onyansafoɔ sɛ woɔ.
Wobɛdi me fie so, na w’anomu asɛm so na me man nyinaa bɛdie, gye ahennwa nko so na mɛsene woɔ.
Na Farao ka kyerɛɛ Yosef sɛ: Hwɛ, mede wo masi Misraim asase nyinaa so.
Na Farao yii nsɔanokaa firii ne nsa de hyɛɛ Yosef nsa, na ɔhyɛɛ no nwera pa atadeɛ, na ɔde sika atweaban too ne kɔn mu.
Na ɔmaa no tenaa ne teaseɛnam a ɛtɔ so mmienu mu, na wɔteaa mu dii n’anim sɛ: Monkoto!
Na ɔde no sii Misraim asase nyinaa so.
Na Farao ka kyerɛɛ Yosef sɛ: Mene Farao, na obiara renkwati wo nyɛ biribiara wɔ Misraim asase nyinaa so.
Na Farao frɛɛ Yosef Safnat-panea.
Na ɔde On sɔfoɔ Potifera babaa Asnat maa no awareɛ.
Na Yosef kɔgyinaa Misraimhene Farao anim no, na wadi mfirinhyia aduasa.
Na Yosef firii Farao anim hɔ kɔkyinii Misraim asase nyinaa so.
Na ahotɔ mfeɛ nson no mu no, aduane pii baa asase no so maa no buu so.
Na ɔboaboaa mfeɛ nson a ɛbaa Misraim asase soɔ no mu aduane nyinaa ano, na ɔde aduane no siee nkuro no mu; nkuraa a atwa ahyia no mu aduane na ɔde siee nkuro no mu.
Na Yosef boaboaa ayuo ano pii pa ara sɛ mpoano anwea de kɔsii sɛ wɔgyaee kan, ɛfiri sɛ na ɛnni ano.
Na wɔwoo mma baanu maa Yosef ansa na ɛkɔm mfirinhyia no reduro; wɔn na On sɔfoɔ Potifera ba Asnat wo maa no.
Na Yosef too abakan no din Manase, ɛfiri sɛ ɔse: Onyankopɔn ama me werɛ afiri m’amaneɛ ne m’agya fie nyinaa.
Na ɔtoo deɛ ɔtɔ so mmienu no din Efraim, ɛfiri sɛ ɔse: Onyankopɔn ama madɔ wɔ m’amanehunu asase yi so.
Na ahotɔ a ɛbaa Misraim asase so mfeɛ nson no to twae.
Na ɛkɔm mfeɛ nson no firii aseɛ bae, sɛdeɛ Yosef kaeɛ no, na ɛkɔm baa nsase nyinaa so na Misraim asase nyinaa so deɛ, na aduane wɔ hɔ.
Na ɛberɛ a ɛkɔm kaa Misraim asase nyinaa no, na ɔman no kɔsu kɔm kyerɛ Farao.
Na Farao ka kyerɛɛ Misraim nyinaa sɛ: Monkɔ Yosef nkyɛn, deɛ ɔbɛka akyerɛ mo no, monyɛ.
Na ɛkɔm no baa asase no so nyinaa.
Na Yosef buebuee aduanekora adan no nyinaa, na ɔtɔnee aburoo maa Misraimfoɔ no, na ɛkɔm no mu yɛɛ den Misraim asase so.
Na aman nyinaa baa Misraim bɛtɔɔ aduane wɔ Yosef nkyɛn, ɛfiri sɛ ɛkɔm no mu yɛɛ den wɔ asase no nyinaa so.
Yakob soma ne mma aduanetɔ Na Yakob hunuu sɛ aduane wɔ Misraim no, ɔka kyerɛɛ ne mmammarima no sɛ: Adɛn na mohwehwɛ mo ho anim yi?
Na ɔse: Monhwɛ, mate sɛ aduane wɔ Misraim.
Monsiane nkɔ hɔ nkɔtɔ bi wɔ hɔ mmrɛ yɛn, na yɛntena ase, na yɛanwu.
Ɛnna Yosef nuanom mu du siane kɔɔ Misraim aduanetɔ.
Na Yosef nua Benyamin deɛ, Yakob ansoma no anka ne nuanom no ho ankɔ, na ɔse: Ebia na mmusuo bi ato no.
Na Israel mma no de wɔn ho fraa wɔn a wɔbaa aduanetɔ no mu, ɛfiri sɛ na ɛkɔm no aba Kanaan asase so bi.
Na Yosef ne asase no so tumfoɔ, ɔne deɛ ɔtɔn aduane ma asase no sofoɔ nyinaa.
Na Yosef nuanom ba bɛkotoo no de wɔn anim butubutuu fam.
Na Yosef ani bɔɔ ne nuanom no anim no, ɔhunuu wɔn, nanso ɔyɛɛ ne ho sɛ ɔnanani wɔ wɔn anim, na ɔpoopoo n’ani kasa kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ɛhe na mofiri baeɛ?
Na wɔse: Yɛfiri Kanaan asase so na yɛbaa aduanetɔ.
Na Yosef hunuu ne nuanom no; na wɔn deɛ, wɔanhu no.
Na Yosef kaee daeɛ a ɔsosoo no wɔn ho no; na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Moyɛ akwansrafoɔ, asase yi adagya na morebɛhwehwɛ.
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Dabi, me wura, na aduanetɔ na wo nkoa baeɛ.
Yɛn nyinaa yɛ ɔbarima baako mma, yɛyɛ anokwafoɔ, wo nkoa nyɛ akwansrafoɔ.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Dabi, na asase yi adagya na moreba abɛhwehwɛ.
Ɛnna wɔse: Wo nkoa yɛ anuanom dummienu.
Yɛyɛ ɔbarima baako mma wɔ Kanaan asase so, na hwɛ, ɔkaakyire no wɔ yɛn agya nkyɛn nnɛ, na ɔbaako deɛ ɔnni hɔ.
Ɛnna Yosef ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ ɛteɛ ara ne sɛ meka mekyerɛɛ mo sɛ: Moyɛ akwansrafoɔ.
Yei ho na mɛsɔ mo ahwɛ: Sɛ Farao te aseɛ yi, moremfiri ha nkɔ gye sɛ mo nua kumaa no ba ha ansa.
Monsoma mo mu baako, na ɔnkɔfa mo nua no mmra, na mo deɛ, mongu afiase na wɔnhwehwɛ mo nsɛm mu, sɛ nokorɛ wɔ mu a; anyɛ saa deɛ a, sɛ Farao te aseɛ yi, moyɛ akwansrafoɔ.
Na ɔde wɔn kɔguu afiase mu nnansa.
Na da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, Yosef ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monyɛ yei, na montena ase, na me deɛ, mesuro Onyankopɔn.
Sɛ moyɛ anokwafoɔ a, momma wɔnkyere mo nuanom yi mu baako ntena mo nnedua fie ha, na mo deɛ, ɛkɔm a ɛwɔ mo afie mu nti, monsoa aduane nkɔ.
Na momfa mo nua kumaa no mmrɛ me, na mo nsɛm ayɛ nokorɛ, na moanwu.
Na wɔyɛɛ saa.
Na wɔsesee wɔn ho wɔn ho sɛ: Ampa ara, yɛdi yɛn nua no ho fɔ, sɛ yɛhunuu n’ahohiahia, na ɔsrɛɛ yɛn mmɔborɔhunu, na yɛantie; enti na saa ɔhaw yi aba yɛn soɔ.
Na Ruben buaa wɔn sɛ: Manka ankyerɛ mo sɛ: Monnyɛ abɔfra no bɔne biara, na moantie?
Na hwɛ, ne mogya na wɔrehwehwɛ yi.
Na wɔnnim sɛ Yosef te, ɛfiri sɛ ɔkyeame na ɔdi wɔn ntam yi wɔn ano.
Na ɔdanee ne ho firii wɔn nkyɛn kɔsui.
Na ɔsane baa wɔn nkyɛn bio ne wɔn bɛkasae, na ɔyii Simeon wɔ wɔn mu, na ɔkyekyeree no wɔn anim hɔ ara.
Yosef nuanom sane kɔ Kanaan Ɛnna Yosef hyɛɛ sɛ wɔmfa aburoo nhyehyɛ wɔn nkotokuo mama, na wɔnnane wɔn mu biara dwetɛ nhyɛ ne kotokuo mu, na wɔmma wɔn akwan so aduane.
Na wɔyɛɛ wɔn saa.
Na wɔde wɔn aburoo no soasoaa wɔn mfunumu, na wɔfirii hɔ kɔe.
Na wɔn mu baako buee ne kotokuo ano sɛ ɔrema n’afunumu aduane wɔ asoɛeɛ no, ɔhunui, na hwɛ, na ne dwetɛ no hyɛ ne kotokuo ano.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne nuanom sɛ: Wɔadane me dwetɛ no ama me, na hwɛ, ɛhyɛ me kotokuo mu.
Na wɔn akoma tutui, na wɔde ahopopoɔ sesee wɔn ho wɔn ho sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na Onyankopɔn ayɛ yɛn yi?
Na wɔbaa wɔn agya Yakob nkyɛn Kanaan asase so, na wɔkaa deɛ ɛyɛɛ wɔn nyinaa kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɔbarima a ɔyɛ asase no wura no poopoo n’ani kasa kyerɛɛ yɛn, na ɔbuu yɛn asase no so akwansrafoɔ.
Na yɛsee no sɛ: Yɛyɛ anokwafoɔ, yɛnyɛ akwansrafoɔ.
Yɛyɛ yɛn agya mma anuanom dummienu, ɔbaako na ɔnni hɔ, na akumaa no wɔ yɛn agya nkyɛn wɔ Kanaan asase so seesei.
Na ɔbarima a ɔyɛ asase no wura no ka kyerɛɛ yɛn sɛ: Yei na mede bɛhunu sɛ moyɛ anokwafoɔ: Monnya mo nua baako wɔ me nkyɛn, na momfa aduane nkɔ nkɔhwɛ mo afiafi, na momfa mo nua kumaa no mmrɛ me, na mahunu sɛ monyɛ akwansrafoɔ, na moyɛ anokwafoɔ, na mayi mo nua no ama mo, na moadi asase yi so dwa.
Na ɛbaa sɛ wɔreyiyi wɔn nkotokuo mu adeɛ no, na hwɛ, wɔn mu biara dwetɛ boa hyɛ ne kotokuo mu.
Na wɔne wɔn agya hunuu wɔn dwetɛ mmoa no, wɔsuroe.
Na wɔn agya Yakob ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Moagye me nsam mma: Yosef nni hɔ, Simeon nni hɔ, na morebɛfa Benyamin nso akɔ.
Me so na yei nyinaa ba!
Na Ruben ka kyerɛɛ n’agya sɛ: Sɛ mamfa no mansane mammrɛ wo a, kum me mmammarima baanu.
Fa no hyɛ me nsa, na mede no bɛsane abrɛ wo.
Na ɔse: Me ba ne mo renkɔ, ɛfiri sɛ ne nua awu, na aka ɔno nko, na sɛ mmusuo bi kɔto no wɔ kwan a morekorɔ no mu a, ɛnneɛ mode me dwono bɛkɔ Asamando awerɛhoɔ mu.
Yosef nuanom ne Benyamin kɔ Misraim Na ɛkɔm no mu yɛɛ den wɔ asase no so.
Na wɔwiee aduane a wɔde firi Misraim baeɛ no die no, wɔn agya ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monsane nkɔtɔ aduane kakra mmrɛ yɛn.
Na Yuda ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɔbarima no hyɛɛ yɛn ketee sɛ: Sɛ mo nua no nka mo ho a, monnsi m’anim.
Na sɛ worema yɛn nua ne yɛn akɔ a, ɛnneɛ yɛbɛsiane akɔtɔ aduane abrɛ wo.
Na sɛ woremma no nkɔ a, ɛnneɛ yɛrensiane nkɔ hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔbarima no ka kyerɛɛ yɛn sɛ: Sɛ mo nua no nka mo ho a, monsi m’anim.
Na Israel kaa sɛ: Adɛn nti na moyɛ me bɔne seyie, sɛ moka kyerɛɛ ɔbarima no sɛ mowɔ nua bie?
Na wɔse: Bisa na ɔbarima no bisaa yɛn, yɛn ne yɛn abusua ho asɛm sɛ: Mo agya da so te ase anaa?
Mowɔ nua bi anaa?
Deɛ ɔbisabisaeɛ yi ara na yɛbuaeɛ.
Yɛbɛyɛ dɛn ahunu sɛ ɔbɛbisa yɛn sɛ: Momfa mo nua mmra?
Na Yuda ka kyerɛɛ n’agya Israel sɛ: Ma abɔfra no ne me nkɔ, na yɛnsim nkɔ, na yɛne wo ne yɛn mma atena ase, na yɛanwu.
Medi ne ho agyinamu; me nsam na hwehwɛ no.
Sɛ mamfa no mammrɛ wo ammɛgyina w’anim a, ɛnneɛ mayɛ wo bɔne daa nyinaa.
Sɛ yɛantwentwɛn a, anka sɛsɛɛ yɛakɔ aba mprenu.
Na wɔn agya Israel ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ ɛte saa a, ɛnneɛ monyɛ yei: Momfa asase yi so nnepa ngu mo adeɛ mu, na momfa ayɛyɛdeɛ nkɔma ɔbarima no, akyenkyennuro kakra, ɛwoɔ kakra, ohwam, kurobo, nkateɛ ne sorɔno aba nkɔma ɔbarima no.
Na momfa dwetɛ foforɔ nkura, ne dwetɛ a wɔdane maa mo wɔ mo nkotokuo ano no, monkura nsane nkɔ; ebia ɛyɛ anifasoɔ.
Na momfa mo nua no, na monsim nsane nkɔ ɔbarima no nkyɛn.
Na Onyankopɔn Tweaduampɔn mma ɔbarima no nhu mo mmɔbɔ, na ɔnnyaa mo nua no ne Benyamin mma mo.
Na me deɛ, me mma firi me nsa a, na wɔafiri me nsa!
Na mmarima no faa ayɛyɛdeɛ no, na wɔfaa dwetɛ mmɔho kurae ne Benyamin, na wɔsɔre siane kɔɔ Misraim kɔgyinaa Yosef anim.
Na Yosef hunuu Benyamin sɛ ɔka wɔn ho no, ɔka kyerɛɛ ne fie panin sɛ: Fa nnipa yi kɔ fie, na kum mmoa siesie yɛ aduane, na nnipa yi ne me rebɛdidi awia yi.
Na ɔbarima no yɛɛ sɛdeɛ Yosef kaeɛ no, na ɔde nnipa no kɔɔ Yosef fie.
Na nnipa no suroo sɛ wɔde wɔn akɔ Yosef fie, na wɔkaa sɛ: Dwetɛ a ɛsane kekaa yɛn nkotokuo mu kane no nti na wɔde yɛn aba ha yi, na wabɛtoa yɛn ato ahyɛ yɛn so afa yɛn ne yɛn mfunumu ayɛ nkoa.
Na wɔtwe pinii Yosef fie panin no ne no kasae wɔ efie no pono ano sɛ: Owura, yɛpa wo kyɛw, yɛsiane baa ha kane bɛtɔɔ aduane.
Na yɛkɔduruu asoɛeɛ na yɛsanesanee yɛn nkotokuo ano no, na hwɛ, yɛn nyinaa dwetɛ hyehyɛ yɛn nkotokuo ano, yɛn dwetɛ sɛdeɛ wɔkariiɛ no pɛ, na yɛkura de asane aba.
Nso yɛkura dwetɛ foforɔ aba de rebɛtɔ aduane.
Yɛnnim onii ko a ɔde yɛn dwetɛ no hyehyɛɛ yɛn nkotokuo no mu.
Na ɔse: Asomdwoeɛ nka mo, monnsuro.
Mo Nyankopɔn ne mo agya Nyankopɔn ama mo mo nkotokuo mu ademudeɛ, mo dwetɛ no kaa me nsa.
Na ɔyii Simeon brɛɛ wɔn.
Na ɔbarima no de nnipa no hyɛnee Yosef fie, na ɔmaa wɔn nsuo hohoroo wɔn nan ho, na ɔmaa wɔn mfunumu aduane.
Na wɔsiesiee ayɛyɛdeɛ no twɛn ba a Yosef bɛba awigyina no, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔate sɛ wɔrebɛdidi hɔ.
Na Yosef baa fie no, wɔde ayɛyɛdeɛ a wɔkura no kɔɔ ɛdan mu kɔmaa no, na wɔkotoo fam wɔ n’anim.
Na Yosef bisaa wɔn sɛ wɔn ho yɛ anaa; na ɔse: Mo agya akɔkoraa a mokaa ne ho asɛm no ho yɛ anaa?
Ɔda so te ase anaa?
Na wɔse: W’akoa, yɛn agya no ho yɛ, ɔda so te ase.
Na wɔbobɔɔ wɔn mu ase kotoo no.
Na ɔmaa n’ani so hunuu ne nua Benyamin, ne na ba no, ɔbisaa sɛ: Mo nua kumaa a mokaa me ne ho asɛm no ni anaa?
Na ɔse: Onyankopɔn nnom wo, me ba.
Na Yosef yɛɛ no ntɛm, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔnhunu deɛ ɔnyɛ wɔ ne nua no ho, na na ɔrehwehwɛ baabi akɔsu, na ɔhyɛnee ne pia mu kɔsuu wɔ hɔ.
Na ɔhohoroo n’anim, na ɔfirii adi, na ɔhyɛɛ ne ho so kaa sɛ: Momfa aduane mmɛsisi hɔ.
Na wɔde ne deɛ sii fa, na wɔde wɔn deɛ sisii fa, na wɔde Misraimfoɔ a wɔne no redidie no deɛ sisii fa, ɛfiri sɛ Misraimfoɔ ne Hebrifoɔ ntumi nnidi, na Misraimfoɔ kyi.
Na wɔbɛtenatenaa n’anim, ɔpanin sɛdeɛ ne panin teɛ, ne akumaa sɛdeɛ n’akumaa teɛ, na ɛyɛɛ nnipa no nyinaa nwanwa.
Na wɔgyegyee aduane no firii n’anim brɛɛ wɔn, na Benyamin deɛ boroo wɔn nyinaa deɛ so mprenum.
Na wɔnonnomee, na wɔne no ani gyee.
Yosef dwetɛ kuruwa Na Yosef hyɛɛ ne fie panin no sɛ: Fa aduane dodoɔ a wɔbɛtumi asoa hyehyɛ nnipa no nkotokuo mu amaama.
Fa wɔn mu biara dwetɛ hyɛ ne kotokuo ano, na fa me kuruwa, mekyerɛ dwetɛ kuruwa no, hyɛ akumaa no kotokuo ano ka n’aburoo dwetɛ no ho.
Na ɔyɛɛ sɛdeɛ Yosef kaeɛ no.
Adeɛ kyeeɛ ara pɛ, na wɔgyaa mmarima no ne wɔn mfunumu kwan.
Wɔfirii kuro no mu kɔeɛ na wɔnnya nnuruu akyirikyiri no, Yosef ka kyerɛɛ ne fie panin no sɛ: Sɔre, ti mmarima no, na sɛ woto wɔn a, ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Adɛn nti na mode bɔne tua papa ka?
Ɛnyɛ yei na me wura nom mu na ɔde yɛ ne nyankomadeɛ anaa?
Deɛ moayɛ yi, moayɛ bɔne.
Na ɔkɔtoo wɔn no, ɔkaa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ wɔn.
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Adɛn nti na me wura ka saa nsɛm yi?
Ɛmpare wo nkoa sɛ wɔbɛyɛ saa adeɛ yi.
Hwɛ, dwetɛ a yɛhunuu no yɛn nkotokuo ano no, yɛde asane afiri Kanaan asase so abrɛ wo; na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na yɛbɛwia wo wura fie dwetɛ anaa sika?
Wo nkoa yi mu deɛ wobɛhunu no ne nkyɛn no, ma no nwu, na yɛn nso yɛbɛyɛ me wura nkoa.
Na ɔse: Ɛnyɛ sɛdeɛ moseɛ no.
Na deɛ wɔbɛhunu no ne nkyɛn no nyɛ m’akoa, na mo deɛ, mobɛdi bem.
Ɛnna wɔn nyinaa yɛɛ ntɛm soɛsoɛɛ wɔn nkotokuo totoo fam, na wɔsanesanee wɔn nkotokuo ano.
Na ɔhwehwɛe, ɔfirii aseɛ firi ɔpanin no deɛ so de kɔsii akumaa no deɛ so.
Na wɔhunuu kuruwa no wɔ Benyamin kotokuo mu.
Ɛnna wɔsunsuanee wɔn ntadeɛ mu, na wɔde wɔn nnesoa soasoaa wɔn mfunumu sane kɔɔ kuro no mu.
Na Yuda ne ne nuanom baa Yosef fie, na ɔda so wɔ hɔ, na wɔhwehwee n’anim ase.
Na Yosef ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ɛdeɛn adeɛ na moayɛ yi?
Monnim sɛ onipa a ɔte sɛ me nim nkɔmhyɛ anaa?
Na Yuda kaa sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na yɛnse me wura?
Na ɛdeɛn na yɛnka?
Na yɛnyi yɛn ano sɛn?
Onyankopɔn ahunu wo nkoa amumuyɛ.
Hwɛ, yɛyɛ me wura nkoa, yɛne deɛ wɔhunuu ne nsam kuruwa no.
Na ɔse: Ɛmpare me sɛ meyɛ saa.
Na deɛ wɔhunuu kuruwa no wɔ ne nsa mu no, ɔno ara na ɔbɛyɛ m’akoa, na mo deɛ, monsim mfa asomdwoeɛ nkɔ mo agya nkyɛn.
Yuda srɛ ma Benyamin Ɛnna Yuda twe pinii no kaa sɛ: Me wura, mesrɛ wo, ma w’akoa nkasa me wura aso mu, na mma wo bo mmfu w’akoa, na wote sɛ Farao ara.
Me wura bisaa ne nkoa sɛ: Mowɔ agya anaa nua bi?
Na yɛka kyerɛɛ me wura sɛ: Yɛwɔ agya akɔkoraa ne ne nkɔkoraa ba kumaa bi.
Ne nua awu, na ne na ba a aka ara ne no, na n’agya dɔ no.
Na woka kyerɛɛ wo nkoa sɛ: Momfa no mmrɛ me, na memfa m’ani menhwɛ no.
Na yɛsee me wura sɛ: Abɔfra no ntumi nnya n’agya hɔ, na sɛ ɔgya n’agya hɔ a, n’agya bɛwu.
Na wosee wo nkoa sɛ: Sɛ mo nua kumaa no anka mo ho amma a, monnsi m’anim bio.
Na yɛkɔɔ w’akoa, m’agya, nkyɛn no, yɛkaa me wura nsɛm no kyerɛɛ no.
Na yɛn agya ka kyerɛɛ yɛn sɛ: Monsane nkɔtɔ aduane kakra mmrɛ yɛn.
Na yɛse: Yɛrentumi nsiane nkɔ.
Sɛ yɛn nua kumaa no ka yɛn ho a, yɛbɛsiane akɔ.
Yɛrentumi nkɔ ɔbarima no anim, gye sɛ yɛn nua kumaa no ka yɛn ho.
Ɛnna w’akoa, yɛn agya, ka kyerɛɛ yɛn sɛ: Mo ara monim sɛ mma baanu na me yere wo maa me.
Na ɔbaako firii me nkyɛn kɔe, na mese: Ampa ara teteɛ na wɔatete no mu, na ɛfiri hɔ no, menhunuu no.
Na sɛ mofa oyi nso firi me nkyɛn na mmusuo bi kɔto no a, mode me tiri dwono nam awerɛhoɔ mu na ɛbɛkɔ Asamando.
Na afei sɛ mekɔ w’akoa, m’agya, nkyɛn na abɔfra yi nka yɛn ho a, — nso n’akoma da abɔfra yi ho, — ɛbɛba sɛ, sɛ ɔhunu sɛ abɔfra yi nka yɛn ho a, ɔbɛwu, na wo nkoa de w’akoa, yɛn agya, dwono nam awerɛhoɔ mu na ɛbɛkɔ Asamando.
Na w’akoa dii abɔfra yi ho agyinamu wɔ m’agya anim sɛ: Sɛ mamfa no mammrɛ wo a, ɛnneɛ na mayɛ m’agya bɔne daa nyinaa.
Na afei mesrɛ wo, ma w’akoa ntena ha nsi abɔfra no ananmu nyɛ me wura akoa, na ma abɔfra no ne ne nuanom nkɔ.
Na sɛ abɔfra no nka me ho a, mɛkɔ m’agya anim sɛn?
Ɛnneɛ na merekɔhunu bɔne a ɛbɛto m’agya no.
Yosef yi ne ho adi kyerɛ ne nuanom Afei na Yosef ntumi nhyɛ ne ho so wɔ wɔn a wɔgyinagyina ne ho no nyinaa anim, na ɔteaa mu sɛ: Momma nnipa nyinaa mfiri me ho mfiri adi.
Na Yosef reyi ne ho adie akyerɛ ne nuanom no, na onipa biara nnyina ne nkyɛn.
Na ɔmaa ne nne so sui, na Misraimfoɔ no ne Farao fiefoɔ tee.
Na Yosef ka kyerɛɛ ne nuanom sɛ: Mene Yosef, m’agya da so te ase anaa?
Na ne nuanom antumi ammua no, na mmom wɔn ho dwirii wɔn wɔ n’anim.
Na Yosef ka kyerɛɛ ne nuanom sɛ: Montwe mpini me.
Na wɔtwe pinii no.
Na ɔse: Mene mo nua Yosef a motɔn no baa Misraim no.
Na afei mommma no nnyɛ mo ya, nso mo bo mmfu mo ho mo ho sɛ motɔn me baa ha, ɛfiri sɛ nkwagyeɛ nti na Onyankopɔn somaa me dii mo anim.
Na mfeɛ mmienu ni a ɛkɔm aba asase yi soɔ, na aka mfeɛ nnum bio a funtum ne otwa nni mu.
Na Onyankopɔn somaa me dii mo anim sɛ memma monnya nkaeɛ wɔ asase so, na mennye mo nkwa a ɛbɛma dodoɔ no ara afiri mu afire.
Na afei ɛnyɛ mo na mosomaa me baa ha, na mmom Onyankopɔn na ɔde me abɛyɛ sɛ Farao n’agya ne ne fie nyinaa wura ne Misraim asase nyinaa sodifoɔ.
Monyɛ ntɛm nkɔ m’agya nkyɛn nkɔka nkyerɛ no sɛ: Sɛ wo ba Yosef seɛ nie: Onyankopɔn de me ayɛ Misraim nyinaa so wura.
Siane bra me nkyɛn.
Nkyɛ!
Na bɛtena Gosen asase so, na woabɛn me, wo ne wo mma ne wo nananom ne wo nnwan ne w’anantwie ne deɛ wowɔ nyinaa, na mɛhwɛ wo wɔ hɔ, ɛfiri sɛ mfeɛ nnum kɔm da so reba, na ohia anhia wo ne wo fiefoɔ ne deɛ wowɔ nyinaa.
Na hwɛ, mo ani ahunu, na me nua Benyamin nso ani ahunu sɛ m’ano na mede mekasa mekyerɛ mo yi.
Na monka m’animuonyam a mewɔ wɔ Misraim nyinaa nkyerɛ m’agya ne deɛ moahunu nyinaa, na monyɛ ntɛm mfa m’agya nsiane mmra ha.
Ɛnna ɔsɔɔ ne nua Benyamin kɔn mu na ɔsuiɛ; na Benyamin nso sui wɔ ne kɔn ho.
Na ɔfefee ne nuanom nyinaa ano, na ɔsuu wɔ wɔn so, na ɛno akyiri no ne nuanom no ne no kasae.
Na wɔtee nka wɔ Farao fie sɛ: Yosef nuanom aba.
Na ɛsɔɔ Farao ne ne nkoa ani.
Na Farao ka kyerɛɛ Yosef sɛ: Ka kyerɛ wo nuanom sɛ: Yei na monyɛ: Momfa nnoɔma nsoasoa mo mmoa no, na monkɔ Kanaan asase so nkɔfa mo agya ne mo fiefoɔ mmra me nkyɛn, na mɛma mo Misraim asase so deɛ ɛyɛ, na moadi asase no sradeɛ.
Ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Yei na monyɛ.
Momfa nteaseɛnam mfiri Misraim asase so nkɔma mo mma ne mo yerenom, na monkɔfa mo agya mmra.
Na mo nso monnwennwene mo nnoɔma ho, na Misraim asase nyinaa so deɛ ɛyɛ yɛ mo dea.
Na Israel mma no yɛɛ saa.
Na Yosef maa wɔn nteaseɛnam sɛdeɛ Farao anomu asɛm seɛ, na ɔmaa wɔn akwansoduane.
Ɔmaa wɔn nyinaa ntadeɛ nsakyeraho mmaako mmaako, na Benyamin deɛ, ɔmaa no nnwetɛbena ahasa ne ntadeɛ nsakyeraho nnum.
Na deɛ ɔde kɔmaa n’agya nso nie: Mfunumu du a wɔsoso Misraim nnepa no bie ne mfunumubereɛ du a wɔsoso aburoo ne paanoo ne akwansoduane a ɛbɛyɛ n’agya dea.
Na ɔgyaa ne nuanom kwan maa wɔkɔe.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Mo bo nnkɔfu mo ho mo ho wɔ ɔkwan so oo!
Yakob ho sane no Ɛnna wɔfirii Misraim foro kɔɔ Kanaan asase so wɔn agya Yakob nkyɛn, na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Yosef da so te ase, na ɔdi Misraim asase nyinaa so.
Na ne tirim yɛɛ no naa, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔnnye wɔn nni.
Na wɔkaa nsɛm a Yosef aka akyerɛ wɔn no nyinaa kyerɛɛ no, na ɔhunuu nteaseɛnam a Yosef asoma de rebɛfa no no, wɔn agya Yakob ho sanee no.
Na Israel kaa sɛ: Ɛdɔɔso, me ba Yosef da so te ase.
Mɛkɔ makɔhu no ansa na mawu.
Yakob ne ne fiefoɔ kɔ Misraim Na Israel ne deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa sii mu, na ɔduruu Beer-seba, na ɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ maa n’agya Isak Nyankopɔn.
Na Onyankopɔn nam anadwo anisoadehunu mu ka kyerɛɛ Israel sɛ: Yakob, Yakob!
Na ɔse: Menie.
Na ɔse: Mene Onyankopɔn, w’agya Nyankopɔn no.
Nsuro sɛ wobɛsiane akɔ Misraim, na mɛyɛ wo ɔman kɛseɛ wɔ hɔ.
Me ne wo bɛsiane akɔ Misraim, na mede wo asane aba nso, na Yosef deɛ, ne nsa so na wo bɛwuo.
Na Yakob sii mu firii Beer-seba; na Israel mma de wɔn agya Yakob ne wɔn mma ne wɔn yerenom tenatenaa nteaseɛnam a Farao soma maa wɔde kɔfaa no no mu.
Na wɔfaa wɔn mmoa ne wɔn ahodeɛ a wɔanya wɔ Kanaan asase soɔ no kɔɔ Misraim, Yakob ne n’asefoɔ nyinaa, ne mmammarima ne ne mmammarima mma ne ne mmammaa ne ne mmammarima mmammaa ne n’asefoɔ nyinaa, na ɔne wɔn kɔɔ Misraim.
Na yeinom ne Israel mma a wɔkɔɔ Misraim no din, Yakob ne ne mma: Yakob abakan Ruben.
Na Ruben mmammarima ne: Hanok, Palu, Hesron ne Karmi.
Na Simeon mmammarima ne: Yemuel, Yamin, Ohad, Yakin, Sohar ne Kanaanni baa ba Saulo.
Na Lewi mmammarima ne: Gerson, Kohat ne Merari.
Na Yuda mmammarima ne: Er, Onan, Sela, Peres ne Sera; (na Er ne Onan wuu Kanaan asase so.)
Na Peres mmammarima ne: Hesron ne Hamul.
Na Isakar mmammarima ne: Tola, Puwa, Hiob ne Simron.
Na Sebulon mmammarima ne: Sered, Elon ne Yakleel.
(Yeinom ne Lea mmammarima a ɔwo maa Yakob wɔ Mesopotamia ne ne babaa Dina, ne mmammarima ne ne mmammaa nyinaa yɛ akra aduasa mmiɛnsa.)
Na Gad mmammarima ne: Sifion, Hagi, Suni, Esbon, Eri, Arodi ne Areli.
Aser mmammarima ne: Yimna, Isua, Isui, Beria ne wɔn nuabaa Sera.
Na Beria mmammarima ne: Heber ne Malkiel.
(Yeinom ne Silpa a Laban de no maa ne babaa Lea no mma a ɔwo maa Yakob, wɔyɛ akra dunsia.)
Yakob yere Rahel mmammarima ne: Yosef ne Benyamin.
Na Yosef mma a On sɔfoɔ Potifera babaa Asnat wo maa no Misraim asase soɔ ne: Manase ne Efraim.
Na Benyamin mmammarima ne: Bela, Beker, Asbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Ros, Mupim, Hupim ne Ard.
(Yeinom ne Rahel mma a wɔwo maa Yakob, akra no nyinaa yɛ dunan.)
Na Dan babarima ne: Husim.
Na Naftali mmammarima ne: Yahseel, Guni, Yeser ne Silem.
(Yeinom ne Bilha a Laban de no maa ne ba Rahel no mma a ɔwo maa Yakob, akra no nyinaa yɛ baason).
Akra a wɔne Yakob kɔɔ Misraim a wɔfiri n’asene mu, Yakob mma yerenom mfram, akra no nyinaa yɛ aduosia nsia.
Na Yosef mma a wɔwoo wɔn Misraim no yɛ akra baanu.
Yakob fie akra a wɔbaa Misraim no nyinaa yɛ aduɔson.
Yakob ne ne fiefoɔ kɔ Misraim Na ɔsomaa Yuda dii n’anim kɔɔ Yosef nkyɛn sɛ ɔmmɛdi n’anim nkyerɛ no Gosen kwan.
Na wɔduruu Gosen asase so.
Na Yosef siesiee ne nteaseɛnam kɔhyiaa n’agya Israel wɔ Gosen.
Na ɔde ne ho kɔkyerɛɛ no no, ɔsɔɔ ne kɔn mu, na ɔsui ara kyɛree wɔ ne kɔn ho.
Na Israel ka kyerɛɛ Yosef sɛ: Afei a manya mahunu w’anim sɛ woda so te aseɛ yi, wɔmma menti nananom wɔ asamando.
Na Yosef ka kyerɛɛ ne nuanom ne n’agya fiefoɔ sɛ: Merekɔ makɔka akyerɛ Farao sɛ: Me nuanom ne m’agya fiefoɔ a wɔwɔ Kanaan asase soɔ no aba me nkyɛn.
Na nnipa no yɛ nnwanhwɛfoɔ, na mmoa na wɔyɛne, na wɔde wɔn nnwan ne wɔn anantwie ne deɛ wɔwɔ nyinaa aba.
Na sɛ Farao bɛfrɛ mo, na ɔbisa mo sɛ: Mo adwuma ne sɛn a?
Monse no sɛ: Wo nkoa yɛ mmoahwɛfoɔ firi yɛn mmɔfraase de bɛsi nnɛ, yɛn ne yɛn nananom, na moatena Gosen asase so, ɛfiri sɛ Misraimfoɔ kyiri mmoahwɛfoɔ nyinaa.
Yosef de n’agya ne ne nuanom mu bi kɔkyea Farao Na Yosef kɔka kyerɛɛ Farao sɛ: M’agya ne me nuanom ne wɔn nnwan ne wɔn anantwie ne deɛ wɔwɔ nyinaa firi Kanaan asase so aba, na hwɛ, wɔwɔ Gosen asase so.
Na ɔde ne nuanom mu baanum kɔgyinaa Farao anim.
Na Farao bisaa ne nuanom no sɛ: Mo adwuma ne sɛn?
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wo nkoa yɛ mmoahwɛfoɔ, yɛn ne yɛn nananom nso.
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ Farao bio sɛ: Yɛaba sɛ yɛrebɛtena asase yi so, ɛfiri sɛ wo nkoa nnya adidibea mma wɔn nnwan, ɛfiri sɛ ɛkɔm no mu yɛ den wɔ Kanaan asase so.
Enti afei yɛsrɛ wo, ma wo nkoa ntena Gosen asase so.
Na Farao ka kyerɛɛ Yosef sɛ: W’agya ne wo nuanom aba wo nkyɛn.
Misraim asase na ɛda w’anim yi, asase no mu deɛ ɛyɛ no, ma w’agya ne wo nuanom ntena hɔ.
Ma wɔntena Gosen asase so.
Na sɛ wonim sɛ wɔn mu bi yɛ nsiyɛfoɔ a, fa wɔn si me mmoa a mewɔ so.
Na Yosef de n’agya Yakob kɔgyinaa Farao anim.
Na Yakob hyiraa Farao.
Na Farao bisaa Yakob sɛ: Wo nkwa mu mfirinhyia yɛ ahe?
Na Yakob ka kyerɛɛ Farao sɛ: Me hɔhobea asetena mfirinhyia mu nna yɛ mfeɛ ɔha aduasa; me nkwa mfirinhyia mu nna yɛ kakraa bi ne amaneɛ nko, ɛnnuru me nananom nkwa mfirinhyia mu nna wɔ wɔn hɔhobea asetena nna mu.
Na Yakob hyiraa Farao, na ɔfirii Farao anim kɔe.
Na Yosef maa n’agya ne ne nuanom tenaberɛ, na ɔmaa wɔn asase wɔ Misraim wɔ deɛ asase no yɛ, wɔ Rameses asase so, sɛdeɛ Farao hyɛeɛ no.
Na Yosef bɔɔ n’agya ne ne nuanom ne n’agya fiefoɔ nyinaa akɔnhoma, sɛdeɛ abusua biara dodoɔ teɛ.
Ɛkɔm no Na aduane nni asase biara so, na ɛkɔm no mu yɛɛ den yie maa Misraim asase ne Kanaan asase tɔɔ ɛkɔm no anim piti.
Na Yosef prapraa sika a ɛwɔ Misraim asase ne Kanaan asase soɔ nyinaa wɔ aburoo a wɔbɛtɔeɛ no mu, na Yosef de sika no kɔɔ Farao fie.
Na sika saa Misraimfoɔ ne Kanaanfoɔ ho no, Misraimfoɔ nyinaa baa Yosef nkyɛn sɛ: Ma yɛn aduane ɛ!
Adɛn na sɛ sika asa nti, yɛnwuwu w’anim?
Na Yosef se: Momfa mo mmoa mmra, na sɛ mo sika asa a, mɛma mo bi magye mo mmoa.
Na wɔde wɔn mmoa bae, na Yosef maa wɔn aduane gyegyee apɔnkɔ, nnwan, anantwie ne mfunumu.
Na ɔmaa wɔn aduane de gyee wɔn mmoa nyinaa afirinhyia no.
Na afe no twaa mu no, afe a ɛdi soɔ no, wɔbaa ne nkyɛn bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Yɛremfa nhunta me wura sɛ yɛn sika asa na mmoa akuakuo no yɛ me wura dea, na biribiara nkae wɔ me wura anim sɛ yɛn honam ne yɛn asase nko.
Adɛn nti na yɛn ne yɛn asase nwu w’anim?
Tɔ yɛn ne yɛn asase, na ma yɛn aduane, na yɛde yɛn ho ne yɛn asase bɛsom Farao.
Ma yɛn aduaba, na yɛntena ase, na yɛanwu amma asase yi anna mpan.
Na Yosef tɔɔ Misraim asase nyinaa maa Farao.
Na Misraimfoɔ nyinaa tontɔnee wɔn mfuo, ɛfiri sɛ ɛkɔm no denee wɔn, na asase no danee Farao dea.
Na nkurɔfoɔ no deɛ, ɔdanee wɔn nkoa, ɛfiri Misraim hyeɛ so kɔsi hyeɛ so.
Gye asɔfoɔ nsase nko na wantɔ, ɛfiri sɛ na Farao ahyɛ kyɛfa bi ama asɔfoɔ no, na wɔdi wɔn kyɛfa a Farao de ma wɔn no nti, wɔantɔn wɔn asase.
Na Yosef ka kyerɛɛ nkurɔfoɔ no sɛ: Monhwɛ, ɛnnɛ matɔ mo ne mo asase mama Farao, na hwɛ, mo aduaba a momfa nkɔdua asase no soɔ nie.
Na deɛ ɛbɛsoɔ no, momfa nkyekyɛmu nnum mu baako mma Farao, na emu abupɛn nnan no nyɛ mo dea, na mode bi adua mfuo mu, na mode bi ayɛ mo ne mo fiefoɔ ne mo mma aduane.
Na wɔse: Woagye yɛn nkwa; ma yɛnnya me wura anim adom ara, na yɛbɛyɛ Farao nkoa.
Na Yosef hyɛɛ yei ho mmara wɔ Misraim a ɛwɔ hɔ de bɛsi nnɛ, sɛ wɔmfa Misraim asase so adeɛ biara nkyekyɛmu nnum mu baako mma Farao, gye asɔfoɔ asase nko na anyɛ Farao dea.
Yakob adesrɛ a ɛtwa toɔ Na Israel tenaa Misraim asase so wɔ Gosen, na wɔnyaa mu adeɛ, na wɔdɔree, na wɔn ase trɛɛ pa ara.
Na Yakob tenaa Misraim asase so mfeɛ dunson, na Yakob nna, ne nkwa mfirinhyia, yɛ mfeɛ ɔha aduanan nson.
Na Israel nna duruu sɛ ɔbɛwuo no, ɔfrɛɛ ne ba Yosef ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ manya w’anim adom a, fa wo nsa ka m’asene mu, na yɛ me adɔeɛ di me nokorɛ, na nsie me Misraim!
Ɛda a mɛtoa nananom no, soa me firi Misraim kɔsie me wɔ me nananom amusieeɛ.
Na ɔbuaa sɛ: Mɛyɛ sɛdeɛ woaka yi.
Na ɔse: Ka me ntam.
Na ɔkaa no ntam.
Na Israel bɔɔ ne mu ase kyerɛɛ mpa no atifi.
Yakob hyira Efraim ne Manase Na nsɛm yi akyiri no, wɔka kyerɛɛ Yosef sɛ: Hwɛ, w’agya yare.
Na ɔfaa ne mmabarima baanu, Manase ne Efraim kaa ne ho.
Na wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ Yakob sɛ: Hwɛ, wo ba Yosef reba wo nkyɛn.
Na Israel miaa n’ani tenaa ne mpa so.
Na Yakob ka kyerɛɛ Yosef sɛ: Onyankopɔn Tweaduampɔn yii ne ho kyerɛɛ me wɔ Lus a ɛwɔ Kanaan asase soɔ, na ɔhyiraa me ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Hwɛ, mɛma woadɔ, na mama woadɔɔso, mɛyɛ wo aman asafo, na mede asase yi bɛma w’asefoɔ a wɔbɛdi w’akyire no sɛ daa agyapadeɛ.
Na afei wo mma baanu a wowoo wɔn wɔ Misraim asase soɔ ansa na mereba wo nkyɛn wɔ Misraim no, wɔnyɛ me dea.
Efraim ne Manase nyɛ me dea te sɛ Ruben ne Simeon.
Na wo mma a wobɛnya wɔn wɔ wɔn akyiri no na ɛnyɛ wo dea, na wɔde wɔn nuanom din bɛfrɛ wɔn wɔ wɔn agyapadeɛ mu.
Na me deɛ, mefiri Padan baeɛ no, Rahel wui m’anim wɔ Kanaan asase so wɔ kwan mu, na aka kwantiaa bi na wɔaduru Efrat, na mesiee no hɔ wɔ Efrat (a ɛne Betlehem) no kwan nkyɛn.
Na Israel hunuu Yosef mma no, ɔkaa sɛ: Hwannom nie?
Na Yosef ka kyerɛɛ n’agya sɛ: Ɛyɛ me mma a Onyankopɔn de ama me wɔ ha yi.
Ɛnna ɔse: Fa wɔn brɛ me ɛ ma menhyira wɔn.
Na enyini nti, na Israel ani so ayɛ no kusukusu a ɔnhunu adeɛ yie.
Na ɔde wɔn pinii ne nkyɛn; na ɔfee wɔn ano yɛɛ wɔn atuu.
Na Israel ka kyerɛɛ Yosef sɛ: Mansusu sɛ mɛhunu w’anim, na hwɛ, Onyankopɔn ama mahunu wo mma nso.
Na Yosef yii wɔn firii Yakob nantam, na ɔponoo ne mu de n’anim butuu fam.
Na Yosef faa wɔn baanu nyinaa de ne nifa sɔɔ Efraim mu de no kyerɛɛ Israel benkum, de ne benkum sɔɔ Manase mu de no kyerɛɛ Israel nifa, na ɔde wɔn pinii ne nkyɛn.
Na Israel tenee ne nifa too Efraim a ɔyɛ akumaa no atifi, ne ne benkum too Manase atifi, ɔboapa na ɔyɛɛ ne nsa saa, ɛfiri sɛ Manase ne abakan.
Na ɔhyiraa Yosef sɛ: Onyankopɔn a me nananom Abraham ne Isak nantee n’anim no, Onyankopɔn a wayɛne me me nkwa nna nyinaa de abɛsi nnɛ.
Ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔyii me bɔne nyinaa mu no, nhyira mmɔfra yi, na wɔmfa me din ne me nananom Abraham ne Isak din mfrɛ wɔn, na wɔnnɔɔso nyɛ pii wɔ asase so.
Na Yosef hunuu sɛ n’agya de ne nsa nifa ato Efraim atifi no, anyɛ no dɛ, na ɔsɔɔ n’agya nsa sɛ ɔnyi mfiri Efraim atifi nkɔto Manase atifi.
Na Yosef ka kyerɛɛ n’agya sɛ: M’agya, ɛnyɛ sɛ ɛteɛ ne no, na oyi ne abakan, fa wo nifa to n’atifi.
Na n’agya ampene, na ɔse: Menim, me ba, menim; ɔno nso bɛyɛ ɔman, na ɔno nso ayɛ kɛse, nanso ne nua kumaa no bɛso asene no, na n’asefoɔ bɛyɛ aman pii.
Na ɛda no ɔhyiraa wɔn sɛ: Wo na Israel de wo bɛhyira sɛ: Onyankopɔn nyɛ wo sɛ Efraim ne Manase.
Na ɔde Efraim dii Manase kan. Na Israel ka kyerɛɛ Yosef sɛ: Hwɛ, merewu, na Onyankopɔn bɛdi mo akyi, na ɔde mo asane akɔ mo nananom asase so.
Na me deɛ, mama wo asase kɛseɛ bi a ɛboro wo nuanom deɛ soɔ a mede me nkrantɛ ne me tadua megyee no Amorifoɔ nsam.
Yakob hyira ne mma Na Yakob frɛɛ ne mma sɛ: Mommoaboa mo ano, na menka mo deɛ ɛbɛyɛ mo, nna a ɛdi akyire no mu.
Yakob mma, monhyia na montie, montie mo agya Israel!
Ruben, m’abakan ne wo; m’ahoɔden ne me mmaninyɛ asefire.
Woboro so anidie mu, woboro so tumi mu.
Wohinhim sɛ nsuo, enti wo kandie bɛfiri wo nsa, ɛfiri sɛ woforoo w’agya nnaeɛ.
Ɛno mu na woguu ɛho fi, — me mpa na woforoeɛ!
Simeon ne Lewi yɛ anuanom.
Wɔn nkrantɛ yɛ aniɛden akodeɛ.
Me kra, nnkɔ wɔn agyina mu, na m’animuonyam nkɔfra wɔn asafo mu.
Ɛfiri sɛ wɔn abufuo mu na wɔkum nnipa, na wɔn ahokyerɛ mu na wɔsɛee anantwie.
Wɔadome wɔn abufuo, sɛ ɛso, ne wɔn anibereɛ, sɛ emu yɛ den.
Mɛkyekyɛ wɔn mu wɔ Yakob mu, na mabɔ wɔn ahwete Israel mu.
Yuda, wo na wo nuanom bɛyi wo ayɛ; wo nsa bɛtia w’atamfo kɔn so; w’agya mma bɛkoto w’anim.
Gyata ba ne Yuda; hanam so na wode anyini, me ba.
Ɔkotoe, ɔbutuu sɛ gyata ne gyatabereɛ; hwan na ɔbɛhwanyan no?
Ahempoma remfiri Yuda nsa, na mmarahyɛ poma remfiri ne nan ntam de kɔsi sɛ ɛsodifoɔ a aman bɛyɛ setie ama no no bɛba.
Ɔsa n’afunumu ba wɔ bobe mu, ne n’afunumu bereɛ ba wɔ bobe pa mu.
Ɔsi n’atadeɛ wɔ nsa mu, ne ne ntoma wɔ bobe aba mogya mu.
Bobesa bɛma n’ani ayɛ kɔɔ, na nufosuo ama ne se ayɛ fitaa.
Sebulon tenabea bɛkyerɛ mpoano, na wahwɛ deɛ ahyɛn gyinagyina, na ɔne Sidon abɔ hyeɛ.
Isakar yɛ afunumu hoɔdenfoɔ, ɔbutu mmoaban ntam; na ɔhunu sɛ homebea no yɛ ne asase no sɛ ɛyɛ fɛ, na ɔbrɛ ne mmatiri ase de gye adesoa, na ɔde ɛsom adwuma ayi toɔ.
Dan bɛbu ne nkurɔfoɔ atɛn sɛ Israel mmusuakuo mu biara.
Dan bɛyɛ ɔkwan so ɔwɔ, tempɔn so ahuritia.
Ɔka ɔpɔnkɔ nantin, na ne so tenafoɔ ahwe n’akyi.
AWURADE, wo nkwagyeɛ na mehwɛ no kwan.
Gad, asafo bi retoa no, na ɔno nso atoa wɔn aka wɔn nantin.
Aser aduane bɛyɛ sradeduane, na ɔbɛma ahennuane a ɛyɛ akɔnnɔ.
Naftali yɛ ɔforoteɛ a wɔato no sraha; ɔka nsɛm dɛdɛ.
Yosef yɛ dua a ɛso aba mman, dua a ɛso aba wɔ nsuo aniwa soɔ mman; ne mman tratra ɔfasuo.
Mmɛmmatofoɔ hyɛɛ no yea, wɔtotoo no, na wɔtaa no.
Nanso na ne tadua kura no pintinn, na ne basa mu yɛɛ den.
Ɛfiri Yakob Tumfoɔ no nsam, ɛfiri ɔhwɛfoɔ a ɔyɛ Israel botan no mu.
Ɛfiri w’agya Nyankopɔn, ɔmmoa wo, na ɛfiri Tweaduampɔn hɔ, ɔnhyira wo.
Ɔmfa ɔsorosoro nhyira, ne ebunu a ɛtrɛtrɛ aseɛ mu nhyira, ne nufoɔ ne yafunu mu nhyira nhyira wo.
W’agya nhyira a ɛyɛ kɛseɛ boro daa daa mmepɔ no nhyira a ɛkɔduru tete nteredee nkokoɔ no ahyeɛso nohoa; ɛmmra Yosef atifi, deɛ wɔyii no firii ne nuanom mu no mpampam.
Benyamin yɛ pataku a ɔtete mmoa mu; ɔdi hanam anɔpa, na anwummerɛ nso ɔkyɛ asadeɛ mu.
Yeinom nyinaa ne Israel mmusuakuo dummienu no, na yei ne deɛ wɔn agya ka kyerɛɛ wɔn de hyiraa wɔn.
Sɛdeɛ wɔn nhyira teɛ mmaako mmaako na ɔhyiraa wɔn.
Yakob wuo ne ne sie Na ɔhyɛɛ wɔn ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Aka kumaa bi na maka m’ani agu so.
Monkɔsie me me nananom nkyɛn, wɔ ɔbodan a ɛwɔ Hetini Efron afuo mu no mu, ɔbodan a ɛwɔ Makpela afuo soɔ Mamre ntentensoɔ wɔ Kanaan asase so, asase a Abraham tɔeɛ wɔ Hetini Efron nkyɛn de yɛɛ amusieeɛ no mu.
Ɛhɔ na wɔsiee Abraham ne ne yere Sara, ɛhɔ na wɔsiee Isak ne ne yere Rebeka, na ɛhɔ na mesiee Lea.
Afuo no ne ɔbodan a ɛwɔ mu no, wɔtɔɔ no Het mma nsam.
Na Yakob hyɛɛ ne mma nsamanseɛ wieeɛ no, ɔboaa ne nan ano guu mpa no so, na ɔguu n’ahome a ɛdi akyire, na ɔtii ne nananom wɔ asamando.
Na Yosef de n’anim kɔbutuu n’agya anim, na ɔsu guu ne so, na ɔfee n’ano.
Na Yosef hyɛɛ ne nkoa a wɔhyɛ amu aduro sɛ wɔnhyɛ n’agya mu aduro.
Na wɔhyɛɛ Israel mu aduro.
Na wɔdii ho adaduanan, nna a wɔde wie adurohyɛ no ne no.
Na Misraimfoɔ suu no adaduɔson.
Na nna a wɔde suu no no twaa mu no, Yosef ka kyerɛɛ Farao fiefoɔ sɛ: Sɛ manya adom wɔ mo anim a, monkɔyi Farao asotire sɛ: M’agya maa mekaa no ntam sɛ: Hwɛ, merewu, na ɛda a mabɔ no Kanaan asase so mafa no mu, ɛhɔ na kɔsie me.
Enti afei ma menkɔ menkɔsie m’agya, na mensane memmra.
Na Farao kaa sɛ: Kɔ, na kɔsie w’agya, sɛdeɛ ɔmaa wokaa ntam no.
Na Yosef kɔɔ sɛ ɔrekɔsie n’agya; na Farao nkoa nyinaa, ne fie mpanimfoɔ ne Misraim asase so mpanimfoɔ nyinaa ne Yosef fiefoɔ nyinaa ne ne nuanom ne n’agya fiefoɔ kaa ne ho kɔe, gye wɔn mma ne wɔn nnwan ne wɔn anantwie na wɔgyaa wɔn Gosen asase no soɔ.
Na nteaseɛnam ne apɔnkɔsotefoɔ ne no kɔe; na ɛyɛ dɔm kɛseɛ.
Na wɔduruu Atad ayuporebea a ɛwɔ Yordan agya nohoa no, wɔtwaa kwadwom kɛseɛ a emu yɛ den wɔ hɔ, na ɔgyam n’agya nnanson.
Na ɛhɔfoɔ, Kanaanfoɔ no, hunuu esu a wɔsuu no Atad ayuporebea hɔ no, wɔkaa sɛ: Yei deɛ, Misraimfoɔ ayie a emu yɛ den nie.
Enti wɔfrɛ hɔ sɛ Abel-misraim ɛwɔ Yordan agya nohoa.
Na ne mma yɛɛ no sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ wɔn no.
Na ne mma soaa no kɔɔ Kanaan asase so kɔsiee no wɔ Makpela afuo so ɔbodan a ɛwɔ Mamre ntentensoɔ a Abraham tɔɔ ɛne afuo no wɔ Hetini Efron nkyɛn de yɛɛ asieeɛ no mu.
Na Yosef siee n’agya wieeɛ no, ɔne ne nuanom ne wɔn a wɔne no kɔsiee n’agya no nyinaa sane baa Misraim.
Yosef ma ne nuanom awerɛhyɛmu Na Yosef nuanom hunuu sɛ wɔn agya awuo no, wɔkaa sɛ: Ebia Yosef bɛtane yɛn, na watua yɛn bɔne a yɛyɛɛ no nyinaa so ka.
Na wɔmaa wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ Yosef sɛ: W’agya hyɛe ansa na ɔrewuo sɛ: Monka nkyerɛ Yosef sɛ: Mesrɛ wo, fa wo nuanom amumuyɛ ne wɔn bɔne kyɛ wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ wɔayɛ wo bɔne.
Na afei yɛsrɛ wo, fa w’agya Nyankopɔn nkoa amumuyɛ no kyɛ wɔn.
Na wɔkaa saa kyerɛɛ Yosef no, ɔsui.
Na ne nuanom nso ba bɛtwa hwee n’anim kaa sɛ: Hwɛ, yɛyɛ wo nkoa.
Na Yosef ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monnsuro, na megyina Nyankopɔn ananmu anaa?
Na mo deɛ modwenee me ho bɔne nanso Onyankopɔn deɛ, na ɔde rebɛyɛ papa.
Sɛ ɔbɛyɛ deɛ ada adi nnɛ yi, na ɔbɛgye nnipa pii nkwa.
Na afei monnsuro; na mɛhwɛ mo ne mo mma.
Na ɔkyekyeree wɔn werɛ kaa wɔn akoma too wɔn yam.
Yosef wuo Na Yosef ne n’agya fiefoɔ tenaa Misraim, na Yosef dii mfirinhyia ɔha ne du.
Na Yosef hunuu Efraim mmanana.
Manase ba Makir mma nso, wɔwoo wɔn guu Yosef srɛ so.
Na Yosef ka kyerɛɛ ne nuanom sɛ: Merebɛti nananom wɔ asamando, na Onyankopɔn bɛba abɛhwɛ mo ampa, na wabɛyi mo afiri asase yi so akɔ asase a ɔkaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ Abraham ne Isak ne Yakob no so.
Na Yosef maa Israel mma kaa ntam na ɔkaa sɛ: Ampa ara, Onyankopɔn bɛba abɛhwɛ mo, na monsoa me nnompe mfiri ha nkɔ.
Na Yosef wui, berɛ a na wadi mfirinhyia ɔha ne du.
Na wɔhyɛɛ ne mu aduro, na wɔde no too adaka mu wɔ Misraim.
NHYƐNMU Nwoma no din “Eksodɔs” no asekyerɛ ne “Otukorɔ”.
Nwoma yi ka Israelfoɔ abakɔsɛm mu adeɛ titire bi a ɛsiiɛ ho asɛm.
Ɛne sɛ, Israelfoɔ tu firii Misraim asase so, nkoasom mu.
Wɔtumi kyɛ nwoma yi mu mmiɛnsa: .
Wɔgyee Hebrifoɔ firii nkoasom mu maa wɔtuu kwan firii Misraim kɔɔ Sinai bepɔ ho; .
Onyankopɔn apam a ɔne ne man pameeɛ wɔ Sinai Bepɔ ho no.
Apam yi fa abrabɔ, amanyɛ ne Onyamesom mmara a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔdi soɔ ho.
.
Wɔsii ɛdan siesiee mu sɛ Israelfoɔ no nsom wɔ mu, na wɔhyehyɛɛ mmara maa asɔfodie ne sɛdeɛ wɔsom Onyankopɔn fa.
Ne korakora ne sɛ, nwoma no ka deɛ Onyankopɔn yɛeɛ, sɛ ɔgyee ne man a wɔde wɔn ayɛ nkoa ne mfenaa na ɔyɛɛ wɔn ɔman a wɔanya anidasoɔ.
Onipa titire a nwoma no ka ne ho asɛm ne Mose.
Ɔno na Onyankopɔn yii no sɛ ɔnni ne man no anim nyi wɔn mfiri Misraim.
Nwoma no fa bi a wɔnim no yie papaapa ne Mmara Nsɛm Du a ɛwɔ Ti mu no.
EMU NSƐM Wɔgyee Israelfoɔ firii Misraim nsamu .—.
.
Wɔyɛɛ wɔn nkoa wɔ Misraim .- .
Mose awoɔ ne ne mmɔfraase ho nsɛm .—.
.
Mose ne Aaron kɔhyiaa Misraimhene .—.
.
Twam afahyɛ ne firi a Israelfoɔ firii Misraim .—.
Wɔfirii Mmɛwa Po no ho kɔɔ Sinai Bepɔ ho .—.
Mmara no ne apam no .—.
Ntomadan no ne ɔsom ho nhyehyɛɛ .—.
Israelfoɔ amanehunu wɔ Misraim Na yeinom ne Israel mma a wɔne Yakob baa Misraim no din.
Wɔn mu biara ne ne fiefoɔ na ɛbaeɛ.
Ruben, Simeon, Lewi, Yuda, Isakar, Sebulon, Benyamin, Dan, Naftali, Gad ne Aser.
Na nnipa a wɔfiri Yakob asene mu nyinaa yɛ aduɔson.
Na Yosef wɔ Misraim dada.
Na Yosef ne ne nuanom nyinaa ne wɔn berɛ sofoɔ no nyinaa wuwui.
Na Israel mma no wowoe, na wɔdɔree bebree, na wɔn ase kyenee, na wɔn ho yɛɛ den papaapa; na wɔyɛɛ asase no so ma.
Na ɔhene foforɔ bi sɔree Misraim a na ɔnnim Yosef.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne man sɛ: Hwɛ, Israelfoɔ no dɔɔso, na wɔn ho yɛ den sene yɛn.
Momma yɛmfa nyansa kwan bi so ne wɔn nni, na wɔannɔɔso, na sɛ ɛsa bi ba a, wɔankɔka yɛn atamfoɔ ho ne yɛn ammɛko, na wɔansɔre asase yi so ankɔ.
Na wɔsisii wɔn so adwumayɛfoɔ so mpanimfoɔ sɛ wɔmfa nnesoadeɛ a emu yɛ duro nhyɛ wɔn so.
Na wɔkyekyeree adekora nkuro Pitom ne Raamses maa Farao.
Nanso dodoɔ a wɔhyɛɛ wɔn soɔ no, dodoɔ no ara na wɔdɔreeɛ, na wɔtrɛe.
Na Misraimfoɔ suroo Israelfoɔ no.
Na wɔde nyadie yaya dii Israelfoɔ.
Wɔmaa wɔn asetena fonoo wɔn wɔ dɔteɛ ne ntaayaa ho adwuma a ɛyɛ den ne afuom adwumayɛ ahodoɔ ne nnwuma ahodoɔ nyinaa mu nyadie yaya a wɔde dii wɔn mu.
Na Misraimhene ka kyerɛɛ Hebrifoɔ awogyefoɔ a wɔn mu baako din de Sifra, na ɔbaako din de Pua no sɛ: Sɛ mokɔgye Hebrifoɔ mmaa awoɔ, na awoeɛ hɔ mohunu sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbarima a, monku no; na sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbaa deɛ a, momma no ntena ase.
Na awogyefoɔ no suro Onyankopɔn, enti wɔanyɛ sɛdeɛ Misraimhene ka kyerɛɛ wɔn no, na mmom wɔgyee mmabanin no nkwa.
Na Misraimhene frɛɛ awogyefoɔ no bisaa wɔn sɛ: Adɛn nti na moyɛ saa, na momma mmarima no tena aseɛ?
Na awogyefoɔ no buaa Farao sɛ: Hebrifoɔ mmaa nte sɛ Misraimfoɔ mmaa, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn deɛ, wɔyɛ pirimpirim; awogyefoɔ no nnya nnuruu wɔn nkyɛn no, na wɔawo dada.
Enti Onyankopɔn ne awogyefoɔ no dii no yie.
Na nkurɔfoɔ no dɔɔso ara, na wɔyɛɛ den yie.
Na ɛsiane sɛ awogyefoɔ no suro Onyankopɔn nti, ɔmaa wɔn afie mu yɛɛ yie.
Ɛnna Farao hyɛɛ ne man nyinaa sɛ: Ɔbabanin biara a wɔbɛwo no no, monkɔto no ntwene asubɔnten no mu, na mmammaa nyinaa deɛ, momma wɔntena ase.
Adebɔ Mfiase Mfiase no Onyankopɔn bɔɔ ɔsoro ne asase.
Na asase da hɔ hunu a enni bɔbea biara na Onyankopɔn honhom butuw nsu no ani.
Na Onyankopɔn kae sɛ: Ɛnyɛ hann!
Na ɛyɛɛ hann.
Na Onyankopɔn huu hann no sɛ eye.
Na Onyankopɔn paee hann ne sum no mu.
Na ɔfrɛɛ hann no sɛ: Adekyee, na esum no de, ɔfrɛɛ no adesae.
Na ade sae, na ade kyee, da a edi kan nen.
Na Onyankopɔn kae sɛ: Ntrɛwmu mmra nsu no ntam, na ɛmmɛpae nsu no mu.
Na Onyankopɔn yɛɛ ahun mu ntrɛwmu, na ɔpaee nsu a ɛwɔ ntrɛwmu no ase ne nsu a ɛwɔ ntrɛwmu no so no mu.
Na ɛyɛɛ sa.
Na Onyankopɔn frɛɛ ntrɛw mu no ɔsoro.
Na ade sae, na ade kyee, da a ɛto so abien nen.
Na Onyankopɔn kae sɛ: Nsu a ɛwɔ ɔsoro ase no mmoaboa ano wɔ faako, na wonhu asase kesee.
Na ɛyɛɛ sa.
Na Onyankopɔn frɛɛ kesee no asase, na nsu mmoaano no, ɔfrɛɛ no ɛpo.
Na Onyankopɔn hui sɛ eye.
Na Onyankopɔn kae sɛ asase mfifi nwura frɔmfrɔm, nhaban a ɛsow aba, nnua a ɛsow nnuaba sɛnea ne su te a n'aba wɔ mu, wɔ asase so.
Na ɛyɛɛ sa.
Na asase fifii wura, nhaban a ɛsow aba sɛnea ne su te, ne nnua a ɛsow nnuaba a n'aba wɔ mu sɛnea ne su te.
Na Onyankopɔn hui sɛ eye.
Na ade sae, na ade kyee, da a ɛto so abiɛsa nen.
Na Onyankopɔn kae sɛ: Akanea mmra ɔsoro ntrɛwmu no mu, na ɛmmɛpae awia ne anadwo mu, na ɛnyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne ne bere nkyekyem ne nna ne mfe; na ɛnyɛ akanea wɔ ɔsoro ntrɛwmu no mu, na ɛnharan asase so.
Na ɛyɛɛ sa.
Na Onyankopɔn yɛɛ akanea akɛse abien no, ɔkanea kɛse no, sɛ enni awia so, ne ɔkanea ketewa no, sɛ enni anadwo so, ne nsoromma nso.
Na Onyankopɔn de sisii ɔsoro ntrɛwmu no mu sɛ ɛnharan asase so, na enni awia ne anadwo so, na ɛmpae hann ne esum no mu.
Na Onyankopɔn hui sɛ eye.
Na ade sae, na ade kyee, da a ɛto so anan nen.
Na Onyankopɔn kae sɛ: Nsu no nnɔ abɔde a ɛte ase manyamanya, na ntakraboa ntu mfa asase so ɔsoro ntrɛwmu no ani.
Na Onyankopɔn bɔɔ nsuboa akɛse ne abɔde a ɛte ase a ɛkeka ne ho a ɛyɛ nsu mu manyamanya nyinaa, sɛnea wɔn su te, ɛne nnomaa a wɔwɔ ntaban nyinaa, sɛnea wɔn su te.
Na Onyankopɔn hui sɛ eye.
Na Onyankopɔn hyiraa wɔn sɛ: Monwo, na monnɔ, na monyɛ ɛpo mu nsu mu ma, na ntakraboa nnɔɔso asase so.
Na ade sae, na ade kyee, da a ɛto so anum nen.
Na Onyankopɔn kae sɛ: Asase mma abɔde a ɛtete ase mfi mmra, sɛnea wɔn su te; ntɔteboa ne mmoa a wɔwea ne asase so mmoadoma, sɛnea wɔn su te.
Na ɛyɛɛ sa.
Na Onyankopɔn yɛɛ asase so mmoadoma sɛnea wɔn su te, ne ntɔteboa sɛnea wɔn su te, ne mmoa a wɔwea fam nyinaa sɛnea wɔn su te.
Na Onyankopɔn hui sɛ eye.
Na Onyankopɔn kae sɛ: Momma yɛnyɛ onipa wɔ yɛn suban so sɛ yɛn sɛso, na wonni ɛpo mu mpataa ne wim nnomaa ne ntɔteboa ne mmoa a wɔwea asase so nyinaa so.
Na Onyankopɔn bɔɔ onipa wɔ ne suban so, Yiw Onyankopɔn suban so na ɔbɔɔ no, ɔbarima ne ɔbea na ɔbɔɔ wɔn.
Na Onyankopɔn hyiraa wɔn, na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monwo, na monnɔre, na monyɛ asase so ma, na monni so tumi, na munni ɛpo mu mpataa ne wim nnomaa ne mmoa a wɔkeka wɔn ho wɔ asase so nyinaa so.
Na Onyankopɔn kae sɛ: Hwɛ, mede nhaban a ɛsow aba nyinaa a ɛwɔ asase nyinaa ani, ɛne nnua nyinaa a adua a n'aba wɔ mu wɔ so mama mo sɛ ɛnyɛ mo aduan.
Na asase so mmoadoma nyinaa ne wim nnomaa nyinaa ne mmoa a wɔwea asase so nyinaa a ɔkra a ɛte ase wɔ wɔn mu no, mede nhaban momono mama wɔn sɛ wonni.
Na ɛyɛɛ sa.
Na Onyankopɔn huu nea ɔyɛe nyinaa, na hwɛ, eye papa.
Na ade sae, na ade kyee, da a ɛto so asia nen.
Homeda Na wowiee ɔsoro ne asase ne nea ɛwɔ mu nyinaa.
Na da a ɛto so ason no, Onyankopɔn wiee n'adwuma a ɔyɛe no, na da a ɛto so ason no, ɔhome fii n'adwuma a ɔyɛe nyinaa ho.
Na Onyankopɔn hyiraa da a ɛto so ason no, na ɔtew ho, efisɛ ɛno mu na Onyankopɔn home fii n'adwuma a ɔbɔe na ɔyɛe nyinaa ho.
Adebɔ su: Eden turo Eyi ne sɛnea Awurade Nyankopɔn bɔɔ ɔsoro ne asase.
Na afuw mu nnua nyinaa nnya mmaa asase so, na afuw mu nhaban nyinaa nnya mfifii, efisɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn nnya ntɔɔ osu nguu asase so ɛ, na onipa a ɔbɛdɔw asase nni hɔ.
Na nsu fi asase so foroe, na ɛfɔw asase ani nyinaa.
Na AWURADE Nyankopɔn de fam dɔte nwenee onipa, na ohuw nkwa home guu ne hwene mu, na onipa yɛɛ ɔkra teasefo.
Na AWURADE Nyankopɔn yɛɛ turo bi wɔ Eden a ɛwɔ apuei fam, na ɔde onipa a ɔnwenee no, tenaa hɔ.
Na AWURADE Nyankopɔn maa nnua ahorow nyinaa a wɔhwɛ a, ɛyɛ fɛ, na eye sɛ wodi asase no so, ne nkwa dua a esi turo no mfinimfini, ne papa ne bɔne hu dua fifii asase so.
Na asu bi fi Eden bɛfɔw turo no, na efi hɔ ara na emu paepae yɛɛ nsuti anan.
Nea edi kan no din de Pison, ɛno na ɛkɔntɔn twa Hawila asase a sika wɔ so no nyinaa ho hyia; na asase no so sika ye; ɛhɔ na bedola ne apopobibiribo wɔ.
Na asu a ɛto so abien no din de Gihon, ɛno na ɛkɔntɔn twa Kus asase nyinaa ho hyia.
Na asu a ɛto so abiɛsa ne Tigri, ɛno na ɛsen wɔ Asaria apuei.
Na asu a ɛto so anan ne Eufrate.
Na AWURADE Nyankopɔn de onipa no kɔtenaa Eden turom sɛ ɔnnɔw na ɔnwɛn hɔ.
Na ɔhyɛɛ onipa no sɛ: Turom ha nnua nyinaa, di bi.
Na papa ne bɔne hu dua no de, nni, efisɛ da a wubedi bi no, owu na wubewu.
Na AWURADE Nyankopɔn kae sɛ: Enye sɛ onipa nko tena, mɛyɛ ne sɛso boafo mama no.
Na AWURADE Nyankopɔn de dɔte nwenee wuram mmoadoma nyinaa ne wim nnomaa nyinaa, na ɔde wɔn baa onipa no nkyɛn sɛ obehu sɛnea ɔbɛfrɛ wɔn.
Na nea onipa de frɛɛ abɔde a ɛte ase biara no, ɛno ara ne ne din.
Na onipa totoo afieboa nyinaa ne wim nnomaa ne wuram mmoadoma nyinaa din.
Nanso onipa de, wɔannya ne sɛso boafo amma no.
Na AWURADE Nyankopɔn maa nnahɔɔ tɔɔ onipa no so, na ɔdae, na oyii ne mfe pare mu biako, na ɔde nam tuaa anan mu.
Na AWURADE Nyankopɔn de mfe pare a oyi fii onipa no mu no yɛɛ ɔbea, na ɔde no brɛɛ onipa no.
Na onipa no kae sɛ: Ampa ara me nnompe mu dompe ne me honam mu nam ankasa ni.
Oyi na wɔbɛfrɛ no ɔbea, efisɛ ɔbarima mu na woyii no fii.
Ne saa nti na ɔbarima begyaw ne na ne n'agya, na ɔde ne ho akɔbata ne yere ho, na wɔayɛ ɔhonam koro.
Na wɔn baanu no deda adagyaw, ɔbarima no ne ne yere, na wɔn ani nwu.
Onipa Asehwe Na ɔwɔ yɛ anifere kyɛn wuram mmoadoma a AWURADE Nyankopɔn yɛɛ wɔn nyinaa.
Na obisaa ɔbea no sɛ: Ampa sɛ Nyankopɔn aka sɛ Munnni turom ha nnua nyinaa bi?
Na ɔbea no ka kyerɛɛ ɔwɔ no sɛ: Turom ha nnua aba no, yedi bi, nanso dua a esi turo no mfinimfini no aba de, Onyankopɔn aka sɛ: Munnni bi, nso mommfa mo nsa nnka, na moanwu.
Na ɔwɔ no ka kyerɛɛ ɔbea no sɛ: Ɛnyɛ owu na mubewu: na Onyankopɔn nim sɛ da a mubedi bi no, mo ani bebue, na moayɛ sɛ Onyankopɔn, ahu papa ne bɔne.
Na ɔbea no hui sɛ dua no ye sɛ wodi, na ɛyɛ aniwa fɛ, na dua no dɔ kɔn na ɛbɛtew ani no, ɔtew n'aba no bi, na odii, na ɔde bi maa ne kunu a ɔka ne ho no nso, na odii.
Na wɔn baanu ani buebuei, na wohui sɛ wɔdeda adagyaw, na wɔpompam borɔdɔma ahaban yɛɛ nkataanim fae.
Na wɔtee AWURADE Nyankopɔn nka sɛ ɔnam turom hɔ wɔ anwummere mfare mu.
Na Adam no ne ne yere kohintaw fii AWURADE Nyankopɔn anim wɔ turom hɔ nnua mu.
Na AWURADE Nyankopɔn frɛɛ Adam, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wowɔ he?
Na ose: Metee wo nka wɔ turom hɔ no, misuroe, efisɛ meda adagyaw, na mihintawee.
Na ɔkae sɛ: Hena na ɔka kyerɛɛ wo sɛ woda adagyaw?
Dua a mehyɛɛ wo sɛ nni bi no na woadi yi?
Na Adam se: Ɔbea no a wode no bɛkaa me ho no, ɔno na ɔmaa me dua no aba bi na midii.
Na AWURADE Nyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ ɔbea no sɛ: Ɛdɛn nti na woyɛɛ saa?
Na ɔbea no se: Ɔwɔ no na ɔdaadaa me na midii.
Na AWURADE Nyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ ɔwɔ no sɛ: Sɛ woayɛ eyi nti, wɔadome wo ntɔteboa ne wuram mmoadoma nyinaa mu.
Wo yafunu so na wobɛnantew, na woadi dɔte wo nkwa nna nyinaa.
Na mede ɔtan mɛto wo ne ɔbea no ntam, ɛne w'asefo ne n'asefo ntam; ɔno na ɔbɛbɔ wo ti, na wo nso woaka ne nantin.
Ɔbea no de, ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɔdɔ na mɛma wo yaw ne wo nyinsɛn mu brɛ adɔɔso.
Ɛyaw mu na wobɛwo mma, na w'ani begyina wo kunu, na ɔno na obedi wo so.
Na Adam de, ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ woatie wo yere nne, na woadi dua a mehyɛɛ wo sɛ nni no bi nti, wo nti wɔadome asase.
Ɛyaw mu na wubedidi so, wo nkwa nna nyinaa, na nsɔe ne nnɛnkyɛnse na ebefifi ama wo, na woadi afuw so ahaban.
W'anim fifiri mu na wubedidi de akosi sɛ wobɛsan akɔ dɔte mu, efisɛ emu na woyii wo fii, na woyɛ dɔte, na dɔte mu na wobɛsan akɔ.
Na Adam too ne yere din Hawa, efisɛ ɔno na wayɛ ateasefo nyinaa na.
Na AWURADE Nyankopɔn yɛɛ nhoma ntade maa Adam ne ne yere de hyɛɛ wɔn.
Na AWURADE Nyankopɔn kae sɛ: Hwɛ, onipa no ayɛ sɛ yɛn mu biako ahu papa ne bɔne.
Na afei, nea ɛbɛyɛ na wanteɛ ne nsa antew nkwa dua no nso bi anni antena ase daa nti, AWURADE Nyankopɔn tuu no fii Eden turom hɔ sɛ ɔnkɔdɔw asase a wɔfaa no fii mu no.
Na ɔpam onipa no, na ɔde Kerubim ne gyaframa afoa a edi ahim besii Eden turo no anim apuei fam sɛ wɔnwɛn ɔkwan a ɛkɔ nkwa dua no ho no.
Kain ne Habel Na Adam ne ne yere Hawa hyiae, na onyinsɛnee, na ɔwoo Kain, na ɔkae se: AWURADE adaworoma, manya ɔbarima.
Na ɔwoo ne nua Habel kaa ne ho.
Na Habel yɛɛ oguanhwɛfo, na Kain de, ɔyɛɛ okuafo.
Na ɛbae sɛ nna bi akyi no, Kain de afum nneɛma bɛyɛɛ AWURADE ayɛ.
Na Habel nso de ne nguan mu mmakan ne wɔn a wɔadɔ no bi bɛmae.
Na AWURADE ani sɔɔ Habel ne n'ayɛyɛde no, nanso Kain ne n'ayɛyɛde de, n'ani ansɔ.
Na Kain bo fuwii pii, na omunae.
Na AWURADE bisaa Kain sɛ ɛdɛn nti na wo bo afuw, na ɛdɛn nti na woamuna yi?
Sɛ woyɛ papa a, anka w'anim rentew anaa?
Na sɛ woanyɛ papa nti, bɔne butuw ɔpon ano, na w'akyi kwan na ɛrehwehwɛ, nanso di no so.
Na Kain ka kyerɛɛ ne nua Habel sɛ ɔmma wɔnkɔ afum, na ɛbae sɛ wɔwɔ afum no, Kain sɔre hyɛɛ ne nua Habel, na okum no.
Na AWURADE bisaa Kain sɛ: Ɛhe na wo nua Habel wɔ?
Na Kain buae sɛ: Minnim, me nua so hwɛfo ne me anaa?
Na AWURADE se: Ɛdɛn na woayɛ yi?
Wo nua mogya nne teɛm frɛ me fi asase so.
Na afei wɔadome wo afi asase a abue n'ano agye wo nua mogya afi wo nsam no so.
Sɛ wodɔw asase a, ɛrenkɔ so mma wo ne nnɔbae bio, wobɛbɔ asesa na waye ɔkobɔfo wɔ asase so.
Na Kain ka kyerɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: Me bɔne so ade so kyɛn sɛ metumi masoa.
Hwɛ, woapam me nnɛ afi asase so, na mehintaw mafi w'anim, na mayɛ ɔsesafo ne ɔkobɔfo wɔ asase so, na obiara a obehu me no, obekum me.
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛno nti obiara a obekum Kain no, wobedi ne were ahorow asɔn.
Na AWURADE yɛɛ sɛnkyerɛnne bi maa Kain, na obiara a obehu no no ankum no.
Na Kain fii AWURADE anim kɔe, na ɔkɔtenaa Nod asase so wɔ Eden apuei.
Kain Asefo Na Kain ne ne yere Hawa dae, na onyinsɛnee, na ɔwoo Enok.
Na ɔkyekyeree kurow bi, na ɔde ne ba Enok din too kurow no.
Na wɔwoo Irad maa Enok, na Irad woo Mehuyael, na Mehuyael woo Metusael, na Metusael woo Lamek.
Lamek ne ne yerenom Na Lamek faa mmea baanu waree, obiako din de Ada, na nea ɔka ho no din de Sila.
Na Ada woo Yabal, ɔno na ɔyɛ ntamadan mu ne mmoa ho tenafo agya.
Na ne nua din de Yubal, ɔno na ɔyɛ asankubɔfo ne mmɛnhyɛnfo nyinaa agya.
Na Sila nso woo Tubal-kain a ɔyɛ kɔbere mfrafrae ne dade ade nyinaa atomfo agya.
Na Tubal-kain ne nuabea ne Naama.
Na Lamek ka kyerɛɛ ne yerenom sɛ: Ada ne Sila, muntie me nne; Lamek yerenom, monyɛ aso mma m'asɛm: Mikum aberante bi sɛ opiraa me, na mikum aberante sɛ ɔboroo me.
Na sɛ wodi Kain so were mpɛn ason a, Lamek de bɛyɛ aduɔsɔn asɔn.
Set ne Enos awo Na Adam ne ne yere dae bio, na ɔwoo babarima, na ɔtoo no din Set a ase ne: Nsiananmu, sɛ Onyankopɔn de ɔba foforo asi me Habel a Kain kum no no anan mu.
Na Set nso, wɔwoo ba maa no, na ɔtoo no din Enos.
Ɛbere no mu na wofii ase bɔɔ AWURADE din sɔree no.
Adam awo ntoatoaso Adam awo ntoatoaso nhoma ni: Da a Onyankopɔn bɔɔ onipa no, ne suban so na ɔyɛɛ no; ɔbarima ne ɔbea na ɔbɔɔ wɔn, na ohyiraa wɔn, na ɔtoo wɔn din onipa.
Na Adam dii mfirihyia ɔha aduasa na ɔwoo babarima wɔ ne sɛso so sɛ ne suban so, na ɔtoo no din Set.
Na Adam woo Set no akyi no odii mfirihyia ahanwɔtwe, na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmabea.
Na Adam nna a odii nyinaa si mfe ahankron aduasa, na owui.
Na Set dii mfirihyia ɔha ne anum na ɔwoo Enos.
Na Set woo Enos no akyi no, odii mfe ahanwɔtwe ne asɔn, na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmabea.
Na Set nna nyinaa si mfe ahankron ne dumien, na owui.
Na Enos dii mfirihyia aduakron na ɔwoo Kenan.
Na Enos woo Kenan no akyi no, odii mfe ahanwɔtwe ne dunum, na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmabea.
Na Enos nna nyinaa si mfe ahankron ne anum, na owui.
Na Kenan dii mfirihyia aduɔsɔn na ɔwoo Mahalaleel.
Na Kenan woo Mahalaleel no akyi no, odii mfe ahanwɔtwe aduanan, na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmabea.
Na Kenan nna nyinaa si mfe ahankron ne du, na owui.
Na Mahalaleel dii mfirihyia aduosia anum na ɔwoo Yared.
Na Mahalaleel woo Yared akyi no, odii mfe ahanwɔtwe aduasa, na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmabea.
Na Mahalaleel nna nyinaa si mfe ahanwɔtwe aduakron anum, na owui.
Na Yared dii mfirihyia ɔha aduosia abien na ɔwoo Enok.
Na Yared woo Enok akyi no, odii mfe ahanwɔtwe, na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmabea.
Na Yared nna nyinaa si mfe ahankron aduosia abien, na owui.
Na Enok dii mfirihyia aduosia anum na ɔwoo Metusela.
Na Enok woo Metusela no akyi no, ɔne Nyankopɔn nantewee mfirihyia ahasa, na ɔsan woo mmammarima ne mmabea.
Na Enok nna nyinaa si mfe ahasa aduosia anum.
Na Enok ne Nyankopɔn nantewee; na wanhu no efisɛ Onyankopɔn faa no kɔe.
