Mmarima bɛyɛ sɛ ahannan na wɔkaa Dawid ho kɔe, ɛnna mmarima ahannu nso tena wɛn akode no.
Nabal asomfo no mu baako kɔka kyerɛɛ Nabal yere Abigail se, “Dawid somaa abɔfo fi sare no so sɛ wɔne yɛn wura mmɛkasa, nanso ɔyeyaw wɔn.
Nanso Dawid nnipa no ye ma yɛn.
Wɔanyɛ yɛn bɔne biara.
Bere a yɛne wɔn wɔ hɔ no, wɔamfa yɛn biribiara.
Anadwo ne awia nyinaa, na wɔbɔ yɛn ne nguan no ho ban.
Enti dwene ho yiye, anyɛ saa a asɛm bɛto yɛn wura ne nʼabusua nyinaa.
Ɔyɛ obi a ne koma nye na obiara ntumi nkasa nkyerɛ no.” Abigail ansɛe bere koraa.
Ɔfaa brodo mua ahannu, nsa aboa nhoma abien, nguan anum a wɔakum wɔn asiesie wɔn, nkyewe susude anum, bobe ɔfam ɔha ne bobe aba a wɔabɔ no atɔwatɔw ahannu de soaa mfurum.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ nʼasomfo se, “Munni kan nkɔ.
Metiw mo.” Nanso wanka nea na ɔreyɛ no ankyerɛ ne kunu Nabal.
Ɔte nʼafurum so nam ara kosii bepɔw bi asiansian mu no, ohuu Dawid nso ne ne mmarima sɛ wɔrehyia no.
Na Dawid aka se, “Mfaso biara nni so sɛ mahwɛ saa onipa yi agyapade so wɔ sare so a ne biribiara anyera.
Ɔde bɔne atua me papa a meyɛɛ no no so ka.
Sɛ ɛba sɛ ɔkyena ne fini barima bi da so te ase a, Onyankopɔn ne me nni no ɔyaw so pa ara.” Abigail Pata Dawid Abigail huu Dawid no, ntɛm ara, ohuruw fii nʼafurum no so sii fam, bɔɔ ne mu ase wɔ nʼanim.
Ɔhwee ne nan ase kae se, “Me wura migye saa asɛm yi ho afɔdi nyinaa to me ho so.
Mesrɛ wo sɛ, tie asɛm a mewɔ ka.
Minim sɛ Nabal yɛ otirimɔdenfo; mesrɛ wo, ntie no.
Ɔyɛ ɔkwasea sɛnea ne din kyerɛ no.
Na me, wʼafenaa, abɔfo a wosomaa wɔn no, manhu wɔn.
Afei, me wura, mpɛn dodow a Awurade te ase, na wo nso wote ase na Awurade amma woamfa awudi ne aweretɔ anhyɛ wo nsam yi, ma mmusu mmra wʼatamfo nyinaa so, sɛnea bi aba Nabal so yi.
Akyɛde a mede abrɛ wo ne wo mmerante no ni.
“Mesrɛ wo, sɛ mafom a, fa kyɛ me.
Akyinnye biara nni ho sɛ Awurade de ofi a nʼahenni ase betim bɛdom wo, efisɛ woreko Awurade ko.
Na wonyɛɛ bɔne biara nso wɔ wʼasetena mu.
Na sɛ ɛba sɛ wɔn a wɔpɛ wo kra no taataa wo so a, Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn, begye wo, abɔ wo ho ban sɛnea wɔbɔ ademude ho ban no.
Na wʼatamfo nkwa de, ɛbɛyera te sɛ abo a wɔatow fi ahwimmo mu.
Sɛ Awurade di bɔ a ɔhyɛɛ wo no nyinaa so ma wo, na ɔde wo di Israelhene a, mma eyi nnyɛ nkekae wɔ wʼabrabɔ mu.
Na worensoa wʼahonim adesoa duruduru a efi mogyahwiegu ne aweretɔ a so nni mfaso ho.
Na sɛ Awurade yɛ saa nneɛma akɛse yi ma wo a, mesrɛ wo, kae me!” Dawid buaa Abigail se, “Nhyira nka Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn a wama woabehyia me nnɛ.
Da Awurade ase wɔ wʼadwene pa ho.
Nhyira nka wo sɛ woamma me ankum ɔbarima no, na woamma mamfa me nsa antɔ were.
Na meka Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn a wamma manyɛ wo bɔne no ntam sɛ, sɛ woanka wo ho ammehyia me a, anka ebedu ɔkyena anɔpa no, na Nabal mmarima no mu baako koraa nte ase.” Na Dawid gyee nʼakyɛde no, ka kyerɛɛ no se, “San kɔ fie asomdwoe mu.
Yɛrenkum wo kunu no.” Bere a Abigail duu fie no, ohuu sɛ Nabal ato pon kɛse sɛ ɔhene.
Na wabow nsa nti, wanka biribiara a ɛfa ɔne Dawid nhyiamu no ho ankyerɛ no kosii adekyee.
Ade kyee a nʼani so daa hɔ no, Abigail kaa nsɛm a asisi no kyerɛɛ no.
Nabal tee nsɛm no, obubu kaa mpa mu.
Nnafua du akyi no, Awurade bɔɔ no ma owui.
Dawid Ware Abigail Dawid tee sɛ Nabal awu no, ɔkae se, “Nhyira nka Awurade a watua Nabal ka na wamma mankum no.
Nabal anya ne bɔne so akatua.” Na Dawid yɛɛ ntɛm soma kɔɔ Abigail nkyɛn, ma wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ no se ɔbɛware no.
Asomfo no kɔɔ Karmel kɔka kyerɛɛ Abigail se, “Dawid asoma yɛn sɛ yɛmmra mmɛfa wo mmrɛ no sɛ ne yere.” Ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase de nʼanim kyerɛɛ fam kae se, “Yiw, masiesie me ho sɛ mɛsom Dawid asomfo mpo.” Ntɛm ara, Abigail huruw tenaa nʼafurum so, faa ne mmaawa baanum kaa ne ho, na ɔne Dawid asomfo no kɔe, na ɔbɛyɛɛ Dawid yere.
Dawid waree Ahinoam a ofi Yesreel, na wɔn baanu bɛyɛɛ ne yerenom.
Na Saulo de ne babea Mikal, Dawid yere, ama ɔbarima bi a ofi Galim a ne din de Palti a na ɔyɛ Lais babarima.
Bio, Dawid Ampɛ Sɛ Obekum Saulo Sififo kɔɔ Saulo nkyɛn wɔ Gibea kɔka kyerɛɛ no se, “Dawid akohintaw wɔ Hakila bepɔw a ɛkyerɛ Yesimon no mu.” Enti Saulo yii nʼakofo mpensa kaa wɔn ho kɔɔ Sif sare so sɛ wɔrekɔhwehwɛ Dawid.
Saulo bɔɔ nʼatenae wɔ ɔkwan a ɛbɛn Hakila bepɔw a ɛne Yesimon di nhwɛanim no nkyɛn, baabi a Dawid akohintaw hɔ.
Dawid tee sɛ Saulo aba hɔ, enti ɔsomaa akwansrafo sɛ wɔntetɛw no.
Dawid kopuee baabi a Saulo abɔ ne ho atenase hɔ anadwo bi.
Ohuu sɛ Saulo ne Abner a ɔyɛ Ner babarima a ɔyɛ ɔsafohene adeda atenae no mu a asraafo a wɔadeda atwa ne ho ahyia.
Dawid bisaa Hetini Ahimelek ne Seruia babarima Abisai, Yoab nua se, “Hena na ɔne me bɛkɔ Saulo nkyɛn wɔ nʼatenae hɔ?” Abisai buae se, “Me ne wo bɛkɔ.” Enti Dawid ne Abisai kɔɔ asraafo no nkyɛn anadwo, kɔtoo Saulo sɛ wada wɔ atenae hɔ a, ɔde ne peaw atim fam wɔ ne ti ho pɛɛ.
Na Abner ne asraafo no nso atwa ne ho ahyia a wɔadeda.
Abisai ka kyerɛɛ Dawid brɛoo se, “Nnɛ de, Onyankopɔn ayi wo tamfo ahyɛ wo nsa.
Enti ma memfa me peaw no nwɔ no pɛn koro, nka no ntim fam.
Merenwɔ no mprenu.” Nanso Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Abisai se, “Dabi da, nsɛe no.
Hena na obetumi de ne nsa aka onipa a Awurade asra no, na onni ho fɔ?
Nokware ni, Awurade bɛbɔ Saulo ahwe da koro, anaasɛ ɔbɛtɔ wɔ ɔko mu, anaasɛ obenyin na wawu.
Onyame ma ɛmpare me sɛ mede me nsa bɛka onipa a Onyankopɔn asra no.
Na wunim biribi?
Yɛbɛfa ne peaw ne ne sukuruwa na yɛakɔ.” Na Dawid faa peaw no ne sukuruwa a esi Saulo ti ho no, na wɔkɔe a obiara anhu wɔn na wɔn mu biara nso annyan mpo.
Na wɔn nyinaa adeda, efisɛ Awurade de nnahɔɔ too wɔn so.
Dawid foroo bepɔw a ɛne atenae hɔ di nhwɛanim kosii sɛ oduu baabi a bɔne bi ntumi nka no.
Ɔteɛɛ mu frɛɛ Abner ne Saulo se, “Sɔre oo!
Abner.” Abner bisaa se, “Hena ni?” Dawid goruu ne ho se, “Abner, woyɛ onipa kɛse, ɛnte saa?
Israelman mu nyinaa, ɛhe na otumfo bi wɔ?
Na adɛn nti na woannwɛn wo wura, ɔhene no bere a obi baa sɛ ɔrebekum no no?
Saa asɛm yi nye koraa!
Meka ntam wɔ Awurade din mu sɛ, wo ne wo mmarima no nyinaa sɛ owu, efisɛ moantumi ammɔ mo wura, nea Awurade asra no no ho ban.
Monhwɛ mo ho nhyia.
Ɔhene no peaw ne ne sukuruwa a na esi ne ti ho no wɔ he?” Saulo tee Dawid nne nti ɔfrɛe se, “Wo ni, me ba Dawid?” Na Dawid buaa no se, “Nana, ɛyɛ me.
Adɛn nti na wotaa me?
Dɛn na mayɛ?
Me bɔne ne dɛn?
Na afei mepɛ sɛ me wura tie ne somfo, Nana.
Sɛ Awurade na wahwanyan wo atia me a, ɛno de ma onnye mʼafɔre.
Na sɛ nso ɛyɛ onipa nhyehyɛe a, ɛno de, Awurade nnome wɔn a wɔyɛɛ saa nhyehyɛe no.
Efisɛ moapam me afi me fi sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a, merentumi ne Awurade nkurɔfo ntena, nsom sɛnea ɛsɛ.
Minwu wɔ ananafo asase so a ɛhɔ ne Awurade anim kwan ware ana?
Adɛn nti na Israelhene atu sa, rehwehwɛ sommɔre; sɛnea ɔbɔmmɔfo kɔ ahayɛ kɔpɛ asɛmɛntɛ wɔ mmepɔw so?” Afei Saulo kae se, “Mayɛ bɔne.
San bra fie, me ba Dawid.
Efisɛ nnɛ, woama me nkwa asom wo bo.
Merenhaw wo bio.
Mayɛ nkwaseade na mafom yiye.” Dawid buae se, “Ao, ɔhene, wo peaw ni.
Ma wo mmerante no mu baako mmra mmegye.
Awurade na ɔma papayɛ ne nokwaredi so akatua.
Awurade de wo hyɛɛ me tumi ase mpo, mampɛ sɛ mekum wo, efisɛ woyɛ obi a Awurade asra wo.
Afei, me kra nsom Awurade bo, sɛnea wo de asom me bo nnɛ yi.
Onnye me mfi me haw nyinaa mu.” Na Saulo ka kyerɛɛ Dawid se, “Nhyira nka wo, me ba Dawid.
Wobɛyɛ mmaninne ne nkonimdifo kɛse.” Na Dawid kɔe, na Saulo nso san kɔɔ fie.
Dawid Wɔ Filistifo Mu Na Dawid dwen ho se, “Da bi, mɛtɔ wɔ Saulo nsa ano.
Na nea mɛyɛ a eye pa ara ne sɛ, meguan akɔ Filistifo nkyɛn.
Ɛba saa a, Saulo begyae mʼakyidi na menya bammɔ.” Na Dawid ne mmarima ahansia tutu kɔtenaa Gat kɔhyɛɛ Maok babarima ɔhene Akis ase.
Na Dawid de ne yerenom baanu a wɔyɛ Ahinoam a ofi Yesreel ne Abigail a ofi Karmel a na ɔyɛ Nabal kunabea no kɔe.
Saulo tee sɛ Dawid aguan kɔ Gat no, wanni nʼakyi anhwehwɛ no bio.
Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Akis se, “Sɛ ɛrenhaw wo a, ma yɛn baabi wɔ nkurow no bi so na yɛnkɔtena hɔ sen sɛ yɛbɛtena ahenkurow yi mu.” Enti Akis de Siklag kurow maa no, (na efi saa da no, ɛhɔ abɛyɛ Yuda ahemfo atenae de besi nnɛ), na wɔtenaa Filistifo no mu afe ne asram anan.
Afei, Dawid ne ne dɔm kɔtow hyɛɛ Gesurfo, Girsifo ne Amalekfo so.
Saa nnipa yi na na kan no, wɔtete asase a ɛtrɛw kɔ Sur a ɛwɔ Misraim kwan so no.
Dawid annyaw onipa baako anikann wɔ nkuraa a ɔkɔtow hyɛɛ wɔn so no mu.
Ɔfaa nguan, anantwi, mfurum, yoma ne ntade nyinaa ansa na ɔresan akɔ Akis nkyɛn.
Akis bisaa Dawid se, “Ɛhe na nnɛ mofom nneɛma kodui?” Dawid buae se, “Yɛkɔɔ Yuda anafo fam kɔtow hyɛɛ Yerahmeelfo ne Kenifo so.” Dawid kum wɔn nyinaa.
Wannyaw obiara a obetumi aba Gat abɛkyerɛ faako a ɔkɔe.
Saa ade yi kɔɔ so ara wɔ bere a na Dawid te Filistifo mu no.
Akis gyee Dawid dii, na ɔkaa wɔ ne tirim se, “Saa bere yi de, Israelfo bekyi no kɔkɔɔkɔ, na ɛbɛma no atena ha, na wasom me afebɔɔ.”
Saulo Kɔ Abisa Saa bere no, Filistifo no boaboaa wɔn asraafo ano sɛ wɔrebɛko atia Israel.
Akis ka kyerɛɛ Dawid se, “Merehwɛ kwan sɛ, wo ne wo mmarima bɛka me ho akɔ ɔko no.” Dawid penee so se, “Eye pa ara, wʼankasa wubehu nea wʼakoa betumi ayɛ.” Akis kae se, “Eye, mɛyɛ wo me bammɔfo afebɔɔ.” Saa bere yi na Samuel awu, ama Israel nyinaa atwa agyaadwo.
Wosiee no wɔ ɔno ara ne kurom Rama.
Saa bere no, na Saulo apam atutu ahoni ne ahonhom afi asase no so.
Filistifo no boaa wɔn ho ano, kyeree nsraban wɔ Sunem, na Saulo nso boaboaa Israelfo no nyinaa ano, kyeree nsraban wɔ Gilboa.
Bere a Saulo huu Filistifo asraafo no dodow no, osuroe; ehu hyɛɛ ne koma ma.
Obisaa Awurade nea ɔnyɛ nanso Awurade amfa adaeso anaa ntontobɔ kronkron anaa adiyifo so ammua no.
Saulo ka kyerɛɛ nʼafotufo se, “Monhwehwɛ ɔbea samanfrɛfo bi mma me, na menkɔ ne hɔ abisa.” Nʼafotufo no buae se, “Ɔbea samanfrɛfo bi wɔ En-Dor.” Enti Saulo hyɛɛ ntade afoforo a ɛnyɛ ɔhene afade, sakraa ne ho, na ɔne mmarima no mu baanu kɔɔ ɔbea no nkyɛn anadwo.
Saulo kae se, “Ɛsɛ sɛ me ne obi a wawu kasa.
Wubetumi afrɛ ne honhom ama me ana?” Ɔbea no bisae se, “Wopɛ sɛ wokum me ana?
Wunim sɛ Saulo apam asamanfrɛfo ne ahohomfrɛfo nyinaa afi asase yi so.
Adɛn nti na wusum me afiri?” Saulo de Awurade din kaa no ntam se, “Mmere dodow a Awurade te ase yi, wɔrentwe wʼaso wɔ eyi ho da.” Afei, ɔbea no bisae se, “Hena na memfrɛ no mma wo?” Obuae se, “Frɛ Samuel ma me.” Na ɔbea no huu Samuel no, ɔde nne kɛse teɛɛ mu ka kyerɛɛ Saulo se, “woadaadaa me!
Wone Saulo!” Ɔhene no ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Nsuro.
Dɛn na wuhu?” Ɔbea no buae se, “Mihu honhom bi sɛ apue afi fam reba.” Saulo bisae se, “Ɔte dɛn?” Obuae se, “Akwakoraa bi a ɔhyɛ batakari, na ɔreba.” Ɛhɔ na Saulo huu sɛ ɛyɛ Samuel, enti ɔbɔɔ ne mu ase de nʼanim butuw fam.
Samuel bisae se, “Adɛn nti na wofrɛ me de haw me saa?” Saulo buae se, “Efisɛ ɔhaw ne abɛbrɛsɛ amene me.
Filistifo de ɔko atentam yɛn.
Na Onyankopɔn nso agyaw me.
Mente ne nka wɔ adiyifo nkyɛn anaa daeso mu.
Enti mafrɛ wo sɛ kyerɛ me nea menyɛ.” Na Samuel buae se, “Sɛ Awurade agyaw wo, abɛyɛ wo tamfo a, adɛn nti na worebisa me?
Awurade ayɛ nea ɔnam me so hyɛɛ ho nkɔm no.
Wagye ahenni no afi wo nsam de ama Dawid, wo nkurɔfo no mu baako.
Awurade ayɛ saa, efisɛ woanni ne mmara a ɛfa Amalekfo ho no so.
Nea ɛka ho ne se, ɔkyena, Awurade de wo ne Israel asraafo nyinaa bɛma Filistifo, na wo ne wo mma abɛka me ho wɔ ha.
Awurade bɛma Israel asraafo no nyinaa adi nkogu.” Samuel nsɛm a Saulo tee no nti, ehu kyekyeree no ma ɔhwee fam.
Na onni ahoɔden biara, efisɛ na onnidii da mu no ne anadwo mu no nyinaa.
Ɔbea no huu adwene mu haw a ɔwɔ mu no, ɔka kyerɛɛ no se, “Owura, mede me nkwa too hɔ, yɛɛ wʼabisade.
Enti yɛ nea mɛkyerɛ wo sɛ yɛ no, na mama wo biribi adi sɛnea ɛbɛma woanya ahoɔden asan akɔ wʼakyi.” Nanso Saulo antie.
Mmarima a wɔka ne ho no hyɛɛ no sɛ onnidi.
Enti akyiri no, ɔpenee so sɔre fii fam hɔ, tenaa akongua so.
Na ɔbea no ayɛn nantwi ba ama wadɔ srade nti, ɔyɛɛ ntɛm kokum no, na ɔfɔw asikresiam, fɔtɔw de too apiti.
Ɔde aduan no besii Saulo ne ne mmarima no anim ma wodii.
Na wofii hɔ kɔɔ anadwo no.
Filistifo Pam Dawid Filistifo no boaboaa wɔn asraafo nyinaa ano wɔ Afek, na Israelfo nso kɔkyeree nsraban wɔ asuti bi ho wɔ Yesreel.
Bere a Filistifo ntuanofo de wɔn asraafo akuwakuw ɔha ɔha mu ne mpempem retu ɔsa no, na Dawid nso ne ne dɔm retu ɔsa wɔ wɔn akyi a, Akis ka wɔn ho.
Filistifo asahene no bisae se, “Dɛn na Hebrifo yi reyɛ wɔ ha?” Akis buae se, “Oyi ne Dawid, ɔbarima a oguan fii Israelhene Saulo anim no.
Waba me nkyɛn ha ne me abɛtena bɛboro afe ni.
Na efi bere a ogyaw Saulo hɔ besi nnɛ yi, minhuu ne ho mfomso biara.” Na Filistifo asahene no bo fuw no kae se, “Ma ɔbarima no nsan nkɔ, sɛnea ɔbɛkɔ faako a wode maa no no.
Ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔka yɛn ho kɔ ɔko no, efisɛ sɛ anhwɛ a, ɔbɛdan nʼani ako atia yɛn wɔ ɔko no mu.
Ɔkwan foforo bi nni hɔ a ɔbɛfa so ne ne wura Saulo aka abɔ mu a ɛbɛma no ako atia yɛn ana?
Ɛnyɛ saa Dawid yi na wɔtoo dwom faa ne ho wɔ wɔn asaw mu se: “Saulo akum ne apem apem na Dawid de, wakum mpem du du no?” Na Akis frɛɛ Dawid ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Mmere dodow a Awurade te ase yi, minhyiaa mmarima a wɔte sɛ mo, anka mepɛ sɛ mo ne yɛn kɔ ɔko, nanso Filistifo asodifo a wɔaka no mpene so.
Enti san wʼakyi na kɔ no asomdwoe mu.
Ɛno nti, nyɛ biribiara a ɛbɛhaw Filistifo no.” Dawid bisae se, “Dɛn na mayɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde me fa saa ɔkwan yi so?
Adɛn nti na ɛnsɛ sɛ meko tia me wura ɔhene no atamfo?” Nanso Akis gyinaa mu pintinn kae se, “Me nko ara me fa mu de, woyɛ pɛpɛ te sɛ Onyankopɔn bɔfo.
Nanso asahene no suro sɛ wɔde wo bɛka wɔn ho wɔ ɔko mu.
Enti sɔre anɔpahema, na wo ne wo mmarima no nkɔ bere a anim retetew no.” Na Dawid san kɔɔ Filistifo asase so, na Filistifo asraafo no nso kɔɔ Yesreel.
Dawid Tɔre Amalekfo Ase Nnansa so, Dawid ne ne mmarima koduu Siklag.
Na Amalekfo abɛtow ahyɛ Negeb so ahyew Siklag pasaa, akyekyeree mmea ne mmofra ne mpanyin a wɔwɔ mu nyinaa.
Wɔankum wɔn mu biara, mmom, wɔsoaa wɔn de wɔn kɔe.
Bere a Dawid ne ne mmarima no huu sɛnea Siklag asɛe ne asɛm a ato wɔn abusuafo no, wotwaa agyaadwo ara kosii sɛ afei na wontumi ntwa agyaadwo no bio.
Dawid yerenom baanu a wɔne Yesreelni Ahinoam ne Karmelni Abigail a na ɔyɛ Nabal yere no ka wɔn a wɔsoaa wɔn kɔe no ho.
Dawid ho yeraw no yiye, efisɛ na mmarima no adwene ho sɛ wobesiw no abo, esiane wɔn mmabarima ne wɔn mmabea a wɔakyekyere wɔn no nti.
Nanso Dawid nyaa ahoɔden wɔ Awurade, ne Nyankopɔn mu.
Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ ɔsɔfo Abiatar se, “Fa asɔfotade no brɛ me.” Na Abiatar de bae.
Na Dawid bisaa Awurade se, “Mintiw dɔm no ana?
Mɛto wɔn ana?” Awurade buaa no se, “Yiw, tiw wɔn.
Na biribiara a wɔafa afi mo nkyɛn no, mo nsa bɛka ne nyinaa.” Enti Dawid ne ne mmarima ahansia no sii kwan so.
Ankyɛ biara na woduu Besor asuwa no so.
Nanso mmarima no mu ahannu de, na wɔabrɛbrɛ yiye nti wɔantumi antwa asu no.
Ɛno nti, Dawid de asraafo ahannan a wɔaka no toaa so.
Asraafo no bi huu Misraimni barima bi wɔ wuram hɔ ma wɔde no brɛɛ Dawid.
Wɔmaa no brodo sɛ onni ne nsu sɛ ɔnnom.
Wɔsan maa no borɔdɔma ɔfam sin bi ne bobe aba ɔbɔnta, efisɛ na hwee nkaa nʼano nnansa; awia ne anadwo.
Ankyɛ na onyaa ahoɔden.
Dawid bisaa no se, “Hena nipa ne wo, na wufi he?” Obuae se, “Meyɛ Misraimni, na Amalekni bi akoa ne me.
Nnansa ni na me wura gyaw me hɔ, efisɛ na meyare.
Yɛkɔtoaa Keretifo wɔ Negeb a ɛyɛ Yudaman wɔ Kaleb asase so, na yɛhyew Siklag.” Dawid bisaa no se, “Enti wubedi mʼanim akɔ wɔn nkyɛn?” Aberante no buae se, “Sɛ wode Onyankopɔn din bɛka ntam sɛ worenkum me anaa worensan mfa me mma me wura de a, ɛno de, medi wʼanim de wo akɔ.” Na Misraimni no dii wɔn anim kɔɔ Amalekfo no atenae.
Bere a Dawid ne ne mmarima no duu hɔ no, na Amalekfo no ahwete wɔ sare no so a wɔredidi nom na wɔde ahosɛpɛw resaw, efisɛ na wɔanya asade bebree afi Filistifo nkyɛn ne Yuda asase so.
Dawid ne ne mmarima to hyɛɛ wɔn so, kunkum wɔn wɔ afoa ano anadwo mu no nyinaa, kosii adekyee no anwummere.
Amalekfo no mu biara antumi anguan, gye mmarima ahannan a wɔtenatenaa yoma so guanee no.
Dawid gyee biribiara a Amalekfo no fae, san gyee ne yerenom baanu no.
Biribiara anyera; sɛ ɛyɛ akumaa anaa ɔpanyin, abarimaa anaa abeawa anaa biribiara a wɔfae sɛ asade no, Dawid de ne nyinaa san bae.
Nʼakofo no kaa nguan ne anantwi no de wɔn bae.
Na wɔkae se, “Eyinom nyinaa yɛ Dawid asade.” Na woduu Besor asuwa no so no, wohuu mmarima ahannu a ɔbrɛ dodow nti, wɔantumi ne wɔn ankɔ no.
Dawid kyiaa wɔn anigye so.
Nanso Dawid mmarima no mu asɛmpɛfo bi kae se, “Wɔne yɛn ankɔ nti, wɔrennya asade no bi.
Momfa wɔn yerenom ne wɔn mma mma wɔn, na monka nkyerɛ wɔn se, womfi yɛn ani so nkɔ.” Nanso Dawid kae se, “Dabi, anuanom!
Monnyɛ nea Awurade de ama yɛn no ho pɛsɛmenkominya.
Wakora yɛn so, aboa yɛn ama yɛadi yɛn atamfo so nkonim.
Mugye di sɛ sɛ moka no saa a, obi betie mo?
Sɛ yɛrekyɛ a, momma yɛnkyɛ no pɛ mma wɔn a wɔkɔ ɔsa ne wɔn a wɔhwɛ akode so nyinaa.” Efi saa bere no, Dawid yɛɛ eyi mmara, maa Israel nyinaa na wɔda so di so saa ara de besi nnɛ.
Bere a Dawid duu Siklag no, ɔsoma ma wɔde asade no bi kɔmaa Yuda mpanyimfo a na wɔyɛ ne nnamfonom kae se, “Mo akyɛde a yɛfa fi Awurade atamfo nsam ni.” Wɔde akyɛde no kɔmaa wɔn a wɔwɔ Bet-El, Ramot a ɛwɔ anafo fam ne Yatir; wɔn a wɔwɔ Aroer, Sifmot, Estemoa ne Rakal ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Yerahmeelfo nkurow mu ne Kenifo kurow mu, ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Horma, Bor-Asan, Atak, Hebron ne mmeaemmeae a Dawid ne ne mmarima kyinkyinii hɔ nyinaa.
Saulo Wu Afei, Filistifo no ko tiaa Israel.
Israelfo no guanee wɔ wɔn anim, na wokunkum pii wɔ Gilboa bepɔw so.
Filistifo no kɔɔ Saulo ne ne mmabarima so, kunkum wɔn mu baasa a ɛyɛ Yonatan, Abinadab ne Malki-Sua.
Ɔko no mu yɛɛ den wɔ baabi a na Saulo wɔ hɔ.
Filistifo agyantowfo no bɛn no, na wopiraa no kɛse pa ara.
Saulo fi yaw mu ka kyerɛɛ nʼakodekurafo no se, “Twe wʼafoa no, na fa wɔ me, na wɔn a wontwaa twetia no amfa wɔn afoa ammɛwɔ me, angu mʼanim ase.” Na nʼakodekurafo no suroo sɛ ɔbɛyɛ saa.
Enti Saulo twee ɔno ankasa afoa sinaa ne ho wɔ so.
Bere a nʼakodekurafo no huu sɛ wawu no, ɔno nso sinaa ne ho wɔ nʼankasa afoa no so, na owu kaa ne ho.
Enti Saulo ne ne mma mmarima baasa, nʼakodekurafo ne nʼakofo nyinaa totɔɔ saa da no.
Bere a Israelfo a wɔwɔ Yesreel bon no fa baabi ne Yordan agya no huu sɛ Israel asraafo no adi nkogu, na Saulo nso ne ne mmabarima no nso atotɔ no, wogyaw wɔn nkurow hɔ guanee.
Na Filistifo no bɛtenaa hɔ.
Ade kyee a Filistifo koyiyii atɔfo no ho no, wohuu Saulo ne ne mmabarima baasa no amu wɔ Gilboa bepɔw so.
Enti wotwaa Saulo ti, yiyii nʼakode nyinaa.
Afei, wɔbɔɔ Saulo wu no dawuru wɔ wɔn abosomfi, ne ɔman no mu nyinaa.
Wɔde nʼakode no koguu Astoret nsɔree so, na wɔkyekyeree nʼamu no fam kuropɔn Bet-San fasu ho.
Na Yabes Gileadfo tee nea Filistifo ayɛ Saulo no, wɔn akofo twaa kwan anadwo mu no nyinaa kɔɔ Bet-San kɔfaa Saulo ne ne mmabarima baasa no amu fii ɔfasu no ho.
Wɔde kɔɔ Yabes bɛhyew wɔn.
Afei, wɔfaa wɔn nnompe kɔkoraa no odum dua no ase wɔ Yabes, na wodii mmuada nnanson.
Nhyɛnmu Samuel Nhoma ka Dawid ho asɛm.
Wosii no hene wɔ Yuda, na afei, odii hene wɔ Israelman nyinaa so .
Ɔkɔfaa Apam Adaka no baa Hyiadan no mu .
Odii nʼakofo anim, ko tiaa nʼatamfo dii wɔn nyinaa so nkonim, na ɔde Bɔhyɛ Asase so nkonimdi a Yosua fii ase no wiee nʼakodi .
Dawid yɛɛ nneɛma akɛse bebree.
Sɔhwɛ ahorow baa nʼakwan mu ma ɔyɛɛ bɔne a aguamammɔ ne awudi di mu akoten , na ɛda adi sɛ, nnipa akɛse a wɔbɔ wɔn ho mmɔden sɛ wobedi Onyankopɔn akyi no, wotumi tɔ sɔhwɛ ne bɔne mu.
Onyamesuro nkyerɛ sɛ onipa betumi atena ase ayɛ nea ɔpɛ biara.
Dawid nyaa abusua mu akwanside .
Kɛseyɛ tumi de ahantan ba sɛnea yehuu wɔ Dawid bɔneyɛ mu no.
Ɔma wɔkan ɔman no mu nnipa nyinaa sɛnea ɛbɛma wahu ne man no ahoɔden .
Nanso ɔkokodurofo yi awiei ankɔyɛ awerɛhow ntraso.
Esiane nʼahonu ne nʼayɔnkofa a ɔnam so de ne ho bɔɔ Onyankopɔn no nti, onyaa nʼasomdwoe, nanso bɔne a ɔyɛe no de, ɛho asɛm antwa .
Dawid Nyamesom pa, ne nokwaredi, ne ntoboase, nʼayamye, nʼahofama ne pɛpɛyɛ yɛ suban pa a ɛsɛ sɛ yesua.
Emu Nsɛm Dawid Nkonimdi Ahorow Dawid Akodi
Dawid Te Saulo Wu Saulo wu akyi no, Dawid san fii nkonim a odii Amalekfo so no mu bɛtenaa Siklag nnaanu.
Ne nnansa so no, ɔbarima bi fi Saulo nsraban mu a watetew ne ntade mu, atu mfutuma agu ne ti mu, de rekyerɛ sɛ ɔretwa adwo bae.
Oduu Dawid nkyɛn no, ɔdan ne ho hwee fam nidi mu.
Dawid bisaa no se, “Ɛhe na wufi?” Obuae se, “Maguan afi Israel nsraban mu.” Dawid bisaa no se, “Na ɛyɛɛ dɛn?
Ɔko no kosii dɛn?” Ɔkae se, “Mmarima no guan fii akono.
Bebree totɔe.
Na Saulo ne ne babarima Yonatan nso atotɔ.” Enti Dawid bisaa aberante a ɔbɛbɔɔ no saa amanneɛ no se, “Ɛyɛɛ dɛn na wuhuu sɛ Saulo ne ne babarima Yonatan awuwu?” Aberante no buae se, “Mikofii Gilboa bepɔw so, na mekɔtoo sɛ Saulo sɛn ne peaw so a atamfo no nteaseɛnam ne nʼapɔnkɔsotefo mmɛn no ara.
Ɔdan ne ho a ohuu me no, ɔteɛɛ mu frɛɛ me se memmra.
Mibisaa no se, ‘Menyɛ dɛn?’ “Obisaa me se, ‘Wo ne hena?’ “Mibuaa no se, ‘Meyɛ Amalekni.’ “Na ɔsrɛɛ me se, ‘Begyina me so na kum me, na me ho yeraw me yiye, na mepɛ sɛ me wu.’ “Enti migyinaa ne so kum no, efisɛ na minim sɛ tebea a ɔwɔ mu no, ɔrennya nkwa.
Na mituu nʼahenkyɛw a ɛhyɛ no no ne nʼabasa so atweaban no sɛ mede rebrɛ wo, me wura.” Dawid ne ne mmarima no tee asɛm no, wɔde awerɛhow sunsuan wɔn ntade mu.
Wotwaa ho agyaadwo, sui, bua daa da mu no nyinaa wɔ Saulo ne ne babarima Yonatan wu ne Awurade asraafo ne Israelman sɛ wɔn mu pii wuwuu saa da no.
Na Dawid bisaa aberante a ɔbɛbɔɔ wɔn saa amanneɛ no se, “Wufi he?” Na obuae se, “Meyɛ ɔhɔho Amalekni a mete mo asase so.” Dawid bisaa no se, “Na wunsuro sɛ wukum obi a Awurade asra no no?” Dawid ka kyerɛɛ ne mmarima no mu baako se, “Kum no!” Enti ɔbarima no twee nʼafoa de wɔɔ Amalekni no, kum no.
Na Dawid kae se, “Wʼano ayi mmusu ama wo ama woawu, efisɛ wo ara na wokae se woakum obi a Awurade asra no no.” Dawid Dwom A Ɔhyehyɛ Maa Saulo Ne Yonatan Na Dawid too kwadwom maa Saulo ne Yonatan.
Na ɔhyɛɛ sɛ wɔnkyerɛ nnipa a wɔwɔ Yuda nyinaa to.
Wɔtoo no din sɛ agyan dwom a wɔakyerɛw wɔ Yasar Nhoma mu.
“Wʼanuonyam ne wʼahosɛpɛw, Israel, awu da mmepɔw so!
Akofo akɛse atotɔ!
“Monnka asɛm yi wɔ Gat, na Filistifo abɔ ose!
Monnka wɔ Askelon mmɔnten so, na abosonsomfo anserew ahosɛpɛw mu.
“Gilboa mmepɔw, mma obosu anaa osu ntɔ ngu wo so anaa wo nsian so.
Efisɛ ɛhɔ na woguu ɔkofo kɛse no akokyɛm ho fi; wɔremfa ngo nsra Saulo nkatabo ho bio.
“Saulo ne Yonatan kunkum wɔn atamfo ahoɔdenfo!
Wɔamfi akono amma no nsapan.
Ɔdɔ ne ahoɔfɛ bɛn na na Saulo ne Yonatan nni, wɔn mu antetew da, nkwa ne owu mu.
Na wɔn ho yɛ hare kyɛn akɔre; na wɔn ho yɛ den kyɛn gyata.
“Israel mmabea, munsu Saulo, efisɛ ofuraa mo ntama pa, hyehyɛɛ mo sikakɔkɔɔ agude.
“Akofo akɛse atotɔ akono.
Yonatan awu da mmepɔw no so.
Misu wo, me nua Yonatan!
Na wosom me bo yiye.
Na wo dɔ a wowɔ ma me no yɛ nwonwa; emu dɔ sen ɔbea dɔ!
“Hwɛ sɛnea akofo akɛse atotɔ!
Ɔko mu akode ayerayera!”
Dawid Di Yuda So Hene Mmere no ara mu, Dawid bisaa Awurade se, “Mensan nkɔ Yuda ana?” Awurade buaa no se, “Kɔ.” Dawid bisaa no se, “Kurow bɛn na menkɔ so?” Awurade buaa no se, “Hebron.” Na Dawid yerenom ne Ahinoam a ofi Yesreel ne Abigail a ofi Karmel a na ɔyɛ Nabal yere no.
Enti Dawid ne ne yerenom, ne ne mmarima ne wɔn fifo nyinaa tu kɔɔ Yuda, na wɔkɔtenaa Hebron ne ne nkurow so.
Afei, Yuda ntuanofo kɔɔ Hebron, kɔsraa Dawid ngo sii no hene wɔ Yuda abusuakuw so.
Na bere a Dawid tee sɛ Yabes Gilead mmarima asie Saulo no, ɔsomaa abɔfo kosee wɔn se, “Awurade nhyira mo sɛ moayi nokware a ɛte saa adi, ama mo wura Saulo, na moasie no anuonyam so.
Na afei, Awurade ne mo nni no yiye na ontua mo dɔ sononko yi so ka.
Na me nso metua mo nea a moayɛ yi so ka.
Afei a Saulo awu yi, mepɛ sɛ mobɛyɛ mʼasomfo nokwafo sɛ Yudafo a wɔasra me ngo sɛ minni wɔn so hene no.” Is-Boset Di Hene Wɔ Israel Na Ner babarima Abner a na ɔyɛ Saulo safohene wɔ nʼakofo so ne Saulo babarima Is-Boset kɔɔ Mahanaim.
Ɛhɔ na osii Is-Boset hene wɔ Gilead, Yesreel, Efraim, Benyamin, Asurifo asase ne Israel nyinaa so.
Bere a Is-Boset dii ade no, na wadi mfirihyia aduanan, na odii ade fi Mahanaim mfe abien.
Na Yuda abusuakuw no dii Dawid nokware.
Dawid yɛɛ Hebron ne kuropɔn.
Na odii Yuda so hene mfirihyia ason ne fa.
Israel Ne Yuda Di Ako Da koro bi, Abner dii Is-Boset asraafo anim, fi Mahanaim kɔɔ Gibeon.
Saa bere koro no ara mu, Seruia babarima Yoab nso dii Dawid asraafo anim, fi Hebron na wohyiaa Abner wɔ Gibeon ɔtare ho.
Akuw abien no tenatenaa ase a na wodi nhwɛanim.
Afei, Abner susuw ho kyerɛɛ Yoab se, “Ma yɛmfa yɛn akofo no mu kakra, na wɔmfa wɔn nsa nni ako.” Yoab penee so kae se, “Wɔnsɔre nko ɛ.” Enti woyii mmarima dumien fii kuw biara mu sɛ wonni wɔn ho ako.
Obiara soo ne tamfo tinwi mu, de nʼafoa wowɔɔ wɔn ho wɔn ho, maa wɔn nyinaa wuwui.
Enti wɔfrɛ atɔe mu hɔ se Afoa Afuw de besi nnɛ.
Afei, nsraadɔm abien no de ɔko hyehyɛɛ so, na saa da no baa awiei no, na Dawid nsraadɔm no adi Abner ne Israel so nkonim.
Asahel Wu Na Yoab, Abisai ne Asahel a wɔyɛ Seruia mmabarima baasa no ka Dawid asraafo no ho saa da no.
Na Asahel tu mmirika te sɛ ɔforote, na ɔpam Abner ara sɛ ɔbɛkyere no.
Bere a Abner twaa nʼani huu sɛ odi nʼakyi no, ɔteɛɛ mu se, “Wo ni, Asahel!” Obuae se, “Yiw, ɛyɛ me!” Na Abner ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Ɛno de, kɔhwehwɛ obi foforo, na wone no nko.
Kɔ na kotintim mmerante no baako, na gye nʼakode a ɛwɔ ne ho nyinaa.” Nanso Asahel, kɔɔ so taa no.
Bio, Abner teɛɛ mu ka kyerɛɛ Asahel se, “Fi ha kɔ!
Sɛ mikum wo a, merentumi nhwɛ wo nuabarima Yoab anim.” Nanso Asahel antie ara, enti Abner de ne peaw no wɔɔ ne yafunu mu, maa peaw no pue fii nʼakyi.
Obu hwee fam wuu wɔ hɔ.
Na obiara a oduu atɔe mu hɔ no gyinaa dinn hwɛɛ Asahel sɛ ɔda hɔ.
Bere a Yoab ne Abisai tee asɛm a asi no, wɔkɔɔ sɛ wɔrekɔhwehwɛ Abner.
Bere a woduu Amma bepɔw a ɛbɛn Gia a ɛwɔ ɔkwan a ɛda hɔ kɔ Gibeon sare so no, na onwini adwo.
Abner asraafo a wofi Benyamin abusuakuw mu no boaa wɔn ho ano wɔ bepɔw no so yɛɛ krado maa ɔko.
Ɛhɔ na Abner teɛɛ mu, ka kyerɛɛ Yoab se, “Enti, ɛsɛ sɛ daa yɛfa afoa so de ka yɛn ntam asɛm ana?
Munnhu sɛ, saa ɔkwan no de nitan bɛto yɛn ntam ana?
Da bɛn na wobɛfrɛ wo mmarima no aka akyerɛ wɔn se, wonnyae wɔn nuanom Israelfo akyidi?” Na Yoab kae se, “Sɛ woankasa a anka, Onyankopɔn nko ara na onim nea ɛbɛba; anka yɛbɛtaa wo anadwo mu no nyinaa.” Enti Yoab hyɛn ne torobɛnto, maa ne mmarima no gyaee Israel asraafo no taa.
Anadwo mu no nyinaa, Abner ne ne mmarima nantew kɔɔ Araba.
Wotwaa Yordan bon, toaa so kɔɔ Bitron, beduu Mahanaim.
Na Yoab gyaee Abner akyidi, na ɔboaboaa ne mmarima ano.
Asahel akyi no, wohuu sɛ Dawid mmarima no mu dunkron ayera.
Nanso na Dawid mmarima no akunkum Benyaminfo no mu nnipa ahansia ne aduosia a na wɔka Abner ho no.
Wɔfaa Asahel siee no wɔ nʼagya ɔboda mu wɔ Betlehem.
Na Yoab ne ne mmarima nantew anadwo mu no nyinaa koduu Hebron adekyee.
Ɔko a ɛbɛtɔɔ wɔn a wɔwɔ Saulo afa ne wɔn a wɔwɔ Dawid afa no kyɛe yiye, na ne mfiase ni.
Bere a Dawid adedi renya ahoɔden no na Saulo adedi no resɛe.
Eyinom ne Dawid mmabarima a wɔwoo wɔn wɔ Hebron: Nʼabakan no din de Amnon a ɔyɛ Ahinoam a ofi Yesreel no babarima.
Nea ɔto so abien no din de Kileab a ɔyɛ Abigail a na ɔyɛ Nabal a ofi Karmel no kunabea babarima; nea ɔto so abiɛsa no din de Absalom a ɔyɛ Gesurhene Talmai babea Maaka babarima.
Nea ɔto so anan no din de Adoniya a ɔyɛ Hagit babarima; nea ɔto so anum no din de Sefatia a ɔyɛ Abital babarima.
Na nea ɔto so asia no din de Yitream a ɔyɛ Dawid yere Egla babarima.
Wɔwoo saa mma yi maa Dawid wɔ Hebron.
Abner Kɔdɔm Dawid Bere a na ɔko a ɛda Saulo fi ne Dawid fi no gu so no, na Abner agye din ama nʼankasa ne ho wɔ Saulo fi.
Na Saulo wɔ mpena bi a wɔfrɛ no Rispa, a ɔyɛ Aia babea.
Na Is-Boset bisaa Abner se, “Adɛn nti na wo ne mʼagya mpena dae?” Abner bo fuw yiye kae se, “Meyɛ akraman sodifo wɔ Yuda na wɔadwoodwoo me saa?
Nea mayɛ ama wo ne wʼagya, a manyi mo amma Dawid no, mʼayeyi ne sɛ, mode ɔbea yi ho asɛm rekyekyere me?
Sɛ mammoa Dawid amma ne nsa anka nea Awurade hyɛɛ ho bɔ no a, Onyankopɔn ne me nni no ɔnwene so.
Mede Saulo ahenni bɛkɔ akɔma Dawid na matim Dawid ahengua ase wɔ Israel ne Yuda so afi Dan akosi Beer-Seba.” Esiane sɛ na Is-Boset suro Abner nti, wantumi ankasa bio.
Afei, Abner tuu abɔfo kɔɔ Dawid nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no se, “Ma yɛnyɛ nhyehyɛe na mɛboa ama yɛadan Israelman mu no nyinaa ama wo.” Dawid buae se, “Ɛyɛ asɛm papa, nanso me ne wo renyɛ saa nhyehyɛe no gye sɛ, sɛ woreba a, wode me yere Mikal a ɔyɛ Saulo babea no brɛ me.” Enti, Dawid soma ma wɔkɔbɔɔ Saulo babarima Is-Boset amanneɛ se, “Ma me nsa nka me yere Mikal, efisɛ mede Filistifo ɔha nkwa na ɛtɔɔ no.” Enti Is-Boset gyee Mikal fii ne kunu Paltiel a ɔyɛ Lais babarima no nsam.
Na Paltiel de osu dii ɔbea no akyi koduu Bahurim.
Na Abner ka kyerɛɛ no se, “San kɔ fie.” Na Paltiel san kɔɔ fie.
Na Abner ne Israel ntuanofo adidi nkɔmmɔ.
Ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn se, “Mmere kakra a atwam no, na mopɛ sɛ musi Dawid ɔhene.
Bere no ni.
Efisɛ Awurade aka se, ‘Mayi Dawid sɛ onnye me nkurɔfo mfi Filistifo ne wɔn atamfo nyinaa nsam.’ ” Abner san ne Benyamin abusua mu ntuanofo kasae.
Afei, ɔkɔɔ Hebron kɔbɔɔ Dawid amanneɛ se, Israel nyinaa ne Benyamin taa wʼakyi.
Bere a Abner ne ne mmarima aduonu baa Hebron no, Dawid too wɔn pon kɛse.
Na Abner ka kyerɛɛ Dawid se, “Ma menkɔ na menkɔfrɛ Israel nnipa nyinaa na wɔmmra wʼafa.
Wɔne wo bɛyɛ apam, na wɔasi wo hene.
Na ɛbɛma woadi biribiara a wo koma pɛ so.” Enti Dawid maa Abner kɔɔ dwoodwoo.
Yoab Kum Abner Abner kɔe ara pɛ, Yoab ne Dawid asraafo no bi fi ɔsa mu bae a wokura asade bebree.
Bere a wɔka kyerɛɛ Yoab se Abner baa hɔ nkyɛe koraa, na ɔbɛsraa ɔhene, ama ɔhene ama no kɔ asomdwoe mu no, Yoab yɛɛ ntɛm kohuu ɔhene bisaa no se, “Dɛn na woayɛ yi?
Abner kɔ a womaa no kɔe yi, wokyerɛ dɛn?
Wunim pefee sɛ, ɔbaa wo so sɛ ɔkwansrafo, bɛhwehwɛɛ nea woreyɛ nyinaa mu ana?” Ɛhɔ ara, Yoab fi Dawid nkyɛn, na ɔsomaa abɔfo sɛ wontiw Abner.
Wɔkɔtoo no Sira ɔtare ho, twee no de no bae.
Nanso na Dawid nnim ho hwee.
Afei, Abner san kɔɔ Hebron no, Yoab frɛɛ no kɔɔ nkyɛn kosii ɔpon ano te sɛ nea ɔrekɔka kokoamsɛm akyerɛ no no.
Na ɛhɔ no na esiane sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔtɔ ne nuabarima Asahel so were no nti, Yoab wɔɔ Abner yafunu mu afoa ma owui.
Akyiri no a Dawid tee asɛm no, ɔkae se, “Me ne mʼaheman nnim saa asɛm a ɛfa Abner yi ho hwee wɔ Awurade anim.
Ne mogya ngu Yoab ne nʼagya fi so!
Yoab fi de, awo ntoatoaso mu nyinaa, obi a watutu akuru anaa ɔyare kwata, nea ɔnam pema ho nantew anaa nea owu afoa ano ne nea ɔsrɛsrɛ aduan rempa hɔ da.” Yoab ne ne nuabarima Abisai kum Abner, efisɛ Abner kum wɔn nuabarima Asahel wɔ akono wɔ Gibeon.
Dawid Su Abner Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Yoab ne nnipa a wɔka ne ho no nyinaa se, “Munsunsuan mo ntama mu, na mumfura atweaatam.
Muntwa Abner ho agyaadwo.” Na ɔhene Dawid ankasa dii santen a wɔato no akyi, kɔɔ ɔda no so.
Wosiee Abner wɔ Hebron, na ɔhene Dawid ne nnipa no nyinaa suu wɔ ne da no ho.
Afei, ɔhene too saa kwadwom yi maa Abner: “Ɛsɛ sɛ Abner wu sɛnea nkwaseafo wu ana?
Wɔankyekyere wo nsa; wɔangu wo nan nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn.
Dabi, wodii wo awu; amumɔyɛfo atirimpɔw so ade.” Nnipa no nyinaa suu Abner bio.
Da a wɔreyɛ ayi no, Dawid annidi da mu no nyinaa, maa afei, obiara srɛɛ no se onnidi.
Nanso na Dawid aka ntam se, “Sɛ mididi ansa na owia akɔtɔ a, Onyankopɔn nkum me.” Eyi sɔɔ nnipa no ani yiye.
Nokware, biribiara a ɔhene no yɛe no sɔɔ ɔmanfo no ani.
Eyi maa obiara a ɔte Yuda ne Israel no huu sɛ, ɛnyɛ ɔhene Dawid na okum Abner.
Na ɔhene Dawid bisaa ɔmanfo no se, “Munhu sɛ ɔkannifo kɛse ne onipa kɛse atɔ fam nnɛ wɔ Israel ana?
Na ɛwɔ mu sɛ me ne ɔhene a wɔasra no de, nanso Seruia mmabarima Yoab ne Abisai de, wɔyɛ den dodo ma me sɛ metumi aka wɔn ahyɛ.
Ɛno nti, Awurade ntua saa mmarima amumɔyɛfo yi so ka wɔ wɔn amumɔyɛsɛm ho.”
Is-Boset Wu Bere a Is-Boset tee sɛ Abner awu wɔ Hebron no, nʼaba mu bui, na saa ara nso na ne nkurɔfo no bɔɔ huboa.
Afei, na anuanom baanu a wɔn din de Baana ne Rekab na na wɔyɛ asafohene ma Is-Boset akofo no.
Na wɔyɛ Rimon a ofi Benyamin fi wɔ Beerot kurow mu no mmabarima.
Wɔfa no sɛ kurow Beerot ka Benyamin ho, efisɛ wɔn a na wɔte Beerot mmere bi no guan kɔɔ Gitaim a wɔda so te hɔ sɛ ahɔho de besi nnɛ yi.
Na Saulo babarima Yonatan wɔ ɔbabarima bi a ne din de Mefiboset a na ɔyɛ obubuafo fi ne mmofraase.
Wokum Saulo ne Yonatan wɔ Yesreel akono no, na abofra no adi mfe anum.
Bere a ɔko no ho asɛm duu kurow no mu no, obi a ɔhwɛ abofra no kyekyeree no de no guanee.
Nanso bere a ɔreguan no, ɔhwee ase maa abofra no bɔɔ fam, ma ɔyɛɛ obubuafo.
Da bi, Beerotni, Rimon mmabarima baanu a wɔn din de Rekab ne Baana kɔɔ Is-Boset fi awia bere mu a na ɔregye nʼahome.
Wowuraa mu kɔɔ ne pia mu te sɛnea wɔrekɔpɛ awi, kɔwɔɔ ne yafunu mu afoa.
Afei Rekab ne Baana wiawiaa wɔn ho guanee.
Ansa na wɔbɛkɔ no, wotwaa ne ti bere a ɔda ne mpa so.
Wɔfaa ne ti no kotwaa Yordan bon no, nantew anadwo mu no nyinaa kɔe.
Wɔde Is-Boset ti no brɛɛ Dawid wɔ Hebron, na wɔka kyerɛɛ ɔhene no se, “Wo tamfo Saulo a anka ɔrehwehwɛ wo akum wo no babarima Is-Boset ti ni.
Nnɛ, Awurade ama me wo aweretɔ ho kwan atia Saulo ne nʼabusua.” Na Dawid buaa Beerotni Rimon mma Rekab ne ne nua Baana se, “Mmere dodow a Awurade a ogyee me fii ɔhaw ne abɛbrɛsɛ mu te ase yi, mɛka nokware akyerɛ mo.
Bere a onipa bi bɛka kyerɛɛ me se, ‘Saulo awu’ a na osusuw sɛ ɔreka asɛm pa akyerɛ me no, mekyeree no kum no wɔ Siklag.
Nʼasɛm a ɔbɛka kyerɛɛ me no so akatua a mede maa no ne no.
Na akatua bɛn na memfa mma amumɔyɛfo a wɔakum obi a ne ho nni asɛm wɔ ne fi bere a ɔda ne mpa so?
Ɛnsɛ sɛ mibisa ne mogya fi mo nsam ana?” Enti Dawid hyɛɛ ne mmarima ma wokunkum wɔn.
Wotwitwaa wɔn nsa ne wɔn anan, na wɔde asin no sensɛn Hebron ɔtare ho.
Na wɔfaa Is-Boset ti no kosiee no wɔ Abner ɔboda mu wɔ Hebron.
Dawid Di Israel Nyinaa So Hene Afei, Israel mmusuakuw no nyinaa kɔɔ Dawid nkyɛn wɔ Hebron kɔka kyerɛɛ no se, “Yɛn nyinaa yɛ wʼabusuafo.
Mmere bi a atwa mu no a mpo, na Saulo yɛ yɛn hene no, wo ara na wudii Israel anim.
Na Awurade aka akyerɛ wo se, ‘Wobɛyɛ me manfo Israel so guanhwɛfo.
Wobɛyɛ wɔn kannifo.’ ” Enti Dawid ne Israel ntuanofo no yɛɛ apam wɔ Hebron Awurade anim.
Na wɔsraa no ngo sii no Israelhene.
Dawid dii ade no, na wanya mfirihyia aduasa.
Na odii ade mfirihyia aduanan.
Ɔtenaa Hebron dii ade wɔ Yuda so mfirihyia ason ne asram asia.
Na ɔtenaa Yerusalem no nso, odii Israel ne Yuda nyinaa so hene mfirihyia aduasa abiɛsa.
Dawid Ko Fa Yerusalem Dawid dii nʼakofo anim kɔɔ Yerusalem kɔko tiaa Yebusifo.
Yebusifo no dii wɔn ho fɛw se, “Morentumi mma ha.
Na mpo, anifuraefo ne mmubuafo betu mo afi ha.” Efisɛ na Yebusifo no dwene sɛ wɔwɔ bammɔ.
Nanso Dawid ko faa Sion aban no a mprempren wɔfrɛ no Dawid Kuropɔn no.
Bere a animka nkra fi bammɔfo a wɔwɔ kurow no mu duu Dawid asom no, ɔka kyerɛɛ ne dɔm no se, “Momfa nsudorobɛn no mu nkɔ kurow no mu, na monkɔsɛe Yebusifo mpakye ne anifuraefo no, efisɛ mikyi wɔn!
Ɛno nti na wɔka se, ‘Anifuraefo ne mpakye’ renkɔ ahemfi” no.
Enti Dawid yɛɛ nʼatenae wɔ abandennen na ɔfrɛɛ hɔ Dawid Kuropɔn no mu.
Osisii bammɔ adan bebree twaa kurow no ho kaa ho.
Wofii dwumadi no ase wɔ Milo de baa mu.
Na Dawid kɔɔ so yɛɛ kɛse adekyee biara, efisɛ na Asafo Awurade Nyankopɔn ka ne ho.
Afei, Tirohene Huram somaa abɔfo kɔɔ Dawid nkyɛn a nnua dwumfo ne abo adansifo ka wɔn ho sɛ wonkosi ahemfi mma no.
Huram de sida nnua bebree kɔɔ hɔ sɛ wɔmpae.
Na Dawid huu sɛ, ne nkurɔfo Israelfo nti, Awurade asi no hene, na wayɛ nʼaheman kɛse.
Dawid tu fi Hebron baa Yerusalem no, ɔwaree mmea bebree, faa mpenanom nso.
Ɛno nti, ɔwoo mmabarima ne mmabea bebree.
Eyinom ne Dawid mmabarima a wɔwowoo wɔn wɔ Yerusalem no: Samua, Sobab, Natan, Salomo Yibhar, Elisua, Nefeg, Yafia Elisama, Eliada ne Elifelet.
Dawid Di Filistifo So Nkonim Bere a Filistifo tee sɛ wɔasra Dawid, de no asi Israelhene no, wɔboaboaa wɔn asraafo ano, kɔhwehwɛɛ Dawid sɛ wobenya no akyere no.
Na Dawid tee no, ɔno nso kɔɔ ne ban mu.
Afei, Filistifo no beduu Refaim bon mu, na wɔtrɛtrɛw wɔn ho mu wɔ hɔ.
Enti Dawid bisaa Awurade se, “Menkɔtow nhyɛ Filistifo yi so ana?
Wobɛdan wɔn ahyɛ me nsa ana?” Awurade buaa no se, “Yiw, kɔ na mɛdan Filistifo no ahyɛ wo nsa.” Enti Dawid kɔɔ Baal-Perasim, na ɛhɔ na odii Filistifo no so nkonim.
Ɔkae se, “Awurade ayɛ!
Ɔbɔ wuraa mʼatamfo no mu sɛ nsuyiri a ɛworo so!” Enti Dawid too beae hɔ din se Baal-Perasim.
Filistifo no gyaw wɔn ahoni wɔ hɔ, maa Dawid ne ne mmarima no soaa ne nyinaa kɔe.
Filistifo no san baa bio bɛtrɛtrɛw wɔn ho mu wɔ Refaim bon ho, enti Dawid bisaa Awurade nea ɔnyɛ.
Awurade buae se, “Nkɔ tee, mmom, twa fa wɔn ho wɔ wɔn akyi, na tow hyɛ wɔn so wɔ baka nnua no anim.
Na sɛ wote nnyigyei te sɛ nsrabɔ bi wɔ baka nnua no atifi a, bɔ toa wɔn!
Ɛkyerɛ sɛ, Awurade atu di wʼanim rekokunkum Filistifo no.” Enti Dawid yɛɛ nea Awurade ka kyerɛɛ no no, na ɔsɛee Filistifo no fi Geba de kosii Geser.
Wɔde Apam Adaka No Kɔ Yerusalem Na Dawid boaboaa Israel mmabun a wɔn ho mmu wɔn dwɛ mpem aduasa ano.
Odii wɔn anim fi Baala a ɛwɔ Yuda, sɛ wɔrekɔfa Onyankopɔn Adaka, a ekura Awurade Tumfo no a wɔde no asi kerubim ntam no din.
Wɔde Onyankopɔn Adaka no sii teaseɛnam foforo so, de fii Abinadab fi a na ɛwɔ bepɔw so no bae.
Usa ne Ahio a na wɔyɛ Abinadab mmabarima no na na wɔkyerɛ teaseɛnam foforo no a na Onyankopɔn Adaka no si mu no kwan.
Na Ahio na odi anim.
Dawid ne Israel manfo gyee wɔn ani wɔ Awurade anim wɔ ahoɔden so a wɔreto nnwom, na wɔde asanku, mmɛnta, akasae, mfirikyiwa ne kyɛnkyɛn nenam mu.
Na woduu Nakon awiporowbea no, nantwi no nan totoe, maa Usa teɛɛ ne nsa soo Onyankopɔn Adaka no mu sɛ ɔreteɛ no.
Na Awurade bo fuw Usa sɛ ɔyɛɛ saa, na Onyankopɔn bɔɔ no ma owu daa adaka no ho.
Dawid nso bo fuw, efisɛ Awurade abufuw atia Usa.
Ɔtoo saa beae hɔ din Peres-Usa a ase ne abufuwhyew a etia Usa.
Wɔfrɛ hɔ saa ara de besi nnɛ.
Afei, na Dawid suro Awurade nti obisaa se, “Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na Awurade adaka no bɛba me nkyɛn?” Na Dawid yɛɛ nʼadwene sɛ, ɔremma Awurade Adaka no so nkɔ Dawid Kuropɔn no mu.
Na mmom, ɔmaa so de kɔɔ Obed-Edom a ɔyɛ Gatni fi.
Na Awurade adaka no sii Gatni Obed-Edom fifo nkyɛn asram abiɛsa, na Awurade hyiraa no ne ne fi mu nnipa nyinaa.
Afei, wɔka kyerɛɛ ɔhene Dawid se, “Esiane Awurade Adaka no nti, Awurade ahyira Obed-Edom fi ne biribiara a ɔwɔ so.” Enti Dawid kɔɔ hɔ kɔfaa Adaka no, de osebɔ kɛse baa Dawid Kuropɔn no mu.
Nnipa a na wɔso Awurade Adaka no tuu anammɔn asia pɛ, wogyinaa hɔ twɛnee, sɛnea Dawid betumi de nantwi ne nantwi ba a wadɔ srade abɔ afɔre.
Na Dawid fii nʼahoɔden nyinaa mu saw wɔ Awurade anim a na ɔhyɛ asɔfotade yuu.
Enti Dawid ne Israel nyinaa de nteɛteɛmu ne ntorobɛntohyɛn maa Awurade Adaka no so kɔe.
Mikal Ka Dawid Anim Bere a wɔde Awurade Adaka no rewura Dawid Kuropɔn no mu no, Saulo babea a ne din de Mikal no kɔtɛwee mfɛnsere mu hwɛe.
Ohuu sɛ ɔhene Dawid rehuruhuruw, resaw anigye so wɔ Awurade anim no, nʼani annye.
Wɔde Awurade Adaka no kosii nʼafa wɔ ntamadan a ɛno nti, Dawid asi no mu, na Dawid bɔɔ ɔhyew afɔre ne asomdwoe afɔre wɔ Awurade anim.
Owiei no, ohyiraa nkurɔfo no wɔ Asafo Awurade din mu.
Afei, ɔmaa Israel dɔm no mu onipa biara brodo mua, namkum ne bobe aba ɔfam.
Na wɔn mu biara kɔɔ ne fi.
Bere a Dawid san kɔɔ ne fi sɛ ɔrekohyira ne fifo no, Mikal fii adi ba behyiaa no ka kyerɛɛ no abufuw so se, “Nnɛ de, na Israelhene nsɛ ha!
Ɔpaa ne ho kyerɛɛ ne mfenaa te sɛ nea obiara a ommu ne ho bɛyɛ no ara pɛ.” Dawid buaa Mikal se, “Na meresaw wɔ Awurade a oyii me, na otwaa wʼagya ne nʼabusuafo gyawee no anim.
Oyii me sɛ menyɛ Israel a wɔyɛ Awurade nkurɔfo ɔkannifo.
Ɛno nti, ɛyɛ me pɛ sɛ meyɛ me ho sɛ ɔkwasea, sɛnea ɛbɛma makyerɛ mʼahokeka a mewɔ wɔ Awurade mu.
Yiw, na mepɛ sɛ meyɛ ɔkwasea koraa sen eyi, na mmeawa koro yi ara a woreka wɔn ho asɛm yi bɛhyɛ me anuonyam.” Na Saulo babea Mikal anwo ba da wɔ ne nkwa nna nyinaa.
Onyankopɔn Hyɛ Dawid Bɔ Bere a wɔbɔɔ ɔhene no atenase wɔ nʼahemfi na Awurade ama asomdwoe aba asase no so no, Dawid frɛɛ odiyifo Natan se, “Hwɛ, mete ahemfi a wɔde sida asi mu, na Onyankopɔn Adaka no nso si ntamadan mu.” Na Natan buaa ɔhene no se, “Biribiara a woadwene ho sɛ wobɛyɛ no, kɔ so na yɛ, na Awurade ka wo ho.” Na anadwo no, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Natan se, “Kɔka kyerɛ me somfo Dawid se, ‘Sɛnea Awurade se ni: Wone obi a ɛsɛ sɛ wusi dan ma me na metena mu ana?
Efi bere a mede Israelfo fi Misraim bae de besi nnɛ no, mentenaa ɔdan mu da.
Daa wotu mʼase fi baabi kɔ baabi.
Bere biara a wotu mʼase a Israelman nyinaa ka me ho no, motee sɛ mibisaa wɔn sodifo, wɔn a mehyɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnhwɛ me nkurɔfo Israelfo no se, “Adɛn nti na momfaa sida nsii ofi mmaa me da?” ’ “Afei, kɔka kyerɛ me somfo Dawid se, ‘Sɛnea Asafo Awurade se ni: Miyii wo fii mmoa adidibea ne nguan akyidi mu, de wo besii me nkurɔfo Israel so hene.
Na baabiara a wokɔ no, meka wo ho, na matwa wʼatamfo nyinaa afi wʼanim.
Na mɛma woagye din wɔ asase yi nyinaa so.
Na mama me nkurɔfo Israelfo no baabi a wɔbɛtena afebɔɔ.
Beae bi a ɛwɔ bammɔ a obiara renhaw wɔn.
Ɛhɔ bɛyɛ wɔn ankasa asase a aman amumɔyɛfo renhyɛ wɔn so, sɛnea wɔyɛɛ bere bi a atwa mu no, efi bere a mepaw atemmufo sɛ wonni me nkurɔfo so no.
Mɛsan ama mo bammɔ afi mo atamfo nyinaa nsam.
“ ‘Na Awurade aka akyerɛ wo se, ɔno Awurade na ɔbɛkyekyere ofi ama wo; ahemfo ntoatoaso fi.
Na sɛ wo nna to twa a, mɛma wʼaseni a ofi wʼasen mu adi wʼade, na matim nʼaheman ase.
Ɔno ne obi a obesi dan de me din ato so.
Na matim nʼaheman mu ahengua ase afebɔɔ.
Mɛyɛ nʼagya, na wayɛ me Ba.
Sɛ ɔyɛ bɔne a, mɛma aman bi atwe nʼaso.
Nanso, merenyi me dɔ mfi ne so da, sɛnea miyi fii Saulo a miyii no fii wʼanim no so ansa na wubedii nʼade no.
Wo fi ne wʼahenni betim wɔ mʼanim afebɔɔ; na wʼahengua betim daa nyinaa.’ ” Enti Natan san kɔɔ Dawid nkyɛn kɔkaa nsɛm a Awurade aka no nyinaa kyerɛɛ no.
Dawid Aseda Mpaebɔ Na ɔhene Dawid kɔtenaa Awurade anim bɔɔ mpae se, “Awurade Tumfo, me ne hena, na me fifo yɛ dɛn a wode me abedu nnɛ?
Na afei Otumfo Awurade, eyinom nyinaa akyi no, woka sɛ wobɛma me ahenni a ɛte hɔ daa.
Woyɛ nnipa nyinaa sɛɛ ana, Awurade Tumfo?
“Dɛn bio na metumi aka?
Efisɛ wunim wʼakoa, Awurade Tumfo.
Wʼasɛm ne wo pɛ mu nti, woayɛ nneɛma kɛse yi nyinaa akyerɛ wo somfo.
“Wo kɛseyɛ yɛ kokuroo, Awurade Tumfo!
Obiara nte sɛ wo, Onyankopɔn bi nni hɔ sɛ wo, na yɛntee onyame foforo bi mpo ho asɛm ɛ!
Ɔman bɛn na ɛwɔ asase yi so a ɛte sɛ Israel?
Ɔman foforo bɛn na woayi no afi nkoasom mu de wɔn ayɛ wo man?
Bere a wuyii wo nkurɔfo fii Misraim no, wugyee din.
Woyɛɛ anwonwade a ɛyɛ hu de pam aman ne ahoni ahorow a na wɔyɛ akwanside ma wo nkurɔfo no.
Woasi wo nkurɔfo Israel sɛ wʼankasa wʼade afebɔɔ, na wo, Awurade, woabɛyɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn.
“Na afei, Awurade Nyankopɔn, di bɔ a wohyɛ faa wʼakoa ne ne fi ho no so.
Ma ɛnyɛ bɔhyɛ a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa, na ama wo din akorɔn afebɔɔ.
Na nnipa bɛka se, ‘Asafo Awurade yɛ Israel so Nyankopɔn.’ Na ma wo somfo Dawid ahenni ase ntim wɔ wʼanim.
“Asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn, masi me bo abɔ saa mpae yi efisɛ woakyerɛ sɛ wobɛkyekye ofi a ɛyɛ daa ahenni ama me.
Awurade Tumfo, woyɛ Onyankopɔn!
Wo nsɛm mu wɔ ahotoso, na woahyɛ wo somfo nnepa ho bɔ.
Afei, ma ɛnyɛ wo pɛ sɛ wubehyira wʼakoa fi so, na atoa so afebɔɔ wɔ wʼanim, na wo, Awurade, woakasa, na wo nhyira a wode behyira wo somfo fi no bɛyɛ daapem nhyira.”
Dawid Akodi Mu Nkonimdi Akyiri no, Dawid dii Filistifo no so, brɛɛ wɔn ase.
Ɔko gyee Gat a ɛyɛ wɔn kuropɔn kɛse no.
Dawid san dii Moabfo so.
Ɔmaa nnipa no dedaa fam, na ɔde hama susuw wɔn.
Osusuw hama no abien a, na wakyerɛ sɛ wonkum saa nnipa no.
Ɛnna osusuw hama no baako a, na wakyerɛ sɛ wonnyaa saa nkurɔfo no.
Enti Moabfo a wonyaa wɔn ti didii mu no bɛyɛɛ Dawid asomfo a na afe biara woyi tow brɛ no.
Dawid sɛe Rehob babarima Hadadeser a na odi hene wɔ Soba no akofo, bere a Hadadeser kɔɔ Asubɔnten Eufrate ho, pɛe sɛ ɔkɔhyɛ ne nniso mu den no.
Dawid kyeree ne nteaseɛnam apem, nteaseɛnamkafo mpem ason ne asraafo a wɔnam mpem aduonu.
Dawid twitwaa nteaseɛnam apɔnkɔ no nyinaa nantin ntin, na ogyaw mu ɔha pɛ.
Bere a Aramfo a wofi Damasko baa sɛ wɔrebɛboa Sobahene Hadadeser no, Dawid kum wɔn mu mpem aduonu.
Na ɔde asraafo a wɔyɛ bansifo kɔtenaa Damasko, maa Aramfo bɛyɛɛ Dawid nkurɔfo a na woyi tow brɛ no.
Baabiara a Dawid bɛkɔ no, Awurade ma no di nkonim.
Dawid de Hadadeser asraafo mpanyimfo sikakɔkɔɔ nkatabo no baa Yerusalem.
Ɔde Beta ne Berotai a na ɛyɛ Hadadeser nkurow no mu kɔbere bebree kaa ne ho kɔe.
Bere a Hamathene Toi tee sɛ Dawid atɔre Hadadeser asraafo no ase pasaa no, ɔsomaa ne babarima Yoram kɔɔ Dawid nkyɛn, kokyiaa no maa no mo.
Na Hadadeser ne Toi yɛ atamfo fi teteete a wɔako atia wɔn ho wɔn ho mpɛn pii.
Yoram kɔkyɛɛ Dawid nneɛma bebree a ɛyɛ, dwetɛ, sikakɔkɔɔ ne kɔbere mfrafrae.
Ɔhene Dawid too akyɛde no nyinaa din de maa Awurade a, dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ a onya fii aman bi a odii wɔn so no nyinaa ka ho.
Saa aman no ne Edom, Moab, Amon, Filistia, Amalek ne nea efi Sobahene Rehob babarima Hadadeser nkyɛn nso.
Eyi maa Dawid gyee din.
Ɔsan nʼakyi kɔe no, okunkum Edomfo mpem dunwɔtwe wɔ Nkyene Bon mu.
Ɔde asraafo bansifo tuatuaa Edom nyinaa ano.
Na Edomfo nyinaa bɛyɛɛ Dawid nkoa.
Eyi yɛ nhwɛso foforo a ɛkyerɛɛ nkonim a Awurade maa Dawid dii wɔ baabiara a ɔkɔe no.
Dawid dii Israel nyinaa so hene, a wanhyɛ obiara so na wansisi obiara nso.
Seruia babarima Yoab na na ɔyɛ ɔsafohene.
Ahilud babarima Yehosafat na na ɔyɛ adehye abakɔsɛmkyerɛwni.
Sadok a na ɔyɛ Ahitub babarima ne Abiatar babarima Ahimelek na na wɔyɛ asɔfo.
Na Seraia yɛ asennii kyerɛwfo.
Yehoiada babarima Benaia na na odi Keretifo ne Peletifo so, na Dawid mmabarima tua asɔfodɔm ano.
Dawid Yɛ Mefiboset Adɔe Da bi, Dawid pɛɛ sɛ obehu sɛ obi aka wɔ Saulo fi ana.
Efisɛ na wahyɛ Yonatan bɔ sɛ ɔbɛyɛ wɔn adɔe.
Ɔfrɛɛ ɔbarima bi a wɔfrɛ no Siba a na anka ɔfra Saulo asomfo mu.
Na ɔhene bisaa no se, “Wo na wɔfrɛ wo Siba no ana?” Obuaa no se, “Yiw, me ne Siba no.” Ɔhene no bisaa no se, “Obi aka wɔ Saulo fi ana?
Sɛ ɛte saa a mepɛ sɛ mɛyɛ wɔn adɔe a efi Onyankopɔn wɔ ɔkwan biara a metumi so.” Siba buaa ɔhene se, “Yonatan babarima obubuafo bi da so wɔ hɔ.” Ɔhene bisae se, “Ɔwɔ he?” Siba buae se, “Ɔwɔ Amiel babarima Makir fi wɔ Lo-debar.” Na ɔhene Dawid ma wɔkɔfaa no fii Amiel babarima Makir fi wɔ Lo-debar, de no brɛɛ no.
Ne din de Mefiboset, a ɔyɛ Yonatan babarima ne Saulo nena.
Ɔbaa Dawid anim no, ɔde ahopopo kotow no, kae se, “Meyɛ wo somfo.” Dawid ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Nsuro, na nea ɛbɛyɛ biara no, esiane wʼagya Yonatan nti, mɛyɛ wo adɔe.
Nsase a na ɛyɛ wo nena Saulo agyapade no nyinaa, mɛsan de ama wo, na woadidi me didipon so daa daa.” Mefiboset bɔɔ ne mu ase kae se, “Hena ne me, ɔkraman funu a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ me saa adɔe yi?” Ɔhene frɛɛ ne somfo Siba, ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Mede biribiara a na ɛyɛ Saulo ne ne fifo agyapade no nyinaa ama wo wura Saulo nenabarima no.
Wo ne wo mmabarima ne mo asomfo na mobɛdɔw asase no, ayɛ so mfuw ama no, na wanya aduan ama ne fifo.
Na Mefiboset de, ɔne me bɛtena mʼahemfi ha.” Na Siba a na ɔwɔ mmabarima dunum ne asomfo aduonu no buae se, “Me wura pa, asɛm a woaka akyerɛ me no nyinaa, medi so.” Na efi saa bere no, Mefiboset ne Dawid didii daa te sɛnea ɔyɛ nʼasen mu ba.
Na Mefiboset wɔ ɔba abarimaa bi a ne din de Mika.
Na efi saa bere no, Siba fifo nyinaa bɛyɛɛ Mefiboset asomfo.
Na Mefiboset a ɔyɛ obubuafo no tu kɔɔ Yerusalem kɔtenaa ahemfi hɔ.
Dawid Di Amonfo So Nkonim Akyiri no, Amonfo hene Nahas wui.
Ne babarima Hanun na odii nʼade sɛ ɔhene.
Dawid kae se, “Mɛyɛ Nahas babarima Hanun adɔe, sɛnea nʼagya yɛɛ me adɔe no.” Nʼagya wu nti, Dawid tuu abɔfo kɔɔ ne nkyɛn kɔmaa no hyɛden.
Bere a Dawid abɔfo baa Amonfo asase so no, Amonfo atitiriw no kobisaa wɔn wura Hanun se, “Wugye di sɛ ba a Dawid somaa nʼabɔfo baa wo nkyɛn bɛmaa wo hyɛden no kyerɛ nidi ampa ara ana?
Wunnye nni sɛ Dawid somaa wɔn akwansra so, sɛ wɔmmɛhwɛ wo kuropɔn na wɔabetu agu?” Ɛno nti, Hanun kyeree Dawid abɔfo no, yii obiara abogyesɛ fa, twitwaa wɔn ntade to mfimfini hɔ, tutuu mu, na wogyaa wɔn kwan, ma wɔde animguase kɔe.
Bere a wɔbɔɔ Dawid amanneɛ no, otuu abɔfo ma wokohyiaa mmarima no, efisɛ woguu wɔn anim ase yiye.
Ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ wɔn se, “Montena Yeriko kosi sɛ mo abogyesɛ befuw ansa na moasan aba.” Bere a Amonfo huu sɛ wɔahyɛ Dawid abufuw no, wɔkɔbɔɔ Aramfo asraafo mpem aduonu paa fii Bet-Rehob ne Soba.
Saa ara na Maakahene nso maa wɔn mmarima apem fii ne nkyɛn, na Tob nso wonyaa mmarima mpem dumien.
Dawid tee saa no, ɔkaa Yoab ne akofo asraafo guu mu.
Amonfo no gyinaa wɔn kurow pon ano.
Saa bere no na Aramfo a wofi Soba ne Rehob ne mmarima a wofi Tob ne Maaka no wɔ mfikyiri baabiara retwɛn ɔtamfo no.
Bere a Yoab huu sɛ ɔrebɛko akofanu no, oyii asraafo a wɔyɛ nnam.
Ɔno ara dii wɔn so safohene, dii wɔn anim, kɔko tiaa Aramfo no wɔ mfikyiri hɔ.
Ogyaw asraafo no nkae hɔ, de wɔn hyɛɛ ne nuabarima Abisai nsa sɛ ɔsafohene a ɔbɛkɔ akotua Amonfo no.
Yoab ka kyerɛɛ ne nuabarima no se, “Sɛ Aramfo no yɛ den dodo ma me a, ɛyɛ a, bɛboa me.
Na sɛ Amonfo no nso yɛ den dodo ma wo a, me nso, mɛba abɛboa wo.
Ma wo bo nyɛ duru.
Ma yɛnko akokoduru so mfa nnye yɛn nkurɔfo ne Onyankopɔn nkurow.
Awurade pɛ nyɛ hɔ.” Bere a Yoab ne nʼakofo no tow hyɛɛ Aramfo no so no, wofii ase guanee.
Na Amonfo no huu sɛ Aramfo no reguan no, woguan fii Abisai ho kɔhyɛɛ kurow no mu.
Ɔko no gui no, Yoab san kɔɔ Yerusalem.
Afei, Aramfo no huu sɛ ɛnyɛ wɔn afɛ ne Israelfo.
Enti wɔboaa wɔn ho ano bio.
Aram asraafo foforo bi bɛkaa wɔn ho a Hadadeser na ɔsoma ma wɔkɔfaa wɔn fii Asubɔnten Eufrate fa nohɔ bae.
Saa asraafo no beduu Helam a Sobak na na ɔyɛ wɔn ɔsahene, na ɔyɛ ɔsahene a otua Hadadeser asraafo nyinaa ano nso.
Bere a Dawid tee nea ɛreba no, ɔboaboaa Israel nyinaa ano, de wɔn twaa Asubɔnten Yordan, dii asraafo no anim, koduu Helam.
Ɛhɔ na Aramfo no fifii wɔn mpasua so tow hyɛɛ Dawid so.
Nanso Aramfo no guan fii Israelfo no anim bio.
Saa bere no, Dawid asraafo no kunkum nteaseɛnamkafo ahanson ne apɔnkɔsotefo mpem aduanan a Sobak a na ɔyɛ wɔn sahene no ka ho.
Bere a ahemfo a wɔhyɛ Hadadeser ase no huu sɛ Israel adi wɔn so nkonim no, wɔmaa wɔn nsa so, na wɔbɛyɛɛ Israelfo nkoa.
Ɛno akyi no, Aramfo suroo sɛ wɔbɛboa Amonfo.
Dawid Ne Batseba Asusowbere a edi so no mu, bere a ɛsɛ sɛ ahemfo kɔ ɔsa no, Dawid somaa Yoab ne Israel asraafo nyinaa sɛ wɔnkɔsɛe Amonfo.
Wokotuaa kuropɔn Raba ano, na Dawid de, ɔkaa Yerusalem.
Da bi anwummere a Dawid ayi nʼani so kakra no, ɔsɔre fii ne mpa so nantew faa nʼahemfi no atifi.
Ogyina hɔ no, ohuu ɔbea bi sɛ ɔreguare.
Na ɔbea no ho yɛ fɛ yiye; na Dawid somaa obi sɛ onkobisa ne ho nsɛm.
Ɔbarima no bɛkae se, “Ɛyɛ Eliam babea Batseba, a ɔyɛ Hetini Uria yere.” Na Dawid tuu abɔfo sɛ wɔnkɔfrɛ no mmrɛ no.
Ɔbaa Dawid nkyɛn.
Dawid ne no dae.
(Odwiraa ne ho fii ne nsabu mu no, na ɛnkyɛe.)
Afei, ɔsan kɔɔ fie.
Bere a Batseba huu sɛ wanyinsɛn no, ɔsoma ma wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ Dawid.
Enti Dawid soma kɔɔ Yoab nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no se, “Fa Hetini Uria brɛ me.” Bere a Uria duu Dawid nkyɛn no, obisaa gyinabea a Yoab ne asraafo no wɔ mu ne sɛnea ɔko no rekɔ so.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ Uria se, “Kɔ fie na kɔhome.” Na mpo, Uria fii ahemfi hɔ no, Dawid soma ma wɔde akyɛde bi kɔmaa no.
Nanso Uria ankɔ fie.
Ɔne ɔhene asomfo no bi tenaa ahemfi pon no ano.
Bere a Dawid tee nea Uria ayɛ no, ɔfrɛɛ no bisaa no se, “Dɛn na ɛhaw wo?
Wufii fie akyɛ na adɛn na woankɔ hɔ nnɛra anadwo?” Uria buae se, “Apam Adaka no ne Israel asraafo ne Yuda tete ntamadan mu, na Yoab nso ne ne mpanyimfo abɔ atenae wɔ wuram baabi petee mu.
Na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na matumi akɔ fie akɔnom nsa, adidi na me ne me yere akɔda?
Meka ntam se merenyɛ eyi na madi ho fɔ.” Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Eye, tena ha anadwo yi, na ɔkyena wobɛkɔ asraafo no mu.” Enti Uria tenaa Yerusalem da no ne nʼadekyee.
Na Dawid frɛɛ no adidi ne ɔnom aponto, na ɔmaa no nsa ma ɔbowee.
Na ɛno mpo, Uria ankɔ fie ankohu ne yere.
Ɔdaa ahemfi no kwan ano bio.
Dawid Hyehyɛ Uria Wu Ho Ade kyee anɔpa no, Dawid kyerɛw krataa maa Uria sɛ ɔmfa nkɔma Yoab.
Krataa no mu nsɛm kyerɛɛ Yoab se, “Ma Uria nkɔ akono baabi a ɔko no ano yɛ den pa ara.
Wo de, san wʼakyi, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a, wobekum no.” Enti Yoab maa Uria kogyinaa baabi a ɛbɛn kurow no fasu, a ɛhɔ na onim sɛ atamfo no mmarima a wɔyɛ den no reko.
Ɛhɔ na wokum Hetini Uria ne Israel asraafo no bebree.
Na Yoab de ɔsa mu amanneɛ kɔbɔɔ Dawid.
Ɔka kyerɛɛ nʼabɔfo no se, “Monka ɔsa mu nsɛm no nyinaa nkyerɛ ɔhene.
Nanso ebia ne bo befuw, ama wabisa se, ‘Adɛn nti na asraafo no kɔbɛn kurow no pɛɛ saa?
Na wonnim sɛ wɔbɛtow agyan afi afasu no mu?
Ɔbeabasia antow awiyammo ammɔ Gideon babarima Abimelek wɔ Tebes ankum no?’ Afei, monka nkyerɛ no se, wɔakum Hetini Uria nso.” Enti abɔfo no kɔɔ Yerusalem kɔbɔɔ ɔsa no mu amanneɛ kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛnea Yoab somaa no sɛ ɔnkɔka no.
Abɔfo no ka kyerɛɛ Dawid se, “Mmarima no bu faa yɛn so, na wotiaa yɛn petee mu de, nanso yepiaa wɔn kɔɔ kurow no pon ano.
Ɛhɔ na agyantowfo tow wʼasomfo fii ɔfasu ho, maa ɔhene mmarima no bi wuwui.
Na wo somfo Hetini Uria nso awu.” Dawid ka kyerɛɛ abɔfo no se, “Monka nkyerɛ Yoab se ɔmmma nʼaba mu mmu, na ɔko mu de obiara tumi wu.
Monyere mo ho nko ɔkoden na munni kuropɔn no so nkonim.” Bere a Batseba tee sɛ ne kunu awu no, osuu no.
Na osu no akyi no, Dawid soma ma wɔkɔfaa no baa ne fi.
Ɔbɛyɛɛ ne yere, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima.
Na nea Dawid yɛe no ansɔ Awurade ani.
Natan Ka Dawid Anim Awurade somaa odiyifo Natan kɔɔ Dawid nkyɛn.
Oduu hɔ no ɔkae se, “Na mmarima baanu bi te kurow bi so.
Na mmarima no mu baako yɛ ɔdefo, na nea ɔka ho no nso yɛ ohiani.
Na ɔdefo no wɔ nguan ne anantwi bebree, ohiani no de, na onni hwee ka oguan bere ketewa bi a ɔtɔɔ no no ho.
Ɔyɛn no maa ɔne ɔno ankasa mma nyin bɔɔ mu.
Na ɔne aboa no di nʼaduan, nom fi ne kuruwa mu, na nna mu nso, na daa ɔda nʼabasa so.
Na ɔte sɛ ne babea.
“Da koro bi, ɔhɔho bi baa ɔdefo no nkyɛn, nanso wankum ne nguan anaa ne nantwi annoa aduan amfa ansom no hɔho.
Na mmom, ɔkɔkyeree ohiani no guanbere no, de yɛɛ aduan maa ɔhɔho a wabɛsoɛ no no.” Dawid tee asɛm no, ne bo fuw saa ɔbarima no yiye, na ɔka kyerɛɛ Natan se, “Mmere dodow a Awurade te ase yi, ɛfata sɛ ɔbarima a ɔyɛɛ saa no wu.
Ɛsɛ sɛ otua oguan bere no ka mmɔ ho anan sɛ ɔyɛɛ bɔne saa a wannya ahummɔbɔ biara.” Ɛhɔ ara, Natan ka kyerɛɛ Dawid se, “Wone saa ɔbarima no!
Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn, se, ‘Mesraa wo sɛ Israelhene, gyee wo fii Saulo tumi ase.
Mede ne fi ne ne yerenom ne Israel ne Yuda ahemman maa wo.
Na sɛ na ɛno nnɔɔso a, anka mɛma wo bebree aka ho.
Adɛn nti na woabu Awurade asɛm animtiaa, na woayɛ bɔne a ɛte saa?
Woakum Hetini Uria, awia ne yere.
Efi nnɛ rekɔ, afoa na ɛbɛyɛ ahunahunade ama wo fifo, efisɛ woabu me animtiaa, afa Hetini Uria yere de no ayɛ wo yere.’ “Esiane nea woayɛ yi nti, me Awurade, mɛma wʼankasa fi mufo asɔre atia wo.
Mede wo yerenom bɛma ɔbarima foforo, na ɔne wɔn bɛda ama obiara ahu.
Woyɛɛ eyi wɔ kokoa mu, nanso mɛma nea ɛreba wo so no ada gua, ama Israel nyinaa ahu.” Dawid Gye Ne Bɔne To Mu Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Natan se, “Mayɛ bɔne atia Awurade.” Natan buae se, “Awurade ayi wo bɔne no afi wo so.
Worenwu.
Nanso sɛ woama Awurade atamfo kwan sɛ wommu no animtiaa, ngu ne din ho fi nti, ɔba a wɔbɛwo no ama wo no bewu.” Natan kɔɔ ne fi ara pɛ, Awurade maa abofra a Uria yere Batseba wo maa Dawid no yaree denneennen.
Dawid srɛɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ ɔmma abofra no ntena ase.
Ɔkyen ho kɔm, na ɔkɔɔ fi, na anadwo mu no nyinaa, furaa atweaatam, daa fam tim.
Mpanyimfo a wɔwɔ ne fi srɛɛ no sɛ ɔnsɔre na ɔne wɔn nnidi, nanso wampene.
Ne nnanson so, abofra no wui.
Na Dawid afotufo no suro sɛ wɔbɛbɔ no amanneɛ sɛ abofra no awu, efisɛ na wɔn adwene ne se, “Bere a na abofra no te ase no, yɛkasa kyerɛɛ Dawid, nanso wantie yɛn.
Na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na yɛatumi aka akyerɛ no se abofra no awu?
Anhwɛ a, ɔbɛyɛ ne ho biribi.” Na Dawid huu sɛ nʼafotufo no reyɛ huhuhuhu no, ɔtee nka sɛ abofra no awu.
Obisae se, “Abofra no awu ana?” Wobuae se, “Yiw, wawu.” Na Dawid sɔre fii fam hɔ.
Afei, oguare wiee a ɔpetee ne ho aduhuam, na ɔsesaa ne ntade no, ɔkɔɔ Awurade fi kɔsɔree.
Afei, ɔkɔɔ nʼankasa fi, na ɔno ankasa ka ma wɔbrɛɛ no aduan, na odidii.
Nʼafotufo no bisaa no se, “Nea woreyɛ yi, ase ne dɛn?
Bere a abofra no te ase no, wudii mmuada, twaa agyaadwo.
Na afei a wawu no mmom na woasɔre adidi!” Obuae se, “Bere a na abofra no da so te ase no de, midii abuada, twaa agyaadwo.
Medwenee sɛ, ‘Hena na onim?
Ebia, Awurade behu me mmɔbɔ ama abofra no atena.’ Na afei a wawu yi, adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ midi abuada?
Metumi asan de no aba nkwa mu bio ana?
Mɛkɔ ne nkyɛn da bi, na ɔno de, ɔrensan mma me nkyɛn ha da.” Na Dawid kyekyeree ne yere Batseba werɛ, na ɔne no dae.
Onyinsɛnee, woo ɔbabarima, na wɔtoo no din Salomo.
Awurade pɛɛ abofra no asɛm, na ɔde asɛm faa odiyifo Natan so se, ɛsɛ sɛ abofra no din yɛ Yedidia, efisɛ na Awurade dɔ no.
Dawid Ko Fa Raba Saa bere no, na Yoab ne Israel asraafo no ako afa Amon ahenkurow Raba no nnommum.
Yoab somaa abɔfo kɔɔ Dawid nkyɛn, kɔka kyerɛɛ no se, “Mako atia Raba, afa nea wonya wɔn nsu fi.
Afei, fa asraafo a wɔaka no bra na wonwie adwuma no, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a, wubenya nkonimdi anuonyam no sen sɛ ɛbɛyɛ me de.” Enti Dawid dii nʼakofo a wɔaka no anim kɔɔ Raba kɔfaa hɔ.
Dawid tuu ɔhene no ahenkyɛw, na nnipa no de hyɛɛ Dawid.
Wɔde sikakɔkɔɔ na ɛyɛɛ ahenkyɛw no a aboɔdenmmo bobɔ mu a, na ɛkari nsania ani kilogram aduasa anan.
Dawid fow asade bebree wɔ kuropɔn no mu.
Ɔsan faa nnipa a wɔwɔ Raba no sɛ nkoa, hyɛɛ wɔn, ma wɔde ɔwan, pinkase ne mmonnua yɛɛ adwuma wɔ ntayaa fononoo ho.
Saa ara na ɔne nnipa a wɔwɔ Amon nkurow nyinaa so dii no.
Na Dawid ne nʼakofo san kɔɔ Yerusalem.
Amnon To Tamar Mmonnaa Na Dawid babarima Absalom wɔ nuabea bi a na ne ho yɛ fɛ yiye.
Na saa ɔbea no din de Tamar.
Na Amnon a ɔyɛ ne nuabarima no kɔn dɔɔ no.
Amnon tuu nʼani sii Tamar so ara kosii sɛ ɛbɔɔ no yare.
Na ɔyɛ ɔbabun nti, na na ɛyɛ sɛ Amnon rentumi nyɛ no hwee.
Na Amnon wɔ adamfo onifirifo bi a wɔfrɛ no Yonadab.
Na ɔyɛ Dawid nuabarima Simea babarima.
Da koro bi, Yonadab bisaa Amnon se, “Asɛm bɛn na aba?
Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔhene babarima yɛ bosaa anɔpa biara saa?” Na Amnon buaa no se, “Medɔ Tamar, Absalom nuabea no.” Yonadab kae se, “Eye, mɛkyerɛ wo nea wobɛyɛ.
San kɔ na kɔda wo mpa so, na hyɛ da yɛ sɛnea woyare no.
Sɛ wʼagya behu wo a, ka kyerɛ no se ɔnka nkyerɛ Tamar, na ɔmmɛyɛ aduan bi mma wo nni.
Ka kyerɛ no se, sɛ ɔno brɛ wo aduan di a, wo ho bɛtɔ wo.” Enti Amnon patuw yaree.
Na ɔhene no bɛsraa no no, Amnon ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Mesrɛ wo, ma Tamar mmɛhwɛ me, na ɔnnoa biribi mma minni.” Dawid penee so, somaa Tamar kɔɔ Amnon fi, kɔnoaa aduan maa no.
Bere a Tamar duu Amnon fi hɔ no, ɔkɔɔ ɔdan a na ɔda mu no mu, sɛnea sɛ Tamar refɔtɔw asikresiam a obehu.
Enti ɔtoo brodo sononko bi maa no.
Nanso ɔde aduan no guu apampaa so besii nʼanim no, wampɛ sɛ odi.
Na Amnon ka kyerɛɛ nʼasomfo a wɔwɔ hɔ no se, “Obiara mfi ha nkɔ!” Enti wɔn nyinaa kɔe.
Afei, ɔka kyerɛɛ Tamar se, “Fa aduan no brɛ me wɔ me pia mu, na bubu hyɛ mʼano.” Enti Tamar maa so de kɔɔ hɔ.
Na bere a ogu so de rema no no, ɔtow hyɛɛ ne so, na ɔkae se, “Wo ne me nna, me nuabea ɔdɔfo.” Na Tamar teɛɛ mu se, “Dabi da, onuabarima!
Nyɛ saa amumɔyɛde yi!
Nyɛ me saa!
Wunim sɛ, sɛ woyɛ a, ɛyɛ bɔne kɛse wɔ Israel.
Na ɛhe na anka mede saa aniwu no bɛfa?
Na wɔbɛka sɛ, wo nso woyɛ nkwaseafo akɛse a wɔwɔ Israel no mu baako.
Mesrɛ wo, ka biribi kɛkɛ kyerɛ ɔhene, na ɔbɛma woaware me.” Nanso Amnon ampene so.
Na esiane sɛ ɔwɔ ahoɔden sen Tamar nti, ɔtoo no mmonnaa.
Ɛhɔ ara, Amnon dɔ no dan ɔtan.
Ɔtan no mu yɛɛ den sen ɔdɔ a na ɔdɔ no no.
Ɔteɛteɛɛ mu se, “Fi ha kɔ ntɛm!” Tamar nso teɛteɛɛ mu se, “Dabi da.
Sɛ worepam me afi ha mprempren no yɛ bɔne kɛse koraa sen nea woayɛ me dedaw no.” Nanso Amnon ampɛ sɛ obetie no.

Na ɔhyɛ batakari tenten fɛfɛ bi sɛnea na amanne kyerɛ wɔ ɔhene babea a ɔyɛ ɔbabun ho no.
Nanso Tamar sunsuan ne batakari no mu, de nsõ guu ne ti mu.
Afei, ɔde ne nsa kataa nʼani, de osu sii kwan so.
Ne nuabarima Absalom huu no bisaa no se, “Wo nuabarima Amnon ne wo ada ana?

Mfa saa asɛm yi nhyɛ wo koma mu.” Na Tamar tenaa ase sɛ ankonam werɛhonibea wɔ Absalom fi.
Bere a ɔhene Dawid tee asɛm no, ne bo fuw yiye.

Absalom Tɔ Amnon So Were Mfe abien akyi, da koro bi a na wɔretwitwa Absalom nguan ho nwi wɔ Baal-Hasor a ɛbɛn Efraim hye so no, Absalom too nsa frɛɛ ɔhene mmabarima nyinaa sɛ wɔmmra hɔ.

Ɔhene ne nʼasomfo bɛba abɛka me ho ana?” Ɔhene buae se, “Dabi, me ba.
Ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛn nyinaa kɔ; yɛbɛyɛ ɔhaw ama wo.” Ɛwɔ mu sɛ Absalom hyɛɛ no de, nanso wampene sɛ ɔbɛkɔ, na ohyiraa no kosɛkosɛ.
Na Absalom kae se, “Sɛ saa na ɛte de a, ma me nuabarima Amnon mmɛka yɛn ho.” Ɔhene no bisaa no se, “Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔbɛka mo ho?” Nanso ɔhyɛɛ no nti, ɔmaa Amnon ne ahenemma no nyinaa bɛkaa ne ho.

Munnsuro.
Me ara na mahyɛ mo sɛ monyɛ saa.
Momfa akokoduru nyɛ.” Enti Absalom mmarima no yɛɛ Amnon saa, sɛnea Absalom hyɛɛ wɔn no.
Afei, ahene mmabarima no nyinaa sɔre tenatenaa wɔn mfurum so, na woguanee.

Ɛyɛ Amnon nko ara.” Saa bere no, na Absalom aguan.

Wo mma no reba sɛnea mekae no.” Ankyɛ na wobedui a, wɔretwa adwo, tew nisu, na ɔhene ne ne mpanyimfo nso twaa agyaadwo.

Boa me!” Ɔhene no bisaa no se, “Ɛyɛ asɛm bɛn?” Obuaa no se, “Meyɛ okunafo.
Me mma baanu twaa wɔn ho koe, a na obiara nni hɔ a ɔbɛpata wɔn.
Ɔbaako bɔɔ ɔbaako kum no.

Kɔ fie na mɛhwɛ sɛ obiara remfa ne nsa nka no.” Ɔkae se, “Me wura, meda wo ase.
Mmoa a wode ama me yi nti, sɛ obi kasa tia wo a, mɛfa ho sobo no.” Ɔhene no kae se, “Mma eyi nhaw wo.
Sɛ nnipa bi mpene a, fa wɔn brɛ me wɔ ha.
Na metumi ama wo awerehyɛmu sɛ, obiara renwiinwii wɔ ho bio.” Afei, ɔbea no kae se, “Fa Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn, no din ka ntam kyerɛ me sɛ, woremma obiara ntɔ me babarima no so were.
Menhwehwɛ mogyahwiegu bio.” Ɔhene no nso kae se, “Mmere dodow a Awurade te ase yi, wo ba no tinwi a ɛwɔ ne ti so mu baako mpo ho renka.” Afei, ɔbea no kae se, “Ma wo somfo nka biribi nkyerɛ me wura ɔhene.” Obuae se, “Kɔ so kasa.” Ɔbea no bisae se, “Adɛn nti na wonyɛ mma Onyankopɔn nkurɔfo sɛnea wɔahyɛ bɔ sɛ wobɛyɛ ama me no.
Woabu wo ho fɔ sɛ woasi saa gyinae yi.
Wompɛ sɛ woma wʼankasa wo ba a wɔatwa no asu no ba fie.
Nea ɛte biara no, obiara bewu.
Na sɛnea nsu hwie gu fam a wosesaw a ɛnyɛ yiye no, saa ara na nkwa te.
Ɛno nti na Onyankopɔn san de yɛn ba ne nkyɛn bere a yɛatew yɛn ho afi ne ho no.
Wɔn a ɔhwɛ wɔn no, ɔmma wɔnnhwere wɔn kra; enti wo nso, ɛnsɛ sɛ woyɛ saa.
“Na maba sɛ merebedi ama me babarima, efisɛ wɔde owu hunahuna me ne me ba no.
Meka kyerɛɛ me ho se, ‘Ebia, ɔhene betie me, na wagye yɛn afi wɔn a wobetwa yɛn afi Onyankopɔn nkurɔfo ho no nsam.’ “Yiw, ɔhene no bɛma yɛn asomdwoe bio.
‘Minim sɛ wote sɛ Onyankopɔn bɔfo a wubetumi ahu papa ne bɔne ntam nsonoe.
Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn, nka wo ho.’ ” Ɔhene no ka kyerɛɛ ɔbea no se, “Mepɛ sɛ mihu ade baako; mfa nhintaw me.” Ɔbea no kae se, “Ɛyɛ dɛn asɛm, me wura?” “Yoab na ɔsomaa wo ha ana?” Ɔbea no buae se, “Me wura, Daasebrɛ, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na matwa eyi ho atoro?
Obiara ntumi mfa biribiara nhintaw wo.
Ɛyɛ nokware sɛ Yoab na ɔsomaa me, na ɔkyerɛɛ me asɛm a menka.
Ɔyɛɛ saa, sɛnea mɛfa ɔkwan foforo so de saa asɛm yi ato wʼanim.

Dawid Guan Fi Yerusalem Ankyɛ, ɔbɔfo bi baa Yerusalem bɛka kyerɛɛ ɔhene Dawid se, “Israel nyinaa atu di Absalom akyi sɛ wɔayɛ adɔm atia wo.” Ɛhɔ ara, Dawid ka kyerɛɛ ne mmarima se, “Monyɛ no ntɛm na yenguan mfi ha, ansa na wadu ha, sɛnea amanehunu bɛpare yɛn ne Yerusalem kurow mu no nyinaa.” Nʼafotufo no buae se, “Yegyina wʼakyi.
Biribiara a wugye di sɛ eye no, yɛ.” Enti ɔhene no ne ne fifo sii mu kɔɔ prɛko pɛ a wannyaw biribiara wɔ akyi sɛ ne mpenanom du bi a wɔbɛhwɛ nʼahemfi no so.
Ɔhene no ne ne nkurɔfo no faa fam, na wɔfaa kuropɔn no fa bi, maa Dawid asraafo no betwaa wɔn ho dii wɔn anim.

Wuduu ha nnɛra nko ara.
Na ɛsɛ sɛ mehyɛ wo na wo ne yɛn kyin ana?
Me mpo, minnim baabi a yɛbɛkɔ.

Na Husai a ofi Arki a ɔyɛ Dawid adamfo no, kɔɔ Absalom nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no se, “Ɔhene nkwa so!
Ɔhene nkwa so!” Na Absalom bisaa Husai se, “Eyi ne ɔkwan a wode wʼadamfo Dawid fa so?
Adɛn nti na wo ne wʼadamfo ankɔ?” Husai ka kyerɛɛ Absalom se, “Mewɔ ha efisɛ meyɛ adwuma ma ɔbarima a Awurade ne Israel ayi no.
Nea ɛka ho bio ne sɛ, hena na ɛsɛ sɛ mesom no?
Sɛnea mesom wʼagya no, saa ara na mɛsom wo.” Absalom dan ne ho bisaa Ahitofel se, “Dɛn bio na menyɛ?” Ahitofel buaa no se, “Kɔ na wo ne wʼagya mpenanom no nna, efisɛ wagyaw wɔn hɔ sɛ wɔnhwɛ ahemfi hɔ.
Ɛno bɛma Israel nyinaa ahu sɛ, woabu no animtiaa a ɛboro nkabom so, na wɔde wɔn ho bɛma wo.” Enti wosii ntamadan wɔ ahemfi no atifi baabi a obiara behu, na Absalom kɔɔ ntamadan no mu, na ɔne nʼagya mpenanom no dae.
Absalom tiee Ahitofel afotu sɛnea Dawid yɛe no pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Na asɛm biara a efi Ahitofel anom bae no mu nyansa no yɛɛ sɛnea efi Onyankopɔn anom.
Ahitofel ka kyerɛɛ Absalom se, “Meyi asraafo mpem dumien, na mafi ha anadwo yi akɔtaa Dawid.
Mɛto no wɔ bere a ɔbrɛ nti, nʼaba mu abu.
Ɔne nʼakofo nyinaa bɛbɔ hu na wɔaguan.
Ɔhene no nko ara na mɛbɔ no ahwe, na mede nnipa no asan abrɛ wo.
Onipa a wohwehwɛ no no wu bɛma wɔn nyinaa asan aba; nnipa no mu biara ho rentɔ kyima.” Saa nhyehyɛe yi sɔɔ Absalom ne Israel mpanyimfo nyinaa ani.
Husai Tia Ahitofel Afotu Mu Nanso Absalom kae se, “Momfrɛ Husai a ofi Arki no mmra na yentie nea ɔwɔ ka.” Husai bae no, Absalom kaa nea Ahitofel aka no kyerɛɛ no.
Afei obisaa no se, “Wʼadwene ne dɛn?
Yɛmfa Ahitofel afotu no ana?
Na sɛ ɛnte saa a, kyerɛ yɛn wʼadwene.” Husai buaa Absalom se, “Afotu a Ahitofel ama wo no nnye saa bere yi.
Wunim wʼagya ne ne dɔm; wɔyɛ akofo akɛse, na wɔn ho yɛ hu sɛ sisi a wɔawia ne mma.
Ɛno da nkyɛn a, wʼagya nim de wɔ akodi mu; ɔne nʼakofo no rentena anadwo yi.
Sesɛɛ mpo, wakɔtɛw ɔbodan bi mu anaa baabi foforo.
Na sɛ odi kan tow hyɛ mo so a, nea ɔbɛte biara no bɛka se, ‘Wɔakunkum asraafo a wodi Absalon akyi no.’ Na sɛ ɛba saa a, ɔsraani a ɔyɛ nnam a ne koma te sɛ gyata no koraa, ehu bɛma wabɔ hu.
Na Israel nyinaa nim sɛ wʼagya yɛ ɔkofo, na wɔn a wɔka ne ho no nso koko yɛ duru.
“Enti mitu wo fo sɛ, boa Israel nyinaa ano, efi Dan kosi Beer-Seba.
Woyɛ saa a wubenya asraafo a wɔn dodow bɛyɛ sɛ mpoano nwea.
Na migye di sɛ wʼankasa bedi asraafo no anim.
Na sɛ yehu Dawid a, yɛbɛtow ahyɛ no so, sɛnea obosu gu asase so, a ɔno ne mmarima no mu baako mpo nka.
Na sɛ Dawid aguan kɔ kuropɔn bi so a, wode Israel asraafo nyinaa bɛkɔ hɔ.
Afei, yebetumi afa ntampehama de atwe kurow no afasu, akogu obon a ɛbɛn mu, kosi sɛ ɔbo biara a ɛwɔ mu no bɛyam.” Afei, Absalom ne Israel mpanyimfo nyinaa kae se, “Husai afotu no ye sen Ahitofel de no.” Efisɛ Awurade ahyehyɛ sɛ Ahitofel afotu pa a ɔde ama no bɛsɛe, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a, ɔhaw ne abɛbrɛsɛ bɛba Absalom so.
Husai Bɔ Dawid Kɔkɔ Sɛ Onguan Na Husai kɔkaa asɛm a Ahitofel aka ne ɔno ankasa adwenkyerɛ no kyerɛɛ asɔfo Sadok ne Abiatar.
Ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn se, “Ntɛm!
Monkɔhwehwɛ Dawid, na monka nkyerɛ no se, ɔnntena Asubɔnten Yordan aworoe so hɔ anadwo yi.
Ɛsɛ sɛ otwa kɔ sare no so akyi, anyɛ saa a, ɔne nʼakofo nyinaa bewuwu.” Yonatan ne Ahimaas tenaa En-Rogel, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a, wɔrenkɔ kurow no mu na wɔnnsan mpue.
Na wɔayɛ nhyehyɛe bi sɛ abaawa bi de nkra a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde kɔma ɔhene Dawid no bɛbrɛ wɔn.
Nanso abarimaa bi huu wɔn sɛ wɔrefi En-Rogel akɔ Dawid nkyɛn nti, ɔkɔka kyerɛɛ Absalom.
Na woguan kɔɔ Bahurim, maa ɔbarima bi de wɔn kosiee abura bi a ɛwɔ nʼadiwo mu.
Ɔbarima no yere de ntama kataa abura no so, de atoko guu so te sɛnea ɔrehata no owia so, na obiara ansusuw sɛ nnipa hyɛ abura no mu.
Bere a Absalom mmarima no duu hɔ no, wobisaa ɔbea no se, “Woahu Ahimaas ne Yonatan ana?” Obuaa wɔn se, “Na wɔwɔ ha de, nanso wɔatwa asuwa no kɔ.” Absalom mmarima no hwehwɛɛ wɔn, nanso wɔanhu wɔn nti, wɔsan kɔɔ Yerusalem.
Afei mmarima baanu no fii abura no mu, de mmirika kɔɔ ɔhene Dawid nkyɛn kɔbɔɔ no amanneɛ se, “Fi ha twa asu no ntɛm anadwo yi!” Wɔkaa Ahitofel afotu a ɛbɛma wɔakyere no akum no no kyerɛɛ no.
Enti Dawid ne nnipa no nyinaa tutuu so, kotwaa Yordan.
Eduu adekyee no, na obiara atwa Yordan kɔ nʼagya.
Ahitofel huu sɛ nʼanim agu ase, efisɛ wɔamfa nʼafotu no, ɔhyehyɛɛ nʼafurum tenaa ne so, kɔɔ ne kurom.
Ɔtotoo ne nneɛma yiye, na ɔkɔsɛn ne ho.
Enti owu ma wosiee no wɔ nʼagya ɔda mu.
Ankyɛ na Dawid duu Mahanaim.
Saa bere no na Absalom aboaboa Israel asraafo no nyinaa ano a odi wɔn anim rekotwa Asubɔnten Yordan.
Absalom yii Amasa de no tuaa asraafo no ano, sii Yoab a na anka ɔyɛ Dawid sahene no anan mu.
Amasa yɛ ɔbarima bi a wɔfrɛ no Yitra, a ɔyɛ Israelni a ɔwaree Abigail a ɔyɛ Nahas babea, na ɔyɛ Seruia nuabea, a ɔyɛ Yoab na ba.
Israelfo no ne Absalom tenaa Gilead asase so.
Na Dawid duu Mahanaim no, Nahas a ofi Raba babarima Sobi Amonni no, kyiaa no fɛw so.
Saa ara na Amiel a ofi Lo-debar babarima Makir ne Gileadni Barsilai a ofi Rogelim nso gyee no fɛw so.
Wɔbrɛɛ no kɛtɛ, nkuku ne nkaka, atoko, asikresiam, nkyewe, asɛ ne asedua, ɛwo ne nufusu ani srade ne anantwi nufusu a akyenkyen mua.
Wɔde brɛɛ Dawid ne ne nkurɔfo a wɔka ne ho no.
Na wɔkae se, “Mo nyinaa moabrɛbrɛ, na ɔkɔm ne osukɔm de mo efisɛ moanantew kwan tenten wɔ sare so.”
Absalom Nkogu Ne Ne Wu Afei, Dawid yiyii asahene ne asafohene dii nʼakofo anim.
Yoab na na otua wɔn mu nkyemu abiɛsa mu baako ano.
Yoab nuabarima Abisai a na ɔyɛ Seruia babarima na na otua nkyemu abiɛsa mu baako nso ano.
Ɛnna nkyemu abiɛsa mu baako a aka no, Gatni Itai na na otua ano.
Ɔhene no ka kyerɛɛ nʼakofo no se, “Me ne mo na ɛrekɔ.” Nanso ne mmarima no tiaa mu denneennen se, “Ɛnsɛ se wokɔ bi.
Na sɛ ɛba sɛ, ɛsɛ sɛ yegyae, na yeguan, na sɛ mpo, yɛn mu fa koraa wuwu a, ɛrennu Absalom asraafo no ho hwee.
Wo ara na wɔbɛhwehwɛ.
Wo nko ara yɛ yɛn mu mpem du, enti eye sɛ wobɛtena kurom na sɛ mmoa bi ho hia yɛn a, wode bɛba.” Ɔhene penee so se, “Sɛ modwene sɛ ɛno ne adwene pa de a, mate.” Enti okogyinaa kurow no pon ano, bere a asraafo no rekɔ no.
Na ɔhene no hyɛɛ Yoab, Abisai ne Itai se, “Me nti mo ne abofra Absalom nni no bɔkɔɔ.” Na asraafo no nyinaa tee saa ɔhyɛ a ɔhene hyɛɛ nʼasafohene no.
Enti ɔko no fii ase wɔ Efraim kwae mu.
Na Dawid mmarima no yɛɛ Israel asraafo no pasaa.
Ɛyɛ afoa ano kum, na da no, mmarima mpem aduonu na wɔhweree wɔn nkwa.
Ɔko no didi kɔɔ nkurow so, na esiane kwae no nti, nnipa pii wuwu sen wɔn a wowuwuu wɔ afoa ano no.
Ɔko no gyina mu no, Absalom puee prɛko pɛ wɔ Dawid mmarima no bi mu.
Ɔpɛɛ sɛ oguan wɔ nʼafurumpɔnkɔ so, nanso oguan kɔfaa ɔdɔtɔ bi mu wɔ odum bi ase.
Ɔdɔtɔ no kyekyeree ne tinwi, ma ɔkaa mu.
Nʼafurumpɔnkɔ no de, na kɔ ara na ɔrekɔ enti, ogyaw no hɔ a, ɔsensɛn ɔdɔtɔ no mu a ɔretow donko wɔ wim.
Dawid mmarima no baako huu asɛm a asi no, ɔka kyerɛɛ Yoab se, “Mihuu Absalom sɛ ɔsensɛn dua bi so wɔ ɔdɔtɔ mu.” Yoab bisae se, “Asɛm pa ara?
Wuhuu no na woankum no?
Anka mɛma wo dwetɛ gram ɔha ne dunan ne akokoduru nkyekyeremu sɛ siade.” Ɔbarima no buae se, “Sɛ anka wobɛma me dwetɛ kilogram dubaako ne fa koraa a, anka merenyɛ saa.
Yɛn nyinaa tee sɛ, ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ wo, Abisai ne Itai se, ‘Me nti, obiara nnyɛ aberante Absalom bɔne.’ Na sɛ mibu ɔhene asɛm so kum ne babarima a, anka nea ɛbɛyɛ biara, ɔhene bɛhwehwɛ nea ɔyɛɛ saa.
Na anka wʼankasa ne onipa a anka wubeyi me ama.” Yoab kae se, “Merentwentwɛn me nan ase mma wo wɔ eyi ho.” Enti, ɔtwee mpɛmɛ abiɛsa de wowɔɔ Absalom koma mu bere a na ɔsensɛn odum no so a na onwui no.
Yoab akodekurafo no mu mmerante du twaa Absalom ho hyiae, na wokum no.
Na Yoab hyɛn torobɛnto, maa asraafo no gyaee Israel taa.
Wɔfaa Absalom amu no tow kyenee amoa donkudonku bi mu wɔ kwae mu hɔ, na wɔsoaa abotan guu ne so.
Na Israelfo no nyinaa guan kɔɔ wɔn afi.
Bere a Absalom te ase no, osii nkaedum bi wɔ ɔhene bon mu de kaee ɔno ara ne ho, efisɛ ɔdwenee se, “Minni ɔbabarima biara a ɔbɛyɛ nkae ade biara de akae me din.” Ɔde nkaedum no too ne ho, na wɔfrɛ no Absalom Nkaedum de besi nnɛ.
Dawid Su Absalom Na Sadok babarima Ahimaas kae se, “Momma mintu mmirika nkɔbɔ ɔhene amanneɛ sɛ, Awurade ayi no afi atamfo nsam.” Na Yoab nso ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Sɛ ɔhene ba awu a, ɛnyɛ asɛm papa mma no.
Wubetumi akɔbɔ saa amanneɛ no da foforo bi, na ɛnyɛ nnɛ.” Na Yoab ka kyerɛɛ Kusni bi se, “Kɔ na kɔka nea woahu no kyerɛ ɔhene.” Ɛhɔ ara na Kusni no bɔɔ ne mu ase wɔ Yoab anim, na otuu mmirika kɔe.
Bio, Sadok babarima Ahimaas ka kyerɛɛ Yoab se, “Nea ɛbɛba biara mmra, ma me ne Kusni no nkɔ.” Nanso Yoab bisaa no se, “Me ba, adɛn nti na wopɛ sɛ wokɔ?
Wunni amanneɛbɔ biara a ɛbɛma wo abasobɔde biara.” Ɔkae se, “Mepene so, nanso ma menkɔ.” Enti Yoab ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Kɔ!” Na Ahimaas faa tataw no so kɔ kotwaa Kusni no ho.
Bere a Dawid te kurow no pon ano no, ne wɛmfo no kɔɔ kurow no pon no atifi wɔ ɔfasu no so.
Ɔtoo nʼani no, ohuu sɛ obi de mmirika reba.
Ɔwɛmfo no teɛɛ mu ka kyerɛɛ Dawid na ɔhene no buae se, “Sɛ ɔno nko ara na ɔnam de a, ebia, na ɔde asɛm pa nam.” Bere a ɔsomafo no rebɛn no, ɔwɛmfo no huu sɛ ɔbarima foforo nso di so reba, na ɔteɛɛ mu se, “Hwɛ onipa foforo bi de mmirika reba!” Ɔhene no kae se, “Ebia na ɔno nso de asɛm pa na ɛnam.” Ɔwɛmfo no kae se, “Ɔbarima a odi kan no sɛ Sadok babarima Ahimaas.” Ɔhene no kae se, “Ɔyɛ onipa pa a, ɔde asɛm pa nam.” Na Ahimaas teɛɛ mu, frɛɛ ɔhene no se, “Biribiara ye!” Ɔkotow wɔ ɔhene no anim, de nʼanim butuw fam kae se, “Anuonyam nka Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn.
Ɔde nnipa a wɔyɛɛ adɔm tiaa me wura ɔhene ahyɛ ne nsa.” Ɔhene bisae se, “Na aberante, Absalom ho ye ana?” Ahimaas buae se, “Bere a Yoab yɛɛ nʼadwene sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔsoma ɔhene somfo ne me wo somfo no, mihuu sɛ nneɛma ayɛ basaa a na minhu mu yiye.” Ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Gyina nkyɛn ha na twɛn.” Enti ogyinaa nkyɛn twɛnee.
Na Kusni no bedu kae se, “Me wura, Nana, tie asɛm pa a mede nam!
Nnɛ, Awurade ayi wo afi wɔn a wɔsɔre tiaa wo no nyinaa nsam.” Na ɔhene bisaa Kusni no se, “Na aberante Absalom ho te dɛn?” Kusni no buae se, “Me wura ɔhene, atamfo nyinaa ne wɔn a wɔsɔre tia wo, pɛ sɛ wɔyɛ wo bɔne no, nhu amane sɛ saa aberante no.” Ɔhene ho wosowee.
Ɔfaa ɔkwan ano pon no mu kɔɔ ne dan mu kosui, twaa adwo.
Ɔrekɔ no, ɔkae se, “Ao, me ba Absalom!
Me ba, me ba Absalom!
Anka minwu nnya wo!
Ao, Absalom, me ba, me ba!”
Yoab Ka Ɔhene Anim Ankyɛ na nkra duu Yoab nkyɛn se ɔhene no resu, redi awerɛhow wɔ Absalom ho.
Bere a asraafo no tee ɔhene no awerɛhow a ɔredi wɔ ne ba no ho no, nkonimdi mu anigye a na wɔwɔ mu saa da no dan awerɛhow.
Wowiaa wɔn ho kɔɔ kurow no mu sɛnea wɔn a wɔadi nkogu de aniwu guan fi ɔko mu.
Ɔhene de ne nsa kataa nʼanim, kɔɔ so twaa adwo se, “Ao, me ba Absalom!
Ao, Absalom, me ba, me ba!” Na Yoab kɔɔ ɔhene no dan mu kɔka kyerɛɛ no se, “Nnɛ yɛagye wo, ne wo mmabarima, ne wo mmabea, ne wo yerenom, ne wo mpenanom nkwa.
Nanso woreyɛ eyi de gu yɛn anim ase te sɛ nea yɛayɛ bɔne bi.
Wodɔ wʼatamfo, na wotan wʼadɔfo.
Woada no adi nnɛ sɛ, yɛnsɛ hwee mma wo.
Sɛ Absalom te ase, na yɛn nyinaa awuwu a, anka wopɛ no saa.
Afei, fi kɔ mprempren, na kɔma asraafo no mo, na mebɔ Awurade din, ka ntam se, sɛ woanyɛ saa a, wɔn mu baako koraa nka ha anadwo yi.
Na ɛbɛma woagyigya asen kan no.” Na ɔhene no fii adi kɔtenaa kurow no abɔntenpon no ano.
Na asɛm no trɛw kurow no mu nyinaa sɛ ɔwɔ hɔ no, obiara kɔɔ ne nkyɛn.
Saa bere no na Israelfo a wɔtaa Absalom akyi no nyinaa aguan kɔ wɔn afi mu.
Na Israel mmusuakuw no nyinaa mu, na wɔredi abooboo, gye akyinnye.
Na nnipa no reka se, “Ɔhene no gyee yɛn fii atamfo a wɔyɛ Filistifo nsam, nanso Absalom taa no, pam no fii ɔman no mu.
Na mprempren Absalom a wɔsraa no sɛ ommedi yɛn so hene no nso awu.
Momma yɛnkɔka nkyerɛ Dawid na ɔnsan mmra mmedi yɛn so.” Na ɔhene Dawid somaa asɔfo Sadok ne Abiatar, ma wokobisaa Yuda mpanyimfo se, “Adɛn nti na mo de, mompɛ sɛ mode ɔhene ahenni bɛsan ama no?
Na mate sɛ Israel nyinaa ayɛ krado, na mo nko ara na motwentwɛn mo anan ase.
Moyɛ mʼabusuafo, mʼabusuakuw, mʼankasa me honam ne me mogya.
Na ɛno nti, adɛn nti na mutwa to wɔ wɔn a wɔpene sɛ mɛsan aba no mu?” Dawid ma wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ Amasa se, “Sɛ woyɛ me wɔfaase yi, sɛ manyɛ wo ɔsahene ansi Yoab anan mu a, Onyankopɔn ne me nni no nwenweenwen.” Afei, Amasa bɔɔ Yuda ntuanofo no nyinaa adafa, ma wotiee no sɛ nnipa koro.
Wɔde saa asɛm yi kɔtoo ɔhene anim se, “Wo ne wɔn a wɔne wo wɔ hɔ no nyinaa mmra yɛn nkyɛn.” Dawid San Kɔ Yerusalem Na ɔhene no de nʼani kyerɛɛ Yerusalem.
Oduu Asubɔnten Yordan ho no, Yudafo behyiaa no sɛ wɔde no retwa asu no.
Gera a ɔyɛ Benyaminni a ofi Bahurim babarima Simei ne Yuda mmarima yɛɛ ntɛm kohyiaa ɔhene Dawid.
Ɔrekɔ no, na Benyaminfo apem ka ne ho, a na Siba a na ɔyɛ Saulo fi mu soodoni ne ne mmabarima dunum ne nʼasomfo aduonu ka ho.
Wɔyɛɛ ntɛm dii ɔhene no kan koduu Yordan hɔ.
Wotwa kɔɔ baabi a ɛhɔ nnɔ kɔfaa ɔhene fifo no de wɔn twaa asu no, na wɔyɛɛ nea wɔpɛ biara maa wɔn.
Bere a Gera ba Simei twaa asu no, kɔkotow ɔhene no, srɛɛ no se, “Me wura ɔhene, fa me bɔne kyɛ me.
Nkae bɔne a wʼakoa yɛe bere a wufii Yerusalem no Ɔhene yi fi wʼadwene mu.
Mahu bɔne a mayɛ, enti na madi kan wɔ Yosef abusua nyinaa mu rebekyia wo yi.” Na Seruia babarima Abisai kae se, “Simei sɛ owu, efisɛ ɔdomee nea Awurade asra no no.” Na Dawid bisae se, “Mo Seruia mma, dɛn na me ne mo wɔ yɛ?
Nnɛ nyɛ da a wokum obi.
Ɛyɛ anigye da!
Masan mabedi hene wɔ Israel so bio!” Enti ɔhene no kaa ntam kyerɛɛ Simei se, “Wɔrenkum wo.” Dawid Yɛ Mefiboset Adɔe Mefiboset a ɔyɛ Saulo nena nso kohyiaa ɔhene no bi.
Efi bere a ɔhene kɔe no, na onsiesiee ne nan ase, nyii ne hweneanonwi, nhoroo ne ntade da, kosii sɛ ɔhene san baa asomdwoe mu no.
Ɔhene no bisaa no se, “Mefiboset, adɛn nti na wo ne me ankɔ?” Obuae se, “Nana, me somfo Siba daadaa me.
Meyɛ obubuafo nti, mekae se, ‘hyehyɛ mʼafurum ma me, na mentena ne so, sɛnea metumi ne ɔhene akɔ.’ Siba abɛsɛe me akyerɛ me wura ɔhene sɛ mampɛ sɛ meba.
Nanso minim sɛ wote sɛ Onyankopɔn bɔfo; ne saa nti, yɛ nea wugye di sɛ eye.
Biribiara mfata me ne me nenabarima asefo sɛ owu a ebefi me wura, ɔhene, nanso, woahyɛ me anuonyam wɔ wɔn a wodidi wo pon so no mu.
Enti tumi bɛn na mewɔ sɛ mibisa ɔhene nea mehwehwɛ?” Ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ no se, “Adɛn nti na wʼasɛm aware?
Mehyɛ mo sɛ, wo ne Siba nkyɛ nsase no mu.” Mefiboset ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene no se, “Sɛ me wura ɔhene asan aba fie dwoodwoo yi, ma Siba mfa biribiara.” Dawid Yɛ Barsilai Adɔe Gileadni Barsilai nso fi Rogelim baa sɛ ɔrebɛboa ama ɔhene atwa Yordan.
Na Barsilai abɔ akwakoraa a wadi mfe aduɔwɔtwe, na ɔyɛ ɔdefo kɛse.
Ɔno na ɔmaa ɔhene biribi dii bere a na ɔte Mahanaim no.
Ɔhene no ka kyerɛɛ Barsilai se, “Wo ne me ntwa, na wo ne me nkɔtena Yerusalem, na mɛhwɛ wo.” Nanso, Barsilai buaa ɔhene se, “Aka me nna ahe a ɛsɛ sɛ me ne wo kɔtena Yerusalem, Nana?
Madi mfirihyia aduɔwɔtwe, na biribiara nyɛ me akɔnnɔ.
Aduan ne nsa nyɛ me dɛ.
Nnwontofo nne nso, merente na adesoa nko ara na mɛyɛ ama Nana.
Anuonyam a mepɛ ara ne sɛ me ne Nana betwa asu no.
Ma wo somfo nsan nʼakyi, sɛnea mewu wɔ me ara me kurom faako a wosiee mʼawofo.
Na me babarima Kimham ni.
Ma ɔne me wura ɔhene nkɔ na ade pa biara a wopɛ no, yɛ ma no.” Ɔhene no gye too mu kae se, “Eye, Kimham ne me bɛkɔ, na nea anka mɛyɛ ama wo no, mɛyɛ ama no.” Enti nnipa no nyinaa ne ɔhene twaa Yordan, ɔhene no yɛɛ Barsilai atuu, hyiraa no.
Na Barsilai san kɔɔ ne kurom.
Ɔhene faa Kimham kaa ne ho kɔɔ Gilgal.
Yuda asraafo nyinaa ne Israel asraafo no mu fa de ɔhene twaa asu no.
Ɔhene Ho Akyinnyegye Ankyɛ, Israel mmarima nyinaa baa ɔhene hɔ bebisaa no se, “Adɛn nti na yɛn nuanom Yuda mmarima wiaa ɔhene kɔe, na wɔde Ɔhene ne ne fifo ne Dawid mmarima nyinaa a wɔka ne ho no akotwa Yordan aba?” Yuda mmarima nyinaa buaa Israel mmarima no se, “Yɛyɛɛ saa, efisɛ, ɔhene no yɛ yɛn busuani pɛɛ.
Adɛn nti na mo bo afuw wɔ saa asɛm yi ho?
Yɛannye no hwee na ɔno nso amma yɛn aduan anaa akyɛde biara nso.” Na Israel mmarima buaa Yuda mmarima no se, “Yɛwɔ mmusuakuw du wɔ Israel na ɛno nti yɛwɔ ɔhene no mu kyɛfa du.
Na adɛn nti na mubu yɛn abomfiaa?
Ɛnyɛ yɛn na yedii kan kae se, wɔmfa yɛn hene nsan mmra?” Na Yuda mmarima no ano yɛɛ den sen Israel mmarima no.
Seba Atuatew Ɔtɔkwapɛfo bi a na wɔfrɛ no Seba na ɔyɛ Bikri a ofi Benyamin babarima, hyɛn torobɛnto teɛɛ mu se, “Yɛne Dawid nni hwee yɛ.
Yenni agyapade biara wɔ Yisai babarima no nkyɛn.
Israel mmarima, mommra na yɛn nyinaa nkɔ yɛn kurom!” Enti Israel mmarima gyaw Dawid hɔ, kodii Seba akyi.
Nanso Yuda mmarima no de, wɔtenaa wɔn hene nkyɛn, na wɔwowaw no fi Asubɔnten Yordan ho, kosii Yerusalem.
Bere a oduu nʼahemfi hɔ wɔ Yerusalem no, ɔhyɛɛ sɛ ne mpenanom du a ogyaw wɔn hɔ no, wɔmfa wɔn nkɔhyɛ kokoa mu baabi.
Na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔma wɔn wɔn ahiade nyinaa, nanso ɔne wɔn renna bio.
Enti wɔn mu biara tenaa ase sɛ okunafo, kosii ne wuda.
Ɔhene no hyɛɛ Amasa sɛ ɔmfa nnansa mmoaboa Yuda asraafo ano, na ɔmmɛka biribi nkyerɛ no saa bere no mu.
Enti Amasa kɔbɔɔ asraafo no amanneɛ, nanso nʼahoboa no boroo nnansa no.
Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Abisai se, “Saa ɔtɔkwapɛfo Seba no rebɛhaw yɛn asen sɛ nea Absalom haw yɛn no.
Fa mʼakofo no, na taa no ansa na waguan akɔbɔ ne ho aguaa wɔ hintabea nkurow no mu baabi a yɛn nsa renka no.” Enti Abisai ne Yoab yiyii awɛmfo a wodi mu fii Yoab asraafo ne ɔhene no ankasa de mu de tiw Seba.
Na woduu Gibeon ɔbo kɛse no ho no, Amasa hyiaa wɔn.
Na Yoab hyɛ nʼakotade a ɔde afoa abɔ nʼataaso.
Otuu nten kɔɔ nʼanim sɛ ɔrekokyia Amasa no, afoa no fii boha no mu tɔɔ fam.
Yoab bisaa no se, “Me nua, wo ho te dɛn?” Ɛhɔ ara na Yoab de ne nsa nifa soo nʼabogyesɛ mu, sɛ nea ɔrefew nʼano.
Amasa anhu sɛ afoa no hyɛ ne nsa benkum mu.
Na Yoab de afoa no wɔɔ ne yam, maa ne nsono tu guu fam.
Ɛho anhia sɛ Yoab betia ne so koraa, na Amasa wui.
Yoab ne ne nuabarima Abisai gyaw no hɔ, toaa so tiw Bikri babarima Seba.
