Wɔbɔɔ wɔn atenaseɛ wɔ Halah nkuro wɔ asuo Habor a ɛwɔ Gosan a ɛfra Media nkuropɔn no mu no so.
Asiria Di Samaria So Saa amanehunu yi baa Israelman so, ɛfiri sɛ, nnipa no somm anyame foforɔ, yɛɛ bɔne tia Awurade, wɔn Onyankopɔn a ɔyii wɔn firii wɔn nkoasom mu wɔ Misraim.
Wɔsuasuaa abosonsom aman nneyɛɛ a enti Awurade pamoo wɔn firii asase a ɛda wɔn anim no so, ne ɔsom a Israel ahemfo de aba no.
Na Israelfoɔ no nso nam esum ase, ayɛ nneɛma pii a na ɛnsɔ Awurade wɔn Onyankopɔn ani.
Wɔsisii abosonnan maa wɔn ho wɔ wɔn nkuro nyinaa so, ɛfiri wɔn nkuro akɛseɛ a wɔatwa afasuo afa ho, kɔsi nkuraaseɛ.
Wɔsisii afadum kronkron ne Asera afɔrebukyia wɔ kokoɔ biara so ne dua biara a ɛyɛ frɔmm ase.
Wɔhyee nnuhwam wɔ asɔreeɛ hɔ, te sɛ deɛ aman a Awurade apamo wɔn afiri asase a ɛda wɔn anim no so no yɛeɛ pɛ.
Enti, Israelfoɔ yɛɛ bɔne bebree hyɛɛ Awurade abufuo.
Aane, Awurade kɔkɔbɔ pɔtee ne ne ntimu no nyinaa akyi, wɔsomm ahoni.
Awurade somaa nʼadiyifoɔ ne ademuhunufoɔ ntoatoasoɔ ma wɔkɔbɔɔ Israel ne Yuda kɔkɔ sɛ, “Monnane mfiri mo akwammɔne nyinaa ho.
Monyɛ ɔsetie mma mʼahyɛdeɛ ne me mmara, deɛ mehyɛɛ mo agyanom sɛ wɔnni so no nyinaa, deɛ menam mʼasomfoɔ adiyifoɔ no so de maa mo no.” Nanso, Israelfoɔ no antie.
Na wɔyɛɛ asoɔden sɛ wɔn agyanom, na wɔannye Awurade, wɔn Onyankopɔn, anni.
Wɔpoo ne mmara ne nʼapam a ɔne wɔn agyanom yɛeɛ no.
Na wɔamfa ne kɔkɔbɔ no anyɛ hwee.
Wɔsomm abosomhuhuo, ma wɔdanee nnipa teta.
Wɔhwɛɛ aman a atwa wɔn ho ahyia no nhwɛsoɔ so, nam so yɛɛ asoɔden maa Awurade nhyɛ a ɔhyɛɛ sɛ wɔnnsuasua wɔn no.
Wɔantie Awurade wɔn Onyankopɔn nhyɛ no nyinaa, na wɔyɛɛ nantwie mma mmienu ahoni a wɔaguo.
Wɔsii Asera afɔrebukyia, somm Baal ne ewiem atumfoɔ nyinaa.
Na mpo, wɔde wɔn ankasa mmammarima ne wɔn mmammaa bɔɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ ogya mu.
Wɔkɔɔ abisa, wɔyɛɛ abayisɛm, nam so tɔn wɔn ho maa bɔne, de hyɛɛ Awurade abufuo.
Na ɛsiane sɛ Awurade bo fuiɛ enti, ɔpepaa wɔn firii nʼanim.
Yuda abusuakuo nko ara na ɛkaa wɔn wɔ asase no so.
Na mpo, nnipa a wɔwɔ Yuda anni Awurade, wɔn Onyankopɔn, ahyɛdeɛ so.
Wɔfaa ɛkwan bɔne a Israel faa so no so.
Ɛno enti, Awurade poo Israel asefoɔ nyinaa.
Ɔde wɔn maa wɔn atamfoɔ, nam so twee wɔn aso, kɔsii sɛ wɔsɛee wɔn.
Na ɛberɛ a Awurade tee Israel firii Dawid ahemman ho no, wɔfaa Nebat babarima Yeroboam, de no dii wɔn so ɔhene.
Na Yeroboam maa Israelfoɔ gyaee Awurade akyidie, ma wɔyɛɛ bɔne kɛseɛ.
Na Israelfoɔ no kɔɔ so nantee Yeroboam akwammɔne no so.
Wɔannyae ahonisom ho bɔneyɛ no, kɔsii sɛ, ne korakora, Awurade pepaa wɔn firii hɔ, sɛdeɛ nʼadiyifoɔ hyɛɛ ho nkɔm sɛ ɛbɛba no.
Enti, wɔtwaa Israel asuo kɔɔ Asiria asase so baabi a wɔte bɛsi ɛnnɛ yi.
Amamfrafoɔ Kɔtena Israel Na Asiriahene twee nnipa akuakuo firii Babilonia, Kuta ne Awa, Hamat ne Sefarwaim, de wɔn bɛduaa Samaria nkuro so, ma wɔsii Israelfoɔ ananmu.
Enti Asiriafoɔ no faa Samaria ne Israel nkuro a ɛkeka ho no.
Nanso, ɛsiane sɛ saa ahɔhoɔ atutenafoɔ yi ansom Awurade ɛberɛ a wɔduruu hɔ ara pɛ no enti, Awurade maa agyata kɔɔ wɔn mu, kɔkunkumm wɔn mu bi.
Enti, wɔde nkra kɔmaa Asiriahene sɛ, “Nnipa a woabɔ wɔn atenaseɛ wɔ Israel nkuro so no nnim sɛdeɛ wɔsom asase no so Onyankopɔn.
Wasoma agyata akɔ wɔn mu, akɔsɛe wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ, wɔansom no anisɔ mu.” Ɛnna Asiriahene nso hyɛɛ sɛ, “Soma asɔfoɔ a wɔatwa wɔn asuo no mu baako firi Samaria, na ɔnsane nkɔ Israel.
Ma ɔnkyerɛ ahɔhoɔ no ɛkwan a wɔfa so som asase no so Onyankopɔn.” Enti, asɔfoɔ a wɔatwa wɔn asuo afiri Samaria no mu baako sane kɔɔ Bet-El, kɔkyerɛɛ ahɔhoɔ no kwan a wɔfa so som Awurade.
Nanso, saa ahɔhoɔ akuakuo ahodoɔ yi kɔɔ so somm wɔn ankasa anyame.
Kuro biara a wɔtete mu no, wɔde wɔn ahoni kɔsisii abosonnan a Israelfoɔ no asisi no mu.
Wɔn a wɔfiri Babilonia no somm wɔn nyame Sukot-Benot ahoni.
Wɔn a wɔfiri Kut somm wɔn nyame Nergal.
Na wɔn a wɔfiri Hamat somm Asima.
Awifoɔ somm wɔn anyame Nibhas ne Tartak.
Na mpo, nnipa a ɛfiri Sefarwain hyee wɔn ankasa mma sɛ afɔrebɔdeɛ, de maa Adramelek ne Anamelek.
Saa ahɔhoɔ yi somm Awurade deɛ, nanso wɔyii asɔfoɔ bi firii wɔn mu a, na wɔbɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ abosonnan mu.
Na wɔsom Awurade deɛ, nanso wɔkɔɔ so faa amanneɛ kwan a wɔn aman a wɔfiri so fa so som no so.
Na yei da so kɔ so wɔ wɔn mu de bɛsi ɛnnɛ.
Na wɔda so yɛ kane nnebɔne no a anka ɛsɛ sɛ wɔsom Awurade, di ne mmara, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ahyɛdeɛ a ɔde maa Yakob a ɔsesaa ne din ma ɛbɛyɛɛ Israel asefoɔ no so.
Nanso, na Awurade ne Yakob asefoɔ ayɛ apam, ahyɛ wɔn sɛ, “Monnsom anyame foforɔ, monnkoto wɔn, na monnsom wɔn, na mommmɔ afɔdeɛ mmma wɔn.
Awurade a ɔnam nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ akɛseɛ ne tumi so yii mo firii Misraim no nko ara na monsom no.
Ɔno nko ara na ɛsɛ sɛ mosom no, na mokoto no, na mobɔ afɔdeɛ ma no.
Monhwɛ yie, na monni mmara, nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ahyɛdeɛ a ɔtwerɛ maa mo no so.
Ɛnsɛ sɛ mosom anyame foforɔ biara.
Mommma mo werɛ mfiri apam a me ne mo yɛeɛ no, na monnsom anyame foforɔ biara.
Monsom Awurade, mo Onyankopɔn nko ara.
Ɔno na ɔbɛgye mo afiri mo atamfoɔ nyinaa nsam.” Nanso, nnipa no antie, kɔɔ so faa wɔn akwan dada no so.
Enti, ɛberɛ a ahɔhoɔ yi resom Awurade no, berɛ korɔ no ara mu, na wɔresom wɔn ahoni.
Na ɛbɛsi ɛnnɛ, wɔn asefoɔ yɛ ade korɔ no ara.
Hesekia Di Ɔhene Wɔ Yuda Ahas babarima Hesekia hyɛɛ aseɛ dii ɔhene wɔ Yuda no, na Ela babarima Hosea adi ɔhene wɔ Israel mfeɛ mmiɛnsa.
Ɔdii ɔhene no na wadi mfirinhyia aduonu enum, na ɔdii ɔhene wɔ Yerusalem mfirinhyia aduonu nkron.
Na ne maame yɛ Sakaria babaa a wɔfrɛ no Abi.
Ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛfata wɔ Awurade ani so, sɛdeɛ ne tete agya Dawid yɛeɛ no.
Ɔtutuu abosonnan, bubuu afadum kronkron no, kaa Asera afɔrebukyia no guu fam.
Ɔbubuu kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ɔwɔ a Mose ayɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ, na nnipa no hye nnuhwam ma no de som.
Na wɔfrɛ ɔwɔ no a wɔde kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ayɛ no Nehustan.
Hesekia de ne ho too Awurade, Israel Onyankopɔn so.
Nʼakyi ne nʼanim no, na ɔhene biara nni hɔ a ɔte sɛ no wɔ Yuda asase so.
Biribiara mu, ɔdii Awurade nokorɛ, na ɔde ntoboaseɛ dii ahyɛdeɛ a Awurade de maa Mose no nyinaa so.
Ne saa enti, na Awurade ka ne ho, na Hesekia kɔɔ so wɔ biribiara a ɔyɛeɛ mu.
Ɔyɛɛ dɔm tiaa Asiriahene, na wantua apeatoɔ amma no.
Afei, ɔkɔdii Filistifoɔ so nkonim, de kɔsii Gasa ne nʼahyeɛ so, firi ne nkuraaseɛ, de kɔsii wɔn kuropɔn a wɔato ɔfasuo atwa ho no.
Hesekia ahennie no mfeɛ ɛnan so a na ɔhene Hosea nso wɔ nʼahennie wɔ Israel mfeɛ nson mu no, Asiriahene Salmaneser kɔtuaa Israel, hyɛɛ aseɛ kaa Samaria kuropɔn hyɛeɛ.
Mfeɛ mmiɛnsa akyi a, na ɔhene Hesekia adi adeɛ mfeɛ nsia mu a, na ɛyɛ ɔhene Hosea nso adedie wɔ Israel mfeɛ nkron mu no, Samaria bɔeɛ.
Saa ɛberɛ no, Asiriahene twaa Israelfoɔ no asuo, kɔɔ Asiria, de wɔn hyehyɛɛ aman so wɔ Halah wɔ Asubɔnten Habor a ɛwɔ Gosan nkonkɔnoa ne nkuro akɛseɛ a ɛwɔ Media mu.
Ɛfiri sɛ, wɔantie Awurade, wɔn Onyankopɔn no.
Wɔbuu nʼapam no so, mmara a Awurade nam Mose so hyehyɛ maa wɔn no.
Asiria Tuu Yuda So Sa Ɔhene Hesekia adedie mfeɛ dunan so, Asiriahene Sanaherib bɛto hyɛɛ Yuda nkuro a na wɔabɔ ho ban no so, dii wɔn so nkonim.
Na Hesekia de saa nkra yi kɔmaa Asiriahene wɔ Lakis sɛ, “Mayɛ mfomsoɔ.
Sɛ wobɛfiri ha akɔ nko ara deɛ a, apeatoɔ biara a wobɛgye me no, mɛtua.” Na Asiriahene bisaa mpatadeɛ a ɛboro dwetɛ tɔno ne sikakɔkɔɔ nso bɛyɛ tɔno baako.
Enti, ɔhene Hesekia de dwetɛ a wɔakora no Awurade Asɔredan no mu ne deɛ ɛwɔ ahemfie adekoraeɛ hɔ nyinaa maeɛ.
Mpo, Hesekia waawae sikakɔkɔɔ a wɔde aduradura Awurade asɔredan no apono ho, de ne nyinaa maa Asiriahene.
Yeinom nyinaa akyi, Asiriahene somaa ne sahene, nʼasraadɔmhene ne nʼananmusini firii Lakis ne akodɔm a wɔn mu yɛ duru, kɔɔ Hesekia so wɔ Yerusalem.
Asiriafoɔ no gyinaa nsukwan bi a ɛma atifi ɔtadeɛ nsuo a ɛbɛn ɛkwan a ɛde kɔ baabi a wɔpa ntoma ani no ho.
Wɔfrɛɛ Hesekia, nanso ɔsomaa ne mpanimfoɔ yi sɛ wɔnkɔhyia wɔn: Hilkia babarima Eliakim a ɔhwɛ ahemfie hɔ so, ɔtwerɛfoɔ Sebna ne Asaf babarima Yoa a ɔyɛ ahemfie abakɔsɛm twerɛfoɔ.
Senaherib Hunahuna Yerusalem Na Asiriahene no ara ananmusini no ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ, “Monka nkyerɛ Hesekia sɛ, “ ‘Asɛm a otumfoɔ Asiriahene ka nie: Ɛdeɛn na wode wo ho to so a ɛma wogye wo ho di saa?
Wogye di sɛ wobɛtumi de anosɛm hunu asi akodie mu nyansa ne nʼahoɔden anan?
Wʼakyitaafoɔ bɛn na wɔbɛtaa wʼakyi, ama woatumi ako atia Asiria?
Misraim anaa?
Sɛ wotwere Misraim a, wobɛhunu sɛ, ɛte sɛ abaa a wo mu duru bɛbu no, na awɔ wo ahwire wo nsam.
Misraim Farao mpo mu nni ahotosoɔ korakora.
Ebia, wobɛka sɛ, “Yɛde yɛn ho to Awurade, yɛn Onyankopɔn so!” Nanso, ɛnyɛ ɔno na ɔhene Hesekia didii nʼatɛm no?
Hesekia ammubu abosonnan ne afɔrebukyia nyinaa, anhyɛ Yudafoɔ sɛ wɔnsom wɔ afɔrebukyia a ɛwɔ Yerusalem ha nko ara no so?
“ ‘Mɛka asɛm bi akyerɛ wo!
Me wura Asiriahene ne wo bɛyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ bi.
Sɛ wobɛnya apɔnkɔsotefoɔ mpenu, afiri wʼasraadɔm mu a, ɔbɛma wɔn apɔnkɔ mpenu ama wɔatenatena wɔn so.
Na wʼasraadɔm ketewa sɛɛ yi, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na woaso daeɛ sɛ wobɛtumi ne me wura akodɔm no mu fa bi a wɔyɛ mmerɛ mpo adi asie.
Menim sɛ wode wo ho ato Misraim nteaseɛnam ne apɔnkɔsotefoɔ mmoa so.
Deɛ ɛka ho ne sɛ, wogye di sɛ yɛadi mo asase yi so a Awurade akwankyerɛ nni mu?
Awurade ankasa na ɔka kyerɛɛ yɛn sɛ, Kɔ na kɔsɛe no!’ ” Afei, Hilkia babarima Eliakim ne Sebna ne Yoa ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene no ananmusini no sɛ, “Kasa wɔ Arameike mu kyerɛ yɛn, na saa kasa no na yɛte aseɛ yie.
Nka Hebri nkyerɛ yɛn, ɛfiri sɛ nnipa a wɔwɔ ɔfasuo no so no bɛte.” Na ɔsahene no buaa sɛ, “Me wura pɛ sɛ obiara a ɔwɔ Yerusalem te saa asɛm yi, na ɛnyɛ mo nko.
Ɔpɛ sɛ wɔte sɛ, sɛ moamma mo nsa so a, wɔbɛtua kuropɔn yi.
Ɛkɔm ne sukɔm werɛmfoɔ bɛde nkurɔfoɔ no ara kɔsi sɛ, wɔbɛdi wɔn ara agyanan, anom wɔn dwonsɔ.” Afei, ɔsɔre gyinaeɛ, maa ne nne so kasaa wɔ Hebri mu, kyerɛɛ nnipa a wɔwɔ ɔfasuo no so sɛ, “Montie nkra a ɛfiri Asiria ɔhene kɛseɛ no nkyɛn!
Sɛdeɛ ɔhene seɛ nie: Mommma ɔhene Hesekia nnaadaa mo.
Ɔrentumi nnye mo mfiri me tumi ase.
Mommma ɔnnaadaa mo sɛ, momfa mo ho nto Awurade so, nnka sɛ, ‘Awurade bɛgye yɛn!
Wɔremfa saa kuropɔn yi mma Asiriahene da.’ “Monntie Hesekia.
Yeinom ne nhyehyɛeɛ a Asiriahene reyɛ.
Mo ne me nni no asomdwoeɛ so.
Mommue apono no, na mompue mmra.
Na mɛma mo mu biara ɛkwan, na moatoa so adidi afiri mo bobe ne borɔdɔma mfikyifuo mu, anom nsuo afiri mo ara mo abura mu.
Na mɛyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ de mo akɔ asase foforɔ bi a ɛte sɛ yei so.
Ɛyɛ ɔman a atokoɔ, nsã, burodo, bobe nturo, ngo nnua ne ɛwoɔ abu so hɔ.
Ɛyɛ asase a nneɛma pa abu so hɔ.
Mompere nkwa, na monyi owuo akwa!
“Mommma Hesekia nnaadaa mo nka sɛ, ‘Awurade bɛgye yɛn!’ Anyame a wɔwɔ aman so no atumi agye wɔn nkurɔfoɔ afiri Asiriahene nsam da?
Asɛm bɛn na ɛtoo Hamat ne Arpad anyame no?
Na Sefarwaim, Hena ne Iwa anyame nso, wɔwɔ he?
Wɔtumi gyee Samaria firii me tumi ase anaa?
Ɔman bɛn so anyame na watumi agye ne nkurɔfoɔ afiri me tumi ase?
Mommɔ baako pɛ din.
Na afei, ɛdeɛn na ɛma mo dwene sɛ Awurade bɛtumi agye Yerusalem?” Na nnipa no yɛɛ komm a wɔamma mmuaeɛ biara, ɛfiri sɛ, na Hesekia aka akyerɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnnkasa.
Afei, Hilkia babarima Eliakim, ahemfie sohwɛfoɔ ne ɔtwerɛfoɔ Sebna ne Asaf babarima Yoa, ahemfie abakɔsɛm twerɛfoɔ, sane kɔɔ Hesekia nkyɛn.
Wɔsunsuanee wɔn ntadeɛ mu, na wɔkɔhunuu ɔhene no, kaa asɛm a Asiria ɔnanmusini kaeɛ no kyerɛɛ no.
Hesekia Hwehwɛ Awurade Mmoa Ɛberɛ a ɔhene Hesekia tee yeinom no, ɔsunsuanee ne ntadeɛ mu, ɛnna ɔfiraa ayitoma, na ɔkɔɔ Awurade asɔredan mu.
Na ɔsomaa ahemfie sohwɛfoɔ Eliakim, ɔtwerɛfoɔ Sebna ne asɔfoɔ mpanin a wɔn nyinaa hyehyɛ ayitadeɛ kɔɔ Amos babarima odiyifoɔ Yesaia nkyɛn.
Wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Sɛdeɛ ɔhene Hesekia ka nie: Saa ɛda yi yɛ ɔhaw, animka ne animguaseɛ da.
Ayɛ te sɛ deɛ mmɔfra awoɔ duru so na ahoɔden a wɔde bɛwo wɔn nni hɔ.
Nanso, ebia Awurade, mo Onyankopɔn ate sɛ Asiria ɔnanmusini no regu Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ no anim ase, na wɔbɛtwe nʼaso wɔ ne nsɛnkeka no ho.
Enti mommɔ mpaeɛ mma nkaeɛfoɔ a wɔte nkwa mu no.” Na ɔhene Hesekia mpanimfoɔ no kɔkaa ɔhene nkra no kyerɛɛ Yesaia, na Yesaia buaa sɛ, “Ka kyerɛ wo wura sɛ, ‘Sɛdeɛ Awurade seɛ nie: Mma abususɛm a Asiriahene asomafoɔ no ka tiaa me no nha wo.
Montie!
Mede honhom bi rebɛhyɛ ne mu, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a sɛ ɔte asɛm bi a ɔbɛsane akɔ ne ɔman mu, na ɛhɔ na mɛma wɔde akofena akum no.’ ” Ɛberɛ a ɔsahene no tee sɛ Asiriahene afiri Lakis no, ɔsanee nʼakyi kɔhunuu sɛ ɔhene no ne Libna reko.
Ankyɛre, ɔhene Sanaherib nyaa nkra sɛ, Etiopiahene Tirhaka adi akodɔm anim, rebɛko atia no.
Na ansa na ɔbɛsane akohyia akodɔm no, ɔtoo saa nkra yi sɛ wɔmfa nkɔma Hesekia wɔ Yerusalem.
“Monka nkyerɛ Yudahene Hesekia sɛ: Ɛmma onyame a wode wo ho ato no so no nnaadaa mo nka sɛ, ‘Asiriahene rentumi mfa Yerusalem.’ Moate deɛ Asiria ahemfo ayɛ amanaman no nyinaa.
Wɔasɛe wɔn pasaa.
Na mo deɛ wɔbɛgye mo anaa?
Anyame a wɔwɔ aman a me nananom sɛee wɔn no, aman te sɛ Gosan, Haran, Resef ne Edenfoɔ a na wɔwɔ Telasar no anyame gyee wɔn anaa?
Ɛhe na Hamathene ne Arpadhene, kuropɔn Sefarwaim anaa Hena anaa Iwa ahemfo no wɔ?” Hesekia nsa kaa krataa a abɔfoɔ no de baeɛ no, ɔkenkaneeɛ.
Afei ɔforo kɔɔ Awurade asɔredan no mu kɔtrɛɛ mu wɔ Awurade anim.
Na Hesekia bɔɔ mpaeɛ kyerɛɛ Awurade sɛ: “Ao, Awurade, Israel Onyankopɔn a wodi ɔhene firi Kerubim ntam, wo nko ara na woyɛ Onyankopɔn wɔ asase so ahennie nyinaa so.
Wo na wobɔɔ ɔsoro ne asase.
Brɛ wʼaso ase, Ao Awurade, na tie!
Bue wʼani, Ao Awurade, na hwɛ!
Tie Sanaherib nsɛm a ɔka de bu Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ no animtiaa.
“Awurade, ɛyɛ nokorɛ sɛ Asiria ahemfo asɛe aman yi nyinaa, sɛdeɛ nkra no ka no.
Na wɔato aman yi anyame agu ogya mu, ahye wɔn.
Asiriafoɔ no tumi sɛe wɔn ɛfiri sɛ na wɔnyɛ anyame koraa.
Na wɔyɛ nnua ne aboɔ ahoni a nnipa de wɔn nsa ayɛ.
Afei, Ao Awurade, yɛn Onyankopɔn, gye yɛn firi ne tumi ase, na ɛbɛma ahennie a ɛwɔ asase so nyinaa ahunu sɛ wo nko ara, Ao Awurade, na woyɛ Onyankopɔn.” Yesaia Hyɛ Yuda Gyeɛ Ho Nkɔm Na Amos babarima Yesaia too saa nkra yi kɔmaa Hesekia sɛ, “Sɛdeɛ Awurade, Israel Onyankopɔn, seɛ nie: ‘Mate wo mpaeɛbɔ a ɛfa Asiriahene Sanaherib ho no.
Yei ne asɛm a Awurade aka atia no: “ ‘Ɔbabaabunu Sion sopa wo, na ɔsere wo.
Ɔbabaa Yerusalem di wo ho fɛ, na ɔwoso ne ti ɛberɛ a woredwane.
Hwan na wasopa no na woagu ne ho fi yi?
Hwan na woama wo nne so atia no na wohwɛɛ no ahantan so?
Ɛyɛ Israel ɔkronkronni no!
Wonam wʼasomafoɔ so adi Awurade ho fɛw.
Na woaka sɛ, “Mede me nteaseɛnam bebrebe no adi bepɔ tentene pa ara so, aane, Lebanon nkokoɔ a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri no.
Matwitwa ntweneduro atentene pa ara ne ne pepeaa a ɛdi mu no nso agu fam.
Maduru ne twetwɛwa so akyirikyiri na manantenante ne kwaeɛbirentuo mu.
Matutu nsubura wɔ ahɔhoɔ nsase bebree so de ne nsu pa no adwodwo me ho.
Mpo, mepaee Misraim nsubɔntene mu sɛdeɛ mʼakodɔm bɛtumi atwa!” “ ‘Na Monteeɛ?
Ɛberɛ tentene a atwam na mehyɛ too hɔ.
Ɛberɛ bi a atwam no na medwenee ho; afei mama aba mu sɛ, moadane nkuropɔn a mosɛe nkuro a wɔwɔ banbɔ ma wɔdane aboɔ asie.
Wɔn nkurɔfoɔ a tumi afiri wɔn nsa no ho adwiri wɔn na animguaseɛ aka wɔn.
Wɔte sɛ afuo so nnua, ne afifideɛ foforɔ a ɛyɛ mmrɛ; wɔte sɛ ɛserɛ a ɛfifiri ɛdan atifi a owia tumi hye so sɛe no.
“ ‘Nanso, menim deɛ woteɛ ɛberɛ a woba ne ɛberɛ a wokorɔ ne sɛdeɛ wo bo huru tia me.
Na ɛsiane mo ahomasoɔ a ɛtia me, na mʼankasa mate no enti, mede me darewa bɛsɔ mo hwene mu, na mede nnareka ato mo ano, na mama mo afa ɛkwan a mofaa so baeɛ no so, asane mo akyi.’ “Yei na ɛbɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ama woɔ, Ao Hesekia: “Saa afe yi wobɛdi deɛ ɛno ankasa fifirie, afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu no, wobɛdi deɛ ɛfiri mu ba.
Na afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa so no, mobɛdua mfudeɛ, na moatwa.
Mobɛyɛ bobe nturo, na moadi nʼaba no.
Na mo a moaka Yuda a moatumi agyina ntua no mu ɔhaw ne abɛbrɛsɛ no ano no, mobɛsane atena mo asase so, na mobɛdi yie na moadɔre.
Na nkaeɛfoɔ bi bɛfiri Yerusalem aba, na nkaeɛfoɔ dɔm afiri Bepɔ Sion so.
Asafo Awurade di nsiyɛ bɛhwɛ ama yei aba mu.
“Yei ne asɛm a Awurade ka fa Asiriahene ho: “Ɔrenhyɛne saa kuropɔn yi mu na ɔrento bɛmma wɔ ha.
Ɔremfa akokyɛm mmɛnnyina kuropɔn no akyi na ɔrensi otua pie ntia no.
Ɔhene no kwan a ɔfaa so baeɛ no ara so na ɔbɛsane afa akɔ nʼankasa ɔman mu.
Awurade ka sɛ, ɔrenwura saa kuro yi mu.
Esiane mʼankasa mʼanimuonyam ne mʼakoa Dawid enti, mɛbɔ ho ban.” Saa anadwo no, Awurade ɔbɔfoɔ kɔɔ Asiria sraban mu, kɔkumm Asiria akodɔm no mpem ɔha aduɔwɔtwe enum.
Asiriafoɔ a wɔkaeɛ no nyanee anɔpa no, wɔhunuu sɛ afunu gugu mmɔntene so baabiara.
Na Asiriahene Sanaherib gyaee ɔko no, kɔɔ nʼankasa nʼasase so.
Ɔkɔtenaa nʼahenkuro Ninewe mu.
Ɛda koro bi a ɔresom wɔ ne nyame Nisrok abosonnan mu no, ne mmammarima Adramelek ne Sareser de wɔn akofena kɔkumm no.
Wɔdwane firii hɔ kɔtenaa Ararat asase so, na ne babarima foforɔ Esarhadon bɛdii nʼadeɛ sɛ Asiriahene.
Hesekia Yadeɛ Ne Nʼayaresa Saa ɛberɛ no mu, ɔhene Hesekia yaree yarewuo, ɛnna Amos babarima odiyifoɔ Yesaia kɔsraa no.
Ɔkaa saa asɛm yi kyerɛɛ ɔhene no, “Sɛdeɛ Awurade seɛ nie: Hyɛ wo nsamanseɛ, ɛfiri sɛ, wobɛwu.
Wo yadeɛ no rennyae.” Ɛberɛ a Hesekia tee asɛm yi, ɔtwaa nʼani hwɛɛ fasuo, bɔɔ Awurade mpaeɛ sɛ, “Kae, Ao, Awurade, sɛdeɛ manante wʼanim nokorɛm na mede mʼakoma ayɛ deɛ ɛfata wɔ wʼanim.” Na Hesekia suu bebree.
Na ansa na Yesaia bɛfiri adihɔ no mfimfini no, Awurade de asɛm yi bɛsii ne so sɛ, “Sane kɔ Hesekia a ɔyɛ me nkurɔfoɔ ɔkannifoɔ no nkyɛn, na kɔka kyerɛ no sɛ, ‘Sei na Awurade a ɔyɛ wʼagya Dawid Onyankopɔn seɛ: Mate wo mpaeɛbɔ no, ahunu wo nisuo no.
Mɛsa wo yadeɛ, na nnansa akyi no, wobɛsɔre afiri mpa so, na woakɔ Awurade Asɔredan mu.
Mede mfeɛ dunum bɛka wo mfeɛ ho, na mɛgye wo ne saa kuropɔn yi afiri Asiriahene nsam.
Me ɔsomfoɔ Dawid enti, mɛyɛ yei, de agye mʼanimuonyam.’ ” Na Yesaia ka kyerɛɛ Hesekia asomfoɔ no sɛ, “Momfa borɔdɔma nyɛ ngo, na momfa nsrasra pɔmpɔ no so.” Wɔyɛɛ saa, na Hesekia nyaa ahoɔden.
Ansa na ɔrebɛnya ayaresa no, Hesekia bisaa Yesaia sɛ, “Nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ bɛn na Awurade bɛyɛ, de akyerɛ sɛ ɔbɛsa me yadeɛ, na matumi akɔ Awurade Asɔredan mu nnansa so?” Yesaia buaa sɛ, “Yei ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a Awurade bɛyɛ akyerɛ wo sɛ ɔbɛdi ne bɔhyɛ so.
Wopɛ sɛ sunsum a ɛda sunsumma susuniwa no kɔ nʼanim anammɔntuo edu anaa ɛsane nʼakyi anammɔntuo edu?” Hesekia buaa sɛ, “Sunsum no kɔ nʼanim ɛberɛ biara.
Na mmom, ma ɛnkɔ nʼakyi.” Enti, Yesaia bisaa Awurade sɛ ɔnyɛ yei, na ɔmaa sunsum no tete sane nʼakyi anammɔntuo edu wɔ Ahas sunsumma susuniwa no so.
Babilonia Ananmusifoɔ Yei akyi, Babiloniahene Baladan babarima Merodak-Baladan soma ma wɔkɔmaa Hesekia tirinkwa ne akyɛdeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ, na wate sɛ yare denden bi bɔɔ Hesekia.
Hesekia gyee Babilonia ananmusifoɔ yi, kyerɛɛ wɔn biribiara a ɔwɔ wɔ nʼadekoradan mu a ɛyɛ dwetɛ, sikakɔkɔɔ, nnuhwam ne ngo a ɛyɛ hwam.
Afei nso, ɔde wɔn kɔɔ nʼadekorabea, sane kyerɛɛ wɔn nʼadekoradan mu biribiara.
Biribiara nni nʼahemfie hɔ anaa nʼahemman mu hɔ a Hesekia ankyerɛ wɔn.
Na odiyifoɔ Yesaia kɔɔ ɔhene Hesekia nkyɛn, kɔbisaa no sɛ, “Ɛdeɛn na saa nnipa no repɛ?
Na wɔfiri he na wɔbaeɛ?” Hesekia buaa sɛ, “Wɔfiri Babilonia akyirikyiri asase so pɛɛ.” Yesaia bisaa no sɛ, “Ɛdeɛn na wɔhunuu wɔ wʼahemfie hɔ?” Hesekia buaa sɛ, “Wɔhunuu biribiara a ɛwɔ mʼahemfie ha.
Biribiara nni mʼademudeɛ mu a mamfa ankyerɛ wɔn.” Na Yesaia ka kyerɛɛ Hesekia sɛ, “Tie saa asɛm a ɛfiri Awurade nkyɛn yi: Ɛberɛ bi reba a biribiara a wowɔ no, agyapadeɛ a wʼagyanom akora no nyinaa, wɔbɛtwe akɔ Babilonia a ɛrenka hwee.
Sɛdeɛ Awurade seɛ nie: Wʼankasa wʼasefoɔ bi mpo, wɔbɛfa wɔn nnommum.
Wɔbɛyɛ apiafoɔ a wɔbɛsom wɔ Babiloniahene ahemfie.” Na Hesekia ka kyerɛɛ Yesaia sɛ, “Saa asɛm yi a ɛfiri Awurade nkyɛn a woaka akyerɛ me yi yɛ asɛm papa.” Nanso, na ɔhene no redwene sɛ, “Me berɛ so deɛ ɛsɛ sɛ yɛnya asomdwoeɛ ne banbɔ.” Nsɛm a ɛsisii Hesekia ahennie mu nkaeɛ no a ne tumidie ka ho, ne sɛdeɛ ɔyɛɛ subunu, twaa suka maa nsuo baa kuro no mu no nyinaa, wɔatwerɛ agu Yuda Ahemfo Abakɔsɛm Nwoma no mu.
Ɛberɛ a Hesekia wuiɛ no, ne babarima Manase na ɔdii nʼadeɛ sɛ ɔhene.
Manase Di Ɔhene Wɔ Yuda Ɛberɛ a Manase dii ɔhene no, na wadi mfeɛ dumienu, na ɔdii ɔhene Yerusalem mfirinhyia aduonum enum.
Na ne maame din de Hefsiba.
Ɔyɛɛ bɔne wɔ Awurade ani so, suasuaa abosonsomfoɔ aman nneyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ akyiwadeɛ.
Ɔsuaa deɛ ɛnam so maa Awurade pamoo abosonsomfoɔ no firii asase a ɛda Israel anim no so no.
Ɔsane sisii abosonsomfoɔ abosonnan a nʼagya Hesekia bubu guiɛ no.
Ɔyɛɛ afɔrebukyia pii maa Baal, ɛnna ɔsii Asera dua, sɛdeɛ Israelhene Ahab yɛeɛ ara pɛ.
Afei, ɔkoto sɔree ewiem atumfoɔ.
Na mpo, ɔsisii abosom afɔrebukyia pii wɔ Awurade asɔredan mu; baabi a Awurade aka sɛ wɔnhyɛ ne din animuonyam no.
Ɔsisii saa afɔrebukyia no wɔ Awurade Asɔredan no adihɔ mmienu hɔ.
Na mpo, Manase de ɔno ankasa babarima bɔɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ ogya mu.
Na ɔyɛ abayisɛm, kɔ abisa.
Ɔkɔɔ asamanfrɛfoɔ hɔ ne asumanfoɔ so.
Ɔyɛɛ bɔne bebree Awurade ani so, ma ɛhyɛɛ no abufuo.
Manase faa Asera dua a wayɛ no, de kɔsii asɔredan mu, beaeɛ korɔ no ara a Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Dawid ne ne babarima Salomo sɛ, “Wɔbɛhyɛ me din animuonyam wɔ ha daa nyinaa wɔ saa asɔredan yi mu wɔ Yerusalem.
Yerusalem yɛ kuro a mayi afiri Israel mmusuakuo a aka no nyinaa mu.
Na sɛ Israelfoɔ bɛtie mʼahyɛdeɛ a menam mʼakoa Mose so hyɛ maa wɔn no a, merentwa wɔn asuo mfiri asase yi a mede maa wɔn agyanom no so.” Nanso, nnipa no antie.
Manase dii wɔn anim, ma wɔyɛɛ bɔne bebree a ɛsene abosonsom aman a Awurade sɛee no ɛberɛ a Israelfoɔ kɔɔ saa asase no so no mpo.
Awurade nam nʼasomfoɔ a wɔyɛ nʼadiyifoɔ so kaa sɛ, “Yudahene Manase ayɛ akyiwadeɛ bebree.
Na mpo, ɔyɛ omumuyɛfoɔ sene Amorifoɔ a wɔbɛtenaa asase yi so ansa na Israel reba no.
Wadi Yudafoɔ anim, de wɔn akɔ ahonisom mu.
Enti, sei na Awurade, Israel Onyankopɔn, seɛ: Mede ɔhaw ne abɛbrɛsɛ bɛto Yerusalem ne Yuda so ama aso a ɛbɛte saa nsɛm no mu ayɛ no gyenn.
Mɛfa ɛkwan a menam so buu Samaria ne Ahab abusua atɛn no so mabu Yerusalem atɛn.
Mɛpepa nnipa a wɔwɔ Yerusalem nyinaa, te sɛ deɛ obi hohoro ayowaa mu, na ɔdane butu no.
Na mpo, mɛpo me nkurɔfoɔ kakra a wɔaka no, na mede wɔn bɛma wɔn atamfoɔ sɛ asadeɛ.
Ɛfiri sɛ, wɔayɛ bɔne kɛseɛ wɔ mʼanim, nam so ahyɛ me abufuo, firi ɛberɛ a wɔn agyanom firii Misraim no.” Manase kunkumm nnipa a wɔnyɛɛ bɔne nso bebree kɔsii sɛ, mogya a ɛdi bem hyɛɛ Yerusalem ma, firi tire kɔsi tire.
Yei ka bɔne a ɔmaa Yudafoɔ no yɛ de wɔn kɔɔ bɔne a wɔyɛɛ no Awurade ani so no ho.
Manase ahennie ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne dwuma a ɔdiiɛ nyinaa ne bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ no, wɔatwerɛ agu Yuda Ahemfo Abakɔsɛm Nwoma no mu.
Manase wuiɛ no, wɔsiee no wɔ ahemfie no turo a na ɛyɛ Usa dea no mu.
Na ne babarima Amon na ɔdii nʼadeɛ sɛ ɔhene.
Amon Di Adeɛ Yuda Amon dii ɔhene no, na wadi mfeɛ aduonu mmienu.
Ɔdii ɔhene Yerusalem mfeɛ mmienu.
Na wɔfrɛ ne maame Mesulemet a na ɔyɛ Harus a ɔfiri Yolba no babaa.
Ɔyɛɛ bɔne wɔ Awurade ani so, sɛdeɛ nʼagya Manase yɛeɛ no ara pɛ.
Ɔfaa nʼagya nhwɛsoɔ so, somm ahoni korɔ no ara a na nʼagya somm wɔn no.
Ɔgyaa Awurade, nʼagyanom Onyankopɔn no na wampɛ sɛ ɔbɛfa Awurade akwan so.
Na Amon no ankasa asomfoɔ bɔɔ ne ho pɔ, kumm no wɔ nʼahemfie.
Na nnipa a wɔwɔ asase no so nyinaa kunkumm nnipa a wɔbɔɔ ɔhene Amon ho pɔ no, na wɔde ne babarima Yosia dii adeɛ sɛ ɔhene.
Amon ahennie ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne dwuma a ɔdiiɛ no nyinaa, wɔatwerɛ agu Yuda Ahemfo Abakɔsɛm Nwoma no mu.
Wɔsiee no wɔ ne boda a ɛwɔ Usa turo mu hɔ no mu.
Na ne babarima Yosia dii adeɛ sɛ ɔhene.
Yosia Di Ɔhene Wɔ Yuda Ɛberɛ a Yosia dii ɔhene wɔ Yuda no, na wadi mfirinhyia nwɔtwe, na ɔdii adeɛ Yerusalem mfeɛ aduasa baako.
Na ne maame din de Yedida a ɔyɛ Adaia a ɔfiri Boskat no babaa.
Ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛsɔ Awurade ani, na ɔfaa ne tete agya Dawid nhwɛsoɔ.
Wammane ankɔ nifa anaa benkum.
Ɔhene Yosia dii mfirinhyia dunwɔtwe wɔ nʼahennie mu no, ɔsomaa Asalia babarima Safan, asɛnniiɛ twerɛfoɔ Mesulam nana, kɔɔ Awurade Asɔredan mu.
Ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Kɔ ɔsɔfopanin Hilkia nkyɛn, na ma ɔnkan sika a apono anohwɛfoɔ no agyegye afiri nnipa no nkyɛn wɔ Awurade Asɔredan mu no.
Fa saa sika yi hyɛ nnipa a wɔayi wɔn sɛ wɔnhwɛ asɔredan no ho nsiesie no nsa.
Na wɔde atua adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔbɛsiesie Awurade Asɔredan no ho ka.
Ɛho bɛhia sɛ wɔbɛfa nnua adwumfoɔ, adansifoɔ ne abohyehyɛfoɔ.
Afei, ma wɔntɔ nnua ne aboɔ a wɔatwa a wɔde bɛsiesie asɔredan no.
Nanso, ɛho nhia sɛ adansie no sohwɛfoɔ bɛbu sika a wɔn nsa bɛka no ho nkonta, ɛfiri sɛ, wɔyɛ nokwafoɔ.” Helkia Kɔhunu Onyankopɔn Mmara No Ɔsɔfopanin Hilkia ka kyerɛɛ asɛnniiɛ twerɛfoɔ Safan sɛ, “Mahunu Mmara Nwoma no wɔ Awurade Asɔredan mu hɔ.” Na Hilkia de nwoma mmobɔeɛ no maa Safan, na ɔkenkaneeɛ.
Safan sane kɔɔ ɔhene no nkyɛn kɔkaa sɛ, “Wo mpanimfoɔ no de sika a wɔgyegyee wɔ Awurade asɔredan no mu no ama adwumayɛfoɔ no ne sohwɛfoɔ a wɔwɔ asɔredan no ho no.” Safan sane ka kyerɛɛ ɔhene no sɛ, “Ɔsɔfoɔ Hilkia de nwoma mmobɔeɛ bi ama me.” Na Safan kenkan kyerɛɛ ɔhene no.
Ɛberɛ a ɔhene no tee nsɛm a ɛwɔ Awurade Mmara Nwoma no mu no, ɔde ahometeɛ sunsuanee ne ntadeɛ mu.
Na ɔhyɛɛ ɔsɔfoɔ Hilkia, Safan babarima Ahikam ne Mikaia babarima Akbor ne asɛnniiɛ twerɛfoɔ Safan ne ɔhene fotufoɔ Asaia sɛ, “Monkɔ asɔredan no mu, na monkɔkasa nkyerɛ Awurade mma me, mma nnipa no ne Yuda nyinaa.
Mommisa no nsɛm a wɔatwerɛ agu nwoma mmobɔeɛ no a wahunu no ho asɛm.
Awurade abufuhyeɛ aba yɛn so, ɛfiri sɛ, yɛn agyanom anni nwoma yi mu nsɛm so.
Ɛnyɛ deɛ nwoma yi ka sɛ yɛnyɛ no na yɛyɛ.” Enti, ɔsɔfoɔ Hilkia, Ahikam, Akbor, Safan ne Asaia kɔɔ Yerusalem Fa Foforɔ Misne kɔhunuu odiyifoɔ Hulda.
Na ɔyɛ Tikwa babarima Salum yere, a na ɔyɛ Harhas a ɔhwɛ ntadeɛ adaka a ɛwɔ asɔredan mu so no nso nana.
Ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ, “Awurade, Israel Onyankopɔn akasa.
Monkɔka nkyerɛ onipa a ɔsomaa mo no sɛ, ‘Sɛdeɛ Awurade seɛ nie: Mɛsɛe kuropɔn yi ne mu nnipa, sɛdeɛ matwerɛ wɔ nwoma mmobɔeɛ a mokenkaneɛ no mu no.
Ɛfiri sɛ, me nkurɔfoɔ agya me, na wɔsom anyame huhuo, na biribiara a wɔayɛ no, ahyɛ me abufuo.
Mʼabufuhyeɛ redɛre wɔ ha, na ɛrennum.’ Na monkɔ Yudahene a ɔsomaa mo no nkyɛn nkɔhwehwɛ Awurade, na monka nkyerɛ no sɛ, Sei na Awurade, Israel Onyankopɔn ka fa asɛm a woate no seesei no ho.
Wotee asɛm a meka de tiaa kuropɔn no ne emu nnipa no sɛ, wɔbɛdome saa asase yi na ada mpan no, ɛyɛɛ wo ya, ma wobrɛɛ wo ho ase Awurade anim.
Wode ahometeɛ sunsuanee wo ntadeɛ mu, suu wɔ mʼanim ahonu mu.
Enti, nokorɛm, Awurade se, ‘mate wo sufrɛ.
Amanehunu a mehyɛɛ ho bɔ de tiaa kuropɔn yi no bɛba wo wuo ne wosie akyi.
Worenhunu amanehunu a mede bɛba kuropɔn yi so no.’ ” Enti, wɔsane de ne nkra no kɔmaa ɔhene no.
Yosia Gyedisom Mu Nsakraeɛ Afei, ɔhene no frɛɛ Yuda ne Yerusalem mpanimfoɔ nyinaa.
Na ɔhene no ne Yuda ne Yerusalem manfoɔ ne asɔfoɔ ne adiyifoɔ a ɛfiri akumaa so kɔsi ɔkɛseɛ so, foro kɔɔ Awurade Asɔredan no mu.
Ɛhɔ na ɔhene no kenkanee Apam Nwoma a wɔahunu wɔ Awurade Asɔredan mu hɔ no nyinaa kyerɛɛ wɔn.
Ɔhene no tenaa beaeɛ bi a ɛkyerɛ ne tumi wɔ afadum no ho, hyɛɛ apam no mu den bio wɔ Awurade anim.
Ɔhyɛɛ bɔ sɛ, ɔfiri nʼakoma ne ne kra nyinaa mu bɛdi Awurade mmaransɛm ahyɛdeɛ ne mmara nyinaa so.
Ɔfaa saa ɛkwan yi so sii apam no mu nhyehyɛeɛ ahodoɔ a na wɔatwerɛ wɔ nwoma no mu no nyinaa so dua, maa nnipa no nyinaa hyɛɛ bɔ sɛ wɔbɛdi so.
Afei, ɔhene hyɛɛ ɔsɔfopanin Hilkia ne asɔfoɔ akunini ne asɔredan sohwɛfoɔ nyinaa sɛ, wɔnyiyi nneɛma a na wɔde som Baal ne Asera ne ewiem atumfoɔ no nyinaa mfiri Awurade asɔredan no mu.
Ɔhene no ma wɔhyee ne nyinaa wɔ Kidron bɔnhwa a ɛwɔ Yerusalem mfikyire no, soaa ne nsõ de kɔɔ Bet-El.
Ɔpamoo abosom akɔmfoɔ a Yuda ahemfo a wɔdii ɛkan no yii wɔn no nyinaa, ɛfiri sɛ, na wɔhye nnuhwam wɔ Yuda abosomfie nyinaa mu a mpo, na ɛreyɛ akɔduru Yerusalem kurom.
Wɔhyee nnuhwam maa Baal ne owia, ɔsrane ne nsoromma ne ewiem atumfoɔ.
Ɔhene no tuu Asera afɔrebukyia no firii Awurade asɔredan mu, de kɔɔ Yerusalem mfikyire wɔ Kidron bɔnhwa mu hɔ kɔhyee no.
Afei, ɔyam dua no muhumuhu, kɔtoo ne mfuturo no guu amusieeɛ.
Ɔdwirii asɔreeɛ adwamanfoɔ adan a na ɛwɔ Awurade Asɔredan no mu no, baabi a na mmaa no nwono nkatahotam, de kata Asera dua no ho no nyinaa guiɛ.
Yosia sane de Awurade asɔfoɔ no a na wɔtete Yuda nkuro afoforɔ so no nyinaa baa Yerusalem.
Ɛfiri Geba kɔsi Beer-Seba, ɔsɛee ɛhɔ abosonnan no nyinaa.
Saa beaeɛ no na na wɔhye nnuhwam no.
Ɔbubuu abosonnan a ɛwɔ Yosua a na ɔyɛ Yerusalem amrado no ɛpono ano.
Sɛ obi rewura kuropɔn no mu a ɔbɛhunu saa ɛpono no wɔ kuropɔn ɛpono no benkum so.
Asɔfoɔ a na wɔsom abosonnan no mu no, na wɔmma wɔn ɛkwan mma wɔnnsom wɔ Awurade afɔrebukyia a ɛwɔ Yerusalem no so, nanso na wɔma wɔne asɔfoɔ a aka no di burodo a mmɔreka nni mu no.
Afei, ɔhene no sɛee Tofet afɔrebukyia a na ɛwɔ Ben-Hinom bɔnhwa no mu no enti, na obiara ntumi mfa ne babarima anaa ne babaa mmɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ ogya mu wɔ so sɛ afɔrebɔdeɛ a wɔde ma Molek bio.
Ɔtutuu apɔnkɔ sɛso a wɔagu a ɛsisi Awurade Asɔredan ɛkwan no ano a Yuda ahemfo too edin maa owia no nyinaa firii hɔ.
Na ne nyinaa wowɔ adihɔ a ɛbɛn opiani bi a wɔfrɛ no Natan-Malek dan ho.
Yosia hyee nteaseɛnam a na wɔato edin ama owia no.
Yosia bubuu afɔrebukyia a Yuda ahemfo sisii wɔ ahemfie no atifi wɔ Ahas dan apampam no nyinaa.
Ɔhene no bubuu afɔrebukyia a Manase sisii wɔ Awurade Asɔredan no adihɔ mmienu hɔ no nyinaa guiɛ.
Ɔdwirii no pasapasa, too ne nkunkumaboɔ no petee Kidron bɔnhwa no mu.
Ɔhene no sane guu abosonnan a ɛwɔ Yerusalem apueeɛ fam no ne deɛ ɛwɔ Ɔsɛeɛ Bepɔ no anafoɔ fam no.
Saa beaeɛ no na Israelhene Salomo sisii abosonnan maa Astoret, a ɛyɛ Sidonfoɔ bosom bɔne, ne Kemos, Moabfoɔ bosom bɔne, ne Molek, Amonfoɔ bosom bɔne.
Yosia dwerɛɛ afadum kronkron no nyinaa, bubuu Asera afɔrebukyia no.
Ɔde nnipa nnompe guguu ne nyinaa so.
Ɔhene no sane bubuu afɔrebukyia a ɛwɔ Bet-El abosonnan a Nebat babarima Yeroboam yɛeɛ ɛberɛ a ɔdii Israel anim, de wɔn kɔɔ bɔne mu no.
Yosia yam aboɔ no, ma ɛdanee mfuturo, hyee Asera dua no.
Ɛberɛ a Yosia retoto nʼani no, ɔhunuu damena pii wɔ kokoɔ no nkyɛnmu.
Ɔhyɛɛ sɛ wɔntu nnompe no, na ɔhyee ne nyinaa wɔ afɔrebukyia a ɛwɔ Bet-El no so, de guu afɔrebukyia no ho fi.
Yei siiɛ sɛdeɛ Awurade nam Onyankopɔn onipa so ahyɛ no, ɛberɛ a Yeroboam kɔgyinaa afɔrebukyia no ho wɔ afahyɛ da no.
Afei Yosia danee ne ho hwɛɛ Onyankopɔn onipa a ɔhyɛɛ yeinom nyinaa ho nkɔm no damena.
Yosia bisaa sɛ, “Nkaeɛdum bɛn na ɛwɔ nohoa no?” Na nnipa a wɔwɔ kuro no mu ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn onipa no a ɔfiri Yuda a ɔhyɛɛ nkɔm faa dwuma a woadi seesei wɔ afɔrebukyia a ɛwɔ Bet-El ho no ɔboda.” Yosia buaa sɛ, “Momma no nwɔ hɔ.
Obiara mmfa ne nsa nka ne nnompe no.” Ɛno enti, wɔanhye ne nnompe no anaa odiyifoɔ akɔkoraa a ɔfiri Samaria no deɛ nso.
Na Yosia bubuu abosonnan no a ɛwɔ Samaria no, sɛdeɛ ɔyɛɛ wɔ Bet-El no.
Israel ahemfo ahodoɔ bi na wɔsisiiɛ de hyɛɛ Awurade abufuo.
Ɔkunkumm asɔreeɛ so abosomfoɔ no wɔ wɔn ankasa afɔrebukyia so, na ɔhyee nnipa nnompe wɔ afɔrebukyia ahodoɔ no so, de guu ho fi.
Akyire yi, ɔsane kɔɔ Yerusalem.
Yosia Di Twam Afahyɛ Ɔhene Yosia hyɛɛ nnipa no nyinaa sɛ, “Ɛsɛ sɛ modi Twam Afahyɛ ma Awurade, mo Onyankopɔn, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ wɔ Apam Nwoma mu no.” Ɛfiri ɛberɛ a atemmufoɔ dii Israel so mfeɛ bebree a atwam wɔ Israel ne Yuda ahemfo so no, wɔnnii Twam Afahyɛ no bi saa da.
Ɛberɛ a ɔhene Yosia dii mfeɛ dunwɔtwe wɔ akonnwa so no na wɔdii saa Twam Afahyɛ yi wɔ Yerusalem maa Awurade.
Yosia tɔre asamanfrɛfoɔ ne adunsifoɔ ne afie mu anyame ne ahonisom biara ase wɔ Yerusalem ne Yuda asase so baabiara.
Ɔyɛɛ saa de dii mmara a wɔatwerɛ wɔ nwoma mmobɔeɛ a ɔsɔfoɔ Hilkia kɔhunuu wɔ Awurade Asɔredan mu no so.
Ɔhene biara mmaeɛ a ɔte sɛ Yosia a ɔde nʼakoma, ne kra ne nʼahoɔden ama Awurade na ɔnam so adi Mose mmara nyinaa so.
Na ɔhene biara nso mmaeɛ a ɔte sɛ ɔno.
Nanso, yei nyinaa akyi no, Awurade abufuo no dɛre tiaa Yuda, ɛsiane bɔne akɛseɛ a Ɔhene Manase yɛeɛ no.
Ɛno enti, wanyi nʼabufuhyeɛ no amfiri wɔn so.
Awurade kaa sɛ, “Mɛsɛe Yuda, sɛdeɛ mesɛee Israel no.
Mɛpam nnipa no afiri mʼanim, na mapo me kuropɔn Yerusalem ne Asɔredan a anka ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhyɛ me din animuonyam wɔ mu no.” Yosia ahennie ho asɛm nkaeɛ ne dwuma a ɔdiiɛ nyinaa no, wɔatwerɛ agu Yuda Ahemfo Abakɔsɛm Nwoma no mu.
Ɛberɛ a Yosia di ɔhene no, Misraimhene Farao Neko kɔɔ Asubɔnten Eufrate ho kɔboaa Asiriahene.
Ɔhene Yosia de nʼakodɔm tuu sa, kɔko tiaa no, nanso ɛberɛ a wɔhyiaa wɔ Megido no, ɔhene Neko kumm no.
Yosia akodɔm mu mpanimfoɔ no de nʼamu no too teaseɛnam mu firii Megido, baa Yerusalem bɛsiee no ɔno ankasa ɔboda mu.
Na nnipa no sraa ne babarima Yehoahas ngo, sii no ɔhene.
Yehoahas Di Ɔhene Wɔ Yuda Ɛberɛ a Yehoahas dii ɔhene no, na wadi mfeɛ aduonu mmiɛnsa, na ɔdii adeɛ Yerusalem abosome mmiɛnsa.
Na ne maame yɛ Yeremia a ɔfiri Libna no babaa a na ne din de Hamutal.
Ɔyɛɛ bɔne wɔ Awurade ani so, sɛdeɛ nʼagyanom yɛeɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Farao Neko de Yehoahas too afiase wɔ Ribla wɔ Hamat asase so, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, ɔrentumi nni ɔhene wɔ Yerusalem.
Afei, ɔbisaa sɛ Yuda ntua toɔ dwetɛ tɔno mmiɛnsa ne fa ne sikakɔkɔɔ kilogram aduasa ɛnan sɛ apeatoɔ.
Afei, Farao Neko de Eliakim a ɔyɛ Yosia babarima, dii adeɛ, ma ɔsii nʼagya ananmu.
Ɔsesaa Eliakim din frɛɛ no Yehoiakim.
Wɔde Yehoahas kɔɔ Misraim sɛ odeduani, na ɔwuu wɔ hɔ.
Yehoiakim Di Ɔhene Wɔ Yuda Sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɔbɛnya dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ toɔ a Farao Neko regye no, Yehoiakim gyegyee akwabrantoɔ firii Yudafoɔ nkyɛn.
Obiara tuaa sɛdeɛ nʼahonya teɛ.
Ɛberɛ a Yehoiakim dii adeɛ no, na wadi mfirinhyia aduonu enum, na ɔdii adeɛ Yerusalem mfeɛ dubaako.
Na ne maame din de Sebuda a ɔyɛ Pedaia a ɔfiri Ruma babaa.
Ɔyɛɛ bɔne wɔ Awurade ani so, sɛdeɛ nʼagyanom yɛeɛ no.
Yehoiakim ahennie mu no, Babiloniahene Nebukadnessar bɛto hyɛɛ Yuda asase so.
Yehoiakim maa ne nsa so, na ɔtuaa toɔ maa no mfeɛ mmiɛnsa, nanso ɔtee Nebukadnessar so atua.
Na Awurade somaa akofoɔ firi Babilonia, Aram, Moab ne Amon, kɔko tiaa Yuda, sɛee no, sɛdeɛ Awurade nam nʼadiyifoɔ so hyɛɛ ho nkɔm no.
Saa amanehunu yi baa Yuda so, sɛdeɛ Awurade hyɛeɛ no, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɔbɛyi no afiri nʼanim, ɛsiane bɔne dodoɔ a Manase yɛeɛ no enti.
Manase kaa mogya a ɛdi bem guiɛ de hyɛɛ Yerusalem ma, ɛno enti, Awurade amfa yei ankyɛ.
Yehoiakim ahennie ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne dwuma a ɔdiiɛ nyinaa, wɔatwerɛ agu Yuda Ahemfo Abakɔsɛm Nwoma no mu.
Ɛberɛ a Yehoiakim wuiɛ no, ne babarima Yehoiakyin na ɔdii nʼadeɛ sɛ ɔhene.
Na ɛno akyi, Misraimhene ansane amma bio.
Na Babiloniahene na ɔfaa asase a anka na Misraimfoɔ no agyeɛ no nyinaa, ɛfiri Misraim asuwa no so, kɔsi Asubɔnten Eufrate ho.
Yehoiakyin Di Ɔhene Wɔ Yuda Ɛberɛ a Yehoiakyin dii adeɛ no, na wadi mfeɛ dunwɔtwe, na ɔdii ɔhene Yerusalem abosome mmiɛnsa.
Na ne maame yɛ Elnatan a ɔfiri Yerusalem no babaa Nehusta.
Yehoiakyin yɛɛ bɔne wɔ Awurade ani so, sɛdeɛ nʼagya yɛeɛ no ara pɛ.
Yehoiakyin ahennie mu no, Babiloniahene Nebukadnessar akodɔm mu mpanimfoɔ bɛtuaa Yerusalem.
Ɔtua no mu, Nebukadnessar ankasa baa kuropɔn no mu.
Na ɔhene Yehoiakyin ne nʼafotufoɔ, atitire, mpanimfoɔ ne ɔhemmaa de wɔn ho maa Babiloniafoɔ.
Nebukadnessar dii adeɛ ne mfeɛ nwɔtwe so no, ɔkyeree Yehoiakyin, de no too afiase.
Sɛdeɛ Awurade aka dada no, Nebukadnessar tasee agyapadeɛ a ɛwɔ Awurade Asɔredan mu hɔ no ne ahemfie hɔ nyinaa.
Wɔsɛee sikakɔkɔɔ akoradeɛ a Israelhene Salomo de sisii asɔredan mu hɔ no nyinaa.
Ɔhene Nebukadnessar kyekyeree nneduafoɔ ɔpedu firii Yerusalem a ahenemma nyinaa ne asraafoɔ akodifoɔ, adwumfoɔ ne atomfoɔ a wɔdi mu ka ho.
Ɛno enti, ahiafoɔ nko ara na ɔgyaa wɔn wɔ asase no so.
Nebukadnessar faa ɔhene Yehoiakyin de no kɔɔ Babilonia sɛ odeduani a ne yerenom ne ne mpanimfoɔ, ɔhemmaa ne Yerusalem nnipa atitire ka ho.
Afei, ɔfaa akofoɔ a wɔte apɔ no mpem nson, adwumfoɔ ne atomfoɔ apem a wɔn nyinaa yɛ mmarima a wɔn ho yɛ den na wɔfata akodie.
Afei, Babiloniahene de Yehoiakyin wɔfa Matania dii adeɛ sɛ ɔhene foforɔ.
Ɔsesaa Matania din frɛɛ no Sedekia.
Sedekia Di Ɔhene Wɔ Yuda Ɛberɛ a Sedekia dii adeɛ no, na wadi mfirinhyia aduonu baako.
Ɔdii adeɛ wɔ Yerusalem mfirinhyia dubaako.
Na ne maame din de Hamutal a ɔyɛ Yeremia a ɔfiri Libna no babaa.
Na Sedekia yɛɛ bɔne wɔ Awurade ani so, sɛdeɛ Yehoiakim yɛeɛ no.
Ɛno enti, Awurade abufuo enti na yeinom nyinaa baa Yerusalem ne Yuda so, na akyire yi, ɔyii nʼani firii wɔn so.
Yerusalem Asehweɛ Afei, Sedekia sɔre tiaa Babiloniahene.
Ɔbosome Tebet (bɛyɛ Ɔpɛpɔn) da a ɛtɔ so dunum wɔ Sedekia ahennie mfeɛ nkron so no, ɔhene Nebukadnessar dii nʼakodɔm nyinaa anim, bɛko tiaa Yerusalem.
Wɔtwaa kuropɔn no ho hyiaeɛ.
Wɔbobɔɔ mpampim wɔ kuropɔn no afasuo ho.
Wɔkaa Yerusalem hyɛɛ kɔsii ɔhene Sedekia ahennie no mfeɛ dubaako so.
Ɛduruu Tammus bosome (bɛyɛ Kitawonsa) da a ɛtɔ so dunwɔtwe no, Sedekia ahennie mfeɛ dubaako mu no, na ɛkɔm a aba kuropɔn no mu no ano ayɛ den yie, ama wɔn aduane a aka no nyinaa asa.
Na kuropɔn no ɔfasuo fa bi abu agu fam enti, asraafoɔ no nyinaa yɛɛ adwene sɛ, wɔbɛdwane afiri kuropɔn no mu.
Nanso, ɛsiane sɛ na Babiloniafoɔ atwa kuropɔn no ho ahyia enti, wɔtwɛn kɔsii anadwo, na wɔdwane faa ɛpono a ɛda afasuo mmienu a ɛwɔ ɔhene no nturo no mu mu.
Wɔyɛɛ ntɛm faa wiramkwan de wɔn ani kyerɛɛ Yordan bɔnhwa no.
Nanso, Babiloniafoɔ no tii wɔn, kɔkyeree ɔhene no wɔ Yeriko tata so, ɛfiri sɛ, saa ɛberɛ no, na ne mmarima no nyinaa adwane agya no.
Wɔde no brɛɛ Babiloniahene wɔ Ribla, ma wɔbuu no atɛn.
Babiloniahene maa Sedekia de nʼani kann hwɛɛ sɛ, wɔrekunkum ne mmammarima nyinaa.
Afei, wɔtutuu Sedekia ani, de kɔbere nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn guu no, na wɔde no kɔɔ Babilonia.
Wɔsɛe Asɔredan No Ab bosome (bɛyɛ Ɔsannaa) ɛda a ɛtɔ so dunan wɔ afe a ɛyɛ Nebukadnessar mfeɛ dunkron adedie mu no, Nebusaradan a ɔyɛ awɛmfoɔ so panin a ɔyɛ Babiloniahene mpanimfoɔ nu mu baako no kɔɔ Yerusalem.
Ɔhyee Awurade Asɔredan ne ahemfie ne afie a ɛwɔ Yerusalem nyinaa.
Adan pa a ɛwɔ kuropɔn no mu no, ɔsɛee ne nyinaa.
Awɛmfoɔ so panin no hwɛ maa Babilonia akodɔm no bubuu Yerusalem afasuo no.
Nebusaradan a ɔyɛ awɛmfoɔ so panin no kyekyeree wɔn a wɔkaa kuropɔn no mu no, twaa wɔn ne nnipa a aka no ne akodɔm a wɔdaa wɔn ho adi sɛ wɔtaa Babiloniahene akyi no asuo.
Na awɛmfoɔ so panin no maa mmɔborɔfoɔ no mu bi tenaa Yuda, sɛ wɔnhwɛ bobe mfuo ne mfuo foforɔ a ɛka ho no so.
Babiloniafoɔ no bubuu kɔbere mfrafraeɛ afadum, kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nsuo nteaseɛnam ne Po a na ɛwɔ Awurade Asɔredan mu hɔ no, na wɔsoaa ne nyinaa kɔɔ Babilonia.
Wɔtasee nkukuo, sofi, nkanea akapɛ, nyowaa ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nneɛma ahodoɔ a wɔde di wɔn afɔrebɔ ho dwuma wɔ Asɔredan no mu no nyinaa.
Nebusaradan a ɔyɛ awɛmfoɔ so panin no sane tasee nkyɛnsee a wɔnoa mu ne nhweaseammɔ ne nkuku ne nkaka nkaeɛ a wɔde sikakɔkɔɔ ne dwetɛ ayɛ no nyinaa.
Kɔbere mfrafraeɛ a wɔnya firii afadum mmienu, nsuo teaseɛnam ne Ɛpo no mu no, na emu yɛ duru dodo sɛ wɔbɛtumi akari.
Ɔhene Salomo berɛ so na ɔyɛɛ saa nneɛma yi guu Awurade Asɔredan mu.
Na afadum no mu biara ɔsorokɔ yɛ anammɔn aduonu nson.
Kɔbere mfrafraeɛ no ntaasoɔ a ɛdeda afadum no mu biara so no ɔsorokɔ yɛ anammɔn nson ne fa a wɔde kɔbere mfrafraeɛ no ara bi a ɛyɛ atena sɛso ne ateaa aba sɛso atwa ho nyinaa ahyia de asiesie no.
Awɛmfoɔ so panin no kyekyeree ɔsɔfopanin Seraia, nʼabadiakyire Sefania ne apono ano sohwɛfoɔ mpanimfoɔ baasa sɛ nneduafoɔ.
Nnipa a na wɔakɔtetɛ no mu nso, ɔkyeree Yuda asraadɔm no mu panin baako, ɔhene no ankasa afotufoɔ baanum, asraadɔm sahene no twerɛfoɔ panin a na ɔfa nnipa wɔ adwuma mu ne ɔmanfoɔ aduosia.
Ɔsahene Nebusaradan de wɔn nyinaa kɔɔ Babiloniahene anim wɔ Ribla.
Wɔ Ribla a ɛwɔ Hamat hɔ no, ɔhene no ma wɔkunkum wɔn.
Enti wɔtwaa Yuda asuo firii nʼasase so.
Gedalia Hwɛ Yuda So Ɔhene Nebukadnessar yii Ahikam babarima Gedalia a na ɔyɛ Safan nana no sɛ amrado a na ɔhwɛ nnipa a wɔkaa Yuda no so.
Ɛberɛ a asraadɔm asahene ne wɔn mmarima tee sɛ Babiloniahene asi Gedalia amrado no, wɔkɔkaa ne ho wɔ Mispa.
Nnipa a wɔkɔkaa ne ho no ne Netania babarima Ismael, Karea babarima Yohanan, Tanhumet a ɔfiri Netofa babarima Seraia ne Maakatni babarima Yaasania ne wɔn mmarima nyinaa.
Gedalia dii nse, kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ, Babilonia mpanimfoɔ no amma hɔ ɔhaw so.
Ɔtuu wɔn fo sɛ, “Monnsuro sɛ mobɛsom Babiloniafoɔ.
Montena asase no so na monsom Babiloniahene, na ɛbɛsi mo yie.” Tisri bosome (bɛyɛ Ɛbɔ ne Ahinime ntam) no mpaemu wɔ saa afe no mu no, Netania babarima Ismael a ɔyɛ Elisama nana a na ɔfiri adehyeɛ abusua mu no de mmarima edu kɔɔ Mispa, kɔkumm Gedalia ne nnipa a na wɔka ne ho a wɔyɛ Yudafoɔ ne Babiloniafoɔ no nyinaa.
Afei, nnipa a wɔwɔ Yuda nyinaa, ɛfiri akumaa so, kɔsi ɔkɛseɛ so ne akodɔm asahene, bɔɔ huboa, na wɔdwane kɔɔ Misraim, ɛfiri sɛ, na wɔsuro sɛ Babiloniafoɔ no bɛyɛ wɔn biribi.
Israel Adehyeɛ Anidasoɔ Ɔhene Yehoiakyin dii mfeɛ aduasa nson wɔ nʼasutwa mu wɔ Babilonia no, Ewil-Merodak bɛdii Babiloniahene.
Ɔhunuu Yehoiakyin mmɔbɔ, enti ɔyii no firii afiase saa afe no ara mu Adar bosome (bɛyɛ Oforisuo) da a ɛtɔ so mmienu.
Ɔkaa abodwosɛm kyerɛɛ no, na ɔmaa no diberɛ a ɛwɔ animuonyam sene ahemfo a wɔne no wɔ Babilonia no deɛ.
Enti Yehoiakyin yii nʼafiase ntadeɛ guu nkyɛn, na ɛfiri saa ɛda no ɔdidii wɔ ɔhene didipono so ɛberɛ biara, kɔsii ne wu da.
Na Babiloniahene no sane maa Yehoiakyin sika ɛberɛ-ano-berɛ-ano, ma ɔde tuatua ne ho aka, kɔsii ne wu da.
Nnianimu Nwoma a ɛdi yei anim a ɛyɛ Ahemfo Nwoma a Ɛtɔ so Mmienu no awieeɛ kaa sɛdeɛ Israel ne Yuda nyinaa kɔɔ nkoasom mu.
Ɛyɛɛ ɛberɛ bɔne maa Onyankopɔn nkurɔfoɔ.
Ɛno akyi na wɔtwerɛɛ Berɛsosɛm no nyinaa a abɛyɛ Berɛsosɛm a Ɛdi Ɛkan ne deɛ Ɛtɔ so Mmienu.
Berɛsosɛm a Ɛdi Ɛkan no yɛ Samuel a Ɛtɔ so Mmienu no ntoasoɔ.
Ɛkaakae yɛn sɛ yɛmmma yɛn werɛ mfiri sɛ yɛbɛkae tete.
Ɛma yɛhwɛ yɛn akyi, ama yɛahunu yɛn abɔseɛ.
Berɛsosɛm a Ɛdi Ɛkan yi, wɔde Adam ho asɛm na ɛfitii aseɛ.
Afei wɔbobɔɔ akunini bi din wɔ Israel abakɔsɛm mu, de sii Dawid adehyebusua no so dua.
Nwoma no nkaeɛ ka Dawid a ɔyɛ Onyankopɔn onipa ho asɛm.
Emu Nsɛm Israel Mmusuadua Dawid Ahennie
Ɛfiri Adam So Kɔsi Noa Mma So Adam asefoɔ yɛ Set, Enos, Kenan, Mahalalel, Yared, Henok, Metusela, Lamek, Noa mma ne, Sem, Ham, ne Yafet.
Yafet Asefoɔ Na Yafet asefoɔ ne Gomer, Magog, Media, Yawan, Tubal, Mesek ne Tiras.
Na Gomer asefoɔ ne Askenas, Rifat ne Togarma.
Na Yawan asefoɔ ne Elisa, Tarsis, Kitim ne Rodanim.
Ham Asefoɔ Na Ham asefoɔ ne Kus, Misraim, Put ne Kanaan.
Na Kus asefoɔ ne Seba, Hawila, Sabta, Raama ne Sabteka.
Na Raama asefoɔ yɛ Saba ne Dedan.
Kus woo Nimrod.
Na Nimrod bɛyɛɛ ɔkofoɔ kɛseɛ wɔ asase so.
Misraim yɛ tete agya ma Ludfoɔ, Anamfoɔ, Lehabfoɔ, Naftuhfoɔ, Patrusfoɔ, Kasluhfoɔ ne Kaftorfoɔ a wɔn ase na Filistifoɔ firi.
Na Kanaan abakan din de Sidon a na ɔyɛ Sidonfoɔ tete agya.
Na Kanaan nso yɛ Hetifoɔ, Yebusifoɔ, Amorifoɔ, Girgasifoɔ, Hewifoɔ, Arkifoɔ, Sinifoɔ, Arwadfoɔ, Semarifoɔ ne Hamatifoɔ tete agya.
Sem Asefoɔ Na Sem asefoɔ yɛ Elam, Asur, Arfaksad, Lud ne Aram.
Aram asefoɔ ne Us, Hul, Geter ne Mas.
Na Arfaksad woo Sela na Sela woo Eber.
Eber woo mmammarima baanu.
Abakan no din de Peleg a asekyerɛ ne “nkyekyɛmu” ɛfiri sɛ, ne berɛ so na nnipa a wɔwɔ ewiase mu kyekyɛ kɔɔ kasa ahodoɔ mu na wɔbɔ hweteeɛ.
Nʼakyiri ba no din de Yoktan.
Yoktan woo Almodada, Selef, Hasarmawet, Yera, Hadoram, Usal, Dikla, Obal, Abimael, Seba, Ofir, Hawila ne Yobab.
Yeinom nyinaa yɛ Yoktan asefoɔ.
Ɛno enti, yei ne abusuadua a ɛfiri Sem: Arfaksad, Sela, Eber, Peleg, Reu, Serug, Nahor, Tera, ne Abram a akyire yi, wɔfrɛɛ no Abraham no.
Abraham Asefoɔ Abraham mmammarima yɛ Isak ne Ismael.
Na Ismael mmammarima nso ne Nebaiot a ɔyɛ nʼabakan, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam, Misma, Duma, Masa, Hadad, Tema, Yetur, Nafis ne Kedema.
Yeinom ne Ismael mmammarima.
Na Abraham mpena Ketura mmammarima ne Simran, Yoksan, Medan, Midian, Yisbak ne Sua.
Na Yoksan asefoɔ yɛ Seba ne Dedan.
Na Midian mmammarima ne Efa, Efer, Henok, Abida ne Eldaa.
Yeinom nyinaa yɛ Abraham ne ne mpena Ketura mmammarima.
Isak Asefoɔ Abraham woo Isak.
Isak mmammarima yɛ Esau ne Israel.
Esau Asefoɔ Na Esau mmammarima yɛ Elifas, Reuel, Yeus, Yalam ne Kora.
Na Elifas mmammarima yɛ Teman, Omar, Sefi, Gatam, Kenas, Timna ne Amalek.
Na Reuel mmammarima yɛ Nahat, Serah, Sama ne Misa.
Edomfoɔ Abɔseɛ Na Seir mmammarima yɛ Lotan, Sobal, Sibeon, Ana, Dison, Eser ne Disan.
Na Lotan mmammarima yɛ Hori ne Homam.
Na Lotan nuabaa din de Timna.
Na Sobal mmammarima yɛ Alian, Manahat, Ebal, Sefi ne Onam.
Sibeon mmammarima yɛ Aya ne Ana.
Na Ana babarima yɛ Dison.
Na Dison mma yɛ Hemdan, Esban, Yitran ne Keran.
Na Eser mmammarima yɛ Bilhan, Saawan ne Akan.
Na Disan mmammarima yɛ Us ne Aran.
Edom Sodifoɔ Yeinom ne ahemfo a wɔdii Edom so ansa na Israelfoɔ renya ahemfo: Beor babarima Bela, a ɔtenaa kuropɔn Dinhaba so dii ɔhene.
Na Bela wuiɛ no, Serah babarima Yobab a ɔfiri Bosra bɛdii nʼadeɛ sɛ ɔhene.
Na Yobab wuiɛ no, Husam a ɔfiri Teman asase so bɛdii nʼadeɛ sɛ ɔhene.
Husam owuo akyi Hadad a ɔyɛ Bedad babarima a ɔkɔdii Midian so nkonim wɔ Moab asase so no na ɔdii nʼadeɛ sɛ ɔhempɔn.
Wɔtoo nʼahenkuro no edin Hawit.
Hadad wuiɛ no, Samla a ɔfiri Masreka kuropɔn mu bɛyɛɛ ɔhene.
Samla wuiɛ no, Saulo a ɔfiri Rehobot a ɛda asuo Eufrate ho no bɛdii ɔhene.
Na Saulo wuiɛ no, Akbor babarima Baal-Hanan bɛdii ɔhene.
Baal-Hanan wuiɛ no, Hadad tenaa kuropɔn Pai mu dii ɔhene.
Na ne yere a wɔfrɛ no Mehetabel no yɛ Matred babaa ne Me-Sahab nso nana.
Na Hadad nso wuiɛ.
Na Edom mmusua no ntuanofoɔ ne Timna, Alwa, Yetet, Oholibama, Ela, Pinon, Kenas, Teman, Mibsar, Magdiel ne Iram.
Yeinom na na wɔyɛ Edom mmusua ntuanofoɔ.
Israel Awoɔ Ntoatoasoɔ Israel mmammarima yɛ Ruben, Simeon, Lewi, Yuda, Isakar, Sebulon, Dan, Yosef, Benyamin, Naftali, Gad ne Aser.
Yuda Asefoɔ Yuda ne Kanaanni baa Bat-Sua woo mmammarima baasa.
Na wɔn din de Er, Onan ne Sela.
Nanso, na abakan Er no yɛ omumuyɛfoɔ enti, Awurade kumm no.
Akyire no, Yuda ne nʼase kunafoɔ Tamar woo ntafoɔ.
Na wɔn din de Peres ne Serah.
Enti Yuda woo mmammarima baanum.
Na Peres mmammarima din de Hesron ne Hamul.
Serah mmammarima din de Simri, Etan, Heman, Kalkol ne Dara; wɔyɛ enum.
Akar a ɔyɛ Karmi babarima ne Serah asefoɔ no mu baako nam fa a ɔfaa asadeɛ a wɔgya maa Awurade no so, de amanehunu baa Israelfoɔ so.
Na Etan babarima ne Asaria.
Ɛfiri Yuda Nana Barima Hesron So Kɔsi Dawid So Hesron mmammarima edin de Yerahmeel, Ram ne Kaleb.
Ram yɛ Aminadab agya.
Aminadab yɛ Nahson a na ɔyɛ Yuda ntuanoni no agya.
Nahson yɛ Salma agya.
Na Salma nso yɛ Boas agya.
Boas yɛ Obed agya.
Obed yɛ Yisai agya.
Yisai abakan yɛ Eliab.
Deɛ ɔtɔ so mmienu yɛ Abinadab ɛnna deɛ ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa yɛ Simea.
Na deɛ ɔtɔ so ɛnan yɛ Netanel ɛnna Radai tɔ so enum.
Ne babarima a ɔtɔ so nsia no din de Osem, na Dawid na na ɔtɔ so nson.
Na wɔn nuanom mmaa din de Seruia ne Abigail.
Na Seruia woo mmammarima baasa a wɔn din yɛ Abisai, Yoab ne Asahel.
Abigail waree ɔbarima bi a ne din de Yeter a ɔyɛ Ismaelni na wɔwoo ɔbabarima a wɔtoo no edin Amasa.
Hesron Babarima Kaleb Asefoɔ Na Hesron babarima Kaleb wɔ yerenom baanu a wɔne Asuba ne Yeriot.
Na Asuba mmammarima edin de Yeser, Sobab ne Ardon.
Asuba owuo akyi no, Kaleb waree Efrata.
Wɔwoo ɔbabarima too no edin Hur.
Hur woo Uri.
Uri nso woo Besaleel.
Ɛberɛ a Hesron dii mfeɛ aduosia no, ɔwaree Gilead nuabaa a na ɔyɛ Makir babaa.
Wɔwoo ɔbabarima too no edin Segub.
Segub woo Yair a ɔdii nkuro aduonu mmiɛnsa so wɔ Gilead asase so no.
(Akyire no, Gesur ne Aram gyee Yair nkuro, sane gyee Kenat ne ne nkuraa aduosia a atwa ho ahyia no nyinaa.)
Na yeinom nyinaa yɛ Makir a ɔyɛ Gilead agya no asefoɔ.
Hesron wuu wɔ kuro Kaleb-Efrata mu no, ankyɛ na ne yere Abia woo ɔbabarima a wɔtoo no edin Asur (Tekoa agya).
Hesron Ba Yerahmeel Asefoɔ Hesron abakan Yerahmeel mmammarima a ɔwoo wɔn no edin yɛ Ram (abakan), Buna, Oren, Osem ne Ahiya.
Yerahmeel wɔ yere a ɔtɔ so mmienu a wɔfrɛ no Atara, na ɔno na ɔwoo Onam.
Ram a ɔyɛ Yerahmeel abakan no mmammarima yɛ Maas, Yamin ne Eker.
Onam mmammarima yɛ Samai ne Yada.
Na Samai mmammarima yɛ Nadab ne Abisur.
Na Abisur ne ne yere Abihail mmammarima yɛ Ahban ne Molid.
Na Nadab mmammarima yɛ Seled ne Apaim.
Seled wuiɛ a wanwo mma; na Apaim deɛ, ɔwoo ɔbabarima a wɔfrɛ no Yisi.
Na Yisi woo Sesan.
Na Sesan nyaa nʼaseni bi a wɔfrɛ no Ahlai.
Na Samai nuabarima Yada woo Yeter ne Yonatan.
Na Yeter wuiɛ a wanwo ba biara, nanso Yonatan woo mmammarima baanu a na wɔfrɛ wɔn Pelet ne Sasa.
Na yeinom nyinaa yɛ Yerahmeel asefoɔ.
Na Sesan annya mmammarima, ɔnyaa mmammaa.
Na ɔwɔ Misraimni ɔsomfoɔ bi a ne din de Yarha.
Sesan de ne mmammaa no mu baako maa Yarha awadeɛ na wɔwoo ɔbabarima too no edin Atai.
Atai woo Natan na Natan woo Sabad.
Sabad woo Efial.
Efial woo Obed.
Obed woo Yehu na Yehu woo Asaria.
Asaria woo Heles.
Heles woo Eleasa.
Eleasa woo Sisemai na Sisemai woo Salum.
Salum woo Yekamia, na Yekamia woo Elisama.
Hesron Babarima Kaleb Asefoɔ Yerahmeel nua Kaleb babarima piesie ne Mesa a ɔyɛ Sif agya.
Na Kaleb babarima a ɔtɔ so mmienu din de Maresa a ɔyɛ Hebron agya.
Na Hebron mmammarima yɛ Kora, Tapua, Rekem ne Sema.
Na Sema woo Raham.
Raham woo Yorkeam.
Na Rekem woo Samai.
Na Samai woo Maon.
Maon woo Bet-Sur.
Na Kaleb mpena Efa woo Haran, Mosa ne Gases.
Na Haran woo Gases.
Na Yahdai mmammarima yɛ Regem, Yotam, Gesan, Pelet, Efa ne Saaf.
Kaleb mpena foforɔ bi a wɔfrɛ no Maaka woo Seber ne Tirhana.
Ɔsane woo Saaf a na ɔyɛ Madmana agya ne Sewa a na ɔyɛ Makbena ne Gibea agya.
Na Kaleb woo ɔbabaa a ne din de Aksa.
Yeinom nyinaa yɛ Kaleb asefoɔ.
Kaleb Babarima Hur Asefoɔ Kaleb yere Efrata abakan Hur mmammarima yɛ Sobal a ɔyɛ Kiriat-Yearim agya Salma a ɔyɛ Betlehem agya ne Haref a ɔyɛ Bet-Gader agya.
Sobal a ɔyɛ Kiriat-Yearim agya no mmammarima yɛ Haroe a ne fa yɛ Manahatini na ne fa a aka no firi Kiriat-Yearim mmusua mu.
Sobal asefoɔ a wɔka ho ne Yitrifoɔ, Putifoɔ, Sumatifoɔ ne Misraimfoɔ.
Wɔn mu na Sorafoɔ ne Estaolfoɔ firie.
Salma asefoɔ yɛ Betlehem, Netofafoɔ, Atrot-Bet-Yoabfoɔ, Manahatfoɔ fa bi, Sorifoɔ, ne atwerɛfoɔ mmusua a wɔte Yabes no, Tirafoɔ, Simeafoɔ ne Sukatfoɔ.
Yeinom nyinaa yɛ Kenifoɔ, Hamat a ɔyɛ Rekab agya no asefoɔ.
Dawid Asefoɔ Yeinom ne mmammarima a wɔwowoo wɔn maa Dawid wɔ Hebron.
Na nʼabakan din de Amnon a ne maame a na ɔfiri Yesreel no din de Ahinoam.
Ne ba a ɔtɔ so mmienu no, na ne din de Daniel.
Na ne maame a ɔfiri Karmel no din de Abigail.
Ne ba a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, na wɔfrɛ no Absalom.
Na ne maame din de Maaka a na ɔyɛ Gesurhene Talmai babaa.
Ne ba a ɔtɔ so ɛnan din de Adoniya a ne maame din de Hagit.
Ne ba a ɔtɔ so enum no, na wɔfrɛ no Sefatia.
Na wɔfrɛ ne maame Abital.
Ne ba a ɔtɔ so nsia no din de Yitream a na wɔfrɛ ne maame Egla.
Wɔwowoo mmammarima baasia yi nyinaa maa Dawid wɔ Hebron.
Ɔdii adeɛ wɔ hɔ mfirinhyia nson ne fa.
Dawid yii kuropɔn no kɔɔ Yerusalem, na ɔdii adeɛ mfirinhyia aduasa mmiɛnsa wɔ hɔ.
Mmammarima a wɔwowoo wɔn maa Dawid wɔ Yerusalem no ne: Simea, Sobab, Natan ne Salomo.
Amiel babaa Batseba na ɔwoo saa mmarima yi.
Wɔsane wowoo mmammarima baakron bi maa Dawid.
Wɔne Yibhar, Elisua, Elifelet, Noga, Nefeg, Yafia, Elisama, Eliada ne Elifelet.
Yeinom ne Dawid mmammarima a ne mpena mma nka ho.
Na Dawid wɔ ɔbabaa bi a wɔfrɛ no Tamar.
Salomo Asefoɔ Na Salomo asefoɔ yɛ Rehoboam, Abia, Asa, Yehosafat, Yehoram, Ahasia, Yoas, Amasia, Asaria, Yotam, Ahas, Hesekia, Manase, Amon ne Yosia.
Na Yosia mmammarima ne Yohanan a ɔyɛ abakan, Yehoiakim a ɔtɔ so mmienu, Sedekia a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa, ɛnna Salum a ɔtɔ so ɛnan.
Yehoiakim babarima Yehoiakyin na ɔdii nʼadeɛ, ɛnna ɔno nso ne wɔfa Sedekia bɛdii nʼadeɛ.
Yehoiakyin Asefoɔ Yehoiakyin a Babiloniafoɔ kyeree no kɔtoo afiase no mmammarima ne Sealtiel, Malkiram, Pedaia, Senasar, Yekamia, Hosama ne Nedabia.
Na Pedaia mmammarima yɛ Serubabel ne Simei.
Na Serubabel mmammarima yɛ Mesulam ne Hanania.
Na ɔwɔ ɔbabaa nso a ne din de Selomit.
Na ne mmammarima baanum bi nso din ne Hasuba, Ohel, Berekia, Hasadia ne Yusab-Hesed.
Na Hanania mmammarima din de Pelatia ne Yesaia.
Na Yesaia babarima din de Refaia.
Na Refaia babarima din de Arnan.
Na Arnan babarima din de Obadia.
Na Obadia babarima din de Sekania.
Na Sekania asefoɔ yɛ Semaia ne ne mmammarima Hatus, Igal, Baria, Nearia ne Safat.
Na wɔn nyinaa yɛ baasia.
Na Nearia mmammarima din de Elioenai, Hiskia ne Asrikam.
Na wɔyɛ baasa.
Na Elioenai mmammarima din de Hodawia, Eliasib, Pelaia, Akub, Yohanan, Delaia ne Anani.
Na wɔyɛ baason.
Yuda Asefoɔ Nkaeɛ Yuda asefoɔ no bi edin de Peres, Hesron, Karmi, Hur ne Sobal.
Sobal babarima Reaia na ɔwoo Yahat.
Yahat woo Ahumai ne Lahad.
Yeinom na na wɔyɛ Sorafoɔ mmusua.
Na Etam asefoɔ no ne Yesreel, Yisma, Yidbas, ɛnna Haslelponi a na ɔyɛ ne babaa, Penuel a na ɔyɛ Gedor agya ne Eser a na ɔyɛ Husa agya.
Yeinom na na wɔyɛ Hur a na ɔyɛ Efrata abakan ne Betlehem agya no asefoɔ.
Na Tekoa agya a ne din de Ashur no wɔ yerenom baanu a wɔfrɛ wɔn Hela ne Naara.
Naara woo Ahusam, Hefer, Temeni ne Ahastari.
Hela woo Seret, Sohar, Etnan, ne Kos a nʼasefoɔ ne Anub, Hasobeba ne Harum babarima Aharhel, Harum ne ne mmusua nyinaa.
Na ɔbarima bi wɔ hɔ a wɔfrɛ no Yabes a ɔyɛɛ ɔkɛseɛ sene ne nuammarima nyinaa.
Ne maame too no edin Yabes, ɛfiri sɛ, ɔnyaa ɔyea wɔ nʼawoɔ mu.
Yabes ne obi a ɔbɔɔ mpaeɛ kyerɛɛ Israel Onyankopɔn sɛ, “Ao, hyira me na trɛ mʼahyeɛ mu.
Mesrɛ wo, ka me ho wɔ deɛ mɛyɛ biara mu, na yi me firi ɔhaw ne ɔyea nyinaa mu.” Na Onyankopɔn yɛɛ nʼabisadeɛ no maa no.
Suba nuabarima Kelub woo Mehir.
Mehir woo Eston.
Eston woo Bet-Rafa, Paseah ne Tehina.
Tehina woo Ir-Nahas.
Yeinom ne Reka asefoɔ.
Kenas mmammarima ne Otniel ne Seraia.
Otniel mmammarima ne Hatat ne Meonotai.
Meonotai woo Ofra.
Na Seraia woo Yoab a ɔhyɛɛ Adwumfoɔ Bɔnhwa ase, ɛfiri sɛ, na adwumfoɔ pii tete hɔ.
Na Yefune babarima Kaleb mmammarima yɛ Iru, Ela ne Naam.
Na Ela babarima yɛ Kenas.
Yehalelel mmammarima ne Sif ne Sifa, Tiria ne Asarel.
Ɛsra mmammarima yɛ Yeter, Mered, Efer ne Yalon.
Mered waree Misraimni baa ma ɔwoo Miriam, Samai ne Yisba a ɔbɛyɛɛ Estemoa agya no.
Mered nso waree ɔbaa a ɔfiri Yuda.
Ɔno nso woo Yered a ɔbɛyɛɛ Gedor agya, Heber a ɔyɛ Soko agya, ne Yekutiel a ɔyɛ Sanoa agya.
Na wɔfrɛ Mered yere Misraimni no Bitia a na ɔyɛ Misraimhene babaa.
Na Hodia yere yɛ Naham nuabaa.
Ne mmammarima no mu baako na ɔwoo Keila a ɔyɛ Garmini na ɔbaako nso woo Estemoa a ɔyɛ Maakatni.
Simon mmammarima ne Amnon, Rina, Ben-Hanan ne Tilon.
Na Yisi asefoɔ no ne Sohet ne Ben-Sohet.
Yuda Babarima Sela Asefoɔ Na Sela yɛ Yuda mma no mu baako.
Na Sela asefoɔ no ne Er a ɔwoo Leka, Lada a ɔwoo Maresa a na wɔyɛ nweratam ho adwuma wɔ Bet-Asbea, Yokim, Koseba mmarima, Yoas, ne Saraf a na wɔdi Moab ne Yasubi-Lehem so no.
Saa edin yi nyinaa, wɔnya firii tete atwerɛ a na wɔatwerɛ agu hɔ mu.
Na wɔyɛ nkukuonwomfoɔ a na wɔte Netaim ne Gedera.
Na wɔn nyinaa yɛ nnwuma ma ɔhene.
Simeon Asefoɔ Na Simeon mmammarima no edin de Nemuel, Yamin, Yarib, Serah ne Saulo.
Na Saulo asefoɔ yɛ Salum, Mibsam ne Misma.
Na Misma asefoɔ yɛ Hamuel, Sakur ne Simei.
Simei woo mmammarima dunsia ne mmammaa baasia.
Ne nuammarima no deɛ, na wɔn mu biara nni abusua kɛseɛ saa.
Ɛno enti, Simeon abusua annɔre te sɛ Yuda abusua no.
Wɔtenaa Beer-Seba, Molada ne Hasar-Sual, Bilha, Esem ne Tolad, Betuel, Horma ne Siklag, Bet-Markabot, Hasar-Susim, Bet-Biri ne Saaraim.
Na saa nkuro yi nyinaa hyɛɛ wɔn ase kɔsii ɔhene Dawid berɛ so.
Wɔn asefoɔ nso tenaa Etam, Ain, Rimon, Token ne Asan a ɛyɛ nkurotoɔ enum yi so, ne ne nkuraaseɛ a atwa ho ahyia no kɔsii Baal.
Na wɔn atenaeɛ nie, na wɔahyehyɛ saa edin yi nyinaa wɔ wɔn abusuadua nkrataa mu.
Wɔn a wɔka Simeon asefoɔ ho no bi nso ne Mesobab, Yamlek ne Amasia babarima Yosa, Yoɛl, Yosibia babarima Yehu a ɔyɛ Seraia babarima, na ɔno nso yɛ Asiel babarima, Elioenai, Yaakoba, Yesohaia, Asaia, Adiel, Yesimiel ne Benaia, Sifi babarima Sisa a nʼagya yɛ Alon babarima, na ɔno yɛ Yedaia babarima, na ɔno nso yɛ Simri babarima a nʼagya yɛ Semaia.
Edin a yɛabobɔ yi yɛ ntuanofoɔ a wɔdeda Simeon mmusuakuo a wɔyɛ adefoɔ no ano no bi.
Wɔkɔɔ Gedor fam a na ɛwɔ bɔnhwa no apueeɛ fam sɛ wɔrekɔpɛ asase pa ama wɔn mmoa adidi so.
Wɔnyaa mmoa adidibea pa wɔ hɔ.
Na asase no so dwo na basabasayɛ biara nni hɔ.
Na Ham asefoɔ no bi akɔtena Gedor fa mu hɔ dada.
Yudahene Hesekia ɛberɛ so no, Simeon ntuanofoɔ no ko dii hɔ so, sɛee Ham ne Maonfoɔ afie pasaa.
Wɔkumm obiara a na ɔte hɔ, faa asase no, ɛfiri sɛ, na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔnya mmoa didibea pa no.
Akofoɔ no mu ahanum a wɔfiri Simeon abusuakuo mu no kɔɔ bepɔ Seir so, a na Pelatia, Nearia, Refaia ne Usiel a wɔn nyinaa yɛ Yisi mmammarima no na na wɔdi wɔn anim.
Amalekfoɔ kakra a wɔkaeɛ no, wɔkunkumm wɔn nyinaa, faa hɔ, na wɔtenaa hɔ.
Ruben Asefoɔ Na Israel babarima panin ne Ruben.
Nanso, ɛsiane sɛ wammu nʼagya, na ɔne nʼagya mpenafoɔ no mu baako kɔdaeɛ no enti, ɔde nʼabakanyɛ maa ne nua Yosef mmammarima.
Esiane saa asɛm yi enti, wɔamfa Ruben din anka abusuadua no ho sɛ abakan.
Yuda asefoɔ na wɔyɛɛ abusuakuo a wɔwɔ tumi pa ara, ne saa enti wɔyii ɔman no sodifoɔ firi wɔn mu, nanso, mpaninnie no deɛ, na ɛyɛ Yosef dea.
Israel abakan Ruben no mmammarima ne: Hanok, Palu, Hesron ne Karmi.
Yoɛl asefoɔ ne Semaia, Gog, Simei, Mika, Reaia, Baal, ne Beera.
Ɛberɛ a Asiriahene Tilgat-Pilneser de Rubenfoɔ kɔɔ nnommumfa mu no, Beera na na ɔdi Rubenfoɔ no anim.
Wɔatwerɛ Beera nkurɔfoɔ din sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua ne abusua no teɛ: Yeiel ne wɔn ntuanoni, ɛnna Sakaria ne Asas babarima Bela a ɔyɛ Sema babarima a ɔyɛ Yoɛl babarima.
Saa Rubenfoɔ yi tenaa beaeɛ a ɛfiri Aroer de kɔsi Nebo ne Baal-Meon.
Esiane sɛ na wɔwɔ anantwie bebree wɔ Gilead asase so no enti, wɔdidi kɔɔ apueeɛ fam wɔ anweatam a ɛtrɛ kɔ Asubɔnten Eufrate no ho.
Ɔhene Saulo pɛn so, Rubenfoɔ dii Hagarfoɔ so nkonim wɔ ɔko mu.
Enti, wɔtu kɔɔ Hagarfoɔ atenaeɛ a ɛwɔ Gilead apueeɛ fam hɔ no.
Gad Asefoɔ Basan asase so no, na Gad asefoɔ na wɔtete asase a ɛdi Rubenfoɔ deɛ no so.
Wɔtrɛ kɔɔ apueeɛ fam kɔsii Saleka.
Na Yoɛl na ɔtua wɔn ano wɔ Basan asase so.
Na Safam, Yanai ne Safat yɛ nʼaboafoɔ.
Na wɔn abusuafoɔ a wɔyɛ ntuanofoɔ ma mmusua afoforɔ nson din ne: Mikael, Mesulam, Seba, Yorai, Yakan, Sia ne Eber.
Yeinom nyinaa yɛ Huri babarima Abihail a ɔyɛ Yaroa babarima, Gilead babarima, Mikael babarima, Yesisai babarima Yahdo babarima, Bus babarima.
Abdiel babarima Ahi, Guni babarima no na na ɔyɛ wɔn mmusua no ntuanoni.
Gadfoɔ no tenaa Gilead asase a ɛwɔ Basan ne ne nkuraaseɛ ne Saron tata no nyinaa so.
Yudahene Yotam ne Israelhene Yeroboam ɛberɛ so na wɔtwerɛɛ yeinom nyinaa guu abusuadua nkrataa mu.
Yordan Apueeɛ Fam Mmusuakuo Na akofoɔ akɛseɛ a wɔwɔ Ruben, Gad mmusua ne Manase abusua fa mu no ano si ɔpeduanan ɛnan ahanson ne aduosia.
Wɔkurakura akokyɛm, akofena ne agyan, na wɔn nyinaa akwadare wɔ akodie mu.
Wɔko tiaa Hagarfoɔ, Yeturfoɔ, Nafisfoɔ ne Nodabfoɔ.
Wɔsu frɛɛ Onyankopɔn wɔ ɔko no mu, na ɔtiee wɔn mpaeɛbɔ, ɛfiri sɛ, wɔde wɔn ho too no so.
Enti, wɔdii Hagarfoɔ no ne wɔn dɔm nyinaa so nkonim.
Asadeɛ a wɔfa firii Hagarfoɔ no nkyɛn no yɛ nyoma ɔpeduonum, nnwan ɔpehanu aduonum, mfunumu mpenu ne nneduafoɔ ɔpeha.
Wɔkunkumm Hagarfoɔ no bebree ɔko no mu, ɛfiri sɛ, na Onyankopɔn reko tia wɔn.
Enti, wɔtenaa wɔn asase so, kɔsii sɛ wɔtwaa wɔn asuo.
Manase abusua fa no trɛɛ wɔ asase no so firi Basan kɔsii Baal-Hermon, Senir ne bepɔ Hermon ho.
Na wɔdɔɔso yie.
Yeinom ne wɔn mmusua no ntuanofoɔ: Efer, Yisi, Eliel, Asriel, Yeremia, Hodawia ne Yahdiel.
Na wɔn mu biara agye edin sɛ ɔkofoɔ kɛseɛ ne ɔkandifoɔ.
Nanso, na wɔnni nokorɛ, na wɔbuu wɔn agyanom ne Onyankopɔn apam no so.
Wɔsomm aman a Onyankopɔn sɛee wɔn no anyame.
Enti, Israel Onyankopɔn de hyɛɛ Asiriahene Pul (a na wɔsane frɛ no Tiglat-Pileser) akoma mu sɛ ɔnko mfa asase no, na ɔnkyekyere Rubenfoɔ, Gadfoɔ ne Manasefoɔ abusua fa sɛ nneduafoɔ.
Asiariafoɔ no twaa wɔn asuo kɔɔ Halah, Habor, Hara ne Asubɔnten Gosan ho a wɔda so te hɔ bɛsi ɛnnɛ.
Asɔfoɔ Awoɔ Ntoatoasoɔ Na Lewi mmammarima yɛ: Gerson, Kohat ne Merari.
Na Kohat asefoɔ nso yɛ: Amram, Ishar, Hebron ne Usiel.
Na Amram mma yɛ: Aaron, Mose ne Miriam.
Na Aaron mmammarima yɛ: Nadab, Abihu, Eleasa ne Itamar.
Eleasa woo Pinehas.
Pinehas woo Abisua.
Abisua woo Buki, na Buki woo Usi, Usi woo Serahia, Serahia woo Meraiot, Meraiot woo Amaria, na Amaria woo Ahitub, Ahitub woo Sadok, na Sadok woo Ahimaas, Ahimaas woo Asaria, Asaria woo Yohanan, Yohanan woo Asaria, a ɔno na na ɔyɛ ɔsɔfopanin wɔ asɔredan a Salomo sii wɔ Yerusalem no mu.
Asaria woo Amaria, Amaria woo Ahitub, Ahitub woo Sadok, Sadok woo Salum, Salum woo Hilkia, Hilkia woo Asaria.
Asaria woo Seraia, Seraia woo Yehosadak.
Wɔtwaa Yehosadak asuo ɛberɛ a Awurade de Yudafoɔ ne Yerusalemfoɔ kɔɔ nnommum mu a na wɔhyɛ Nebukadnessar ase no.
Lewifoɔ Mmusua Na Lewi mmammarima din de: Gersom, Kohat ne Merari.
Na Libni ne Simei ka Gerson asefoɔ ho.
Na Amram, Ishar, Hebron ne Usiel ka Kohat asefoɔ no ho.
Na Mahli ne Musi ka Merari asefoɔ no ho.
Yeinom ne Lewifoɔ mmusua sɛdeɛ wɔn mpanimfoɔ nnidisoɔ teɛ.
Na Gerson asefoɔ yɛ: Libni, Yahat, Sima, Yoa, Ido, Serah ne Yeaterai.
Na Kohat asefoɔ ne Aminadab, Kora, Asir, Elkana, Ebiasaf, Asir, Tahat, Uriel, Usia ne Saulo.
Na Elkana asefoɔ ne: Amasai, Ahimot, Sofai, Nahat, Eliab, Yeroham, Elkana ne Samuel.
Na Samuel mmammarima din ne: Yoɛl a ɔyɛ ɔpanin ne Abiya a ɔtɔ so mmienu no.
Na Merari mma ne: Mahli, Libni, Simei, Usa, Simea, Hagia ne Asaia.
Asɔredan Mu Nnwom Ho Nimdefoɔ Dawid maa saa nnipa a wɔn din didi soɔ yi dii Awurade fie nnwom anim, ɛberɛ a wɔde Apam Adaka no sii hɔ no.
Wɔde nnwom kaa wɔn som ho wɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no mu hɔ, kɔsii sɛ Salomo sii Awurade asɔredan no wɔ Yerusalem.
Afei, wɔnam mmara a wɔde maa wɔn so dii wɔn dwuma wɔ hɔ.
Saa mmarima yi na wɔne wɔn mma somm wɔ hɔ no.
Heman, dwom ho nimdefoɔ no, na ɔfiri Kohat abusua mu.
Wɔto nʼabusuadua ana firi Yoɛl, Samuel, Elkana, Yeroham, Eliel, Yoa, Suf, Elkana, Mahat, Amasai, Elkana, Yoɛl, Asaria, Sefania, Tahat, Asir, Ebiasaf, Kora, Ishar, Kohat, Lewi ne Israel ase; Herman abadiakyire a ɔdi ɛkan no din de Asaf, a na ɔfiri Gerson abusua mu.
Wɔto Asaf abusuadua ana firi Berekia, Simea, Mikael, Baaseia, Malkia, Etni, Serah, Adaia, Etan, Sima, Simei, Yahat, Gersom ne Lewi ase.
Herman abadiakyire a ɔtɔ so mmienu no din de Etan, a na ɔfiri Merari abusua mu.
Wɔto Etan abusuadua ana firi Kisi, Abdi, Maluk, Hasabia, Amasia, Hilkia, Amsi, Bani, Semer, Mahli, Musi, Merari ne Lewi ase.
Aaron Asefoɔ Na wɔn abusuafoɔ a wɔyɛ Lewifoɔ no nso, wɔmaa wɔn dwuma ahodoɔ bi dii wɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan a ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn fie no mu.
Aaron ne nʼasefoɔ nko na wɔsom sɛ asɔfoɔ.
Na wɔde afɔrebɔdeɛ gu ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia ne ohwam afɔrebukyia so, na wɔdi dwuma biara a ɛfa kronkron mu kronkron hɔ ho.
Wɔnam mmara a Onyankopɔn ɔsomfoɔ Mose de maa wɔn no so yɛɛ mpatadeɛ maa Israel.
Na Aaron asefoɔ yɛ: Eleasa, Pinehas, Abisua, Buki, Usi, Serahia, Meraiot, Amaria, Ahitub, Sadok ne Ahimaas.
Yei ne abakɔsɛm a ɛfa nkuro ne asase a wɔnam ntontobɔ kronkron so de maa Aaron ne nʼasefoɔ a wɔfiri Kohat abusua mu no.
Na Hebron ne mmoa adidibea nsase a atwa ho ahyia wɔ Yuda no ka ho.
Nanso, kuro no ho mfuo ne ɛho nkuraa no deɛ, wɔde maa Yefune babarima Kaleb.
Enti, saa nkuro yi a mmoa adidibea atwa ebiara ho ahyia na wɔde maa Aaron asefoɔ: Hebron a ɛyɛ dwanekɔbea kuro, Libna, Yatir, Estemoa, Hilen, Debir, Asan, Yuta ne Bet-Semes.
Na wɔmaa wɔn Gibeon, Geba, Alemet ne Anatot firii Benyamin asase mu a mmoa adidibea ka emu biara ho.
Enti, nkurotoɔ dumiɛnsa na wɔde maa Aaron asefoɔ.
Na Kohat asefoɔ a wɔkaeɛ no nso, wɔnyaa nkurotoɔ edu a wɔnam ntontobɔ kronkron so firii Manase abusua fa no asase so.
Gerson asefoɔ nam ntontobɔ kronkron so nyaa nkurotoɔ dumiɛnsa firii Isakar, Aser ne Naftali nsase so.
Wɔnyaa bi nso firii Basan pɔ mu a ɛyɛ Manase dea, a ɛwɔ Yordan apueeɛ fam no.
Merari asefoɔ nam ntontobɔ kronkron so, nyaa nkurotoɔ dumienu firii Ruben, Gad ne Sebulon nsase so.
Enti, Israelfoɔ de saa nkuro yi ne mmoa adidibea yi nyinaa maa Lewifoɔ.
Wɔnam ntontobɔ kronkron so na wɔde nkuro a ɛwowɔ Yuda, Simeon ne Benyamin nsase so maeɛ sɛdeɛ wɔaka dada no.
Saa nkurotoɔ yi ne ɛho mmoa adidibea na Kohat asefoɔ nya firii Efraim asase so: Sekem a ɛyɛ dwanekɔbea kuro a ɛwɔ Efraim bepɔ asase no so, Geser, Yokmeam, Bet-Horon, Ayalon ne Gat-Rimon.
Kohat asefoɔ nkaeɛ no, wɔde saa nkurotoɔ a ɛfiri Manase abusua fa no mu na ɛmaa wɔn: Aner ne Bileam a emu biara mmoa adidibea ka ho.
Gerson asefoɔ nyaa kuro a wɔfrɛ no Golan a ɛwɔ Basan no firii Manase abusua fa asase so a Astarot ka ho, a ne nyinaa mmoa adidibea da ho.
Isakar asase so nso, wɔmaa wɔn Kedes, Daberat, Ramot ne Anem a wɔn mmoa adidibea ka ho.
Aser asase so, wɔnyaa Masal, Abdon, Hukok ne Rehob a na emu biara mmoa adidibea ka ho.
Naftali asase so, wɔde Kedes a ɛwɔ Galilea, Hamon ne Kiriataim maa wɔn, a na mmoa adidibea ka emu biara ho.
Merari asefoɔ nkaeɛ no nyaa Yokneam, Karta, Rimon ne Tabor nkuro firi Sebulon asase so, a na mmoa adidibea ka ebiara ho.
Ruben asase a ɛda Asubɔnten Yordan apueeɛ fam a ɛne Yeriko di nhwɛanim no nso, wɔnyaa Beser a ɛyɛ anweatam kuro, Yahas, Kedemot ne Mefaat a mmoa adidibea ka emu biara ho.
Na Gad asase so nso, wɔnyaa Ramot a ɛwɔ Gilead, Mahanaim, Hesbon ne Yaser a mmoa adidibea ka ebiara ho.
Isakar Asefoɔ Na Isakar mmammarima baanan no din de Tola, Pua, Yasub ne Simron.
Tola mmammarima no ne: Usi, Refaia, Yeriel, Yahmai, Yibsam ne Samuel.
Na wɔn mu biara yɛ wɔn agyanom mmusua ntuanofoɔ.
Ɔhene Dawid ɛberɛ so no, na mmarima dodoɔ a wɔwɔ saa mmusua yi mu a wɔyɛ asraafoɔ no dodoɔ yɛ ɔpeduonu mmienu ne ahansia .
Na Usi babarima din de: Yisrahia.
Na Yisrahia mmammarima din de: Mikael, Obadia, Yoɛl ne Yisia a na wɔn baanum tuatua mmusua ano.
Mmarima dodoɔ a na wɔwɔ hɔ a wɔyɛ asraafoɔ no dodoɔ yɛ ɔpeduasa nsia.
Na wɔn baanum no nyinaa yerenom ne wɔn mmammarima yɛ bebree.
Mmarima a na wɔwɔ hɔ a wɔfiri Isakar mmusua no nyinaa mu a wɔyɛ asraafoɔ no dodoɔ yɛ ɔpeduɔwɔtwe nson .
Wɔtwerɛɛ wɔn nyinaa din nnidisoɔ nnidisoɔ guu wɔn abusuadua krataa mu.
Benyamin Asefoɔ Na Benyamin mmammarima baasa no din de: Bela, Beker ne Yediael.
Na Bela mmammarima yɛ: Esbon, Usi, Usiel, Yerimot ne Iri.
Na saa akofoɔ baanum yi yɛ mmusua ntuanofoɔ.
Nnipa a wɔfiri wɔn asefoɔ mu yɛɛ asraafoɔ no dodoɔ yɛ ɔpeduonu mmienu ne aduasa ɛnan .
Wɔtwerɛɛ wɔn nyinaa din guu wɔn abusuadua krataa mu.
Na Beker mmammarima din de: Semira, Yoas, Elieser, Elioenai, Omri, Yeremot, Abia, Anatot ne Alemet.
Sɛdeɛ na wɔn abusuadua kyerɛ no, na wɔn abusua ntuanofoɔ akyi no, wɔn asefoɔ ɔpeduonu ne ahanu wɔ hɔ a wɔtumi dɔm sraa.
Na Yediael babarima ne: Bilhan.
Na Bilhan mmammarima ne: Yeus, Benyamin, Ehud, Kenaana, Setan, Tarsis ne Ahisahar.
Na wɔyɛ Yediael mmusua no mu ntuanofoɔ a wɔn asefoɔ a na wɔka wɔn ho a wɔtumi dɔm sraa no dodoɔ yɛ ɔpedunson ne ahanu .
Na Ir mmammarima ne Supim, ne Hupim.
Aher na ɔwoo Husim.
Naftali Asefoɔ Na Naftali mmammarima yɛ: Yahsiel, Guni, Yeser ne Salum.
Na wɔn nyinaa yɛ Yakob yere Bilha asefoɔ.
Manase Asefoɔ Manase mmammarima a ɔne ne mpena Aramni wowoo wɔn ne Asriel ne Makir.
Makir na ɔwoo Gilead.
Makir pɛɛ ɔyerenom maa Hupim ne Supim.
Na wɔfrɛ Makir nuabaa Maaka.
Na Makir asefoɔ no mu baako a wɔfrɛ no Selofehad wowoo mmammaa nko ara.
Makir yere Maaka woo ɔbabarima a ɔtoo no edin Peres.
Na ne nuabarima din de Seres.
Peres mmammarima din de Ulam ne Rekem.
Na Ulam babarima din de: Bedan.
Na wɔn nyinaa yɛ Gileadfoɔ a wɔyɛ Manase babarima Makir asefoɔ.
Makir nuabaa Moleket woo Is-Hod, Abieser ne Mahla.
Na Semida mmammarima yɛ: Ahian, Sekem, Likhi ne Aniam.
Efraim Asefoɔ Efraim asefoɔ ne: Sutela, Bered, Tahat, Elada, Tahat, Sabad ne Sutela.
Wɔkunkumm Efraim mmammarima Eser ne Elad wɔ Gat, ɛfiri sɛ, wɔpɛɛ sɛ wɔwia nyɛmmoa firi akuafoɔ a wɔbɛn hɔ no.
Wɔn agya Efraim suu wɔn kyɛree yie, na nʼabusuafoɔ bɛkyekyeree ne werɛ.
Ɛno akyi, Efraim kɔɔ ne yere ho, na ɔnyinsɛnee, woo ɔbabarima.
Efraim too no edin Beria ɛsiane abɛbrɛsɛ a nʼabusuafoɔ faa mu no enti.
Efraim woo ɔbabaa too no edin Seer.
Ɔno na ɔkyekyeree nkuro Bet-Horon Anafoɔ, Atifi ne Usen-Seera.
Efraim asefoɔ nnidisoɔ ne Refa, Resef, Tela, Tahan Ladan, Amihud, Elisama, Nun ne Yosua.
Efraim asefoɔ no tenaa asase Bet-El ne ne nkurotoɔ a atwa afa anafoɔ fam, Naaran a ɛda apueeɛ fam, Geser ne ne nkuraaseɛ a ɛda atɔeɛ fam ne Sekem ne ne nkuraaseɛ a atwa ho ahyia, kɔfa atifi fam, de kɔsi Aya a nkuraaseɛ ka ho no so.
Manase hyeɛ so no, na nkuro a ɛdeda hɔ yɛ Bet-Sean, Taanak, Megido, Dor ne wɔn nkuraase a atwa ho ahyia no.
Israel ba Yosef asefoɔ tenaa saa nkuro yi so.
Aser Asefoɔ Na Aser mmammarima yɛ: Yimna, Yiswa, Yiswi ne Beria.
Na wɔwɔ nuabaa a ne din de Sera.
Na Beria mmammarima din de: Heber ne Malkiel a ɔwoo Birsait no.
Na Heber mmammarima din de Yaflet, Somer ne Hotam.
Na wɔwɔ nuabaa a ne din de Sua.
Na Yaflet mmammarima din de: Pasak, Bimhal ne Aswat.
Na Semer mmammarima din de: Ahi, Rohga, Hubah ne Aram.
Na ne nuabarima Helem mmammarima din de: Sofa, Yimna, Seles ne Amal.
Na Sofa mmammarima din de: Suah, Harnefer, Sual, Beri, Yimra, Beser, Hod, Sama, Silsa, Yitran ne Beera.
Na Yeter mmammarima din de: Yefune, Pispa ne Ara.
Na Ula mmammarima din de: Arah, Haniel ne Risia.
Na Aser asefoɔ no mu biara yɛ wɔn agyanom abusua ɔdaanoni.
Na wɔn nyinaa yɛ akofoɔ pa ne ntuanofoɔ a wɔdi mu.
Na mmarima ɔpeduonu nsia na wɔwɔ hɔ a wɔatwerɛ wɔn din agu wɔn mmusuadua nwoma mu a wɔyɛ akofoɔ a wɔagye edin.
Benyamin Asefoɔ Benyamin mmammarima na ɛdidi soɔ yi: Bela (abakan), Asbel, Ahra, Noha ne Rafha.
Bela mmammarima yɛ: Adar, Gera, Abihud, Abisua, Naaman, Ahoa, Gera, Sefufan ne Huram.
Ehud mmammarima, mmusua ntuanofoɔ, a na wɔte Geba a wɔpamoo wɔn firii hɔ kɔɔ Manahat nie: Naaman, Ahiya ne Gera.
Gera a na ɔyɛ Usa ne Ahihud agya no na ɛberɛ a wɔretu no, ɔdii wɔn anim.
Saharaim gyaee ne yerenom Husim ne Baara akyi no, ɔwoo mma wɔ Moab asase so.
Ne yere foforɔ Hodes woo Yobab, Sibia, Mesa, Malkam, Yeus, Sakia ne Mirma.
Saa mmammarima yi bɛyɛɛ mmusua ntuanofoɔ.
Na Saharaim yere Husim awo Abitub ne Elpaal dada.
Elpaal mmammarima yɛ: Eber, Misam ne Semed a ɔkyekyeree Ono ne Lod ne wɔn nkuraaseɛ no, Beria ne Sema.
Na wɔyɛ mmusua ntuanofoɔ a na wɔte Ayalon, na wɔpamoo ɔmanfoɔ a wɔte Gat no.
Beria mmammarima yɛ Ahio, Sasak, Yeremot, Sebadia, Arad, Eder, Mikael, Yispa ne Yoha.
Elpaal mmammarima yɛ Sebadia, Mesulam, Hiski, Heber, Ismerai, Yislia ne Yobab.
Simei mmammarima yɛ Yakim, Sikri, Sabdi, Elienai, Siletai, Eliel, Adaia, Beraia ne Simrat.
Sasak mmammarima yɛ Yispan, Eber, Eliel, Abdon, Sikri, Hanan, Hanania, Elam, Antotia, Yifdeia ne Penuel.
Yeroham mmammarima yɛ: Samserai, Seharia, Atalia, Yaaresia, Elia ne Sikri.
Yeinom ne agyanom mmusua ntuanofoɔ a wɔatwerɛ wɔn din wɔ wɔn mu biara abusuadua nkrataa mu.
Na wɔn nyinaa tenaa Yerusalem.
Saulo Abusua Yeiel (Gibeon agya) tenaa Gibeon.
Na ne yere din de Maaka a na ne babarima piesie din de Abdon.
Na Yeiel mmammarima a wɔaka no din de Sur, Kis, Baal, Ner, Nadab, Gedor, Ahio, Seker, ne Miklot a ɔyɛ Simea agya.
Na saa mmusuafoɔ yi tete bemmɛn wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ Yerusalem.
Ner na ɔwoo Kis.
Kis na ɔwoo Saulo, Saulo na ɔwoo Yonatan, Malki-Sua, Abinadab ne Esbaal.
Yonatan babarima ne: Merib-Baal (anaa Mefiboset) na Merib-Baal woo Mika.
Mika mmammarima ne: Piton, Melek, Tarea ne Ahas.
Ahas woo Yehoada na Yehoada woo Alemet, Asmawet ne Simri.
Na Simri woo Mosa.
Mosa woo Binea.
Binea woo Rafha.
Rafha woo Elasa.
Elasa woo Asel.
Asel woo mmammarima baasia a wɔne: Asrikam, Bokeru, Ismael, Searia, Obadia ne Hanan.
Na yeinom yɛ Asel mma.
Na Asel nuabarima Esek wɔ mmammarima baasa a wɔne Ulam a ɔyɛ abakan, Yeus a ɔtɔ so mmienu ne Elifelet a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa.
Ulam mmammarima nyinaa yɛ akofoɔ a wɔakwadare wɔ akodie mu, na wɔyɛ agyantofoɔ toamfom.
Na wɔwɔ mma ne mmanananom bebree a na wɔn nyinaa dodoɔ yɛ ɔha aduonum.
Yeinom nyinaa yɛ Benyamin asefoɔ.
Wɔtwerɛɛ Israel abusuadua biara mu nnipa din guu Israel ne Yuda Ahemfo nwoma mu.
Esiane sɛ na Yudafoɔ no nni Awurade nokorɛ no enti, wɔtwaa wɔn asuo kɔɔ Babilonia.
Atukɔfoɔ A Wɔsane Baeɛ Wɔn a wɔsane baeɛ bɛfaa wɔn agyapadeɛ wɔ wɔn nkuro dada mu no yɛ Israelfoɔ bi, asɔfoɔ, Lewifoɔ ne asɔredan mu aboafoɔ.
Nnipa a wɔfiri Yuda, Benyamin, Efraim ne Manase mmusuakuo mu ba bɛtenaa Yerusalem no yɛ: Amihud babarima Utai a ɔyɛ Omri babarima na ɔno nso yɛ Imri babarima na ɔno nso yɛ Bani babarima a wɔyɛ Yuda babarima Peres asefoɔ.
Wɔn a wɔfiri Silonfoɔ abusua mu no yɛ: Asaia a ɔyɛ abakan no ne ne mmammarima.
Serah abusua mu no: Yeuel ne nʼabusuafoɔ na wɔsane baeɛ.
Yuda abusuakuo no mu mmusua ahansia aduɔkron na wɔsane baeɛ.
Wɔn a wɔfiri Benyamin abusuakuo mu a wɔsane baeɛ no ne: Mesulam babarima Salu, a ɔyɛ Hodawia babarima na ɔno nso yɛ Hasenua babarima; Yibneia a ɔyɛ Yeroham babarima; Ela a ɔyɛ Usi babarima, Mikri babarima; Mesulam a ɔyɛ Sefatia babarima, Reuel babarima, Yibnia babarima baeɛ.
Saa mmarima yi nyinaa, na wɔyɛ mmusua ntuanofoɔ, na wɔatwerɛ wɔn din wɔ wɔn mmusuakuo mmusuadua nwoma mu.
Benyamin abusuakuo mu mmusua aha nkron ne aduonum nsia na wɔsane baeɛ.
Asɔfoɔ A Wɔsane Baeɛ Asɔfoɔ a wɔsane baeɛ no bi ne: Yedaia, Yehoriarib, Yakin; Asaria a ɔyɛ Hilkia babarima, a ɔno nso yɛ Mesulam babarima, na ɔno nso yɛ Sadok babarima, na ɔno nso yɛ Meraiot babarima, na ɔno nso yɛ Ahitub babarima.
Na Asaria yɛ Onyankopɔn fie ahwɛfoɔ so panin.
Asɔfoɔ a wɔsane baeɛ no bi ne Adaia a ɔyɛ Yeroham babarima, a na ɔno nso yɛ Pashur babarima, na ɔno nso yɛ Malkia babarima ne Masai a ɔyɛ Adiel babarima, na ɔno nso yɛ Yahsera babarima, na ɔno nso yɛ Mesulam babarima, a ɔno nso yɛ Mesilemit babarima, na ɔno nso yɛ Imer babarima.
Asɔfoɔ a wɔsane baeɛ nyinaa dodoɔ yɛ apem ahanson aduosia.
Na wɔyɛ mmusua ntuanofoɔ a wɔyɛ nsiyɛfoɔ.
Na wɔn adwuma ne sɛ, wɔsom wɔ Onyankopɔn fie.
Lewifoɔ a wɔsane baeɛ no yɛ: Semaia a ɔyɛ Hasub babarima, a na ɔyɛ Asrikam babarima, a na ɔno nso yɛ Hasabia babarima, a na ɔyɛ Merari aseni; Bakbakar; Heres; Galal; Mika babarima Matania a ɔyɛ Sikri babarima, na ɔno nso yɛ Asaf babarima, Obadia a ɔyɛ Semaia babarima, a ɔyɛ Galal babarima, na ɔno nso yɛ Yedutun babarima, ne Asa a ɔyɛ Elkana babarima Berekia a wɔtenaa Netofa asase so.
Apono anohwɛfoɔ a wɔsane baeɛ no yɛ: Salum, Akub, Talmon, Ahiman ne wɔn mmusuafoɔ.
Salum na na ɔyɛ ɔpono ano hwɛfoɔ panin.
Kane no nso, na anka wɔn na wɔhwɛ ɔhene ɛpono a ɛkyerɛ apueeɛ fam no so.
Na saa mmarima no som sɛ Lewifoɔ atenaeɛ apono ano ahwɛfoɔ.
Na Salum yɛ Kore babarima a ɔyɛ Ebiasaf a ɔfiri Kora abusua mu aseni.
Na ɔne nʼabusuafoɔ a wɔyɛ Korafoɔ no na na wɔwɛn ɛkwan a ɛkɔ kronkronbea hɔ no, sɛdeɛ na wɔn mpanimfoɔ wɛnee Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan wɔ Awurade atenaeɛ hɔ no.
Eleasa babarima Pinehas na kane no na ɔhwɛ apono ano ahwɛfoɔ no so, na Awurade ka ne ho.
Akyire no, Meselemia babarima Sakaria na na ɔwɛn ɛkwan a ɛkɔ Ahyiaeɛ Ntomadan no mu no ano.
Ne nyinaa mu, saa ɛberɛ no, na apono ano ahwɛfoɔ no dodoɔ yɛ ahanu ne dumienu a na wɔatwerɛ wɔn din wɔ wɔn mmusuadua nkrataa mu wɔ wɔn nkuraaseɛ.
Dawid ne Samuel a na ɔyɛ ɔdehunufoɔ no yiyii wɔn agyanom, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔyɛ nokwafoɔ.
Saa apono ano ahwɛfoɔ yi ne wɔn asefoɔ no, na wɔkyekyɛ wɔn mu kɔwɛn ɛkwan a ɛkɔ Awurade efie, a kane no na ɛyɛ ntomadan no ano.
Wɔde apono ano ahwɛfoɔ no gyinagyinaa afanan no nyinaa a ɛyɛ apueeɛ, atɔeɛ, atifi ne anafoɔ.
Ɛberɛ-ano-berɛ-ano, na wɔn abusuafoɔ a wɔwɔ nkuraaseɛ no bɛboa wɔn wɔ wɔn nnanson nnanson dwumadie mu.
Saa apono ano ahwɛfoɔ mpanimfoɔ baanan a na wɔyɛ Lewifoɔ no, na wɔn adwuma no yɛ deɛ ɛkura asodie kɛseɛ, ɛfiri sɛ, wɔn na na wɔhwɛ adan ne sikakoradan a ɛwɔ Onyankopɔn fie hɔ no so.
Wɔwɛn Onyankopɔn fie hɔ anadwo, ɛfiri sɛ, na ɛyɛ wɔn asɛdeɛ.
Afei, na ɛyɛ wɔn adwuma sɛ da biara anɔpa wɔbuebue apono no.
Na apono ano ahwɛfoɔ no bi adwuma ne sɛ wɔhwɛ nneɛma ahodoɔ a wɔde yɛ ɔsom adwuma no so.
Sɛ wɔrekɔfa, na wɔresane de akɔgu hɔ no nyinaa a, wɔhwɛ sɛ ebi nnyera.
Afoforɔ nso hwɛ nneɛma a wɔde asiesie hɔ, nneɛma a ɛwɔ kronkronbea hɔ, nneɛma a wɔde brɛ wɔn, sɛ ebia, asikyiresiam a wɔayam no muhumuhu, nsã, ngo, nnuhwam ne kurobo ahodoɔ so.
Nanso, na asɔfoɔ no na wɔdi nnuhwam no ne kurobo no ho dwuma.
Matitia a ɔyɛ Lewini, na ɔyɛ Korani Salum abakan no na na ɔto burodo a wɔde bɔ afɔdeɛ no.
Na nnipa bi a wɔfiri Kohat abusua mu nso na na wɔhwɛ, siesie burodo a wɔde to ɛpono Homeda no.
Nnwom ho nimdefoɔ a na wɔn nso yɛ Lewifoɔ atitire no nyinaa, na wɔtete Asɔredan no mu.
Na wɔmma wɔnnyɛ adwuma foforɔ biara, ɛsiane wɔn adwuma a wɔyɛ no mmerɛ nyinaa enti.
Na saa nnipa yi nyinaa tete Yerusalem.
Na wɔyɛ Lewifoɔ mmusua no nyinaa ntuanofoɔ a wɔatwerɛ wɔn din ahyɛ wɔn mmusuadua krataa mu.
Ɔhene Saulo Abusuadua Yeiel (Gibeon agya) tenaa Gibeon.
Na ne yere din de Maaka, a na ne babarima piesie din de Abdon.
Na Yeiel mmammarima a wɔaka no din de Sur, Kis, Baal, Ner, Nadab, Gedor, Ahio, Sakaria ne Miklot.
Miklot na ɔyɛ Simeam agya.
Na saa mmusuafoɔ yi tete bemmɛn wɔn ho wɔn ho wɔ Yerusalem.
Ner na ɔwoo Kis.
Kis na ɔwoo Saulo, Saulo na ɔwoo Yonatan, Malki-Sua, Abinadab ne Esbaal.
Yonatan babarima ne: Merib-Baal (anaa Mefiboset) na Merib-Baal woo Mika.
Mika mmammarima ne: Piton, Melek, Tarea ne Ahas.
Ahas woo Yara.
Yara woo Alemet, Asmawet ne Simri.
Na Simri woo Mosa.
Mosa woo Binea.
Binea woo Refaia.
Refaia woo Elasa.
Elasa woo Asel.
Asel woo mmammarima baasia a wɔne: Asrikam, Bokeru, Ismael, Searia, Obadia ne Hanan.
Na yeinom yɛ Asel mma.
Ɔhene Saulo Owuo Afei, Filistifoɔ no bɛto hyɛɛ Israel so, ma Israelfoɔ no dwaneeɛ.
Wɔkunkumm wɔn mu pii wɔ bepɔ Gilboa so.
Filistifoɔ no kaa Saulo ne ne mmammarima hyɛeɛ.
Wɔkunkumm wɔn mu baasa a wɔn ne Yonatan, Abinadab ne Malki-Sua.
Ɔko no ano yɛɛ den wɔ Saulo ho hyiaaɛ, ma Filistifoɔ agyantofoɔ no nyaa Saulo piraa no yie.
Saulo firi apenesie mu ka kyerɛɛ nʼakodeɛkurafoɔ no sɛ, “Twe wʼakofena, na fa wɔ me kum me na Filistifoɔ abosonsomfoɔ yi ammɛto me, angu mʼanim ase.” Nanso, na nʼakodeɛkurafoɔ no suro enti, wanyɛ saa.
Enti, Saulo twee ɔno ara nʼakofena, de kumm ne ho.
Ɛberɛ a nʼakodeɛkurafoɔ no hunuu sɛ Saulo awuo no, ɔno nso de nʼakofena kumm ne ho.
Ɛno enti, Saulo ne ne mmammarima baasa no wuwuu wɔ hɔ ara, ma nʼahennie nnidisoɔ no baa awieeɛ.
Ɛberɛ a Israelfoɔ a wɔwɔ Yesreel bɔnhwa no mu no hunuu sɛ wɔadi wɔn akodɔm no so, na Saulo ne ne mmammarima baasa no awuwu no, wɔdwane gyaa wɔn nkuro hɔ.
Ɛno enti, Filistifoɔ no kɔfaa wɔn nkuro no.
Adeɛ kyeeɛ a Filistifoɔ no kɔɔ sɛ wɔrekɔyiyi atɔfoɔ no ho nneɛma no, wɔhunuu sɛ Saulo ne ne mmammarima no amu gugu bepɔ Gilboa so.
Enti, wɔyiyii Saulo akodeɛ firii ne ho, twaa ne ti.
Afei wɔbɔɔ Saulo wuo no ho dawuro, maa wɔn ahoni ne nnipa a wɔwɔ Filistia nyinaa teeɛ.
Wɔde nʼakodeɛ no guu wɔn anyame no abosonnan mu, na wɔkyekyeree ne ti no fam Dagon asɔredan no ɔfasuo ho.
Nanso, Yabes Gileadfoɔ tee deɛ Filistifoɔ ayɛ Saulo no, wɔn akofoɔ kɔfaa Saulo ne ne mmammarima baasa no amu baa Yabes.
Na wɔsiee wɔn amu wɔ odum dua bi a ɛwɔ Yabes ase, na wɔdii mmuada nnanson.
Na Saulo wuiɛ, ɛfiri sɛ, wanni Awurade nokorɛ.
Wanni Awurade ahyɛdeɛ so, na mpo, ɔkɔɔ asamanfrɛ, wɔ ɛberɛ a anka ɛsɛ sɛ ɔbisa akwankyerɛ firi Awurade hɔ.
Ɛno enti, Awurade kumm no, de nʼahennie hyɛɛ Yisai babarima Dawid nsa.
Dawid Di Israel Nyinaa So Ɔhene Na Israel nyinaa kɔɔ Dawid nkyɛn wɔ Hebron kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Yɛn nyinaa yɛ wʼabusuafoɔ.
Mmerɛ tenten bi a atwam, mpo ɛberɛ a Saulo di yɛn so ɔhene no, na wone obi a nokorɛm na wodi Israel anim.
Na Awurade, wo Onyankopɔn, aka kyerɛ wo sɛ, ‘Wobɛyɛ odwanhwɛfoɔ ama me nkurɔfoɔ Israel.
Wobɛyɛ wɔn sodifoɔ.’ ” Enti, Dawid ne Israel ntuanofoɔ no yɛɛ apam wɔ Awurade anim wɔ Hebron.
Wɔsraa no ngo, sii no Israelhene sɛdeɛ Awurade nam Samuel so hyɛɛ ho bɔ no.
Dawid Ko Faa Yerusalem Na Dawid ne Israel nyinaa kɔɔ Yerusalem anaa Yebus, sɛdeɛ na wɔfrɛ hɔ kane no, ɛfiri sɛ, Yebusifoɔ na wɔkɔtenaa asase no so kane kyekyereeɛ.
Nnipa a wɔfiri Yebus no ka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ, “Worentumi mma ha da biara da.” Nanso, Dawid faa aban a na ɛwɔ Sion a wɔfrɛ no Dawid Kuro no.
Dawid ka kyerɛɛ nʼakodɔm no sɛ, “Mo mu biara a ɔbɛdi anim na yɛakɔto ahyɛ Yebusifoɔ no so no, ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ mʼakodɔm so sahene.” Na Dawid nuabaa Seruia babarima Yoab dii ntohyɛsoɔ no anim, enti ɔbɛyɛɛ Dawid akodɔm so sahene.
Dawid tenaa aban no mu, na ɛno enti na wɔfrɛɛ hɔ Dawid kuro no.
Dawid kyekyeree kuro no, trɛɛ mu firi Milo de twaa ho hyiaeɛ, ɛberɛ a na Yoab nso rekyekyere Yerusalem nkaeɛ no.
Na Dawid tumi yɛɛ kɛseɛ, ɛfiri sɛ, na Asafo Awurade ka ne ho.
Dawid Nnɔmmarima Yeinom ne Dawid nnɔmmarima ntuanofoɔ.
Wɔne Israel nyinaa boom, sii gyinaeɛ sɛ wɔde Dawid bɛyɛ wɔn so ɔhene sɛdeɛ Awurade ahyɛ bɔ afa Israel ho no.
Dawid nnɔmmarima no ho nsɛm nie: Deɛ ɔdi ɛkan no ne Yasobeam, a ɔyɛ Hakmonini a na ɔda Baasa no ano sɛ ɔsahene—Baasa no yɛ nnɔmmarima akatakyie a na wɔwɔ Dawid asraafoɔ mu.
Ɛberɛ bi, ɔde ne pea kunkumm atamfoɔ ahasa wɔ akodie baako mu.
Deɛ ɔtɔ so mmienu wɔ Baasa no mu no yɛ Dodo babarima Eleasa a ɔyɛ Ahoa aseni.
Ɛberɛ a Dawid sɔre tiaa Filistifoɔ wɔ Pas-Damim no, na ɔka ne ho.
Ɔko no sii wɔ baabi a na ɛyɛ atokofuo nko, na Israel asraafoɔ no dwaneeɛ.
Nanso, Eleasa ne Dawid gyinaa wɔn nan so wɔ afuo no mfimfini, bɔɔ Filistifoɔ guiɛ.
Na Awurade maa wɔdii nkonim de gyee wɔn.
Ɛda bi a Dawid wɔ ɔbotan bi a ɛbɛn Adulam ɔbodan ho no, na Filistifoɔ asraadɔm akyere sraban wɔ Refaim bɔnhwa mu.
Baasa no a na wɔka Aduasa no a wɔagye edin wɔ Dawid akodɔm mu no siane kɔhyiaa no wɔ hɔ.
Saa ɛberɛ no, na Dawid te abanbɔeɛ mu hɔ a na Filistifoɔ akodɔm kuo bi akɔtena Betlehem.
Dawid firi akɔnnɔ mu kaeɛ sɛ, “Ao me kɔn dɔ nsu pa a ɛwɔ abura a ɛwɔ Betlehem no bi; deɛ ɛbɛn ɛpono ano no bi.” Enti, Baasa no bɔ wuraa Filistifoɔ no mu, kɔsaa abura no mu nsuo no bi de brɛɛ Dawid.
Nanso, Dawid annom.
Mmom, ɔhwie guu Awurade anim teaam sɛ, “Ɛmpare me sɛ mɛnom saa nsuo yi.
Ɛsom bo te sɛ saa mmarima yi a wɔde wɔn ho bɔɔ afɔdeɛ kɔsa brɛɛ me no mogya.” Enti, Dawid annom.
Yei yɛ Baasa no mmaninsɛm no bi nhwɛsoɔ.
Dawid Nnɔmmarima Aduasa No Yoab nuabarima Abisai na na ɔtua Aduasa no ano.
